@@ -6,43 +6,78 @@ ## t-getting-started | Getting Started
 ## t-getting-started | Getting Started
 [b]Welcome, pilot.[/b]
 
-![](shot:space_hud)
-
-You fly a light fighter in a sector full of raiders. Destroy enemy ships, collect what they drop, sell it at stations, and spend your drachmas on better equipment and technology.
+You are an automaton built by Ephestos, flying a light ship in [b]New Hellas[/b] - star systems in 3D you cross on the Hyperion drive, planets you fly down to and walk, stations you land on by hand, the old monsters in the void.
 
 [b]Your first steps[/b]
-1. Click anywhere in empty space to fly there.
-2. Click a red-marked enemy ship to attack it.
-3. Fly over the glowing loot it drops to collect it.
-4. You start in orbit above [b]Amnissos[/b] - click its LAND button to explore it - near [b]Kephala Outpost[/b]. Land on Amnissos first: [b]Kilon Alios[/b], the hooded wanderer by the landing pad, gives you the story. Click a station to dock, sell loot, and pick up extra jobs under [b]Missions[/b]. A hollow [b]yellow triangle[/b] over their head marks whoever has a quest for you.
-5. Press [b]Tab[/b] any time to open this Ship Computer.
+1. Move the mouse off the middle of the screen: the ship turns. [b]W[/b] opens the throttle.
+2. Press [b]T[/b] with a planet near the middle of your view to target it, then [b]J[/b]: the Hyperion drive takes you there.
+3. Come down low and slow over level ground and press [b]L[/b] to land. [b]E[/b] stands you up; walk down the ramp at the back of your ship.
+4. Back aboard ([b]E[/b] at the foot of the ramp, [b]E[/b] by the seat), take off with [b]L[/b]. Near a station, [b]F[/b] asks for a landing pad.
+5. Press [b]Tab[/b] any time to open the Ship Computer.
 
-## t-the-galaxy | The Galaxy
-[b]New Hellas[/b]: [b]fifty-eight star systems[/b], linked by [b]jump gates[/b] at their edges. Each has a star at its centre, planets on slow orbits, stations, asteroid fields - and an owner.
+## t-flying | Flying
+The mouse is a [b]virtual stick[/b]: the further from the middle (the ring on screen), the faster the ship pitches and turns. [b]C[/b] or the middle button centres it.
 
-![](shot:computer_galaxy)
+• [b]W / S[/b] set the throttle - it stays where you leave it; [b]X[/b] stops.
+• [b]A / D[/b] roll; [b]Shift[/b] boosts.
+• [b]Space / Ctrl[/b] fire the thrusters up and down, [b]Q / E[/b] sideways - for landing on pads.
+• The [b]wheel[/b] moves the camera in and out; hold the [b]right button[/b] to look round.
 
-[b]Four star empires[/b] rebuilt the Greek civilisations among the stars: the [b]Athenian League[/b] (your home), the [b]Spartan Hegemony[/b], the [b]Minoan Thalassocracy[/b] and the [b]Mycenaean Kingdoms[/b]. The [b]Sea Peoples[/b] are raiders who prey on everyone. Each empire has its own ships, stations and architecture.
+The ring round your health gauge is your [b]readout[/b]: compass, speed, the drive, the throttle - and near a planet your latitude, longitude and altitude.
 
-Empires make [b]war and peace[/b] over time and fight over border systems, which can change hands. Systems go through [b]states[/b] - Boom, Bust, Famine, Outbreak, Civil Unrest, Pirate Raids, Expansion - that move prices and danger. Follow it all in the [b]galactic news[/b].
+## t-hyperion | The Hyperion drive
+[b]J[/b] charges it (two seconds), then the ship races across the system at up to 250 km/s.
 
-[b]G[/b] opens the [b]Galaxy map[/b]: click a system and [b]Plot route[/b] - your course is set to the right gate, and after each jump to the next one. Fly into a gate to jump.
+• Target something first ([b]T[/b]): the drive turns you to it - leave the mouse alone - engages once you're lined up, steers round what's in the way, and drops you out about 1.5 km from it.
+• [b]Gravity wells[/b] slow it: near a planet, moon or the star the drive can't go as fast (the readout names the well).
+• Flying too close to anything, or being shot, drops you out. Any planet of a system is seconds to a minute away.
+
+## t-landing | Landing and walking
+Planets are whole worlds of real ground - what you see from orbit is what you land on.
+
+1. Come within 160 m of the ground, slower than 80 m/s, over dry, level ground clear of trees and boulders - [b]L[/b] lands (the readout says why not when it can't).
+2. [b]E[/b] stands you up from the seat. Walk through your ship - its terminals open the Ship Computer's pages - and down the ramp at the back.
+3. [b]W A S D[/b] walk, [b]Shift[/b] runs, [b]Space[/b] jumps, the [b]left button[/b] fires your rifle.
+4. Back up the ramp and [b]E[/b] by the seat to fly again.
+
+Watch out for [b]predators[/b] and [b]pirate camps[/b] (a red light on a mast). The inhabited worlds have [b]towns[/b] - their palaces, houses, people - each with a landing field beside it: from orbit, [b]T[/b] targets a town.
+
+## t-combat | Combat
+The [b]left button[/b] fires your ship's weapons - the ones fitted on its hardpoints; [b]1-9[/b] pick one on the toolbar. With a ship targeted ([b]T[/b]), a ring shows where to aim to hit it.
+
+• [b]Shields[/b] (the blue ring) soak hits and come back after a few seconds; the [b]hull[/b] (red) doesn't - repair it at a station or in the Repair Bay.
+• [b]Pirate raiders[/b] come for you now and then - more in lawless systems. Each one destroyed pays a bounty.
+• Keep away from the [b]star[/b]: its heat burns your shields, then your hull.
+
+## t-monsters | The old monsters
+Every system has its [b]unknown bio-signatures[/b] - markers on your screen with how dangerous they are. Each is a monster's lair: the Void Leviathan, Cetus, Charybdis, Skylla, the Hydra, Cerberus, the Chimera, Echidna or the Minotaur.
+
+• Come near and it comes for you. When its glow gathers, orbs are coming: a ring round you with a gap in the middle (hold still), fans, spirals, blooms.
+• Keep moving, keep firing - hit it anywhere along its body. Its shields come back if you let up.
+• Slain, it pays a bounty - bigger for the harder ones.
+
+## t-stations | Docking at a station
+Stations are kilometres across, with numbered landing pads at the ends of their arms.
+
+1. Near a station, press [b]F[/b]: you're given a pad - it lights up and is marked on your screen.
+2. Fly over it, slow down, and come down on the thrusters ([b]Ctrl[/b] down, [b]Q / E[/b] sideways). The readout shows your height, how far off the pad's middle you are, your speed.
+3. Touch down level and slower than 12 m/s: the pad's lift takes you into the [b]hangar[/b].
+4. Get up, walk down the ramp: the terminals along the back wall ([b]E[/b]) are the station's [b]Market[/b], [b]Repair[/b], [b]Outfitting[/b], [b]Shipyard[/b], [b]Missions[/b] and more.
+5. Back aboard, [b]L[/b] undocks: up the lift and off.
 
 ## t-trading | Trading
 Every station has a live [b]Market[/b]. Stations [b]produce[/b] some goods and [b]need[/b] others; prices follow supply - cheap where goods are made, dear where they're scarce.
 
-![](shot:station_market)
 
 Production chains link the stations: a station short of its inputs (shown in red) slows down - and pays more for them. System states and wars shift demand too (weapons, fuel and medicine sell high in wartime).
 
 [b]NPC traders[/b] fly these routes, each with their own cargo and drachmas - and so can you. Your hold size depends on your ship and its cargo racks.
 
-[b]Sea Peoples raiders[/b] board disabled freighters and steal their cargo. Destroy them and the stolen goods spill out for you to collect - plus a bounty from the system's owner.

 ## t-empires-reputation | Empires & Reputation
 You answer to no empire. Your [b]reputation[/b] with each of them - and with the [b]Independents[/b] - is all that counts, from [b]Hostile[/b] through Unfriendly, Neutral, Cordial and Friendly to [b]Allied[/b] (the station's [b]Reputation[/b] tab shows it).
 
-![](shot:station_reputation)
 
 - It [b]rises[/b] with missions at their stations, trading there (every 10,000 dr bought or sold: +1 - reputation grows slowly) and hunting Sea Peoples raiders in their space.

-[b]The Thread of Ariadne[/b] (talk to [b]Kilon Alios[/b] by the landing pad on Amnissos to take it) is the story of the Atrapos sector - a mystery that leads back to the Minoans of Bronze Age Crete.

-
-## t-flying | Flying
-[b]Moving[/b]
-• Click empty space: the ship turns and flies to that point, slowing down as it arrives. A ring marks the destination.
-• Hold the left button and drag to steer continuously; the cursor hides while you steer.
-
-[b]Camera & minimap[/b]
-• The camera follows your ship.
-• The round minimap (top right) shows you as an arrow, enemies as red dots, and stations as coloured diamonds.

-
-## t-combat | Combat
-[b]Attacking[/b]
-• Click an enemy to lock on - red brackets and its class name appear.
-• If it's out of range, your ship [b]flies into range automatically[/b], then fires on its own.
-• Keep clicking empty space to manoeuvre while firing; the lock stays.
-• Shift + right-click and choose [b]Stop attacking[/b] to stop firing.
-• Click a [b]neutral[/b] ship once to follow it; click it again to attack.
-• [b]Right-click[/b] an asteroid to prospect it: what it's made of and where its veins run - then hold the button on it to cut a vein, keeping its heat in the green. Right-click empty space for the [b]probe scanner[/b] (outfitters sell it): launch probes on the map, draw them in tight and analyze to locate the system's [b]signal sources[/b], ships, planets and stations - then press ENTER at a located beacon (distress calls, pirate attacks, wrecks, alien creatures, anomalies to scan, deadly anomaly fields).

+                                            external/sfx/pirate_spectrograms.png
+
+Takes: <name>_<n>.ogg; Sfx (scripts/sfx.gd) plays a random one, with a little
+random pitch, so repeats don't sound the same. Every take is seeded: the same
+files every run.
+
+The sounds (an evil android pirate with a laser rifle, a tattered coat):
+  shot      the red laser rifle: a falling zap, a crack, a thump      (4 takes)
+  raise     the rifle coming up: a servo whir up and a click           (2)
+  lower     the rifle going down: a servo whir down and a clunk        (2)
+  step      a metal foot: a dull thud and a short clank                (6)
+  hurt      hit: a sizzle and a robotic grunt                          (4)
+  death     power failing: a falling whine, sparks, a crash            (2)
+  taunt     a robot pirate's growled babble, ending in a rolled "arr"  (4)
+  flee      an alarm chirp and a quick, higher babble                  (2)
+  bolt_hit  a red bolt striking: a sizzle and a snap                   (3)
+  loot_drop the loot chest landing: a wooden thud, coins               (1)
+  loot_take picking the loot up: coins and a rising chime              (1)
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import wave
+
+import numpy as np
+
+SR = 44100
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "sounds", "pirate")
+REPORT = os.path.join(ROOT, "external", "sfx")
+
+
+# --- building blocks ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def t_axis(dur):
+    return np.arange(int(dur * SR)) / SR
+
+
+def env_exp(t, attack, decay):
+    """A fast attack (s) and an exponential decay (time constant, s)."""
+    a = np.clip(t / max(attack, 1e-4), 0, 1)
+    return a * np.exp(-np.maximum(t - attack, 0) / decay)
+
+
+def phase_of(freq):
+    """Phase (radians) of an oscillator whose frequency follows the array freq."""
+    return 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(freq) / SR
+
+
+def saw(ph):
+    return 2 * ((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1.0) - 1
+
+
+def square(ph, duty=0.5):
+    return np.where(((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1.0) < duty, 1.0, -1.0)
+
+
+def noise(n, rng):
+    return rng.standard_normal(n)
+
+
+def fft_filter(x, lo=None, hi=None, slope=1.0):
+    """Band-limit x to lo..hi Hz (smooth edges) in the frequency domain."""
+    X = np.fft.rfft(x)
+    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x), 1 / SR)
+    g = np.ones_like(f)
+    if lo:
+        g *= 1 / (1 + (lo / np.maximum(f, 1)) ** (2 * slope))
+    if hi:
+        g *= 1 / (1 + (f / hi) ** (2 * slope))
+    return np.fft.irfft(X * g, len(x))
+
+
+def biquad_bp(x, f0, q, gain=1.0):
+    """A resonant band-pass (RBJ cookbook), f0 may be an array (a moving resonance)."""
+    f0 = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(f0, float), x.shape)
+    y = np.zeros_like(x)
+    x1 = x2 = y1 = y2 = 0.0
+    for i in range(len(x)):
+        w = 2 * np.pi * f0[i] / SR
+        alpha = np.sin(w) / (2 * q)
+        cw = np.cos(w)
+        a0 = 1 + alpha
+        b0, b2 = alpha / a0, -alpha / a0
+        a1, a2 = -2 * cw / a0, (1 - alpha) / a0
+        yi = b0 * x[i] + b2 * x2 - a1 * y1 - a2 * y2
+        x2, x1 = x1, x[i]
+        y2, y1 = y1, yi
+        y[i] = yi
+    return y * gain
+
+
+def metal(t, rng, partials=5, lo=600, hi=4000, decay=(0.04, 0.14), amp=1.0):
+    """A clank: inharmonic partials, each decaying at its own rate."""
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    for _ in range(partials):
+        f = rng.uniform(lo, hi)
+        out += np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + rng.uniform(0, 6.28)) * np.exp(-t / rng.uniform(*decay)) * rng.uniform(0.4, 1.0)
+    return out * amp / partials
+
+
+def thud(t, f=80, decay=0.05, rng=None):
+    """A dull low hit: a falling sine and a little low noise."""
+    ph = phase_of(f * (1 + 1.5 * np.exp(-t / 0.01)))
+    x = np.sin(ph) * np.exp(-t / decay)
+    if rng is not None:
+        x += fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), hi=400) * np.exp(-t / (decay * 0.6)) * 0.6
+    return x
+
+
+def crackle(t, rng, rate=120, dur_each=0.002, amp=1.0):
+    """Electric crackle: random little clicks of filtered noise."""
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    n = int(rate * t[-1]) if len(t) else 0
+    for _ in range(n):
+        i = rng.integers(0, len(t))
+        L = int(dur_each * SR * rng.uniform(0.5, 2))
+        seg = rng.standard_normal(min(L, len(t) - i)) * rng.uniform(0.3, 1.0)
+        out[i:i + len(seg)] += seg * np.exp(-np.arange(len(seg)) / max(L / 3, 1))
+    return fft_filter(out, lo=1500) * amp
+
+
+def place(dst, src, at):
+    i = int(at * SR)
+    n = min(len(src), len(dst) - i)
+    if n > 0:
+        dst[i:i + n] += src[:n]
+    return dst
+
+
+def echo(x, delay=0.07, fb=0.3, taps=3):
+    out = x.copy()
+    d = int(delay * SR)
+    for k in range(1, taps + 1):
+        if d * k < len(x):
+            out[d * k:] += x[:len(x) - d * k] * (fb ** k)
+    return out
+
+
+def robot(x, rng, ring=55.0, crush=0.0):
+    """The android: ring modulation (a metallic voice) and optional bit-crushing."""
+    t = np.arange(len(x)) / SR
+    y = x * (0.55 + 0.45 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ring * t))
+    if crush:
+        steps = 2 ** (16 - crush * 12)
+        y = np.round(y * steps) / steps
+        hold = int(1 + crush * 3)          # (sample-rate reduction too)
+        y = np.repeat(y[::hold], hold)[:len(x)]
+    return y
+
+
+VOWELS = {   # F1, F2, F3 (Hz) - a deep, gruff voice
+    "a": (700, 1150, 2500), "o": (500, 850, 2400), "u": (380, 800, 2300), "e": (500, 1700, 2500),
+    "r": (480, 1150, 1500),   # (a low F3: the growled "r")
+}
+
+
+def voice(dur, pitch, vowels, rng, growl=0.0, breath=0.08):
+    """A buzz (a glottal-ish pulse train at `pitch`, an array or a number) through
+    three formant resonances moving through `vowels` (a list of letters)."""
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    p = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(pitch, float), t.shape).copy()
+    if growl:   # a rough, rolled throat: fast irregular pitch flutter
+        p *= 1 + growl * (0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 28 * t) + 0.5 * fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=15, hi=60) * 3)
+    ph = phase_of(p)
+    src = saw(ph) * 0.7 + square(ph, 0.18) * 0.3
+    src += noise(len(t), rng) * breath
+    # formants moving from vowel to vowel
+    k = np.linspace(0, len(vowels) - 1, len(t))
+    i0 = np.floor(k).astype(int)
+    i1 = np.minimum(i0 + 1, len(vowels) - 1)
+    fr = k - i0
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    for j, (q, g) in enumerate(((5, 1.0), (7, 0.6), (9, 0.35))):
+        fa = np.array([VOWELS[v][j] for v in vowels])
+        f = fa[i0] * (1 - fr) + fa[i1] * fr
+        out += biquad_bp(src, f, q, g)
+    return out / (np.max(np.abs(out)) + 1e-9)     # (resonators leave it quiet: back to full scale)
+
+
+def fade(x, a=0.003, b=0.02):
+    """Fade in / out so no take starts or ends with a click."""
+    n = len(x)
+    na, nb = int(a * SR), int(b * SR)
+    if na:
+        x[:na] *= np.linspace(0, 1, na)
+    if nb:
+        x[n - nb:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, nb)
+    return x
+
+
+def finish(x, peak_db=-1.0):
+    x = x - np.mean(x)
+    x = np.tanh(x / (np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-9) * 1.2)      # (a gentle saturation: denser, no hard clips)
+    x = fade(x)
+    return x / (np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-9) * 10 ** (peak_db / 20)
+
+
+# --- the sounds ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def shot(rng):
+    dur = 0.42
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    top = rng.uniform(2000, 2800)
+    f = top * np.exp(-t / rng.uniform(0.03, 0.045)) + rng.uniform(150, 220)
+    f *= 1 + 0.03 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * rng.uniform(40, 70) * t)      # (a wobble in the beam)
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    beam = (saw(ph) * 0.6 + square(ph, 0.3) * 0.4) * env_exp(t, 0.002, 0.09)
+    beam = fft_filter(beam, lo=120, hi=9000)
+    crack = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=2000, hi=9000) * env_exp(t, 0.0005, 0.012) * 1.2
+    sub = thud(t, 65, 0.06) * 0.8
+    x = beam + crack + sub
+    return echo(x, 0.06, 0.22, 3), -1.5
+
+
+def servo(dur, f0, f1, rng):
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    f = f0 + (f1 - f0) * (t / dur) ** 0.7
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    x = saw(ph) * (0.6 + 0.4 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 32 * t))     # (gear teeth: a fast flutter)
+    x = fft_filter(x, lo=250, hi=3000)
+    return x * np.sin(np.pi * np.clip(t / dur, 0, 1)) ** 0.6
+
+
+def raise_(rng):
+    dur = 0.55
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    x = servo(0.38, rng.uniform(130, 150), rng.uniform(250, 290), rng) * 1.6
+    x = np.pad(x, (0, len(t) - len(x)))
+    click = fft_filter(noise(int(0.008 * SR), rng), lo=2500) * np.exp(-np.arange(int(0.008 * SR)) / 60)
+    place(x, click * 0.9, 0.38)
+    tc = t_axis(0.16)
+    place(x, metal(tc, rng, 4, 1500, 4500, (0.02, 0.06), 0.6), 0.38)
+    return x, -4.0
+
+
+def lower(rng):
+    dur = 0.7
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    x = servo(0.48, rng.uniform(250, 280), rng.uniform(110, 130), rng) * 0.5
+    x = np.pad(x, (0, len(t) - len(x)))
+    tc = t_axis(0.22)
+    place(x, thud(tc, 95, 0.05, rng) * 0.7 + metal(tc, rng, 4, 700, 2500, (0.03, 0.09), 0.6), 0.48)
+    return x, -5.0
+
+
+def step(rng):
+    dur = 0.22
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    x = thud(t, rng.uniform(60, 90), rng.uniform(0.03, 0.05), rng) * 0.9
+    x += metal(t, rng, 5, 500, 3200, (0.015, 0.05), 0.45)
+    grit = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=800, hi=5000) * env_exp(t, 0.001, 0.015) * 0.25   # (gravel)
+    return x + grit, -9.0
+
+
+def hurt(rng):
+    dur = 0.55
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    sizzle = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=1200, hi=9000) * env_exp(t, 0.001, 0.07) * 0.6
+    sizzle += crackle(t, rng, 160, amp=0.5) * np.exp(-t / 0.12)
+    p = rng.uniform(95, 120) * (1 - 0.35 * (t / dur))        # (the grunt falls)
+    v = voice(dur, p, ["a", "u", "u"], rng, growl=0.06)
+    v = robot(v, rng, ring=rng.uniform(45, 70), crush=0.25)
+    v *= env_exp(t, 0.02, 0.18)
+    x = place(sizzle * 0.45, v * 1.0, 0.03)
+    return x, -2.0
+
+
+def death(rng):
+    dur = 1.9
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    f = 520 * np.exp(-t / 0.45) + 35
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    whine = (saw(ph) * 0.5 + np.sin(ph * 2) * 0.3) * np.clip(1.3 - t / 1.4, 0, 1)
+    whine = np.tanh(whine * (1 + 3 * t))                     # (more and more broken)
+    whine = fft_filter(whine, lo=40, hi=6000)
+    sparks = crackle(t, rng, 90, amp=0.7) * np.clip(1.2 - t / 1.6, 0, 1)
+    v = voice(0.7, 110 * np.exp(-t_axis(0.7) / 0.5), ["a", "o", "u"], rng, growl=0.12)
+    v = robot(v, rng, ring=40, crush=0.4) * env_exp(t_axis(0.7), 0.02, 0.3)
+    x = whine * 0.6 + sparks
+    place(x, v * 0.7, 0.02)
+    tc = t_axis(0.6)
+    place(x, thud(tc, 70, 0.09, rng) * 1.0 + metal(tc, rng, 7, 300, 2800, (0.06, 0.25), 0.9), 1.15)   # (the crash)
+    place(x, metal(t_axis(0.3), rng, 4, 900, 3500, (0.03, 0.1), 0.4), 1.33)                         # (a bounce)
+    return echo(x, 0.09, 0.2, 2), -1.0
+
+
+SYLL = [["a", "r"], ["o", "a"], ["u", "a"], ["e", "o"], ["a", "u"], ["o", "r"], ["a", "e"]]
+
+
+def babble(rng, syllables, base, spread, growl_end=True, crush=0.3, ring=None):
+    parts = []
+    for k in range(syllables):
+        d = rng.uniform(0.11, 0.2)
+        tt = t_axis(d)
+        p = base * rng.uniform(1 - spread, 1 + spread) * (1 + 0.15 * np.sin(np.pi * tt / d))   # (each syllable rises and falls)
+        v = voice(d, p, SYLL[rng.integers(len(SYLL))], rng, growl=0.03)
+        v *= np.sin(np.pi * np.clip(tt / d, 0, 1)) ** 0.5
+        cons = fft_filter(noise(int(0.025 * SR), rng), lo=2500, hi=8000) * 0.25 * np.hanning(int(0.025 * SR))
+        parts += [cons * (rng.random() < 0.6), v, np.zeros(int(rng.uniform(0.015, 0.05) * SR))]
+    if growl_end:   # "arrr": a long, rolled growl
+        d = rng.uniform(0.45, 0.6)
+        tt = t_axis(d)
+        v = voice(d, base * 0.85 * (1 - 0.15 * tt / d), ["a", "a", "r", "r", "r"], rng, growl=0.22)
+        parts.append(v * np.minimum(1, (d - tt) / 0.12) * np.minimum(1, tt / 0.02))
+    x = np.concatenate(parts)
+    return robot(x, rng, ring=ring or rng.uniform(35, 60), crush=crush)
+
+
+def taunt(rng):
+    x = babble(rng, int(rng.integers(3, 6)), rng.uniform(85, 105), 0.18)
+    return echo(x, 0.05, 0.15, 2), -2.5
+
+
+def flee(rng):
+    beeps = []
+    for k in range(2):
+        tt = t_axis(0.09)
+        f = 1400 + 900 * tt / 0.09 if k == 0 else 1900 + 900 * tt / 0.09
+        beeps.append(square(phase_of(np.full(len(tt), 1.0) * f), 0.4) * np.hanning(len(tt)) * 0.35)
+        beeps.append(np.zeros(int(0.03 * SR)))
+    x = np.concatenate(beeps + [babble(rng, 3, rng.uniform(140, 160), 0.2, growl_end=False, crush=0.2, ring=70)])
+    return x, -5.0
+
+
+def bolt_hit(rng):
+    dur = 0.32
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    snap = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=1500, hi=10000) * env_exp(t, 0.0005, 0.02)
+    f = 1800 * np.exp(-t / 0.02) + 300
+    zap = square(phase_of(f), 0.35) * env_exp(t, 0.001, 0.04) * 0.4
+    fizz = crackle(t, rng, 220, amp=0.6) * np.exp(-t / 0.08)
+    return snap + zap + fizz, -3.0
+
+
+def coins(t_len, rng, n=7, start=0.0):
+    x = np.zeros(int(t_len * SR))
+    at = start
+    for k in range(n):
+        tt = t_axis(0.25)
+        ting = sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * tt) * np.exp(-tt / rng.uniform(0.04, 0.1))
+                   for f in rng.uniform(3200, 7800, 3)) / 3
+        place(x, ting * rng.uniform(0.3, 0.8), at)
+        at += rng.uniform(0.02, 0.07)
+    return x
+
+
+def loot_drop(rng):
+    dur = 0.8
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    tc = t_axis(0.4)
+    wood = biquad_bp(noise(len(tc), rng), 190, 4) * env_exp(tc, 0.001, 0.05) * 1.2 + thud(tc, 85, 0.05) * 0.8
+    x = np.zeros_like(t)
+    place(x, wood, 0.0)
+    x += coins(dur, rng, 8, 0.03)
+    return x, -3.0
+
+
+def loot_take(rng):
+    dur = 0.9
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    x = coins(dur, rng, 6, 0.0) * 0.8
+    for k, f in enumerate((880, 1109, 1319, 1760)):            # (a rising arpeggio)
+        tt = t_axis(0.35)
+        ch = (np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * tt) + 0.3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * f * tt)) * env_exp(tt, 0.003, 0.12) * 0.45
+        place(x, ch, 0.06 + k * 0.07)
+    return x, -4.0
+
+
+SOUNDS = [("shot", shot, 4), ("raise", raise_, 2), ("lower", lower, 2), ("step", step, 6), ("hurt", hurt, 4),
+          ("death", death, 2), ("taunt", taunt, 4), ("flee", flee, 2), ("bolt_hit", bolt_hit, 3),
+          ("loot_drop", loot_drop, 1), ("loot_take", loot_take, 1)]
+
+
+# --- writing and analysing ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def write_ogg(x, path):
+    pcm = (np.clip(x, -1, 1) * 32767).astype("<i2")
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as fh:
+        tmp = fh.name
+    with wave.open(tmp, "wb") as w:
+        w.setnchannels(1)
+        w.setsampwidth(2)
+        w.setframerate(SR)
+        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
+    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", tmp, "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "5", path], check=True)
+    os.remove(tmp)
+
+
+def analyse(x):
+    db = lambda v: 20 * np.log10(max(v, 1e-9))
+    peak = np.max(np.abs(x))
+    rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2))
+    # loudness over the loudest 100 ms (what the ear judges a short effect by)
+    w = int(0.1 * SR)
+    win = np.sqrt(np.convolve(x ** 2, np.ones(w) / w, mode="valid")) if len(x) > w else np.array([rms])
+    X = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x))
+    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x), 1 / SR)
+    centroid = float(np.sum(f * X) / (np.sum(X) + 1e-9))
+    lowshare = float(np.sum(X[f < 250] ** 2) / (np.sum(X ** 2) + 1e-9))
+    return {"dur": len(x) / SR, "peak_db": db(peak), "rms_db": db(rms), "loud100_db": db(np.max(win)),
+            "crest_db": db(peak) - db(rms), "centroid_hz": centroid, "low_share": lowshare,
+            "dc": float(np.mean(x)), "edge": float(max(abs(x[0]), abs(x[-1])))}
+
+
+def spectrogram(x, w=360, h=120):
+    n = 1024
+    hop = max(1, (len(x) - n) // w)
+    cols = []
+    win = np.hanning(n)
+    for i in range(w):
+        seg = x[i * hop:i * hop + n]
+        if len(seg) < n:
+            seg = np.pad(seg, (0, n - len(seg)))
+        cols.append(np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg * win)))
+    S = np.array(cols).T                                         # (freq x time)
+    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1 / SR)
+    rows = np.geomspace(40, 16000, h)                            # (log frequency, low at the bottom)
+    idx = np.clip(np.searchsorted(f, rows), 0, len(f) - 1)
+    S = 20 * np.log10(S[idx] + 1e-6)
+    S = np.clip((S - (S.max() - 70)) / 70, 0, 1)[::-1]
+    return S
+
+
+def sheet(takes, path):
+    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+    W, H, cols = 360, 120, 4
+    rows = (len(takes) + cols - 1) // cols
+    img = Image.new("RGB", (cols * (W + 10) + 10, rows * (H + 34) + 10), (14, 12, 20))
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    for i, (name, x) in enumerate(takes):
+        S = spectrogram(x, W, H)
+        rgb = np.stack([np.clip(S * 2.2 - 0.6, 0, 1), np.clip(S * 1.6 - 0.15, 0, 1) ** 1.3, np.clip(S * 1.3, 0, 1) ** 0.6], -1)
+        tile = Image.fromarray((rgb * 255).astype(np.uint8))
+        cx, cy = 10 + (i % cols) * (W + 10), 10 + (i // cols) * (H + 34)
+        img.paste(tile, (cx, cy + 20))
+        d.text((cx, cy + 4), "%s  (%.2f s)" % (name, len(x) / SR), fill=(235, 220, 190))
+    img.save(path)
+
+
+def main():
+    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

+pitch sweeps, filtered noise, inharmonic metal partials, a formant "voice"

+then faded in/out (no clicks), normalised and written as OGG Vorbis.
+
+  python3 tools/sfx_pirate.py            -> sounds/pirate/*.ogg (several takes of each)
+                                            external/sfx/pirate_analysis.md (a table)
+                                            external/sfx/pirate_spectrograms.png
+
+Takes: <name>_<n>.ogg; Sfx (scripts/core/sfx.gd) plays a random one, with a little
+random pitch, so repeats don't sound the same. Every take is seeded: the same
+files every run.
+
+The sounds (an evil android pirate with a laser rifle, a tattered coat):
+  shot      the red laser rifle: a falling zap, a crack, a thump      (4 takes)
+  raise     the rifle coming up: a servo whir up and a click           (2)
+  lower     the rifle going down: a servo whir down and a clunk        (2)
+  step      a metal foot: a dull thud and a short clank                (6)
+  hurt      hit: a sizzle and a robotic grunt                          (4)
+  death     power failing: a falling whine, sparks, a crash            (2)
+  taunt     a robot pirate's growled babble, ending in a rolled "arr"  (4)
+  flee      an alarm chirp and a quick, higher babble                  (2)
+  bolt_hit  a red bolt striking: a sizzle and a snap                   (3)
+  loot_drop the loot chest landing: a wooden thud, coins               (1)
+  loot_take picking the loot up: coins and a rising chime              (1)

+import numpy as np

+SR = 44100
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "sounds", "pirate")

+# --- building blocks ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def t_axis(dur):
+    return np.arange(int(dur * SR)) / SR
+
+
+def env_exp(t, attack, decay):
+    """A fast attack (s) and an exponential decay (time constant, s)."""
+    a = np.clip(t / max(attack, 1e-4), 0, 1)
+    return a * np.exp(-np.maximum(t - attack, 0) / decay)
+
+
+def phase_of(freq):
+    """Phase (radians) of an oscillator whose frequency follows the array freq."""
+    return 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(freq) / SR
+
+
+def saw(ph):
+    return 2 * ((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1.0) - 1
+
+
+def square(ph, duty=0.5):
+    return np.where(((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1.0) < duty, 1.0, -1.0)
+
+
+def noise(n, rng):
+    return rng.standard_normal(n)
+
+
+def fft_filter(x, lo=None, hi=None, slope=1.0):
+    """Band-limit x to lo..hi Hz (smooth edges) in the frequency domain."""
+    X = np.fft.rfft(x)
+    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x), 1 / SR)
+    g = np.ones_like(f)
+    if lo:
+        g *= 1 / (1 + (lo / np.maximum(f, 1)) ** (2 * slope))
+    if hi:
+        g *= 1 / (1 + (f / hi) ** (2 * slope))
+    return np.fft.irfft(X * g, len(x))
+
+
+def biquad_bp(x, f0, q, gain=1.0):
+    """A resonant band-pass (RBJ cookbook), f0 may be an array (a moving resonance)."""
+    f0 = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(f0, float), x.shape)
+    y = np.zeros_like(x)
+    x1 = x2 = y1 = y2 = 0.0
+    for i in range(len(x)):
+        w = 2 * np.pi * f0[i] / SR
+        alpha = np.sin(w) / (2 * q)
+        cw = np.cos(w)
+        a0 = 1 + alpha
+        b0, b2 = alpha / a0, -alpha / a0
+        a1, a2 = -2 * cw / a0, (1 - alpha) / a0
+        yi = b0 * x[i] + b2 * x2 - a1 * y1 - a2 * y2
+        x2, x1 = x1, x[i]
+        y2, y1 = y1, yi
+        y[i] = yi
+    return y * gain
+
+
+def metal(t, rng, partials=5, lo=600, hi=4000, decay=(0.04, 0.14), amp=1.0):
+    """A clank: inharmonic partials, each decaying at its own rate."""
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    for _ in range(partials):
+        f = rng.uniform(lo, hi)
+        out += np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + rng.uniform(0, 6.28)) * np.exp(-t / rng.uniform(*decay)) * rng.uniform(0.4, 1.0)
+    return out * amp / partials
+
+
+def thud(t, f=80, decay=0.05, rng=None):
+    """A dull low hit: a falling sine and a little low noise."""
+    ph = phase_of(f * (1 + 1.5 * np.exp(-t / 0.01)))
+    x = np.sin(ph) * np.exp(-t / decay)
+    if rng is not None:
+        x += fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), hi=400) * np.exp(-t / (decay * 0.6)) * 0.6
+    return x
+
+
+def crackle(t, rng, rate=120, dur_each=0.002, amp=1.0):
+    """Electric crackle: random little clicks of filtered noise."""
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    n = int(rate * t[-1]) if len(t) else 0
+    for _ in range(n):
+        i = rng.integers(0, len(t))
+        L = int(dur_each * SR * rng.uniform(0.5, 2))
+        seg = rng.standard_normal(min(L, len(t) - i)) * rng.uniform(0.3, 1.0)
+        out[i:i + len(seg)] += seg * np.exp(-np.arange(len(seg)) / max(L / 3, 1))
+    return fft_filter(out, lo=1500) * amp
+
+
+def place(dst, src, at):
+    i = int(at * SR)
+    n = min(len(src), len(dst) - i)
+    if n > 0:
+        dst[i:i + n] += src[:n]
+    return dst
+
+
+def echo(x, delay=0.07, fb=0.3, taps=3):
+    out = x.copy()
+    d = int(delay * SR)
+    for k in range(1, taps + 1):
+        if d * k < len(x):
+            out[d * k:] += x[:len(x) - d * k] * (fb ** k)
+    return out
+
+
+def robot(x, rng, ring=55.0, crush=0.0):
+    """The android: ring modulation (a metallic voice) and optional bit-crushing."""
+    t = np.arange(len(x)) / SR
+    y = x * (0.55 + 0.45 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ring * t))
+    if crush:
+        steps = 2 ** (16 - crush * 12)
+        y = np.round(y * steps) / steps
+        hold = int(1 + crush * 3)          # (sample-rate reduction too)
+        y = np.repeat(y[::hold], hold)[:len(x)]
+    return y
+
+
+VOWELS = {   # F1, F2, F3 (Hz) - a deep, gruff voice
+    "a": (700, 1150, 2500), "o": (500, 850, 2400), "u": (380, 800, 2300), "e": (500, 1700, 2500),
+    "r": (480, 1150, 1500),   # (a low F3: the growled "r")
+}
+
+
+def voice(dur, pitch, vowels, rng, growl=0.0, breath=0.08):
+    """A buzz (a glottal-ish pulse train at `pitch`, an array or a number) through
+    three formant resonances moving through `vowels` (a list of letters)."""
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    p = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(pitch, float), t.shape).copy()
+    if growl:   # a rough, rolled throat: fast irregular pitch flutter
+        p *= 1 + growl * (0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 28 * t) + 0.5 * fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=15, hi=60) * 3)
+    ph = phase_of(p)
+    src = saw(ph) * 0.7 + square(ph, 0.18) * 0.3
+    src += noise(len(t), rng) * breath
+    # formants moving from vowel to vowel
+    k = np.linspace(0, len(vowels) - 1, len(t))
+    i0 = np.floor(k).astype(int)
+    i1 = np.minimum(i0 + 1, len(vowels) - 1)
+    fr = k - i0
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    for j, (q, g) in enumerate(((5, 1.0), (7, 0.6), (9, 0.35))):
+        fa = np.array([VOWELS[v][j] for v in vowels])
+        f = fa[i0] * (1 - fr) + fa[i1] * fr
+        out += biquad_bp(src, f, q, g)
+    return out / (np.max(np.abs(out)) + 1e-9)     # (resonators leave it quiet: back to full scale)
+
+
+def fade(x, a=0.003, b=0.02):
+    """Fade in / out so no take starts or ends with a click."""
+    n = len(x)
+    na, nb = int(a * SR), int(b * SR)
+    if na:
+        x[:na] *= np.linspace(0, 1, na)
+    if nb:
+        x[n - nb:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, nb)
+    return x
+
+
+def finish(x, peak_db=-1.0):
+    x = x - np.mean(x)
+    x = np.tanh(x / (np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-9) * 1.2)      # (a gentle saturation: denser, no hard clips)
+    x = fade(x)
+    return x / (np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-9) * 10 ** (peak_db / 20)
+

+def shot(rng):

+    ph = phase_of(f)

+    sub = thud(t, 65, 0.06) * 0.8

+
+
+def servo(dur, f0, f1, rng):

+    x = fft_filter(x, lo=250, hi=3000)
+    return x * np.sin(np.pi * np.clip(t / dur, 0, 1)) ** 0.6
+

+

+
+def step(rng):

+
+def hurt(rng):

+    t = t_axis(dur)

+SYLL = [["a", "r"], ["o", "a"], ["u", "a"], ["e", "o"], ["a", "u"], ["o", "r"], ["a", "e"]]

+def babble(rng, syllables, base, spread, growl_end=True, crush=0.3, ring=None):
+    parts = []
+    for k in range(syllables):
+        d = rng.uniform(0.11, 0.2)
+        tt = t_axis(d)
+        p = base * rng.uniform(1 - spread, 1 + spread) * (1 + 0.15 * np.sin(np.pi * tt / d))   # (each syllable rises and falls)
+        v = voice(d, p, SYLL[rng.integers(len(SYLL))], rng, growl=0.03)

+        tt = t_axis(d)
+        v = voice(d, base * 0.85 * (1 - 0.15 * tt / d), ["a", "a", "r", "r", "r"], rng, growl=0.22)
+        parts.append(v * np.minimum(1, (d - tt) / 0.12) * np.minimum(1, tt / 0.02))

+def write_ogg(x, path):
+    pcm = (np.clip(x, -1, 1) * 32767).astype("<i2")
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as fh:
+        tmp = fh.name
+    with wave.open(tmp, "wb") as w:

+        w.setsampwidth(2)
+        w.setframerate(SR)
+        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
+    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", tmp, "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "5", path], check=True)
+    os.remove(tmp)

+def analyse(x):

+		"S": ["#######", "##.....", "##.....", "#######", ".....##", ".....##", "#######"],

+## LiveLink: the running game's door for live coding (development only).
+## Off unless the game is a debug run started with the user arg --live
+## (godot --path . -- --live[=PORT]); then it listens on 127.0.0.1:6070 (or
+## PORT) - only this machine can connect. Driven by tools/live.py.
+##
+## Protocol: one JSON object per line in, one JSON reply per line out:
+##   {"cmd": "...", ...}  ->  {"ok": true, "result": ...} | {"ok": false, "error": "..."}
+## Commands:
+##   ping                          - "pong", the game's pid and fps
+##   state                         - a snapshot: ship, the signal, enemies, fps
+##   eval   {expr}                 - a GDScript expression (Expression); names:
+##                                   main, ship, site, root, tree, live
+##   set    {target, prop, value}  - target/value are expressions; prop may be
+##                                   an indexed path ("position:x")
+##   run    {code}                 - GDScript statements, compiled into a
+##                                   throwaway script's run() (may await; the
+##                                   same names as eval); or a whole script
+##                                   source that has its own func run()
+##   reload {paths}                - hot reload scripts (keeping every live
+##                                   object's state) / shaders / other resources
+##   watch  {on}                   - hot reload changed files automatically
+##   events {since}                - the log since seq `since` (errors, prints,
+##                                   reloads, deaths)
+##   tree   {path, depth}          - the node tree under a node
+##   shot   {path}                 - a screenshot (PNG) of the game's view
+##   pause  {on} / speed {scale}   - pause the game / Engine.time_scale
+##   inspect {expr}                - open the Inspector window on an object
+##
+## In any debug run (with or without --live), Alt + right-click opens the
+## developer menu: inspect the thing under the cursor, the Inspector window
+## (DevInspector - live values, right of the game's window), pause, game
+## speed, hot reload on / off.
+
+const PORT := 6070
+var watch_dirs := ["res://scripts", "res://scripts/pages", "res://shaders", "res://data", "res://data/sprites"]

+## a changed one is cut again (tools/extract_sprites.py, on a thread) - its new
+## pieces then come in through data/sprites like any changed picture.
+const SHEETS_DIR := "res://external/images"
+const SHEET_MATCH := "tile_sheet"
+var _cutting := {}                 # sheet -> Thread
+const WATCH_EXT := ["gd", "gdshader", "png", "json"]

+var enabled := false
+var port := PORT
+var auto_reload := true
+var _server: TCPServer
+var _clients: Array = []           # [{peer, buf}]
+var _events: Array = []            # [{seq, t, kind, text}]
+var _seq := 0
+var _mutex := Mutex.new()
+var _mtimes := {}                  # watched file -> modified time
+var _watch_t := 0.0
+var dev := false                   # the developer menu (any debug run)
+var inspector: Window   # (DevInspector)
+var _menu: PopupMenu
+var _speeds: PopupMenu
+var _picked: Array = []            # menu id -> object to inspect
+
+
+## --live / --live=PORT among the user args (after --), in a debug run.
+static func live_arg() -> int:
+	if not OS.is_debug_build():
+		return 0
+	for a in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
+		if a == "--live":
+			return PORT
+		if a.begins_with("--live="):
+			return int(a.trim_prefix("--live="))
+	return 0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	dev = OS.is_debug_build()
+	set_process_input(dev)
+	port = live_arg()
+	if port <= 0:
+		auto_reload = false
+		set_process(false)
+		return
+	start(port)
+
+
+func start(p: int) -> Error:
+	_server = TCPServer.new()
+	var err := _server.listen(p, "127.0.0.1")
+	if err != OK:
+		push_warning("LiveLink: can't listen on port %d (%s)" % [p, error_string(err)])
+		_server = null
+		return err
+	port = p
+	enabled = true
+	set_process(true)
+	OS.add_logger(_Log.new(self))
+	_scan(true)
+	print("LiveLink: listening on 127.0.0.1:%d" % p)
+	return OK
+
+
+func stop() -> void:
+	for c in _clients:
+		c["peer"].disconnect_from_host()
+	_clients.clear()
+	if _server:
+		_server.stop()
+	_server = null
+	enabled = false
+	set_process(false)
+
+
+# --- The log ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A line in the event log (thread safe - the logger calls it from any thread).
+func event(kind: String, text: String) -> void:
+	_mutex.lock()
+	_seq += 1
+	_events.append({"seq": _seq, "t": snappedf(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0, 0.01), "kind": kind, "text": text})
+	if _events.size() > MAX_EVENTS:
+		_events = _events.slice(_events.size() - MAX_EVENTS)
+	_mutex.unlock()
+
+
+func events_since(since: int) -> Array:
+	_mutex.lock()
+	var out := _events.filter(func(e): return e["seq"] > since)
+	_mutex.unlock()
+	return out.slice(maxi(0, out.size() - 400))   # (the latest - a reply carries 500 at most)
+
+
+## Godot's log (prints, warnings, errors with their script place) into events.
+class _Log extends Logger:
+	var link: WeakRef
+
+	func _init(l: Node) -> void:
+		link = weakref(l)
+
+	func _log_message(message: String, error: bool) -> void:
+		var l = link.get_ref()
+		if l and not message.begins_with("LiveLink"):
+			l.event("error" if error else "print", message.strip_edges(false, true))
+
+	func _log_error(function: String, file: String, line: int, code: String, rationale: String,
+			_editor_notify: bool, error_type: int, script_backtraces: Array[ScriptBacktrace]) -> void:
+		var l = link.get_ref()
+		if l == null:
+			return
+		var where := "%s:%d (%s)" % [file, line, function]
+		# (a parse error names the script and line itself; else: where the script was)
+		for bt in script_backtraces if not file.begins_with("res://") else []:
+			if bt.get_frame_count() > 0:
+				where = "%s:%d (%s)" % [bt.get_frame_file(0), bt.get_frame_line(0), bt.get_frame_function(0)]
+				break
+		var kind := "warning" if error_type == ERROR_TYPE_WARNING else "error"
+		l.event(kind, "%s - %s" % [rationale if rationale != "" else code, where.replace("::trial", "")])
+
+
+# --- The connection --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if auto_reload:
+		_watch_t -= delta
+		if _watch_t <= 0.0:
+			_watch_t = 0.5
+			_scan(false)
+	if _server == null:
+		return
+	while _server.is_connection_available():
+		var peer := _server.take_connection()
+		peer.set_no_delay(true)
+		_clients.append({"peer": peer, "buf": PackedByteArray()})
+	for c in _clients.duplicate():
+		var peer: StreamPeerTCP = c["peer"]
+		peer.poll()
+		if peer.get_status() != StreamPeerTCP.STATUS_CONNECTED:
+			_clients.erase(c)
+			continue
+		var n := peer.get_available_bytes()
+		if n > 0:
+			c["buf"].append_array(peer.get_data(n)[1])
+		var nl: int = c["buf"].find(10)
+		while nl >= 0:
+			var line: String = c["buf"].slice(0, nl).get_string_from_utf8()
+			c["buf"] = c["buf"].slice(nl + 1)
+			nl = c["buf"].find(10)
+			if line.strip_edges() != "":
+				_serve(peer, line)
+
+
+func _serve(peer: StreamPeerTCP, line: String) -> void:
+	var req: Variant = JSON.parse_string(line)
+	var reply: Dictionary
+	if not (req is Dictionary) or not req.has("cmd"):
+		reply = {"ok": false, "error": "not a JSON command: " + line.left(80)}
+	else:
+		reply = await handle(req)
+	if peer.get_status() == StreamPeerTCP.STATUS_CONNECTED:
+		peer.put_data((JSON.stringify(reply) + "\n").to_utf8_buffer())
+
+
+## One command (see the header); a coroutine (run may await).
+func handle(req: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var cmd: String = req["cmd"]
+	match cmd:
+		"ping":
+			return _ok({"pong": true, "pid": OS.get_process_id(), "fps": Engine.get_frames_per_second(), "port": port})
+		"state":
+			return _ok(snapshot())
+		"eval":
+			return _eval(str(req.get("expr", "")))
+		"set":
+			return _set_cmd(req)
+		"run":
+			return await _run(str(req.get("code", "")))
+		"reload":
+			return _ok(reload(req.get("paths", [])))
+		"watch":
+			set_auto_reload(bool(req.get("on", true)))
+			return _ok({"auto_reload": auto_reload})
+		"inspect":
+			var r := _expr(str(req.get("expr", "ship")))
+			if not r[0] or not (r[1] is Object):
+				return _err("not an object: " + str(r[1]))
+			open_inspector(r[1])
+			return _ok(inspector.target)
+		"events":
+			return _ok({"events": events_since(int(req.get("since", 0))), "last": _seq})
+		"tree":
+			var n := _node(str(req.get("path", "")))
+			if n == null:
+				return _err("no node " + str(req.get("path", "")))
+			return _ok(_tree(n, int(req.get("depth", 2))))
+		"shot":
+			return _shot(str(req.get("path", "user://live_shot.png")))
+		"pause":
+			get_tree().paused = bool(req.get("on", not get_tree().paused))
+			return _ok({"paused": get_tree().paused})
+		"speed":
+			Engine.time_scale = clampf(float(req.get("scale", 1.0)), 0.0, 20.0)
+			return _ok({"time_scale": Engine.time_scale})
+	return _err("unknown command " + cmd)
+
+
+func _ok(result: Variant) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"ok": true, "result": jsonable(result)}
+
+
+func _err(msg: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"ok": false, "error": msg}
+
+
+# --- Names for eval / run ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The game scene (Main) - the current scene, or wherever a script put it.
+func main() -> Node:
+	var cs := get_tree().current_scene
+	if cs and cs.has_method("enter_site"):
+		return cs
+	for c in get_tree().root.get_children():
+		if c.has_method("enter_site"):
+			return c
+	return null
+
+
+func _names() -> Dictionary:
+	var m := main()
+	var d := {}
+	for c in get_tree().root.get_children():   # the autoloads (Galaxy, Settings, ...)
+		if c != m and ProjectSettings.has_setting("autoload/" + str(c.name)):
+			d[str(c.name)] = c
+	for s in ["Engine", "Input", "OS", "Time", "DisplayServer", "ResourceLoader", "ProjectSettings"]:
+		d[s] = Engine.get_singleton(s)
+	for c in ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list():   # (the game's classes: MinoanTiles, Galaxy's types...)
+		if not d.has(c["class"]) and ResourceLoader.has_cached(c["path"]):
+			d[c["class"]] = load(c["path"])
+	d.merge({
+		"main": m,
+		"ship": m.get("ship") if m else null,
+		"site": m.get("site") if m else null,
+		"root": get_tree().root,
+		"tree": get_tree(),
+		"live": self,
+	}, true)
+	return d
+
+
+## A node by alias (main, ship, site) or path (from root or from Main).
+func _node(path: String) -> Node:
+	var names := _names()
+	if path == "" or path == "root":
+		return get_tree().root
+	var head := path.get_slice("/", 0)
+	if names.get(head) is Node:
+		var base: Node = names[head]
+		var rest := path.substr(head.length()).trim_prefix("/")
+		return base if rest == "" else base.get_node_or_null(rest)
+	var n := get_tree().root.get_node_or_null(path)
+	if n == null and names["main"]:
+		n = names["main"].get_node_or_null(path)
+	return n
+
+
+func _expr(code: String) -> Array:   # [ok, value or error]
+	var names := _names()
+	var e := Expression.new()
+	if e.parse(code, PackedStringArray(names.keys())) != OK:
+		return [false, e.get_error_text()]
+	var v: Variant = e.execute(names.values(), self, false)
+	if e.has_execute_failed():
+		return [false, "failed: " + e.get_error_text()]
+	return [true, v]
+
+
+func _eval(code: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var r := _expr(code)
+	return _ok(r[1]) if r[0] else _err(r[1])
+
+
+func _set_cmd(req: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var t := _expr(str(req.get("target", "")))
+	if not t[0]:
+		return _err("target: " + str(t[1]))
+	if not (t[1] is Object):
+		return _err("target is not an object: " + str(t[1]))
+	var v := _expr(str(req.get("value", "null")))
+	if not v[0]:
+		return _err("value: " + str(v[1]))
+	var obj: Object = t[1]
+	var prop := str(req.get("prop", ""))
+	obj.set_indexed(NodePath(prop), v[1])
+	return _ok(obj.get_indexed(NodePath(prop)))
+
+
+var _run_n := 0
+## The snippets' scripts and objects, kept for the whole run: freeing a script
+## whose code made lambdas crashes Godot 4.7 (double free) a run or two later.
+var _runs: Array = []
+
+## Statements -> a throwaway script: func run() with main/ship/site/... set.
+func _run(code: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var src := code
+	if not code.contains("func run("):
+		var body := ""
+		for l in code.split("\n"):
+			body += "\t" + l + "\n"
+		src = "func run():\n" + body + "\treturn null\n"
+	if not src.begins_with("extends"):
+		src = "extends RefCounted\nvar main\nvar ship\nvar site\nvar root\nvar tree\nvar live\n\n" + src
+	var s := GDScript.new()
+	s.source_code = src
+	_run_n += 1
+	var err := s.reload()
+	if err != OK:
+		return _err("doesn't compile (%s) - see the events for the line" % error_string(err))
+	var obj: Object = s.new()
+	_runs.append([s, obj])
+	for k in _names():
+		if k in obj:
+			obj.set(k, _names()[k])
+	var v: Variant = await obj.run()
+	return _ok(v)
+
+
+# --- Hot reload --------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Reload scripts (live objects keep their state and get the new code -
+## subclasses that are loaded are reloaded after their bases), shaders (their
+## code, so every material using them updates) and other resources (in place).
+func reload(paths: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var done := []
+	var failed := []
+	var scripts := []
+	for p in paths:
+		p = _res_path(str(p))
+		if p.ends_with(".gd"):
+			scripts.append(p)
+		elif not ResourceLoader.has_cached(p):
+			continue   # (not loaded - the game reads it fresh when it needs it)
+		elif p.ends_with(".gdshader"):
+			var sh: Shader = load(p)
+			sh.code = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(p)
+			done.append(p)
+		else:
+			ResourceLoader.load(p, "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REPLACE)
+			done.append(p)
+	# Loaded scripts that extend a changed one reload with it (base first).
+	var all := scripts.duplicate()
+	for p in _loaded_scripts():
+		if p in all:
+			continue
+		var s: Script = load(p)
+		var b := s.get_base_script()
+		while b:
+			if b.resource_path in scripts:
+				all.append(p)
+				break
+			b = b.get_base_script()
+	all.sort_custom(func(a, b): return _depth(a) < _depth(b))
+	for p in all:
+		if not ResourceLoader.has_cached(p):
+			continue
+		if p == get_script().resource_path:
+			continue   # (not itself - it's running the reload; restart for that)
+		var s: GDScript = load(p)
+		if _base_failed(s, failed):
+			continue
+		var src := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(p)
+		# Compile it on the side first: broken code mustn't break the live script.
+		if not compiles(src, p):
+			failed.append(p)
+			continue
+		var before := _member_names(s)
+		s.source_code = src
+		if s.reload(true) == OK:
+			done.append(p)
+			var added := _member_names(s).filter(func(n): return not before.has(n))
+			if not added.is_empty():
+				_init_members(s, added)
+		else:
+			failed.append(p)
+	_rebuild_buildings(paths.map(func(x): return _res_path(str(x))), done)
+	if not done.is_empty():
+		event("reload", "reloaded " + ", ".join(done.map(func(x): return x.get_file())))
+	if not failed.is_empty():
+		event("error", "reload failed (kept the old code): " + ", ".join(failed))
+	return {"reloaded": done, "failed": failed}
+
+
+## Whether GDScript source compiles (its class_name blanked out - a scratch
+## copy may not take the real one's name; the errors go to the log with the
+## real file's line numbers).
+static func compiles(src: String, path: String) -> bool:
+	var lines := src.split("\n")
+	for i in lines.size():
+		if lines[i].begins_with("class_name "):
+			lines[i] = ""
+	var t := GDScript.new()
+	t.source_code = "\n".join(lines)
+	t.take_over_path(path + "::trial")
+	return t.reload() == OK
+
+
+func _base_failed(s: Script, failed: Array) -> bool:
+	var b := s.get_base_script()
+	while b:
+		if b.resource_path in failed:
+			return true
+		b = b.get_base_script()
+	return false
+
+
+## Buildings: tile pieces' pictures changed (data/sprites/tile_*.png) or the
+## building styles did (minoan_tiles.gd reloaded) - fresh pieces, and every
+## building holder (planet surfaces, the Library: group "hot_buildings") reskinned.
+func _rebuild_buildings(paths: Array, reloaded: Array) -> void:
+	var tiles := paths.filter(func(p): return p.get_file().begins_with("tile_") and p.ends_with(".png"))
+	var styles := reloaded.any(func(p): return p.ends_with("minoan_tiles.gd"))
+	if tiles.is_empty() and not styles:
+		return
+	var mt: Script = load("res://scripts/minoan_tiles.gd")
+	mt.hot_reload(tiles)
+	var n := 0
+	for h in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("hot_buildings"):
+		if h.has_method("reskin_buildings"):
+			n += int(h.reskin_buildings())
+	event("reload", "buildings: %d tile picture(s)%s - %d piece(s) redone" % [tiles.size(), " and the styles" if styles else "", n])
+
+
+func _member_names(s: Script) -> Array:
+	return s.get_script_property_list().map(func(p): return p["name"])
+
+
+## Variables a reload added are null in the objects that already existed:
+## give them their declared defaults (in every node of the tree with that
+## script or one extending it - nodes are what lives; the rest can't be
+## found).
+func _init_members(s: Script, names: Array) -> void:
+	var n_set := 0
+	var stack: Array = [get_tree().root]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		stack.append_array(n.get_children(true))
+		var ns: Script = n.get_script()
+		while ns and ns != s:
+			ns = ns.get_base_script()
+		if ns == null:
+			continue
+		var decl: Dictionary = preload("res://scripts/dev_inspector.gd").declared_defaults(s)
+		for m in names:
+			if typeof(n.get(m)) == TYPE_NIL:
+				var d: Variant = decl.get(m, s.get_property_default_value(m))
+				if d is Array or d is Dictionary:
+					d = d.duplicate(true)
+				if d != null:
+					n.set(m, d)
+					n_set += 1

+		event("reload", "gave %d new variable(s) of %s their defaults in live objects" % [n_set, s.resource_path.get_file()])

+				continue

+			_mtimes[p] = t

+		reload(changed)

+			continue
+		var p := SHEETS_DIR.path_join(f)

+	var th := Thread.new()
+	_cutting[f] = th
+	th.start(func():
+		var out := []
+		var code := OS.execute("python3", [ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://tools/extract_sprites.py"), f], out, true)

+## The game object under a screen point: the nearest scripted Node2D in the

+func pick_at(screen: Vector2) -> Node2D:
+	var m := main()
+	var vp := get_viewport()
+	if m == null:
+		return null
+	var ct := vp.get_canvas_transform()
+	var world := ct.affine_inverse() * screen
+	var zoom := ct.get_scale().x
+	var world_canvas := vp.find_world_2d().canvas
+	var best: Node2D = null
+	var best_d := INF
+	var stack: Array = [m]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		for c in n.get_children():
+			if c is CanvasLayer or c is Control or c is Window:
+				continue
+			stack.append(c)
+			if not (c is Node2D) or c.get_script() == null or not c.is_visible_in_tree():
+				continue
+			if c.get_canvas() != world_canvas:
+				continue
+			var r: float = 40.0 / maxf(zoom, 0.0001)
+			var cr = c.get("click_radius")
+			if cr is float or cr is int:
+				r = maxf(r, float(cr))
+			var d: float = c.global_position.distance_to(world) / r
+			if d < 1.0 and d < best_d:
+				best_d = d
+				best = c
+	return best

+		"scene": get_tree().current_scene.name if get_tree().current_scene else "",
+		"in_game": m != null,

+	if m == null:
+		return out
+	var ship: Node2D = m.get("ship")
+	if ship:
+		out["ship"] = {
+			"pos": ship.global_position,
+			"vel": ship.get("velocity"),
+			"hull": ship.get("hull"), "max_hull": ship.get("max_hull"),
+			"shield": ship.get("shield"), "max_shield": ship.get("max_shield"),
+		}
+	var site = m.get("site")
+	if is_instance_valid(site):
+		var sig: Dictionary = site.get("sig")
+		out["site"] = {"kind": site.get("kind"), "id": sig.get("id", ""),
+			"level": sig.get("level", ""), "seed": sig.get("seed", 0)}
+	var foes := []
+	for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
+		if not (e is Node2D) or not is_instance_valid(e):
+			continue
+		foes.append({
+			"name": str(e.name),
+			"type": e.get("type_id") if e.get("type_id") != null else e.get_script().resource_path.get_file() if e.get_script() else e.get_class(),
+			"hull": e.get("hull"), "max_hull": e.get("max_hull"),
+			"pos": e.global_position,
+			"dist": e.global_position.distance_to(ship.global_position) if ship else 0.0,
+		})

+	return out

+func _tree(n: Node, depth: int) -> Dictionary:
+	var d := {"name": str(n.name), "class": n.get_class()}
+	if n.get_script():
+		d["script"] = n.get_script().resource_path

+## LiveLink: the running game's door for live coding (development only).
+## Off unless the game is a debug run started with the user arg --live
+## (godot --path . -- --live[=PORT]); then it listens on 127.0.0.1:6070 (or
+## PORT) - only this machine can connect. Driven by tools/live.py.
+##
+## Protocol: one JSON object per line in, one JSON reply per line out:
+##   {"cmd": "...", ...}  ->  {"ok": true, "result": ...} | {"ok": false, "error": "..."}
+## Commands:
+##   ping                          - "pong", the game's pid and fps
+##   state                         - a snapshot: ship, the signal, enemies, fps
+##   eval   {expr}                 - a GDScript expression (Expression); names:
+##                                   main, ship, site, root, tree, live
+##   set    {target, prop, value}  - target/value are expressions; prop may be
+##                                   an indexed path ("position:x")
+##   run    {code}                 - GDScript statements, compiled into a
+##                                   throwaway script's run() (may await; the
+##                                   same names as eval); or a whole script
+##                                   source that has its own func run()
+##   reload {paths}                - hot reload scripts (keeping every live
+##                                   object's state) / shaders / other resources
+##   watch  {on}                   - hot reload changed files automatically
+##   events {since}                - the log since seq `since` (errors, prints,
+##                                   reloads, deaths)
+##   tree   {path, depth}          - the node tree under a node
+##   shot   {path}                 - a screenshot (PNG) of the game's view
+##   pause  {on} / speed {scale}   - pause the game / Engine.time_scale
+##   inspect {expr}                - open the Inspector window on an object
+##
+## In any debug run (with or without --live), Alt + right-click opens the
+## developer menu: inspect the thing under the cursor, the Inspector window
+## (DevInspector - live values, right of the game's window), pause, game
+## speed, hot reload on / off.
+
+const PORT := 6070
+var watch_dirs := ["res://scripts", "res://scripts/pages", "res://shaders", "res://data", "res://data/sprites"]

+## a changed one is cut again (tools/extract_sprites.py, on a thread) - its new
+## pieces then come in through data/sprites like any changed picture.
+const SHEETS_DIR := "res://external/images"
+const SHEET_MATCH := "tile_sheet"
+var _cutting := {}                 # sheet -> Thread
+const WATCH_EXT := ["gd", "gdshader", "png", "json"]
+const MAX_EVENTS := 2000

+var enabled := false
+var port := PORT
+var auto_reload := true
+var _server: TCPServer
+var _clients: Array = []           # [{peer, buf}]
+var _events: Array = []            # [{seq, t, kind, text}]
+var _seq := 0
+var _mutex := Mutex.new()

+var _watch_t := 0.0

+var _speeds: PopupMenu

+## --live / --live=PORT among the user args (after --), in a debug run.
+static func live_arg() -> int:
+	if not OS.is_debug_build():
+		return 0
+	for a in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
+		if a == "--live":
+			return PORT
+		if a.begins_with("--live="):
+			return int(a.trim_prefix("--live="))
+	return 0
+

+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	dev = OS.is_debug_build()
+	set_process_input(dev)
+	port = live_arg()
+	if port <= 0:
+		auto_reload = false
+		set_process(false)
+		return

+func start(p: int) -> Error:
+	_server = TCPServer.new()
+	var err := _server.listen(p, "127.0.0.1")
+	if err != OK:
+		push_warning("LiveLink: can't listen on port %d (%s)" % [p, error_string(err)])
+		_server = null
+		return err
+	port = p
+	enabled = true
+	set_process(true)

+		_server.stop()
+	_server = null
+	enabled = false
+	set_process(false)

+## A line in the event log (thread safe - the logger calls it from any thread).
+func event(kind: String, text: String) -> void:
+	_mutex.lock()
+	_seq += 1
+	_events.append({"seq": _seq, "t": snappedf(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0, 0.01), "kind": kind, "text": text})
+	if _events.size() > MAX_EVENTS:
+		_events = _events.slice(_events.size() - MAX_EVENTS)
+	_mutex.unlock()
+
+
+func events_since(since: int) -> Array:
+	_mutex.lock()
+	var out := _events.filter(func(e): return e["seq"] > since)
+	_mutex.unlock()
+	return out.slice(maxi(0, out.size() - 400))   # (the latest - a reply carries 500 at most)

+## Godot's log (prints, warnings, errors with their script place) into events.

+	func _init(l: Node) -> void:

+	func _log_message(message: String, error: bool) -> void:
+		var l = link.get_ref()
+		if l and not message.begins_with("LiveLink"):
+			l.event("error" if error else "print", message.strip_edges(false, true))
+
+	func _log_error(function: String, file: String, line: int, code: String, rationale: String,
+			_editor_notify: bool, error_type: int, script_backtraces: Array[ScriptBacktrace]) -> void:
+		var l = link.get_ref()
+		if l == null:
+			return
+		var where := "%s:%d (%s)" % [file, line, function]
+		# (a parse error names the script and line itself; else: where the script was)
+		for bt in script_backtraces if not file.begins_with("res://") else []:
+			if bt.get_frame_count() > 0:
+				where = "%s:%d (%s)" % [bt.get_frame_file(0), bt.get_frame_line(0), bt.get_frame_function(0)]
+				break
+		var kind := "warning" if error_type == ERROR_TYPE_WARNING else "error"
+		l.event(kind, "%s - %s" % [rationale if rationale != "" else code, where.replace("::trial", "")])

+# --- The connection --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if auto_reload:
+		_watch_t -= delta
+		if _watch_t <= 0.0:
+			_watch_t = 0.5
+			_scan(false)
+	if _server == null:
+		return
+	while _server.is_connection_available():
+		var peer := _server.take_connection()
+		peer.set_no_delay(true)
+		_clients.append({"peer": peer, "buf": PackedByteArray()})
+	for c in _clients.duplicate():
+		var peer: StreamPeerTCP = c["peer"]
+		peer.poll()
+		if peer.get_status() != StreamPeerTCP.STATUS_CONNECTED:
+			_clients.erase(c)
+			continue
+		var n := peer.get_available_bytes()
+		if n > 0:
+			c["buf"].append_array(peer.get_data(n)[1])
+		var nl: int = c["buf"].find(10)
+		while nl >= 0:
+			var line: String = c["buf"].slice(0, nl).get_string_from_utf8()
+			c["buf"] = c["buf"].slice(nl + 1)
+			nl = c["buf"].find(10)
+			if line.strip_edges() != "":
+				_serve(peer, line)

+
+func _serve(peer: StreamPeerTCP, line: String) -> void:
+	var req: Variant = JSON.parse_string(line)
+	var reply: Dictionary
+	if not (req is Dictionary) or not req.has("cmd"):
+		reply = {"ok": false, "error": "not a JSON command: " + line.left(80)}
+	else:
+		reply = await handle(req)
+	if peer.get_status() == StreamPeerTCP.STATUS_CONNECTED:
+		peer.put_data((JSON.stringify(reply) + "\n").to_utf8_buffer())

+## One command (see the header); a coroutine (run may await).
+func handle(req: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var cmd: String = req["cmd"]

+		"ping":

+		"state":

+		"eval":
+			return _eval(str(req.get("expr", "")))
+		"set":
+			return _set_cmd(req)
+		"run":
+			return await _run(str(req.get("code", "")))
+		"reload":
+			return _ok(reload(req.get("paths", [])))
+		"watch":
+			set_auto_reload(bool(req.get("on", true)))
+			return _ok({"auto_reload": auto_reload})
+		"inspect":
+			var r := _expr(str(req.get("expr", "ship")))
+			if not r[0] or not (r[1] is Object):
+				return _err("not an object: " + str(r[1]))
+			open_inspector(r[1])
+			return _ok(inspector.target)
+		"events":
+			return _ok({"events": events_since(int(req.get("since", 0))), "last": _seq})
+		"tree":
+			var n := _node(str(req.get("path", "")))
+			if n == null:
+				return _err("no node " + str(req.get("path", "")))
+			return _ok(_tree(n, int(req.get("depth", 2))))
+		"shot":
+			return _shot(str(req.get("path", "user://live_shot.png")))
+		"pause":
+			get_tree().paused = bool(req.get("on", not get_tree().paused))
+			return _ok({"paused": get_tree().paused})
+		"speed":
+			Engine.time_scale = clampf(float(req.get("scale", 1.0)), 0.0, 20.0)
+			return _ok({"time_scale": Engine.time_scale})
+	return _err("unknown command " + cmd)
+
+
+func _ok(result: Variant) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"ok": true, "result": jsonable(result)}
+
+
+func _err(msg: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"ok": false, "error": msg}
+
+
+# --- Names for eval / run ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The game scene (Main) - the current scene, or wherever a script put it.
+func main() -> Node:
+	var cs := get_tree().current_scene
+	if cs and cs.has_method("enter_site"):
+		return cs
+	for c in get_tree().root.get_children():
+		if c.has_method("enter_site"):
+			return c
+	return null
+
+
+func _names() -> Dictionary:
+	var m := main()
+	var d := {}
+	for c in get_tree().root.get_children():   # the autoloads (Galaxy, Settings, ...)
+		if c != m and ProjectSettings.has_setting("autoload/" + str(c.name)):
+			d[str(c.name)] = c
+	for s in ["Engine", "Input", "OS", "Time", "DisplayServer", "ResourceLoader", "ProjectSettings"]:
+		d[s] = Engine.get_singleton(s)
+	for c in ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list():   # (the game's classes: MinoanTiles, Galaxy's types...)
+		if not d.has(c["class"]) and ResourceLoader.has_cached(c["path"]):
+			d[c["class"]] = load(c["path"])
+	d.merge({
+		"main": m,
+		"ship": m.get("ship") if m else null,
+		"site": m.get("site") if m else null,
+		"root": get_tree().root,
+		"tree": get_tree(),
+		"live": self,
+	}, true)
+	return d
+
+
+## A node by alias (main, ship, site) or path (from root or from Main).
+func _node(path: String) -> Node:
+	var names := _names()
+	if path == "" or path == "root":
+		return get_tree().root
+	var head := path.get_slice("/", 0)
+	if names.get(head) is Node:
+		var base: Node = names[head]
+		var rest := path.substr(head.length()).trim_prefix("/")
+		return base if rest == "" else base.get_node_or_null(rest)
+	var n := get_tree().root.get_node_or_null(path)
+	if n == null and names["main"]:
+		n = names["main"].get_node_or_null(path)
+	return n
+
+
+func _expr(code: String) -> Array:   # [ok, value or error]
+	var names := _names()
+	var e := Expression.new()
+	if e.parse(code, PackedStringArray(names.keys())) != OK:
+		return [false, e.get_error_text()]
+	var v: Variant = e.execute(names.values(), self, false)
+	if e.has_execute_failed():
+		return [false, "failed: " + e.get_error_text()]
+	return [true, v]
+
+
+func _eval(code: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var r := _expr(code)
+	return _ok(r[1]) if r[0] else _err(r[1])
+
+
+func _set_cmd(req: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var t := _expr(str(req.get("target", "")))
+	if not t[0]:
+		return _err("target: " + str(t[1]))
+	if not (t[1] is Object):
+		return _err("target is not an object: " + str(t[1]))
+	var v := _expr(str(req.get("value", "null")))
+	if not v[0]:
+		return _err("value: " + str(v[1]))
+	var obj: Object = t[1]
+	var prop := str(req.get("prop", ""))
+	obj.set_indexed(NodePath(prop), v[1])
+	return _ok(obj.get_indexed(NodePath(prop)))
+
+
+var _run_n := 0
+## The snippets' scripts and objects, kept for the whole run: freeing a script
+## whose code made lambdas crashes Godot 4.7 (double free) a run or two later.
+var _runs: Array = []
+
+## Statements -> a throwaway script: func run() with main/ship/site/... set.
+func _run(code: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var src := code
+	if not code.contains("func run("):
+		var body := ""
+		for l in code.split("\n"):
+			body += "\t" + l + "\n"
+		src = "func run():\n" + body + "\treturn null\n"
+	if not src.begins_with("extends"):
+		src = "extends RefCounted\nvar main\nvar ship\nvar site\nvar root\nvar tree\nvar live\n\n" + src
+	var s := GDScript.new()
+	s.source_code = src
+	_run_n += 1
+	var err := s.reload()
+	if err != OK:
+		return _err("doesn't compile (%s) - see the events for the line" % error_string(err))
+	var obj: Object = s.new()
+	_runs.append([s, obj])
+	for k in _names():
+		if k in obj:
+			obj.set(k, _names()[k])
+	var v: Variant = await obj.run()
+	return _ok(v)
+
+
+# --- Hot reload --------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Reload scripts (live objects keep their state and get the new code -
+## subclasses that are loaded are reloaded after their bases), shaders (their
+## code, so every material using them updates) and other resources (in place).
+func reload(paths: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var done := []
+	var failed := []
+	var scripts := []
+	for p in paths:
+		p = _res_path(str(p))
+		if p.ends_with(".gd"):
+			scripts.append(p)
+		elif not ResourceLoader.has_cached(p):
+			continue   # (not loaded - the game reads it fresh when it needs it)
+		elif p.ends_with(".gdshader"):
+			var sh: Shader = load(p)
+			sh.code = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(p)
+			done.append(p)
+		else:
+			ResourceLoader.load(p, "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REPLACE)
+			done.append(p)
+	# Loaded scripts that extend a changed one reload with it (base first).
+	var all := scripts.duplicate()
+	for p in _loaded_scripts():
+		if p in all:
+			continue
+		var s: Script = load(p)
+		var b := s.get_base_script()
+		while b:
+			if b.resource_path in scripts:
+				all.append(p)
+				break
+			b = b.get_base_script()
+	all.sort_custom(func(a, b): return _depth(a) < _depth(b))
+	for p in all:
+		if not ResourceLoader.has_cached(p):
+			continue
+		if p == get_script().resource_path:
+			continue   # (not itself - it's running the reload; restart for that)
+		var s: GDScript = load(p)
+		if _base_failed(s, failed):
+			continue
+		var src := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(p)
+		# Compile it on the side first: broken code mustn't break the live script.
+		if not compiles(src, p):
+			failed.append(p)
+			continue
+		var before := _member_names(s)
+		s.source_code = src
+		if s.reload(true) == OK:
+			done.append(p)
+			var added := _member_names(s).filter(func(n): return not before.has(n))
+			if not added.is_empty():
+				_init_members(s, added)
+		else:
+			failed.append(p)
+	_rebuild_buildings(paths.map(func(x): return _res_path(str(x))), done)
+	if not done.is_empty():
+		event("reload", "reloaded " + ", ".join(done.map(func(x): return x.get_file())))
+	if not failed.is_empty():
+		event("error", "reload failed (kept the old code): " + ", ".join(failed))
+	return {"reloaded": done, "failed": failed}
+
+
+## Whether GDScript source compiles (its class_name blanked out - a scratch
+## copy may not take the real one's name; the errors go to the log with the
+## real file's line numbers).
+static func compiles(src: String, path: String) -> bool:
+	var lines := src.split("\n")
+	for i in lines.size():
+		if lines[i].begins_with("class_name "):
+			lines[i] = ""
+	var t := GDScript.new()
+	t.source_code = "\n".join(lines)
+	t.take_over_path(path + "::trial")
+	return t.reload() == OK
+
+
+func _base_failed(s: Script, failed: Array) -> bool:
+	var b := s.get_base_script()
+	while b:
+		if b.resource_path in failed:
+			return true
+		b = b.get_base_script()
+	return false
+
+
+## Buildings: tile pieces' pictures changed (data/sprites/tile_*.png) or the
+## building styles did (minoan_tiles.gd reloaded) - fresh pieces, and every
+## building holder (planet surfaces, the Library: group "hot_buildings") reskinned.
+func _rebuild_buildings(paths: Array, reloaded: Array) -> void:
+	var tiles := paths.filter(func(p): return p.get_file().begins_with("tile_") and p.ends_with(".png"))
+	var styles := reloaded.any(func(p): return p.ends_with("minoan_tiles.gd"))
+	if tiles.is_empty() and not styles:
+		return
+	var mt: Script = load("res://scripts/minoan_tiles.gd")
+	mt.hot_reload(tiles)
+	var n := 0
+	for h in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("hot_buildings"):
+		if h.has_method("reskin_buildings"):
+			n += int(h.reskin_buildings())
+	event("reload", "buildings: %d tile picture(s)%s - %d piece(s) redone" % [tiles.size(), " and the styles" if styles else "", n])
+
+
+func _member_names(s: Script) -> Array:
+	return s.get_script_property_list().map(func(p): return p["name"])
+
+
+## Variables a reload added are null in the objects that already existed:
+## give them their declared defaults (in every node of the tree with that
+## script or one extending it - nodes are what lives; the rest can't be
+## found).
+func _init_members(s: Script, names: Array) -> void:
+	var n_set := 0
+	var stack: Array = [get_tree().root]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		stack.append_array(n.get_children(true))
+		var ns: Script = n.get_script()
+		while ns and ns != s:
+			ns = ns.get_base_script()
+		if ns == null:
+			continue
+		var decl: Dictionary = preload("res://scripts/core/dev_inspector.gd").declared_defaults(s)
+		for m in names:
+			if typeof(n.get(m)) == TYPE_NIL:
+				var d: Variant = decl.get(m, s.get_property_default_value(m))
+				if d is Array or d is Dictionary:
+					d = d.duplicate(true)
+				if d != null:
+					n.set(m, d)
+					n_set += 1
+	if n_set > 0:
+		event("reload", "gave %d new variable(s) of %s their defaults in live objects" % [n_set, s.resource_path.get_file()])
+
+
+func _res_path(p: String) -> String:
+	if p.contains("://"):
+		return p
+	var root := ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://")
+	return "res://" + p.trim_prefix(root).trim_prefix("./")
+
+
+func _depth(p: String) -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	var b: Script = (load(p) as Script).get_base_script()
+	while b:
+		n += 1
+		b = b.get_base_script()
+	return n
+
+
+func _loaded_scripts() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for d in ["res://scripts", "res://scripts/pages"]:
+		for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(d):
+			if f.ends_with(".gd") and ResourceLoader.has_cached(d + "/" + f):
+				out.append(d + "/" + f)
+	return out
+
+
+## The watched files' times; changed ones are hot reloaded (first = just record).
+func _scan(first: bool) -> void:
+	var changed := []
+	for d in watch_dirs:
+		for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(d):
+			if not WATCH_EXT.has(f.get_extension()):
+				continue
+			var p: String = d.path_join(f)
+			var t := FileAccess.get_modified_time(p)
+			if not first and _mtimes.get(p, -1) != t:   # (changed, or new)
+				changed.append(p)
+			_mtimes[p] = t
+	if not changed.is_empty():
+		reload(changed)
+	# The tile sheets: cut again when they change.
+	for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(SHEETS_DIR):
+		if not f.contains(SHEET_MATCH) or f.get_extension() != "png":
+			continue
+		var p := SHEETS_DIR.path_join(f)
+		var t := FileAccess.get_modified_time(p)
+		if not first and _mtimes.get(p, -1) != t and not _cutting.has(f):
+			_cut_sheet(f)
+		_mtimes[p] = t
+
+
+## Cuts a changed tile sheet into its pieces (data/sprites/tile_*.png) on a
+## thread; the watcher then reloads them.
+func _cut_sheet(f: String) -> void:
+	event("reload", "%s changed - cutting its pieces (tools/extract_sprites.py)" % f)
+	var th := Thread.new()
+	_cutting[f] = th
+	th.start(func():
+		var out := []
+		var code := OS.execute("python3", [ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://tools/extract_sprites.py"), f], out, true)
+		_cut_done.call_deferred(f, code, "".join(out)))
+
+
+func _cut_done(f: String, code: int, out: String) -> void:
+	var th: Thread = _cutting.get(f)
+	if th:
+		th.wait_to_finish()
+	_cutting.erase(f)
+	if code == 0:
+		event("reload", "%s cut: %d pieces" % [f, out.count("\n")])
+		_scan(false)
+	else:
+		event("error", "cutting %s failed (%d): %s" % [f, code, out.right(400)])
+
+
+func set_auto_reload(on: bool) -> void:
+	auto_reload = on
+	if on:
+		_scan(true)
+		set_process(true)
+	event("reload", "hot reload " + ("on" if on else "off"))
+

+func open_menu(at: Vector2) -> void:

+		_speeds.id_pressed.connect(func(i): Engine.time_scale = [0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0][i])
+		_menu.add_child(_speeds)
+		add_child(_menu)
+	_menu.clear()
+	_picked.clear()
+	var thing := pick_at(at)
+	if thing:
+		_menu.add_item("Inspect  " + _label(thing), 100)
+		_picked.append(thing)
+	var ui := get_viewport().gui_get_hovered_control()
+	if ui and ui != thing:
+		_menu.add_item("Inspect UI  " + _label(ui), 100 + _picked.size())

+	if _picked.size() > 0:
+		_menu.add_separator()
+	_menu.add_check_item("Inspector", 1)
+	_menu.set_item_checked(_menu.get_item_index(1), inspector != null and inspector.visible)
+	_menu.add_separator()
+	_menu.add_check_item("Pause", 2)
+	_menu.set_item_checked(_menu.get_item_index(2), get_tree().paused)
+	_menu.add_submenu_node_item("Game speed", _speeds, 3)
+	for i in 5:
+		_speeds.set_item_checked(i, is_equal_approx(Engine.time_scale, [0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0][i]))
+	_menu.add_check_item("Hot reload (watch files)", 4)
+	_menu.set_item_checked(_menu.get_item_index(4), auto_reload)
+	_menu.add_item("Screenshot", 5)
+	_menu.reset_size()

+	var origin := Vector2i.ZERO if get_viewport().gui_embed_subwindows else get_window().position
+	_menu.popup(Rect2i(Vector2i(at) + origin, Vector2i.ZERO))

+func _label(o: Object) -> String:

+	if o.get_script() and o.get_script().resource_path != "":

+func _on_menu(id: int) -> void:
+	match id:
+		1:
+			if inspector and inspector.visible:
+				inspector.hide()
+			else:

+		2:

+			set_auto_reload(not auto_reload)

+			if r["ok"]:

+				open_inspector(_picked[id - 100])

+func open_inspector(obj: Object) -> void:
+	if inspector == null:
+		inspector = preload("res://scripts/core/dev_inspector.gd").new()
+		add_child(inspector)

+		inspector.open()

+		inspector.inspect(obj)

+## The game object under a screen point: the nearest scripted Node2D in the
+## world (not the HUD) within its click radius (or 40 screen px).
+func pick_at(screen: Vector2) -> Node2D:
+	var m := main()
+	var vp := get_viewport()
+	if m == null:
+		return null
+	var ct := vp.get_canvas_transform()
+	var world := ct.affine_inverse() * screen
+	var zoom := ct.get_scale().x
+	var world_canvas := vp.find_world_2d().canvas
+	var best: Node2D = null
+	var best_d := INF
+	var stack: Array = [m]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		for c in n.get_children():
+			if c is CanvasLayer or c is Control or c is Window:
+				continue
+			stack.append(c)
+			if not (c is Node2D) or c.get_script() == null or not c.is_visible_in_tree():
+				continue
+			if c.get_canvas() != world_canvas:
+				continue
+			var r: float = 40.0 / maxf(zoom, 0.0001)
+			var cr = c.get("click_radius")
+			if cr is float or cr is int:
+				r = maxf(r, float(cr))
+			var d: float = c.global_position.distance_to(world) / r
+			if d < 1.0 and d < best_d:
+				best_d = d
+				best = c
+	return best
+
