+# --- Looking at things -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
+	var m := main()
+	var out := {
+		"fps": Engine.get_frames_per_second(),
+		"paused": get_tree().paused,
+		"time_scale": Engine.time_scale,
+		"scene": get_tree().current_scene.name if get_tree().current_scene else "",
+		"in_game": m != null,
+	}
+	if m == null:
+		return out
+	var ship: Node2D = m.get("ship")
+	if ship:
+		out["ship"] = {
+			"pos": ship.global_position,
+			"vel": ship.get("velocity"),
+			"hull": ship.get("hull"), "max_hull": ship.get("max_hull"),
+			"shield": ship.get("shield"), "max_shield": ship.get("max_shield"),
+		}
+	var site = m.get("site")
+	if is_instance_valid(site):
+		var sig: Dictionary = site.get("sig")
+		out["site"] = {"kind": site.get("kind"), "id": sig.get("id", ""),
+			"level": sig.get("level", ""), "seed": sig.get("seed", 0)}
+	var foes := []
+	for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
+		if not (e is Node2D) or not is_instance_valid(e):
+			continue
+		foes.append({
+			"name": str(e.name),
+			"type": e.get("type_id") if e.get("type_id") != null else e.get_script().resource_path.get_file() if e.get_script() else e.get_class(),
+			"hull": e.get("hull"), "max_hull": e.get("max_hull"),
+			"pos": e.global_position,
+			"dist": e.global_position.distance_to(ship.global_position) if ship else 0.0,
+		})
+	foes.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a["dist"] < b["dist"])
+	out["enemies"] = foes
+	return out
+
+
+func _tree(n: Node, depth: int) -> Dictionary:
+	var d := {"name": str(n.name), "class": n.get_class()}
+	if n.get_script():
+		d["script"] = n.get_script().resource_path
+	if n is Node2D:
+		d["pos"] = n.global_position
+	if depth > 0 and n.get_child_count() > 0:
+		var kids := []
+		for c in n.get_children():
+			if kids.size() >= 60:
+				kids.append({"name": "... %d more" % (n.get_child_count() - 60)})
+				break
+			kids.append(_tree(c, depth - 1))
+		d["children"] = kids
+	elif n.get_child_count() > 0:
+		d["children"] = n.get_child_count()
+	return d
+
+
+func _shot(path: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var img := get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
+	if img == null:
+		return _err("no image (headless?)")
+	var p := path if path.is_absolute_path() or path.begins_with("user://") else ProjectSettings.globalize_path("user://") + path
+	var err := img.save_png(p)
+	if err != OK:
+		return _err("can't save %s (%s)" % [p, error_string(err)])
+	return _ok({"path": ProjectSettings.globalize_path(p), "size": img.get_size()})
+
+
+## Any value -> something JSON can carry (vectors as [x, y], objects named).
+static func jsonable(v: Variant, depth := 0) -> Variant:
+	if depth > 6:
+		return "..."
+	match typeof(v):
+		TYPE_NIL, TYPE_BOOL, TYPE_INT, TYPE_STRING:
+			return v
+		TYPE_FLOAT:
+			return snappedf(v, 0.001) if is_finite(v) else str(v)
+		TYPE_STRING_NAME, TYPE_NODE_PATH:
+			return str(v)
+		TYPE_VECTOR2, TYPE_VECTOR2I:
+			return [snappedf(v.x, 0.01), snappedf(v.y, 0.01)]
+		TYPE_VECTOR3, TYPE_VECTOR3I:
+			return [snappedf(v.x, 0.01), snappedf(v.y, 0.01), snappedf(v.z, 0.01)]
+		TYPE_COLOR:
+			return "#" + v.to_html()
+		TYPE_OBJECT:
+			if not is_instance_valid(v):
+				return "<freed>"
+			if v is Node:
+				return "<%s %s>" % [v.get_class(), v.get_path() if v.is_inside_tree() else v.name]
+			if v is Resource and v.resource_path != "":
+				return "<%s %s>" % [v.get_class(), v.resource_path]
+			return "<%s>" % v.get_class()
+		TYPE_DICTIONARY:
+			var d := {}
+			for k in v:
+				d[str(k)] = jsonable(v[k], depth + 1)
+			return d
+	if v is Array or typeof(v) >= TYPE_PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY:
+		var a := []
+		for x in v:
+			if a.size() >= 500:
+				a.append("... %d more" % (v.size() - 500))
+				break
+			a.append(jsonable(x, depth + 1))
+		return a
+	return str(v)",

+class_name TransferPanel
+extends CanvasLayer
+## At your ship on a planet (clicking it: PlanetSurface.board_ship): what you
+## carry (Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS slots) beside the ship's hold (its class's
+## slots, Shipyard.cargo_capacity) - click a stack on either side to move it
+## to the other (up to 100 at a time, as far as there's room). Take off, or
+## close and stay. The game waits while it's open.
+
+const COLS_YOU := 4
+const COLS_SHIP := 10
+const SLOT := 56.0
+
+var surface: Node
+var _you: GridContainer
+var _ship: GridContainer
+var _you_label: Label
+var _ship_label: Label
+var _status: Label
+var _was_paused := false
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	layer = 60
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	_was_paused = get_tree().paused
+	get_tree().paused = true
+	var root := Control.new()
+	root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	add_child(root)
+	var v := UI.modal(root, NeonTheme.CYAN, Vector2(980, 0))
+	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
+	head.add_child(UI.label("YOUR SHIP", 24, NeonTheme.CYAN))
+	head.add_child(UI.spacer())
+	head.add_child(UI.label("Click a stack to move it across (up to 100 at a time).", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	v.add_child(head)
+	var cols := HBoxContainer.new()
+	cols.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 28)
+	v.add_child(cols)
+	var left := VBoxContainer.new()
+	_you_label = UI.label("", 16, UI.GOLD)
+	left.add_child(_you_label)
+	_you = _grid(COLS_YOU)
+	left.add_child(_you)
+	cols.add_child(left)
+	var right := VBoxContainer.new()
+	right.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_ship_label = UI.label("", 16, UI.GOLD)
+	right.add_child(_ship_label)
+	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
+	scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(COLS_SHIP * (SLOT + 6), 380)
+	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
+	_ship = _grid(COLS_SHIP)
+	scroll.add_child(_ship)
+	right.add_child(scroll)
+	cols.add_child(right)
+	_status = UI.label("", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	v.add_child(_status)
+	var buttons := HBoxContainer.new()
+	buttons.add_child(UI.spacer())
+	buttons.add_child(UI.button("Stay", close, 16))
+	buttons.add_child(UI.button("Take off", _take_off, 16))
+	v.add_child(buttons)
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _grid(cols: int) -> GridContainer:
+	var g := GridContainer.new()
+	g.columns = cols
+	g.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 6)
+	g.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 6)
+	return g
+
+
+func _player() -> Dictionary:
+	return surface.state["player"]
+
+
+## The ship's hold size in slots (its class, its Cargo Racks).
+func ship_slots() -> int:
+	var pd: Node = preload("res://scripts/player_data.gd").new()
+	pd.load_save_data(_player())
+	var n := Shipyard.cargo_capacity(pd)
+	pd.free()
+	return n
+
+
+func refresh() -> void:
+	var you: Dictionary = Inventory.carried(_player())
+	var hold: Dictionary = _player().get("items", {})
+	var cap := ship_slots()
+	_you_label.text = "YOU CARRY  ·  %d / %d slots" % [Inventory.slots_used(you), Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS]
+	_ship_label.text = "SHIP'S HOLD  ·  %d / %d slots" % [Inventory.slots_used(hold), cap]
+	_fill(_you, Inventory.slots(you, Inventory.layout(_player(), "carried"), Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS), "carried", _to_ship)
+	_fill(_ship, Inventory.slots(hold, Inventory.layout(_player(), "hold"), cap), "hold", _to_you)
+
+
+## A grid of slots: click a stack to move it across; drag it to another slot
+## (they swap) or into the other grid (it moves there, into that slot).
+func _fill(g: GridContainer, slots_: Array, which: String, on_click: Callable) -> void:
+	UI.clear(g)
+	for i in slots_.size():
+		var st: Array = slots_[i]
+		var s := ItemSlot.make(st[0] if not st.is_empty() else "", int(st[1]) if not st.is_empty() else 0, SLOT)
+		if not st.is_empty():
+			s.clicked.connect(on_click)
+			s.tooltip_text = "%s  ×%d\nClick or drag it across; drag it to another slot to arrange." % [Items.display_name(st[0]), int(st[1])]
+			s.payload = {"src": which, "index": i, "id": st[0]}
+		s.accepts = func(d): return d.get("src") in ["hold", "carried"]
+		s.on_drop = _dropped.bind(which, i)
+		g.add_child(s)
+
+
+func _dropped(d: Dictionary, which: String, i: int) -> void:
+	var pl := _player()
+	if d.get("src") == which:
+		Inventory.swap(Inventory.layout(pl, which), int(d["index"]), i)
+		refresh()
+		return
+	var n: int
+	if which == "hold":
+		n = Inventory.move_stack_into(Inventory.carried(pl), pl["items"], d["id"], ship_slots(), Inventory.layout(pl, "hold"), i)
+	else:
+		n = Inventory.move_stack_into(pl["items"], Inventory.carried(pl), d["id"], Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS, Inventory.layout(pl, "carried"), i)
+	_status.text = ("%d %s moved." % [n, Items.display_name(d["id"])]) if n > 0 else "No room there."
+	_moved()
+
+
+func _to_ship(id: String) -> void:
+	var n := Inventory.move_stack(Inventory.carried(_player()), _player()["items"], id, ship_slots())
+	_status.text = ("%d %s into the ship's hold." % [n, Items.display_name(id)]) if n > 0 else "The ship's hold is full."
+	_moved()

+extends SceneTree
+## The frame-rate tour: plays every area and way of playing in a real window
+## (vsync off, no frame cap) and measures each for a few seconds - title
+## screen; space at home and in every empire (idle, flying, a battle, the
+## Minotaur, every signal site, the Ship Computer's tabs, docked at a
+## station); landing; every landable planet's surface (idle, a long walk that
+## streams the world in, a fight, inside a building, the Field Computer, the
+## transfer screen at the ship). A scenario passes when its average is at
+## least TARGET FPS (240) and 95% of its frames are too (frame time <=
+## 1000/TARGET ms), and none of its frames takes over FREEZE_MS (a stutter).
+## tools/fps_test.py also compares each with tests/fps_baseline.json (slower
+## by a quarter: flagged, even above the bar).
+##
+##   python3 tools/fps_test.py [filter]      (runs this in a window, your user data untouched)
+##   godot --path . --resolution 1920x1080 -s tests/fps_tour.gd [-- <filter>]
+##
+## Not headless: rendering is what's measured. Not part of tools/test.py (the
+## tests run headless, 12 Godots at once - no frame rate to speak of).
+
+var TARGET := 240.0          # --target=N to judge against another frame rate (the game's bar: 240)
+const SECONDS := 4.0          # measured per scenario
+const WARMUP := 0.75          # s run first, not measured (art baked on first use)
+const HITCH_MS := 25.0        # a frame this long counts as a hitch
+const FREEZE_MS := 50.0       # any frame this long fails a scenario (a stutter you'd see)
+
+var results: Array = []
+var _filter := ""
+var _shots := false           # --shots: a screenshot of each scenario (user://fps_shots/)
+var _attrib := false          # --attrib: for a slow scenario, what its frame time goes on
+var _scene: Node
+var _drive := Callable()      # called every frame while measuring (keeps a scenario going)
+var galaxy: Node              # (the autoloads: not known by name in a -s script)
+var save: Node
+var PlanetsS: GDScript           # (class names that use autoloads: loaded at run time)
+var SignalSitesS: GDScript
+var SurfaceCreatureS: GDScript
+
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	_run()
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	var args: Array = Array(OS.get_cmdline_user_args())
+	_attrib = args.has("--attrib")
+	_shots = args.has("--shots")
+	for a in args:
+		if a.begins_with("--target="):
+			TARGET = float(a.trim_prefix("--target="))
+	args = args.filter(func(a): return not a.begins_with("--"))   # (--attrib, --mute, --window-at=...)
+	_filter = args[0] if not args.is_empty() else ""
+	galaxy = root.get_node("Galaxy")
+	save = root.get_node("SaveGame")
+	PlanetsS = load("res://scripts/planet_data.gd")
+	SignalSitesS = load("res://scripts/signal_sites.gd")
+	SurfaceCreatureS = load("res://scripts/surface_creature.gd")
+	DisplayServer.window_set_vsync_mode(DisplayServer.VSYNC_DISABLED)
+	RenderingServer.viewport_set_measure_render_time(root.get_viewport_rid(), true)
+	Engine.max_fps = 0
+	for i in 3:
+		await process_frame
+	var art: Node = root.get_node_or_null("ProcArt")
+	while art and not art.ready_done:
+		await process_frame
+	# As the loading screen does: the main scenes loaded up front, kept.
+	for path in ["res://main_menu.tscn", "res://main.tscn", "res://scenes/planet_surface.tscn", "res://scenes/station_menu.tscn"]:
+		art.scenes[path] = load(path)
+	galaxy.new_game(false)
+	print("FPS tour: target %d FPS, %s, %s" % [TARGET, DisplayServer.window_get_size(), RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name()])
+	await _title()
+	await _space_home()
+	await _space_empires()
+	await _signal_sites()
+	await _landing()
+	for pid in ["thalassa", "krystallos", "akrotiri", "kronos", "selene"]:
+		await _surface(pid)
+	_set_scene(null)
+	_report()
+
+
+## A section runs if the filter names it ("space", "surface", "thalassa") or
+## one of its scenarios ("space: battle" - its scenario names begin with it).
+func _wanted(section: String) -> bool:
+	return _filter == "" or section.contains(_filter) or _filter.contains(section)
+
+
+## Measures `name` for SECONDS (after WARMUP), calling _drive every frame.
+func _measure(name: String, seconds := SECONDS) -> void:
+	if _filter != "" and not name.contains(_filter):
+		return
+	var t_end := Time.get_ticks_usec() + int(WARMUP * 1e6)
+	while Time.get_ticks_usec() < t_end:
+		await process_frame
+		if _drive.is_valid():
+			_drive.call()
+	print("@@profile " + name)   # (for tools/fps_test.py --profile)
+	var frames: Array = []
+	var cost := {"script": 0.0, "physics": 0.0, "render_cpu": 0.0, "gpu": 0.0}
+	var vp := root.get_viewport_rid()
+	var last := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	t_end = last + int(seconds * 1e6)
+	while last < t_end:
+		await process_frame
+		if _drive.is_valid():
+			_drive.call()
+		var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		frames.append((now - last) / 1000.0)
+		last = now
+		cost["script"] += Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PROCESS) * 1000.0
+		cost["physics"] += Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS) * 1000.0
+		cost["render_cpu"] += RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_cpu(vp) + RenderingServer.get_frame_setup_time_cpu()
+		cost["gpu"] += RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_gpu(vp)
+	print("@@profile -")
+	if _shots:
+		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute("user://fps_shots")
+		root.get_texture().get_image().save_png("user://fps_shots/%s.png" % name.validate_filename().replace(" ", "_"))
+	for k in cost:
+		cost[k] /= maxf(1.0, frames.size())
+	_record(name, frames, cost)
+	if _attrib and not results[-1]["ok"]:
+		await _attribute()
+
+
+## The average frame (ms) over `n` frames.
+func _avg_frame(n := 40) -> float:
+	for i in 5:
+		await process_frame
+		if _drive.is_valid():
+			_drive.call()
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for i in n:
+		await process_frame
+		if _drive.is_valid():
+			_drive.call()
+	return (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0 / n
+
+
+## What each script costs: its nodes' own processing switched off for a
+## moment (not their children's) - the frame time saved, against the frames
+## just before and after (a battle changes as it goes).
+func _attribute() -> void:
+	# First: everything's processing off (what's left: drawing and the engine).
+	var procs := []
+	for n in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
+		if n.is_processing() and n.get_script() != null:
+			procs.append(n)
+	var on_ms := await _avg_frame(60)
+	procs = procs.filter(func(n): return is_instance_valid(n))
+	for n in procs:
+		n.set_process(false)
+	var off_ms := await _avg_frame(60)
+	for n in procs:
+		if is_instance_valid(n):
+			n.set_process(true)
+	print("       frame %.2f ms; with no script processing %.2f ms (%d nodes)" % [on_ms, off_ms, procs.size()])
+	var by_script := {}
+	for n in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
+		var sc: Script = n.get_script()
+		if sc == null or not (n.is_processing() or n.is_physics_processing()):
+			continue
+		var key: String = sc.resource_path.get_file()
+		if key == "" or key.begins_with("fps_tour"):
+			continue
+		if not by_script.has(key):
+			by_script[key] = []
+		by_script[key].append(n)
+	var rows := []
+	for key in by_script:
+		var before := await _avg_frame(30)
+		var nodes: Array = by_script[key].filter(func(n): return is_instance_valid(n))
+		var was := []
+		for n in nodes:
+			was.append([n.is_processing(), n.is_physics_processing()])
+			n.set_process(false)
+			n.set_physics_process(false)
+		var off := await _avg_frame(30)
+		for i in nodes.size():
+			if is_instance_valid(nodes[i]):
+				nodes[i].set_process(was[i][0])
+				nodes[i].set_physics_process(was[i][1])
+		var after := await _avg_frame(30)
+		rows.append([(before + after) * 0.5 - off, key, nodes.size(), (before + after) * 0.5])
+	rows.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a[0] > b[0])
+	print("       what its scripts' processing costs (per frame):")
+	for r in rows.slice(0, 12):
+		if r[0] > 0.3:
+			print("         %-32s x%-4d %5.1f ms  (of %.1f)" % [r[1], r[2], r[0], r[3]])
+
+
+func _record(name: String, frames: Array, cost := {}) -> void:
+	var sorted := frames.duplicate()
+	sorted.sort()
+	var total := 0.0
+	for f in frames:
+		total += f
+	var avg := frames.size() / (total / 1000.0)
+	var p95: float = sorted[int(sorted.size() * 0.95)]
+	var p99: float = sorted[int(sorted.size() * 0.99)]
+	var worst: float = sorted[-1]
+	var hitches := frames.filter(func(f): return f > HITCH_MS).size()
+	var ok := avg >= TARGET and p95 <= 1000.0 / TARGET and worst <= FREEZE_MS
+	var r := {"name": name, "fps": avg, "p95_ms": p95, "low1_fps": 1000.0 / p99, "worst_ms": worst, "hitches": hitches,
+		"frames": frames.size(), "ok": ok,
+		"draw_calls": Performance.get_monitor(Performance.RENDER_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME),
+		"objects": Performance.get_monitor(Performance.OBJECT_NODE_COUNT), "cost_ms": cost}
+	results.append(r)
+	print("  %-4s %-46s %6.0f fps  p95 %5.1f ms  1%%low %5.0f fps  worst %6.1f ms  hitches %d  (%d draw calls, %d nodes)" % [
+		"ok" if ok else "SLOW", name, avg, p95, r["low1_fps"], worst, hitches, r["draw_calls"], r["objects"]])
+	if not cost.is_empty():
+		print("       (per frame: scripts %.1f ms, physics %.1f ms, render CPU %.1f ms, GPU %.1f ms)" % [cost["script"], cost["physics"], cost["render_cpu"], cost["gpu"]])
+
+
+func _set_scene(n: Node) -> void:
+	_drive = Callable()
+	if paused:
+		paused = false
+	if is_instance_valid(_scene):
+		_scene.queue_free()
+		await process_frame
+		await process_frame
+	_scene = n
+	if n:
+		root.add_child(n)
+		current_scene = n
+
+
+# --- Title -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _title() -> void:
+	if not _wanted("title"):
+		return
+	await _set_scene(load("res://main_menu.tscn").instantiate())
+	await _measure("title screen")
+
+
+# --- Space -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _enter_space(system: String) -> Node:
+	galaxy.current_system = system
+	save.travelling = system != galaxy.HOME
+	save.landed_planet = ""
+	await _set_scene(load("res://main.tscn").instantiate())
+	for i in 40:
+		await process_frame
+	save.travelling = false
+	_scene.ship.invulnerable = true   # (a battle shouldn't end the run)
+	return _scene
+
+
+func _space_home() -> void:
+	if not _wanted("space"):
+		return
+	var main: Node = await _enter_space(galaxy.HOME)
+	await _measure("space: home system, idle")
+	# Flying: a new course across the system every 1.5 s.
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = 7
+	var t := [0.0]
+	_drive = func():
+		if Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1500.0 > t[0]:
+			t[0] = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1500.0 + 1.0
+			main._move_ship(main.ship.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(rng.randf() * TAU) * 3000.0)
+	await _measure("space: flying across the system")
+	# A battle: 6 pirates on you, you fighting back (a new one for each that falls).
+	main.ship.stop()
+	var foes: Array = []
+	_drive = func():
+		for e in foes.duplicate():   # (in place: a lambda's own reassignments don't last)
+			if not is_instance_valid(e) or not e.is_alive():
+				foes.erase(e)
+		while foes.size() < 6:
+			var e: Node2D = main.spawn_enemy(main.ship.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(rng.randf() * TAU) * rng.randf_range(500, 900))
+			foes.append(e)
+		if not main.ship._target_valid():
+			main.ship.set_attack_target(foes[0], true)
+		main.ship.hull = main.ship.max_hull
+	await _measure("space: battle, 6 pirates")
+	for e in foes:
+		if is_instance_valid(e):
+			e.queue_free()
+	_drive = Callable()
+	# The Minotaur.
+	var m: Node2D = main.spawn_ship(main.ship.global_position + Vector2(0, -900), "minotaur")
+	main.ship.set_attack_target(m, true)
+	await _measure("space: the Minotaur boss")
+	if is_instance_valid(m):

+	# The Ship Computer: the map (flying on), then every tab.
+	main._open_panel(main.ship_menu, main.ship_menu.MAP_TAB)
+	await _measure("space: Ship Computer, system map")
+	for i in main.ship_menu.TABS.size():
+		if i == main.ship_menu.MAP_TAB:
+			continue
+		main.ship_menu.show_tab(i)
+		await _measure("space: Ship Computer, %s" % main.ship_menu.TABS[i].to_lower(), 2.0)

+	# Docked: every station tab.
+	var st: Node2D = get_nodes_in_group("stations")[0]
+	main.dock(st)
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	while not main.station_menu.visible and Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0 < 6000:
+		await process_frame

+## One system of each other empire: its ships and stations, flying through.
+func _space_empires() -> void:

+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()

+		_drive = func():

+				t[0] = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1500.0 + 1.0

+
+
+func _signal_sites() -> void:
+	if not _wanted("site"):
+		return
+	for kind in SignalSitesS.KINDS:
+		var main: Node = await _enter_space(galaxy.HOME)
+		var sig := {"id": "fps:%s" % kind, "kind": kind, "pos": [5000.0, 0.0], "located": true, "done": false, "seed": 12345}
+		sig["level"] = "hard"
+		var b: Node2D = load("res://scripts/signal_beacon.gd").new()

+		_drive = func():   # (fight whatever is there)

+# --- Landing ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The landing animation, the surface building in the background meanwhile.
+func _landing() -> void:
+	if not _wanted("landing"):
+		return
+	var main: Node = await _enter_space(galaxy.HOME)
+	var body: Node2D = main._planet_body("thalassa")

+# --- Planet surfaces -------------------------------------------------------

+extends SceneTree
+## The frame-rate tour: plays every area and way of playing in a real window
+## (vsync off, no frame cap) and measures each for a few seconds - title
+## screen; space at home and in every empire (idle, flying, a battle, the
+## Minotaur, every signal site, the Ship Computer's tabs, docked at a
+## station); landing; every landable planet's surface (idle, a long walk that
+## streams the world in, a fight, inside a building, the Field Computer, the
+## transfer screen at the ship). A scenario passes when its average is at
+## least TARGET FPS (240) and 95% of its frames are too (frame time <=
+## 1000/TARGET ms), and none of its frames takes over FREEZE_MS (a stutter).
+## tools/fps_test.py also compares each with tests/fps_baseline.json (slower
+## by a quarter: flagged, even above the bar).
+##
+##   python3 tools/fps_test.py [filter]      (runs this in a window, your user data untouched)
+##   godot --path . --resolution 1920x1080 -s tests/fps_tour.gd [-- <filter>]
+##
+## Not headless: rendering is what's measured. Not part of tools/test.py (the
+## tests run headless, 12 Godots at once - no frame rate to speak of).
+
+var TARGET := 240.0          # --target=N to judge against another frame rate (the game's bar: 240)
+const SECONDS := 4.0          # measured per scenario
+const WARMUP := 0.75          # s run first, not measured (art baked on first use)
+const HITCH_MS := 25.0        # a frame this long counts as a hitch
+const FREEZE_MS := 50.0       # any frame this long fails a scenario (a stutter you'd see)
+
+var results: Array = []
+var _filter := ""
+var _shots := false           # --shots: a screenshot of each scenario (user://fps_shots/)
+var _attrib := false          # --attrib: for a slow scenario, what its frame time goes on
+var _scene: Node
+var _drive := Callable()      # called every frame while measuring (keeps a scenario going)
+var galaxy: Node              # (the autoloads: not known by name in a -s script)
+var save: Node
+var PlanetsS: GDScript           # (class names that use autoloads: loaded at run time)
+var SignalSitesS: GDScript
+var SurfaceCreatureS: GDScript
+
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	_run()
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	var args: Array = Array(OS.get_cmdline_user_args())
+	_attrib = args.has("--attrib")
+	_shots = args.has("--shots")
+	for a in args:
+		if a.begins_with("--target="):
+			TARGET = float(a.trim_prefix("--target="))
+	args = args.filter(func(a): return not a.begins_with("--"))   # (--attrib, --mute, --window-at=...)
+	_filter = args[0] if not args.is_empty() else ""
+	galaxy = root.get_node("Galaxy")
+	save = root.get_node("SaveGame")
+	PlanetsS = load("res://scripts/sim/planet_data.gd")
+	SignalSitesS = load("res://scripts/sim/signal_sites.gd")
+	SurfaceCreatureS = load("res://scripts/surface_creature.gd")
+	DisplayServer.window_set_vsync_mode(DisplayServer.VSYNC_DISABLED)
+	RenderingServer.viewport_set_measure_render_time(root.get_viewport_rid(), true)
+	Engine.max_fps = 0
+	for i in 3:
+		await process_frame
+	var art: Node = root.get_node_or_null("ProcArt")
+	while art and not art.ready_done:
+		await process_frame
+	# As the loading screen does: the main scenes loaded up front, kept.
+	for path in ["res://scenes/ui/main_menu.tscn", "res://main.tscn", "res://scenes/planet_surface.tscn", "res://scenes/ui/station_menu.tscn"]:
+		art.scenes[path] = load(path)
+	galaxy.new_game(false)
+	print("FPS tour: target %d FPS, %s, %s" % [TARGET, DisplayServer.window_get_size(), RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name()])
+	await _title()
+	await _space_home()
+	await _space_empires()
+	await _signal_sites()
+	await _landing()
+	for pid in ["thalassa", "krystallos", "akrotiri", "kronos", "selene"]:
+		await _surface(pid)
+	_set_scene(null)
+	_report()
+
+
+## A section runs if the filter names it ("space", "surface", "thalassa") or
+## one of its scenarios ("space: battle" - its scenario names begin with it).
+func _wanted(section: String) -> bool:
+	return _filter == "" or section.contains(_filter) or _filter.contains(section)
+
+
+## Measures `name` for SECONDS (after WARMUP), calling _drive every frame.
+func _measure(name: String, seconds := SECONDS) -> void:
+	if _filter != "" and not name.contains(_filter):
+		return
+	var t_end := Time.get_ticks_usec() + int(WARMUP * 1e6)
+	while Time.get_ticks_usec() < t_end:
+		await process_frame
+		if _drive.is_valid():
+			_drive.call()
+	print("@@profile " + name)   # (for tools/fps_test.py --profile)
+	var frames: Array = []
+	var cost := {"script": 0.0, "physics": 0.0, "render_cpu": 0.0, "gpu": 0.0}
+	var vp := root.get_viewport_rid()
+	var last := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	t_end = last + int(seconds * 1e6)
+	while last < t_end:
+		await process_frame
+		if _drive.is_valid():
+			_drive.call()
+		var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		frames.append((now - last) / 1000.0)
+		last = now
+		cost["script"] += Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PROCESS) * 1000.0
+		cost["physics"] += Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS) * 1000.0
+		cost["render_cpu"] += RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_cpu(vp) + RenderingServer.get_frame_setup_time_cpu()
+		cost["gpu"] += RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_gpu(vp)
+	print("@@profile -")
+	if _shots:
+		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute("user://fps_shots")
+		root.get_texture().get_image().save_png("user://fps_shots/%s.png" % name.validate_filename().replace(" ", "_"))
+	for k in cost:
+		cost[k] /= maxf(1.0, frames.size())
+	_record(name, frames, cost)
+	if _attrib and not results[-1]["ok"]:
+		await _attribute()
+
+
+## The average frame (ms) over `n` frames.
+func _avg_frame(n := 40) -> float:
+	for i in 5:
+		await process_frame
+		if _drive.is_valid():
+			_drive.call()
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for i in n:
+		await process_frame
+		if _drive.is_valid():
+			_drive.call()
+	return (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0 / n
+
+
+## What each script costs: its nodes' own processing switched off for a
+## moment (not their children's) - the frame time saved, against the frames
+## just before and after (a battle changes as it goes).
+func _attribute() -> void:
+	# First: everything's processing off (what's left: drawing and the engine).
+	var procs := []
+	for n in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
+		if n.is_processing() and n.get_script() != null:
+			procs.append(n)
+	var on_ms := await _avg_frame(60)
+	procs = procs.filter(func(n): return is_instance_valid(n))
+	for n in procs:
+		n.set_process(false)
+	var off_ms := await _avg_frame(60)
+	for n in procs:
+		if is_instance_valid(n):
+			n.set_process(true)
+	print("       frame %.2f ms; with no script processing %.2f ms (%d nodes)" % [on_ms, off_ms, procs.size()])
+	var by_script := {}
+	for n in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
+		var sc: Script = n.get_script()
+		if sc == null or not (n.is_processing() or n.is_physics_processing()):
+			continue
+		var key: String = sc.resource_path.get_file()
+		if key == "" or key.begins_with("fps_tour"):
+			continue
+		if not by_script.has(key):
+			by_script[key] = []
+		by_script[key].append(n)
+	var rows := []
+	for key in by_script:
+		var before := await _avg_frame(30)
+		var nodes: Array = by_script[key].filter(func(n): return is_instance_valid(n))
+		var was := []
+		for n in nodes:
+			was.append([n.is_processing(), n.is_physics_processing()])
+			n.set_process(false)
+			n.set_physics_process(false)
+		var off := await _avg_frame(30)
+		for i in nodes.size():
+			if is_instance_valid(nodes[i]):
+				nodes[i].set_process(was[i][0])
+				nodes[i].set_physics_process(was[i][1])
+		var after := await _avg_frame(30)
+		rows.append([(before + after) * 0.5 - off, key, nodes.size(), (before + after) * 0.5])
+	rows.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a[0] > b[0])
+	print("       what its scripts' processing costs (per frame):")
+	for r in rows.slice(0, 12):
+		if r[0] > 0.3:
+			print("         %-32s x%-4d %5.1f ms  (of %.1f)" % [r[1], r[2], r[0], r[3]])
+
+
+func _record(name: String, frames: Array, cost := {}) -> void:
+	var sorted := frames.duplicate()
+	sorted.sort()
+	var total := 0.0
+	for f in frames:
+		total += f
+	var avg := frames.size() / (total / 1000.0)
+	var p95: float = sorted[int(sorted.size() * 0.95)]
+	var p99: float = sorted[int(sorted.size() * 0.99)]
+	var worst: float = sorted[-1]
+	var hitches := frames.filter(func(f): return f > HITCH_MS).size()
+	var ok := avg >= TARGET and p95 <= 1000.0 / TARGET and worst <= FREEZE_MS
+	var r := {"name": name, "fps": avg, "p95_ms": p95, "low1_fps": 1000.0 / p99, "worst_ms": worst, "hitches": hitches,
+		"frames": frames.size(), "ok": ok,
+		"draw_calls": Performance.get_monitor(Performance.RENDER_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME),
+		"objects": Performance.get_monitor(Performance.OBJECT_NODE_COUNT), "cost_ms": cost}
+	results.append(r)
+	print("  %-4s %-46s %6.0f fps  p95 %5.1f ms  1%%low %5.0f fps  worst %6.1f ms  hitches %d  (%d draw calls, %d nodes)" % [
+		"ok" if ok else "SLOW", name, avg, p95, r["low1_fps"], worst, hitches, r["draw_calls"], r["objects"]])
+	if not cost.is_empty():
+		print("       (per frame: scripts %.1f ms, physics %.1f ms, render CPU %.1f ms, GPU %.1f ms)" % [cost["script"], cost["physics"], cost["render_cpu"], cost["gpu"]])
+
+
+func _set_scene(n: Node) -> void:
+	_drive = Callable()
+	if paused:
+		paused = false
+	if is_instance_valid(_scene):
+		_scene.queue_free()
+		await process_frame
+		await process_frame
+	_scene = n
+	if n:
+		root.add_child(n)
+		current_scene = n
+
+
+# --- Title -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _title() -> void:
+	if not _wanted("title"):
+		return
+	await _set_scene(load("res://scenes/ui/main_menu.tscn").instantiate())
+	await _measure("title screen")
+
+
+# --- Space -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _enter_space(system: String) -> Node:
+	galaxy.current_system = system
+	save.travelling = system != galaxy.HOME
+	save.landed_planet = ""
+	await _set_scene(load("res://main.tscn").instantiate())
+	for i in 40:
+		await process_frame
+	save.travelling = false
+	_scene.ship.invulnerable = true   # (a battle shouldn't end the run)

+
+
+func _space_home() -> void:
+	if not _wanted("space"):
+		return

+	await _measure("space: home system, idle")

+	_drive = func():

+			t[0] = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1500.0 + 1.0
+			main._move_ship(main.ship.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(rng.randf() * TAU) * 3000.0)
+	await _measure("space: flying across the system")
+	# A battle: 6 pirates on you, you fighting back (a new one for each that falls).

+	var foes: Array = []
+	_drive = func():
+		for e in foes.duplicate():   # (in place: a lambda's own reassignments don't last)

+				foes.erase(e)
+		while foes.size() < 6:
+			var e: Node2D = main.spawn_enemy(main.ship.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(rng.randf() * TAU) * rng.randf_range(500, 900))

+		await tree.process_frame

+## The panels of `root` sticking out of the window: ["name: rect", ...].
+func _outside(root: Control) -> Array:
+	var vp := root.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().grow(1.0)
+	var out := []
+	var stack: Array = [root]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		if n is ScrollContainer:
+			continue   # (its content scrolls)
+		if n is Control and not n.is_visible_in_tree():
+			continue
+		if n is PanelContainer and not vp.encloses(n.get_global_rect()):
+			out.append("%s: %s" % [n.get_path(), n.get_global_rect()])
+		stack.append_array(n.get_children())
+	return out

+		box.add_child(_item(t[0], t[1], t[2], EditorIcons.tip(t[1], t[3], t[4]), go))
+	var gap := Control.new()
+	gap.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	box.add_child(gap)
+	box.add_child(_item("menu", "Exit", "exit", EditorIcons.tip("Exit Talos", "", "Back to the title screen. Each tool asks about unsaved changes first;\nedits already made apply to games started from here on.")
+		, go))
+	select(box, current)
+	return box
+
+
+static func _item(id: String, name: String, icon: String, tip: String, go: Callable) -> Button:
+	var b := Button.new()
+	b.name = "Nav_" + id
+	b.text = name
+	b.icon = EditorIcons.get_icon(icon)
+	b.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	b.vertical_icon_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_TOP
+	b.toggle_mode = true
+	b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(WIDTH, ITEM_H)
+	b.clip_text = true   # (a long name can't widen the rail)
+	b.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
+	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
+	b.tooltip_text = tip
+	b.set_meta("talos_nav", id)
+	b.pressed.connect(func():
+		select(b.get_parent(), str(b.get_parent().get_meta("current", "")))   # (lit only when you get there)
+		go.call(id))
+	return b
+
+
+## The tools' scenes, loaded in the background once Talos is open, so the
+## first visit to each doesn't wait for its scripts and scene to load
+## (~0.4-1 s the first time; then they're ready).
+static func _warm() -> void:
+	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
+		return
+	for path in [EDITOR] + SCENES.values():
+		if path != MENU and not ResourceLoader.has_cached(path) and ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path) == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE:
+			ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path)
+
+
+## Lights `current`'s button.
+static func select(box: Node, current: String) -> void:
+	box.set_meta("current", current)
+	for b in box.get_children():
+		if b is Button:
+			b.set_pressed_no_signal(b.get_meta("talos_nav", "") == current)
+
+
+## The rail beside a screen's content: `root` (a full-screen modal's box)
+## gets the rail and a column for the screen, which is returned.
+static func wrap(root: VBoxContainer, current: String, go: Callable, keys := true) -> VBoxContainer:
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
+	root.add_child(row)
+	row.add_child(rail(current, go, keys))
+	var sep := VSeparator.new()
+	row.add_child(sep)
+	var col := VBoxContainer.new()
+	col.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	col.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	col.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	row.add_child(col)
+	return col
+
+
+## The Talos host (editor_screen.gd: every tool kept, switched by showing
+## one), or null when a tool runs as a scene of its own (tests).
+static func host(tree: SceneTree) -> Node:
+	var s := tree.current_scene
+	return s if s != null and s.has_method("show_tool") else null
+
+
+## The rail's click from a tool: in the host, straight there (the tool stays
+## as it is, so nothing to ask); on its own, `guard` first (it asks about
+## unsaved changes, then calls what it's given), then the tool's scene.
+static func go(tree: SceneTree, id: String, guard := Callable()) -> void:
+	var h := host(tree)
+	if h:
+		h.show_tool(id)
+	elif guard.is_valid():
+		guard.call(func(): open(tree, id))
+	else:
+		open(tree, id)
+
+
+## A tool's scene: the one loaded in the background (_warm) if it's there.
+static func scene(path: String) -> PackedScene:
+	if ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path) != ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE:
+		var r := ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(path)
+		if r is PackedScene:
+			return r
+	return load(path)
+
+
+## Goes to tool `id` (a data-editor page, a tool, or "menu").
+static func open(tree: SceneTree, id: String) -> void:
+	var h := host(tree)
+	if h:
+		h.show_tool(id)
+		return
+	if id in PAGES:
+		page = PAGES.find(id)
+		tree.change_scene_to_file(EDITOR)
+	elif SCENES.has(id):
+		tree.change_scene_to_file(SCENES[id])
+
+
+## A screen's header: its name (and a line under it, `note`, for status
+## messages) on the left; the screen's own buttons go after the spacer.
+## Returns [header, note label].
+static func header(title: String, note: String, accent: Color) -> Array:
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	var t := UI.label(title, 24, accent)
+	t.name = "TalosTitle"
+	h.add_child(t)
+	var n := UI.label(note, 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	n.name = "TalosNote"
+	n.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	n.clip_text = true
+	n.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
+	n.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	h.add_child(n)
+	return [h, n]
+

+## The tools' shortcuts, wherever you are in Talos (before the tool's own keys:
+## Ctrl+digit isn't a room or a zoom here).
+class Keys extends Node:
+	var go: Callable
+	var current := ""
+
+	func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+		var k := event as InputEventKey
+		if k == null or not k.pressed or k.echo or not is_visible_in_tree_safe():
+			return
+		var id := ""
+		if k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode >= KEY_1 and k.keycode < KEY_1 + PAGES.size():
+			id = PAGES[k.keycode - KEY_1]
+		elif not k.ctrl_pressed:
+			id = {KEY_F3: "library", KEY_F4: "scenarios", KEY_F6: "svg", KEY_F7: "patcher"}.get(k.keycode, "")
+		if id == "" or id == current:
+			return
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+		go.call(id)
+
+	func is_visible_in_tree_safe() -> bool:
+		var p := get_parent() as Control
+		return p != null and p.is_visible_in_tree()",

+	var main: Node = load("res://main.tscn").instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(main)
+	for i in 5:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	# (not the current scene in a test: give SaveGame the game to save)
+	var g: Node = main
+	check(SaveGame.save_game(g.get_save_data(), SaveGame.QUICK), "a quicksave")
+	check(SaveGame.has_save(SaveGame.QUICK) and not SaveGame.has_save(1), "in its own slot, not a numbered one")
+	check(SaveGame.save_game(g.get_save_data(), SaveGame.AUTO), "an autosave")
+	check(SaveGame.has_save(SaveGame.AUTO), "in its own slot")
+	check(SaveGame.QUICK in SaveGame.all_slots() and SaveGame.AUTO in SaveGame.all_slots(), "both in the load list")
+	check(SaveGame.latest_slot() in [SaveGame.QUICK, SaveGame.AUTO], "the newest of them")
+	check(SaveGame.queue_load(SaveGame.QUICK) and not SaveGame.pending.is_empty(), "the quicksave loads")
+	SaveGame.pending = {}
+	# Under attack: no autosave.
+	var e: Node2D = main.spawn_enemy(main.ship.global_position + Vector2(400, 0))
+	e._target = main.ship
+	check(main.in_combat(), "in combat with an enemy on you")
+	e.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+	check(not main.in_combat(), "out of it")
+	check(Keybinds.binds.has("quicksave") and Keybinds.binds.has("quickload"), "F5 / F9 are bindable actions")
+	main.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+	for s in [SaveGame.QUICK, SaveGame.AUTO]:
+		SaveGame.delete_slot(s)

+func test_autosave_settings() -> void:
+	var old_m: int = Settings.autosave_minutes
+	var old_e: bool = Settings.autosave_events

+	Settings.autosave_minutes = 0
+	SaveGame._auto_t = 0.0
+	SaveGame._process(1.0)
+	check(not SaveGame.has_save(SaveGame.AUTO), "periodic autosaves off: none")
+	check(SaveGame._auto_t <= 0.0, "(the timer doesn't run)")

+		var raw := f.get_buffer(1 << 16)
+		f.close()
+		var parts := _split_nul(raw)
+		if parts.size() > 1:
+			return parts.slice(1)   # (without the executable itself)
+	var pos := DisplayServer.window_get_position_with_decorations()
+	var size := DisplayServer.window_get_size()
+	var args := ["--path", ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://"), "--resolution", "%dx%d" % [size.x, size.y],
+		"--position", "%d,%d" % [pos.x, pos.y]]
+	var user := Array(OS.get_cmdline_user_args())
+	return args + (["--"] + user if not user.is_empty() else [])
+
+
+static func _split_nul(raw: PackedByteArray) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var start := 0
+	for i in raw.size():
+		if raw[i] == 0:
+			out.append(raw.slice(start, i).get_string_from_utf8())
+			start = i + 1
+	if start < raw.size():
+		out.append(raw.slice(start).get_string_from_utf8())
+	return out
+
+
+func _read_resume() -> Dictionary:
+	if not FileAccess.file_exists(RESUME_FILE):
+		return {}
+	var d: Variant = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(RESUME_FILE))
+	DirAccess.remove_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(RESUME_FILE))
+	return d if d is Dictionary else {}

+## After a live restart: once the title screen is up, back where you were.
+func _resume_step() -> void:
+	var tree := get_tree()
+	var scene := tree.current_scene

+		return
+	var r := _resume
+	_resume = {}
+	match str(r.get("kind", "")):
+		"game":
+			SaveGame.load_slot(SaveGame.LIVE)
+			if r.get("talos_overlay", false):
+				_reopen_talos = r   # (once the game is back: Talos over it again)
+		"talos":
+			SaveGame.talos_return = bool(r.get("talos_return", false))
+			TalosNav.page = int(r.get("page", 0))
+			tree.change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/editor/editor.tscn")
+			var tool := str(r.get("tool", ""))
+			if tool != "":

+
+var _reopen_talos := {}
+
+func _reopen_talos_step() -> void:

+		return   # (still loading)
+	var r := _reopen_talos

+func _talos_open() -> bool:

+## Whether any Talos tool has edits not saved yet.
+func _talos_unsaved() -> bool:
+	for s in [get_tree().current_scene, SaveGame.talos_overlay()]:

+			continue
+		for n in s.find_children("*", "", true, false):

+## After a hot reload: the screens on show rebuilt with the new code (a
+## page built before keeps what it built until it's built again).

+	"ship_menu.gd": "show_tab", "field_menu.gd": "show_tab", "patcher.gd": "show_patch"}
+
+func _refresh_screens() -> void:
+	var stack: Array = [get_tree().current_scene, SaveGame.talos_overlay()].filter(func(x): return x != null)
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		stack.append_array(n.get_children())
+		var sc: Script = n.get_script()
+		if sc == null or not SCREENS.has(sc.resource_path.get_file()):
+			continue
+		if n is CanvasItem and not n.is_visible_in_tree():

+				n.call(m, cur)
+		else:

+## A note in the corner for a few seconds (what a live update did).
+const NOTE := Color(0.55, 0.9, 1.0)

+extends SceneTree
+## Screenshots for the guide, the tutorial and the encyclopedia (data/docs/
+## shots.json): each shot sets up a moment of the game and saves the screen,
+## full size, as a PNG - tools/doc_shots.py then draws its infographic over it
+## and saves it into data/docs/shots/. Run by that tool, in a window:
+##   godot --path . -s tests/doc_shots.gd -- [shot ids...] --out=DIR
+## (no ids: every shot).
+
+const ALL := ["space_hud", "space_combat", "mining", "damage", "nav_beacon", "signal_site", "salvage",
+	"station_market", "station_outfitting", "station_weapons", "station_shipyard", "station_missions", "station_reputation", "station_service",
+	"computer_inventory", "computer_map", "probes", "computer_galaxy", "computer_tech", "computer_quest", "industry", "repair_bay", "surgery", "archive",
+	"surface_walk", "field_inventory", "surface_map"]
+
+var galaxy: Node
+var save: Node
+var _scene: Node
+var _want: Array = []
+var _out := "user://doc_shots"
+var _done: Array = []
+
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	_run()
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	for a in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
+		if a.begins_with("--out="):
+			_out = a.trim_prefix("--out=")
+		elif not a.begins_with("--"):
+			_want.append(a)
+	if _want.is_empty():
+		_want = ALL.duplicate()
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(_out)
+	galaxy = root.get_node("Galaxy")
+	save = root.get_node("SaveGame")
+	DisplayServer.window_set_vsync_mode(DisplayServer.VSYNC_ENABLED)
+	for i in 3:
+		await process_frame
+	var art: Node = root.get_node_or_null("ProcArt")
+	while art and not art.ready_done:
+		await process_frame
+	galaxy.new_game(false)
+	if _any(["space_hud", "space_combat", "mining", "damage", "nav_beacon", "salvage"]):
+		await _space()
+	if _any(["signal_site"]):
+		await _signal_site()
+	if _any(["station_market", "station_outfitting", "station_weapons", "station_shipyard", "station_missions", "station_reputation", "station_service"]):
+		await _station()
+	if _any(["computer_inventory", "computer_map", "probes", "computer_galaxy", "computer_tech", "computer_quest", "industry", "repair_bay", "surgery", "archive"]):
+		await _computer()
+	if _any(["surface_walk", "field_inventory", "surface_map"]):
+		await _surface()
+	await _set_scene(null)
+	print("DOC SHOTS: " + ",".join(_done))
+	quit()
+
+
+func _any(ids: Array) -> bool:
+	return ids.any(func(i): return i in _want)
+
+
+## Saves the screen as shot `id` (when it's wanted), after `wait` seconds.
+func _snap(id: String, wait := 1.5) -> void:
+	if not id in _want:
+		return
+	var t_end := Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(wait * 1000.0)
+	while Time.get_ticks_msec() < t_end:
+		await process_frame
+	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
+	root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(_out.path_join(id + ".png"))
+	_done.append(id)
+
+
+func _set_scene(n: Node) -> void:
+	if paused:
+		paused = false
+	if is_instance_valid(_scene):
+		_scene.queue_free()
+		await process_frame
+		await process_frame
+	_scene = n
+	if n:
+		root.add_child(n)
+		current_scene = n
+
+
+func _enter_space(system: String) -> Node:
+	galaxy.current_system = system
+	save.travelling = system != galaxy.HOME
+	save.landed_planet = ""
+	await _set_scene(load("res://main.tscn").instantiate())
+	for i in 60:
+		await process_frame
+	save.travelling = false
+	_scene.ship.invulnerable = true
+	return _scene
+
+
+# --- In space --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _space() -> void:

+	var st: Node2D = _nearest_station(main)
+	main.ship.global_position = st.global_position + Vector2(-700, 450)
+	main.ship.stop()
+	await _snap("space_hud", 2.5)
+	# A fight: four raiders round you, you firing back.
+	var foes := []
+	for i in 4:
+		foes.append(main.spawn_enemy(main.ship.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / 4.0 + 0.4) * 620.0))
+	main.ship.set_attack_target(foes[0], true)
+	await _snap("space_combat", 2.2)
+	for e in foes:
+		if is_instance_valid(e):
+			e.queue_free()
+	main.ship.set_attack_target(null)
+	# Mining: the beam on the nearest rock.
+	var rock: Node2D = null
+	for r in main.asteroids.get_children():
+		if rock == null or r.global_position.distance_to(main.ship.global_position) < rock.global_position.distance_to(main.ship.global_position):
+			rock = r
+	if rock:
+		main.ship.global_position = rock.global_position + Vector2(0, 260)
+		main.ship.rotation = 0.0
+		main.ship.stop()
+		main.ship.set_attack_target(rock)   # (no chase: it mines from where it stands)
+		rock.scanned = true                  # (prospected: its veins - Mining)
+		main.ship.mining_auto = true         # (cutting a vein, its heat kept in the band)
+		await _snap("mining", 3.0)
+		main.ship.mining_auto = false
+		main.ship.set_attack_target(null)

+		main.ship.global_position = st.global_position + Vector2(-900, 700)

+		main.ship.apply_tech()
+		main.hud.afflictions.refresh()
+		await _snap("damage", 3.0)

+		var w = load("res://scripts/wreck.gd").spawn(main, at, root.get_node("ProcArt").get_tex("ship_player"), Vector2.ONE, 0.6, {"kind": "ship", "title": "Sea Raider Ember-class Fighter"})

+		await _snap("salvage", 2.5)

+func _signal_site() -> void:

+def gd_str(s):

+def main():
+    ids = set()
+    goods, cats, makes, uses = [], [], {e: [] for e in ECONOMIES}, {e: [] for e in ECONOMIES}
+    for title, base, makers, users, new in CATEGORIES:
+        assert len(base) + len(new) == 14, title
+        for m in makers + users:
+            assert m in ECONOMIES, m
+        cats.append((title, base + [g[0] for g in new]))
+        for g in new:
+            gid = g[0]
+            assert gid not in ids, gid
+            ids.add(gid)
+            goods.append((title, g))
+            for m in makers:
+                makes[m].append(gid)
+            # two users, picked by the good's name (stable)
+            h = zlib.crc32(gid.encode())
+            picks = [users[h % len(users)], users[(h // 7 + 1 + h % (len(users) - 1)) % len(users)]]
+            for u in dict.fromkeys(picks):
+                if u not in makers:
+                    uses[u].append(gid)
+    assert len(ids) == 126, len(ids)
+
+    out = []
+    out.append("class_name TradeGoods")

+    out.append("##")

+    out.append("## desc, cat) plus each one's icon (shape, c1, c2 - draw_icon). CATEGORIES: the")
+    out.append("## market's tabs in order, [title, [ids]] - the originals first in each. MAKES /")
+    out.append("## USES: economy -> the new goods its stations make / use (Galaxy sets the rates).")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("const GOODS := {")
+    for title, (gid, name, value, shape, c1, c2, desc) in goods:
+        out.append('\t%s: {"name": %s, "kind": "cargo", "value": %d, "cat": %s, "shape": %s, "c1": Color("%s"), "c2": Color("%s"),' % (
+            gd_str(gid), gd_str(name), value, gd_str(title), gd_str(shape), c1, c2))
+        out.append('\t\t"desc": %s},' % gd_str(desc))
+    out.append("}")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("const CATEGORIES := [")
+    for title, members in cats:
+        out.append("\t[%s, [%s]]," % (gd_str(title), ", ".join(gd_str(m) for m in members)))
+    out.append("]")
+    out.append("")
+    for name, table in (("MAKES", makes), ("USES", uses)):
+        out.append("const %s := {" % name)
+        for e in ECONOMIES:
+            out.append("\t%s: [%s]," % (gd_str(e), ", ".join(gd_str(g) for g in table[e])))
+        out.append("}")
+        out.append("")
+    out.append(DRAW)
+    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "scripts", "trade_goods.gd")
+    open(path, "w").write("\n".join(out))
+    print("wrote scripts/trade_goods.gd: %d goods, %d categories" % (len(goods), len(cats)))

hunks.title: The new automaton.py
hunks.note: The automaton (you on foot), rebuilt from its reference sheets (external/images/player_on_foot_idle.png / _aim.png).

files.explanation: The Blender character kit: The android kit: what the automaton (automaton.py) and the pirate android (pirate.py) are built from, rigged with and rendered by. materials cel shading (a toon ramp on a flat colour, an ink outline drawn as an inverted hull), glowing lights meshes box / loft / tube / ball / plate - rigid armour parts, each parented to ONE bone (androids: no weight painting) the rig build_rig(): an armature "Rig" under the empty "Root" (turned to face the 8 directions). The character faces -Y, its left is +X, feet on z = 0. Bones: pelvis, spine, chest, head, pauldron.L/R, upper.L/R, fore.L/R, hand.L/R, fingers.L/R, thigh.L/R, shin.L/R, foot.L/R, gun, + extra "tail" bones a skin may add (coat tails). the solver solve(pose) -> every bone's matrix from a pose of a few controls (pelvis, chest twist / lean, head, the hands' and feet's targets: analytic two-bone IK) - moves.py describes every animation as key poses of those controls; bake() keys them into actions. rendering stage() (the game's view: orthographic, 30 degrees above, lights fixed to the camera), render_clip(). Run through build.py (blender -b --python build.py -- <skin> ...).
