files.explanation: An engine-level service: The Inspector (developer menu, Alt + right-click > Inspector): a window inside the game's (along its right edge; movable, resizable), showing live objects' values as they change. Top: the node tree (filterable; select a node to inspect it). Bottom: the inspected object's properties - its script's variables first, then the built-in ones - refreshed several times a second. Arrays, dictionaries and objects open into their contents; double-click an object to inspect it (Back returns). Numbers, text, booleans, vectors and colours can be edited in place (Enter sets the value on the live object). A field that isn't at its default (the script variable's declared value, or the engine's default for a built-in property) has a reset button (↺); Reset all puts every such field of the object back. (Moved from scripts/dev_inspector.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,843 @@ 
+extends Window
+## The Inspector (developer menu, Alt + right-click > Inspector): a window
+## inside the game's (along its right edge; movable, resizable), showing
+## live objects' values as they change. Top: the node tree (filterable;
+## select a node to inspect it).
+## Bottom: the inspected object's properties - its script's variables first,
+## then the built-in ones - refreshed several times a second. Arrays,
+## dictionaries and objects open into their contents; double-click an object
+## to inspect it (Back returns). Numbers, text, booleans, vectors and colours
+## can be edited in place (Enter sets the value on the live object). A field
+## that isn't at its default (the script variable's declared value, or the
+## engine's default for a built-in property) has a reset button (↺); Reset
+## all puts every such field of the object back.
+
+const REFRESH := 0.2
+const W := 560
+const BUILTIN := ["position", "global_position", "rotation", "scale", "visible", "modulate",
+	"z_index", "process_mode", "size"]
+
+var target: Object
+var _history: Array = []           # WeakRefs of earlier targets (Back)
+var _nodes: Tree
+var _props: Tree
+var _filter: LineEdit
+var _path: Label
+var _builtin: CheckBox
+var _t := 0.0
+var _editing := false
+var _defaults := {}                # property -> [has a default, default] (the target's)
+var _reset_all: Button
+const SNAP := 24                   # px: an edge this near the game window's snaps to it
+var docked := {}                   # SIDE_* -> true: edges flush with the game window's
+var _last := Rect2i()
+var _last_view := Vector2i()
+const RESET := 7
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	title = "Inspector"
+	visible = false
+	force_native = false   # (inside the game's window - an embedded subwindow)
+	transient = false
+	exclusive = false
+	wrap_controls = false
+	min_size = Vector2i(380, 300)
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	close_requested.connect(hide)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	var bg := Panel.new()
+	bg.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	sb.bg_color = Color(0.06, 0.07, 0.11)
+	bg.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
+	add_child(bg)
+	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
+	box.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	for side in ["left", "right", "top", "bottom"]:
+		box.set("offset_" + side, 6 if side in ["left", "top"] else -6)
+	add_child(box)
+
+	var bar := HBoxContainer.new()
+	box.add_child(bar)
+	var back := Button.new()
+	back.text = "◀ Back"
+	back.pressed.connect(go_back)
+	bar.add_child(back)
+	var refresh := Button.new()
+	refresh.text = "⟳ Tree"
+	refresh.tooltip_text = "Rebuild the node tree"
+	refresh.pressed.connect(rebuild_tree)
+	bar.add_child(refresh)
+	_filter = LineEdit.new()
+	_filter.placeholder_text = "Filter nodes..."
+	_filter.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_filter.text_changed.connect(func(_t): rebuild_tree())
+	bar.add_child(_filter)
+
+	var split := VSplitContainer.new()
+	split.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	box.add_child(split)
+	_nodes = Tree.new()
+	_nodes.custom_minimum_size.y = 160
+	_nodes.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_nodes.size_flags_stretch_ratio = 0.6
+	_nodes.item_selected.connect(_on_node_selected)
+	_nodes.item_collapsed.connect(_on_node_collapsed)
+	split.add_child(_nodes)
+
+	var lower := VBoxContainer.new()
+	lower.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	split.add_child(lower)
+	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
+	lower.add_child(head)
+	_path = Label.new()
+	_path.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_path.clip_text = true
+	_path.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.55, 0.9, 1.0))
+	head.add_child(_path)
+	_builtin = CheckBox.new()
+	_builtin.text = "Built-in"
+	_builtin.tooltip_text = "Also show the engine's properties (position, scale, ...)"
+	_builtin.toggled.connect(func(_on): _rebuild_props())
+	head.add_child(_builtin)
+	_props = Tree.new()
+	_props.columns = 2
+	_props.hide_root = true
+	_props.column_titles_visible = true
+	_props.set_column_title(0, "Property")
+	_props.set_column_title(1, "Value")
+	_props.set_column_expand_ratio(0, 2)
+	_props.set_column_expand_ratio(1, 3)
+	_props.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_props.item_activated.connect(_on_prop_activated)
+	_props.item_edited.connect(_on_prop_edited)
+	_props.item_collapsed.connect(_on_prop_collapsed)
+	lower.add_child(_props)
+	rebuild_tree()
+
+
+## Show it right of the game's window (inside the screen if there's no room).
+## Show it inside the game's window, along its right edge (the first time -
+## after that where it was left: drag the title bar to move it, an edge to
+## resize it).
+func open() -> void:
+	var view := get_tree().root.get_visible_rect().size
+	if not has_meta("placed"):
+		# Docked to the right edge, top to bottom.
+		var m := frame_margins()
+		var w := mini(W, int(view.x * 0.45))
+		size = Vector2i(w, maxi(300, int(view.y - m[1] - m[3])))
+		position = Vector2i(int(view.x - m[2]) - w, int(m[1]))
+		docked = {SIDE_RIGHT: true, SIDE_TOP: true, SIDE_BOTTOM: true}
+		_last = Rect2i(position, size)
+		set_meta("placed", true)
+	else:   # (keep it on screen if the game's window shrank)
+		position = Vector2i(clampi(position.x, 0, maxi(0, int(view.x) - size.x)), clampi(position.y, 0, maxi(0, int(view.y) - 40)))
+	show()
+	grab_focus()
+	rebuild_tree()
+	if target == null:
+		var link := get_parent()
+		var m: Node = link.main() if link and link.has_method("main") else null
+		inspect(m.get("ship") if m else get_tree().root)
+
+
+func inspect(obj: Object, remember := true) -> void:
+	if remember and is_instance_valid(target) and target != obj:
+		_history.append(weakref(target))
+	target = obj
+	_rebuild_props()
+	_select_in_tree(obj)
+
+
+func go_back() -> void:
+	while not _history.is_empty():
+		var o: Object = _history.pop_back().get_ref()
+		if is_instance_valid(o):
+			inspect(o, false)
+			return
+
+
+# --- The node tree ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func rebuild_tree() -> void:
+	if _nodes == null:
+		return
+	_nodes.clear()
+	var f := _filter.text.strip_edges().to_lower()
+	var top := _nodes.create_item()
+	_set_node_item(top, get_tree().root)
+	if f == "":
+		_add_kids(top, get_tree().root, 0)
+	else:
+		_add_matches(top, get_tree().root, f, 0)
+
+
+## A node's label: Godot's made-up names (@Node2D@494) give way to its own.
+static func node_label(n: Node) -> String:
+	var s := str(n.name)
+	if s.begins_with("@"):
+		for k in ["display_name", "type_id"]:
+			var v = n.get(k)
+			if v is String and v != "":
+				return "%s  (%s)" % [v, s]
+	return s
+
+
+func _set_node_item(it: TreeItem, n: Node) -> void:
+	var s := node_label(n)
+	if n.get_script() and n.get_script().resource_path != "":
+		s += "  · " + n.get_script().resource_path.get_file().get_basename()
+	else:
+		s += "  · " + n.get_class()
+	it.set_text(0, s)
+	it.set_metadata(0, n.get_instance_id())
+	if n == self:
+		it.set_custom_color(0, Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
+
+
+## Two levels at a time; deeper ones fill when opened.
+func _add_kids(it: TreeItem, n: Node, depth: int) -> void:
+	for c in n.get_children():
+		if c == self:
+			continue
+		var ci := _nodes.create_item(it)
+		_set_node_item(ci, c)
+		if c.get_child_count() > 0:
+			if depth < 1:
+				_add_kids(ci, c, depth + 1)
+			else:
+				_nodes.create_item(ci).set_text(0, "...")
+			ci.collapsed = depth >= 1 or c.get_child_count() > 30
+
+
+func _add_matches(it: TreeItem, n: Node, f: String, depth: int) -> void:
+	if depth > 12:
+		return
+	for c in n.get_children():
+		if c == self:
+			continue
+		var name_hit: bool = str(c.name).to_lower().contains(f) or (c.get_script() != null and c.get_script().resource_path.get_file().to_lower().contains(f))
+		if name_hit:
+			var ci := _nodes.create_item(it)
+			_set_node_item(ci, c)
+			ci.set_text(0, str(c.get_path()).trim_prefix("/root/") + ("  · " + c.get_script().resource_path.get_file().get_basename() if c.get_script() else ""))
+		_add_matches(it, c, f, depth + 1)
+
+
+func _on_node_collapsed(it: TreeItem) -> void:
+	if it.collapsed:
+		return
+	var first := it.get_first_child()
+	if first and first.get_text(0) == "..." and first.get_metadata(0) == null:
+		first.free()
+		var n := instance_from_id(it.get_metadata(0)) as Node
+		if is_instance_valid(n):
+			_add_kids(it, n, 1)
+			for c in it.get_children():
+				c.collapsed = true
+
+
+func _on_node_selected() -> void:
+	var it := _nodes.get_selected()
+	if it == null or it.get_metadata(0) == null:
+		return
+	var n := instance_from_id(it.get_metadata(0))
+	if is_instance_valid(n) and n != target:
+		inspect(n)
+
+
+func _select_in_tree(obj: Object) -> void:
+	if _nodes == null or not (obj is Node) or not obj.is_inside_tree():
+		_nodes.deselect_all() if _nodes else null
+		return
+	# Open the way down to it (deeper rows are only made when opened).
+	var chain: Array = []
+	var a: Node = obj
+	while a:
+		chain.push_front(a)
+		a = a.get_parent()
+	var cur := _nodes.get_root()
+	for i in range(1, chain.size()):
+		if cur == null:
+			break
+		if cur.collapsed:
+			cur.collapsed = false   # (fills it - item_collapsed)
+		var next: TreeItem = null
+		for c in cur.get_children():
+			if c.get_metadata(0) == chain[i].get_instance_id():
+				next = c
+				break
+		cur = next
+	var it := _find_item(_nodes.get_root(), obj.get_instance_id())
+	if it and not it.is_selected(0):
+		var p := it.get_parent()
+		while p:
+			p.collapsed = false
+			p = p.get_parent()
+		it.select(0)
+		_nodes.scroll_to_item(it)
+
+
+func _find_item(it: TreeItem, id: int) -> TreeItem:
+	if it == null:
+		return null
+	if it.get_metadata(0) == id:
+		return it
+	for c in it.get_children():
+		var r := _find_item(c, id)
+		if r:
+			return r
+	return null
+
+
+# --- The properties ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _names() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	if not is_instance_valid(target):
+		return out
+	var built := []
+	for p in target.get_property_list():
+		var u: int = p["usage"]
+		if u & PROPERTY_USAGE_SCRIPT_VARIABLE:
+			out.append(p["name"])
+		elif _builtin.button_pressed and (u & PROPERTY_USAGE_EDITOR) and p["name"] != "script":
+			built.append(p["name"])
+		elif p["name"] in BUILTIN:
+			built.append(p["name"])
+	if not _builtin.button_pressed:
+		built = built.filter(func(n): return n in BUILTIN)
+	return out + built
+
+
+func _rebuild_props() -> void:
+	if _props == null:
+		return
+	_props.clear()
+	var root := _props.create_item()
+	if not is_instance_valid(target):
+		_path.text = "(nothing - or it was freed)"
+		return
+	_path.text = _describe(target)
+	_path.tooltip_text = _path.text
+	_defaults.clear()
+	for n in _names():
+		var it := _props.create_item(root)
+		it.set_text(0, n)
+		it.set_metadata(0, [n])   # (the path of keys from the target)
+		_show(it, target.get(n))
+	_t = REFRESH
+
+
+func _describe(o: Object) -> String:
+	if o is Node:
+		var s := str(o.get_path()) if o.is_inside_tree() else str(o.name)
+		return s + ("  (%s)" % o.get_script().resource_path.get_file() if o.get_script() else "  (%s)" % o.get_class())
+	if o is Resource and o.resource_path != "":
+		return "%s  (%s)" % [o.resource_path, o.get_class()]
+	return "<%s #%d>" % [o.get_class(), o.get_instance_id()]
+
+
+## The value in an item's column 1 (+ an openable placeholder for containers).
+func _show(it: TreeItem, v: Variant) -> void:
+	var text := _brief(v)
+	if it.get_text(1) != text and not (_editing and it == _props.get_edited()):
+		it.set_text(1, text)
+	var t := typeof(v)
+	var editable := t in [TYPE_INT, TYPE_FLOAT, TYPE_STRING, TYPE_STRING_NAME, TYPE_VECTOR2, TYPE_VECTOR2I, TYPE_COLOR, TYPE_BOOL]
+	it.set_editable(1, editable and _is_settable(it))
+	it.set_custom_color(1, Color(0.6, 0.85, 1.0) if t == TYPE_OBJECT else (Color(1, 0.8, 0.5) if t in [TYPE_INT, TYPE_FLOAT] else Color(0.88, 0.9, 0.95)))
+	var opens: bool = (t == TYPE_OBJECT and is_instance_valid(v)) or ((v is Array or v is Dictionary or t >= TYPE_PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY) and v.size() > 0)
+	if opens and it.get_child_count() == 0:
+		_props.create_item(it).set_text(0, "...")
+		it.collapsed = true
+	elif not opens and it.get_child_count() > 0:
+		for c in it.get_children():
+			c.free()
+	var keys = it.get_metadata(0)
+	if keys is Array and keys.size() == 1:
+		_show_reset(it, keys[0], v)
+
+
+## While it has focus, Godot sends it every mouse click - even ones outside it,
+## over the game (only a left click there takes the focus back): so an
+## Alt + right-click reaching it opens the developer menu where it was made.
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+	if mb and mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT and mb.alt_pressed:
+		var link := get_parent()
+		if link and link.has_method("open_menu"):
+			set_input_as_handled()
+			link.open_menu(mb.position + Vector2(position))   # (its own coordinates -> the game view's)
+
+
+# --- Snapping to the game window's edges ----------------------------------------
+
+## The frame Godot draws round the window (title bar and border included) -
+## [left, top, right, bottom] beyond its content.
+func frame_margins() -> Array:
+	var sb := get_theme_stylebox("embedded_border")
+	if sb is StyleBoxFlat:
+		return [sb.expand_margin_left, sb.expand_margin_top, sb.expand_margin_right, sb.expand_margin_bottom]
+	return [0.0, float(get_theme_constant("title_height")), 0.0, 0.0]
+
+
+## The window's frame, in the game view.
+func frame_rect() -> Rect2:
+	var m := frame_margins()
+	return Rect2(Vector2(position) - Vector2(m[0], m[1]), Vector2(size) + Vector2(m[0] + m[2], m[1] + m[3]))
+
+
+## Every frame: moved (by its title bar) - a frame edge near a game window
+## edge snaps flush to it; resized (by an edge) - the moved edge snaps; the
+## game window resized - docked edges follow it.
+func snap() -> void:
+	if not is_embedded():
+		return
+	var view := Vector2i(get_tree().root.get_visible_rect().size)
+	var now := Rect2i(position, size)
+	var view_changed := _last_view != Vector2i() and view != _last_view
+	_last_view = view
+	if now == _last and not view_changed:
+		return
+	var moved := now.position != _last.position and now.size == _last.size
+	var resized := now.size != _last.size
+	var m := frame_margins()
+	var f := frame_rect()
+	var pos := Vector2(position)
+	var sz := Vector2(size)
+	if view_changed and not moved and not resized:
+		# (follow the game window: keep docked edges on its edges)
+		if docked.has(SIDE_RIGHT):
+			if docked.has(SIDE_LEFT):
+				sz.x = view.x - m[0] - m[2]
+			else:
+				pos.x = view.x - m[2] - sz.x
+		if docked.has(SIDE_BOTTOM):
+			if docked.has(SIDE_TOP):
+				sz.y = view.y - m[1] - m[3]
+			else:
+				pos.y = view.y - m[3] - sz.y
+	elif moved:
+		docked.clear()
+		if absf(f.position.x) < SNAP:
+			pos.x = m[0]
+			docked[SIDE_LEFT] = true
+		elif absf(f.end.x - view.x) < SNAP:
+			pos.x = view.x - m[2] - sz.x
+			docked[SIDE_RIGHT] = true
+		if absf(f.position.y) < SNAP:
+			pos.y = m[1]
+			docked[SIDE_TOP] = true
+		elif absf(f.end.y - view.y) < SNAP:
+			pos.y = view.y - m[3] - sz.y
+			docked[SIDE_BOTTOM] = true
+	elif resized:
+		# Only the edges that moved snap (the others stay where they are).
+		if now.position.x != _last.position.x:   # left edge
+			docked.erase(SIDE_LEFT)
+			if absf(f.position.x) < SNAP:
+				sz.x += pos.x - m[0]
+				pos.x = m[0]
+				docked[SIDE_LEFT] = true
+		elif now.end.x != _last.end.x:            # right edge
+			docked.erase(SIDE_RIGHT)
+			if absf(f.end.x - view.x) < SNAP:
+				sz.x = view.x - m[2] - pos.x
+				docked[SIDE_RIGHT] = true
+		if now.position.y != _last.position.y:   # top edge
+			docked.erase(SIDE_TOP)
+			if absf(f.position.y) < SNAP:
+				sz.y += pos.y - m[1]
+				pos.y = m[1]
+				docked[SIDE_TOP] = true
+		elif now.end.y != _last.end.y:            # bottom edge
+			docked.erase(SIDE_BOTTOM)
+			if absf(f.end.y - view.y) < SNAP:
+				sz.y = view.y - m[3] - pos.y
+				docked[SIDE_BOTTOM] = true
+	sz = sz.max(Vector2(min_size))
+	position = Vector2i(pos.round())
+	size = Vector2i(sz.round())
+	_last = Rect2i(position, size)
+
+
+# --- Resetting to defaults ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+## [has one, value]: a script variable's declared default (a constant
+## expression - "var hull := -1.0"; not one computed at run time), or a
+## built-in property's engine default. Objects aren't reset (no default
+## node to point at).
+func default_of(prop: String) -> Array:
+	if typeof(_defaults) != TYPE_DICTIONARY:
+		_defaults = {}
+	if _defaults.has(prop):
+		return _defaults[prop]
+	var out := [false, null]
+	if is_instance_valid(target):
+		var cur: Variant = target.get(prop)
+		var d: Variant = null
+		var found := false
+		var s: Script = target.get_script()
+		var is_script_var := false
+		for p in (s.get_script_property_list() if s else []):
+			if p["name"] == prop:
+				is_script_var = true
+				break
+		if is_script_var:
+			var decl := declared_defaults(s)
+			found = decl.has(prop)
+			d = decl.get(prop)
+		elif ClassDB.class_get_property_list(target.get_class()).any(func(p): return p["name"] == prop):
+			d = ClassDB.class_get_property_default_value(target.get_class(), prop)
+			found = true
+		var numeric := [TYPE_INT, TYPE_FLOAT]
+		var fits := typeof(d) == typeof(cur) or (typeof(d) in numeric and typeof(cur) in numeric)
+		if found and fits and typeof(cur) != TYPE_OBJECT:
+			out = [true, d]
+	_defaults[prop] = out
+	return out
+
+
+static var _decl_cache := {}
+
+## A script's variables' declared values (its own and its bases'): each
+## top-level "var x := <value>" / "var x: T = <value>" (exported or not)
+## whose value is a constant expression - literals, vectors, colours,
+## arrays, dictionaries, maths, the script's constants. Read from the source
+## and evaluated on the side: nothing of the game runs. Values worked out
+## at run time ("var hull := max_hull", "@onready") have none.
+static func declared_defaults(s: Script) -> Dictionary:
+	var chain: Array = []
+	var b := s
+	while b:
+		chain.push_front(b)
+		b = b.get_base_script()
+	var out := {}
+	for sc in chain:
+		out.merge(_own_defaults(sc), true)
+	return out
+
+
+static func _own_defaults(sc: Script) -> Dictionary:
+	var src: String = sc.source_code
+	if src == "" and sc.resource_path != "":
+		src = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(sc.resource_path)
+	var key := "%s:%d" % [sc.resource_path, src.hash()]
+	if _decl_cache.has(key):
+		return _decl_cache[key]
+	var consts: Dictionary = sc.get_script_constant_map()
+	var names := PackedStringArray()
+	var values := []
+	for k in consts:
+		names.append(str(k))
+		values.append(consts[k])
+	var re := RegEx.create_from_string("^(?:@export\\w*(?:\\([^)]*\\))?\\s+)?var\\s+(\\w+)\\s*(?::\\s*[\\w\\[\\]\\.]+\\s*)?:?=\\s*(.+)$")
+	var lines := src.split("\n")
+	var out := {}
+	var i := 0
+	while i < lines.size():
+		var m := re.search(lines[i])
+		i += 1
+		if m == null:
+			continue
+		var expr := _strip_comment(m.get_string(2))
+		# (a value over several lines: read on until the brackets close)
+		var extra := 0
+		while _open_brackets(expr) > 0 and i < lines.size() and extra < 40:
+			expr += " " + _strip_comment(lines[i].strip_edges())
+			i += 1
+			extra += 1
+		var e := Expression.new()
+		if e.parse(expr.strip_edges(), names) != OK:
+			continue
+		var v: Variant = e.execute(values, null, false)
+		if not e.has_execute_failed() and typeof(v) != TYPE_OBJECT:
+			out[m.get_string(1)] = v
+	_decl_cache[key] = out
+	return out
+
+
+static func _strip_comment(s: String) -> String:
+	var q := ""
+	for i in s.length():
+		var c := s[i]
+		if q != "":
+			if c == q and (i == 0 or s[i - 1] != "\\"):
+				q = ""
+		elif c == "\"" or c == "'":
+			q = c
+		elif c == "#":
+			return s.substr(0, i).strip_edges()
+	return s.strip_edges()
+
+
+static func _open_brackets(s: String) -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	for c in s:
+		if c in "([{":
+			n += 1
+		elif c in ")]}":
+			n -= 1
+	return n
+
+
+static func same(a: Variant, b: Variant) -> bool:
+	if typeof(a) in [TYPE_INT, TYPE_FLOAT] and typeof(b) in [TYPE_INT, TYPE_FLOAT]:
+		return is_equal_approx(float(a), float(b))
+	if typeof(a) != typeof(b):
+		return false
+	return a == b
+
+
+func is_default(prop: String) -> bool:
+	var d := default_of(prop)
+	return not d[0] or same(target.get(prop), d[1])
+
+
+## Put a property back to its default (true: it had one).
+func reset(prop: String) -> bool:
+	var d := default_of(prop)
+	if not d[0] or not is_instance_valid(target):
+		return false
+	var v: Variant = d[1]
+	if v is Array or v is Dictionary:
+		v = v.duplicate(true)   # (not the script's own copy)
+	target.set(prop, v)
+	_refresh_now()
+	return true
+
+
+func reset_all() -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	for prop in _names():
+		if not is_default(prop) and reset(prop):
+			n += 1
+	return n
+
+
+func _show_reset(it: TreeItem, prop: String, v: Variant) -> void:
+	var d := default_of(prop)
+	var differs: bool = d[0] and not same(v, d[1])
+	var has := it.get_button_by_id(1, RESET) >= 0
+	if differs and not has:
+		it.add_button(1, EditorIcons.get_icon("undo"), RESET, false, "Reset to the default: " + _brief(d[1]))
+	elif not differs and has:
+		it.erase_button(1, it.get_button_by_id(1, RESET))
+
+
+func _on_prop_button(it: TreeItem, _col: int, id: int, _mb: int) -> void:
+	if id == RESET and it.get_metadata(0) is Array:
+		reset(it.get_metadata(0)[0])
+
+
+func _refresh_now() -> void:
+	if _props and _props.get_root():
+		_refresh(_props.get_root())
+
+
+## The reset controls (made here, not in _ready, so a hot-reloaded open
+## Inspector gets them too).
+func _ensure_reset_ui() -> void:
+	if not _props.button_clicked.is_connected(_on_prop_button):
+		_props.button_clicked.connect(_on_prop_button)
+	if _reset_all == null and _builtin:
+		_reset_all = Button.new()
+		_reset_all.text = "Reset all"
+		_reset_all.icon = EditorIcons.get_icon("undo")
+		_reset_all.tooltip_text = "Put every field that isn't at its default back to it"
+		_reset_all.pressed.connect(reset_all)
+		_builtin.get_parent().add_child(_reset_all)
+		_builtin.get_parent().move_child(_reset_all, _builtin.get_index())
+
+
+## Only properties of the target and entries inside its arrays / dictionaries
+## (not things inside another object - inspect that one to change it).
+func _is_settable(it: TreeItem) -> bool:
+	var keys: Array = it.get_metadata(0)
+	for i in range(keys.size() - 1):
+		var parent: Variant = _value_at(keys.slice(0, i + 1))
+		if typeof(parent) == TYPE_OBJECT:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+func _brief(v: Variant) -> String:
+	match typeof(v):
+		TYPE_NIL:
+			return "null"
+		TYPE_FLOAT:
+			return str(snappedf(v, 0.001))
+		TYPE_VECTOR2:
+			return "(%s, %s)" % [snappedf(v.x, 0.01), snappedf(v.y, 0.01)]
+		TYPE_STRING:
+			return '"%s"' % v
+		TYPE_OBJECT:
+			if not is_instance_valid(v):
+				return "<freed>"
+			if v is Node:
+				return "%s  <%s>" % [v.name, v.get_script().resource_path.get_file() if v.get_script() else v.get_class()]
+			if v is Resource and v.resource_path != "":
+				return "<%s> %s" % [v.get_class(), v.resource_path.get_file()]
+			return "<%s>" % v.get_class()
+		TYPE_ARRAY:
+			return "Array (%d)" % v.size()
+		TYPE_DICTIONARY:
+			return "Dictionary (%d)" % v.size()
+	if typeof(v) >= TYPE_PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY:
+		return "%s (%d)" % [type_string(typeof(v)), v.size()]
+	return str(v)
+
+
+## The value at a key path from the target ([prop, index/key, ...]).
+func _value_at(keys: Array) -> Variant:
+	if not is_instance_valid(target):
+		return null
+	var v: Variant = target.get(keys[0])
+	for i in range(1, keys.size()):
+		var k = keys[i]
+		if typeof(v) == TYPE_OBJECT:
+			if not is_instance_valid(v):
+				return null
+			v = v.get(k)
+		elif v is Dictionary:
+			v = v.get(k)
+		elif (v is Array or typeof(v) >= TYPE_PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY) and typeof(k) == TYPE_INT and k < v.size():
+			v = v[k]
+		else:
+			return null
+	return v
+
+
+## Opening a row fills it - after the Tree's own click handling (changing
+## the tree inside its signal can leave it half-built).
+func _on_prop_collapsed(it: TreeItem) -> void:
+	if not it.collapsed:
+		_fill_children.call_deferred(it)
+
+
+func _fill_children(it: TreeItem) -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(it) or it.get_tree() != _props:
+		return
+	for c in it.get_children():
+		c.free()
+	var keys: Array = it.get_metadata(0)
+	var v: Variant = _value_at(keys)
+	var sub := []   # [label, key]
+	if typeof(v) == TYPE_OBJECT and is_instance_valid(v):
+		for p in v.get_property_list():
+			if p["usage"] & PROPERTY_USAGE_SCRIPT_VARIABLE or p["name"] in BUILTIN:
+				sub.append([p["name"], p["name"]])
+	elif v is Dictionary:
+		for k in v.keys():
+			sub.append([str(k), k])
+	elif v is Array or typeof(v) >= TYPE_PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY:
+		for i in mini(v.size(), 200):
+			sub.append(["[%d]" % i, i])
+	for s in sub.slice(0, 300):
+		var ci := _props.create_item(it)
+		if ci == null:
+			return
+		ci.set_text(0, s[0])
+		ci.set_metadata(0, keys + [s[1]])
+		_show(ci, _value_at(keys + [s[1]]))
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not visible:
+		return
+	snap()
+	_ensure_reset_ui()
+	_t -= delta
+	if _t > 0.0:
+		return
+	_t = REFRESH
+	if target != null and not is_instance_valid(target):
+		_path.text = "(freed)"
+		return
+	if _props.get_root() == null:
+		return
+	_refresh(_props.get_root())
+
+
+func _refresh(it: TreeItem) -> void:
+	for c in it.get_children():
+		var keys = c.get_metadata(0)
+		if keys == null:
+			continue
+		var v: Variant = _value_at(keys)
+		_show(c, v)
+		if not c.collapsed:
+			_refresh(c)
+
+
+## Double-click: an object opens in the inspector.
+func _on_prop_activated() -> void:
+	var it := _props.get_selected()
+	if it == null or it.get_metadata(0) == null:
+		return
+	var v: Variant = _value_at(it.get_metadata(0))
+	if typeof(v) == TYPE_OBJECT and is_instance_valid(v):
+		inspect(v)
+	elif it.is_editable(1):
+		_editing = true
+		_props.edit_selected(true)
+
+
+func _on_prop_edited() -> void:
+	_editing = false
+	var it := _props.get_edited()
+	if it == null:
+		return
+	var keys: Array = it.get_metadata(0)
+	var old: Variant = _value_at(keys)
+	var nv: Variant = parse_value(it.get_text(1), old)
+	if nv == null:
+		it.set_text(1, _brief(old))
+		return
+	set_at(keys, nv)
+	_show(it, _value_at(keys))
+
+
+## Text typed in the value column -> a value of the old one's type (null: invalid).
+static func parse_value(s: String, old: Variant) -> Variant:
+	s = s.strip_edges()
+	match typeof(old):
+		TYPE_INT:
+			return int(s) if s.is_valid_int() or s.is_valid_float() else null
+		TYPE_FLOAT:
+			return float(s) if s.is_valid_float() or s.is_valid_int() else null
+		TYPE_BOOL:
+			return s.to_lower() in ["true", "1", "yes", "on"]
+		TYPE_STRING:
+			return s.trim_prefix('"').trim_suffix('"')
+		TYPE_STRING_NAME:
+			return StringName(s.trim_prefix('"').trim_suffix('"'))
+		TYPE_COLOR:
+			return Color.from_string(s, old) if not s.begins_with("(") else str_to_var("Color" + s)
+		TYPE_VECTOR2, TYPE_VECTOR2I:
+			var parts := s.trim_prefix("(").trim_suffix(")").split(",")
+			if parts.size() != 2 or not parts[0].strip_edges().is_valid_float() or not parts[1].strip_edges().is_valid_float():
+				return null
+			var v2 := Vector2(float(parts[0]), float(parts[1]))
+			return v2 if typeof(old) == TYPE_VECTOR2 else Vector2i(v2)
+	return null
+
+
+## Set the value at a key path (containers are values: write them back up).
+func set_at(keys: Array, v: Variant) -> void:
+	if keys.size() == 1:
+		target.set(keys[0], v)
+		return
+	var parent: Variant = _value_at(keys.slice(0, keys.size() - 1))
+	var k = keys[-1]
+	if parent is Dictionary or parent is Array:
+		parent[k] = v   # (arrays and dictionaries are shared - this is live)
+	elif typeof(parent) >= TYPE_PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY:
+		parent[k] = v
+		set_at(keys.slice(0, keys.size() - 1), parent)   # (packed arrays are copies)

hunks.note: The Inspector (developer menu, Alt + right-click > Inspector).

bubbles.text: Show it right of the game's window (inside the screen if there's no room). Show it inside the game's window, along its right edge (the first time - after that where it was left: drag the title bar to move it, an edge to resize it).

While it has focus, Godot sends it every mouse click - even ones outside it, over the game (only a left click there takes the focus back): so an Alt + right-click reaching it opens the developer menu where it was made.

A script's variables' declared values (its own and its bases'): each top-level "var x := <value>" / "var x: T = <value>" (exported or not) whose value is a constant expression - literals, vectors, colours, arrays, dictionaries, maths, the script's constants. Read from the source and evaluated on the side: nothing of the game run
The value at a key path from the target ([prop, index/key, ...]).

files.explanation: An engine-level service: Talos, the game-data editor (main menu > Talos): edit the main quest's dialogue, objectives, rewards, chapters and lore and the NPC interaction texts, and browse the sprites (SPRITES tab: data/sprites/*.png, cut from external/images/ by tools/extract_sprites.py; "Reload sprites" picks up new ones). "Save to file" writes data/main_quest.json and data/interactions.json. "Open the Library" shows every asset animated (Library). (Moved from scripts/dev_mode.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,604 @@ 
+class_name DevMode
+extends Control
+## Talos, the game-data editor (main menu > Talos): edit the main quest's dialogue,
+## objectives, rewards, chapters and lore and the NPC interaction texts, and
+## browse the sprites (SPRITES tab: data/sprites/*.png, cut from
+## external/images/ by tools/extract_sprites.py; "Reload sprites" picks up
+## new ones). "Save to file" writes data/main_quest.json and
+## data/interactions.json. "Open the Library" shows every asset animated (Library).
+
+signal closed
+signal zoo_requested
+signal scenario_requested
+signal svg_requested
+signal patcher_requested
+
+const TABS := ["DIALOGUE", "CHAPTERS", "LORE", "CITIZENS", "SPRITES"]
+const ACCENT := Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.25)
+
+## The dialogue box used to preview a stage's dialogue.
+var dialogue: Control
+## Pause the tree while open (when shown over a running game).
+var pause_game := false
+## Unsaved edits (any field changed, lines added / moved / deleted).
+var dirty := false:
+	set(v):
+		dirty = v
+		if v:
+			_edits += 1   # (built pages older than this are built again when shown)
+## Edits so far (pages built before the latest are stale: show_tab).
+var _edits := 0
+## Each page, once built: index -> {box, actions, inner, status, edits}.
+## Showing a page shows its box; it's built again only when stale.
+var _pages := {}
+var _body: VBoxContainer       # (the scroll's child, holding the pages' boxes)
+var _actions_bar: HBoxContainer
+var current := 0
+var _stage := 0
+var _lore_id := ""
+var _scroll: ScrollContainer
+var _content: VBoxContainer
+var _status: Label
+var _title: Label
+var _nav: VBoxContainer
+var _actions: HBoxContainer
+var _docs: Button
+## The Sprites page's thumbnails (built on the first visit, then kept).
+var _sprites: VBoxContainer
+## The scrolling right side of the Dialogue and Lore pages.
+var _inner: ScrollContainer
+var _paused_by_me := false
+var _built := false
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	hide()
+	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+
+
+func open() -> void:
+	if not _built:
+		_build()
+	current = clampi(TalosNav.page, 0, TABS.size() - 1)
+	_paused_by_me = pause_game and not get_tree().paused
+	if _paused_by_me:
+		get_tree().paused = true
+	show()
+	show_tab(current)
+
+
+## Leaves the editor (then `then`, if given): asks first about unsaved changes.
+func leave(then := Callable()) -> void:
+	var go := func():
+		if then.is_valid():
+			then.call()
+		else:
+			close()
+	if dirty:
+		UI.unsaved(self, "The quest and interaction data", _save, _reload, go)
+	else:
+		go.call()
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	if is_instance_valid(_sprites) and _sprites.get_parent() == null:
+		_sprites.free()
+
+
+## Asks about unsaved changes (save / discard / stay), then `then`.
+func guard(then: Callable) -> void:
+	leave(then)
+
+
+## To another tool: in Talos straight there (this page stays as it is);
+## on its own, asking about unsaved changes first.
+func _switch(to: Callable) -> void:
+	if TalosNav.host(get_tree()):
+		to.call()
+	else:
+		leave(to)
+
+
+func close() -> void:
+	hide()
+	if _paused_by_me:
+		get_tree().paused = false
+	closed.emit()
+
+
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not visible or (dialogue and dialogue.visible):
+		return
+	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()   # (before: leaving may free the scene)
+		var f := get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()
+		if f is TextEdit or f is LineEdit:
+			f.release_focus()   # (typing: Esc only stops it - a RichField shows its formatted text; Esc again leaves)
+			return
+		TalosNav.go(get_tree(), "menu", guard)
+		return
+	var k := event as InputEventKey
+	if k == null or not k.pressed or k.echo:
+		return
+	var act := Callable()
+	if k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode >= KEY_1 and k.keycode < KEY_1 + TABS.size():
+		act = show_tab.bind(k.keycode - KEY_1)
+	elif k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_S:
+		act = _save
+	elif k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_R:
+		act = _reload
+	elif k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_P and current == 0:
+		act = func(): _preview(QuestData.STAGES[_stage].get("dialogue", []))
+	elif k.keycode == KEY_F4:
+		act = _switch.bind(scenario_requested.emit)
+	elif k.keycode == KEY_F6:
+		act = _switch.bind(svg_requested.emit)
+	elif k.keycode == KEY_F7:
+		act = _switch.bind(patcher_requested.emit)
+	elif k.keycode == KEY_F3:
+		act = _switch.bind(zoo_requested.emit)
+	elif k.keycode == KEY_F1:
+		act = func(): EditorDocs.open(self, ["dialogue", "quest", "lore", "interactions", "sprites"][current], EditorDocs.FILE)
+	if act.is_valid():
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()   # (before: the action may leave the scene)
+		act.call()

+func _build() -> void:
+	_built = true
+	var go := func(id: String):
+		if id in TalosNav.PAGES:
+			show_tab(TalosNav.PAGES.find(id))
+		else:
+			TalosNav.go(get_tree(), id, guard)   # (in Talos: just shown; "menu": leaving asks)
+	var root := TalosNav.wrap(UI.modal(self, ACCENT, Vector2.ZERO, true), "dialogue", go, false)
+	_nav = root.get_parent().get_node("TalosNav")
+	var hn := TalosNav.header("DIALOGUE", "", ACCENT)
+	var header: HBoxContainer = hn[0]
+	_title = header.get_node("TalosTitle")
+	_status = hn[1]
+	_actions_bar = HBoxContainer.new()
+	header.add_child(_actions_bar)
+	header.add_child(EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("Save to file", _save, 16), "save",
+		EditorIcons.tip("Save to file", "Ctrl+S", "Writes the quest (dialogue, stages, chapters, lore) to data/main_quest.json and the citizens' lines to data/interactions.json.\nEdits already apply in this session; saving keeps them.")))
+	header.add_child(EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("Reload file", _reload, 16), "reload",
+		EditorIcons.tip("Reload from file", "Ctrl+R", "Throws away every unsaved edit in all pages and reads data/main_quest.json and data/interactions.json again.\nUse it to undo a session of edits; it can't itself be undone.")))
+	_docs = EditorIcons.docs_button(self, "data-editor")
+	header.add_child(_docs)
+	root.add_child(header)
+	_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
+	_scroll.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
+	root.add_child(_scroll)
+	_body = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_body.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_body.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_scroll.add_child(_body)
+
+
+## What each page is for (under its name, until a status message replaces it).
+const PAGE_NOTES := ["the main quest's stages: objective, rewards and the dialogue that plays when each starts",
+	"the main quest's chapter titles, as shown in the Ship Computer",
+	"the lore entries the player unlocks during the quest",
+	"what Minoan citizens say when you click them, and its translation",
+	"every sprite of the game by group - hover one for its key and file"]
+
+
+func show_tab(index: int) -> void:
+	current = index
+	TalosNav.page = index
+	TalosNav.select(_nav, TalosNav.PAGES[index])
+	_title.text = TABS[index]
+	var c: Dictionary = _pages.get(index, {})
+	if c.is_empty() or int(c["edits"]) != _edits:
+		_status.text = PAGE_NOTES[index] + "   ·   edits apply at once; Ctrl+S saves them"
+		_refresh()
+		return
+	_show_page(index)   # (built and current: just shown - no rebuilding)
+
+
+## Rebuilds the current page, keeping the scroll positions.
+func _refresh() -> void:
+	var old: Dictionary = _pages.get(current, {})
+	var keep := [_scroll.scroll_vertical, old["inner"].scroll_vertical if not old.is_empty() and is_instance_valid(old["inner"]) else 0]
+	if not old.is_empty():
+		if is_instance_valid(_sprites) and _sprites.get_parent() == old["box"]:
+			old["box"].remove_child(_sprites)   # (kept for next time: _page_graphics)
+		old["box"].queue_free()
+		old["actions"].queue_free()
+	# The page is built into its own box (and its header buttons into theirs).
+	_content = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_content.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_content.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_content.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	_body.add_child(_content)
+	_actions = HBoxContainer.new()
+	_actions.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	_actions_bar.add_child(_actions)
+	_inner = null
+	match current:
+		0: _page_dialogue()
+		1: _page_quest()
+		2: _page_lore()
+		3: _page_interactions()
+		4: _page_graphics()
+	_pages[current] = {"box": _content, "actions": _actions, "inner": _inner, "status": _status.text, "edits": _edits}
+	if not _fonts_scaled:
+		_fonts_scaled = true
+		UI.scale_fonts(self, "menu", 1.5)
+	else:
+		UI.scale_fonts(_content, "menu", 1.5)
+		UI.scale_fonts(_actions, "menu", 1.5)
+	_show_page(current)
+	_restore_scroll.call_deferred(keep)
+
+
+var _fonts_scaled := false
+
+## Shows page `i`'s box and header buttons, hides the others'.
+func _show_page(i: int) -> void:
+	for k in _pages:
+		var on: bool = k == i
+		_pages[k]["box"].visible = on
+		_pages[k]["actions"].visible = on
+	var c: Dictionary = _pages[i]
+	_inner = c["inner"]
+	_status.text = c["status"]
+	# Pages with a list on the left scroll their right side only (the list stays put).
+	_scroll.vertical_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED if i in [0, 2] else ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_AUTO
+
+
+func _restore_scroll(v: Array) -> void:
+	_scroll.scroll_vertical = v[0]
+	if is_instance_valid(_inner):
+		_inner.scroll_vertical = v[1]
+
+
+func _save() -> void:
+	dirty = false
+	var a := QuestData.save()
+	var b := Planets.save_interactions()
+	_status.text = ("Saved:  %s   ·   %s" % [a, b]) if a != "" and b != "" else "Save failed - check file permissions."
+	
+
+func _reload() -> void:
+	dirty = false
+	_edits += 1   # (every built page shows the old data: built again when shown)
+	QuestData.reload()
+	Planets.reload()
+	_stage = clampi(_stage, 0, QuestData.STAGES.size() - 1)
+	_status.text = "Reloaded from file."
+	_refresh()

+func _field(label: String, control: Control) -> HBoxContainer:
+	var r := HBoxContainer.new()
+	r.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	var l := UI.label(label, 15, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	var tip: String = FIELD_TIPS.get(label, "Chapter title, as shown in the Ship Computer." if label.begins_with("Chapter ") else "")
+	if tip != "":
+		l.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip(label, "", tip)
+		l.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
+		control.tooltip_text = l.tooltip_text
+	l.custom_minimum_size.x = 150
+	r.add_child(l)
+	control.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	r.add_child(control)
+	return r
+
+
+func _line(text: Variant, on_change: Callable) -> LineEdit:
+	var e := LineEdit.new()
+	e.text = str(text)
+	e.text_changed.connect(on_change)
+	e.text_changed.connect(func(_t): dirty = true)
+	return e
+
+
+func _text(text: String, on_change: Callable, height := 64.0) -> TextEdit:
+	var t := TextEdit.new()
+	t.text = text
+	t.wrap_mode = TextEdit.LINE_WRAPPING_BOUNDARY
+	t.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(300, height)
+	t.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	t.text_changed.connect(func(): on_change.call(t.text); dirty = true)
+	return t
+
+
+## A small icon button: "Up", "Down", "Delete".
+func _small(text: String, cb: Callable, tip := "") -> Button:
+	var b := UI.button("", func(): dirty = true; cb.call(), 14)
+	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(36, 34)
+	var icon: String = {"Up": "up", "Down": "down", "Delete": "delete"}.get(text, "")
+	if icon == "":
+		b.text = text
+	EditorIcons.dress(b, icon, EditorIcons.tip(text, "", tip if tip != "" else text))
+	return b

+	if s.has("pos"):
+		var p: Vector2 = s["pos"]
+		_cell(grid, "Position (x, y)", _line("%d, %d" % [p.x, p.y], func(t):
+			var v: PackedStringArray = str(t).split(",")

+				if a.size() == 2 and a[1].strip_edges().is_valid_int():

+			s["items"] = d))
+	if s.has("spawn"):

+		for e in s["spawn"]:

+		_cell(grid, "Enemies", _line(", ".join(parts), func(t):
+			var old: Array = s["spawn"]
+			var out := []
+			var names: PackedStringArray = str(t).split(",", false)
+			for i in names.size():
+				var id: String = names[i].strip_edges()

+					out.append([id, off])
+			s["spawn"] = out))
+	var reward: Dictionary = s.get("reward", {})
+	_cell(grid, "Reward drachmas", _line(reward.get("credits", 0), func(t): _set_reward(s, "credits", t)))

+	_cell(grid, "Reward equipment", _line(reward.get("equipment", ""), func(t): _set_reward(s, "equipment", t)))
+	_cell(grid, "Unlocks lore ids", _line(", ".join(s.get("lore", [])), func(t):
+		s["lore"] = Array(t.split(",", false)).map(func(x): return x.strip_edges())))
+
+	var lines: Array = s.get("dialogue", [])
+	s["dialogue"] = lines
+	ed.add_child(UI.section("DIALOGUE  (%d lines, plays when this stage starts)" % lines.size(), ACCENT))
+	for k in lines.size():
+		var line: Array = lines[k]
+		var r := HBoxContainer.new()
+		r.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+		var sp := _line(line[0], func(t): line[0] = t)
+		sp.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Speaker", "", "Who says the line (shown above it in the dialogue box), e.g. Narrator or a character's name.")
+		sp.custom_minimum_size.x = 190
+		sp.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
+		sp.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
+		r.add_child(sp)
+		# (shown formatted as the player sees it; Edit beside it shows the source)
+		var tx := RichField.new().setup(line[1], func(t): line[1] = t; dirty = true)
+		tx.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Line", "", "What is said, as the player sees it. Edit (beside it) shows the source: the formatting tags, dimmed -\n[b]bold[/b], [i]italic[/i], [color=gold]colour[/color]; Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I wrap the selected words.")
+		r.add_child(tx)
+		for b in [_small("Up", func(): _move(lines, k, -1), "Moves this line one place earlier in the stage's dialogue (swaps it with the line above).\nThe dialogue plays top to bottom when the stage starts."),
+				_small("Down", func(): _move(lines, k, 1), "Moves this line one place later in the stage's dialogue (swaps it with the line below).\nThe dialogue plays top to bottom when the stage starts."),
+				_small("Delete", func(): lines.remove_at(k); _refresh(), "Removes this line from the stage's dialogue. Reload from file (Ctrl+R) brings back everything\nsince the last save if you delete something by mistake.")]:
+			b.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
+			r.add_child(b)
+		ed.add_child(r)
+	var add := EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("Add line", func():
+		dirty = true
+		lines.append([lines[-1][0] if not lines.is_empty() else "Narrator", "..."])
+		_refresh(), 15), "add", EditorIcons.tip("Add line", "", "Adds a new line at the end of this stage's dialogue, with the same speaker as the last line\n(or Narrator) and '...' as its text. Edit it, then move it with the arrows if it belongs earlier."))
+	add.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
+	ed.add_child(add)
+	var prev := EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("Preview dialogue", func(): _preview(lines), 16), "play",
+		EditorIcons.tip("Preview dialogue", "Ctrl+P", "Plays this stage's dialogue in the game's own dialogue box, as the player will see it.\nClick, Space or Enter to advance a line; Skip ends it and returns here."))

+## A label and its field in a grid of label / field pairs.
+func _cell(grid: GridContainer, label: String, control: Control) -> void:
+	var f := _field(label, control)
+	for c in f.get_children():
+		f.remove_child(c)
+		grid.add_child(c)
+	f.free()
+
+
+func _set_reward(s: Dictionary, key: String, t: String) -> void:
+	if not s.has("reward"):
+		s["reward"] = {}
+	var r: Dictionary = s["reward"]
+	if key == "equipment":
+		if t.strip_edges() == "":
+			r.erase(key)
+		else:
+			r[key] = t.strip_edges()
+	elif t.strip_edges().is_valid_int() and int(t) > 0:
+		r[key] = int(t)
+	else:
+		r.erase(key)
+
+
+func _move(lines: Array, k: int, d: int) -> void:
+	var j := k + d
+	if j < 0 or j >= lines.size():
+		return
+	var tmp: Variant = lines[k]
+	lines[k] = lines[j]
+	lines[j] = tmp
+	dirty = true
+	_refresh()
+
+
+func _preview(lines: Array) -> void:
+	if dialogue == null or lines.is_empty():
+		return
+	hide()
+	dialogue.play(lines.duplicate(true), func(): show(), true)

+func _page_graphics() -> void:
+	_status.text = "data/sprites - re-run tools/extract_sprites.py after changing external/images/, then reload them here"
+	_actions.add_child(EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("Reload sprites", func():
+		await ProcArt.rebake()
+		_status.text = "Sprites reloaded."
+		if is_instance_valid(_sprites):
+			_sprites.queue_free()
+		_sprites = null
+		_refresh(), 15), "bake", EditorIcons.tip("Reload sprites", "", "Reads every sprite in data/sprites again and rebuilds the Minoan building textures - after you\nre-run tools/extract_sprites.py on changed reference sheets in external/images/. Takes a few seconds.")))
+	# (built once - some 700 thumbnails - and kept while you visit other pages)
+	if is_instance_valid(_sprites):

+	_sprites = VBoxContainer.new()

files.explanation: An engine-level service: Every rebindable control (autoload "Keybinds"): its default keys and gamepad button, the player's own choices (Settings > Controls, saved in user://keybinds.cfg), all registered in Godot's InputMap so the game asks `Keybinds.pressed(event, "dock")` instead of naming a key. Each action has three slots: two keys and one gamepad input ("" = none). A slot is written "k:<key name>" (OS.get_keycode_string - with its modifiers: "k:Shift+D"; a key with modifiers matches only with exactly those held, a plain key only with none), "p:<joypad button>" or "a:<axis><+|->" (a stick or trigger pushed that way). The menu actions also feed Godot's own ui_* actions (Enter / pad A press a focused button, the arrows / D-pad move the focus), so every menu built of focusable controls gets keyboard and gamepad navigation. Menu navigation (this node, last in line for unhandled input): when a game menu that registered with register_menu() is open, the menu direction actions (WASD as well as the arrows / D-pad / left stick) move the focus between its controls - the first press focuses its first control - and menu_tab_prev / menu_tab_next switch its tabs (the menu's cycle_tab(dir)). The 3D game reads the held ones (forward, boost, up...) with Input.is_action_pressed and the presses with pressed() - CosmosShip, CosmosWalker, Cosmos. (Moved from scripts/keybinds.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,395 @@ 
+extends Node
+## Every rebindable control (autoload "Keybinds"): its default keys and
+## gamepad button, the player's own choices (Settings > Controls, saved in
+## user://keybinds.cfg), all registered in Godot's InputMap so the game asks
+## `Keybinds.pressed(event, "dock")` instead of naming a key.
+##
+## Each action has three slots: two keys and one gamepad input ("" = none).
+## A slot is written "k:<key name>" (OS.get_keycode_string - with its
+## modifiers: "k:Shift+D"; a key with modifiers matches only with exactly
+## those held, a plain key only with none), "p:<joypad
+## button>" or "a:<axis><+|->" (a stick or trigger pushed that way).
+## The menu actions also feed Godot's own ui_* actions (Enter / pad A press a
+## focused button, the arrows / D-pad move the focus), so every menu built of
+## focusable controls gets keyboard and gamepad navigation.
+##
+## Menu navigation (this node, last in line for unhandled input): when a game
+## menu that registered with register_menu() is open, the menu direction
+## actions (WASD as well as the arrows / D-pad / left stick) move the focus
+## between its controls - the first press focuses its first control - and
+## menu_tab_prev / menu_tab_next switch its tabs (the menu's cycle_tab(dir)).
+##
+## The 3D game reads the held ones (forward, boost, up...) with Input.is_action_pressed
+## and the presses with pressed() - CosmosShip, CosmosWalker, Cosmos.
+
+signal changed
+
+const FILE := "user://keybinds.cfg"
+const DEADZONE := 0.3
+
+## [id, group, label, [key 1, key 2, pad]]
+const ACTIONS := [
+	["menu_up", "Menus", "Up", ["k:W", "k:Up", "p:11"]],
+	["menu_down", "Menus", "Down", ["k:S", "k:Down", "p:12"]],
+	["menu_left", "Menus", "Left / less", ["k:A", "k:Left", "p:13"]],
+	["menu_right", "Menus", "Right / more", ["k:D", "k:Right", "p:14"]],
+	["menu_accept", "Menus", "Select / buy", ["k:Enter", "k:Space", "p:0"]],
+	["menu_secondary", "Menus", "Secondary action / sell", ["k:Backspace", "", "p:2"]],
+	["menu_back", "Menus", "Back / close", ["k:Escape", "", "p:1"]],
+	["menu_tab_prev", "Menus", "Previous tab", ["k:Q", "", "p:9"]],
+	["menu_tab_next", "Menus", "Next tab", ["k:E", "", "p:10"]],
+	["undock", "Menus", "Undock (station menu)", ["k:Shift+D", "", "p:3"]],
+	["sector_map", "Menus", "Sector map (Ship Computer)", ["k:M", "", ""]],
+	["galaxy_map", "Menus", "Galaxy map (Ship Computer)", ["k:G", "", ""]],
+	["trade_layer", "Menus", "Trade routes on the maps", ["k:T", "", "p:8"]],
+	["pause", "Ship and on foot", "Menu", ["k:Escape", "", "p:6"]],
+	["computer", "Ship and on foot", "Ship Computer", ["k:Tab", "", "p:4"]],
+	["inventory", "Ship and on foot", "Inventory", ["k:I", "", ""]],
+	["forward", "Ship and on foot", "Throttle up / walk forward", ["k:W", "k:Up", "a:5+"]],
+	["back", "Ship and on foot", "Throttle down / walk back", ["k:S", "k:Down", "a:4+"]],
+	["left", "Ship and on foot", "Roll left / walk left", ["k:A", "k:Left", ""]],
+	["right", "Ship and on foot", "Roll right / walk right", ["k:D", "k:Right", ""]],
+	["boost", "Ship and on foot", "Boost / run", ["k:Shift", "", "p:0"]],
+	["up", "Ship and on foot", "Thrusters up / jump", ["k:Space", "", ""]],
+	["down", "Ship and on foot", "Thrusters down", ["k:Ctrl", "", ""]],
+	["strafe_left", "Ship and on foot", "Thrusters left", ["k:Q", "", ""]],
+	["use", "Ship and on foot", "Thrusters right / use, board, stand up", ["k:E", "", ""]],
+	["stop", "Ship and on foot", "Stop (throttle to zero)", ["k:X", "", "p:1"]],
+	["centre", "Ship and on foot", "Centre the stick", ["k:C", "", ""]],
+	["hyperion", "Ship and on foot", "Hyperion drive", ["k:J", "", "p:3"]],
+	["target", "Ship and on foot", "Target (nearest the middle)", ["k:T", "", "p:9"]],
+	["land", "Ship and on foot", "Land / take off / undock", ["k:L", "", "p:10"]],
+	["dock", "Ship and on foot", "Ask a station for a landing pad", ["k:F", "", ""]],
+	["stand_up", "Ship and on foot", "Up from the seat in flight", ["k:G", "", ""]],
+	["attack", "Ship and on foot", "Fire (held)", ["", "", ""]],
+	["ship_call", "Ship and on foot", "Dismiss / recall your ship (on foot)", ["k:B", "", ""]],
+	["slot_1", "Toolbar", "Slot 1", ["k:1", "", ""]],
+	["slot_2", "Toolbar", "Slot 2", ["k:2", "", ""]],
+	["slot_3", "Toolbar", "Slot 3", ["k:3", "", ""]],
+	["slot_4", "Toolbar", "Slot 4", ["k:4", "", ""]],
+	["slot_5", "Toolbar", "Slot 5", ["k:5", "", ""]],
+	["slot_6", "Toolbar", "Slot 6", ["k:6", "", ""]],
+	["slot_7", "Toolbar", "Slot 7", ["k:7", "", ""]],
+	["slot_8", "Toolbar", "Slot 8", ["k:8", "", ""]],
+	["slot_9", "Toolbar", "Slot 9", ["k:9", "", ""]],
+	["quicksave", "Game", "Quicksave", ["k:F5", "", ""]],
+	["quickload", "Game", "Quickload", ["k:F9", "", ""]],
+	["talos", "Game", "Open Talos", ["k:F8", "", ""]],
+]
+## The menu actions that also drive Godot's ui_* (focus, buttons).
+const UI_MIRROR := {"menu_accept": "ui_accept", "menu_back": "ui_cancel"}
+## Left stick on the menu directions (always, besides the three slots).
+const STICK := {"menu_up": "a:1-", "menu_down": "a:1+", "menu_left": "a:0-", "menu_right": "a:0+"}
+
+var binds := {}          # id -> [3 slot strings]
+var _menus: Array = []   # registered game menus (Controls), see register_menu
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS   # (menus run with the game paused)
+	load_binds()
+
+
+# --- The bindings -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func defaults(id: String) -> Array:
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if a[0] == id:
+			return a[3].duplicate()
+	return ["", "", ""]
+
+
+static func label(id: String) -> String:
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if a[0] == id:
+			return a[2]
+	return id
+
+
+func load_binds() -> void:
+	binds = {}
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		binds[a[0]] = a[3].duplicate()
+	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
+	if cfg.load(FILE) == OK:
+		for id in binds:
+			var v = cfg.get_value("binds", id) if cfg.has_section_key("binds", id) else null
+			if v is Array and v.size() == 3:
+				binds[id] = v.map(func(s): return str(s))
+	_apply()
+
+
+func save_binds() -> void:
+	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
+	for id in binds:
+		if binds[id] != defaults(id):
+			cfg.set_value("binds", id, binds[id])
+	cfg.save(FILE)
+
+
+## Bind `slot` (0, 1: keys; 2: pad) of `id` to `spec` ("" clears it).
+func set_bind(id: String, slot: int, spec: String) -> void:
+	binds[id][slot] = spec
+	_apply()
+	save_binds()
+
+
+func reset(id := "") -> void:
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if id == "" or a[0] == id:
+			binds[a[0]] = a[3].duplicate()
+	_apply()
+	save_binds()
+
+
+## Other actions of the same group using `spec` (a clash to point out).
+func clashes(id: String, spec: String) -> Array:
+	if spec == "":
+		return []
+	var group := ""
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if a[0] == id:
+			group = a[1]
+	var out := []
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if a[0] != id and spec in binds[a[0]] and (a[1] == group or (group != "Menus" and a[1] != "Menus")):
+			out.append(a[0])
+	return out
+
+
+## Puts every binding into the InputMap (and the ui_* mirrors).
+func _apply() -> void:
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		var id: String = a[0]
+		if InputMap.has_action(id):
+			InputMap.action_erase_events(id)
+		else:
+			InputMap.add_action(id, 0.5)
+		var specs: Array = binds[id].duplicate()
+		if STICK.has(id):
+			specs.append(STICK[id])
+		for s in specs:
+			var ev := to_event(s)
+			if ev:
+				InputMap.action_add_event(id, ev)
+	for id in UI_MIRROR:
+		var ui: String = UI_MIRROR[id]
+		# ui_accept keeps its own Enter / Space; add ours (pad A, a rebound key).
+		for s in binds[id]:
+			var ev := to_event(s)
+			if ev and not InputMap.action_has_event(ui, ev):
+				InputMap.action_add_event(ui, ev)
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+static func to_event(spec: String) -> InputEvent:
+	if spec.length() < 3:
+		return null
+	var v := spec.substr(2)
+	match spec[0]:
+		"k":
+			var code := OS.find_keycode_from_string(v)
+			if code & KEY_CODE_MASK == KEY_NONE:
+				return null
+			var k := InputEventKey.new()
+			k.keycode = code & KEY_CODE_MASK
+			k.shift_pressed = code & KEY_MASK_SHIFT != 0
+			k.ctrl_pressed = code & KEY_MASK_CTRL != 0
+			k.alt_pressed = code & KEY_MASK_ALT != 0
+			k.meta_pressed = code & KEY_MASK_META != 0
+			return k
+		"p":
+			var b := InputEventJoypadButton.new()
+			b.button_index = int(v) as JoyButton
+			return b
+		"a":
+			var m := InputEventJoypadMotion.new()
+			m.axis = int(v.left(-1)) as JoyAxis
+			m.axis_value = -1.0 if v.ends_with("-") else 1.0
+			return m
+	return null
+
+
+## The slot string for an input the player pressed ("" if it can't be bound).
+static func spec_of(ev: InputEvent) -> String:
+	if ev is InputEventKey and ev.pressed:
+		var code: int = ev.keycode if ev.keycode != KEY_NONE else ev.physical_keycode
+		if code == KEY_NONE or code in [KEY_SHIFT, KEY_CTRL, KEY_ALT, KEY_META]:
+			return ""   # (a modifier alone: wait for the key it goes with)
+		return "k:" + OS.get_keycode_string(code | (ev.get_modifiers_mask() as int))
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadButton and ev.pressed:
+		return "p:%d" % ev.button_index
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion and absf(ev.axis_value) > 0.6:
+		return "a:%d%s" % [ev.axis, "+" if ev.axis_value > 0.0 else "-"]
+	return ""
+
+
+const PAD_NAMES := {0: "A", 1: "B", 2: "X", 3: "Y", 4: "Back", 5: "Guide", 6: "Start", 7: "L3", 8: "R3",
+	9: "LB", 10: "RB", 11: "D-pad up", 12: "D-pad down", 13: "D-pad left", 14: "D-pad right"}
+const AXIS_NAMES := {"0-": "Left stick left", "0+": "Left stick right", "1-": "Left stick up", "1+": "Left stick down",
+	"2-": "Right stick left", "2+": "Right stick right", "3-": "Right stick up", "3+": "Right stick down", "4+": "LT", "5+": "RT"}
+
+
+## A slot as the player reads it ("W", "Enter", "RB", "RT"...).
+static func spec_text(spec: String) -> String:
+	if spec.length() < 3:
+		return ""
+	var v := spec.substr(2)
+	match spec[0]:
+		"k":
+			return v
+		"p":
+			return PAD_NAMES.get(int(v), "Button %s" % v)
+		"a":
+			return AXIS_NAMES.get(v, "Axis %s" % v)
+	return spec
+
+
+## "W / Up" - an action's keys (and pad, with `pad`), for hints and tooltips.
+func keys_text(id: String, pad := false) -> String:
+	var parts := []
+	for i in 3:
+		if i == 2 and not pad:
+			break
+		var t := spec_text(binds.get(id, ["", "", ""])[i])
+		if t != "":
+			parts.append(t)
+	return " / ".join(parts)
+
+
+## True on the press of `id` (no key repeat). A stick or trigger counts once
+## each time it's pushed past half way (it must come back first: its motion
+## events stream in all the while it's held).
+func pressed(ev: InputEvent, id: String) -> bool:
+	if not InputMap.has_action(id):
+		return false
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion:
+		return _axis_press(ev, id)
+	return ev.is_action_pressed(id, false, true)
+
+
+## The same, allowing key repeat (menu movement: hold to keep moving).
+func pressed_repeat(ev: InputEvent, id: String) -> bool:
+	if not InputMap.has_action(id):
+		return false
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion:
+		return _axis_press(ev, id)
+	return ev.is_action_pressed(id, true, true)
+
+
+## Like pressed_repeat, but held modifiers don't matter (Shift + a direction:
+## a bigger step).
+func pressed_loose(ev: InputEvent, id: String) -> bool:
+	if not InputMap.has_action(id):
+		return false
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion:
+		return _axis_press(ev, id)
+	return ev.is_action_pressed(id, true, false)
+
+
+var _latch := {}   # "<action>|<axis>" -> held past half way
+
+func _axis_press(ev: InputEventJoypadMotion, id: String) -> bool:
+	var key := "%s|%d" % [id, ev.axis]
+	for e in InputMap.action_get_events(id):
+		if e is InputEventJoypadMotion and e.axis == ev.axis:
+			if signf(e.axis_value) == signf(ev.axis_value) and absf(ev.axis_value) >= 0.5:
+				if _latch.get(key, false):
+					return false
+				_latch[key] = true
+				return true
+	return false
+
+
+## A stick or trigger back near the middle: it can count again (_axis_press).
+func _input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion and absf(ev.axis_value) < 0.35 and not _latch.is_empty():
+		var tail := "|%d" % ev.axis
+		for k in _latch:
+			if k.ends_with(tail):
+				_latch[k] = false
+
+
+## The 1-9 toolbar slot this event presses (-1: none).
+func slot_pressed(ev: InputEvent) -> int:
+	for i in 9:
+		if pressed(ev, "slot_%d" % (i + 1)):
+			return i
+	return -1
+
+
+## The left stick, past the dead zone (zero otherwise), on any pad.
+static func stick_vector() -> Vector2:
+	for dev in Input.get_connected_joypads():
+		var v := Vector2(Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X), Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y))
+		if v.length() > DEADZONE:
+			return v.normalized() * inverse_lerp(DEADZONE, 1.0, minf(v.length(), 1.0))
+	return Vector2.ZERO
+
+
+static func pad_connected() -> bool:
+	return not Input.get_connected_joypads().is_empty()
+
+
+# --- Menu navigation ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A game menu (a Control) taking part in menu navigation while visible. It
+## may have cycle_tab(dir: int) for the tab actions.
+func register_menu(menu: Control) -> void:
+	if not menu in _menus:
+		_menus.append(menu)
+
+
+## The open game menu on top (the last registered one visible), or null.
+func active_menu() -> Control:
+	for i in range(_menus.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		var m = _menus[i]
+		if not is_instance_valid(m):
+			_menus.remove_at(i)
+		elif m.is_visible_in_tree():
+			return m
+	return null
+
+
+func _unhandled_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if ev is InputEventMouse or (ev is InputEventKey and not ev.pressed):
+		return
+	var menu := active_menu()
+	if menu == null or UI.esc_menu_open():
+		return
+	var focus := get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()
+	if focus is LineEdit or focus is TextEdit:
+		return
+	if pressed(ev, "menu_tab_prev") or pressed(ev, "menu_tab_next"):
+		if menu.has_method("cycle_tab"):
+			menu.cycle_tab(-1 if pressed(ev, "menu_tab_prev") else 1)
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+		return
+	var side := -1
+	for d in [["menu_up", SIDE_TOP], ["menu_down", SIDE_BOTTOM], ["menu_left", SIDE_LEFT], ["menu_right", SIDE_RIGHT]]:
+		if pressed_repeat(ev, d[0]):
+			side = d[1]
+	if side < 0:
+		return
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+	if focus == null or not menu.is_ancestor_of(focus) or not focus.is_visible_in_tree():
+		var first := first_focusable(menu)
+		if first:
+			first.grab_focus()
+		return
+	var next := focus.find_valid_focus_neighbor(side)
+	if next and next.is_visible_in_tree() and menu.is_ancestor_of(next):
+		next.grab_focus()
+
+
+## The first visible control in `root` that takes focus (depth first).
+static func first_focusable(root: Node) -> Control:
+	for c in root.get_children():
+		if c is Control and not c.is_visible_in_tree():
+			continue
+		if c is Control and c.focus_mode != Control.FOCUS_NONE and not (c is Button and c.disabled):
+			return c
+		var f := first_focusable(c)
+		if f:
+			return f
+	return null

files.explanation: An engine-level service: LiveLink: the running game's door for live coding (development only). Live updates are always on when the game runs from its project (a debug run, not an export, not headless): every changed script, shader, picture and data file applies as it's saved - hot reloaded, the open screens rebuilt; a change hot reload can't take (a new class_name, a variable removed or renamed) restarts the game where you were (live_restart). A note in the corner says what happened. The connection for tools/live.py: with the user arg --live (godot --path . -- --live[=PORT]) it listens on 127.0.0.1:6070 (or PORT) - only this machine can connect. Protocol: one JSON object per line in, one JSON reply per line out: {"cmd": "...", ...} -> {"ok": true, "result": ...} | {"ok": false, "error": "..."} Commands: ping - "pong", the game's pid and fps state - a snapshot: ship, the signal, enemies, fps eval {expr} - a GDScript expression (Expression); names: main, ship, site, root, tree, live set {target, prop, value} - target/value are expressions; prop may be an indexed path ("position:x") run {code} - GDScript statements, compiled into a throwaway script's run() (may await; the same names as eval); or a whole script source that has its own func run() reload {paths} - hot reload scripts (keeping every live object's state) / shaders / other resources watch {on} - hot reload changed files automatically events {since} - the log since seq `since` (errors, prints, reloads, deaths) tree {path, depth} - the node tree under a node shot {path} - a screenshot (PNG) of the game's view pause {on} / speed {scale} - pause the game / Engine.time_scale inspect {expr} - open the Inspector window on an object In any debug run (with or without --live), Alt + right-click opens the developer menu: inspect the thing under the cursor, the Inspector window (DevInspector - live values, right of the game's window), pause, game speed, hot reload on / off. (Moved from scripts/live_link.gd.)

+extends Node
+## LiveLink: the running game's door for live coding (development only).
+## Live updates are always on when the game runs from its project (a debug
+## run, not an export, not headless): every changed script, shader, picture
+## and data file applies as it's saved - hot reloaded, the open screens
+## rebuilt; a change hot reload can't take (a new class_name, a variable
+## removed or renamed) restarts the game where you were (live_restart). A
+## note in the corner says what happened.
+## The connection for tools/live.py: with the user arg --live
+## (godot --path . -- --live[=PORT]) it listens on 127.0.0.1:6070 (or PORT) -
+## only this machine can connect.
+##
+## Protocol: one JSON object per line in, one JSON reply per line out:
+##   {"cmd": "...", ...}  ->  {"ok": true, "result": ...} | {"ok": false, "error": "..."}
+## Commands:
+##   ping                          - "pong", the game's pid and fps
+##   state                         - a snapshot: ship, the signal, enemies, fps
+##   eval   {expr}                 - a GDScript expression (Expression); names:
+##                                   main, ship, site, root, tree, live
+##   set    {target, prop, value}  - target/value are expressions; prop may be
+##                                   an indexed path ("position:x")
+##   run    {code}                 - GDScript statements, compiled into a
+##                                   throwaway script's run() (may await; the
+##                                   same names as eval); or a whole script
+##                                   source that has its own func run()
+##   reload {paths}                - hot reload scripts (keeping every live
+##                                   object's state) / shaders / other resources
+##   watch  {on}                   - hot reload changed files automatically
+##   events {since}                - the log since seq `since` (errors, prints,
+##                                   reloads, deaths)
+##   tree   {path, depth}          - the node tree under a node
+##   shot   {path}                 - a screenshot (PNG) of the game's view
+##   pause  {on} / speed {scale}   - pause the game / Engine.time_scale
+##   inspect {expr}                - open the Inspector window on an object
+##
+## In any debug run (with or without --live), Alt + right-click opens the
+## developer menu: inspect the thing under the cursor, the Inspector window
+## (DevInspector - live values, right of the game's window), pause, game
+## speed, hot reload on / off.
+
+const PORT := 6070
+var watch_dirs := _tree_of(["res://scripts", "res://shaders"]) + ["res://data", "res://data/sprites", "res://data/docs/shots"]
+## Reference sheets the pieces are cut from (external/images is outside the game):
+## a changed one is cut again (tools/extract_sprites.py, on a thread) - its new
+## pieces then come in through data/sprites like any changed picture.
+const SHEETS_DIR := "res://external/images"
+const SHEET_MATCH := "tile_sheet"
+var _cutting := {}                 # sheet -> Thread
+const WATCH_EXT := ["gd", "gdshader", "png", "jpg", "json"]
+const PICTURE_EXT := ["png", "jpg"]
+var _new_files := {}               # (files the watcher saw appear)
+var _importer: Thread              # (pictures being imported again)
+var _to_import := {}
+const MAX_EVENTS := 2000
+
+var enabled := false
+var port := PORT
+var auto_reload := true
+var _server: TCPServer
+var _clients: Array = []           # [{peer, buf}]
+var _events: Array = []            # [{seq, t, kind, text}]
+var _seq := 0
+var _mutex := Mutex.new()
+var _watch_t := 0.0
+var dev := false                   # the developer menu (any debug run)
+var inspector: Window   # (DevInspector)
+var _menu: PopupMenu
+var _speeds: PopupMenu
+var _picked: Array = []            # menu id -> object to inspect
+
+
+## --live / --live=PORT among the user args (after --), in a debug run.
+static func live_arg() -> int:
+	if not OS.is_debug_build():
+		return 0
+	for a in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
+		if a == "--live":
+			return PORT
+		if a.begins_with("--live="):
+			return int(a.trim_prefix("--live="))
+	return 0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	dev = OS.is_debug_build()
+	set_process_input(dev)
+	port = live_arg()
+	for c in ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list():
+		_known_classes[str(c["class"])] = true
+	# (always, run from the project: not an export, not headless - the tests)
+	var project_run := dev and not OS.has_feature("template") and DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless" \
+		and not "--no-live" in OS.get_cmdline_user_args()   # (--no-live: live updates off for this run)
+	auto_reload = project_run
+	if port > 0:
+		start(port)
+	elif project_run:
+		OS.add_logger(_Log.new(self))
+		set_process(true)
+	if project_run:
+		_start_watch()
+	else:
+		set_process(false)
+	if project_run:
+		_resume = _read_resume()
+
+
+func start(p: int) -> Error:
+	_server = TCPServer.new()
+	var err := _server.listen(p, "127.0.0.1")
+	if err != OK:
+		push_warning("LiveLink: can't listen on port %d (%s)" % [p, error_string(err)])
+		_server = null
+		return err
+	port = p
+	enabled = true
+	set_process(true)
+	OS.add_logger(_Log.new(self))
+	print("LiveLink: listening on 127.0.0.1:%d" % p)
+	return OK
+
+
+func stop() -> void:
+	for c in _clients:
+		c["peer"].disconnect_from_host()
+	_clients.clear()
+	if _server:
+		_server.stop()
+	_server = null
+	enabled = false
+	set_process(false)
+
+
+# --- The log ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A line in the event log (thread safe - the logger calls it from any thread).
+func event(kind: String, text: String) -> void:
+	_mutex.lock()
+	_seq += 1
+	_events.append({"seq": _seq, "t": snappedf(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0, 0.01), "kind": kind, "text": text})
+	if _events.size() > MAX_EVENTS:
+		_events = _events.slice(_events.size() - MAX_EVENTS)
+	_mutex.unlock()
+
+
+func events_since(since: int) -> Array:
+	_mutex.lock()
+	var out := _events.filter(func(e): return e["seq"] > since)
+	_mutex.unlock()
+	return out.slice(maxi(0, out.size() - 400))   # (the latest - a reply carries 500 at most)
+
+
+## Godot's log (prints, warnings, errors with their script place) into events.
+class _Log extends Logger:
+	var link: WeakRef
+
+	func _init(l: Node) -> void:
+		link = weakref(l)
+
+	func _log_message(message: String, error: bool) -> void:
+		var l = link.get_ref()
+		if l and not message.begins_with("LiveLink"):
+			l.event("error" if error else "print", message.strip_edges(false, true))
+
+	func _log_error(function: String, file: String, line: int, code: String, rationale: String,
+			_editor_notify: bool, error_type: int, script_backtraces: Array[ScriptBacktrace]) -> void:
+		var l = link.get_ref()
+		if l == null:
+			return
+		var where := "%s:%d (%s)" % [file, line, function]
+		# (a parse error names the script and line itself; else: where the script was)
+		for bt in script_backtraces if not file.begins_with("res://") else []:
+			if bt.get_frame_count() > 0:
+				where = "%s:%d (%s)" % [bt.get_frame_file(0), bt.get_frame_line(0), bt.get_frame_function(0)]
+				break
+		var kind := "warning" if error_type == ERROR_TYPE_WARNING else "error"
+		l.event(kind, "%s - %s" % [rationale if rationale != "" else code, where.replace("::trial", "")])
+
+
+# --- The connection --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if auto_reload:
+		_watch_step(delta)
+	if not _resume.is_empty():
+		_resume_step()
+	if not _reopen_talos.is_empty():
+		_reopen_talos_step()
+	if _restart_why != "" and Time.get_ticks_msec() >= _restart_at:
+		_try_restart()
+	if _server == null:
+		return
+	while _server.is_connection_available():
+		var peer := _server.take_connection()
+		peer.set_no_delay(true)
+		_clients.append({"peer": peer, "buf": PackedByteArray()})
+	for c in _clients.duplicate():
+		var peer: StreamPeerTCP = c["peer"]
+		peer.poll()
+		if peer.get_status() != StreamPeerTCP.STATUS_CONNECTED:
+			_clients.erase(c)
+			continue
+		var n := peer.get_available_bytes()
+		if n > 0:
+			c["buf"].append_array(peer.get_data(n)[1])
+		var nl: int = c["buf"].find(10)
+		while nl >= 0:
+			var line: String = c["buf"].slice(0, nl).get_string_from_utf8()
+			c["buf"] = c["buf"].slice(nl + 1)
+			nl = c["buf"].find(10)
+			if line.strip_edges() != "":
+				_serve(peer, line)
+
+
+func _serve(peer: StreamPeerTCP, line: String) -> void:
+	var req: Variant = JSON.parse_string(line)
+	var reply: Dictionary
+	if not (req is Dictionary) or not req.has("cmd"):
+		reply = {"ok": false, "error": "not a JSON command: " + line.left(80)}
+	else:
+		reply = await handle(req)
+	if peer.get_status() == StreamPeerTCP.STATUS_CONNECTED:
+		peer.put_data((JSON.stringify(reply) + "\n").to_utf8_buffer())
+
+
+## One command (see the header); a coroutine (run may await).
+func handle(req: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var cmd: String = req["cmd"]
+	match cmd:
+		"ping":
+			return _ok({"pong": true, "pid": OS.get_process_id(), "fps": Engine.get_frames_per_second(), "port": port})
+		"state":
+			return _ok(snapshot())
+		"eval":
+			return _eval(str(req.get("expr", "")))
+		"set":
+			return _set_cmd(req)
+		"run":
+			return await _run(str(req.get("code", "")))
+		"reload":
+			return _ok(reload(req.get("paths", [])))
+		"watch":
+			set_auto_reload(bool(req.get("on", true)))
+			return _ok({"auto_reload": auto_reload})
+		"inspect":
+			var r := _expr(str(req.get("expr", "ship")))
+			if not r[0] or not (r[1] is Object):
+				return _err("not an object: " + str(r[1]))
+			open_inspector(r[1])
+			return _ok(inspector.target)
+		"events":
+			return _ok({"events": events_since(int(req.get("since", 0))), "last": _seq})
+		"tree":
+			var n := _node(str(req.get("path", "")))
+			if n == null:
+				return _err("no node " + str(req.get("path", "")))
+			return _ok(_tree(n, int(req.get("depth", 2))))
+		"shot":
+			return _shot(str(req.get("path", "user://live_shot.png")))
+		"pause":
+			get_tree().paused = bool(req.get("on", not get_tree().paused))
+			return _ok({"paused": get_tree().paused})
+		"speed":
+			Engine.time_scale = clampf(float(req.get("scale", 1.0)), 0.0, 20.0)
+			return _ok({"time_scale": Engine.time_scale})
+	return _err("unknown command " + cmd)
+
+
+func _ok(result: Variant) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"ok": true, "result": jsonable(result)}
+
+
+func _err(msg: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"ok": false, "error": msg}
+
+
+# --- Names for eval / run ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The game scene (Main) - the current scene, or wherever a script put it.
+func main() -> Node:
+	var cs := get_tree().current_scene
+	if cs and cs.has_method("enter_site"):
+		return cs
+	for c in get_tree().root.get_children():
+		if c.has_method("enter_site"):
+			return c
+	return null
+
+
+func _names() -> Dictionary:
+	var m := main()
+	var d := {}
+	for c in get_tree().root.get_children():   # the autoloads (Galaxy, Settings, ...)
+		if c != m and ProjectSettings.has_setting("autoload/" + str(c.name)):
+			d[str(c.name)] = c
+	for s in ["Engine", "Input", "OS", "Time", "DisplayServer", "ResourceLoader", "ProjectSettings"]:
+		d[s] = Engine.get_singleton(s)
+	for c in ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list():   # (the game's classes: MinoanTiles, Galaxy's types...)
+		if not d.has(c["class"]) and ResourceLoader.has_cached(c["path"]):
+			d[c["class"]] = load(c["path"])
+	d.merge({
+		"main": m,
+		"ship": m.get("ship") if m else null,
+		"site": m.get("site") if m else null,
+		"root": get_tree().root,
+		"tree": get_tree(),
+		"live": self,
+	}, true)
+	return d
+
+
+## A node by alias (main, ship, site) or path (from root or from Main).
+func _node(path: String) -> Node:
+	var names := _names()
+	if path == "" or path == "root":
+		return get_tree().root
+	var head := path.get_slice("/", 0)
+	if names.get(head) is Node:
+		var base: Node = names[head]
+		var rest := path.substr(head.length()).trim_prefix("/")
+		return base if rest == "" else base.get_node_or_null(rest)
+	var n := get_tree().root.get_node_or_null(path)
+	if n == null and names["main"]:
+		n = names["main"].get_node_or_null(path)
+	return n
+
+
+func _expr(code: String) -> Array:   # [ok, value or error]
+	var names := _names()
+	var e := Expression.new()
+	if e.parse(code, PackedStringArray(names.keys())) != OK:
+		return [false, e.get_error_text()]
+	var v: Variant = e.execute(names.values(), self, false)
+	if e.has_execute_failed():
+		return [false, "failed: " + e.get_error_text()]
+	return [true, v]
+
+
+func _eval(code: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var r := _expr(code)
+	return _ok(r[1]) if r[0] else _err(r[1])
+
+
+func _set_cmd(req: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var t := _expr(str(req.get("target", "")))
+	if not t[0]:
+		return _err("target: " + str(t[1]))
+	if not (t[1] is Object):
+		return _err("target is not an object: " + str(t[1]))
+	var v := _expr(str(req.get("value", "null")))
+	if not v[0]:
+		return _err("value: " + str(v[1]))
+	var obj: Object = t[1]
+	var prop := str(req.get("prop", ""))
+	obj.set_indexed(NodePath(prop), v[1])
+	return _ok(obj.get_indexed(NodePath(prop)))
+
+
+var _run_n := 0
+## The snippets' scripts and objects, kept for the whole run: freeing a script
+## whose code made lambdas crashes Godot 4.7 (double free) a run or two later.
+var _runs: Array = []
+
+## Statements -> a throwaway script: func run() with main/ship/site/... set.
+func _run(code: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var src := code
+	if not code.contains("func run("):
+		var body := ""
+		for l in code.split("\n"):
+			body += "\t" + l + "\n"
+		src = "func run():\n" + body + "\treturn null\n"
+	if not src.begins_with("extends"):
+		src = "extends RefCounted\nvar main\nvar ship\nvar site\nvar root\nvar tree\nvar live\n\n" + src
+	var s := GDScript.new()
+	s.source_code = src
+	_run_n += 1
+	var err := s.reload()
+	if err != OK:
+		return _err("doesn't compile (%s) - see the events for the line" % error_string(err))
+	var obj: Object = s.new()
+	_runs.append([s, obj])
+	for k in _names():
+		if k in obj:
+			obj.set(k, _names()[k])
+	var v: Variant = await obj.run()
+	return _ok(v)
+
