+# --- Hot reload --------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Reload scripts (live objects keep their state and get the new code -
+## subclasses that are loaded are reloaded after their bases), shaders (their
+## code, so every material using them updates) and other resources (in place).
+func reload(paths: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	# A change hot reload can't take - a new class (Godot names classes as the
+	# game starts) or a variable removed or renamed (live objects would keep
+	# the old layout: it has crashed the game) - restarts the game instead.
+	var why := _needs_restart(paths)
+	if why != "":
+		_restart_why = why
+		_prepared_ok = false   # (a newer change: ready it again)
+		_restart_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + RESTART_QUIET_MS   # (more saves soon: wait for them)
+		_notice("Live: restarting to apply %s" % why, NOTE)
+		event("reload", "restart needed: " + why)
+		return {"reloaded": [], "failed": [], "restart": why}
+	var done := []
+	var failed := []
+	var scripts := []
+	var pictures := []
+	for p in paths:
+		p = _res_path(str(p))
+		if p.ends_with(".gd"):
+			scripts.append(p)
+		elif DATA_RELOAD.has(p):
+			if _talos_open():
+				continue   # (Talos edits this data itself: a reload would drop its unsaved edits)
+			DATA_RELOAD[p].call()
+			done.append(p)
+		elif PICTURE_EXT.has(p.get_extension()):
+			pictures.append(p)   # (imported again first - else the old import loads)
+		elif not ResourceLoader.has_cached(p):
+			continue   # (not loaded - the game reads it fresh when it needs it)
+		elif p.ends_with(".gdshader"):
+			var sh: Shader = load(p)
+			sh.code = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(p)
+			done.append(p)
+		else:
+			ResourceLoader.load(p, "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REPLACE)
+			done.append(p)
+	# Loaded scripts that extend a changed one reload with it (base first).
+	var all := scripts.duplicate()
+	for p in _loaded_scripts():
+		if p in all:
+			continue
+		var s: Script = load(p)
+		var b := s.get_base_script()
+		while b:
+			if b.resource_path in scripts:
+				all.append(p)
+				break
+			b = b.get_base_script()
+	all.sort_custom(func(a, b): return _depth(a) < _depth(b))
+	for p in all:
+		if not ResourceLoader.has_cached(p):
+			continue
+		if p == get_script().resource_path:
+			continue   # (not itself - it's running the reload; restart for that)
+		var s: GDScript = load(p)
+		if _base_failed(s, failed):
+			continue
+		var src := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(p)
+		# Compile it on the side first: broken code mustn't break the live script.
+		if not compiles(src, p):
+			failed.append(p)
+			continue
+		var before := _member_names(s)
+		s.source_code = src
+		if s.reload(true) == OK:
+			done.append(p)
+			var added := _member_names(s).filter(func(n): return not before.has(n))
+			if not added.is_empty():
+				_init_members(s, added)
+		else:
+			failed.append(p)
+	if not pictures.is_empty():
+		_import_pictures(pictures)
+	if not done.is_empty():
+		event("reload", "reloaded " + ", ".join(done.map(func(x): return x.get_file())))
+		_refresh_screens()
+		_notice("Live update: " + ", ".join(done.map(func(x): return x.get_file())), NOTE)
+	if not failed.is_empty():
+		event("error", "reload failed (kept the old code): " + ", ".join(failed))
+		_notice("Live: not applied - doesn't compile yet: %s (the old code runs on)" % ", ".join(failed.map(func(x): return x.get_file())), WARN)
+	return {"reloaded": done, "failed": failed}
+
+
+# --- Changes hot reload can't take: a restart, where you were ----------------------
+
+## Class names Godot knew as the game started (a new one needs a restart).
+var _known_classes := {}
+var _restart_why := ""
+var _restart_at := 0
+const RESTART_QUIET_MS := 2500   # (no more changes for this long: then restart)
+const RESUME_FILE := "user://live_resume.json"
+var _resume := {}                # (after a live restart: where to go back to)
+## Data files the game reads itself, and how to read them again.
+var DATA_RELOAD := {
+	"res://data/main_quest.json": func(): QuestData.reload(),
+	"res://data/themes.json": func(): Themes.reload(),
+}
+
+
+## Why these changed files need a restart ("" - hot reload will do): a new
+## class_name; a loaded script that lost variables, or gained some while
+## objects of it live in the game (they were set up without them - their
+## _ready never sees the new ones: a sprite never loaded); a new picture
+## (imported as the game restarts; what looked for it found nothing).
+func _needs_restart(paths: Array) -> String:
+	for p in paths:
+		p = _res_path(str(p))
+		if PICTURE_EXT.has(p.get_extension()) and _new_files.has(p):
+			return "a new picture, %s" % p.get_file()
+		if not p.ends_with(".gd") or not FileAccess.file_exists(p):
+			continue
+		if p == get_script().resource_path:
+			return "live_link.gd itself changed"   # (it can't reload itself)
+		var src := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(p)
+		for c in new_classes(src, _known_classes):
+			return "a new class, %s (%s)" % [c, p.get_file()]
+		if ResourceLoader.has_cached(p) and p != get_script().resource_path:
+			var gone := removed_members(load(p), src, p)
+			if not gone.is_empty():
+				return "%s lost %s" % [p.get_file(), ", ".join(gone)]
+			var gained := added_members(load(p), src, p)
+			if not gained.is_empty() and live_nodes_of(get_tree(), load(p)) > 0:
+				return "%s gained %s (its objects in the game were made without it)" % [p.get_file(), ", ".join(gained)]
+	return ""
+
+
+## The variables the new source `src` has that script `s` doesn't (added)
+## - only if it compiles.
+static func added_members(s: Script, src: String, path: String) -> Array:
+	var t := GDScript.new()
+	t.source_code = trial_source(src)
+	t.take_over_path(path + "::members")
+	if t.reload() != OK:
+		return []
+	var vars := func(sc: Script) -> Array:
+		return sc.get_script_property_list().filter(func(p): return p["usage"] & PROPERTY_USAGE_SCRIPT_VARIABLE).map(func(p): return p["name"])
+	var before: Array = vars.call(s)
+	return vars.call(t).filter(func(n): return not before.has(n))
+
+
+## Nodes in the tree running script `s` (or one extending it).
+static func live_nodes_of(tree: SceneTree, s: Script) -> int:
+	var n_live := 0
+	var stack: Array = [tree.root]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		stack.append_array(n.get_children(true))
+		var ns: Script = n.get_script()
+		while ns and ns != s:
+			ns = ns.get_base_script()
+		if ns != null:
+			n_live += 1
+	return n_live
+
+
+## The class_names in `src` that `known` doesn't have.
+static func new_classes(src: String, known: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for line in src.split("\n"):
+		if line.begins_with("class_name "):
+			var c := line.trim_prefix("class_name ").strip_edges().split(" ")[0].strip_edges()
+			if c != "" and not known.has(c):
+				out.append(c)
+	return out
+
+
+## The variables script `s` has that its new source `src` doesn't (renamed or
+## removed) - only if the new source compiles (broken code isn't a reason).
+static func removed_members(s: Script, src: String, path: String) -> Array:
+	var t := GDScript.new()
+	t.source_code = trial_source(src)
+	t.take_over_path(path + "::members")
+	if t.reload() != OK:
+		return []
+	var now := t.get_script_property_list().map(func(p): return p["name"])
+	return s.get_script_property_list().map(func(p): return p["name"]).filter(func(n): return not now.has(n) and not str(n).ends_with(".gd"))
+
+
+## Restarts the game to apply a change, back where you were - once the files
+## have been quiet a moment, the game can be saved and Talos has nothing
+## unsaved (else it waits, and says why).
+func _try_restart() -> void:
+	if _prep != null:
+		return   # (being prepared)
+	var tree := get_tree()
+	var scene := tree.current_scene
+	if scene == null or tree.root.has_node("LoadVeil"):
+		_restart_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 500
+		return
+	if not _prepared_ok:
+		# First (on a thread - the game runs on): an import, so the new game
+		# knows new class_names, then a check that every script compiles in a
+		# fresh process - never restart into code that doesn't.
+		_notice("Live: getting the update ready (%s)..." % _restart_why, NOTE)
+		_prep = Thread.new()
+		_prep.start(_prepare)
+		return
+	var resume := {"why": _restart_why}
+	if scene.scene_file_path == "res://scenes/editor/editor.tscn":
+		if _talos_unsaved():
+			_notice("Live: a change needs a restart - save your edits in Talos (Ctrl+S) and it restarts", WARN)
+			_restart_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 3000
+			return
+		resume["kind"] = "talos"
+		resume["tool"] = str(scene.get("current"))
+		resume["page"] = TalosNav.page
+		resume["talos_return"] = SaveGame.talos_return
+	elif scene.has_method("get_save_data"):
+		if SaveGame._game(true) == null:
+			_restart_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 1000   # (landing, jumping: in a moment)
+			return
+		if SaveGame.talos_overlay() != null and _talos_unsaved():
+			_notice("Live: a change needs a restart - save your edits in Talos (Ctrl+S) and it restarts", WARN)
+			_restart_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 3000
+			return
+		if not SaveGame.save_game(scene.get_save_data(), SaveGame.LIVE):
+			return
+		resume["kind"] = "game"
+		if SaveGame.talos_overlay() != null:   # (Talos open over it: open again over the game, on that tool)
+			var h := TalosNav.host(tree)
+			resume["talos_overlay"] = true
+			resume["tool"] = str(h.get("current")) if h else ""
+			resume["page"] = TalosNav.page
+	else:
+		resume["kind"] = "menu"
+	live_restart(resume)
+
+
+var _prep: Thread
+var _prepared_ok := false
+
+func _prepare() -> void:
+	var exe := OS.get_executable_path()
+	var proj := ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://")
+	var out := []
+	OS.execute(exe, ["--headless", "--path", proj, "--import"], out, true)
+	out = []
+	var code := OS.execute(exe, ["--headless", "--path", proj, "-s", "res://tools/live_check.gd"], out, true)
+	_prepared.call_deferred(code, "\n".join(out))
+
+
+func _prepared(code: int, out: String) -> void:
+	_prep.wait_to_finish()
+	_prep = null
+	if code != 0:
+		var broken := []
+		for line in out.split("\n"):
+			if line.begins_with("BROKEN "):
+				broken.append(line.trim_prefix("BROKEN ").get_file())
+		_notice("Live: not restarting yet - doesn't compile: %s (save again when fixed)" % ", ".join(broken if not broken.is_empty() else ["?"]), WARN)
+		event("error", "live restart held back - doesn't compile: " + ", ".join(broken))
+		_restart_why = ""
+		return
+	_prepared_ok = true
+	_restart_at = 0
+	_try_restart()
+
+
+## Writes where to come back to, then restarts the game (the same command
+## line, the window where it is now).
+func live_restart(resume: Dictionary) -> void:
+	event("reload", "restarting: " + str(resume.get("why", "")))
+	var f := FileAccess.open(RESUME_FILE, FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f:
+		f.store_string(JSON.stringify(resume))
+		f.close()
+	OS.set_restart_on_exit(true, PackedStringArray(restart_args()))
+	_restart_why = ""
+	get_tree().quit()
+
+
+## The arguments to start the game again with: the very ones it was started
+## with (Linux: /proc/self/cmdline - the engine's own, --path, --position...,
+## aren't in get_cmdline_args), else rebuilt: the project, the window's size
+## and its frame's corner, and the user args as they were.
+static func restart_args() -> Array:
+	var f := FileAccess.open("/proc/self/cmdline", FileAccess.READ)
+	if f:
+		var raw := f.get_buffer(1 << 16)
+		f.close()
+		var parts := _split_nul(raw)
+		if parts.size() > 1:
+			return parts.slice(1)   # (without the executable itself)
+	var pos := DisplayServer.window_get_position_with_decorations()
+	var size := DisplayServer.window_get_size()
+	var args := ["--path", ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://"), "--resolution", "%dx%d" % [size.x, size.y],
+		"--position", "%d,%d" % [pos.x, pos.y]]
+	var user := Array(OS.get_cmdline_user_args())
+	return args + (["--"] + user if not user.is_empty() else [])
+
+
+static func _split_nul(raw: PackedByteArray) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var start := 0
+	for i in raw.size():
+		if raw[i] == 0:
+			out.append(raw.slice(start, i).get_string_from_utf8())
+			start = i + 1
+	if start < raw.size():
+		out.append(raw.slice(start).get_string_from_utf8())
+	return out
+
+
+func _read_resume() -> Dictionary:
+	if not FileAccess.file_exists(RESUME_FILE):
+		return {}
+	var d: Variant = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(RESUME_FILE))
+	DirAccess.remove_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(RESUME_FILE))
+	return d if d is Dictionary else {}
+

+## After a live restart: once the title screen is up, back where you were.

+## Whether any Talos tool has edits not saved yet.
+func _talos_unsaved() -> bool:
+	for s in [get_tree().current_scene, SaveGame.talos_overlay()]:

+## After a hot reload: the screens on show rebuilt with the new code (a
+## page built before keeps what it built until it's built again).
+const SCREENS := {"dev_mode.gd": "_refresh", "station_menu.gd": "refresh", "scenario_editor.gd": "_rebuild",
+	"ship_menu.gd": "show_tab", "field_menu.gd": "show_tab", "patcher.gd": "show_patch"}

+func _refresh_screens() -> void:
+	var stack: Array = [get_tree().current_scene, SaveGame.talos_overlay()].filter(func(x): return x != null)
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		stack.append_array(n.get_children())
+		var sc: Script = n.get_script()
+		if sc == null or not SCREENS.has(sc.resource_path.get_file()):
+			continue
+		if n is CanvasItem and not n.is_visible_in_tree():
+			continue
+		var m: String = SCREENS[sc.resource_path.get_file()]
+		if not n.has_method(m):
+			continue
+		if m in ["show_tab", "show_patch"]:
+			var cur: Variant = n.get("current")
+			if cur is int and int(cur) >= 0:
+				n.call(m, cur)
+		else:
+			n.call(m)

+## Whether GDScript source compiles (its class_name blanked out - a scratch
+## copy may not take the real one's name; the errors go to the log with the
+## real file's line numbers).
+static func compiles(src: String, path: String) -> bool:
+	var t := GDScript.new()
+	t.source_code = trial_source(src)
+	t.take_over_path(path + "::trial")
+	return t.reload() == OK
+
+
+## A script's source for a scratch compile: its class_name line blanked (a
+## scratch copy can't take the real one's name) and its own name, where it
+## is a type (-> X, : X, as X, is X), made Object - else a class that names
+## itself ("-> RichField") never compiles on the side.
+static func trial_source(src: String) -> String:
+	var lines := src.split("\n")
+	var own := ""
+	for i in lines.size():
+		if lines[i].begins_with("class_name "):
+			own = lines[i].trim_prefix("class_name ").strip_edges().split(" ")[0]
+			lines[i] = ""
+	var out := "\n".join(lines)
+	if own != "":
+		var re := RegEx.new()
+		re.compile("(->\\s*|:\\s*|\\bas\\s+|\\bis\\s+)" + own + "\\b")
+		out = re.sub(out, "${1}Object", true)
+	return out
+
+
+func _base_failed(s: Script, failed: Array) -> bool:
+	var b := s.get_base_script()
+	while b:
+		if b.resource_path in failed:
+			return true
+		b = b.get_base_script()
+	return false
+
+
+func _member_names(s: Script) -> Array:
+	return s.get_script_property_list().map(func(p): return p["name"])
+
+
+## Variables a reload added are null in the objects that already existed:
+## give them their declared defaults (in every node of the tree with that
+## script or one extending it - nodes are what lives; the rest can't be
+## found).
+func _init_members(s: Script, names: Array) -> void:
+	var n_set := 0
+	var stack: Array = [get_tree().root]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		stack.append_array(n.get_children(true))
+		var ns: Script = n.get_script()
+		while ns and ns != s:
+			ns = ns.get_base_script()
+		if ns == null:
+			continue
+		var decl: Dictionary = preload("res://scripts/core/dev_inspector.gd").declared_defaults(s)
+		for m in names:
+			if typeof(n.get(m)) == TYPE_NIL:
+				var d: Variant = decl.get(m, s.get_property_default_value(m))
+				if d is Array or d is Dictionary:
+					d = d.duplicate(true)
+				if d != null:
+					n.set(m, d)
+					n_set += 1
+	if n_set > 0:
+		event("reload", "gave %d new variable(s) of %s their defaults in live objects" % [n_set, s.resource_path.get_file()])
+
+
+func _res_path(p: String) -> String:
+	if p.contains("://"):
+		return p
+	var root := ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://")
+	return "res://" + p.trim_prefix(root).trim_prefix("./")
+
+
+func _depth(p: String) -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	var b: Script = (load(p) as Script).get_base_script()
+	while b:
+		n += 1
+		b = b.get_base_script()
+	return n
+

+## The folders under these (and they), for watching.
+static func _tree_of(roots: Array) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	var todo: Array = roots.duplicate()
+	while not todo.is_empty():
+		var d: String = todo.pop_back()
+		out.append(d)
+		for sub in DirAccess.get_directories_at(d):
+			todo.append(d.path_join(sub))
+	return out
+
+
+func _loaded_scripts() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for d in _tree_of(["res://scripts"]):
+		for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(d):
+			if f.ends_with(".gd") and ResourceLoader.has_cached(d + "/" + f):
+				out.append(d + "/" + f)
+	return out

+## The watched files' times, checked on a thread of their own: a file check
+## can block on a busy disk (100+ ms now and then - the project lives in a
+## synced folder), and on the main thread that stuttered the game. A pass
+## every 0.5 s; what changed is handed over (_watch_step, on the main
+## thread), which reloads it - and cuts a changed tile sheet.
+var _watch_thread: Thread
+var _watch_stop := false
+var _watch_mutex := Mutex.new()
+var _changed: Array = []          # changed files the thread found (taken by _watch_step)
+var _changed_sheets: Array = []   # changed tile sheets (file names)
+var _fresh: Array = []            # new files the thread found (taken with _changed)
+
+func _start_watch() -> void:
+	if _watch_thread != null:
+		return
+	_watch_stop = false
+	_watch_thread = Thread.new()
+	_watch_thread.start(_watch_loop)
+
+
+func _stop_watch() -> void:
+	if _watch_thread == null:
+		return
+	_watch_stop = true
+	_watch_thread.wait_to_finish()
+	_watch_thread = null
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	_stop_watch()
+	if _importer != null:
+		_importer.wait_to_finish()
+
+
+func _watch_loop() -> void:
+	var times := {}
+	var first := true   # (the first pass only records)
+	while not _watch_stop:
+		var changed := []
+		var fresh := []   # (new files - not there when the game started)
+		var sheets := []
+		for d in watch_dirs:
+			for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(d):
+				if not WATCH_EXT.has(f.get_extension()):
+					continue
+				var p: String = d.path_join(f)
+				var t := FileAccess.get_modified_time(p)
+				if not first and times.get(p, -1) != t:   # (changed, or new)
+					changed.append(p)
+					if not times.has(p):
+						fresh.append(p)
+				times[p] = t
+		for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(SHEETS_DIR):
+			if not f.contains(SHEET_MATCH) or f.get_extension() != "png":
+				continue
+			var p := SHEETS_DIR.path_join(f)
+			var t := FileAccess.get_modified_time(p)
+			if not first and times.get(p, -1) != t:
+				sheets.append(f)
+			times[p] = t
+		first = false
+		if not changed.is_empty() or not sheets.is_empty():
+			_watch_mutex.lock()
+			_changed.append_array(changed)
+			_fresh.append_array(fresh)
+			_changed_sheets.append_array(sheets)
+			_watch_mutex.unlock()
+		for i in 10:   # (0.5 s, a stop request heard within 50 ms)
+			if _watch_stop:
+				break
+			OS.delay_msec(50)
+
+
+## Changed pictures: Godot imports them again (on a thread, the game runs
+## on), then the loaded ones reload in place - whatever shows them updates.
+func _import_pictures(pics: Array) -> void:
+	for p in pics:
+		_to_import[p] = true
+	if _importer != null:
+		return   # (one import at a time - it picks up the rest after)
+	var batch: Array = _to_import.keys()
+	_to_import = {}
+	event("reload", "importing " + ", ".join(batch.map(func(x): return x.get_file())))
+	_importer = Thread.new()
+	_importer.start(func():
+		var out := []
+		OS.execute(OS.get_executable_path(), ["--headless", "--path", ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://"), "--import"], out, true)
+		_imported.call_deferred(batch))
+
+
+func _imported(batch: Array) -> void:
+	_importer.wait_to_finish()
+	_importer = null
+	var done := []
+	for p in batch:
+		if ResourceLoader.has_cached(p):
+			ResourceLoader.load(p, "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REPLACE)
+			done.append(p.get_file())
+	if not done.is_empty():
+		event("reload", "reloaded " + ", ".join(done))
+		_refresh_screens()
+		_notice("Live update: " + ", ".join(done), NOTE)
+	if not _to_import.is_empty():
+		_import_pictures([])
+
+
+## On the main thread, every frame: what the watcher found, reloaded.
+func _watch_step(_delta: float) -> void:
+	if _changed.is_empty() and _changed_sheets.is_empty():
+		return   # (no lock: a read of the size is enough to skip)
+	_watch_mutex.lock()
+	var changed := _changed
+	_changed = []
+	var sheets := _changed_sheets
+	_changed_sheets = []
+	for p in _fresh:
+		_new_files[p] = true
+	_fresh = []
+	_watch_mutex.unlock()
+	for f in sheets:
+		if not _cutting.has(f):
+			_cut_sheet(f)
+	if not changed.is_empty():
+		reload(changed)
+
+
+## Cuts a changed tile sheet into its pieces (data/sprites/tile_*.png) on a
+## thread; the watcher then reloads them.
+func _cut_sheet(f: String) -> void:
+	event("reload", "%s changed - cutting its pieces (tools/extract_sprites.py)" % f)
+	var th := Thread.new()
+	_cutting[f] = th
+	th.start(func():
+		var out := []
+		var code := OS.execute("python3", [ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://tools/extract_sprites.py"), f], out, true)
+		_cut_done.call_deferred(f, code, "".join(out)))
+
+
+func _cut_done(f: String, code: int, out: String) -> void:
+	var th: Thread = _cutting.get(f)
+	if th:
+		th.wait_to_finish()
+	_cutting.erase(f)
+	if code == 0:
+		event("reload", "%s cut: %d pieces" % [f, out.count("\n")])   # (the watcher finds them changed)
+	else:
+		event("error", "cutting %s failed (%d): %s" % [f, code, out.right(400)])
+
+
+func set_auto_reload(on: bool) -> void:
+	auto_reload = on
+	if on:
+		_start_watch()
+		set_process(true)
+	else:
+		_stop_watch()
+	event("reload", "hot reload " + ("on" if on else "off"))
+

+		_menu.id_pressed.connect(_on_menu)
+		_speeds = PopupMenu.new()
+		_speeds.name = "Speeds"
+		for i in 5:
+			_speeds.add_radio_check_item(["×0.25", "×0.5", "×1", "×2", "×4"][i], i)
+		_speeds.id_pressed.connect(func(i): Engine.time_scale = [0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0][i])
+		_menu.add_child(_speeds)
+		add_child(_menu)
+	_menu.clear()
+	_picked.clear()
+	var thing := pick_at(at)
+	if thing:
+		_menu.add_item("Inspect  " + _label(thing), 100)
+		_picked.append(thing)
+	var ui := get_viewport().gui_get_hovered_control()
+	if ui and ui != thing:
+		_menu.add_item("Inspect UI  " + _label(ui), 100 + _picked.size())
+		_picked.append(ui)
+	if _picked.size() > 0:
+		_menu.add_separator()
+	_menu.add_check_item("Inspector", 1)
+	_menu.set_item_checked(_menu.get_item_index(1), inspector != null and inspector.visible)
+	_menu.add_separator()
+	_menu.add_check_item("Pause", 2)
+	_menu.set_item_checked(_menu.get_item_index(2), get_tree().paused)
+	_menu.add_submenu_node_item("Game speed", _speeds, 3)
+	for i in 5:
+		_speeds.set_item_checked(i, is_equal_approx(Engine.time_scale, [0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0][i]))
+	_menu.add_check_item("Hot reload (watch files)", 4)
+	_menu.set_item_checked(_menu.get_item_index(4), auto_reload)
+	_menu.add_item("Screenshot", 5)
+	_menu.reset_size()
+	# (an embedded menu is placed in the game view's coordinates, a native one on the screen)
+	var origin := Vector2i.ZERO if get_viewport().gui_embed_subwindows else get_window().position
+	_menu.popup(Rect2i(Vector2i(at) + origin, Vector2i.ZERO))
+
+
+func _label(o: Object) -> String:
+	var s: String = inspector.node_label(o) if o is Node and inspector else (str(o.name) if o is Node else o.get_class())
+	if o.get_script() and o.get_script().resource_path != "":
+		s += "  (%s)" % o.get_script().resource_path.get_file().get_basename()
+	return s
+
+
+func _on_menu(id: int) -> void:
+	match id:
+		1:
+			if inspector and inspector.visible:
+				inspector.hide()
+			else:
+				open_inspector(null)
+		2:
+			get_tree().paused = not get_tree().paused
+		4:
+			set_auto_reload(not auto_reload)
+		5:
+			var r := _shot("user://shot_%d.png" % Time.get_unix_time_from_system())
+			if r["ok"]:
+				event("print", "screenshot: " + str(r["result"]["path"]))
+		_:
+			if id >= 100 and id - 100 < _picked.size() and is_instance_valid(_picked[id - 100]):
+				open_inspector(_picked[id - 100])
+
+
+func open_inspector(obj: Object) -> void:
+	if inspector == null:
+		inspector = preload("res://scripts/core/dev_inspector.gd").new()
+		add_child(inspector)
+	if not inspector.visible:
+		inspector.open()
+	if obj:
+		inspector.inspect(obj)
+
+
+## The game object under a screen point: the nearest scripted Node2D in the
+## world (not the HUD) within its click radius (or 40 screen px).
+func pick_at(screen: Vector2) -> Node2D:
+	var m := main()
+	var vp := get_viewport()
+	if m == null:
+		return null
+	var ct := vp.get_canvas_transform()
+	var world := ct.affine_inverse() * screen
+	var zoom := ct.get_scale().x
+	var world_canvas := vp.find_world_2d().canvas
+	var best: Node2D = null
+	var best_d := INF
+	var stack: Array = [m]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		for c in n.get_children():
+			if c is CanvasLayer or c is Control or c is Window:
+				continue
+			stack.append(c)
+			if not (c is Node2D) or c.get_script() == null or not c.is_visible_in_tree():
+				continue
+			if c.get_canvas() != world_canvas:
+				continue
+			var r: float = 40.0 / maxf(zoom, 0.0001)
+			var cr = c.get("click_radius")
+			if cr is float or cr is int:
+				r = maxf(r, float(cr))
+			var d: float = c.global_position.distance_to(world) / r
+			if d < 1.0 and d < best_d:
+				best_d = d
+				best = c
+	return best
+
+
+# --- Looking at things -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
+	var m := main()
+	var out := {
+		"fps": Engine.get_frames_per_second(),
+		"paused": get_tree().paused,
+		"time_scale": Engine.time_scale,
+		"scene": get_tree().current_scene.name if get_tree().current_scene else "",
+		"in_game": m != null,
+	}
+	if m == null:
+		return out
+	var ship: Node2D = m.get("ship")
+	if ship:
+		out["ship"] = {
+			"pos": ship.global_position,
+			"vel": ship.get("velocity"),
+			"hull": ship.get("hull"), "max_hull": ship.get("max_hull"),
+			"shield": ship.get("shield"), "max_shield": ship.get("max_shield"),
+		}
+	var site = m.get("site")
+	if is_instance_valid(site):
+		var sig: Dictionary = site.get("sig")
+		out["site"] = {"kind": site.get("kind"), "id": sig.get("id", ""),
+			"level": sig.get("level", ""), "seed": sig.get("seed", 0)}
+	var foes := []
+	for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
+		if not (e is Node2D) or not is_instance_valid(e):
+			continue
+		foes.append({
+			"name": str(e.name),
+			"type": e.get("type_id") if e.get("type_id") != null else e.get_script().resource_path.get_file() if e.get_script() else e.get_class(),
+			"hull": e.get("hull"), "max_hull": e.get("max_hull"),
+			"pos": e.global_position,
+			"dist": e.global_position.distance_to(ship.global_position) if ship else 0.0,
+		})
+	foes.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a["dist"] < b["dist"])
+	out["enemies"] = foes
+	return out
+
+
+func _tree(n: Node, depth: int) -> Dictionary:
+	var d := {"name": str(n.name), "class": n.get_class()}
+	if n.get_script():
+		d["script"] = n.get_script().resource_path
+	if n is Node2D:
+		d["pos"] = n.global_position
+	if depth > 0 and n.get_child_count() > 0:
+		var kids := []
+		for c in n.get_children():
+			if kids.size() >= 60:
+				kids.append({"name": "... %d more" % (n.get_child_count() - 60)})
+				break
+			kids.append(_tree(c, depth - 1))
+		d["children"] = kids
+	elif n.get_child_count() > 0:
+		d["children"] = n.get_child_count()
+	return d
+
+
+func _shot(path: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var img := get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
+	if img == null:
+		return _err("no image (headless?)")
+	var p := path if path.is_absolute_path() or path.begins_with("user://") else ProjectSettings.globalize_path("user://") + path
+	var err := img.save_png(p)
+	if err != OK:
+		return _err("can't save %s (%s)" % [p, error_string(err)])
+	return _ok({"path": ProjectSettings.globalize_path(p), "size": img.get_size()})
+
+
+## Any value -> something JSON can carry (vectors as [x, y], objects named).
+static func jsonable(v: Variant, depth := 0) -> Variant:
+	if depth > 6:
+		return "..."
+	match typeof(v):
+		TYPE_NIL, TYPE_BOOL, TYPE_INT, TYPE_STRING:
+			return v
+		TYPE_FLOAT:
+			return snappedf(v, 0.001) if is_finite(v) else str(v)
+		TYPE_STRING_NAME, TYPE_NODE_PATH:
+			return str(v)
+		TYPE_VECTOR2, TYPE_VECTOR2I:
+			return [snappedf(v.x, 0.01), snappedf(v.y, 0.01)]
+		TYPE_VECTOR3, TYPE_VECTOR3I:
+			return [snappedf(v.x, 0.01), snappedf(v.y, 0.01), snappedf(v.z, 0.01)]
+		TYPE_COLOR:
+			return "#" + v.to_html()
+		TYPE_OBJECT:
+			if not is_instance_valid(v):
+				return "<freed>"
+			if v is Node:
+				return "<%s %s>" % [v.get_class(), v.get_path() if v.is_inside_tree() else v.name]
+			if v is Resource and v.resource_path != "":
+				return "<%s %s>" % [v.get_class(), v.resource_path]
+			return "<%s>" % v.get_class()
+		TYPE_DICTIONARY:
+			var d := {}
+			for k in v:
+				d[str(k)] = jsonable(v[k], depth + 1)
+			return d
+	if v is Array or typeof(v) >= TYPE_PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY:
+		var a := []
+		for x in v:
+			if a.size() >= 500:
+				a.append("... %d more" % (v.size() - 500))
+				break
+			a.append(jsonable(x, depth + 1))
+		return a
+	return str(v)

files.explanation: An engine-level service: A scene change to the game (a new game, a save loaded, back from Talos) - with NO loading screen: nothing is shown over the game (its screen is made but hidden, and lets clicks through), the space scene comes into view as it's built, pictures not loaded yet stand in as placeholders (ProcArt.sprite) and a new game's economy warms up while you play (Galaxy.new_game_async). It still follows the load (what it's waiting for, the bar's value - tests). A save made in space: the galaxy and the system are rebuilt (one long frame); one made on a planet: then the surface is built too (the bar follows its build_progress). It fades out once the game scene is ready (SaveGame.travelling back to false; a surface built) - or after TIMEOUT seconds, whatever happened. LoadVeil.change_to("res://main.tscn", "Loading slot 2") (Moved from scripts/load_veil.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,158 @@ 
+class_name LoadVeil
+extends CanvasLayer
+## A scene change to the game (a new game, a save loaded, back from Talos) -
+## with NO loading screen: nothing is shown over the game (its screen is made
+## but hidden, and lets clicks through), the space scene comes into view as
+## it's built, pictures not loaded yet stand in as placeholders (ProcArt.sprite)
+## and a new game's economy warms up while you play (Galaxy.new_game_async).
+## It still follows the load (what it's waiting for, the bar's value - tests).
+## A save made in space: the galaxy and the system are rebuilt (one long
+## frame); one made on a planet: then the surface is built too (the bar
+## follows its build_progress). It fades out once the game scene is ready
+## (SaveGame.travelling back to false; a surface built) - or after TIMEOUT
+## seconds, whatever happened.
+##   LoadVeil.change_to("res://main.tscn", "Loading slot 2")
+
+const TIMEOUT := 30.0
+const FADE := 0.3
+## Of the bar: the space scene; the rest, a planet's surface if there's one.
+const SPACE_SHARE := 0.3
+
+var _bar: ProgressBar
+var _stage: Label
+var _root: Control
+var _t := 0.0
+var _shown := 0.0
+var _ready_frames := 0
+var _closing := false
+## The scene to wait for (tests); else the current scene.
+var watch: Node = null
+## The scene showing when the load began (it may be a game too: loading
+## from its menu) - only a new one counts.
+var _from: Node = null
+var _changed := false
+
+
+## Shows the veil, lets it draw, then changes to `path` under it. `prepare`:
+## work done first, under the veil, across frames (a coroutine taking a
+## progress Callable(share) - a new game's galaxy: Galaxy.new_game_async),
+## with its own `stage` line.
+static func change_to(path: String, title := "Loading", prepare := Callable(), stage := "") -> LoadVeil:
+	var tree := Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree
+	var v := LoadVeil.new()
+	v.name = "LoadVeil"
+	tree.root.add_child(v)
+	v._build(title)
+	v._prepare = prepare
+	if stage != "":
+		v._stage.text = stage
+	v._go.call_deferred(path)
+	return v
+
+
+var _prepare := Callable()
+var _prep_share := -1.0   # the preparation's progress (-1: none)
+var _art_wait := false   # (nothing waits for the art now: kept for the time-out check)
+var _art_part := 0.0
+
+
+func _build(title: String) -> void:
+	layer = 128
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	_root = Control.new()
+	_root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP   # (no clicks through while loading)
+	add_child(_root)
+	var bg := ColorRect.new()
+	bg.color = Color(NeonTheme.BG, 1.0)
+	bg.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_root.add_child(bg)
+	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
+	box.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
+	box.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	box.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
+	box.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
+	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
+	_root.add_child(box)
+	var head := Label.new()
+	head.text = title.to_upper()
+	head.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
+	head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.CYAN)
+	box.add_child(head)
+	_bar = ProgressBar.new()
+	_bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(620, 22)
+	_bar.max_value = 1.0
+	_bar.step = 0.0
+	_bar.show_percentage = false
+	_bar.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	var back := NeonBox.new()
+	back.bg_color = Color(NeonTheme.BG, 0.9)
+	back.border_color = NeonTheme.HEAD
+	var fill := NeonBox.new()
+	fill.bg_color = NeonTheme.CYAN
+	fill.border_color = NeonTheme.PINK
+	fill.light = 0.5
+	_bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("background", back)
+	_bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill", fill)
+	box.add_child(_bar)
+	_stage = Label.new()
+	_stage.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	_stage.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
+	_stage.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.85))
+	_stage.text = "Restoring the galaxy"
+	box.add_child(_stage)
+	# (No loading screen: the game shows as it's made.)
+	_root.visible = false
+	_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+
+
+func _go(path: String) -> void:
+	# Two frames so the veil is on screen before the long frame of the load.
+	await get_tree().process_frame
+	await get_tree().process_frame
+	# (The game's art isn't waited for: it keeps loading in the background,
+	# placeholders standing in for pictures not in yet - ProcArt.sprite.)
+	if _prepare.is_valid():
+		_prep_share = 0.0
+		await _prepare.call(func(share: float): _prep_share = _art_part + share * (1.0 - _art_part))
+		_prep_share = 1.0
+		_t = 0.0   # (the time-out counts from here)
+	get_tree().paused = false
+	_from = get_tree().current_scene
+	_changed = true
+	await UI.switch_scene(path)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _closing:
+		return
+	_t += delta
+	var s := watch if watch != null else get_tree().current_scene
+	var target := 0.05 if _prep_share < 0.0 else _prep_share * SPACE_SHARE
+	var done := false
+	if (watch != null or (_changed and s != _from)) and s != null and s.has_method("get_save_data"):
+		var surface := s.get("is_built") != null
+		if surface:
+			target = SPACE_SHARE + (1.0 - SPACE_SHARE) * float(s.get("build_progress"))
+			var p := str(SaveGame.landed_planet)
+			_stage.text = "Landing on " + str(Planets.get_planet(p).get("name", p)) if p != "" else "Landing"
+			done = s.get("is_built") == true and not SaveGame.travelling and (not s.has_method("world_settled") or s.world_settled())
+		else:
+			target = SPACE_SHARE
+			done = not SaveGame.travelling and (not s.has_method("build_settled") or s.build_settled())
+	_shown = move_toward(_shown, target, delta * 2.0)
+	if done:
+		_ready_frames += 1
+		_shown = 1.0
+	_bar.value = _shown
+	if _ready_frames >= 3 or (_t > TIMEOUT and not _art_wait):   # (a few frames for the first picture)
+		_close()
+
+
+func _close() -> void:
+	_closing = true
+	var tw := create_tween()
+	tw.tween_property(_root, "modulate:a", 0.0, FADE)
+	tw.tween_callback(queue_free)

files.explanation: An engine-level service: Autoload "Music": the background music. Three looping tracks in res://music/ (made by tools/music_gen.py, each a seamless 2-minute loop): menu "Atrapos" - the main menu and Talos (the editor) space "Deep Drift" - flying in space surface "Minoan Shores" - on a planet's surface (and the Library) The track follows the scene by itself (TRACK_FOR: scene file -> track); a change crossfades over FADE seconds. play("space") / stop() by hand too. It plays on the "Music" bus, whose volume is Settings.music_volume; it keeps playing while the game is paused (the menu over the game). (Moved from scripts/music.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,122 @@ 
+extends Node
+## Autoload "Music": the background music. Three looping tracks in res://music/
+## (made by tools/music_gen.py, each a seamless 2-minute loop):
+##   menu     "Atrapos"        - the main menu and Talos (the editor)
+##   space    "Deep Drift"     - flying in space
+##   surface  "Minoan Shores"  - on a planet's surface (and the Library)
+## The track follows the scene by itself (TRACK_FOR: scene file -> track);
+## a change crossfades over FADE seconds. play("space") / stop() by hand too.
+## It plays on the "Music" bus, whose volume is Settings.music_volume; it keeps
+## playing while the game is paused (the menu over the game).
+
+const DIR := "res://music/"
+const BUS := "Music"
+const FADE := 2.5
+const TRACK_FOR := {
+	"res://scenes/ui/main_menu.tscn": "menu",
+	"res://scenes/editor/editor.tscn": "menu",
+	"res://scenario_editor.tscn": "menu",
+	"res://scenes/editor/svg_editor.tscn": "menu",
+	"res://scenes/editor/patcher.tscn": "menu",
+	"res://main.tscn": "space",
+	"res://scenes/planet_surface.tscn": "surface",
+	"res://zoo.tscn": "surface",
+}
+const TITLES := {"menu": "Atrapos", "space": "Deep Drift", "surface": "Minoan Shores"}
+
+var current := ""                   # the track playing ("" none)
+var auto := true                    # follow the scene
+var _players: Array[AudioStreamPlayer] = []
+var _active := 0
+var _scene: Node
+var _tween: Tween
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	# Every track loading in the background now: a scene change takes its
+	# track ready-made (loading one then was ~7 ms of that frame).
+	if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
+		for t in TRACK_FOR.values():
+			var path := "%s%s.ogg" % [DIR, t]
+			if ResourceLoader.exists(path) and ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path) == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE:
+				ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path)
+	if AudioServer.get_bus_index(BUS) < 0:
+		AudioServer.add_bus()
+		var i := AudioServer.bus_count - 1
+		AudioServer.set_bus_name(i, BUS)
+		AudioServer.set_bus_send(i, "Master")
+	for k in 2:
+		var p := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
+		p.bus = BUS
+		p.volume_db = -80.0
+		p.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+		add_child(p)
+		_players.append(p)
+	apply_volume()
+
+
+## The Music bus at Settings.music_volume (0 = silent).
+func apply_volume() -> void:
+	var i := AudioServer.get_bus_index(BUS)
+	if i < 0:
+		return
+	var v: float = Settings.music_volume
+	AudioServer.set_bus_mute(i, v <= 0.001)
+	AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(i, linear_to_db(maxf(v, 0.001)))
+
+
+## The track for a scene file ("" if none).
+func track_for(scene_path: String) -> String:
+	return TRACK_FOR.get(scene_path, "")
+
+
+func stream(track: String) -> AudioStream:
+	var path := "%s%s.ogg" % [DIR, track]
+	if not ResourceLoader.exists(path):
+		return null
+	var s: AudioStream = (ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(path) if ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path) != ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE else load(path)) as AudioStream
+	if s is AudioStreamOggVorbis:
+		s.loop = true
+	return s
+
+
+## Crossfades to `track` (no change if it's already playing).
+func play(track: String, fade := FADE) -> void:
+	if track == current:
+		return
+	var s := stream(track) if track != "" else null
+	if track != "" and s == null:
+		return
+	current = track
+	var old := _players[_active]
+	_active = 1 - _active
+	var new := _players[_active]
+	if _tween:
+		_tween.kill()
+	_tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
+	_tween.set_pause_mode(Tween.TWEEN_PAUSE_PROCESS)
+	if s:
+		new.stream = s
+		new.volume_db = -60.0
+		new.play()
+		_tween.tween_property(new, "volume_db", 0.0, fade).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
+	if old.playing:
+		_tween.tween_property(old, "volume_db", -60.0, fade).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
+		_tween.chain().tween_callback(old.stop)
+
+
+func stop(fade := FADE) -> void:
+	play("", fade)
+
+
+func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
+	if not auto:
+		return
+	var sc := get_tree().current_scene
+	if sc == _scene or sc == null:
+		return
+	_scene = sc
+	var t := track_for(sc.scene_file_path)
+	if t != "":
+		play(t)

files.explanation: An engine-level service: Procedural placeholders: what a sprite looks like before its picture is loaded - a simple, low-detail shape for its kind (a ship's hull, a station's ring, a beast, a building's block, a figure, a glow...) in the sprite's own two main colours, fitted to where its picture is opaque (data/sprites/ sizes.json: tools/sprite_sizes.py). Made in microseconds (each kind's shape a 48 px mask drawn once; a placeholder is two masked blits), so every sprite has one long before the pictures load: ProcArt draws them all first, then loads the real pictures, each replacing its placeholder in place. (Moved from scripts/placeholder_art.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,113 @@ 
+class_name PlaceholderArt
+extends RefCounted
+## Procedural placeholders: what a sprite looks like before its picture is
+## loaded - a simple, low-detail shape for its kind (a ship's hull, a station's
+## ring, a beast, a building's block, a figure, a glow...) in the sprite's own
+## two main colours, fitted to where its picture is opaque (data/sprites/
+## sizes.json: tools/sprite_sizes.py). Made in microseconds (each kind's shape a
+## 48 px mask drawn once; a placeholder is two masked blits), so every sprite
+## has one long before the pictures load: ProcArt draws them all first, then
+## loads the real pictures, each replacing its placeholder in place.
+
+const RES := 48
+
+## [key prefix, kind]: the first that matches.
+const KINDS := [
+	["ship_", "hull"], ["station_", "station"], ["monster_", "beast"], ["creature_", "beast"],
+	["npc_", "figure"], ["tile_", "block"], ["gate_", "ring"],
+	["nav_", "diamond"], ["fx_", "glow"], ["sky_", "band"],
+]
+
+static var _masks := {}   # kind -> [base, top] (Images, RES x RES, alpha the shape)
+
+
+static func kind_of(key: String) -> String:
+	for k in KINDS:
+		if key.begins_with(k[0]):
+			return k[1]
+	return "slab"
+
+
+## The placeholder's picture (RES x RES; drawn at the sprite's size). `meta`:
+## sizes.json's [w, h, main, shade, x0, y0, x1, y1].
+static func make(key: String, meta: Array) -> Image:
+	var m: Array = _mask(kind_of(key))
+	var x0 := int(RES * float(meta[4]) / 100.0) if meta.size() > 7 else 0
+	var y0 := int(RES * float(meta[5]) / 100.0) if meta.size() > 7 else 0
+	var x1 := int(ceil(RES * float(meta[6]) / 100.0)) if meta.size() > 7 else RES
+	var y1 := int(ceil(RES * float(meta[7]) / 100.0)) if meta.size() > 7 else RES
+	var bw := clampi(x1 - x0, 2, RES)
+	var bh := clampi(y1 - y0, 2, RES)
+	var main := Color.html(str(meta[2])) if meta.size() > 2 else Color(0.6, 0.7, 0.8)
+	var shade := Color.html(str(meta[3])) if meta.size() > 3 else main.darkened(0.35)
+	var img := Image.create(RES, RES, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+	for layer in 2:
+		var mask: Image = m[layer]
+		if bw != RES or bh != RES:
+			mask = mask.duplicate()
+			mask.resize(bw, bh, Image.INTERPOLATE_NEAREST)
+		var col: Color = shade if layer == 0 else main.lightened(0.12)
+		col.a = 0.95
+		var solid := Image.create(bw, bh, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+		solid.fill(col)
+		img.blit_rect_mask(solid, mask, Rect2i(0, 0, bw, bh), Vector2i(x0, y0))
+	return img
+
+
+## A kind's two masks (its whole shape; its lit top), drawn once.
+static func _mask(kind: String) -> Array:
+	if _masks.has(kind):
+		return _masks[kind]
+	var out := []
+	for layer in 2:
+		var img := Image.create(RES, RES, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+		for y in RES:
+			for x in RES:
+				if _inside(kind, layer, (x + 0.5) / RES, (y + 0.5) / RES):
+					img.set_pixel(x, y, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
+		out.append(img)
+	_masks[kind] = out
+	return out
+
+
+## Is (u, v) (0..1 across the sprite) in the shape - its whole (layer 0) or its lit top (1)?
+static func _inside(kind: String, layer: int, u: float, v: float) -> bool:
+	var p := Vector2(u, v)
+	match kind:
+		"hull":   # (a pointed hull with swept wings, nose up)
+			var body := absf(u - 0.5) < 0.24 * (1.0 - absf(v - 0.55) / 0.55) + 0.05 and v > 0.03 and v < 0.97
+			var wings := v > 0.35 and v < 0.85 and absf(u - 0.5) < (v - 0.35) * 0.95
+			return (body or wings) if layer == 0 else (absf(u - 0.5) < 0.07 and v > 0.12 and v < 0.75)
+		"station":   # (a ring on spokes round a core)
+			var d := p.distance_to(Vector2(0.5, 0.5))
+			if layer == 1:
+				return d < 0.15
+			return (d > 0.3 and d < 0.47) or d < 0.17 or (d < 0.47 and (absf(u - 0.5) < 0.04 or absf(v - 0.5) < 0.04))
+		"beast":   # (a body, a head, legs)
+			var body := pow((u - 0.47) / 0.36, 2) + pow((v - 0.55) / 0.24, 2) < 1.0
+			var head := p.distance_to(Vector2(0.8, 0.35)) < 0.15
+			var legs := v > 0.6 and v < 0.97 and (absf(u - 0.27) < 0.05 or absf(u - 0.42) < 0.05 or absf(u - 0.58) < 0.05 or absf(u - 0.7) < 0.05)
+			if layer == 1:
+				return pow((u - 0.45) / 0.28, 2) + pow((v - 0.45) / 0.12, 2) < 1.0 or p.distance_to(Vector2(0.8, 0.33)) < 0.09
+			return body or head or legs
+		"figure":   # (a head on a robed body)
+			var head := p.distance_to(Vector2(0.5, 0.15)) < 0.12
+			var robe := v > 0.28 and v < 0.98 and absf(u - 0.5) < 0.16 + (v - 0.28) * 0.18
+			return (head or robe) if layer == 0 else head
+		"block":   # (an isometric block: a lit top, two walls)
+			var top := absf(u - 0.5) / 0.5 + absf(v - 0.27) / 0.25 < 1.0
+			var walls := v > 0.27 and v < 0.75 + 0.25 * (1.0 - absf(u - 0.5) / 0.5) and u > 0.0 and u < 1.0
+			return (top or walls) if layer == 0 else top
+		"ring":
+			var d := p.distance_to(Vector2(0.5, 0.5))
+			return (d > 0.32 and d < 0.48) if layer == 0 else (d > 0.39 and d < 0.43)
+		"diamond":
+			var k := absf(u - 0.5) + absf(v - 0.5)
+			return k < 0.48 if layer == 0 else k < 0.2
+		"glow":
+			var d := p.distance_to(Vector2(0.5, 0.5))
+			return d < 0.45 if layer == 0 else d < 0.2
+		"band":
+			return true if layer == 0 else v < 0.35
+	# (anything else: a slab with a lit top edge)
+	return (u > 0.06 and u < 0.94 and v > 0.06 and v < 0.94) if layer == 0 else (u > 0.06 and u < 0.94 and v > 0.06 and v < 0.3)

files.explanation: An engine-level service: Autoload "ProcArt": the game's sprite textures. All art is raster: PNGs cut out of the reference sheets in external/images/ by tools/extract_sprites.py (data/sprites/<key>.png). Godot imports them; at start-up they're loaded on background threads while the loading screen shows its progress, then the Minoan building textures are assembled from the tile pieces. Keys: "ship_<class id>", "ship_player", "station_<design>", "npc_...", "tile_...", "fx_...". (Moved from scripts/proc_art.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,473 @@ 
+extends Node
+## Autoload "ProcArt": the game's sprite textures. All art is raster: PNGs
+## cut out of the reference sheets in external/images/ by tools/extract_sprites.py
+## (data/sprites/<key>.png). Godot imports them; at start-up they're loaded on
+## background threads while the loading screen shows its progress, then the
+## Minoan building textures are assembled from the tile pieces.
+##
+## Keys: "ship_<class id>", "ship_player", "station_<design>", "npc_...",
+## "tile_...", "fx_...".
+
+signal baked
+## Emitted when art was reloaded.
+signal art_changed
+signal progress_changed(value: float, label: String)
+
+const SPRITES := "res://data/sprites/"
+
+var progress := 0.0
+var stage := ""
+var ready_done := false
+## The main scenes the loading screen loaded, kept loaded for the whole game
+## (else they're dropped with the loading screen, and the first landing loads
+## the planet surface's scene again: a 0.4 s freeze as you click Land).
+var scenes := {}
+var scenes_done := true   # (false only while load_scenes is at work)
+
+## The game's scenes still to load after the title screen opened (load_scenes):
+## one after another in the background (parallel loads of scenes sharing
+## dependencies can race).
+var _scene_queue: Array = []
+
+
+## The title screen opens as soon as its own scene is in (the loading screen);
+## the sprites (_load_all, already going) and these scenes come in behind it.
+func load_scenes(paths: Array) -> void:
+	_scene_queue = paths.filter(func(p): return not scenes.has(p))
+	scenes_done = _scene_queue.is_empty()
+	while not _scene_queue.is_empty():
+		var p: String = _scene_queue[0]
+		ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(p, "", false)
+		while true:
+			var st := ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(p)
+			if st == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_LOADED:
+				scenes[p] = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(p)
+				break
+			if st == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_FAILED or st == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE:
+				push_warning("Background load failed, loading normally: " + p)
+				scenes[p] = load(p)
+				break
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+		_scene_queue.pop_front()
+	scenes_done = true
+
+
+## Everything the game needs in (the sprites and the scenes): starting a game,
+## attract mode and Talos wait for it.
+func all_ready() -> bool:
+	return ready_done and scenes_done
+
+
+## Waits until all_ready(); `on_progress` (0..1, stage text) is called each frame meanwhile.
+func wait_ready(on_progress := Callable()) -> void:
+	while not all_ready():
+		if on_progress.is_valid():
+			on_progress.call(overall(), stage if not ready_done else "Loading scenes")
+		await get_tree().process_frame
+
+
+## How far the background loading is (0..1): the sprites most of it.
+func overall() -> float:
+	var art := 1.0 if ready_done else progress
+	return art * 0.9 + (1.0 if scenes_done else 0.0) * 0.1
+var _tex := {}
+var _images := {}
+var _loading := false
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS   # (loading on while the game's paused: menus, the veil)
+	EditorIcons.warm()   # (every GUI icon painted ahead, on worker threads)
+	_load_all()
+
+
+## Quitting: the memory pool emptied while what it points at still exists
+## (its entries - static, holding calls bound to this - outlived it at exit:
+## the game crashed as it closed, a double free).
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	AssetPool.reset()
+
+
+## Every sprite loaded at start-up: [key, path, label].
+func bake_jobs() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	# (ResourceLoader's listing: in an exported game the folder holds the
+	# imported pictures, not the PNGs - DirAccess found next to none there)
+	for f in ResourceLoader.list_directory(SPRITES):
+		if f.ends_with(".png"):
+			var key := f.get_basename()
+			out.append([key, SPRITES + f, _label(key)])
+	return out
+
+
+static func _label(key: String) -> String:
+	if key.begins_with("ship_"):
+		return "Ships: " + key.trim_prefix("ship_").trim_prefix("traced_").replace("_", " ").capitalize()
+	if key.begins_with("station_"):
+		return "Stations: " + key.trim_prefix("station_").replace("_", " ").capitalize()
+	if key.begins_with("monster_"):
+		return "Creatures: " + key.trim_prefix("monster_").replace("_", " ")
+	if key.begins_with("npc_"):
+		return "Citizens: " + key.trim_prefix("npc_minoan_").replace("_", " ")
+	return "Buildings: " + key.trim_prefix("tile_").replace("_", " ")
+
+
+## Sprites being loaded at once (IN_FLIGHT), and the main thread's time a frame for taking
+## them in (making each one's texture): loading all 1000+ at once froze a
+## browser tab for seconds at a time.
+var IN_FLIGHT := 3 if OS.has_feature("web") else 8   # (a browser froze with more at once; a desktop takes them in its stride)
+const TAKE_BUDGET_US := 3000
+
+var _queue: Array = []       # keys still to load, in order
+var _urgent: Array = []      # keys asked for (get_tex) before they're in: first
+var _flight := {}            # key -> path, loading now
+var _ph := {}                # key -> the placeholder handed out for it (ImageTexture), real picture to come
+var _sizes := {}             # key -> Vector2i (data/sprites/sizes.json: tools/sprite_sizes.py)
+var _meta := {}              # key -> sizes.json's row (size, colours, opaque box: PlaceholderArt)
+## Every placeholder drawn (the real pictures load only after: _load_all).
+var placeholders_done := false
+
+
+var _labels := {}
+var _total := 1.0
+
+
+## Every frame (for the whole game - pictures asked for later come in too):
+## a few sprites loading at once, the asked-for ones first; the ones done taken
+## in within the time budget.
+## In a browser: loaded on the main thread, a few a frame within this budget
+## (the threaded loader there handed each texture back to the main thread in
+## stalls of 1-2 s, and took the worker threads a planet's making needs).
+const WEB_BUDGET_US := 8000
+var _web := OS.has_feature("web")
+
+
+## What was built from placeholder images (the ground's pieces and atlases, the
+## buildings' walls, floors and roofs) made again from the real pictures as
+## they come in: checked a few times a second while pictures arrive.
+const REFRESH_EVERY := 0.3
+var _refresh_at := 0.0
+var _refreshed_serial := 0
+
+func _refresh_built() -> void:
+	_refreshed_serial = real_serial
+	pass
+
+
+func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
+	if real_serial != _refreshed_serial and Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0 >= _refresh_at:
+		_refresh_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0 + REFRESH_EVERY
+		_refresh_built()
+	if not placeholders_done or (_queue.is_empty() and _urgent.is_empty() and _flight.is_empty()):
+		return   # (the placeholders all first)
+	if _web:
+		var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		while (not _urgent.is_empty() or not _queue.is_empty()) and Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 < WEB_BUDGET_US:
+			var key: String = _urgent.pop_front() if not _urgent.is_empty() else _queue.pop_front()
+			if _tex.has(key) and not _ph.has(key):
+				continue
+			_queue.erase(key)
+			_take(key, load(path_of(key)))
+			stage = _labels.get(key, key)
+		if _loading:
+			var left := _queue.size() + _urgent.size()
+			progress = 0.9 * (_total - left) / _total
+			progress_changed.emit(progress, stage)
+		return
+	while _flight.size() < IN_FLIGHT and (not _urgent.is_empty() or not _queue.is_empty()):
+		var key: String = _urgent.pop_front() if not _urgent.is_empty() else _queue.pop_front()
+		if _flight.has(key) or (_tex.has(key) and not _ph.has(key)):
+			continue
+		_queue.erase(key)
+		_flight[key] = path_of(key)
+		ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(_flight[key], "Texture2D", false)
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for key in _flight.keys():
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > TAKE_BUDGET_US:
+			break
+		var st := ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(_flight[key])
+		if st == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_LOADED:
+			_take(key, ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(_flight[key]))
+			_flight.erase(key)
+			stage = _labels.get(key, key)
+		elif st == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_FAILED or st == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE:
+			push_warning("Sprite failed to load: " + str(_flight[key]))
+			_flight.erase(key)
+	if _loading:
+		var left := _queue.size() + _urgent.size() + _flight.size()
+		progress = 0.9 * (_total - left) / _total
+		progress_changed.emit(progress, stage)
+
+
+func _load_all() -> void:
+	_loading = true
+	var f := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SPRITES + "sizes.json")
+	var d = JSON.parse_string(f) if f != "" else null
+	var need := 0
+	if d is Dictionary:
+		for k in d:
+			_sizes[k] = Vector2i(int(d[k][0]), int(d[k][1]))
+			_meta[k] = d[k]
+			need += _sizes[k].x * _sizes[k].y * 4
+	# The memory pool's room: twice what's usually loaded (every sprite, the anatomy pictures).
+	AssetPool.set_need(need + AnatomyArt.expected_bytes())
+	var jobs := bake_jobs()
+	var labels := {}
+	for j in jobs:
+		labels[j[0]] = j[2]
+		if not _tex.has(j[0]) or _ph.has(j[0]):
+			_queue.append(j[0])
+	_labels = labels
+	_total = maxf(1.0, jobs.size())
+	# First every sprite's procedural placeholder (PlaceholderArt: a simple shape
+	# in its colours - microseconds each, a few ms a frame), all of them; only
+	# then the real pictures, each replacing its placeholder in place.
+	if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
+		var t0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+		var slice := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		var made := 0
+		for j in jobs:
+			if not _tex.has(j[0]) and _meta.has(j[0]):
+				_placeholder(j[0])
+				made += 1
+			if Time.get_ticks_usec() - slice > PH_BUDGET_US:
+				stage = "procedural placeholders: " + str(j[2])
+				progress_changed.emit(progress, stage)
+				await get_tree().process_frame
+				slice = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		AssetPool.add("placeholders", made * PlaceholderArt.RES * PlaceholderArt.RES * 4, Callable(), Callable(), true,
+			"Procedural placeholders (%d)" % made)
+		AssetPool.note("%d procedural placeholders drawn in %d ms - now the real pictures" % [made, Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0])
+	placeholders_done = true
+	set_process(true)
+	while not _queue.is_empty() or not _urgent.is_empty() or not _flight.is_empty():
+		await get_tree().process_frame
+	stage = "Characters: 3D models"
+	progress_changed.emit(progress, stage)
+	await Stage3D.warm(get_tree())           # (loaded, made, their shaders compiled - unseen)
+	progress = 1.0
+	stage = "Ready"
+	_loading = false
+	ready_done = true
+	baked.emit()
+
+
+## A sprite's texture - always the real picture (one not in yet is loaded now,
+## and fills in a placeholder handed out for it): for anything that reads its
+## pixels or bakes it into something (atlases, tile caches). Drawing it as it
+## is: sprite().
+func get_tex(key: String) -> Texture2D:
+	if _tex.has(key) and not _ph.has(key):
+		AssetPool.touch(key)
+		return _tex[key]
+	var p := path_of(key)
+	if p == "" or not ResourceLoader.exists(p):
+		return null
+	var real: Texture2D = load(p)
+	_take(key, real)
+	return _tex.get(key)
+
+
+## Sprites whose keys start with any of `prefixes` loaded next (a planet
+## about to be landed on: its tiles and creatures).
+func prefetch(prefixes: Array) -> void:
+	# (in the order of `prefixes`: the first ones first)
+	for p in prefixes:
+		var first: Array = []
+		for k in _queue:
+			if str(k).begins_with(p):
+				first.append(k)
+		for k in first:
+			_queue.erase(k)
+			if not k in _urgent:
+				_urgent.append(k)
+		if not _loading:   # (the pool unloaded some: back they come)
+			for k in _labels:
+				if str(k).begins_with(p) and not _tex.has(k) and not k in _urgent and not _flight.has(k):
+					_urgent.append(k)
+
+
+## Waits (frames go on) until every sprite whose key starts with one of
+## `prefixes` is in - loaded first (prefetch): for what must have the real
+## pictures (a planet's surface baking its tiles) without loading them on the
+## spot (a browser froze seconds for a dozen).
+func ensure(prefixes: Array) -> void:
+	prefetch(prefixes)
+	while true:
+		var pending := false
+		for k in _urgent + _flight.keys() + _ph.keys():
+			for p in prefixes:
+				if str(k).begins_with(p):
+					pending = true
+					break
+			if pending:
+				break
+		if not pending:
+			return
+		await get_tree().process_frame
+
+
+## Any sprite starting with one of `prefixes` still to load (not waiting for it).
+func pending(prefixes: Array) -> bool:
+	if _queue.is_empty() and _urgent.is_empty() and _flight.is_empty():
+		return false
+	for k in _queue + _urgent + _flight.keys():
+		for p in prefixes:
+			if str(k).begins_with(p):
+				return true
+	return false
+
+
+## How many sprites are in, of how many (the loading bar).
+func counts() -> Vector2i:
+	return Vector2i(int(_total) - (_queue.size() + _urgent.size() + _flight.size()), int(_total))
+
+
+## A sprite to draw. One not loaded yet comes as a placeholder of its size
+## (a soft, faint shape) and is loaded next; its picture replaces the
+## placeholder in place when it's in (the same texture: whatever holds it shows
+## the real thing from then on) - the game never waits for a picture.
+func sprite(key: String) -> Texture2D:
+	if _tex.has(key):
+		if _ph.has(key):
+			if not key in _urgent and not _flight.has(key):
+				_urgent.append(key)
+		else:
+			AssetPool.touch(key)
+		return _tex[key]
+	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless" or not _meta.has(key) or not ResourceLoader.exists(path_of(key)):
+		return get_tex(key)
+	var ph := _placeholder(key)
+	_urgent.append(key)
+	return ph
+
+
+## A sprite's procedural placeholder (PlaceholderArt), standing in for it at its size.
+const PH_BUDGET_US := 4000
+func _placeholder(key: String) -> ImageTexture:
+	var ph := ImageTexture.create_from_image(PlaceholderArt.make(key, _meta[key]))
+	ph.set_size_override(_sizes[key])
+	_ph[key] = ph
+	_tex[key] = ph
+	return ph
+
+
+## Is its real picture in (not a placeholder)?
+func is_in(key: String) -> bool:
+	return _tex.has(key) and not _ph.has(key)
+
+
+## Counts the real pictures arriving: whatever was built from placeholder
+## images (the ground's tiles, the buildings' walls and floors) is redone when
+## this moves on and its pictures are in (TerrainTiles / MinoanTiles.refresh).
+var real_serial := 0
+var _ph_img := {}            # key -> its placeholder Image at the picture's full size
+
+
+## A sprite as an Image, never waited for: the real one if it's in, else a
+## procedural placeholder at the picture's exact size (PlaceholderArt - the
+## same layout once the real one replaces it), the real one asked for first.
+## Headless (tests, tools): always the real one. -> [Image, is_placeholder].
+func image_now(key: String) -> Array:
+	if is_in(key) or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless" or not _meta.has(key):
+		return [get_image(key), false]
+	if not _ph_img.has(key):
+		var img := PlaceholderArt.make(key, _meta[key])
+		var size: Vector2i = _sizes[key]
+		img.resize(maxi(1, size.x), maxi(1, size.y), Image.INTERPOLATE_NEAREST)
+		_ph_img[key] = img
+	if not key in _urgent and not _flight.has(key):
+		_urgent.append(key)
+	return [_ph_img[key], true]
+
+
+## The real picture in: a placeholder handed out for it takes it on (its RID stays).
+func _take(key: String, tex: Texture2D) -> void:
+	if tex == null:
+		return
+	real_serial += 1
+	_ph_img.erase(key)
+	if _ph.has(key):
+		var img := tex.get_image()
+		if img:
+			(_ph[key] as ImageTexture).set_image(img)
+		_ph.erase(key)
+	else:
+		_tex[key] = tex
+	AssetPool.add(key, tex.get_width() * tex.get_height() * 4, _unload.bind(key), _held.bind(key), false, _labels.get(key, key))
+
+
+## The pool unloads it (it ran out of room): asked for again, it comes back
+## (a placeholder meanwhile).
+func _unload(key: String) -> void:
+	_tex.erase(key)
+
+
+## Something besides ProcArt holds it (a sprite on screen, an atlas): it stays.
+func _held(key: String) -> bool:
+	var t: RefCounted = _tex.get(key)
+	return t != null and t.get_reference_count() > 2   # (the dictionary's and this one's)
+
+
+## The PNG behind a key.
+func path_of(key: String) -> String:
+	return SPRITES + key + ".png"
+
+
+func has_sprite(key: String) -> bool:
+	return ResourceLoader.exists(path_of(key))
+
+
+## A sprite as an Image (for building textures from tile pieces).
+func get_image(key: String) -> Image:
+	if not _images.has(key):
+		var t: Texture2D = get_tex(key)
+		# Headless (tests, tools) has no GPU copy to read back: use the PNG.
+		var img: Image = t.get_image() if t and DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless" else null
+		if img == null and has_sprite(key):
+			# No GPU copy to read back (headless runs): the PNG itself.
+			img = Image.load_from_file(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(path_of(key)))
+		if img:
+			img.decompress()
+			AssetPool.add("image:" + key, img.get_data_size(), func(): _images.erase(key), _image_held.bind(key), false, "Picture data: " + key)
+		_images[key] = img
+	AssetPool.touch("image:" + key)
+	return _images[key]
+
+
+func _image_held(key: String) -> bool:
+	var i: RefCounted = _images.get(key)
+	return i != null and i.get_reference_count() > 2
+
+
+## A ship class's sprite (bosses fly a traced hull).
+func ship_texture(id: String) -> Texture2D:
+	var t := EnemyTypes.get_type(id)
+	if t.has("art") and EnemyTypes.has_type(id):
+		return sprite("ship_" + str(t["art"]))
+	return sprite("ship_" + id)
+
+
+func station_texture(design: String) -> Texture2D:
+	return sprite("station_" + design)
+
+
+## Pixel position of a sprite's anchor (its centre).
+func origin(key: String) -> Vector2:
+	var t := get_tex(key)
+	return t.get_size() / 2.0 if t else Vector2.ZERO
+
+
+## Re-reads every sprite (after tools/extract_sprites.py ran).
+func rebake() -> void:
+	if _loading:
+		return
+	for k in _tex:
+		AssetPool.forget(k)
+	for k in _images:
+		AssetPool.forget("image:" + k)
+	_tex.clear()
+	_images.clear()
+	ready_done = false
+	await _load_all()
+	art_changed.emit()
