+## Explanation bubbles over the code review: each in the empty space beside
+## the code (to the right of short lines, never over code or text), as near
+## its line as there's room, with an arrow to the end of that line (which is
+## outlined). Placed in the text's coordinates, so they scroll with it; laid
+## out again when the viewer is resized. A bubble with no room anywhere near
+## goes at the right edge, over the code, rather than not at all.
+class Bubbles extends Control:
+	const FS := 13
+	const PAD := 10.0
+	const GAP := 36.0              # (from the code to a bubble)
+	const NEAR := 18               # (paragraphs up / down to look for room)
+	var review: RichTextLabel
+	var font: Font                 # (the code's: to measure it)
+	var text_font: Font            # (the bubbles')
+	var placed: Array = []         # [{rect (text coords), para, tip (text coords), text, cramped}]
+	var _code: Dictionary = {}
+	var _points: Array = []
+	var _t := 0.0
+	var _seen := 0                 # (bubbles come in one after another)
+	var _width := -1.0
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		text_font = ThemeDB.fallback_font
+		mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		clip_contents = true
+		review.get_v_scroll_bar().value_changed.connect(func(_v): queue_redraw())
+		review.resized.connect(func():
+			if not _points.is_empty() and absf(review.size.x - _width) > 1.0:
+				_layout())
+		set_process(false)
+
+	func clear() -> void:
+		_code = {}
+		_points = []
+		placed = []
+		set_process(false)
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	func show_points(code: Dictionary, points: Array) -> void:
+		_code = code
+		_points = points
+		placed = []
+		_t = 0.0
+		_seen = 0
+		if points.is_empty():
+			queue_redraw()
+			return
+		_layout.call_deferred()   # (once the text is laid out)
+
+	func _margin() -> Vector2:
+		var sb := review.get_theme_stylebox("normal")
+		return Vector2(sb.get_margin(SIDE_LEFT), sb.get_margin(SIDE_TOP))
+
+	## The paragraph's top and bottom (text coordinates).
+	func _span(p: int) -> Vector2:
+		var top := review.get_paragraph_offset(p)
+		var bot: float = review.get_paragraph_offset(p + 1) if p + 1 < review.get_paragraph_count() else review.get_content_height()
+		return Vector2(top, maxf(bot, top + 1.0))
+
+	## How far right a paragraph's content reaches (inf: text across the width).
+	func _reach(p: int, room: float) -> float:
+		if not _code.has(p):
+			return INF
+		var w := font.get_string_size(_code[p], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, FS).x
+		return w if w < room else INF   # (a wrapped line fills the width)
+
+	func _layout() -> void:
+		placed = []
+		_width = review.size.x
+		if _points.is_empty() or review.get_paragraph_count() == 0:
+			queue_redraw()
+			return
+		var m := _margin()
+		# (the scroll bar only when it shows: hidden - a short file - it can
+		# report the viewer's whole width, which left no room at all)
+		var sb := review.get_v_scroll_bar()
+		var sbw := sb.size.x if sb.visible else 0.0
+		var right := review.size.x - m.x - sbw - 6.0   # (text coords)
+		var room := review.size.x - 2.0 * m.x - sbw
+		var count := review.get_paragraph_count()
+		for pt in _points:
+			var para: int = pt[0]
+			if para >= count:
+				continue
+			var line := _span(para)
+			var tip := Vector2(minf(_reach(para, room), right - 40.0) + 8.0, (line.x + line.y) / 2.0)
+			var best := {}
+			var best_score := INF
+			for w in [380.0, 320.0, 260.0, 210.0]:
+				w = minf(w, right - 60.0)
+				if w < 150.0:
+					break
+				var h := text_font.get_multiline_string_size(pt[1], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, w - 2.0 * PAD, FS).y + 2.0 * PAD
+				for d in range(-NEAR, NEAR + 1):
+					var top := _span(clampi(para + d, 0, count - 1)).x
+					if para + d >= count:
+						top = review.get_content_height() + (para + d - count) * 18.0
+					elif para + d < 0:
+						continue
+					# Everything beside the bubble must end left of it.
+					var reach := 0.0
+					var q := clampi(para + d, 0, count - 1)
+					while q < count and _span(q).x < top + h:
+						reach = maxf(reach, _reach(q, room))
+						q += 1
+					var x := reach + GAP
+					if x + w > right:
+						continue
+					var r := Rect2(x, top, w, h)
+					if _hits(r):
+						continue
+					var score: float = absf(r.get_center().y - tip.y) + (x - tip.x) * 0.15 + (380.0 - w) * 0.3
+					if score < best_score:
+						best_score = score
+						best = {"rect": r, "para": para, "tip": tip, "text": pt[1], "cramped": false}
+			if best.is_empty():   # (no room near it: at the right edge, over the code)
+				var w2 := maxf(150.0, minf(300.0, right - 20.0))
+				var h2 := text_font.get_multiline_string_size(pt[1], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, w2 - 2.0 * PAD, FS).y + 2.0 * PAD
+				best = {"rect": Rect2(right - w2, tip.y + 14.0, w2, h2), "para": para, "tip": tip, "text": pt[1], "cramped": true}
+			placed.append(best)
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	func _hits(r: Rect2) -> bool:
+		for b in placed:
+			if (b["rect"] as Rect2).grow(8.0).intersects(r):
+				return true
+		return false
+
+	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+		_t += delta
+		queue_redraw()
+		var busy := false
+		for b in placed:
+			busy = busy or (b.has("since") and _t - float(b["since"]) < 0.5)
+		if not busy:
+			set_process(false)
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		if placed.is_empty():
+			return
+		var off := _margin() - Vector2(0, review.get_v_scroll_bar().value)
+		_seen = 0
+		var gold := Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.35)
+		for i in placed.size():
+			var b: Dictionary = placed[i]
+			var r: Rect2 = (b["rect"] as Rect2)
+			r.position += off
+			if r.end.y < 0.0 or r.position.y > size.y:
+				continue
+			if not b.has("since"):   # (each fades in when it first comes into view)
+				b["since"] = _t + 0.15 * _seen
+				_seen += 1
+				set_process(true)
+			var a := clampf((_t - float(b["since"])) / 0.35, 0.0, 1.0)
+			if a <= 0.0:
+				continue
+			r.position.y += (1.0 - a) * 8.0
+			var tip: Vector2 = b["tip"] + off
+			# The line it's about, outlined.
+			var line: Vector2 = _span(b["para"])
+			draw_rect(Rect2(off.x - 4.0, line.x + off.y - 1.0, tip.x - off.x - 2.0, line.y - line.x + 1.0), Color(gold, 0.55 * a), false, 1.5)
+			# The arrow: from the bubble's side, bowing, to the line's end.
+			var from := Vector2(r.position.x, clampf(tip.y, r.position.y + 12.0, r.end.y - 12.0))
+			if b["cramped"]:
+				from = Vector2(clampf(tip.x + 30.0, r.position.x + 12.0, r.end.x - 12.0), r.position.y)
+			var mid := (from + tip) / 2.0 + Vector2(0, -18.0 if from.y <= tip.y else 18.0) * clampf(absf(from.x - tip.x) / 200.0, 0.2, 1.0)
+			var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+			for k in 17:
+				var u := k / 16.0
+				pts.append(from.lerp(mid, u).lerp(mid.lerp(tip, u), u))
+			draw_polyline(pts, Color(gold, a), 2.0, true)
+			var dir := (tip - pts[14]).normalized()
+			var side := Vector2(-dir.y, dir.x)
+			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([tip, tip - dir * 10.0 + side * 5.0, tip - dir * 10.0 - side * 5.0]), Color(gold, a))
+			# The bubble.
+			var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+			sb.bg_color = Color(0.1, 0.13, 0.22, 0.96 * a)
+			sb.border_color = Color(gold, a)
+			sb.set_border_width_all(2)
+			sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
+			sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45 * a)
+			sb.shadow_size = 6
+			draw_style_box(sb, r)
+			draw_multiline_string(text_font, r.position + Vector2(PAD, PAD + text_font.get_ascent(FS)), b["text"], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, r.size.x - 2.0 * PAD, FS, -1, Color(0.93, 0.95, 1.0, a))
hunks.title: The new patcher.gd
hunks.note: Versions - the Patcher (Talos > Versions, F7.

bubbles.text: Where Versions opens: the newest version (or patch) - its infographic, never the unpublished changes' code review.

The code review: the changed files (with how many lines were added and removed) and, for the chosen file, what changed and why, hunk by hunk, with the diff itself (+ added in green, - removed in red).
A size that fits `box` (small images grow up to 2x, big ones shrink).
Every asset of the change together: pictures as thumbnails with their names; sounds and fonts listed (pick one to play / see it).

files.explanation: Talos, the game's editor: A property inspector for procedural assets (planets, suns, nebulae in the zoo). It builds itself from a generator's PROPERTIES list: [key, label, type, min, max, help, modes] or ["#", "Group title"] Types: float, int, color, vec2, vec3, enum:<a>,<b>,... `modes` ([] = always) hides properties that don't apply to the asset's current mode (e.g. ocean settings on a gas giant). Every edit emits changed(key, value) immediately (live preview). The header picks the template and variant and has reset / randomise / copy / close. (Moved from scripts/property_panel.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,429 @@ 
+class_name PropertyPanel
+extends PanelContainer
+## A property inspector for procedural assets (planets, suns, nebulae in the
+## zoo). It builds itself from a generator's PROPERTIES list:
+##   [key, label, type, min, max, help, modes]   or   ["#", "Group title"]
+## Types: float, int, color, vec2, vec3, enum:<a>,<b>,...
+## `modes` ([] = always) hides properties that don't apply to the asset's
+## current mode (e.g. ocean settings on a gas giant).
+## Every edit emits changed(key, value) immediately (live preview). The header
+## picks the template and variant and has reset / randomise / copy / close.
+
+signal changed(key: String, value: Variant)
+signal template_changed(template: String)
+signal variant_changed(variant: int)
+signal reset_requested
+signal randomize_requested
+signal closed
+signal undo_requested
+signal redo_requested
+signal paste_requested
+signal apply_all_requested
+signal preset_load(name: String)
+signal preset_save(name: String, rules: Dictionary)
+signal preset_delete(name: String)
+
+const ACCENT := Color(0.4, 0.95, 0.75)
+const LABEL_W := 150.0
+
+var _title: Label
+var _sub: Label
+var _templates: OptionButton
+var _variant: SpinBox
+var _rows: VBoxContainer
+var _scroll: ScrollContainer
+var _schema: Array = []
+var _get: Callable                  # key -> current value
+var _mode_key := ""
+var _editors := {}                  # key -> callable(value) that updates its controls
+var _template_ids: Array = []
+var _presets: OptionButton
+var _preset_name: LineEdit
+var _rules_box: VBoxContainer
+var _rules := {}                     # the rules being edited (Themes.RULE_DEFAULTS keys)
+var _rule_opts := {}                 # rule key -> [[id, label], ...] (choices for list rules)
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	var st: NeonBox = UI.panel_style(Color(ACCENT, 0.7))
+	st.bg_color = Color(st.bg_color, 0.97)   # opaque: the room's signs don't show through
+	add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", st)
+	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(440, 0)
+	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	add_child(v)
+	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
+	v.add_child(head)
+	_title = UI.label("", 20, ACCENT)
+	_title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_title.clip_text = true
+	head.add_child(_title)
+	head.add_child(_icon("duplicate", "Copy properties", "", "Copies every property of this asset to the clipboard (Godot's text\nformat: paste it into a template in the generator's script to keep it).", _copy))
+	head.add_child(_icon("close", "Close the panel", "Esc", "Closes the property panel. Your edits stay on the exhibit until you\nleave the room or reset it.", func(): closed.emit()))
+	_sub = UI.label("", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	_sub.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	v.add_child(_sub)
+	var tv := HBoxContainer.new()
+	tv.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	v.add_child(tv)
+	_templates = OptionButton.new()
+	_templates.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_templates.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Template", "", "The template this asset starts from. Picking another regenerates it\nfrom that template (with the variant number on the right).")
+	_templates.item_selected.connect(func(i): template_changed.emit(_template_ids[i]))
+	tv.add_child(_templates)
+	_variant = SpinBox.new()
+	_variant.min_value = 0
+	_variant.max_value = 99999
+	_variant.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(110, 0)
+	_variant.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Variant", "", "0 is the template itself; every other number mixes in features of the\nother templates and shifts the colours - each one different.")
+	_variant.value_changed.connect(func(x): variant_changed.emit(int(x)))
+	tv.add_child(_variant)
+	tv.add_child(_icon("next", "Random variant", "", "Regenerates the asset as a random variant of its template.", func(): randomize_requested.emit()))
+	tv.add_child(_icon("reload", "Reset", "", "Throws away your edits: back to the asset as it was in the room.", func(): reset_requested.emit()))
+	# Editing tools.
+	var tools := HBoxContainer.new()
+	tools.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	v.add_child(tools)
+	tools.add_child(_icon("undo", "Undo", "Ctrl+Z", "Takes back the last property change (as many steps as you like).", func(): undo_requested.emit()))
+	tools.add_child(_icon("redo", "Redo", "Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z", "Puts back a change you undid.", func(): redo_requested.emit()))
+	tools.add_child(_icon("paste", "Paste properties", "Ctrl+V", "Pastes properties copied from another asset of the same kind\n(Copy at the top): colours, sliders and all.", func(): paste_requested.emit()))
+	tools.add_child(_icon("apply", "Apply to all similar", "", "Gives every exhibit of this kind in the room this exact look\n(e.g. dress every character in this theme).", func(): apply_all_requested.emit()))
+	var sp := Control.new()
+	sp.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	tools.add_child(sp)
+	var rules_toggle := Button.new()
+	rules_toggle.text = "Where and when..."
+	rules_toggle.toggle_mode = true
+	rules_toggle.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	rules_toggle.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Where and when it's used", "", "Shows the rules saved with a preset: which star systems, empires'\nsectors, planets, system conditions, story chapters and allegiances\nthe game uses this look in, how often, and its priority.")
+	rules_toggle.toggled.connect(func(on): _rules_box.visible = on)
+	tools.add_child(rules_toggle)
+	# Named presets.
+	var pr := HBoxContainer.new()
+	pr.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	v.add_child(pr)
+	_presets = OptionButton.new()
+	_presets.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_presets.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Saved presets", "", "Your named looks for this kind of asset (data/themes.json).\nPick one to load it onto the selected exhibit, with its rules.")
+	_presets.item_selected.connect(func(i):
+		if i > 0:
+			_preset_name.text = _presets.get_item_text(i)
+			preset_load.emit(_presets.get_item_text(i)))
+	pr.add_child(_presets)
+	_preset_name = LineEdit.new()
+	_preset_name.placeholder_text = "preset name"
+	_preset_name.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(130, 0)
+	_preset_name.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Preset name", "", "The name to save this look under. Saving with an existing name replaces it.")
+	pr.add_child(_preset_name)
+	pr.add_child(_icon("save", "Save preset", "Ctrl+S", "Saves the current look and its rules (Where and when...) as a named\npreset: the game then uses it wherever its rules match.", func():
+		if _preset_name.text.strip_edges() != "":
+			preset_save.emit(_preset_name.text.strip_edges(), _rules.duplicate(true))))
+	pr.add_child(_icon("delete", "Delete preset", "", "Deletes the preset named in the box (the exhibit keeps its look).", func():
+		if _preset_name.text.strip_edges() != "":
+			preset_delete.emit(_preset_name.text.strip_edges())))
+	_rules_box = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_rules_box.visible = false
+	v.add_child(_rules_box)
+	_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
+	_scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
+	v.add_child(_scroll)
+	_rows = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_rows.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_rows.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	_scroll.add_child(_rows)
+
+
+func _icon(icon: String, title: String, keys: String, body: String, cb: Callable) -> Button:
+	var b := UI.button("", cb, 16)
+	EditorIcons.dress(b, icon, EditorIcons.tip(title, keys, body))
+	b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	return b
+
+
+## Shows an asset: its title and description, the template list (ids and
+## names, the current one), its variant, its schema and a getter for values.
+## `mode_key`: the property whose value filters the rows by their modes.
+func edit(title: String, sub: String, templates: Array, names: Array, template: String, variant: int,
+		schema: Array, getter: Callable, mode_key := "") -> void:
+	_title.text = title
+	_sub.text = sub
+	_template_ids = templates
+	_templates.clear()
+	for i in templates.size():
+		_templates.add_item(names[i])
+	_templates.select(maxi(templates.find(template), 0))
+	_variant.set_value_no_signal(variant)
+	_schema = schema
+	_get = getter
+	_mode_key = mode_key
+	rebuild()
+
+
+## The saved presets' names for the asset's kind.
+func set_presets(names: Array, current := "") -> void:
+	_presets.clear()
+	_presets.add_item("- saved presets (%d) -" % names.size())
+	for n in names:
+		_presets.add_item(n)
+	var i := names.find(current)
+	_presets.select(i + 1 if i >= 0 else 0)
+
+
+## Shows and edits a preset's rules. `options`: rule key -> [[id, label], ...]
+## for the list rules (systems, owners, planets, states, templates, friends).
+func set_rules(rules: Dictionary, options: Dictionary) -> void:
+	_rules = Themes.RULE_DEFAULTS.duplicate(true)
+	_rules.merge(rules, true)
+	_rule_opts = options
+	for c in _rules_box.get_children():
+		c.queue_free()
+	var head := UI.label("WHERE AND WHEN THE GAME USES THIS LOOK (saved with the preset)", 13, ACCENT)
+	head.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	_rules_box.add_child(head)
+	var en := CheckBox.new()
+	en.text = "Enabled"
+	en.button_pressed = bool(_rules["enabled"])
+	en.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Enabled", "", "Off: the preset is kept but the game never picks it.")
+	en.toggled.connect(func(on): _rules["enabled"] = on)
+	_rules_box.add_child(en)
+	for k in [["systems", "Star systems"], ["owners", "Empires' sectors"], ["planets", "Planets"], ["states", "System conditions"],
+			["templates", "Templates"], ["friends", "Empires that like you (Friendly+)"]]:
+		if options.has(k[0]):
+			_rules_box.add_child(_list_rule(k[0], k[1]))
+	for k in [["chapter_min", "From chapter", "The first main-story stage it appears in (-1: from the start)."],
+			["chapter_max", "Until chapter", "The last main-story stage it appears in (-1: forever)."],
+			["priority", "Priority", "When several presets match, the highest priority wins (ties: shared out)."]]:
+		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+		var l := UI.label(k[1], 14)
+		l.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(LABEL_W, 0)
+		row.add_child(l)
+		var sb := SpinBox.new()
+		sb.min_value = -1 if k[0] != "priority" else -100
+		sb.max_value = 100
+		sb.value = float(_rules[k[0]])
+		sb.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		sb.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip(k[1], "", k[2])
+		var key: String = k[0]
+		sb.value_changed.connect(func(x): _rules[key] = int(x))
+		row.add_child(sb)
+		_rules_box.add_child(row)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	var cl := UI.label("Chance", 14)
+	cl.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(LABEL_W, 0)
+	row.add_child(cl)
+	var s := _slider(0.0, 1.0, false, float(_rules["chance"]), EditorIcons.tip("Chance", "", "How often the game uses it where it matches (1: always; 0.3: three in ten)."))
+	row.add_child(s[0])
+	row.add_child(s[1])
+	s[0].value_changed.connect(func(x): _rules["chance"] = x)
+	_rules_box.add_child(row)
+
+
+## A rule that is a list of allowed ids: a drop-down of check items.
+func _list_rule(key: String, title: String) -> Control:
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	var l := UI.label(title, 14)
+	l.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(LABEL_W, 0)
+	row.add_child(l)
+	var mb := MenuButton.new()
+	mb.flat = false
+	mb.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	mb.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip(title, "", "Tick where it may appear. Nothing ticked: anywhere.")
+	var pm := mb.get_popup()
+	pm.hide_on_checkable_item_selection = false
+	var opts: Array = _rule_opts[key]
+	var sel: Array = _rules[key]
+	for i in opts.size():
+		pm.add_check_item(opts[i][1], i)
+		pm.set_item_checked(i, sel.has(opts[i][0]))
+	var refresh := func():
+		var picked: Array = _rules[key]
+		mb.text = "Any" if picked.is_empty() else ", ".join(opts.filter(func(o): return picked.has(o[0])).map(func(o): return o[1]))
+	pm.id_pressed.connect(func(i):
+		pm.set_item_checked(i, not pm.is_item_checked(i))
+		var picked := []
+		for j in opts.size():
+			if pm.is_item_checked(j):
+				picked.append(opts[j][0])
+		_rules[key] = picked
+		refresh.call())
+	refresh.call()
+	row.add_child(mb)
+	return row
+
+
+func preset_name() -> String:
+	return _preset_name.text.strip_edges()
+
+
+func notify(text: String) -> void:
+	_sub.text = text
+
+
+## Rebuilds the rows (after the mode changed: other properties apply).
+func rebuild() -> void:
+	var keep := _scroll.scroll_vertical
+	for c in _rows.get_children():
+		c.queue_free()
+	_editors = {}
+	var mode = _get.call(_mode_key) if _mode_key != "" else null
+	var header: Control = null
+	var in_group := 0
+	for d in _schema:
+		if d[0] == "#":
+			if header and in_group == 0:
+				header.queue_free()   # (a group with nothing that applies)
+			header = UI.label(str(d[1]).to_upper(), 15, ACCENT)
+			header.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 0)
+			var m := MarginContainer.new()
+			m.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 8)
+			m.add_child(header)
+			header = m
+			_rows.add_child(m)
+			in_group = 0
+			continue
+		var modes: Array = d[6] if d.size() > 6 else []
+		if mode != null and not modes.is_empty() and not modes.has(int(mode)):
+			continue
+		_rows.add_child(_row(d))
+		in_group += 1
+	if header and in_group == 0:
+		header.queue_free()
+	await get_tree().process_frame
+	_scroll.scroll_vertical = keep
+
+
+## Number of property rows currently shown.
+func row_count() -> int:
+	return _editors.size()
+
+
+## Sets a property's controls (without emitting).
+func show_value(key: String, value: Variant) -> void:
+	if _editors.has(key):
+		_editors[key].call(value)
+
+
+func _tip(d: Array) -> String:
+	var t: String = d[2]
+	var body: String = d[5]
+	if t in ["float", "int", "vec2", "vec3"]:
+		body += "\nRange: %s to %s." % [str(d[3]), str(d[4])]
+	return EditorIcons.tip(d[1], "", body + "\nChanges show at once on the exhibit.")
+
+
+func _row(d: Array) -> Control:
+	var key: String = d[0]
+	var type: String = d[2]
+	var value = _get.call(key)
+	if value == null:
+		value = _fallback(d)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	var name_l := UI.label(d[1], 14)
+	name_l.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(LABEL_W, 0)
+	name_l.tooltip_text = _tip(d)
+	name_l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
+	row.add_child(name_l)
+	if type.begins_with("enum:"):
+		var ob := OptionButton.new()
+		for o in type.substr(5).split(","):
+			ob.add_item(o)
+		ob.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		ob.select(int(value))
+		ob.tooltip_text = _tip(d)
+		ob.item_selected.connect(func(i): changed.emit(key, i))
+		row.add_child(ob)
+		_editors[key] = func(x): ob.select(int(x))
+	elif type == "color":
+		var cp := ColorPickerButton.new()
+		cp.edit_alpha = false
+		cp.color = value if value is Color else Color.WHITE
+		cp.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		cp.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 26)
+		cp.tooltip_text = _tip(d)
+		cp.color_changed.connect(func(c): changed.emit(key, c))
+		row.add_child(cp)
+		_editors[key] = func(x): cp.color = x
+	elif type == "vec2" or type == "vec3":
+		var n := 2 if type == "vec2" else 3
+		var col := VBoxContainer.new()
+		col.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		row.add_child(col)
+		var sliders := []
+		var cur: Array = [value.x, value.y] if n == 2 else [value.x, value.y, value.z]
+		for i in n:
+			var sub := HBoxContainer.new()
+			sub.add_child(UI.label("xyz"[i], 13, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+			var s := _slider(float(d[3]), float(d[4]), false, cur[i], _tip(d))
+			sub.add_child(s[0])
+			sub.add_child(s[1])
+			col.add_child(sub)
+			sliders.append(s)
+		var emit_vec := func():
+			var vals := sliders.map(func(s): return float(s[0].value))
+			changed.emit(key, Vector2(vals[0], vals[1]) if n == 2 else Vector3(vals[0], vals[1], vals[2]))
+		for s in sliders:
+			s[0].value_changed.connect(func(_x): emit_vec.call())
+		_editors[key] = func(x):
+			var arr: Array = [x.x, x.y] if n == 2 else [x.x, x.y, x.z]
+			for i in n:
+				sliders[i][0].set_value_no_signal(arr[i])
+				sliders[i][1].set_value_no_signal(arr[i])
+	else:
+		var is_int := type == "int"
+		var s := _slider(float(d[3]), float(d[4]), is_int, float(value), _tip(d))
+		row.add_child(s[0])
+		row.add_child(s[1])
+		s[0].value_changed.connect(func(x): changed.emit(key, int(x) if is_int else x))
+		_editors[key] = func(x):
+			s[0].set_value_no_signal(float(x))
+			s[1].set_value_no_signal(float(x))
+	return row
+
+
+## A value for a property nobody has set (and no shader default known).
+func _fallback(d: Array) -> Variant:
+	match str(d[2]):
+		"color": return Color.WHITE
+		"vec2": return Vector2(float(d[3]), float(d[3])).lerp(Vector2(float(d[4]), float(d[4])), 0.5)
+		"vec3": return Vector3(0, 0, 1)
+		"int": return int(d[3])
+	if str(d[2]).begins_with("enum:"):
+		return 0
+	return clampf(0.0, float(d[3]), float(d[4]))
+
+
+## A slider and a number box kept in step: [HSlider, SpinBox].
+func _slider(lo: float, hi: float, is_int: bool, value: float, tip: String) -> Array:
+	var step := 1.0 if is_int else maxf((hi - lo) / 400.0, 0.0001)
+	var sl := HSlider.new()
+	sl.min_value = lo
+	sl.max_value = hi
+	sl.step = step
+	sl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	sl.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	sl.tooltip_text = tip
+	sl.value = value
+	var sp := SpinBox.new()
+	sp.min_value = lo
+	sp.max_value = hi
+	sp.step = step
+	sp.allow_greater = true
+	sp.allow_lesser = true
+	sp.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(84, 0)
+	sp.tooltip_text = tip
+	sp.value = value
+	sl.value_changed.connect(func(x): sp.set_value_no_signal(x))
+	sp.value_changed.connect(func(x): sl.value = x)
+	return [sl, sp]
+
+
+func _copy() -> void:
+	var out := {}
+	for d in _schema:
+		if d[0] != "#":
+			out[d[0]] = _get.call(d[0])
+	DisplayServer.clipboard_set(var_to_str(out))
+	_sub.text = "Copied %d properties to the clipboard." % out.size()

files.explanation: Talos, the game's editor: The SVG Editor's document: a page (width x height) and a list of shapes, bottom to top. Shapes are dictionaries: common: type, name, fill (Color or null = none), stroke (Color or null), stroke_width, opacity, xf (Transform2D: shape -> page), hidden, locked rect: x, y, w, h, r (corner radius) ellipse: cx, cy, rx, ry star: cx, cy, r1, r2 (inner), n (corners), star (bool), angle text: x, y (baseline start), text, size, bold path: subs: [{nodes: [{p, i, o, s}], closed}] - p the node, i / o its in / out handles (equal to p = a sharp, straight join), s smooth Writes and reads SVG (rect, circle, ellipse, line, polyline, polygon, path, text, g with transforms, fill / stroke / opacity attributes and styles). Rendering uses Godot's SVG rasteriser (Image.load_svg_from_string); text is drawn as glyph outlines since the rasteriser has no text. (Moved from scripts/svg_doc.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,691 @@ 
+class_name SvgDoc
+extends RefCounted
+## The SVG Editor's document: a page (width x height) and a list of shapes,
+## bottom to top. Shapes are dictionaries:
+##   common: type, name, fill (Color or null = none), stroke (Color or null),
+##           stroke_width, opacity, xf (Transform2D: shape -> page), hidden, locked
+##   rect:    x, y, w, h, r (corner radius)
+##   ellipse: cx, cy, rx, ry
+##   star:    cx, cy, r1, r2 (inner), n (corners), star (bool), angle
+##   text:    x, y (baseline start), text, size, bold
+##   path:    subs: [{nodes: [{p, i, o, s}], closed}] - p the node, i / o its
+##            in / out handles (equal to p = a sharp, straight join), s smooth
+## Writes and reads SVG (rect, circle, ellipse, line, polyline, polygon, path,
+## text, g with transforms, fill / stroke / opacity attributes and styles).
+## Rendering uses Godot's SVG rasteriser (Image.load_svg_from_string); text
+## is drawn as glyph outlines since the rasteriser has no text.
+
+var width := 800.0
+var height := 600.0
+var background: Variant = null     # page colour in exports (null: transparent)
+var shapes: Array = []
+
+const FONT_SIZE := 48.0
+
+
+static func new_shape(type: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var sh := {"type": type, "name": "", "fill": Color(0.35, 0.6, 0.95), "stroke": Color(0.08, 0.1, 0.16),
+		"stroke_width": 2.0, "opacity": 1.0, "xf": Transform2D.IDENTITY, "hidden": false, "locked": false}
+	match type:
+		"rect": sh.merge({"x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "w": 10.0, "h": 10.0, "r": 0.0}, true)
+		"ellipse": sh.merge({"cx": 0.0, "cy": 0.0, "rx": 5.0, "ry": 5.0}, true)
+		"star": sh.merge({"cx": 0.0, "cy": 0.0, "r1": 10.0, "r2": 5.0, "n": 5, "star": true, "angle": -PI / 2.0}, true)
+		"text": sh.merge({"x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "text": "Text", "size": FONT_SIZE, "bold": false, "stroke": null}, true)
+		"path": sh.merge({"subs": []}, true)
+	return sh
+
+
+static func node(p: Vector2, i = null, o = null, smooth := false) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"p": p, "i": p if i == null else i, "o": p if o == null else o, "s": smooth}
+
+
+# --- Geometry --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The shape as path subpaths in its own coordinates (rects, ellipses, stars
+## and text converted).
+static func to_subs(sh: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	match sh["type"]:
+		"path":
+			return sh["subs"]
+		"rect":
+			var x: float = sh["x"]
+			var y: float = sh["y"]
+			var w: float = sh["w"]
+			var h: float = sh["h"]
+			var r: float = clampf(sh.get("r", 0.0), 0.0, minf(absf(w), absf(h)) / 2.0)
+			if r <= 0.01:
+				return [{"closed": true, "nodes": [node(Vector2(x, y)), node(Vector2(x + w, y)), node(Vector2(x + w, y + h)), node(Vector2(x, y + h))]}]
+			var k := r * 0.5523
+			var ns := []
+			for c in [[Vector2(x + r, y), Vector2(x + w - r, y), Vector2(1, 0)], [Vector2(x + w, y + r), Vector2(x + w, y + h - r), Vector2(0, 1)],
+					[Vector2(x + w - r, y + h), Vector2(x + r, y + h), Vector2(-1, 0)], [Vector2(x, y + h - r), Vector2(x, y + r), Vector2(0, -1)]]:
+				var d: Vector2 = c[2]
+				ns.append(node(c[0], c[0] - d * k, c[0]))
+				ns.append(node(c[1], c[1], c[1] + d * k))
+			return [{"closed": true, "nodes": ns}]
+		"ellipse":
+			var c := Vector2(sh["cx"], sh["cy"])
+			var rx: float = sh["rx"]
+			var ry: float = sh["ry"]
+			var kx := rx * 0.5523
+			var ky := ry * 0.5523
+			return [{"closed": true, "nodes": [
+				node(c + Vector2(rx, 0), c + Vector2(rx, -ky), c + Vector2(rx, ky), true),
+				node(c + Vector2(0, ry), c + Vector2(kx, ry), c + Vector2(-kx, ry), true),
+				node(c + Vector2(-rx, 0), c + Vector2(-rx, ky), c + Vector2(-rx, -ky), true),
+				node(c + Vector2(0, -ry), c + Vector2(-kx, -ry), c + Vector2(kx, -ry), true)]}]
+		"star":
+			var c := Vector2(sh["cx"], sh["cy"])
+			var n: int = maxi(3, int(sh["n"]))
+			var ns := []
+			var steps := n * 2 if sh["star"] else n
+			for i in steps:
+				var a: float = float(sh["angle"]) + TAU * i / steps
+				var r: float = sh["r1"] if (i % 2 == 0 or not sh["star"]) else sh["r2"]
+				ns.append(node(c + Vector2.from_angle(a) * r))
+			return [{"closed": true, "nodes": ns}]
+		"text":
+			return text_subs(sh)
+	return []
+
+
+## Text as glyph outlines (the default font), baseline at (x, y).
+static func text_subs(sh: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var ts := TextServerManager.get_primary_interface()
+	var font: Font = ThemeDB.fallback_font
+	var size := int(maxf(1.0, float(sh["size"])))
+	var rid := ts.create_shaped_text()
+	ts.shaped_text_add_string(rid, str(sh["text"]), font.get_rids(), size)
+	var out := []
+	var pen := Vector2(sh["x"], sh["y"])
+	for g in ts.shaped_text_get_glyphs(rid):
+		var c: Dictionary = ts.font_get_glyph_contours(g["font_rid"], size, g["index"])
+		if not c.is_empty():
+			var at: Vector2 = pen + g["offset"]
+			var start := 0
+			for end in c["contours"]:
+				var sub := _contour(c["points"], start, end, at)
+				if sub.size() > 1:
+					out.append({"closed": true, "nodes": sub})
+				start = end + 1
+		pen.x += float(g["advance"]) * int(g["repeat"])
+	ts.free_rid(rid)
+	if sh.get("bold", false):
+		pass   # (bold is drawn with a stroke in the fill colour, see style)
+	return out
+
+
+## One TrueType / CFF contour (on, conic and cubic points) as path nodes.
+static func _contour(pts: PackedVector3Array, a: int, b: int, at: Vector2) -> Array:
+	var raw := []
+	for k in range(a, b + 1):
+		raw.append([Vector2(pts[k].x, pts[k].y) + at, int(pts[k].z)])
+	if raw.is_empty():
+		return []
+	# Start at an on-curve point (or the midpoint of two conic ones).
+	var first := -1
+	for k in raw.size():
+		if raw[k][1] == 1:
+			first = k
+			break
+	if first == -1:
+		raw.insert(0, [(raw[0][0] + raw[-1][0]) / 2.0, 1])
+		first = 0
+	raw = raw.slice(first) + raw.slice(0, first)
+	var nodes := [node(raw[0][0])]
+	var k := 1
+	var n := raw.size()
+	while k <= n:
+		var cur: Array = raw[k % n]
+		if cur[1] == 1:
+			nodes.append(node(cur[0]))
+			k += 1
+		elif cur[1] == 0:   # conic: implied on-points between consecutive conics
+			var nxt: Array = raw[(k + 1) % n]
+			var end: Vector2 = nxt[0] if nxt[1] == 1 else (cur[0] + nxt[0]) / 2.0
+			var p0: Vector2 = nodes[-1]["p"]
+			nodes[-1]["o"] = p0 + (cur[0] - p0) * 2.0 / 3.0
+			nodes.append(node(end, end + (cur[0] - end) * 2.0 / 3.0))
+			k += 2 if nxt[1] == 1 else 1
+		else:               # cubic: two control points then an on-point
+			var c2: Array = raw[(k + 1) % n]
+			var e: Array = raw[(k + 2) % n]
+			nodes[-1]["o"] = cur[0]
+			nodes.append(node(e[0], c2[0]))
+			k += 3
+	# The last node repeats the first (closed): merge it.
+	if nodes.size() > 1 and (nodes[-1]["p"] as Vector2).is_equal_approx(nodes[0]["p"]):
+		nodes[0]["i"] = nodes[-1]["i"]
+		nodes.pop_back()
+	return nodes
+
+
+## Points along a cubic segment.
+static func flatten_seg(p0: Vector2, c0: Vector2, c1: Vector2, p1: Vector2, out: PackedVector2Array, tol := 1.0) -> void:
+	if c0.is_equal_approx(p0) and c1.is_equal_approx(p1):
+		out.append(p1)
+		return
+	var l := p0.distance_to(c0) + c0.distance_to(c1) + c1.distance_to(p1)
+	var steps := clampi(int(l / maxf(tol * 4.0, 0.5)), 4, 96)
+	for s in range(1, steps + 1):
+		var t := float(s) / steps
+		var u := 1.0 - t
+		out.append(p0 * u * u * u + c0 * 3.0 * u * u * t + c1 * 3.0 * u * t * t + p1 * t * t * t)
+
+
+## Polylines of a shape in page coordinates ([PackedVector2Array, closed]).
+static func polylines(sh: Dictionary, tol := 1.0) -> Array:
+	var xf: Transform2D = sh["xf"]
+	var out := []
+	for sub in to_subs(sh):
+		var ns: Array = sub["nodes"]
+		if ns.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var pts := PackedVector2Array([ns[0]["p"]])
+		for k in range(1, ns.size()):
+			flatten_seg(ns[k - 1]["p"], ns[k - 1]["o"], ns[k]["i"], ns[k]["p"], pts, tol)
+		if sub["closed"] and ns.size() > 1:
+			flatten_seg(ns[-1]["p"], ns[-1]["o"], ns[0]["i"], ns[0]["p"], pts, tol)
+		out.append([xf * pts, bool(sub["closed"])])
+	return out
+
+
+## Bounding box in page coordinates (Rect2() for empty shapes).
+static func bounds(sh: Dictionary) -> Rect2:
+	var r := Rect2()
+	var first := true
+	for pl in polylines(sh, 2.0):
+		for p in pl[0]:
+			if first:
+				r = Rect2(p, Vector2.ZERO)
+				first = false
+			else:
+				r = r.expand(p)
+	return r
+
+
+## True if the page point hits the shape (inside its fill, or on its stroke
+## within `slop` page units).
+static func hit(sh: Dictionary, p: Vector2, slop: float) -> bool:
+	if sh.get("hidden", false):
+		return false
+	var b := bounds(sh).grow(slop + float(sh.get("stroke_width", 0.0)))
+	if not b.has_point(p):
+		return false
+	var inside := 0
+	var reach := slop + (float(sh["stroke_width"]) / 2.0 if sh.get("stroke") != null else 0.0)
+	for pl in polylines(sh, 1.5):
+		var pts: PackedVector2Array = pl[0]
+		if pl[1] and pts.size() >= 3 and Geometry2D.is_point_in_polygon(p, pts):
+			inside += 1
+		for k in range(1, pts.size()):
+			if Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(p, pts[k - 1], pts[k]).distance_to(p) <= reach:
+				return true
+	return inside % 2 == 1 and (sh.get("fill") != null or sh["type"] == "text")
+
+
+# --- Writing SVG ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func color_hex(c: Color) -> String:
+	return "#" + c.to_html(false)
+
+
+static func _num(v: float) -> String:
+	var s := "%.3f" % v
+	s = s.rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
+	return "0" if s == "-0" or s == "" else s
+
+
+static func _pt(p: Vector2) -> String:
+	return _num(p.x) + "," + _num(p.y)
+
+
+static func style(sh: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var s := []
+	var f = sh.get("fill")
+	s.append("fill:" + (color_hex(f) if f != null else "none"))
+	if f != null and f.a < 0.999:
+		s.append("fill-opacity:" + _num(f.a))
+	var st = sh.get("stroke")
+	if sh["type"] == "text" and sh.get("bold", false) and st == null and f != null:
+		st = f   # bold text: a thin stroke in its own colour
+		s.append("stroke:%s;stroke-width:%s;stroke-linejoin:round" % [color_hex(st), _num(float(sh["size"]) * 0.035)])
+	elif st != null and float(sh["stroke_width"]) > 0.0:
+		s.append("stroke:" + color_hex(st))
+		if st.a < 0.999:
+			s.append("stroke-opacity:" + _num(st.a))
+		s.append("stroke-width:" + _num(sh["stroke_width"]))
+		s.append("stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round")
+	if float(sh.get("opacity", 1.0)) < 0.999:
+		s.append("opacity:" + _num(sh["opacity"]))
+	return ";".join(s)
+
+
+static func transform_attr(xf: Transform2D) -> String:
+	if xf.is_equal_approx(Transform2D.IDENTITY):
+		return ""
+	return ' transform="matrix(%s %s %s %s %s %s)"' % [_num(xf.x.x), _num(xf.x.y), _num(xf.y.x), _num(xf.y.y), _num(xf.origin.x), _num(xf.origin.y)]
+
+
+static func path_data(subs: Array) -> String:
+	var d := []
+	for sub in subs:
+		var ns: Array = sub["nodes"]
+		if ns.is_empty():
+			continue
+		d.append("M" + _pt(ns[0]["p"]))
+		var count := ns.size() + (1 if sub["closed"] else 0)
+		for k in range(1, count):
+			var a: Dictionary = ns[k - 1]
+			var b: Dictionary = ns[k % ns.size()]
+			if (a["o"] as Vector2).is_equal_approx(a["p"]) and (b["i"] as Vector2).is_equal_approx(b["p"]):
+				if k < ns.size():   # (the closing straight segment is the Z)
+					d.append("L" + _pt(b["p"]))
+			else:
+				d.append("C%s %s %s" % [_pt(a["o"]), _pt(b["i"]), _pt(b["p"])])
+		if sub["closed"]:
+			d.append("Z")
+	return " ".join(d)
+
+
+## One shape as an SVG element. `for_render`: text as outlines (the rasteriser
+## has no text); otherwise a real <text> element (editable elsewhere).
+static func shape_svg(sh: Dictionary, for_render: bool) -> String:
+	if sh.get("hidden", false) and for_render:
+		return ""
+	var attrs := ' style="%s"%s' % [style(sh), transform_attr(sh["xf"])]
+	if sh.get("name", "") != "":
+		attrs += ' id="%s"' % str(sh["name"]).xml_escape(true)
+	if sh.get("hidden", false):
+		attrs += ' display="none"'
+	match sh["type"]:
+		"rect":
+			var r := ' rx="%s"' % _num(sh["r"]) if float(sh["r"]) > 0.0 else ""
+			return '<rect x="%s" y="%s" width="%s" height="%s"%s%s/>' % [_num(sh["x"]), _num(sh["y"]), _num(sh["w"]), _num(sh["h"]), r, attrs]
+		"ellipse":
+			return '<ellipse cx="%s" cy="%s" rx="%s" ry="%s"%s/>' % [_num(sh["cx"]), _num(sh["cy"]), _num(sh["rx"]), _num(sh["ry"]), attrs]
+		"star":
+			return '<path d="%s" data-star="%s %s %s %s %d %d %s"%s/>' % [path_data(to_subs(sh)), _num(sh["cx"]), _num(sh["cy"]), _num(sh["r1"]),
+				_num(sh["r2"]), int(sh["n"]), 1 if sh["star"] else 0, "%.6f" % float(sh["angle"]), attrs]
+		"text":
+			if for_render:
+				return '<path d="%s"%s/>' % [path_data(text_subs(sh)), attrs]
+			return '<text x="%s" y="%s" font-size="%s"%s%s>%s</text>' % [_num(sh["x"]), _num(sh["y"]), _num(sh["size"]),
+				' font-weight="bold"' if sh.get("bold", false) else "", attrs, str(sh["text"]).xml_escape()]
+		"path":
+			return '<path d="%s"%s/>' % [path_data(sh["subs"]), attrs]
+	return ""
+
+
+## The whole document as SVG. `view`: the page area shown (for rendering a
+## view of it); `px`: the output size in pixels (default: the page size).
+func to_svg(for_render := false, view := Rect2(), px := Vector2.ZERO, with_background := true) -> String:
+	if view.size == Vector2.ZERO:
+		view = Rect2(0, 0, width, height)
+	if px == Vector2.ZERO:
+		px = view.size
+	var out := ['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="%d" height="%d" viewBox="%s %s %s %s">' % [
+		maxi(1, roundi(px.x)), maxi(1, roundi(px.y)), _num(view.position.x), _num(view.position.y), _num(view.size.x), _num(view.size.y)]]
+	if with_background and background != null:
+		out.append('<rect id="page-background" x="0" y="0" width="%s" height="%s" style="fill:%s"/>' % [_num(width), _num(height), color_hex(background)])
+	for sh in shapes:
+		var s := shape_svg(sh, for_render)
+		if s != "":
+			out.append(s)
+	out.append("</svg>")
+	return "\n".join(out)
+
+
+## Rasterises the page (or `area`) at `scale` into an image.
+func render(scale := 1.0, area := Rect2(), with_background := true) -> Image:
+	if area.size == Vector2.ZERO:
+		area = Rect2(0, 0, width, height)
+	var img := Image.new()
+	var err := img.load_svg_from_string(to_svg(true, area, area.size * scale, with_background), 1.0)
+	return img if err == OK else null
+
+
+# --- Reading SVG ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func parse_color(v: String) -> Variant:
+	v = v.strip_edges()
+	if v == "" or v == "none" or v == "transparent":
+		return null
+	if v.begins_with("url("):
+		return Color(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)   # gradients / patterns: not supported, grey
+	if v == "currentColor":
+		return Color.BLACK
+	if v.begins_with("rgb"):
+		var inner := v.substr(v.find("(") + 1).trim_suffix(")").split(",")
+		var c := []
+		for part in inner:
+			var t := part.strip_edges()
+			c.append(float(t.trim_suffix("%")) / (100.0 if t.ends_with("%") else 255.0))
+		return Color(c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3] * 255.0 if c.size() > 3 else 1.0)
+	if v.begins_with("#") and v.length() == 4:
+		v = "#" + v[1] + v[1] + v[2] + v[2] + v[3] + v[3]
+	return Color.from_string(v, Color.BLACK)
+
+
+static func parse_transform(s: String) -> Transform2D:
+	var xf := Transform2D.IDENTITY
+	var re := RegEx.create_from_string("(matrix|translate|scale|rotate|skewX|skewY)\\s*\\(([^)]*)\\)")
+	for m in re.search_all(s):
+		var a := _numbers(m.get_string(2))
+		var t := Transform2D.IDENTITY
+		match m.get_string(1):
+			"matrix":
+				if a.size() >= 6:
+					t = Transform2D(Vector2(a[0], a[1]), Vector2(a[2], a[3]), Vector2(a[4], a[5]))
+			"translate":
+				t = Transform2D(0.0, Vector2(a[0] if a.size() > 0 else 0.0, a[1] if a.size() > 1 else 0.0))
+			"scale":
+				var sx: float = a[0] if a.size() > 0 else 1.0
+				t = Transform2D(Vector2(sx, 0), Vector2(0, a[1] if a.size() > 1 else sx), Vector2.ZERO)
+			"rotate":
+				var r := deg_to_rad(a[0] if a.size() > 0 else 0.0)
+				t = Transform2D(r, Vector2.ZERO)
+				if a.size() >= 3:
+					var c := Vector2(a[1], a[2])
+					t = Transform2D(0.0, c) * t * Transform2D(0.0, -c)
+			"skewX":
+				t = Transform2D(Vector2(1, 0), Vector2(tan(deg_to_rad(a[0])), 1), Vector2.ZERO)
+			"skewY":
+				t = Transform2D(Vector2(1, tan(deg_to_rad(a[0]))), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2.ZERO)
+		xf = xf * t
+	return xf
+
+
+static func _numbers(s: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var re := RegEx.create_from_string("[-+]?(?:\\d*\\.\\d+|\\d+\\.?)(?:[eE][-+]?\\d+)?")
+	for m in re.search_all(s):
+		out.append(float(m.get_string()))
+	return out
+
+
+## SVG path data -> subpaths (every command, relative ones and arcs too).
+static func parse_path(d: String) -> Array:
+	var toks := []   # commands (String) and numbers (float); arc flags split
+	var i := 0
+	var num_re := RegEx.create_from_string("^[-+]?(?:\\d*\\.\\d+|\\d+\\.?)(?:[eE][-+]?\\d+)?")
+	var last_cmd := ""
+	var arg_i := 0
+	while i < d.length():
+		var ch := d[i]
+		if "MmLlHhVvCcSsQqTtAaZz".contains(ch):
+			toks.append(ch)
+			last_cmd = ch.to_upper()
+			arg_i = 0
+			i += 1
+		elif ch in " ,\t\n\r":
+			i += 1
+		else:
+			if last_cmd == "A" and (arg_i % 7 == 3 or arg_i % 7 == 4) and ch in "01":
+				toks.append(float(ch))
+				i += 1
+			else:
+				var m := num_re.search(d.substr(i, 40))
+				if m == null:
+					i += 1
+					continue
+				toks.append(float(m.get_string()))
+				i += m.get_string().length()
+			arg_i += 1
+	var subs := []
+	var cur: Dictionary = {}
+	var pos := Vector2.ZERO
+	var start := Vector2.ZERO
+	var last_c := Vector2.ZERO    # last cubic control (for S)
+	var last_q := Vector2.ZERO    # last quadratic control (for T)
+	var prev := ""
+	var k := 0
+	var cmd := ""
+	while k < toks.size():
+		if toks[k] is String:
+			cmd = toks[k]
+			k += 1
+			if cmd in "Zz":
+				if not cur.is_empty():
+					cur["closed"] = true
+					var ns: Array = cur["nodes"]
+					if ns.size() > 1 and (ns[-1]["p"] as Vector2).is_equal_approx(ns[0]["p"]):
+						ns[0]["i"] = ns[-1]["i"]
+						ns.pop_back()
+					cur = {}
+				pos = start
+				prev = "Z"
+				continue
+		if cmd == "":
+			k += 1
+			continue
+		var rel := cmd == cmd.to_lower()
+		var base := pos if rel else Vector2.ZERO
+		var C := cmd.to_upper()
+		var need: int = {"M": 2, "L": 2, "H": 1, "V": 1, "C": 6, "S": 4, "Q": 4, "T": 2, "A": 7}.get(C, 0)
+		if k + need > toks.size() or need == 0:
+			break
+		var a := []
+		for j in need:
+			if not toks[k + j] is float:
+				return subs
+			a.append(toks[k + j])
+		k += need
+		if C != "M" and cur.is_empty():
+			cur = {"closed": false, "nodes": [node(pos)]}
+			subs.append(cur)
+		match C:
+			"M":
+				pos = base + Vector2(a[0], a[1])
+				start = pos
+				cur = {"closed": false, "nodes": [node(pos)]}
+				subs.append(cur)
+				cmd = "l" if rel else "L"   # further pairs are line-tos
+			"L":
+				pos = base + Vector2(a[0], a[1])
+				cur["nodes"].append(node(pos))
+			"H":
+				pos = Vector2((pos.x if rel else 0.0) + a[0], pos.y)
+				cur["nodes"].append(node(pos))
+			"V":
+				pos = Vector2(pos.x, (pos.y if rel else 0.0) + a[0])
+				cur["nodes"].append(node(pos))
+			"C", "S":
+				var c0: Vector2
+				var c1: Vector2
+				var p: Vector2
+				if C == "C":
+					c0 = base + Vector2(a[0], a[1])
+					c1 = base + Vector2(a[2], a[3])
+					p = base + Vector2(a[4], a[5])
+				else:
+					c0 = pos * 2.0 - last_c if prev in ["C", "S"] else pos
+					c1 = base + Vector2(a[0], a[1])
+					p = base + Vector2(a[2], a[3])
+				cur["nodes"][-1]["o"] = c0
+				cur["nodes"].append(node(p, c1))
+				last_c = c1
+				pos = p
+			"Q", "T":
+				var q: Vector2
+				var p: Vector2
+				if C == "Q":
+					q = base + Vector2(a[0], a[1])
+					p = base + Vector2(a[2], a[3])
+				else:
+					q = pos * 2.0 - last_q if prev in ["Q", "T"] else pos
+					p = base + Vector2(a[0], a[1])
+				cur["nodes"][-1]["o"] = pos + (q - pos) * 2.0 / 3.0
+				cur["nodes"].append(node(p, p + (q - p) * 2.0 / 3.0))
+				last_q = q
+				pos = p
+			"A":
+				var p := base + Vector2(a[5], a[6])
+				for seg in _arc(pos, Vector2(absf(a[0]), absf(a[1])), deg_to_rad(a[2]), a[3] != 0.0, a[4] != 0.0, p):
+					cur["nodes"][-1]["o"] = seg[0]
+					cur["nodes"].append(node(seg[2], seg[1]))
+				pos = p
+		prev = C
+	return subs
+
+
+## An SVG elliptical arc as cubic segments [[c0, c1, p], ...].
+static func _arc(p0: Vector2, r: Vector2, phi: float, large: bool, sweep: bool, p1: Vector2) -> Array:
+	if r.x < 1e-6 or r.y < 1e-6 or p0.is_equal_approx(p1):
+		return [[p0, p1, p1]]
+	var cp := cos(phi)
+	var sp := sin(phi)
+	var d := (p0 - p1) / 2.0
+	var x1 := cp * d.x + sp * d.y
+	var y1 := -sp * d.x + cp * d.y
+	var lam := (x1 * x1) / (r.x * r.x) + (y1 * y1) / (r.y * r.y)
+	if lam > 1.0:
+		r *= sqrt(lam)
+	var num := r.x * r.x * r.y * r.y - r.x * r.x * y1 * y1 - r.y * r.y * x1 * x1
+	var den := r.x * r.x * y1 * y1 + r.y * r.y * x1 * x1
+	var co := sqrt(maxf(0.0, num / den)) * (-1.0 if large == sweep else 1.0)
+	var cxp := co * r.x * y1 / r.y
+	var cyp := -co * r.y * x1 / r.x
+	var c := Vector2(cp * cxp - sp * cyp, sp * cxp + cp * cyp) + (p0 + p1) / 2.0
+	var a1 := Vector2((x1 - cxp) / r.x, (y1 - cyp) / r.y).angle()
+	var da := Vector2((x1 - cxp) / r.x, (y1 - cyp) / r.y).angle_to(Vector2((-x1 - cxp) / r.x, (-y1 - cyp) / r.y))
+	if not sweep and da > 0.0:
+		da -= TAU
+	elif sweep and da < 0.0:
+		da += TAU
+	var n := maxi(1, ceili(absf(da) / (PI / 2.0)))
+	var step := da / n
+	var k := 4.0 / 3.0 * tan(step / 4.0)
+	var out := []
+	var rot := Transform2D(phi, c)
+	for s in n:
+		var t0 := a1 + step * s
+		var t1 := t0 + step
+		var e0 := Vector2(cos(t0), sin(t0))
+		var e1 := Vector2(cos(t1), sin(t1))
+		var q0 := Vector2(e0.x * r.x, e0.y * r.y)
+		var q1 := Vector2(e1.x * r.x, e1.y * r.y)
+		var d0 := Vector2(-e0.y * r.x, e0.x * r.y) * k
+		var d1 := Vector2(-e1.y * r.x, e1.x * r.y) * k
+		out.append([rot * (q0 + d0), rot * (q1 - d1), p1 if s == n - 1 else rot * q1])
+	return out
+
+
+static func _style_map(el: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var m := {}
+	for k in ["fill", "stroke", "stroke-width", "opacity", "fill-opacity", "stroke-opacity", "display", "font-size", "font-weight"]:
+		if el.has(k):
+			m[k] = el[k]
+	for part in str(el.get("style", "")).split(";"):
+		var kv := part.split(":", true, 1)
+		if kv.size() == 2:
+			m[kv[0].strip_edges()] = kv[1].strip_edges()
+	return m
+
+
+## Reads SVG text into this document (replacing it). Returns false on a parse failure.
+func load_svg(text: String) -> bool:
+	var xp := XMLParser.new()
+	if xp.open_buffer(text.to_utf8_buffer()) != OK:
+		return false
+	shapes = []
+	background = null
+	var stack := [{"xf": Transform2D.IDENTITY, "style": {"fill": "#000000"}}]
+	var text_shape: Dictionary = {}
+	var got_root := false
+	while xp.read() == OK:
+		match xp.get_node_type():
+			XMLParser.NODE_ELEMENT:
+				var tag := xp.get_node_name()
+				var el := {}
+				for a in xp.get_attribute_count():
+					el[xp.get_attribute_name(a)] = xp.get_attribute_value(a)
+				var parent: Dictionary = stack[-1]
+				var st: Dictionary = (parent["style"] as Dictionary).duplicate()
+				st.merge(_style_map(el), true)
+				var xf: Transform2D = parent["xf"] * parse_transform(str(el.get("transform", "")))
+				if tag == "svg" and not got_root:
+					got_root = true
+					var vb := _numbers(str(el.get("viewBox", "")))
+					var w := _numbers(str(el.get("width", "")))
+					var h := _numbers(str(el.get("height", "")))
+					if vb.size() == 4:
+						width = vb[2]
+						height = vb[3]
+						xf = Transform2D(0.0, Vector2(-vb[0], -vb[1]))
+					elif w.size() > 0 and h.size() > 0 and not str(el.get("width")).ends_with("%"):
+						width = w[0]
+						height = h[0]
+				var sh := _element(tag, el, st, xf)
+				if str(el.get("id", "")) == "page-background":
+					background = sh["fill"]
+				elif not sh.is_empty():
+					shapes.append(sh)
+					if tag == "text":
+						text_shape = sh
+				if not xp.is_empty():
+					stack.append({"xf": xf, "style": st, "tag": tag})
+			XMLParser.NODE_TEXT:
+				if not text_shape.is_empty() and stack.size() > 1 and str(stack[-1].get("tag", "")) in ["text", "tspan"]:
+					text_shape["text"] = str(text_shape["text"]) + xp.get_node_data().strip_edges()
+			XMLParser.NODE_ELEMENT_END:
+				if xp.get_node_name() == "text":
+					text_shape = {}
+				if stack.size() > 1:
+					stack.pop_back()
+	return got_root
+
+
+func _element(tag: String, el: Dictionary, st: Dictionary, xf: Transform2D) -> Dictionary:
+	var f := func(k: String, def := 0.0) -> float:
+		var n := _numbers(str(el.get(k, "")))
+		return n[0] if n.size() > 0 else def
+	var sh: Dictionary
+	match tag:
+		"rect":
+			sh = new_shape("rect")
+			sh.merge({"x": f.call("x"), "y": f.call("y"), "w": f.call("width"), "h": f.call("height"), "r": f.call("rx", f.call("ry"))}, true)
+		"circle":
+			sh = new_shape("ellipse")
+			sh.merge({"cx": f.call("cx"), "cy": f.call("cy"), "rx": f.call("r"), "ry": f.call("r")}, true)
+		"ellipse":
+			sh = new_shape("ellipse")
+			sh.merge({"cx": f.call("cx"), "cy": f.call("cy"), "rx": f.call("rx"), "ry": f.call("ry")}, true)
+		"line":
+			sh = new_shape("path")
+			sh["subs"] = [{"closed": false, "nodes": [node(Vector2(f.call("x1"), f.call("y1"))), node(Vector2(f.call("x2"), f.call("y2")))]}]
+		"polyline", "polygon":
+			sh = new_shape("path")
+			var n := _numbers(str(el.get("points", "")))
+			var ns := []
+			for k in range(0, n.size() - 1, 2):
+				ns.append(node(Vector2(n[k], n[k + 1])))
+			sh["subs"] = [{"closed": tag == "polygon", "nodes": ns}]
+		"path":
+			var star := _numbers(str(el.get("data-star", "")))
+			if star.size() == 7:
+				sh = new_shape("star")
+				sh.merge({"cx": star[0], "cy": star[1], "r1": star[2], "r2": star[3], "n": int(star[4]), "star": star[5] != 0.0, "angle": star[6]}, true)
+			else:
+				sh = new_shape("path")
+				sh["subs"] = parse_path(str(el.get("d", "")))
+		"text":
+			sh = new_shape("text")
+			sh.merge({"x": f.call("x"), "y": f.call("y"), "text": "", "size": _numbers(str(st.get("font-size", "16")))[0] if not _numbers(str(st.get("font-size", "16"))).is_empty() else 16.0,
+				"bold": str(st.get("font-weight", "")) in ["bold", "700", "800", "900"]}, true)
+		_:
+			return {}
+	sh["xf"] = xf
+	sh["name"] = str(el.get("id", ""))
+	sh["hidden"] = str(st.get("display", "")) == "none"
+	sh["fill"] = parse_color(str(st.get("fill", "#000000")))
+	if sh["fill"] != null and st.has("fill-opacity"):
+		sh["fill"].a = float(st["fill-opacity"])
+	sh["stroke"] = parse_color(str(st.get("stroke", "none")))
+	if sh["stroke"] != null and st.has("stroke-opacity"):
+		sh["stroke"].a = float(st["stroke-opacity"])
+	sh["stroke_width"] = _numbers(str(st.get("stroke-width", "1")))[0] if not _numbers(str(st.get("stroke-width", "1"))).is_empty() else 1.0
+	sh["opacity"] = float(st.get("opacity", "1"))
+	if tag in ["line", "polyline"] and not st.has("fill"):
+		sh["fill"] = null
+	return sh

files.explanation: Talos, the game's editor: The SVG Editor (Editor > SVG Editor, F6): a vector drawing program in the spirit of Inkscape. Tools: select / transform (move, scale, rotate), nodes (edit paths: drag nodes and handles, add, delete, smooth / sharp), rectangle, ellipse, star / polygon, pen (Bezier), pencil (freehand), text and colour picker. Fill, stroke, opacity, z-order, align, flip, an objects list with hide / lock, undo / redo, copy / paste, grid and snapping. Files are real SVG (open, save) and the drawing exports to PNG at any scale. The document is SvgDoc; it is drawn by Godot's SVG rasteriser, so what you see is exactly what's exported. (Moved from scripts/svg_editor.gd.)

@@ -1,0 +1,1889 @@ 
+extends Control
+## The SVG Editor (Editor > SVG Editor, F6): a vector drawing program in the
+## spirit of Inkscape. Tools: select / transform (move, scale, rotate),
+## nodes (edit paths: drag nodes and handles, add, delete, smooth / sharp),
+## rectangle, ellipse, star / polygon, pen (Bezier), pencil (freehand), text
+## and colour picker. Fill, stroke, opacity, z-order, align, flip, an objects
+## list with hide / lock, undo / redo, copy / paste, grid and snapping.
+## Files are real SVG (open, save) and the drawing exports to PNG at any
+## scale. The document is SvgDoc; it is drawn by Godot's SVG rasteriser,
+## so what you see is exactly what's exported.
+
+const EDITOR_SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/editor.tscn"
+const ACCENT := Color(0.55, 0.92, 0.62)
+const DIR := "res://art/svg/"
+const HANDLE := 9.0
+## [id, icon, name, key, help]
+const TOOLS := [
+	["select", "select", "Select and transform", "S", "Click a shape to select it (Shift adds), drag to move it; drag on empty space for a box selection.\nThe handles scale it (Ctrl / Shift: keep proportions); the round handle rotates it (Ctrl: 15° steps).\nDouble-click a shape to edit its nodes. Arrows nudge (Shift: 10 px)."],
+	["node", "node", "Edit nodes", "N", "Edit a path's nodes: drag nodes or their handles (Shift adds to the selection; drag empty space\nfor a box). Double-click a segment to add a node; Delete removes nodes. Rectangles, ellipses,\nstars and text become paths when you edit their nodes."],
+	["rect", "rect", "Rectangle", "R", "Drag to draw a rectangle (Ctrl: a square). Round its corners in the panel."],
+	["ellipse", "ellipse", "Ellipse", "E", "Drag to draw an ellipse (Ctrl: a circle)."],
+	["star", "star_tool", "Star and polygon", "*", "Drag from the centre to draw a star or polygon (Ctrl: snap the angle).\nSet the corners, the spoke ratio and star / polygon in the panel."],
+	["pen", "pen", "Pen (Bezier)", "B", "Click to add sharp nodes, click-and-drag for smooth (curved) ones. Click the first node to close\nthe path; Enter, right-click or a double-click finishes it; Backspace removes the last node; Esc cancels."],
+	["pencil", "pencil", "Pencil (freehand)", "P", "Drag to draw freehand: the line is smoothed into a curve. End near the start to close it."],
+	["text", "text", "Text", "T", "Click to place text, then type it in the panel (size, bold). Click existing text to edit it."],
+	["picker", "picker", "Colour picker", "D", "Click a shape to copy its fill onto the selection (Shift: its stroke too).\nWith nothing selected it sets the colour new shapes are drawn with."],
+]
+
+var doc := SvgDoc.new()
+var file_path := ""
+var dirty := false
+var tool := "select"
+var sel: Array = []               # selected shapes (references into doc.shapes)
+var node_sel: Array = []          # selected nodes: [shape, sub index, node index]
+var zoom := 1.0
+var pan := Vector2(60, 40)
+var show_grid := true
+var snap := false
+var grid := 10.0
+## The style new shapes are drawn with (follows the last edited style).
+var style := {"fill": Color(0.35, 0.6, 0.95), "stroke": Color(0.08, 0.1, 0.16), "stroke_width": 2.0, "opacity": 1.0}
+var star_n := 5
+var star_ratio := 0.45
+var star_on := true
+
+var _undo: Array = []
+var _redo: Array = []
+var _undo_key := ""
+var _undo_time := 0
+var _clip: Array = []
+
+# Interaction.
+var _drag := ""                   # move, scale, rotate, band, create, node, handle, pan, pencil, pen
+var _press := Vector2.ZERO        # page point of the press
+var _press_screen := Vector2.ZERO
+var _orig: Array = []             # selected shapes' transforms (or node positions) at the press
+var _bbox0 := Rect2()
+var _handle := -1
+var _handle_side := ""            # "i" / "o" for a node handle
+var _creating: Dictionary = {}
+var _pen: Dictionary = {}
+var _pencil := PackedVector2Array()
+var _mouse := Vector2.ZERO        # page coordinates
+var _mouse_screen := Vector2.ZERO
+var _hover: Dictionary = {}
+
+# UI.
+var _canvas: Control
+var _tex: ImageTexture
+var _checker: ImageTexture
+var _render_dirty := true
+var _panel: VBoxContainer
+var _objects: Tree
+var _listing := false        # (refreshing the list: ignore its selection signals)
+var _status: Label
+var _coords: Label
+var _title: Label
+var _tool_btns := {}
+var _text_edit: LineEdit
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	NeonTheme.set_empire("")
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(DIR))
+	var ci := Image.create(16, 16, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+	for x in 16:
+		for y in 16:
+			ci.set_pixel(x, y, Color(0.86, 0.86, 0.88) if (x < 8) == (y < 8) else Color(0.97, 0.97, 0.98))
+	_checker = ImageTexture.create_from_image(ci)
+	_build()
+	_new_doc(false)
+	PinTips.install(self, "svg")
+	# Opened from the command line with a file:  ... -- --svg=res://art/svg/x.svg
+	for a in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
+		if a.begins_with("--svg="):
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			open_file(a.substr(6))
+
+
+# --- Layout ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _build() -> void:
+	var root := TalosNav.wrap(UI.modal(self, ACCENT, Vector2.ZERO, true), "svg", func(id): TalosNav.go(get_tree(), id, _guard))
+	var hn := TalosNav.header("SVG", "", ACCENT)
+	var header: HBoxContainer = hn[0]
+	_title = hn[1]
+	header.add_child(_btn("New", "new", "Ctrl+N", "Starts a new, empty drawing (asks about unsaved changes).", func(): _guard(func(): _new_doc(true))))
+	header.add_child(_btn("Open", "open", "Ctrl+O", "Opens an SVG file (shapes, paths, text, groups and their styles are read;\ngradients become grey).", func(): _guard(_open_dialog)))
+	header.add_child(_btn("Save", "save", "Ctrl+S", "Saves the drawing as an SVG file (asks for a name the first time).", _save))
+	header.add_child(_btn("Save as", "duplicate", "Ctrl+Shift+S", "Saves the drawing under a new name.", _save_as))
+	header.add_child(_btn("Export PNG", "export", "Ctrl+E", "Exports the page, the whole drawing or the selection as a PNG image,\nat any scale, with a transparent or a coloured background.", _export_dialog))
+	header.add_child(_btn("Undo", "undo", "Ctrl+Z", "Undoes the last change.", undo))
+	header.add_child(_btn("Redo", "redo", "Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z", "Redoes what was undone.", redo))

+	var d := SvgDoc.new()

+		_set_status("Couldn't read " + p.get_file())
+		return false
+	doc = d
+	file_path = p
+	sel = []
+	node_sel = []
+	_undo = []
+	_redo = []
+	_changed(true)

+func _save_as() -> void:
+	_file_dialog(FileDialog.FILE_MODE_SAVE_FILE, "*.svg ; SVG drawings", save_file, file_path.get_file() if file_path != "" else "drawing.svg")

+
+func save_file(p: String) -> bool:
+	if not p.ends_with(".svg"):
+		p += ".svg"
+	var f := FileAccess.open(p, FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f == null:
+		_set_status("Couldn't write " + p)
+		return false
+	f.store_string(doc.to_svg(false))
+	f.close()
+	file_path = p
+	dirty = false
+	_update_title()
+	_set_status("Saved " + p.get_file())

+
+## The page area an export covers: 0 page, 1 the drawing, 2 the selection.
+func export_area(which: int) -> Rect2:
+	if which == 1 or (which == 2 and not sel.is_empty()):
+		var r := _bounds_of(doc.shapes.filter(func(s): return not s["hidden"]) if which == 1 else sel)
+		if r.size.x > 0.0 and r.size.y > 0.0:
+			return r.grow(2.0)
+	return Rect2(0, 0, doc.width, doc.height)
+
+
+func export_png(p: String, scale := 1.0, which := 0, background := true) -> bool:
+	if not p.ends_with(".png"):
+		p += ".png"
+	var r := export_area(which)
+	var img := doc.render(scale, r, background)
+	if img == null or img.save_png(p) != OK:
+		_set_status("Couldn't export " + p)
+		return false
+	_set_status("Exported %s (%d x %d px)" % [p.get_file(), img.get_width(), img.get_height()])
+	return true
+
+
+func _back() -> void:
+	TalosNav.go(get_tree(), "menu", _guard)   # (Esc: as the rail's Exit)

+
+## Asks about unsaved changes (save / discard / stay), then `then` (Talos's exit).
+func guard(then: Callable) -> void:
+	_guard(then)
