+# --- Undo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Remembers the document before a change. Changes with the same `key`
+## less than a second apart (a slider being dragged) are one step.
+func _push_undo(key := "") -> void:
+	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	if key != "" and key == _undo_key and now - _undo_time < 1000:
+		_undo_time = now
+		return
+	_undo_key = key
+	_undo_time = now
+	_undo.append(_snapshot())
+	if _undo.size() > 200:
+		_undo.pop_front()
+	_redo.clear()
+
+
+func _snapshot() -> Dictionary:
+	return {"shapes": doc.shapes.duplicate(true), "w": doc.width, "h": doc.height, "bg": doc.background,
+		"sel": sel.map(func(s): return _index(s))}
+
+
+func _restore(s: Dictionary) -> void:
+	doc.shapes = s["shapes"].duplicate(true)
+	doc.width = s["w"]
+	doc.height = s["h"]
+	doc.background = s["bg"]
+	sel = []
+	for i in s["sel"]:
+		if i >= 0 and i < doc.shapes.size():
+			sel.append(doc.shapes[i])
+	node_sel = []
+	_pen = {}
+	_creating = {}
+	_undo_key = ""
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+func undo() -> void:
+	if _undo.is_empty():
+		return
+	_redo.append(_snapshot())
+	_restore(_undo.pop_back())
+
+
+func redo() -> void:
+	if _redo.is_empty():
+		return
+	_undo.append(_snapshot())
+	_restore(_redo.pop_back())
+
+
+## Something changed: redraw; `structure` also refreshes the panel and list.
+func _changed(structure := false) -> void:
+	dirty = true
+	_render_dirty = true
+	if _canvas:
+		_canvas.queue_redraw()
+	if structure:
+		_refresh_objects()
+		_rebuild_panel()
+	if _title:
+		_update_title()
+
+
+func _index(sh: Dictionary) -> int:
+	for i in doc.shapes.size():
+		if is_same(doc.shapes[i], sh):
+			return i
+	return -1
+
+
+func _is_sel(sh: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	for s in sel:
+		if is_same(s, sh):
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+# --- View ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _to_page(screen: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	return (screen - pan) / zoom
+
+
+func _to_screen(page: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	return page * zoom + pan
+
+
+func zoom_fit() -> void:
+	if _canvas == null or _canvas.size.x < 10:
+		return
+	zoom = minf((_canvas.size.x - 60) / doc.width, (_canvas.size.y - 60) / doc.height)
+	pan = (_canvas.size - Vector2(doc.width, doc.height) * zoom) / 2.0
+	_render_dirty = true
+	_canvas.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _zoom_at(screen: Vector2, factor: float) -> void:
+	var before := _to_page(screen)
+	zoom = clampf(zoom * factor, 0.02, 64.0)
+	pan = screen - before * zoom
+	_render_dirty = true
+	_canvas.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _snap(p: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	return p.snapped(Vector2(grid, grid)) if snap else p
+
+
+func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
+	if _render_dirty and _canvas and _canvas.size.x > 2 and _canvas.size.y > 2:
+		_render_dirty = false
+		var view := Rect2(_to_page(Vector2.ZERO), _canvas.size / zoom)
+		var img := Image.new()
+		if img.load_svg_from_string(doc.to_svg(true, view, _canvas.size, false), 1.0) == OK:
+			if _tex and Vector2i(_tex.get_size()) == img.get_size():
+				_tex.update(img)
+			else:
+				_tex = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+		_canvas.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _draw_canvas() -> void:
+	var c := _canvas
+	c.draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, c.size), Color(0.12, 0.13, 0.16))
+	var page := Rect2(_to_screen(Vector2.ZERO), Vector2(doc.width, doc.height) * zoom)
+	c.draw_rect(Rect2(page.position + Vector2(5, 5), page.size).grow(1), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
+	if doc.background != null:
+		c.draw_rect(page, doc.background)
+	else:
+		c.draw_texture_rect(_checker, page, true)
+	if show_grid and grid * zoom >= 6.0:
+		var vis := page.intersection(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, c.size))
+		var col := Color(0.3, 0.45, 0.8, 0.18)
+		var x0 := ceilf(_to_page(vis.position).x / grid) * grid
+		var x := x0
+		while _to_screen(Vector2(x, 0)).x < vis.end.x:
+			var sx := _to_screen(Vector2(x, 0)).x
+			c.draw_line(Vector2(sx, vis.position.y), Vector2(sx, vis.end.y), col)
+			x += grid
+		var y := ceilf(_to_page(vis.position).y / grid) * grid
+		while _to_screen(Vector2(0, y)).y < vis.end.y:
+			var sy := _to_screen(Vector2(0, y)).y
+			c.draw_line(Vector2(vis.position.x, sy), Vector2(vis.end.x, sy), col)
+			y += grid
+	if _tex:
+		c.draw_texture(_tex, Vector2.ZERO)
+	c.draw_rect(page, Color(0.45, 0.5, 0.62), false, 1.0)
+	# Hover outline.
+	if not _hover.is_empty() and not _is_sel(_hover) and _drag == "":
+		_outline(_hover, Color(0.4, 0.8, 1.0, 0.8))
+	# Selection.
+	for s in sel:
+		if tool == "node" or sel.size() > 1:
+			_outline(s, Color(0.3, 0.7, 1.0, 0.55))
+	if tool == "select" and not sel.is_empty():
+		var r := _sel_screen_rect()
+		_dashed_rect(r, Color(0.1, 0.1, 0.12), Color(1, 1, 1))
+		for i in 8:
+			var h := _handle_pos(r, i)
+			c.draw_rect(Rect2(h - Vector2.ONE * HANDLE / 2.0, Vector2.ONE * HANDLE), Color(0.95, 0.97, 1.0))
+			c.draw_rect(Rect2(h - Vector2.ONE * HANDLE / 2.0, Vector2.ONE * HANDLE), Color(0.1, 0.2, 0.4), false, 1.0)
+		var rh := _handle_pos(r, 8)
+		c.draw_line(Vector2(r.get_center().x, r.position.y), rh, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6))
+		c.draw_circle(rh, 5.5, Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.3))
+		c.draw_arc(rh, 5.5, 0, TAU, 16, Color(0.2, 0.15, 0.05), 1.0)
+	if tool == "node":
+		_draw_nodes()
+	if _drag == "band":
+		var r := Rect2(_press_screen, Vector2.ZERO).expand(_mouse_screen)
+		c.draw_rect(r, Color(0.4, 0.7, 1.0, 0.12))
+		_dashed_rect(r, Color(0.2, 0.5, 1.0), Color(1, 1, 1))
+	if _drag == "pencil" and _pencil.size() > 1:
+		var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+		for p in _pencil:
+			pts.append(_to_screen(p))
+		c.draw_polyline(pts, Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.3), 1.5, true)
+	if tool == "pen" and not _pen.is_empty():
+		var ns: Array = _pen["subs"][0]["nodes"]
+		var last: Dictionary = ns[-1]
+		if _drag == "":
+			var pts := PackedVector2Array([_to_screen(last["p"])])
+			var tmp := PackedVector2Array([last["p"]])
+			SvgDoc.flatten_seg(last["p"], last["o"], _mouse, _mouse, tmp)
+			for p in tmp:
+				pts.append(_to_screen(p))
+			c.draw_polyline(pts, Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.3), 1.5, true)
+		for k in ns.size():
+			var p := _to_screen(ns[k]["p"])
+			c.draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(4, 4), Vector2(8, 8)), Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.2) if k == 0 else Color.WHITE)
+		if not (last["o"] as Vector2).is_equal_approx(last["p"]):
+			for h in [last["i"], last["o"]]:
+				c.draw_line(_to_screen(last["p"]), _to_screen(h), Color(0.5, 0.8, 1.0))
+				c.draw_circle(_to_screen(h), 3.5, Color(0.5, 0.8, 1.0))
+
+
+func _outline(sh: Dictionary, col: Color) -> void:
+	for pl in SvgDoc.polylines(sh, 1.5 / zoom):
+		var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+		for p in pl[0]:
+			pts.append(_to_screen(p))
+		if pl[1] and pts.size() > 1:
+			pts.append(pts[0])
+		if pts.size() > 1:
+			_canvas.draw_polyline(pts, col, 1.2, true)
+
+
+func _dashed_rect(r: Rect2, a: Color, b: Color) -> void:
+	var pts := [r.position, Vector2(r.end.x, r.position.y), r.end, Vector2(r.position.x, r.end.y), r.position]
+	for k in 4:
+		_canvas.draw_line(pts[k], pts[k + 1], a, 1.0)
+		_canvas.draw_dashed_line(pts[k], pts[k + 1], b, 1.0, 4.0)
+
+
+func _draw_nodes() -> void:
+	for sh in sel:
+		if sh["type"] != "path":
+			continue
+		var xf: Transform2D = sh["xf"]
+		var subs: Array = sh["subs"]
+		for si in subs.size():
+			var ns: Array = subs[si]["nodes"]
+			for ni in ns.size():
+				var n: Dictionary = ns[ni]
+				var p := _to_screen(xf * n["p"])
+				var on := _node_selected(sh, si, ni)
+				if on:
+					for h in ["i", "o"]:
+						if not (n[h] as Vector2).is_equal_approx(n["p"]):
+							var hp := _to_screen(xf * n[h])
+							_canvas.draw_line(p, hp, Color(0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 0.9))
+							_canvas.draw_circle(hp, 4.0, Color(0.5, 0.8, 1.0))
+				var r := Rect2(p - Vector2(4.5, 4.5), Vector2(9, 9))
+				var col := Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.25) if on else Color(0.95, 0.97, 1.0)
+				if n.get("s", false):
+					_canvas.draw_circle(p, 5.0, col)
+					_canvas.draw_arc(p, 5.0, 0, TAU, 12, Color(0.1, 0.15, 0.3), 1.0)
+				else:
+					_canvas.draw_rect(r, col)
+					_canvas.draw_rect(r, Color(0.1, 0.15, 0.3), false, 1.0)
+
+
+# --- Selection geometry ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _bounds_of(list: Array) -> Rect2:
+	var r := Rect2()
+	var first := true
+	for s in list:
+		var b := SvgDoc.bounds(s)
+		if b.size == Vector2.ZERO and b.position == Vector2.ZERO:
+			continue
+		r = b if first else r.merge(b)
+		first = false
+	return r
+
+
+func _sel_screen_rect() -> Rect2:
+	var b := _bounds_of(sel)
+	return Rect2(_to_screen(b.position), b.size * zoom).grow(4.0)
+
+
+## Handle positions: 0..7 round the box from the top-left; 8 = rotate.
+func _handle_pos(r: Rect2, i: int) -> Vector2:
+	var c := r.get_center()
+	match i:
+		0: return r.position
+		1: return Vector2(c.x, r.position.y)
+		2: return Vector2(r.end.x, r.position.y)
+		3: return Vector2(r.end.x, c.y)
+		4: return r.end
+		5: return Vector2(c.x, r.end.y)
+		6: return Vector2(r.position.x, r.end.y)
+		7: return Vector2(r.position.x, c.y)
+	return Vector2(c.x, r.position.y - 26.0)
+
+
+func shape_at(p: Vector2) -> Dictionary:
+	for k in range(doc.shapes.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		var sh: Dictionary = doc.shapes[k]
+		if not sh["locked"] and SvgDoc.hit(sh, p, 4.0 / zoom):
+			return sh
+	return {}
+
+
+func _node_selected(sh: Dictionary, si: int, ni: int) -> bool:
+	for e in node_sel:
+		if is_same(e[0], sh) and e[1] == si and e[2] == ni:
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+# --- Input ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func set_tool(id: String) -> void:
+	if tool == "pen" and id != "pen":
+		_finish_pen()
+	tool = id
+	for t in _tool_btns:
+		_tool_btns[t].button_pressed = t == id
+	if id == "node":
+		for s in sel:
+			if s["type"] != "path":
+				_to_path(s)
+	node_sel = []
+	_rebuild_panel()
+	_set_status()
+	_canvas.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _set_status(text := "") -> void:
+	if text == "":
+		for t in TOOLS:
+			if t[0] == tool:
+				text = t[2] + ": " + t[4].replace("\n", " ")
+	_status.text = text + ("   [snap on]" if snap else "")
+
+
+func _canvas_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventMouseMotion:
+		var mm := event as InputEventMouseMotion
+		_mouse_screen = mm.position
+		_mouse = _to_page(mm.position)
+		_coords.text = "x %.1f   y %.1f   ·   %d%%" % [_mouse.x, _mouse.y, roundi(zoom * 100.0)]
+		if _drag == "pan":
+			pan += mm.relative
+			_render_dirty = true
+		elif _drag != "":
+			on_motion(_mouse, mm.shift_pressed, mm.ctrl_pressed)
+		elif tool in ["select", "node", "picker"]:
+			var h := shape_at(_mouse)
+			if not is_same(h, _hover):
+				_hover = h
+		_canvas.queue_redraw()
+	elif event is InputEventMouseButton:
+		var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+		_mouse_screen = mb.position
+		_mouse = _to_page(mb.position)
+		if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP and mb.pressed:
+			_zoom_at(mb.position, 1.15)
+		elif mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN and mb.pressed:
+			_zoom_at(mb.position, 1.0 / 1.15)
+		elif mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE or (mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SPACE)):
+			_drag = "pan" if mb.pressed else ""
+			if UI.middle_click(self, mb):
+				zoom_fit()   # (a middle click: the whole page again; a middle drag pans)
+		elif mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT and mb.pressed:
+			if tool == "pen" and not _pen.is_empty():
+				_finish_pen()
+			elif _drag == "":
+				context_menu(_mouse, mb.global_position)
+		elif mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+			_canvas.grab_focus()
+			if mb.pressed:
+				on_press(_mouse, mb.shift_pressed, mb.ctrl_pressed, mb.double_click)
+			else:
+				on_release(_mouse, mb.shift_pressed, mb.ctrl_pressed)
+		_canvas.queue_redraw()
+
+
+## A left press at page point p (the tools' logic; tests call it directly).
+func on_press(p: Vector2, shift := false, ctrl := false, double := false) -> void:
+	_press = p
+	_press_screen = _to_screen(p)
+	_mouse = p
+	_mouse_screen = _press_screen
+	match tool:
+		"select":
+			if double:
+				var d := shape_at(p)
+				if not d.is_empty():
+					sel = [d]
+					set_tool("node")
+				return
+			if not sel.is_empty():
+				var r := _sel_screen_rect()
+				for i in 9:
+					if _handle_pos(r, i).distance_to(_press_screen) <= HANDLE:
+						_begin_transform("rotate" if i == 8 else "scale", i)
+						return
+			var hit := shape_at(p)
+			if hit.is_empty():
+				if not shift:
+					_select([])
+				_drag = "band"
+				return
+			if shift:
+				if _is_sel(hit):
+					_select(sel.filter(func(s): return not is_same(s, hit)))
+					return
+				_select(sel + [hit])
+			elif not _is_sel(hit):
+				_select([hit])
+			_begin_transform("move", -1)
+		"node":
+			if double:
+				_insert_node_at(p)
+				return
+			# Handles of selected nodes first, then nodes.
+			for e in node_sel:
+				var n: Dictionary = e[0]["subs"][e[1]]["nodes"][e[2]]
+				for h in ["i", "o"]:
+					if not (n[h] as Vector2).is_equal_approx(n["p"]) and _to_screen(e[0]["xf"] * n[h]).distance_to(_press_screen) <= 7.0:
+						_push_undo()
+						node_sel = [e]
+						_handle_side = h
+						_drag = "handle"
+						return
+			for sh in sel:
+				if sh["type"] != "path":
+					continue
+				var subs: Array = sh["subs"]
+				for si in subs.size():
+					for ni in subs[si]["nodes"].size():
+						if _to_screen(sh["xf"] * subs[si]["nodes"][ni]["p"]).distance_to(_press_screen) <= 7.0:
+							if shift:
+								if not _node_selected(sh, si, ni):
+									node_sel.append([sh, si, ni])
+							elif not _node_selected(sh, si, ni):
+								node_sel = [[sh, si, ni]]
+							_push_undo()
+							_orig = node_sel.map(func(e): return (e[0]["subs"][e[1]]["nodes"][e[2]] as Dictionary).duplicate())
+							_drag = "node"
+							_rebuild_panel()
+							return
+			var hit := shape_at(p)
+			if not hit.is_empty() and not _is_sel(hit):
+				if hit["type"] != "path":
+					_to_path(hit)
+				_select([hit])
+				return
+			if not shift:
+				node_sel = []
+			_drag = "band"
+		"rect", "ellipse", "star":
+			_push_undo()
+			var sh := SvgDoc.new_shape(tool)
+			_apply_style(sh)
+			if tool == "star":
+				sh.merge({"n": star_n, "star": star_on}, true)
+			doc.shapes.append(sh)
+			_creating = sh
+			_drag = "create"
+			on_motion(p, shift, ctrl)
+		"pen":
+			var q := _snap(p)
+			if double:
+				_finish_pen()
+				return
+			if _pen.is_empty():
+				_push_undo()
+				var sh := SvgDoc.new_shape("path")
+				_apply_style(sh)
+				sh["fill"] = null
+				sh["subs"] = [{"closed": false, "nodes": [SvgDoc.node(q)]}]
+				doc.shapes.append(sh)
+				_pen = sh
+				_select([sh])
+			else:
+				var ns: Array = _pen["subs"][0]["nodes"]
+				if ns.size() >= 2 and _to_screen(ns[0]["p"]).distance_to(_press_screen) <= 8.0:
+					_pen["subs"][0]["closed"] = true
+					if style["fill"] != null:
+						_pen["fill"] = style["fill"]
+					_finish_pen()
+					return
+				ns.append(SvgDoc.node(q))
+			_drag = "pen"
+			_changed()
+		"pencil":
+			_pencil = PackedVector2Array([p])
+			_drag = "pencil"
+		"text":
+			var hit := shape_at(p)
+			if not hit.is_empty() and hit["type"] == "text":
+				_select([hit])
+			else:
+				_push_undo()
+				var sh := SvgDoc.new_shape("text")
+				sh["fill"] = style["fill"] if style["fill"] != null else Color.BLACK
+				sh.merge({"x": _snap(p).x, "y": _snap(p).y}, true)
+				doc.shapes.append(sh)
+				_select([sh])
+				_changed(true)
+			if _text_edit:
+				_text_edit.grab_focus()
+				_text_edit.select_all()
+		"picker":
+			var hit := shape_at(p)
+			if hit.is_empty():
+				return
+			if sel.is_empty() or (sel.size() == 1 and is_same(sel[0], hit)):
+				style["fill"] = hit["fill"]
+				if shift:
+					style["stroke"] = hit["stroke"]
+					style["stroke_width"] = hit["stroke_width"]
+				_set_status("New shapes will use the picked colour.")
+			else:
+				_push_undo()
+				for s in sel:
+					s["fill"] = hit["fill"]
+					if shift:
+						s["stroke"] = hit["stroke"]
+						s["stroke_width"] = hit["stroke_width"]
+				_changed(true)
+
+
+func on_motion(p: Vector2, shift := false, ctrl := false) -> void:
+	_mouse = p
+	_mouse_screen = _to_screen(p)
+	match _drag:
+		"move":
+			var d := p - _press
+			if snap:
+				d = _snap(_bbox0.position + d) - _bbox0.position
+			if ctrl:
+				d = Vector2(d.x, 0) if absf(d.x) > absf(d.y) else Vector2(0, d.y)
+			for k in sel.size():
+				sel[k]["xf"] = Transform2D(0.0, d) * _orig[k]
+			_changed()
+		"scale":
+			var b := _bbox0
+			var anchor := b.get_center() * 2.0 - _handle_page(b, _handle)
+			var h0 := _handle_page(b, _handle)
+			var q := _snap(p)
+			var sx := 1.0
+			var sy := 1.0
+			if _handle in [0, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7] and absf(h0.x - anchor.x) > 1e-6:
+				sx = (q.x - anchor.x) / (h0.x - anchor.x)
+			if _handle in [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6] and absf(h0.y - anchor.y) > 1e-6:
+				sy = (q.y - anchor.y) / (h0.y - anchor.y)
+			if ctrl or shift:
+				var s: float = sx if (absf(sx) > absf(sy) and _handle not in [1, 5]) or _handle in [3, 7] else sy
+				sx = s
+				sy = s
+			sx = sx if absf(sx) > 0.001 else 0.001
+			sy = sy if absf(sy) > 0.001 else 0.001
+			var t := Transform2D(0.0, anchor) * Transform2D(Vector2(sx, 0), Vector2(0, sy), Vector2.ZERO) * Transform2D(0.0, -anchor)
+			for k in sel.size():
+				sel[k]["xf"] = t * _orig[k]
+			_changed()
+		"rotate":
+			var c := _bbox0.get_center()
+			var a := (p - c).angle() - (_press - c).angle()
+			if ctrl:
+				a = snappedf(a, deg_to_rad(15.0))
+			var t := Transform2D(0.0, c) * Transform2D(a, Vector2.ZERO) * Transform2D(0.0, -c)
+			for k in sel.size():
+				sel[k]["xf"] = t * _orig[k]
+			_set_status("Rotate: %.1f°" % rad_to_deg(a))
+			_changed()
+		"create":
+			_shape_from_drag(_creating, _snap(_press), _snap(p), ctrl)
+			_changed()
+		"node":
+			for k in node_sel.size():
+				var e: Array = node_sel[k]
+				var inv: Transform2D = (e[0]["xf"] as Transform2D).affine_inverse()
+				var o: Dictionary = _orig[k]
+				var d: Vector2 = inv * _snap(p) - inv * _snap(_press)
+				var n: Dictionary = e[0]["subs"][e[1]]["nodes"][e[2]]
+				n["p"] = o["p"] + d
+				n["i"] = o["i"] + d
+				n["o"] = o["o"] + d
+			_changed()
+		"handle":
+			var e: Array = node_sel[0]
+			var n: Dictionary = e[0]["subs"][e[1]]["nodes"][e[2]]
+			var local: Vector2 = (e[0]["xf"] as Transform2D).affine_inverse() * _snap(p)
+			n[_handle_side] = local
+			if n.get("s", false) and not shift:   # smooth: the other handle stays opposite
+				var other := "o" if _handle_side == "i" else "i"
+				var len: float = (n[other] as Vector2).distance_to(n["p"])
+				var dir: Vector2 = (n["p"] - local).normalized()
+				n[other] = n["p"] + dir * len
+			_changed()
+		"pen":
+			var ns: Array = _pen["subs"][0]["nodes"]
+			var n: Dictionary = ns[-1]
+			if _to_screen(p).distance_to(_to_screen(n["p"])) > 3.0:
+				var q := _snap(p)
+				n["o"] = q
+				n["i"] = n["p"] * 2.0 - q
+				n["s"] = true
+				_changed()
+		"pencil":
+			if _pencil.is_empty() or _to_screen(_pencil[-1]).distance_to(_to_screen(p)) > 2.0:
+				_pencil.append(p)
+
+
+func on_release(p: Vector2, shift := false, _ctrl := false) -> void:
+	match _drag:
+		"band":
+			var r := Rect2(_press, Vector2.ZERO).expand(p)
+			if tool == "node":
+				if not shift:
+					node_sel = []
+				for sh in sel:
+					if sh["type"] != "path":
+						continue
+					var subs: Array = sh["subs"]
+					for si in subs.size():
+						for ni in subs[si]["nodes"].size():
+							if r.has_point(sh["xf"] * subs[si]["nodes"][ni]["p"]) and not _node_selected(sh, si, ni):
+								node_sel.append([sh, si, ni])
+				_rebuild_panel()
+			elif r.size.length() * zoom > 3.0:
+				var picked := doc.shapes.filter(func(s): return not s["locked"] and not s["hidden"] and r.encloses(SvgDoc.bounds(s)))
+				_select((sel + picked) if shift else picked)
+		"create":
+			var b := SvgDoc.bounds(_creating)
+			if b.size.length() * zoom < 3.0:
+				doc.shapes.erase(_creating)
+				_undo.pop_back()
+			else:
+				_select([_creating])
+			_creating = {}
+			_changed(true)
+		"pencil":
+			_finish_pencil()
+		"move", "scale", "rotate", "node", "handle":
+			_changed(true)
+	_drag = "" if _drag != "pan" else _drag
+	_set_status()
+
+
+func _begin_transform(kind: String, handle: int) -> void:
+	_push_undo()
+	_drag = kind
+	_handle = handle
+	_bbox0 = _bounds_of(sel)
+	_orig = sel.map(func(s): return s["xf"])
+
+
+func _handle_page(b: Rect2, i: int) -> Vector2:
+	return _handle_pos(b, i) if i < 8 else b.get_center()
+
+
+func _shape_from_drag(sh: Dictionary, a: Vector2, b: Vector2, ctrl: bool) -> void:
+	var d := b - a
+	if sh["type"] == "star":
+		var ang := d.angle()
+		if ctrl:
+			ang = snappedf(ang, deg_to_rad(15.0))
+		sh.merge({"cx": a.x, "cy": a.y, "r1": d.length(), "r2": d.length() * star_ratio, "angle": ang}, true)
+		return
+	if ctrl:
+		var m := maxf(absf(d.x), absf(d.y))
+		d = Vector2(signf(d.x) if d.x != 0.0 else 1.0, signf(d.y) if d.y != 0.0 else 1.0) * m
+	var r := Rect2(a, Vector2.ZERO).expand(a + d)
+	if sh["type"] == "rect":
+		sh.merge({"x": r.position.x, "y": r.position.y, "w": r.size.x, "h": r.size.y}, true)
+	else:
+		sh.merge({"cx": r.get_center().x, "cy": r.get_center().y, "rx": r.size.x / 2.0, "ry": r.size.y / 2.0}, true)
+
+
+func _apply_style(sh: Dictionary) -> void:
+	for k in style:
+		sh[k] = style[k]
+
+
+func _finish_pen() -> void:
+	if _pen.is_empty():
+		return
+	var ns: Array = _pen["subs"][0]["nodes"]
+	# (A double-click adds the same point twice.)
+	while ns.size() >= 2 and (ns[-1]["p"] as Vector2).distance_to(ns[-2]["p"]) * zoom < 2.0:
+		ns.pop_back()
+	if ns.size() < 2:
+		doc.shapes.erase(_pen)
+		sel = []
+	else:
+		sel = [_pen]
+	_pen = {}
+	_drag = ""
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+func _finish_pencil() -> void:
+	var pts := _simplify(_pencil, 1.6 / zoom)
+	_pencil = PackedVector2Array()
+	if pts.size() < 2:
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var closed := pts.size() > 3 and _to_screen(pts[0]).distance_to(_to_screen(pts[-1])) < 10.0
+	if closed:
+		pts.remove_at(pts.size() - 1)
+	var ns := []
+	var n := pts.size()
+	for k in n:
+		var prev: Vector2 = pts[(k - 1 + n) % n] if (closed or k > 0) else pts[k]
+		var next: Vector2 = pts[(k + 1) % n] if (closed or k < n - 1) else pts[k]
+		var t := (next - prev) / 6.0
+		ns.append(SvgDoc.node(pts[k], pts[k] - t, pts[k] + t, true))
+	var sh := SvgDoc.new_shape("path")
+	_apply_style(sh)
+	if not closed:
+		sh["fill"] = null
+	sh["subs"] = [{"closed": closed, "nodes": ns}]
+	doc.shapes.append(sh)
+	_select([sh])
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+## Ramer-Douglas-Peucker simplification.
+static func _simplify(pts: PackedVector2Array, eps: float) -> PackedVector2Array:
+	if pts.size() < 3:
+		return pts
+	var keep := []
+	keep.resize(pts.size())
+	keep.fill(false)
+	keep[0] = true
+	keep[-1] = true
+	var stack := [[0, pts.size() - 1]]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var seg: Array = stack.pop_back()
+		var best := -1.0
+		var bi := -1
+		for k in range(seg[0] + 1, seg[1]):
+			var d := Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(pts[k], pts[seg[0]], pts[seg[1]]).distance_to(pts[k])
+			if d > best:
+				best = d
+				bi = k
+		if best > eps:
+			keep[bi] = true
+			stack.append([seg[0], bi])
+			stack.append([bi, seg[1]])
+	var out := PackedVector2Array()
+	for k in pts.size():
+		if keep[k]:
+			out.append(pts[k])
+	return out
+
+
+## Turns a rectangle, ellipse, star or text into an editable path.
+func _to_path(sh: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if sh["type"] == "path":
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var subs: Array = SvgDoc.to_subs(sh).duplicate(true)
+	for k in ["x", "y", "w", "h", "r", "cx", "cy", "rx", "ry", "r1", "r2", "n", "star", "angle", "text", "size", "bold"]:
+		sh.erase(k)
+	sh["type"] = "path"
+	sh["subs"] = subs
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+## The point of a selected path's outline nearest p, if within 8 px:
+## [shape, sub index, segment index, t] (else []).
+func _segment_at(p: Vector2) -> Array:
+	var best := INF
+	var hit := []
+	for sh in sel:
+		if sh["type"] != "path":
+			continue
+		var xf: Transform2D = sh["xf"]
+		var subs: Array = sh["subs"]
+		for si in subs.size():
+			var ns: Array = subs[si]["nodes"]
+			var count: int = ns.size() if subs[si]["closed"] else ns.size() - 1
+			for k in count:
+				var a: Dictionary = ns[k]
+				var b: Dictionary = ns[(k + 1) % ns.size()]
+				for s in 41:
+					var t := s / 40.0
+					var q: Vector2 = xf * _bez(a["p"], a["o"], b["i"], b["p"], t)
+					var d := q.distance_to(p)
+					if d < best:
+						best = d
+						hit = [sh, si, k, t]
+	return [] if hit.is_empty() or best * zoom > 8.0 else hit
+
+
+func _insert_node_at(p: Vector2) -> void:
+	var hit := _segment_at(p)
+	if hit.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var ns: Array = hit[0]["subs"][hit[1]]["nodes"]
+	var k: int = hit[2]
+	var t: float = hit[3]
+	var a: Dictionary = ns[k]
+	var b: Dictionary = ns[(k + 1) % ns.size()]
+	var p0: Vector2 = a["p"]
+	var c0: Vector2 = a["o"]
+	var c1: Vector2 = b["i"]
+	var p1: Vector2 = b["p"]
+	var e0 := p0.lerp(c0, t)
+	var e1 := c0.lerp(c1, t)
+	var e2 := c1.lerp(p1, t)
+	var f0 := e0.lerp(e1, t)
+	var f1 := e1.lerp(e2, t)
+	var m := f0.lerp(f1, t)
+	var straight := c0.is_equal_approx(p0) and c1.is_equal_approx(p1)
+	if not straight:
+		a["o"] = e0
+		b["i"] = e2
+	ns.insert(k + 1, SvgDoc.node(m, m if straight else f0, m if straight else f1, not straight))
+	node_sel = [[hit[0], hit[1], k + 1]]
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+static func _bez(p0: Vector2, c0: Vector2, c1: Vector2, p1: Vector2, t: float) -> Vector2:
+	var u := 1.0 - t
+	return p0 * u * u * u + c0 * 3.0 * u * u * t + c1 * 3.0 * u * t * t + p1 * t * t * t
+
+
+func delete_nodes() -> void:
+	if node_sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var by_sub := {}
+	for e in node_sel:
+		var key := [_index(e[0]), e[1]]
+		if not by_sub.has(key):
+			by_sub[key] = [e[0], []]
+		by_sub[key][1].append(e[2])
+	for key in by_sub:
+		var sh: Dictionary = by_sub[key][0]
+		var ns: Array = sh["subs"][key[1]]["nodes"]
+		var idx: Array = by_sub[key][1]
+		idx.sort()
+		idx.reverse()
+		for i in idx:
+			ns.remove_at(i)
+	for sh in sel.duplicate():
+		if sh["type"] == "path":
+			sh["subs"] = sh["subs"].filter(func(s): return s["nodes"].size() >= 2)
+			if sh["subs"].is_empty():
+				doc.shapes.erase(sh)
+				sel.erase(sh)
+	node_sel = []
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+## Node types: smooth (handles in line), sharp (no handles, straight joins).
+func set_nodes_smooth(smooth: bool) -> void:
+	if node_sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	for e in node_sel:
+		var sub: Dictionary = e[0]["subs"][e[1]]
+		var ns: Array = sub["nodes"]
+		var n: Dictionary = ns[e[2]]
+		if not smooth:
+			n["i"] = n["p"]
+			n["o"] = n["p"]
+			n["s"] = false
+			continue
+		var count := ns.size()
+		var prev: Vector2 = ns[(e[2] - 1 + count) % count]["p"] if (sub["closed"] or e[2] > 0) else n["p"]
+		var next: Vector2 = ns[(e[2] + 1) % count]["p"] if (sub["closed"] or e[2] < count - 1) else n["p"]
+		var dir := (next - prev).normalized()
+		n["i"] = n["p"] - dir * (n["p"] as Vector2).distance_to(prev) / 3.0
+		n["o"] = n["p"] + dir * (n["p"] as Vector2).distance_to(next) / 3.0
+		n["s"] = true
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+func toggle_closed() -> void:
+	var done := {}
+	_push_undo()
+	for e in (node_sel if not node_sel.is_empty() else sel.map(func(s): return [s, 0, 0])):
+		var sh: Dictionary = e[0]
+		if sh["type"] != "path" or sh["subs"].is_empty() or done.has([_index(sh), e[1]]):
+			continue
+		done[[_index(sh), e[1]]] = true
+		sh["subs"][e[1]]["closed"] = not sh["subs"][e[1]]["closed"]
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+# --- Selection, arranging ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _select(list: Array) -> void:
+	sel = []
+	for s in list:
+		if not _is_sel(s):
+			sel.append(s)
+	node_sel = []
+	_refresh_objects()
+	_rebuild_panel()
+	_canvas.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func select_all() -> void:
+	_select(doc.shapes.filter(func(s): return not s["locked"] and not s["hidden"]))
+
+
+func delete_selection() -> void:
+	if tool == "node" and not node_sel.is_empty():
+		delete_nodes()
+		return
+	if sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	for s in sel:
+		doc.shapes.erase(s)
+	sel = []
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+func duplicate_selection() -> void:
+	if sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var copies := []
+	for s in sel:
+		var c: Dictionary = s.duplicate(true)
+		doc.shapes.insert(_index(s) + 1 + copies.size(), c)
+		copies.append(c)
+	_select(copies)
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+func copy() -> void:
+	_clip = sel.map(func(s): return s.duplicate(true))
+	DisplayServer.clipboard_set(SvgDoc.new().to_svg() if sel.is_empty() else "\n".join(sel.map(func(s): return SvgDoc.shape_svg(s, false))))
+
+
+func paste() -> void:
+	if _clip.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var copies := []
+	for s in _clip:
+		var c: Dictionary = s.duplicate(true)
+		c["xf"] = Transform2D(0.0, Vector2(10, 10)) * c["xf"]
+		doc.shapes.append(c)
+		copies.append(c)
+	_clip = copies.map(func(s): return s.duplicate(true))
+	_select(copies)
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+## dir: +1 raise one step, -1 lower, +2 to the top, -2 to the bottom.
+func arrange(dir: int) -> void:
+	if sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var order := sel.duplicate()
+	order.sort_custom(func(a, b): return _index(a) > _index(b) if dir > 0 else _index(a) < _index(b))
+	for s in order:
+		var i := _index(s)
+		doc.shapes.remove_at(i)
+		var to: int
+		match dir:
+			1: to = mini(i + 1, doc.shapes.size())
+			-1: to = maxi(i - 1, 0)
+			2: to = doc.shapes.size()
+			_: to = 0
+		doc.shapes.insert(to, s)
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+## Applies a page-space transform about the selection's centre.
+func transform_selection(t: Transform2D) -> void:
+	if sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var c := _bounds_of(sel).get_center()
+	var full := Transform2D(0.0, c) * t * Transform2D(0.0, -c)
+	for s in sel:
+		s["xf"] = full * s["xf"]
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+## Aligns the selection's shapes: edge in left, hcenter, right, top, vcenter,
+## bottom; to the selection's box (or the page with one shape selected).
+func align(edge: String) -> void:
+	if sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var ref := _bounds_of(sel) if sel.size() > 1 else Rect2(0, 0, doc.width, doc.height)
+	for s in sel:
+		var b := SvgDoc.bounds(s)
+		var d := Vector2.ZERO
+		match edge:
+			"left": d.x = ref.position.x - b.position.x
+			"hcenter": d.x = ref.get_center().x - b.get_center().x
+			"right": d.x = ref.end.x - b.end.x
+			"top": d.y = ref.position.y - b.position.y
+			"vcenter": d.y = ref.get_center().y - b.get_center().y
+			"bottom": d.y = ref.end.y - b.end.y
+		s["xf"] = Transform2D(0.0, d) * s["xf"]
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+func _toggle_hidden() -> void:
+	if sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var h: bool = not sel[0]["hidden"]
+	for s in sel:
+		s["hidden"] = h
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+func _toggle_locked() -> void:
+	if sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	_push_undo()
+	var l: bool = not sel[0]["locked"]
+	for s in sel:
+		s["locked"] = l
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+func _refresh_objects() -> void:
+	if _objects == null:
+		return
+	_listing = true
+	_objects.clear()
+	var root := _objects.create_item()
+	for k in range(doc.shapes.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		var s: Dictionary = doc.shapes[k]
+		var t: String = s["type"]
+		var name: String = s["name"] if s["name"] != "" else ("%s \"%s\"" % [t.capitalize(), str(s["text"]).left(18)] if t == "text" else t.capitalize())
+		var it := _objects.create_item(root)
+		it.set_text(0, name)
+		it.set_metadata(0, k)
+		var col = s["fill"] if s["fill"] != null else s["stroke"]
+		it.set_icon(0, EditorIcons.get_icon({"rect": "rect", "ellipse": "ellipse", "star": "star_tool", "text": "text"}.get(t, "pen")))
+		if col != null:
+			it.set_icon_modulate(0, Color(col, 1.0))
+		if s["hidden"]:
+			it.set_custom_color(0, Color(0.55, 0.58, 0.65))
+		it.add_button(0, EditorIcons.get_icon("eye_off" if s["hidden"] else "eye"), 0, false,
+			("Show it" if s["hidden"] else "Hide it") + " (Shift: every selected object)")
+		it.add_button(0, EditorIcons.get_icon("lock" if s["locked"] else "unlock"), 1, false,
+			("Unlock it" if s["locked"] else "Lock it - it can't be clicked on the canvas") + " (Shift: every selected object)")
+		if _is_sel(s):
+			it.select(0)
+	_listing = false
+
+
+## The eye (id 0) and padlock (id 1) on an object's row.
+func _on_object_button(it: TreeItem, _col: int, id: int, _mb: int) -> void:
+	var k: int = it.get_metadata(0)
+	if k < 0 or k >= doc.shapes.size():
+		return
+	var sh: Dictionary = doc.shapes[k]
+	var key := "hidden" if id == 0 else "locked"
+	var value: bool = not sh[key]
+	var targets: Array = sel if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) and _is_sel(sh) else [sh]
+	_push_undo()
+	for s in targets:
+		s[key] = value
+		if key == "hidden" and value and is_same(_hover, s):
+			_hover = {}
+	_changed(true)
+
+
+func _select_from_list() -> void:
+	var picked := []
+	var it := _objects.get_next_selected(null)
+	while it:
+		var k: int = it.get_metadata(0)
+		if k >= 0 and k < doc.shapes.size():
+			picked.append(doc.shapes[k])
+		it = _objects.get_next_selected(it)
+	sel = picked
+	node_sel = []
+	_rebuild_panel()
+	_canvas.queue_redraw()
+

+# --- Right-click menu ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The node under a screen point on a selected path: [shape, sub, node] or [].
+func _node_at(screen: Vector2) -> Array:
+	for sh in sel:
+		if sh["type"] != "path":
+			continue
+		var subs: Array = sh["subs"]
+		for si in subs.size():
+			for ni in subs[si]["nodes"].size():
+				if _to_screen(sh["xf"] * subs[si]["nodes"][ni]["p"]).distance_to(screen) <= 7.0:
+					return [sh, si, ni]
+	return []
+
+
+## Builds the menu for what's under the page point p: nodes and segments
+## (Nodes tool), shapes, or the empty canvas. Returns its entries (tests).
+func context_menu(p: Vector2, at: Vector2, show := true) -> Array:
+	var items := []
+	var C := KEY_MASK_CTRL
+	var S := KEY_MASK_SHIFT
+	if tool == "node" and not sel.is_empty():
+		var n := _node_at(_to_screen(p))
+		if not n.is_empty() and not _node_selected(n[0], n[1], n[2]):
+			node_sel = [n]
+			_rebuild_panel()
+		var seg := _segment_at(p) if n.is_empty() else []
+		items.append("#NODES  (%d selected)" % node_sel.size())
+		if not seg.is_empty():
+			items.append(["Add a node here", func(): _insert_node_at(p), 0, false])
+		var some := not node_sel.is_empty()
+		items.append(["Make smooth", func(): set_nodes_smooth(true), 0, not some])
+		items.append(["Make sharp (corner)", func(): set_nodes_smooth(false), 0, not some])
+		items.append(["Delete nodes", delete_nodes, KEY_DELETE, not some])
+		items.append(["Break the path here", break_at_node, 0, not some])
+		items.append(["Close / open the path", toggle_closed, 0, false])
+		items.append("-")
+		items.append(["Select all nodes", select_all_nodes, C | KEY_A, false])
+		items.append(["Back to the Select tool", set_tool.bind("select"), KEY_S, false])
+	else:
+		var hit := shape_at(p)
+		if not hit.is_empty() and not _is_sel(hit):
+			_select([hit])
+		elif hit.is_empty() and not _bounds_of(sel).grow(4.0 / zoom).has_point(p):
+			_select([])
+		if not sel.is_empty():
+			var one: bool = sel.size() == 1
+			items.append("#" + (str(sel[0]["name"] if sel[0]["name"] != "" else sel[0]["type"]).to_upper() if one else "%d OBJECTS" % sel.size()))
+			items.append(["Cut", cut, C | KEY_X, false])
+			items.append(["Copy", copy, C | KEY_C, false])
+			items.append(["Paste", paste, C | KEY_V, _clip.is_empty()])
+			items.append(["Duplicate", duplicate_selection, C | KEY_D, false])
+			items.append(["Delete", delete_selection, KEY_DELETE, false])
+			items.append("-")
+			items.append(["Edit nodes", set_tool.bind("node"), KEY_N, false])
+			items.append(["Object to path", func():
+				for s in sel:
+					_to_path(s), C | S | KEY_C, sel.all(func(s): return s["type"] == "path")])
+			items.append("-")
+			items.append(["Raise to top", func(): arrange(2), KEY_HOME, false])
+			items.append(["Raise", func(): arrange(1), KEY_PAGEUP, false])
+			items.append(["Lower", func(): arrange(-1), KEY_PAGEDOWN, false])
+			items.append(["Lower to bottom", func(): arrange(-2), KEY_END, false])
+			items.append("-")
+			items.append(["Flip horizontally", func(): transform_selection(Transform2D(Vector2(-1, 0), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2.ZERO)), KEY_H, false])
+			items.append(["Flip vertically", func(): transform_selection(Transform2D(Vector2(1, 0), Vector2(0, -1), Vector2.ZERO)), KEY_V, false])
+			items.append(["Rotate 90° clockwise", func(): transform_selection(Transform2D(PI / 2.0, Vector2.ZERO)), 0, false])
+			items.append(["Rotate 90° anticlockwise", func(): transform_selection(Transform2D(-PI / 2.0, Vector2.ZERO)), 0, false])
+			items.append("-")
+			items.append(["Hide", _toggle_hidden, 0, false])
+			items.append(["Unlock" if sel[0]["locked"] else "Lock", _toggle_locked, 0, false])
+		else:
+			items.append("#CANVAS")
+			items.append(["Paste", paste, C | KEY_V, _clip.is_empty()])
+			items.append(["Select all", select_all, C | KEY_A, doc.shapes.is_empty()])
+			items.append("-")
+			items.append(["Zoom to the page", zoom_fit, KEY_5, false])
+			items.append(["Zoom 100%", func(): _zoom_at(_canvas.size / 2.0, 1.0 / zoom), KEY_1, false])
+			items.append([("Hide" if show_grid else "Show") + " the grid", func(): show_grid = not show_grid; _canvas.queue_redraw(), 0, false])
+			items.append([("Stop snapping" if snap else "Snap") + " to the grid", func(): snap = not snap; _set_status(), 0, false])
+			items.append("-")
+			items.append(["Export PNG...", _export_dialog, C | KEY_E, false])
+	if show:
+		_popup(items, at)
+	return items
+
+
+func _popup(items: Array, at: Vector2) -> void:
+	var m := PopupMenu.new()
+	m.theme = NeonTheme.build()
+	m.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", Settings.fs("menu", 15))
+	m.add_theme_color_override("font_separator_color", ACCENT)
+	var calls := {}
+	for e in items:
+		if e is String:
+			if e.begins_with("#"):
+				m.add_separator(e.substr(1))
+			else:
+				m.add_separator()
+			continue
+		var id := calls.size()
+		m.add_item(e[0], id)
+		var idx := m.item_count - 1
+		if int(e[2]) != 0:
+			m.set_item_accelerator(idx, e[2])
+		m.set_item_disabled(idx, e[3])
+		calls[id] = e[1]
+	m.id_pressed.connect(func(id): (calls[id] as Callable).call())
+	m.popup_hide.connect(m.queue_free)
+	add_child(m)
+	m.popup(Rect2i(Vector2i(at), Vector2i.ZERO))
+
+
+func cut() -> void:
+	copy()
+	delete_selection()
+
+
+func select_all_nodes() -> void:
+	node_sel = []
+	for sh in sel:
+		if sh["type"] == "path":
+			for si in sh["subs"].size():
+				for ni in sh["subs"][si]["nodes"].size():
+					node_sel.append([sh, si, ni])
+	_rebuild_panel()
+	_canvas.queue_redraw()
+
+
+## Breaks the path at the (first) selected node: a closed path opens there;
+## an open one splits in two (the node is doubled, one copy in each part).
+func break_at_node() -> void:
+	if node_sel.is_empty():
+		return
+	var e: Array = node_sel[0]
+	var sh: Dictionary = e[0]
+	var sub: Dictionary = sh["subs"][e[1]]
+	var ns: Array = sub["nodes"]
+	var k: int = e[2]
+	_push_undo()
+	if sub["closed"]:
+		var opened: Array = ns.slice(k) + ns.slice(0, k)
+		var tail: Dictionary = (opened[0] as Dictionary).duplicate()
+		opened[0]["i"] = opened[0]["p"]
+		tail["o"] = tail["p"]
+		opened.append(tail)
+		sub["nodes"] = opened
+		sub["closed"] = false
+	elif k > 0 and k < ns.size() - 1:
+		var first: Array = ns.slice(0, k + 1)
+		var second: Array = ns.slice(k)
+		second[0] = (second[0] as Dictionary).duplicate()
+		first[-1]["o"] = first[-1]["p"]
+		second[0]["i"] = second[0]["p"]
+		sub["nodes"] = first
+		sh["subs"].insert(e[1] + 1, {"closed": false, "nodes": second})
+	node_sel = []
+	_changed(true)
+

+				_panel.add_child(_row("Font size", _spin(1.0, 1000.0, 1.0, float(one["size"]), func(v): set_prop("size", v), " px"), "Height of the letters."))

+func _set_geometry(key: String, v: float) -> void:

@@ -1,0 +1,234 @@ 
+class_name TalosNav
+extends RefCounted
+## Talos's navigation rail: one column down the left of every Talos screen
+## listing every tool by icon and name - Versions (the patch notes) at the
+## top, then the Library, the data editor's pages (Dialogue, Chapters, Lore,
+## Citizens, Sprites), then the tools (Scenarios, SVG) and, at the foot, the way out to the title screen. The tool
+## you're in is lit. Click another and you're there - no going back to a hub
+## first (each screen asks about unsaved changes before it lets you go).
+##   var root := TalosNav.wrap(UI.modal(...), "svg", func(id): _guard(func(): TalosNav.open(get_tree(), id)))
+##   (the screen's own header and body then go in `root`)
+
+const EDITOR := "res://scenes/editor/editor.tscn"
+const MENU := "res://scenes/ui/main_menu.tscn"
+## The rail's size, the same on every screen: it never moves or resizes
+## (fixed font, text clipped, never scaled by the text-size setting).
+const WIDTH := 92
+const ITEM_H := 64
+## Where it sits on screen (the full-screen frames' inside corner; the
+## Library places its own rail there too).
+const AT := Vector2(44, 44)
+
+## [id, name, icon, keys, what it is]; "" separates the groups.
+const TOOLS := [
+	["patcher", "Versions", "patch", "F7", "Every version of the game and its patches: what each brought, as a one-paragraph summary\nand a step-by-step animated infographic (opens on the newest), with the code review behind it."],
+	"",
+	["dialogue", "Dialogue", "dialogue", "Ctrl+1", "Each stage of the main quest: its objective, rewards and the dialogue\nthat plays when it starts. Preview the dialogue in the game's own box."],
+	["chapters", "Chapters", "ui_journal", "Ctrl+2", "The titles of the main quest's chapters, as shown in the Ship Computer."],
+	["lore", "Lore", "lore", "Ctrl+3", "The lore entries the player unlocks during the quest (titles and BBCode text)."],
+	["citizens", "Citizens", "chat", "Ctrl+4", "What Minoan citizens say when you click them: the Minoan words\nand their translation (shown in the event log)."],
+	["sprites", "Sprites", "sprites", "Ctrl+5", "Every sprite of the game by group (hover one for its key and file).\nReload them after re-cutting the reference sheets."],
+	"",
+	["svg", "SVG", "svg", "F6", "A vector drawing program: shapes, Bezier paths, freehand, text, fill and stroke, nodes,\nlayers of objects. Opens and saves SVG files and exports PNG images at any size."],
+]
+## The data editor's pages, in TOOLS order (DevMode.TABS).
+const PAGES := ["dialogue", "chapters", "lore", "citizens", "sprites"]
+const SCENES := {"svg": "res://scenes/editor/svg_editor.tscn", "patcher": "res://scenes/editor/patcher.tscn", "menu": MENU}
+
+## The data editor's page to open on (set when another tool sends you to one).
+static var page := 0
+
+
+## The rail, `current` lit; clicking a tool calls go(id) ("menu": the title screen).
+## `keys`: the rail also answers the tools' shortcuts (Ctrl+1-5, F3, F4, F6, F7)
+## - not for the data editor, which has its own.
+static func rail(current: String, go: Callable, keys := true) -> VBoxContainer:
+	_warm()
+	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
+	box.name = "TalosNav"
+	if keys:
+		var k := Keys.new()
+		k.go = go
+		k.current = current
+		box.add_child(k)
+	box.custom_minimum_size.x = WIDTH
+	box.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
+	box.set_meta("fixed_font", true)   # (UI.scale_fonts leaves it alone)
+	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	for t in TOOLS:
+		if t is String:
+			var sep := HSeparator.new()
+			sep.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+			box.add_child(sep)
+			continue
+		box.add_child(_item(t[0], t[1], t[2], EditorIcons.tip(t[1], t[3], t[4]), go))
+	var gap := Control.new()
+	gap.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	box.add_child(gap)
+	if SaveGame.talos_return:   # (opened from a game: leaving goes back to it)
+		box.add_child(_item("menu", "Back", "exit", EditorIcons.tip("Back to the game", "Esc", "Back to your game, where you left it. Each tool asks about unsaved changes first;\nwhat you changed here applies to it.")
+			, go))
+	else:
+		box.add_child(_item("menu", "Exit", "exit", EditorIcons.tip("Exit Talos", "Esc", "Back to the title screen. Each tool asks about unsaved changes first;\nedits already made apply to games started from here on.")
+			, go))
+	select(box, current)
+	return box
+
+
+static func _item(id: String, name: String, icon: String, tip: String, go: Callable) -> Button:
+	var b := Button.new()
+	b.name = "Nav_" + id
+	b.text = name
+	b.icon = EditorIcons.get_icon(icon)
+	b.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	b.vertical_icon_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_TOP
+	b.toggle_mode = true
+	b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(WIDTH, ITEM_H)
+	b.clip_text = true   # (a long name can't widen the rail)
+	b.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
+	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
+	b.tooltip_text = tip
+	b.set_meta("talos_nav", id)
+	b.pressed.connect(func():
+		select(b.get_parent(), str(b.get_parent().get_meta("current", "")))   # (lit only when you get there)
+		go.call(id))
+	return b
+
+
+## The tools' scenes, loaded in the background once Talos is open, so the
+## first visit to each doesn't wait for its scripts and scene to load
+## (~0.4-1 s the first time; then they're ready).
+static func _warm() -> void:
+	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
+		return
+	for path in [EDITOR] + SCENES.values():
+		if path != MENU and not ResourceLoader.has_cached(path) and ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path) == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE:
+			ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path)
+
+
+## Lights `current`'s button.
+static func select(box: Node, current: String) -> void:
+	box.set_meta("current", current)
+	for b in box.get_children():
+		if b is Button:
+			b.set_pressed_no_signal(b.get_meta("talos_nav", "") == current)
+
+
+## The rail beside a screen's content: `root` (a full-screen modal's box)
+## gets the rail and a column for the screen, which is returned.
+static func wrap(root: VBoxContainer, current: String, go: Callable, keys := true) -> VBoxContainer:
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
+	root.add_child(row)
+	row.add_child(rail(current, go, keys))
+	var sep := VSeparator.new()
+	row.add_child(sep)
+	var col := VBoxContainer.new()
+	col.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	col.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	col.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	row.add_child(col)
+	return col
+
+
+## The Talos host (editor_screen.gd: every tool kept, switched by showing
+## one), or null when a tool runs as a scene of its own (tests).
+static func host(tree: SceneTree) -> Node:
+	var s := tree.current_scene
+	if s != null and s.has_method("show_tool"):
+		return s
+	return tree.get_first_node_in_group("talos_host")   # (Talos over a game)
+
+
+## The rail's click from a tool: in the host, straight there (the tool stays
+## as it is, so nothing to ask); on its own, `guard` first (it asks about
+## unsaved changes, then calls what it's given), then the tool's scene.
+static func go(tree: SceneTree, id: String, guard := Callable()) -> void:
+	var h := host(tree)
+	if h:
+		h.show_tool(id)
+	elif guard.is_valid():
+		guard.call(func(): open(tree, id))
+	else:
+		open(tree, id)
+
+
+## A tool's scene: the one loaded in the background (_warm) if it's there.
+static func scene(path: String) -> PackedScene:
+	if ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path) != ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE:
+		var r := ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(path)
+		if r is PackedScene:
+			return r
+	return load(path)
+
+
+## Leaves Talos: back to the game it was opened from (SaveGame.open_talos),
+## else to the title screen.
+static func leave(tree: SceneTree) -> void:
+	if SaveGame.close_talos():
+		return   # (Talos was over the game: the game, as it was)
+	if SaveGame.talos_return and SaveGame.return_from_talos():
+		return
+	tree.change_scene_to_file(MENU)
+
+
+## Goes to tool `id` (a data-editor page, a tool, or "menu").
+static func open(tree: SceneTree, id: String) -> void:
+	var h := host(tree)
+	if h:
+		h.show_tool(id)   # ("menu": the host's exit - it asks about unsaved changes, then leave())
+		return
+	if id == "menu":
+		leave(tree)
+		return
+	if id in PAGES:
+		page = PAGES.find(id)
+		tree.change_scene_to_file(EDITOR)
+	elif SCENES.has(id):
+		tree.change_scene_to_file(SCENES[id])
+
+
+## A screen's header: its name (and a line under it, `note`, for status
+## messages) on the left; the screen's own buttons go after the spacer.
+## Returns [header, note label].
+static func header(title: String, note: String, accent: Color) -> Array:
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	var t := UI.label(title, 24, accent)
+	t.name = "TalosTitle"
+	h.add_child(t)
+	var n := UI.label(note, 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	n.name = "TalosNote"
+	n.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	n.clip_text = true
+	n.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
+	n.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	h.add_child(n)
+	return [h, n]
+
+
+## The tools' shortcuts, wherever you are in Talos (before the tool's own keys:
+## Ctrl+digit isn't a room or a zoom here).
+class Keys extends Node:
+	var go: Callable
+	var current := ""
+
+	func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+		var k := event as InputEventKey
+		if k == null or not k.pressed or k.echo or not is_visible_in_tree_safe():
+			return
+		var id := ""
+		if k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode >= KEY_1 and k.keycode < KEY_1 + PAGES.size():
+			id = PAGES[k.keycode - KEY_1]
+		elif not k.ctrl_pressed:
+			id = {KEY_F6: "svg", KEY_F7: "patcher"}.get(k.keycode, "")
+		if id == "" or id == current:
+			return
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+		go.call(id)
+
+	func is_visible_in_tree_safe() -> bool:
+		var p := get_parent() as Control
+		return p != null and p.is_visible_in_tree()
hunks.title: The new talos_nav.gd
hunks.note: Talos's navigation rail.

bubbles.at: static func rail(current: String, go: Callable, keys := true) -> VBoxC
bubbles.text: The rail, `current` lit; clicking a tool calls go(id) ("menu": the title screen). `keys`: the rail also answers the tools' shortcuts (Ctrl+1-5, F3, F4, F6, F7) - not for the data editor, which has its own.

bubbles.at: static func select(box: Node, current: String) -> void:
bubbles.text: Lights `current`'s button.

bubbles.at: static func go(tree: SceneTree, id: String, guard := Callable()) -> vo
bubbles.text: The rail's click from a tool: in the host, straight there (the tool stays as it is, so nothing to ask); on its own, `guard` first (it asks about unsaved changes, then calls what it's given), then the tool's scene.
Leaves Talos: back to the game it was opened from (SaveGame.open_talos), else to the title screen.

The game's rules and data (no visuals): Whether a shot lands. Every shooter has an accuracy - its chance to hit a still target at close range (your ship: BASE_SHIP and its upgrades; NPC ships by class; the automaton: BASE_FOOT and its gear; pirates, beasts) - less the target's evasion (its own stat, and how fast it moves across the line of fire) and a little more the further it is (beyond half the reach). A miss isn't a hit that does nothing: the shot is aimed past the target, beside it (miss_dir) and flies on by - it never touches it. (Moved from scripts/accuracy.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,48 @@ 
+class_name Accuracy
+extends RefCounted
+## Whether a shot lands. Every shooter has an accuracy - its chance to hit a
+## still target at close range (your ship: BASE_SHIP and its upgrades; NPC
+## ships by class; the automaton: BASE_FOOT and its gear; pirates, beasts) -
+## less the target's evasion (its own stat, and how fast it moves across the
+## line of fire) and a little more the further it is (beyond half the reach).
+## A miss isn't a hit that does nothing: the shot is aimed past the target,
+## beside it (miss_dir) and flies on by - it never touches it.
+
+const BASE_SHIP := 0.86
+const BASE_FOOT := 0.88
+## NPC ships' accuracy by hull class.
+const NPC := {"interceptor": 0.74, "fighter": 0.74, "courier": 0.68, "explorer": 0.68, "freighter": 0.62,
+	"gunship": 0.72, "frigate": 0.70, "cruiser": 0.70, "battleship": 0.68, "dreadnought": 0.68}
+const MIN_HIT := 0.05
+const MAX_HIT := 0.98
+
+
+## The chance a shot from `from` (accuracy `acc`, reach `reach`) lands on `target`.
+static func chance(acc: float, from: Vector2, target: Node2D, reach := 800.0) -> float:
+	if not is_instance_valid(target):
+		return 0.0
+	var tp: Vector2 = target.global_position
+	var d := from.distance_to(tp)
+	var ev := float(target.get("evasion")) if target.get("evasion") != null else 0.0
+	# Moving across the line of fire is harder to hit than coming straight on.
+	var v = target.get("velocity")
+	if v is Vector2 and d > 1.0:
+		var across := absf((v as Vector2).cross((tp - from) / d))
+		ev += 0.12 * clampf(across / 450.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+	var far := 0.15 * clampf(d / maxf(1.0, reach) - 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)
+	return clampf(acc * (1.0 - ev) - far, MIN_HIT, MAX_HIT)
+
+
+## Every shot lands (tests that measure something other than aim: a beam's drain, a fight's turn).
+static var sure := false
+
+static func roll(acc: float, from: Vector2, target: Node2D, reach := 800.0) -> bool:
+	return sure or randf() < chance(acc, from, target, reach)
+
+
+## A missed shot's direction: from `from` toward a point beside `aim`, clear
+## of a target of radius `r` (by 1.3 to 2.2 of it, either side).
+static func miss_dir(from: Vector2, aim: Vector2, r: float) -> Vector2:
+	var to := aim - from
+	var side := to.orthogonal().normalized() * (1.0 if randf() < 0.5 else -1.0)
+	return from.direction_to(aim + side * r * randf_range(1.3, 2.2))

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): What a ship's damaged parts do to how it flies and fights, beyond weaker numbers (Parts: each part's "effects", scaled by how much of the part is lost): the same for your ship (Ship) and any other (Enemy - its own condition, damaged by hull hits through Parts.hit like yours). "jitter" (Manoeuvring Thrusters) - the ship jerks off its course and wobbles: a random push now and then. "misfire" (Weapon Mounts' fire control) - now and then it loses the target and the guns fire wild for a second or two. "scatter" (Sensor Array) - shots spread off the aim. Each takes `k`: the effect's size, 0 (sound) .. 1 (the part gone) - felt as its square root (a part a third gone already shows: _felt). One state dictionary per ship (new_state()), paced by time, not frames. (Moved from scripts/affliction.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,75 @@ 
+class_name Affliction
+extends RefCounted
+## What a ship's damaged parts do to how it flies and fights, beyond weaker
+## numbers (Parts: each part's "effects", scaled by how much of the part is
+## lost): the same for your ship (Ship) and any other (Enemy - its own
+## condition, damaged by hull hits through Parts.hit like yours).
+##   "jitter"  (Manoeuvring Thrusters) - the ship jerks off its course and
+##             wobbles: a random push now and then.
+##   "misfire" (Weapon Mounts' fire control) - now and then it loses the target
+##             and the guns fire wild for a second or two.
+##   "scatter" (Sensor Array) - shots spread off the aim.
+## Each takes `k`: the effect's size, 0 (sound) .. 1 (the part gone) - felt
+## as its square root (a part a third gone already shows: _felt).
+## One state dictionary per ship (new_state()), paced by time, not frames.
+
+## How hard the worst jitter pushes, as a share of the ship's top speed.
+const JITTER_PUSH := 0.4
+## How far the worst jitter turns the nose (radians).
+const JITTER_TURN := 0.22
+## The fire control losing the target: chances a second at k = 1, and for how long (s).
+const MISFIRE_RATE := 0.3
+const MISFIRE_TIME := Vector2(1.0, 2.2)
+## How wide wild shots go off the nose (radians, either way).
+const WILD_ARC := 1.1
+## The worst sensor scatter (radians, either way).
+const SCATTER := 0.38
+
+
+static func _felt(k: float) -> float:
+	return sqrt(clampf(k, 0.0, 1.0))
+
+
+static func new_state() -> Dictionary:
+	return {"jt": 0.0, "jv": Vector2.ZERO, "jr": 0.0, "wild": 0.0}
+
+
+## The thrusters' misfiring: a push (px/s per second, `speed`: the ship's top
+## speed) - a new random kick every quarter to two-thirds of a second.
+static func jitter_push(st: Dictionary, k: float, delta: float, speed: float) -> Vector2:
+	if k <= 0.01:
+		return Vector2.ZERO
+	st["jt"] = float(st["jt"]) - delta
+	if float(st["jt"]) <= 0.0:
+		st["jt"] = randf_range(0.25, 0.7)
+		st["jv"] = Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(0.5, 1.0)
+		st["jr"] = randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)
+	return st["jv"] * _felt(k) * speed * JITTER_PUSH
+
+
+## The nose's wobble from the thrusters (radians a second to turn by).
+static func jitter_turn(st: Dictionary, k: float) -> float:
+	return float(st["jr"]) * _felt(k) * JITTER_TURN * 6.0 if k > 0.01 else 0.0
+
+
+## Is the fire control off its target now? Starts a wild spell at random
+## (more often the worse the mounts); returns 1 the frame one starts, 2 while
+## it lasts, 0 when it's on target.
+static func misfire(st: Dictionary, k: float, delta: float) -> int:
+	if float(st["wild"]) > 0.0:
+		st["wild"] = float(st["wild"]) - delta
+		return 2
+	if k > 0.01 and randf() < _felt(k) * MISFIRE_RATE * delta:
+		st["wild"] = randf_range(MISFIRE_TIME.x, MISFIRE_TIME.y)
+		return 1
+	return 0
+
+
+## A wild shot's direction: somewhere ahead of the nose, not at the target.
+static func wild_dir(facing: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	return facing.normalized().rotated(randf_range(-WILD_ARC, WILD_ARC))
+
+
+## A shot's aim knocked off by damaged sensors.
+static func scattered(dir: Vector2, k: float) -> Vector2:
+	return dir.rotated(randf_range(-1.0, 1.0) * SCATTER * _felt(k)) if k > 0.01 else dir

+static func generate(template: String, variant := 0, look := {}) -> Dictionary:

+		p["time_offset"] = rng.randf_range(0.0, 100.0)
+		# Colour: rocks stay rocky - small hue and value steps.
+		var dh := (fposmod(float(variant) * 0.618034, 1.0) - 0.5) * 0.06
+		var val := rng.randf_range(0.85, 1.12)
+		for k in ["c_rock", "c_dark", "c_light", "c_rust"]:
+			var c: Color = p[k]
+			p[k] = Color.from_hsv(fposmod(c.h + dh, 1.0), clampf(c.s * rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.2), 0.0, 1.0), clampf(c.v * val, 0.0, 1.0))
+	p.merge(look, true)
+	p["tags"] = tags
+	p["color"] = p["c_rock"]
+	return p
+
+
+## The look of an in-game asteroid: its ore type and seed pick the template
+## and variant; a Themes preset can restyle it (asteroid kind, by system).
+static func for_rock(ore: String, seed_: int, themed := true) -> Dictionary:
+	var template: String = "contact_binary" if posmod(seed_, 3) == 0 else "craggy"
+	var p := generate(template, 1 + posmod(seed_, 100003))
+	p.merge(ORE.get(ore, ORE["iron"]), true)
+	p["ore"] = ore
+	if themed:
+		p.merge(Themes.pick("asteroid", Themes.context(), seed_, template), true)
+	p["color"] = p["c_rock"]
+	return p
+
+
+static func describe(p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var s: String = p.get("name", "Asteroid")
+	if not p.get("tags", []).is_empty():
+		s += " · " + ", ".join(p["tags"])
+	return s
+
+
+static func _mutate(p: Dictionary, m: String, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> void:
+	match m:
+		"contact binary":
+			p["binary"] = rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.0)
+			p["lobe_ratio"] = rng.randf_range(0.6, 0.95)
+			p["neck"] = rng.randf_range(0.06, 0.25)
+			p["elongation"] = minf(float(p["elongation"]), 1.25)
+		"elongated":
+			p["elongation"] = rng.randf_range(1.7, 2.2)
+			p["binary"] = float(p["binary"]) * 0.5
+		"shard":
+			p["flatten"] = rng.randf_range(0.42, 0.58)
+			p["crags"] = maxf(float(p["crags"]), rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.1))
+			p["binary"] = 0.0
+		"rubble pile":
+			p["lumps"] = rng.randf_range(1.0, 1.3)
+			p["lump_scale"] = rng.randf_range(2.4, 3.2)
+			p["crags"] = float(p["crags"]) * 0.5
+		"heavily cratered":
+			p["craters"] = rng.randf_range(1.2, 1.5)
+			p["small_craters"] = rng.randf_range(1.1, 1.4)
+			p["crater_scale"] = rng.randf_range(2.6, 3.4)
+		"smooth":
+			p["craters"] = float(p["craters"]) * 0.4
+			p["pitting"] = float(p["pitting"]) * 0.4
+			p["crags"] = float(p["crags"]) * 0.3
+		"rusty":
+			p["rust"] = rng.randf_range(0.65, 0.9)
+			p["rust_scale"] = rng.randf_range(1.4, 2.6)
+		"dusty":
+			p["dust"] = rng.randf_range(0.6, 0.9)
+		"dark carbon":
+			p["c_rock"] = (p["c_rock"] as Color).darkened(0.4)
+			p["c_light"] = (p["c_light"] as Color).darkened(0.3)
+			p["rust"] = float(p["rust"]) * 0.4
+		"pale":
+			p["c_rock"] = (p["c_rock"] as Color).lightened(0.2)
+		"pitted":
+			p["pitting"] = rng.randf_range(1.1, 1.4)
+		"tumbling":
+			p["tumble"] = rng.randf_range(0.9, 1.3)
+
+
+## Half the rock's longest axis, in body units (the shader's shapes).
+static func extent(p: Dictionary) -> float:
+	var b := float(p.get("binary", 0.0))
+	var e := float(p.get("elongation", 1.3)) * lerpf(1.0, 0.72, b)
+	var lr := float(p.get("lobe_ratio", 0.8))
+	var x := maxf(0.62 * b + e, 0.62 * b * lr + 0.05 + e * lr) if b > 0.01 else e
+	return maxf(x, 1.0) + 0.08 * float(p.get("lumps", 0.5)) + 0.05 * float(p.get("crags", 0.3))
+
+
+## A ColorRect showing the rock, its long half-axis `radius` px, centred on (0, 0).
+static func make(p: Dictionary, radius: float) -> ColorRect:
+	var rect := ColorRect.new()
+	var size := radius * FRAME * 2.0
+	rect.size = Vector2(size, size)
+	rect.position = -rect.size / 2.0
+	rect.pivot_offset = rect.size / 2.0
+	rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	mat.shader = SHADER
+	for k in p:
+		if not k in META:
+			mat.set_shader_parameter(k, p[k])
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("detail", 4 if radius > 90.0 else 3)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("fit", 1.0 / (FRAME * extent(p)))
+	rect.material = mat
+	rect.set_meta("spec", p.duplicate())
+	return rect
+
+
+## Applies one property to a rock made by make() (live editing).
+static func apply(node: Node, key: String, value: Variant) -> void:
+	var mat: ShaderMaterial = node.material if node is CanvasItem else null
+	if mat == null:
+		return
+	mat.set_shader_parameter(key, value)
+	var spec: Dictionary = node.get_meta("spec", {})
+	spec[key] = value
+	node.set_meta("spec", spec)
+	if key in SHAPE_KEYS:
+		mat.set_shader_parameter("fit", 1.0 / (FRAME * extent(spec)))

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): What you've discovered, for the Encyclopedia: the entries it lists stay "? ? ?" until you've met the thing - a ship class that came near, a station you came up to, an asteroid kind you got close to, a planet or a nebula you flew by, weapons and systems seen at a station's outfitter or fitted, items you've held. Keys: "ship:<type id>", "station:<name>", "asteroid:<kind>", "planet:<id>", "nebula", "gear:<id>", "item:<id>". Kept in PlayerData.discovered (saved); on a planet, in the surface's state["player"] (the same data, as a dictionary). (Moved from scripts/discovery.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,76 @@ 
+class_name Discovery
+## What you've discovered, for the Encyclopedia: the entries it lists stay
+## "? ? ?" until you've met the thing - a ship class that came near, a station
+## you came up to, an asteroid kind you got close to, a planet or a nebula you
+## flew by, weapons and systems seen at a station's outfitter or fitted, items
+## you've held. Keys: "ship:<type id>", "station:<name>", "asteroid:<kind>",
+## "planet:<id>", "nebula", "gear:<id>", "item:<id>".
+## Kept in PlayerData.discovered (saved); on a planet, in the surface's
+## state["player"] (the same data, as a dictionary).
+
+const SHIP_RANGE := 1800.0       # a ship this near (about a screen) is seen
+const ROCK_RANGE := 800.0
+const PLANET_RANGE := 700.0      # beyond the planet's disc
+const NEBULA_RANGE := 2200.0
+
+
+## The discovered set: PlayerData's in space; on a planet, the surface state's
+## player dictionary (saved as a list of keys - made a dictionary in place).
+static func _known_set(tree: SceneTree) -> Dictionary:
+	var pd: Node = tree.get_first_node_in_group("player_data") if tree else null
+	if pd != null:
+		return pd.discovered
+	var player: Dictionary = {}
+	var scene: Node = tree.current_scene if tree else null
+	var st: Variant = scene.get("state") if scene else null
+	if st is Dictionary and st.has("player"):
+		player = st["player"]
+	elif SaveGame.space_state is Dictionary and SaveGame.space_state.has("player"):
+		player = SaveGame.space_state["player"]
+	var d: Variant = player.get("discovered")
+	if not (d is Dictionary):
+		var made := {}
+		for k in (d if d is Array else []):
+			made[str(k)] = true
+		player["discovered"] = made
+	return player["discovered"]
+
+
+static func known(tree: SceneTree, key: String) -> bool:
+	return _known_set(tree).get(key, false)
+
+
+## True if it was new.
+static func mark(tree: SceneTree, key: String) -> bool:
+	var d := _known_set(tree)
+	if d.get(key, false):
+		return false
+	d[key] = true
+	return true
+
+
+## (Main, now and then) What's near the ship now.
+static func scan(main: Node) -> void:
+	var tree := main.get_tree()
+	var ship: Node2D = main.ship
+	if ship == null or not ship.is_alive():
+		return
+	var at: Vector2 = ship.global_position
+	for g in ["enemies", "neutrals"]:
+		for e in tree.get_nodes_in_group(g):
+			if e.is_alive() and at.distance_to(e.global_position) < SHIP_RANGE:
+				mark(tree, "ship:" + str(e.type_id))
+	for st in tree.get_nodes_in_group("stations"):
+		if at.distance_to(st.global_position) < st.dock_radius * 2.5:
+			mark(tree, "station:" + str(st.station_name))
+	for a in tree.get_nodes_in_group("asteroids"):
+		if at.distance_to(a.global_position) < ROCK_RANGE:
+			mark(tree, "asteroid:" + str(a.kind))
+	for b in tree.get_nodes_in_group("planet_bodies"):
+		if str(b.planet_id) != "" and at.distance_to(b.global_position) < b.radius + PLANET_RANGE:
+			mark(tree, "planet:" + str(b.planet_id))
+	var nebs: Node = main.get_node_or_null("Nebulae")
+	if nebs:
+		for n in nebs.get_children():
+			if n is Node2D and at.distance_to(n.global_position) < NEBULA_RANGE:
+				mark(tree, "nebula")

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): War fleets (autoload "Fleets"): every empire keeps fleets of MIN_SIZE to MAX_SIZE warships. Defence fleets hold its systems (about one for every three), and go to the help of a system under siege nearby; at war, an empire sends invasion fleets against the enemy systems on its border. Invasions are events: an empire gathers two or three fleets at a staging system on its border (each from a system of its own); when they're all there (or after GATHER_TIME) they set out together against the target. A station under siege sends a distress call (distress): the defence fleets of its owner and of the owner's allies within DISTRESS_JUMPS answer it; allies go home when the danger is over. Away from you it's all worked out here, every TICK seconds: fleets move along the gate lanes (HOP_TIME a jump); where enemies meet they trade losses; an invasion with no defenders left wears down the stations of the empires it's at war with (Galaxy.damage_station) - destroyed at 0 - and when the system's owner has no station left there, the system falls to the invader (its fleet stays on to defend it). A peace sends invasions home. In the system you're in the fleets are real ships (main.gd spawns them, and the ones arriving: fleet_arrived): defenders patrol, invaders go for the stations; each ship lost counts (ship_lost). While you're there, that system's fleets don't move and its fight isn't worked out here. (Moved from scripts/fleets.gd.)
