@@ -1,0 +1,391 @@ 
+extends Node
+## War fleets (autoload "Fleets"): every empire keeps fleets of MIN_SIZE to
+## MAX_SIZE warships. Defence fleets hold its systems (about one for every
+## three), and go to the help of a system under siege nearby; at war, an
+## empire sends invasion fleets against the enemy systems on its border.
+##
+## Invasions are events: an empire gathers two or three fleets at a staging
+## system on its border (each from a system of its own); when they're all
+## there (or after GATHER_TIME) they set out together against the target.
+## A station under siege sends a distress call (distress): the defence fleets
+## of its owner and of the owner's allies within DISTRESS_JUMPS answer it;
+## allies go home when the danger is over.
+##
+## Away from you it's all worked out here, every TICK seconds: fleets move
+## along the gate lanes (HOP_TIME a jump); where enemies meet they trade
+## losses; an invasion with no defenders left wears down the stations of the
+## empires it's at war with (Galaxy.damage_station) - destroyed at 0 - and
+## when the system's owner has no station left there, the system falls to
+## the invader (its fleet stays on to defend it). A peace sends invasions home.
+##
+## In the system you're in the fleets are real ships (main.gd spawns them,
+## and the ones arriving: fleet_arrived): defenders patrol, invaders go for
+## the stations; each ship lost counts (ship_lost). While you're there, that
+## system's fleets don't move and its fight isn't worked out here.
+
+signal fleet_arrived(fleet: Dictionary)
+signal changed
+
+const TICK := 5.0
+const HOP_TIME := 30.0
+const MIN_SIZE := 3
+const MAX_SIZE := 12
+## Station damage an invading ship does a tick (a 10-ship fleet: 6 a tick,
+## a healthy station falls in about a minute and a half of siege).
+const SIEGE_DAMAGE := 0.6
+## A station mends this much a tick when nobody besieges its system.
+const MEND := 0.4
+## An invasion's fleets wait at most this long for each other at the staging system.
+const GATHER_TIME := 120.0
+## How far (gate jumps) a distress call reaches, and how many fleets answer it.
+const DISTRESS_JUMPS := 4
+const DISTRESS_ANSWER := 2
+## A system's distress call is sent again at most this often (s).
+const DISTRESS_EVERY := 60.0
+
+var fleets := {}   # id -> {id, empire, mission ("defend" / "invade"), size, system, route: [], t, target;
+                   #  invasions: event, stage, waiting; answering a distress call: answering}
+var _next := 1
+var _clock := 0.0     # the simulation's own time (s) - for gathering and distress calls
+var _distress := {}   # system id -> _clock of its last distress call
+var _t := TICK
+var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+
+
+func reset() -> void:
+	fleets = {}
+	_next = 1
+	_clock = 0.0
+	_distress = {}
+	_rng.seed = 11
+	_t = TICK
+	_staff()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not Galaxy.active:
+		return
+	_t -= delta
+	if _t <= 0.0:
+		_t = TICK
+		_tick()
+
+
+func _tick() -> void:
+	_clock += TICK
+	_staff()
+	_move()
+	_fight()
+	_mend()
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+# --- Queries ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func in_system(sys_id: String) -> Array:
+	return fleets.values().filter(func(f): return f["system"] == sys_id)
+
+
+## Is this station's system besieged by an empire at war with its owner?
+func besieged(station_id: String) -> bool:
+	var st: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations.get(station_id, {})
+	if st.is_empty():
+		return false
+	var owner := Galaxy.station_owner(station_id)
+	for f in fleets.values():
+		if f["system"] == st["system"] and f["mission"] == "invade" and f["route"].is_empty() and not f.get("waiting", false) and Galaxy.at_war(f["empire"], owner):
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## The empires besieging a system (for the defence missions).
+func besiegers(sys_id: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for f in fleets.values():
+		if f["system"] == sys_id and f["mission"] == "invade" and f["route"].is_empty() and not f.get("waiting", false) and not f["empire"] in out:
+			out.append(f["empire"])
+	return out
+
+
+func ship_lost(fleet_id: String) -> void:
+	var f: Dictionary = fleets.get(fleet_id, {})
+	if f.is_empty():
+		return
+	f["size"] -= 1
+	if f["size"] <= 0:
+		fleets.erase(fleet_id)
+		_news("%s: a %s %s fleet has been wiped out." % [Galaxy.system(f["system"]).get("name", "?"),
+			Galaxy.EMPIRES[f["empire"]]["short"], "invasion" if f["mission"] == "invade" else "defence"], "news")
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+# --- Fleets come and go ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _owned(e: String) -> Array:
+	return Galaxy.systems.keys().filter(func(id): return Galaxy.owner_of(id) == e)
+
+
+## Keeps every empire's defence fleets up (one for three systems) and, at war,
+## an invasion going against each enemy it borders.
+func _staff() -> void:
+	for e in Galaxy.MAJOR:
+		var own := _owned(e)
+		if own.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var mine: Array = fleets.values().filter(func(f): return f["empire"] == e)
+		var defenders := mine.filter(func(f): return f["mission"] == "defend").size()
+		if defenders < ceili(own.size() / 3.0):
+			var at: String = own[_rng.randi() % own.size()]
+			_new_fleet(e, "defend", at, _rng.randi_range(MIN_SIZE, 8), [])
+		for o in Galaxy.MAJOR:
+			if o == e or not Galaxy.at_war(e, o):
+				continue
+			if mine.any(func(f): return f["mission"] == "invade" and Galaxy.owner_of(f["target"]) == o):
+				continue
+			if _rng.randf() > 0.25:
+				continue   # (not every tick: invasions gather)
+			# An enemy system next to ours.
+			var fronts := []
+			for id in _owned(o):
+				if id == Galaxy.HOME:
+					continue   # (the story's home holds)
+				for n in Galaxy.neighbors(id):
+					if Galaxy.owner_of(n) == e:
+						fronts.append([n, id])
+						break
+			if fronts.is_empty():
+				continue
+			var pick: Array = fronts[_rng.randi() % fronts.size()]
+			_launch_invasion(e, pick[0], pick[1])
+
+
+## An invasion event: two or three fleets, each from a system of `e` near
+## the staging system `stage` (next to `target`), gather there and then set
+## out together.
+func _launch_invasion(e: String, stage: String, target: String) -> void:
+	var event := "inv%d" % _next
+	var homes: Array = [stage]
+	for n in Galaxy.neighbors(stage):
+		if Galaxy.owner_of(n) == e:
+			homes.append(n)
+	var count := 2 + (1 if _rng.randf() < 0.5 else 0)
+	var total := 0
+	for i in count:
+		var home: String = homes[i % homes.size()] if i == 0 else homes[_rng.randi() % homes.size()]
+		var route := [] if home == stage else _path(home, stage, e)
+		var f := _new_fleet(e, "invade", home, _rng.randi_range(4, 10), route)
+		f["target"] = target
+		f["event"] = event
+		f["stage"] = stage
+		f["waiting"] = true
+		f["since"] = _clock
+		total += int(f["size"])
+	_news("%s: the %s gathers %d fleets (%d warships) for an invasion of %s." % [Galaxy.system(stage)["name"],
+		Galaxy.empire_name(e), count, total, Galaxy.system(target)["name"]], "danger" if target == Galaxy.current_system else "news")
+
+
+## The fleets of an invasion event.
+func event_fleets(event: String) -> Array:
+	return fleets.values().filter(func(f): return f.get("event", "") == event)
+
+
+## An invasion's fleets all at the staging system (or tired of waiting): off
+## they go together.
+func _gather(f: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if not f.get("waiting", false) or not f["route"].is_empty() or f["system"] != f.get("stage", ""):
+		return
+	var mates := event_fleets(f["event"])
+	var ready := mates.all(func(g): return g["system"] == g["stage"] and g["route"].is_empty())
+	if not ready and _clock - float(f.get("since", 0.0)) < GATHER_TIME:
+		return
+	var ships := 0
+	var going := 0
+	for g in mates:
+		if g.get("waiting", false) and g["system"] == g["stage"] and g["route"].is_empty():
+			g["waiting"] = false
+			g["route"] = [g["target"]]
+			ships += int(g["size"])
+			going += 1
+	if going > 0:
+		_news("%s: the %s's combined invasion - %d fleets, %d warships - sets out for %s." % [Galaxy.system(f["stage"])["name"],
+			Galaxy.empire_name(f["empire"]), going, ships, Galaxy.system(f["target"])["name"]],
+			"danger" if f["target"] == Galaxy.current_system else "news")
+
+
+## A station in `sys_id` (run by `victim`) is under attack by `attacker`: its
+## distress call brings the idle defence fleets of the victim and its allies
+## (those at war with the attacker) within DISTRESS_JUMPS - at most
+## DISTRESS_ANSWER of them, nearest first. At most once every DISTRESS_EVERY s.
+func distress(sys_id: String, victim: String, attacker: String) -> Array:
+	if _clock - float(_distress.get(sys_id, -INF)) < DISTRESS_EVERY:
+		return []
+	_distress[sys_id] = _clock
+	var cands := []
+	for f in fleets.values():
+		if f["mission"] != "defend" or not f["route"].is_empty() or f["system"] == sys_id:
+			continue
+		var e: String = f["empire"]
+		if e != victim and not (Galaxy.allied(e, victim) and Galaxy.at_war(e, attacker)):
+			continue
+		if f["system"] == Galaxy.current_system:
+			continue   # (in your system: real ships - they stay)
+		var p := _path(f["system"], sys_id, e)
+		if p.size() >= 1 and p.size() <= DISTRESS_JUMPS:
+			cands.append([p.size(), f, p])
+	cands.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a[0] < b[0])
+	var answered := []
+	for c in cands.slice(0, DISTRESS_ANSWER):
+		c[1]["route"] = c[2]
+		c[1]["answering"] = sys_id
+		answered.append(c[1])
+	var sys_name: String = Galaxy.system(sys_id).get("name", "?")
+	if answered.is_empty():
+		_news("%s sends a distress call - no fleet is near enough to answer." % sys_name, "danger" if sys_id == Galaxy.current_system else "news")
+	else:
+		var who := ", ".join(answered.map(func(f): return "%s (%d ships)" % [Galaxy.EMPIRES[f["empire"]]["short"], f["size"]]))
+		_news("Distress call from %s: %s answering." % [sys_name, who], "danger" if sys_id == Galaxy.current_system else "news")
+	changed.emit()
+	return answered
+
+
+func _new_fleet(e: String, mission: String, at: String, size: int, route: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var id := "f%d" % _next
+	_next += 1
+	var f := {"id": id, "empire": e, "mission": mission, "size": clampi(size, MIN_SIZE, MAX_SIZE), "system": at,
+		"route": route.duplicate(), "t": 0.0, "target": at}
+	fleets[id] = f
+	if at == Galaxy.current_system:
+		fleet_arrived.emit(f)
+	return f
+
+
+# --- Moving ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _move() -> void:
+	for f in fleets.values():
+		if f["system"] == Galaxy.current_system:
+			continue   # (in your system: real ships, they stay)
+		# A peace (or a target already taken) ends an invasion: home to defend.
+		if f["mission"] == "invade" and not Galaxy.at_war(f["empire"], Galaxy.owner_of(f["target"])):
+			f["mission"] = "defend"
+			var own := _owned(f["empire"])
+			if not own.is_empty() and not f["system"] in own:
+				f["route"] = _path(f["system"], own[0], f["empire"])
+		# An invasion gathering at its staging system: off together when all are there.
+		_gather(f)
+		# Defenders far from home (answering an ally's call) with nothing to
+		# fight any more: home.
+		if f["mission"] == "defend" and f["route"].is_empty() and Galaxy.owner_of(f["system"]) != f["empire"] \
+				and besiegers(f["system"]).is_empty():
+			var own_sys := _owned(f["empire"])
+			if not own_sys.is_empty():
+				own_sys.sort_custom(func(a, b): return _path(f["system"], a, "").size() < _path(f["system"], b, "").size())
+				f["route"] = _path(f["system"], own_sys[0], f["empire"])
+				f.erase("answering")
+		if f["route"].is_empty():
+			continue
+		f["t"] += TICK
+		if f["t"] < HOP_TIME:
+			continue
+		f["t"] = 0.0
+		f["system"] = f["route"].pop_front()
+		if f["system"] == Galaxy.current_system:
+			fleet_arrived.emit(f)
+			if f["mission"] == "invade" and f["route"].is_empty():
+				_news("An invasion fleet of the %s has arrived here: %d warships." % [Galaxy.empire_name(f["empire"]), f["size"]], "danger")
+
+
+## The way from a to b (the systems after a), through any systems.
+func _path(a: String, b: String, _e: String) -> Array:
+	var p := Galaxy.find_route(a, b)
+	return p.slice(1) if p.size() > 1 else []
+
+
+# --- Fighting (away from you) ----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _fight() -> void:
+	var by := {}
+	for f in fleets.values():
+		if f["route"].is_empty() and f["system"] != Galaxy.current_system:
+			if not by.has(f["system"]):
+				by[f["system"]] = []
+			by[f["system"]].append(f)
+	for sys_id in by:
+		var here: Array = by[sys_id]
+		for f in here:
+			if not fleets.has(f["id"]):
+				continue
+			var foes: Array = here.filter(func(g): return fleets.has(g["id"]) and Galaxy.at_war(g["empire"], f["empire"]))
+			if not foes.is_empty():
+				# A battle: losses by the other side's strength.
+				var strength := 0
+				for g in foes:
+					strength += g["size"]
+				var loss := int(_rng.randf() * 0.25 * strength + _rng.randf())
+				f["size"] -= loss
+				if f["size"] <= 0:
+					fleets.erase(f["id"])
+					_news("%s: the %s %s fleet was destroyed in battle." % [Galaxy.system(sys_id)["name"], Galaxy.EMPIRES[f["empire"]]["short"],
+						"invasion" if f["mission"] == "invade" else "defence"], "news")
+				continue
+			if f["mission"] != "invade":
+				continue
+			# A siege: the stations of the empires it's at war with.
+			var targets: Array = Galaxy.system(sys_id).get("stations", []).filter(func(sid): return Galaxy.at_war(f["empire"], Galaxy.station_owner(sid)))
+			if not targets.is_empty():
+				targets.sort_custom(func(a, b): return Galaxy.station_health(a) < Galaxy.station_health(b))
+				Galaxy.damage_station(targets[0], f["size"] * SIEGE_DAMAGE)
+				# Stations shoot back.
+				if _rng.randf() < 0.15:
+					f["size"] -= 1
+					if f["size"] <= 0:
+						fleets.erase(f["id"])
+				continue
+			_capture(sys_id, f)
+
+
+## No station of the owner left: the system falls to the invader.
+func _capture(sys_id: String, f: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var owner := Galaxy.owner_of(sys_id)
+	if owner == f["empire"] or not Galaxy.at_war(owner, f["empire"]):
+		f["mission"] = "defend"
+		return
+	if Galaxy.system(sys_id)["stations"].any(func(sid): return Galaxy.station_owner(sid) == owner):
+		return
+	Galaxy.systems[sys_id]["owner"] = f["empire"]
+	Galaxy.systems[sys_id]["control"] = 40.0
+	f["mission"] = "defend"
+	_news("CONQUEST: %s has fallen to the %s's invasion (taken from the %s)." % [Galaxy.system(sys_id)["name"], Galaxy.empire_name(f["empire"]), Galaxy.empire_name(owner)], "danger")
+	Galaxy.politics_changed.emit()
+
+
+func _mend() -> void:
+	for sid in Galaxy.stations:
+		var st: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations[sid]
+		if float(st.get("health", 100.0)) < 100.0 and not besieged(sid):
+			Galaxy.repair_station(sid, MEND)
+
+
+func _news(text: String, kind: String) -> void:
+	Galaxy._post(text, kind)
+
+
+# --- Saving ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func get_save_data() -> Dictionary:
+	return {"fleets": fleets.duplicate(true), "next": _next, "clock": _clock}
+
+
+func load_save_data(d: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if d.is_empty():
+		return
+	fleets = {}
+	for id in d.get("fleets", {}):
+		var f: Dictionary = d["fleets"][id]
+		f["size"] = int(f["size"])
+		f["t"] = float(f.get("t", 0.0))
+		f["route"] = Array(f.get("route", []))
+		fleets[id] = f
+	_next = int(d.get("next", fleets.size() + 1))
+	_clock = float(d.get("clock", 0.0))
+	_distress = {}

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Fog of war for a map: a grid of how well each patch has been seen (0 never .. 255 seen), revealed in soft-edged circles around you, saved as base64. The planet surfaces (PlanetSurface.fog: one cell per 4 tiles, grid coordinates) and the star systems (Galaxy.fog: one cell per CELL world units round the star) use it; the maps draw texture() over what they show - dark where you haven't been - and hide what lies in the dark. (Moved from scripts/fog_of_war.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,125 @@ 
+class_name FogOfWar
+extends RefCounted
+## Fog of war for a map: a grid of how well each patch has been seen (0
+## never .. 255 seen), revealed in soft-edged circles around you, saved as
+## base64. The planet surfaces (PlanetSurface.fog: one cell per 4 tiles,
+## grid coordinates) and the star systems (Galaxy.fog: one cell per CELL
+## world units round the star) use it; the maps draw texture() over what
+## they show - dark where you haven't been - and hide what lies in the dark.
+
+## Seen at least this much: explored (its things show on the maps).
+const SEEN := 110
+
+var cols := 0
+var rows := 0
+var origin := Vector2.ZERO          # the grid's corner, in the map's own coordinates
+var cell := 1.0                     # one cell's size, in the same units
+var data := PackedByteArray()
+var _image: Image
+var _texture: ImageTexture
+var _dirty := true
+var _la := PackedByteArray()        # the texture's texels (luminance 0, alpha: the fog)
+var _la_shade := -1.0
+## How dark the unexplored parts are drawn (alpha).
+var shade := 0.93
+## The texture is this many texels per cell, smoothed (soft edges even where
+## the map draws without filtering).
+var smooth := 4
+
+
+func _init(cols_: int, rows_: int, origin_ := Vector2.ZERO, cell_ := 1.0) -> void:
+	cols = cols_
+	rows = rows_
+	origin = origin_
+	cell = cell_
+	data.resize(cols * rows)
+
+
+## Reveals a circle (radius r, map units) round p; true if anything new was seen.
+func reveal(p: Vector2, r: float) -> bool:
+	var g := (p - origin) / cell
+	var rc := r / cell
+	var soft := maxf(rc * 0.3, 1.0)
+	var changed := false
+	for y in range(maxi(0, floori(g.y - rc)), mini(rows, ceili(g.y + rc) + 1)):
+		for x in range(maxi(0, floori(g.x - rc)), mini(cols, ceili(g.x + rc) + 1)):
+			var d := Vector2(x + 0.5, y + 0.5).distance_to(g)
+			if d > rc:
+				continue
+			var v := int(clampf((rc - d) / soft, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0)
+			var i := y * cols + x
+			if v > data[i]:
+				data[i] = v
+				changed = true
+				if _la.size() == data.size() * 2:
+					_la[i * 2 + 1] = int((255 - v) * shade)
+	if changed:
+		_dirty = true
+	return changed
+
+
+## Everything seen (a system charted by its navigation beacon).
+func reveal_all() -> void:
+	data.fill(255)
+	_la = PackedByteArray()   # (rebuilt from it)
+	_dirty = true
+
+
+## How well the patch at p has been seen (0..255; outside the grid: 0).
+func seen_at(p: Vector2) -> int:
+	var g := (p - origin) / cell
+	var x := floori(g.x)
+	var y := floori(g.y)
+	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= cols or y >= rows:
+		return 0
+	return data[y * cols + x]
+
+
+func explored(p: Vector2) -> bool:
+	return seen_at(p) >= SEEN
+
+
+## Share of the map explored (0..1).
+func explored_share() -> float:
+	var n := 0
+	for v in data:
+		if v >= SEEN:
+			n += 1
+	return float(n) / maxf(data.size(), 1)
+
+
+## The fog to draw over the map (covering cols x rows cells): black,
+## transparent where seen, smoothed.
+func texture() -> ImageTexture:
+	if _dirty or _texture == null:
+		# (The texels kept up to date as cells are revealed - rebuilding them
+		# all in a loop each time cost a frame 2-3 ms as you walk.)
+		if _la.size() != data.size() * 2 or _la_shade != shade:
+			_la_shade = shade
+			_la.resize(data.size() * 2)
+			for i in data.size():
+				_la[i * 2] = 0
+				_la[i * 2 + 1] = int((255 - data[i]) * shade)
+		_image = Image.create_from_data(cols, rows, false, Image.FORMAT_LA8, _la)
+		if smooth > 1:
+			_image.resize(cols * smooth, rows * smooth, Image.INTERPOLATE_BILINEAR)
+		if _texture == null or _texture.get_size() != Vector2(_image.get_size()):
+			_texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(_image)
+		else:
+			_texture.update(_image)
+		_dirty = false
+	return _texture
+
+
+func save() -> String:
+	return Marshalls.raw_to_base64(data.compress(FileAccess.COMPRESSION_DEFLATE))
+
+
+func load_from(s: String) -> void:
+	if s == "":
+		return
+	var raw := Marshalls.base64_to_raw(s).decompress(cols * rows, FileAccess.COMPRESSION_DEFLATE)
+	if raw.size() == cols * rows:
+		data = raw
+		_la = PackedByteArray()   # (rebuilt from it)
+		_dirty = true

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Autoload "Galaxy": the sandbox simulation that runs behind the game. - 13 star systems linked by jump gates, owned by four star empires that rebuilt the Greek civilisations in space (Athenian League, Spartan Hegemony, Minoan Thalassocracy, Mycenaean Kingdoms) or by the Sea Peoples. - Every station has a market: stock per commodity, production and consumption from its economy type, and prices that follow supply. - NPC traders (each with its own cargo and credits) buy cheap and sell dear across stations and systems, moving goods and evening out prices. Traders in the player's system are flown as real ships by the game; elsewhere they're simulated abstractly. - Pirates hijack traders and steal their cargo. - Empires drift between peace and war; at war they raid and capture border systems. The player has a reputation with each empire. The state is saved with the game (get_save_data / load_save_data). (Moved from scripts/galaxy.gd.)

+extends Node
+## Autoload "Galaxy": the sandbox simulation that runs behind the game.
+##
+## - 13 star systems linked by jump gates, owned by four star empires that
+##   rebuilt the Greek civilisations in space (Athenian League, Spartan
+##   Hegemony, Minoan Thalassocracy, Mycenaean Kingdoms) or by the Sea Peoples.
+## - Every station has a market: stock per commodity, production and
+##   consumption from its economy type, and prices that follow supply.
+## - NPC traders (each with its own cargo and credits) buy cheap and sell dear
+##   across stations and systems, moving goods and evening out prices.
+##   Traders in the player's system are flown as real ships by the game;
+##   elsewhere they're simulated abstractly.
+## - Pirates hijack traders and steal their cargo.
+## - Empires drift between peace and war; at war they raid and capture
+##   border systems. The player has a reputation with each empire.
+## The state is saved with the game (get_save_data / load_save_data).
+
+signal news_posted(text: String, kind: String)
+## A trader started a leg inside the current system (the game spawns a ship).
+signal trader_appeared(record: Dictionary)
+## Diplomacy or ownership changed (maps / HUD refresh).
+signal politics_changed
+
+const HOME := "atrapos"
+## The empire that owns the starting cluster (Atrapos and its neighbours).
+const HOME_EMPIRE := "minoa"
+const TICK := 2.0                 # economy tick, seconds
+## Units per second a production / consumption rate of 1 means. Low enough
+## that the traders (and you) can carry what the stations need: most of what
+## a station uses is shipped in, so hauling - not the rates - sets the prices.
+const RATE := 0.1
+const TRADER_SPEED := 150.0       # abstract travel speed, px/s
+const GATE_JUMP_TIME := 6.0
+## Trader planning: how much a shortage at the destination is worth, per unit
+## (times the good's value, plus a flat part) on top of the trade margin.
+const NEED_PREMIUM := 2.0
+const NEED_FLAT := 25.0
+## Empires at war use this much more weapons, fuel and medicine.
+const WAR_DEMAND := 1.3
+const TRADER_TARGET := 110        # galaxy-wide trader population (~2 a system)
+const CARGO_CAPACITY := 60        # player's hold for trade goods (units)
+## Your standing with each empire (and with the independents), -100..100:
+## [name, from] - the tier is the last whose `from` you've reached. Hostile:
+## their warships attack you and their stations refuse you. It moves with
+## what you do (REP_*): missions, trade and bounties raise it; attacking
+## their ships lowers it - slowly, a ship at a time - and a bad name fades
+## back toward neutral over time (REP_RECOVER a minute).
+const REP_TIERS := [["Hostile", -100.0], ["Unfriendly", -50.0], ["Neutral", -15.0], ["Cordial", 15.0],
+	["Friendly", 40.0], ["Allied", 70.0]]
+const HOSTILE_REP := -50.0
+const REP_TRADE := 0.001          # per drachma you trade at one of their stations (times REP_GAIN: 10,000 dr, +1)
+const REP_PROVOKE := -2.0         # firing on one of their ships (once a ship)
+const REP_KILL := -8.0            # destroying one of their ships
+const REP_LAWLESS := -2.0         # destroying a civilian in someone's space (its owner frowns)
+const REP_RECOVER := 1.0          # a bad name fades this much a minute (toward 0)
+## Market prices at a station by your standing with its owner: [buy, sell]
+## multipliers (Unfriendly pays more and gets less; Allied the best deal).
+const REP_PRICES := {"Hostile": [1.15, 0.85], "Unfriendly": [1.1, 0.9], "Neutral": [1.0, 1.0],
+	"Cordial": [0.98, 1.01], "Friendly": [0.95, 1.03], "Allied": [0.9, 1.05]}
+## Pirate bounties from the system's owner, by your standing with it.
+const REP_BOUNTY := {"Friendly": 1.1, "Allied": 1.25}
+## Your market footprint: each unit you buy at a station pushes its price up by
+## PLAYER_IMPACT (a fraction, compounding), each unit you sell pushes it down -
+## up to 1 + IMPACT_SCARCE times as hard on goods the station is short of
+## (selling a full hold where it's needed soon floods the market). The push
+## fades by IMPACT_DECAY per economy tick (half gone in about 1.5 minutes),
+## so big hauls on one route pay less and spreading them out pays more.
+const PLAYER_IMPACT := 0.003
+const IMPACT_SCARCE := 1.0
+const IMPACT_DECAY := 0.985
+## Pirate bounties: credits per point of hull + shields, plus a flat part.
+const BOUNTY_PER_POINT := 1.0
+const BOUNTY_BASE := 60.0
+
+## The great powers of the 31st century: star nations that rebuilt the old
+## Greek civilisations among the stars (internal id "pirates" = the Sea Peoples).
+const EMPIRES := {
+	"athens": {"name": "Athenian League", "short": "Athenian", "color": Color(0.35, 0.8, 1.0),
+		"desc": "A democratic federation of free colonies, heirs of Athens. Traders, scholars and the finest navy among the stars - their owl-crested fleets guard your home port."},
+	"sparta": {"name": "Spartan Hegemony", "short": "Spartan", "color": Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.18),
+		"desc": "A militarised star state where every citizen serves. Bronze-armoured warships, fortress stations, and a lambda on every hull. Few words, many guns."},
+	"minoa": {"name": "Minoan Thalassocracy", "short": "Minoan", "color": Color(0.3, 1.0, 0.75),
+		"desc": "The oldest of the star nations: a maritime empire of research palaces and bull-horned ships, ruled from the orbital palace of Knossos. Rich in technology, short on food."},
+	"mycenae": {"name": "Mycenaean Kingdoms", "short": "Mycenaean", "color": Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3),
+		"desc": "Warrior-kings of cyclopean citadels and golden fleets. Miners and shipwrights, allied by blood with Sparta, rivals of the Minoans."},
+	"ionia": {"name": "Ionian League", "short": "Ionian", "color": Color(0.5, 0.58, 1.0),
+		"desc": "Philosopher-republics of the eastern lanes - Miletos, Ephesos, Samos - heirs of the Ionian cities where science began. Lapis-and-gold fleets crowned with Ionic columns, floating garden isles and star-gazing observatories. Kin to the Athenians, wary of Sparta."},
+	"cyclades": {"name": "Cycladic Isles", "short": "Cycladic", "color": Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.82),
+		"desc": "The oldest seafarers of the Aegean, reborn among the stars: island-hopping traders, quarrymen and sculptors of white marble and black obsidian, their worlds set in a circle round a sacred centre. Calm, old and proud - friends of the Minoans, wary of the warlike mainland."},
+	"independent": {"name": "Independents", "short": "Independent", "color": Color(0.8, 0.82, 0.86),
+		"desc": "Free ports, waystations and the ships that answer to no empire. Neutral with everyone, they trade with every side and keep out of the empires' wars - only the Sea Peoples prey on them."},
+	"pirates": {"name": "Sea Peoples", "short": "Sea People", "color": Color(1.0, 0.22, 0.22),
+		"desc": "Raider clans from beyond the charted lanes - like the Sea Peoples who once toppled the Bronze Age. They hijack freighters and sell the loot in their dens."},
+}
+const MAJOR := ["athens", "sparta", "minoa", "mycenae", "ionia", "cyclades"]
+

+## The galaxy grown from BASE_SYSTEMS: each empire spreads outward from its
+## territory (away from the galaxy's middle) to EMPIRE_SIZE systems - each new
+## one at least 100 from any other, its gate lane to the system it grew from
+## crossing no other lane, and one more lane to a near neighbour where it can
+## (loops, and contested borders). Deterministic (fixed seed): the same galaxy
+## every game. Returns [systems, links] (cached).
+static func _grow() -> Array:
+	if not _grown.is_empty():
+		return _grown
+	var systems: Dictionary = BASE_SYSTEMS.duplicate(true)
+	var links: Array = BASE_LINKS.duplicate(true)
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = 31337
+	var used := {}
+	for id in systems:
+		used[systems[id]["name"]] = true
+	for pool in [PLANET_NAMES, STATION_ROOTS]:
+		for e in pool:
+			for n in pool[e]:
+				used[n] = true
+	for n in INDEPENDENT_ROOTS:
+		used[n] = true
+	var centre := Vector2.ZERO
+	for id in systems:
+		centre += systems[id]["pos"]
+	centre /= systems.size()
+	var stars: Array = STARS.keys().filter(func(k): return k != "brown" and not STARS[k].get("rare", false))
+	var want := EMPIRE_SIZE.duplicate()
+	want["pirates"] = systems.values().filter(func(sy): return sy["owner"] == "pirates").size() + EXTRA_DENS
+	var serial := 0
+	var growing := true
+	var rounds := 0
+	while growing and rounds < 40:   # (an empire hemmed in stops short of its size)
+		rounds += 1
+		growing = false
+		for e in want:
+			var own: Array = systems.keys().filter(func(k): return systems[k]["owner"] == e)
+			if own.size() >= want[e]:
+				continue
+			growing = true
+			var best := {}
+			for t in 120:
+				var parent: String = own[rng.randi() % own.size()]
+				var pp: Vector2 = systems[parent]["pos"]
+				var out_dir := (pp - centre).normalized() if pp.distance_to(centre) > 1.0 else Vector2.RIGHT
+				var p := pp + Vector2.from_angle(out_dir.angle() + rng.randf_range(-1.7, 1.7)) * rng.randf_range(115.0, 175.0)
+				var near := INF
+				var near_foreign := INF
+				for k in systems:
+					var d: float = p.distance_to(systems[k]["pos"])
+					near = minf(near, d)
+					if systems[k]["owner"] != e:
+						near_foreign = minf(near_foreign, d)
+				if near < 100.0 or _crosses(systems, links, pp, p):
+					continue
+				var score := minf(near_foreign, 400.0) - p.distance_to(pp) * 0.3 + rng.randf() * 30.0
+				if best.is_empty() or score > best["score"]:
+					best = {"pos": p, "parent": parent, "score": score}
+			if best.is_empty():
+				continue
+			var name := ""
+			for n in SYSTEM_NAMES.get(e, []):
+				if not used.has(n):
+					name = n
+					break
+			if name == "":
+				name = "%s %d" % [EMPIRES[e]["short"], serial + 1]
+			used[name] = true
+			serial += 1
+			var id := "g%d_%s" % [serial, name.to_lower().replace(" ", "_")]
+			systems[id] = {"name": name, "pos": best["pos"], "owner": e, "star": stars[rng.randi() % stars.size()],
+				"pirates": 1.0 if e == "pirates" else snappedf(rng.randf_range(0.15, 0.5), 0.05)}
+			links.append([best["parent"], id])
+			# One more lane, to the nearest system it can reach without crossing.
+			var cands: Array = systems.keys().filter(func(k): return k != id and k != best["parent"])
+			cands.sort_custom(func(a, b): return systems[a]["pos"].distance_to(best["pos"]) < systems[b]["pos"].distance_to(best["pos"]))
+			for k in cands.slice(0, 3):
+				var q: Vector2 = systems[k]["pos"]
+				if q.distance_to(best["pos"]) < 210.0 and not _crosses(systems, links, best["pos"], q):
+					links.append([id, k])
+					break
+	_grown = [systems, links]
+	return _grown
+

+## Does the lane a-b cross an existing lane (lanes sharing an end don't count)?
+static func _crosses(systems: Dictionary, links: Array, a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> bool:
+	for l in links:
+		var c: Vector2 = systems[l[0]]["pos"]
+		var d: Vector2 = systems[l[1]]["pos"]
+		if c.is_equal_approx(a) or c.is_equal_approx(b) or d.is_equal_approx(a) or d.is_equal_approx(b):
+			continue
+		if Geometry2D.segment_intersects_segment(a, b, c, d) != null:
+			return true
+	return false

+# --- Setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## `map_only`: just the map - systems, stations, planets - without the traders
+## and the economy's warm-up (60 market ticks, ~0.9 s): for Talos's tools,
+## which list the galaxy's places but never run it. A real game always starts
+## its own (main.gd).
+## A new game made across frames: the economy's warm-up (the slow part, ~0.9 s)
+## a few milliseconds a frame - the loading screen keeps moving meanwhile;
+## `progress(share)` follows it. The space scene then finds the galaxy ready
+## (prepared) instead of making one in its first frame.
+var prepared := false
+const ASYNC_BUDGET_US := 4000
+## `warm_later`: the economy's warm-up (60 rounds of trade, the stations'
+## prices noted) left running in the background after the game starts - no
+## waiting for it (a new game from the title: it was ~12 s of a loading screen).
+func new_game_async(progress := Callable(), warm_later := false) -> void:
+	active = false   # (the simulation waits until it's all there)
+	_new_game_begin(true, false)   # (the map; the stations' stocks, the traders and the economy below, a little a frame)
+	await get_tree().process_frame
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for sid in stations:
+		_stock_goods(stations[sid])
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > ASYNC_BUDGET_US:
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	price_cache = {}
+	sell_sum = {}
+	sell_n = {}
+	for i in TRADER_TARGET:
+		_spawn_trader()
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > ASYNC_BUDGET_US:
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	if warm_later:
+		_new_game_end(true, true)   # (running now; prices noted as the warm-up finishes)
+		prepared = true
+		_warm_up_economy()   # (not waited for)
+		return
+	var ids := stations.keys()
+	for i in 60:
+		for sid in ids:
+			_economy_tick_station(sid, false)
+			if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > ASYNC_BUDGET_US:
+				if progress.is_valid():
+					progress.call(i / 60.0)
+				await get_tree().process_frame
+				t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for sid in ids:
+		_note_prices(sid)
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > ASYNC_BUDGET_US:
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	_new_game_end(true, true)
+	prepared = true

+## A new game's economy warmed up a little a frame while it's played (new_game_async's warm_later).
+const WARM_BUDGET_US := 1500   # (a frame's share while the game is played)
+
+func _warm_up_economy() -> void:
+	var ids := stations.keys()
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for i in 60:
+		for sid in ids:
+			if not stations.has(sid):
+				return   # (another game started meanwhile)
+			_economy_tick_station(sid, false)
+			if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > WARM_BUDGET_US:
+				await get_tree().process_frame
+				t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for sid in ids:
+		if stations.has(sid):
+			_note_prices(sid)
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > WARM_BUDGET_US:
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()

+func new_game(announce := true, map_only := false) -> void:

+		for i in 60:

+## A station's prices worked out and kept, and taken as its last ones (the
+## market's trend starts from them).
+func _note_prices(sid) -> void:
+	cache_prices(sid)
+	var row: Dictionary = price_cache.get(sid, {})
+	for c in stations[sid]["stock"]:
+		if row.has(c):
+			stations[sid]["last"][c] = row[c][3]

+
+## Counts the galaxy's planets as they're generated (their PlanetGen variant).
+var _planet_serial := 0
+var _seeds_used := {}
+
+
+## A planet's surface seed, never one another planet has (the same draw as
+## before; a repeat moves on to the next free one) - no two surfaces alike.
+func _unique_seed(s: int) -> int:
+	while _seeds_used.has(s) or s in [101, 202, 303, 404, 505]:   # (and not a home planet's)
+		s += 1
+	_seeds_used[s] = true
+	return s
+
+func _generate() -> void:
+	_planet_serial = 0
+	_seeds_used = {}
+	planets = {}
+	_names_used = {}
+	_staples_used = {}
+	_roots_used = {}
+	_indie_used = 0
+	added_stations = []
+	for id in SYSTEMS:
+		var d: Dictionary = SYSTEMS[id]
+		var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		rng.seed = hash(id)
+		var sys := {"id": id, "name": d["name"], "owner": d["owner"], "star": d["star"], "pirates": d["pirates"], "state": "none",
+			"control": 60.0, "undermine": {},
+			"planets": [], "stations": [], "gates": {}, "fields": []}
+		# Gates: on the system's edge, in the direction of the neighbour on the map.
+		for n in neighbors(id):
+			var dir: Vector2 = (SYSTEMS[n]["pos"] - d["pos"]).normalized()
+			sys["gates"][n] = dir * GATE_RADIUS
+		if id == HOME:
+			for i in HOME_STATIONS.size():
+				_add_station(sys, HOME_STATIONS[i]["name"], HOME_STATIONS[i]["pos"], HOME_STATIONS[i]["economy"])
+		else:
+			_generate_system(sys, rng)
+		systems[id] = sys
+	# Guests (independents, allies' outposts): once every system's owner is known.
+	for id in systems:
+		if id != HOME:
+			_generate_guests(systems[id])
