+		"desc": "Core: you walk faster."},
+	"fusion_core": {"slot": "core", "name": "Fusion Core", "price": 520, "effects": {"regen_mult": 0.08, "overcharge_mult": 0.15, "max_hp": 6.0},
+		"desc": "Core: energy cells overcharge longer; a little more health and healing."},
+	"med_injector": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Med Injector", "price": 280, "effects": {"regen_mult": 0.12},
+		"desc": "Passive: faster healing."},
+	"heat_sink": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Heat Sink", "price": 300, "effects": {"resist_heat": 0.08},
+		"desc": "Passive: heat resistance (and Akrotiri's heat wears on you less)."},
+	"thermal_lining": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Thermal Lining", "price": 300, "effects": {"resist_cold": 0.08},
+		"desc": "Passive: cold resistance (and the ice slows you less)."},
+	"targeting_ai": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Targeting AI", "price": 460, "effects": {"damage_mult": 0.03, "range_mult": 0.03},
+		"desc": "Passive: a little more damage and reach."},
+	"reinforced_frame": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Reinforced Frame", "price": 340, "effects": {"max_hp": 9.0},
+		"desc": "Passive: more health."},
+}
+
+
+# --- Item ids ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func item_id(kind: String, quality: int) -> String:
+	return "%s%s:%d" % [PREFIX, kind, clampi(quality, 0, QUALITY.size() - 1)]
+
+
+static func is_gear(id: String) -> bool:
+	return id.begins_with(PREFIX)
+
+
+## [kind, quality] of a gear item id, or [] if it isn't one (or unknown).
+static func parse(id: String) -> Array:
+	if not is_gear(id):
+		return []
+	var parts := id.substr(PREFIX.length()).split(":")
+	if parts.size() != 2 or not (FOOT.has(parts[0]) or Shipyard.MODULES.has(parts[0])):
+		return []
+	return [parts[0], clampi(int(parts[1]), 0, QUALITY.size() - 1)]
+
+
+## "ship" or "foot" (or "" if it isn't gear).
+static func side(id: String) -> String:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if p.is_empty():
+		return ""
+	return "foot" if FOOT.has(p[0]) else "ship"
+
+
+## The catalogue entry of a gear item's kind ({} if none).
+static func entry(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if p.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	return FOOT[p[0]] if FOOT.has(p[0]) else Shipyard.MODULES[p[0]]
+
+
+## Its slot: automaton "weapon" / "mod" / "armour" / "core" / "passive", ship "internal" / "utility".
+static func slot_of(id: String) -> String:
+	return str(entry(id).get("slot", ""))
+
+
+static func quality(id: String) -> int:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	return p[1] if not p.is_empty() else 0
+
+
+static func title(id: String) -> String:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	return "%s %s" % [e.get("name", id), QUALITY[quality(id)]] if not e.is_empty() else id
+
+
+static func price(id: String) -> int:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	return roundi(float(e.get("price", 0)) * PRICE_MULT[quality(id)])
+
+
+## Its effects at its quality.
+static func effects(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	var out := {}
+	var m: float = EFFECT_MULT[quality(id)]
+	for k in e.get("effects", {}):
+		out[k] = float(e["effects"][k]) * m
+	return out
+
+
+## An automaton weapon's stats at its quality: {damage, interval, range, type, color}.
+static func weapon_stats(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	if e.get("slot", "") != "weapon":
+		e = FOOT["laser_rifle"]
+	return {"damage": float(e["damage"]) * WEAPON_MULT[quality(id)], "interval": float(e["interval"]),
+		"range": float(e["range"]), "type": str(e["type"]), "color": e["color"]}
+
+
+## Items-style info for a gear item (Items.info): name, kind "gear", value, price, desc.
+static func info(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	if e.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	return {"name": title(id), "kind": "gear", "value": roundi(price(id) * SELL_SHARE), "price": price(id),
+		"desc": "%s %s gear (%s). %s %s" % [QUALITY_NAMES[quality(id)], "automaton" if side(id) == "foot" else "ship",
+			_slot_label(id), e.get("desc", ""), describe(id)]}
+
+
+static func _slot_label(id: String) -> String:
+	var s := slot_of(id)
+	return {"weapon": "weapon", "mod": "weapon mod", "armour": "armour", "core": "core", "passive": "passive",
+		"internal": "internal slot", "utility": "utility slot"}.get(s, s)
+
+
+## What it does, in words ("+14 health, +4% kinetic resistance").
+static func describe(id: String) -> String:
+	var parts := []
+	if slot_of(id) == "weapon" and side(id) == "foot":
+		var w := weapon_stats(id)
+		parts.append("%.0f %s damage, %.1f shots/s, reach %.0f" % [w["damage"], TYPE_NAMES[w["type"]].to_lower(), 1.0 / w["interval"], w["range"]])
+	var fx := effects(id)
+	for k in fx:
+		parts.append(effect_text(k, fx[k]))
+	return ", ".join(parts)
+
+
+static func effect_text(key: String, v: float) -> String:
+	if key.begins_with("resist_"):
+		return "+%d%% %s resistance" % [roundi(v * 100.0), key.trim_prefix("resist_")]
+	match key:
+		"max_hp": return "+%.0f health" % v
+		"max_hull": return "+%.0f hull" % v
+		"max_shields": return "+%.0f shields" % v
+		"hull_regen": return "+%.1f hull/s" % v
+		"cargo": return "+%d hold slots" % roundi(v / Shipyard.RACK_UNITS_PER_SLOT)
+		"fire_rate_mult": return "+%d%% fire rate" % roundi(-v * 100.0)
+	var label: String = {"damage_mult": "damage", "range_mult": "reach", "regen_mult": "healing", "speed_mult": "speed",
+		"overcharge_mult": "overcharge time", "shield_regen_mult": "shield recharge", "handling_mult": "handling"}.get(key, key)
+	return "+%d%% %s" % [roundi(v * 100.0), label]
+
+
+# --- The automaton's loadout ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The player's loadout (the save format's "loadout": {slot: item id}), made if missing.
+static func loadout(player: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	if not player.get("loadout") is Dictionary:
+		player["loadout"] = DEFAULT_LOADOUT.duplicate()
+	return player["loadout"]
+
+
+## Whether gear item `id` goes in loadout slot `slot`.
+static func fits(id: String, slot: String) -> bool:
+	return side(id) == "foot" and SLOT_KIND.get(slot, "") == slot_of(id)
+
+
+## The summed effects of a loadout (weapon included).
+static func loadout_effects(lo: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var total := {}
+	for s in LOADOUT:
+		var id := str(lo.get(s, ""))
+		if id == "":
+			continue
+		var fx := effects(id)
+		for k in fx:
+			total[k] = float(total.get(k, 0.0)) + fx[k]
+	return total
+
+
+## Equips gear item `id` from inventory `inv` into slot `slot` of loadout
+## `lo`; what was there goes back into `inv` (it needs room: `cap` slots).
+## True if done.
+static func equip(lo: Dictionary, inv: Dictionary, cap: int, id: String, slot: String) -> bool:
+	if not fits(id, slot) or int(inv.get(id, 0)) <= 0:
+		return false
+	var old := str(lo.get(slot, ""))
+	Inventory.take(inv, id, 1)
+	if old != "" and Inventory.add(inv, old, 1, cap) < 1:
+		Inventory.add(inv, id, 1, cap + 1)   # (no room for the old one: undone)
+		return false
+	lo[slot] = id
+	return true
+
+
+## The slot a piece of gear would go in: the first empty one that takes it,
+## else the first that takes it ("" if none).
+static func slot_for(lo: Dictionary, id: String) -> String:
+	var first := ""
+	for s in LOADOUT:
+		if fits(id, s):
+			if str(lo.get(s, "")) == "":
+				return s
+			if first == "":
+				first = s
+	return first
+
+
+## Takes off what's in slot `slot` of loadout `lo` into `inv`. True if done
+## (the weapon slot is never left empty: the standard rifle goes back in).
+static func unequip(lo: Dictionary, inv: Dictionary, cap: int, slot: String) -> bool:
+	var old := str(lo.get(slot, ""))
+	if old == "" or (slot == "weapon" and old == DEFAULT_LOADOUT["weapon"]):
+		return false
+	if Inventory.add(inv, old, 1, cap) < 1:
+		return false
+	if slot == "weapon":
+		lo[slot] = DEFAULT_LOADOUT["weapon"]
+	else:
+		lo.erase(slot)
+	return true
+
+
+# --- Ship gear ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Fits ship gear item `id` from the hold: true if it had a free slot.
+static func fit(data: Node, id: String) -> bool:
+	if side(id) != "ship" or data.count(id) <= 0:
+		return false
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if Shipyard.free_for(data, id) <= 0:
+		return false
+	Inventory.take(data.items, id, 1)
+	data.modules.append({"id": p[0], "rating": p[1]})
+	return true
+
+
+## Takes fitted module `i` out into the hold: true if there was room.
+static func unfit(data: Node, i: int) -> bool:
+	if i < 0 or i >= data.modules.size():
+		return false
+	var m: Dictionary = data.modules[i]
+	var id := item_id(m["id"], int(m["rating"]))
+	if Inventory.room_for(data.items, id, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data)) < 1:
+		return false
+	Inventory.add(data.items, id, 1, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data))
+	data.modules.remove_at(i)
+	return true
+
+
+# --- Where gear comes from ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A random piece of gear: `side` "ship" / "foot" / "" (either); `level` 0..1
+## (how tough what dropped it was: the better, the likelier a high quality).
+static func roll(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, side_ := "", level := 0.3) -> String:
+	var s := side_ if side_ != "" else ("ship" if rng.randf() < 0.5 else "foot")
+	var kinds: Array = FOOT.keys() if s == "foot" else Shipyard.MODULES.keys()
+	var kind: String = kinds[rng.randi() % kinds.size()]
+	# Quality: mostly E-C; the tougher the source, the more B and A.
+	var r := rng.randf() + clampf(level, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.55
+	var q := 0
+	for t in [0.55, 0.85, 1.12, 1.38]:
+		if r > t:
+			q += 1
+	return item_id(kind, q)
+
+
+# --- Icons --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A gear item's icon: a glyph for its slot in a ring of its quality's colour.
+static func draw_icon(ci: CanvasItem, id: String, rect: Rect2, dim := false) -> void:
+	var c := rect.get_center()
+	var r := minf(rect.size.x, rect.size.y) * 0.5
+	var qc: Color = QUALITY_COLORS[quality(id)]
+	if dim:
+		qc = qc.darkened(0.5)
+	ci.draw_arc(c, r * 0.92, 0, TAU, 32, Color(qc, 0.9), maxf(1.5, r * 0.08), true)
+	var g := Color(0.92, 0.94, 1.0) if not dim else Color(0.5, 0.52, 0.56)
+	var w := maxf(1.5, r * 0.1)
+	match slot_of(id):
+		"weapon":
+			ci.draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.6, r * 0.25), c + Vector2(r * 0.6, -r * 0.25), g, w * 1.6, true)
+			ci.draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.2, r * 0.1), c + Vector2(-r * 0.3, r * 0.5), g, w, true)
+		"mod":
+			for k in 6:
+				var a := TAU * k / 6.0
+				ci.draw_line(c + Vector2.from_angle(a) * r * 0.25, c + Vector2.from_angle(a) * r * 0.55, g, w, true)
+			ci.draw_arc(c, r * 0.25, 0, TAU, 16, g, w, true)
+		"armour", "internal":
+			ci.draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(-r * 0.5, -r * 0.45), c + Vector2(r * 0.5, -r * 0.45),
+				c + Vector2(r * 0.45, r * 0.15), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.6), c + Vector2(-r * 0.45, r * 0.15), c + Vector2(-r * 0.5, -r * 0.45)]), g, w, true)
+		"core":
+			ci.draw_arc(c, r * 0.45, 0, TAU, 20, g, w, true)
+			ci.draw_circle(c, r * 0.18, Color(qc, 0.9))
+		_:   # passive, utility
+			ci.draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.55), c + Vector2(r * 0.5, 0), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.55),
+				c + Vector2(-r * 0.5, 0), c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.55)]), g, w, true)
+	ci.draw_string(ThemeDB.fallback_font, rect.position + Vector2(rect.size.x - r * 0.55, r * 0.55), QUALITY[quality(id)],
+		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, maxi(9, int(r * 0.42)), qc)

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Ship weapons in sizes, and the hardpoints they're fitted to. A ship class has a row of hardpoints, each of a size from XS to XXL (LAYOUT: two on an interceptor, 24 on a dreadnought); a weapon is an item of a kind (Items.WEAPONS) and a size - "wpn:<kind>:<size>", e.g. "wpn:plasma_cannon:3" (a Plasma Cannon L) - that fits any hardpoint its size or bigger. Every weapon fitted fires at your target on its own (Ship._update_weapons), each from its own place on the hull; the toolbar switches a kind on and off. Items.WEAPONS' numbers are size S; each size up hits DAMAGE_STEP harder, fires INTERVAL_STEP slower, reaches RANGE_STEP further and costs PRICE_STEP more. Fitted weapons: PlayerData.weapons (an item id or "" a hardpoint). Other ships carry a loadout for their class too (loadout(): Enemy). (Moved from scripts/hardpoints.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,325 @@ 
+class_name Hardpoints
+extends RefCounted
+## Ship weapons in sizes, and the hardpoints they're fitted to. A ship class
+## has a row of hardpoints, each of a size from XS to XXL (LAYOUT: two on an
+## interceptor, 24 on a dreadnought); a weapon is an item of a kind
+## (Items.WEAPONS) and a size - "wpn:<kind>:<size>", e.g. "wpn:plasma_cannon:3"
+## (a Plasma Cannon L) - that fits any hardpoint its size or bigger. Every
+## weapon fitted fires at your target on its own (Ship._update_weapons), each
+## from its own place on the hull; the toolbar switches a kind on and off.
+## Items.WEAPONS' numbers are size S; each size up hits DAMAGE_STEP harder,
+## fires INTERVAL_STEP slower, reaches RANGE_STEP further and costs PRICE_STEP
+## more. Fitted weapons: PlayerData.weapons (an item id or "" a hardpoint).
+## Other ships carry a loadout for their class too (loadout(): Enemy).
+
+const PREFIX := "wpn:"
+const SIZES := ["XS", "S", "M", "L", "XL", "XXL"]
+const SIZE_NAMES := ["Extra small", "Small", "Medium", "Large", "Extra large", "Huge"]
+## The size Items.WEAPONS' numbers are for (S).
+const BASE := 1
+const DAMAGE_STEP := 1.7
+const INTERVAL_STEP := 1.1
+const RANGE_STEP := 1.07
+const SPEED_STEP := 0.96
+const PRICE_STEP := 2.6
+## The sizes each kind is made in [smallest, biggest].
+const MADE_IN := {"laser": [0, 4], "plasma_cannon": [0, 5], "missile_launcher": [0, 5],
+	"beam": [1, 5], "bouncer": [1, 4], "electro": [1, 4]}
+## The kinds, in the order the outfitter lists them.
+const KINDS := ["laser", "plasma_cannon", "missile_launcher", "beam", "bouncer", "electro"]
+
+## What your first ship starts with: a Pulse Cannon S.
+const START := ["wpn:laser:1", "", ""]
+
+## Each class's hardpoints, biggest first ("player": the Atrapos you start in).
+const LAYOUT := {
+	"player": [1, 0, 0],
+	"interceptor": [0, 0],
+	"fighter": [1, 1, 0],
+	"courier": [1, 0],
+	"explorer": [1, 1],
+	"freighter": [1, 0],
+	"gunship": [2, 2, 1, 1],
+	"frigate": [3, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1],
+	"cruiser": [4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1],
+	"battleship": [5, 4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1],
+	"dreadnought": [5, 5, 4, 4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1],
+}
+
+
+static func item_id(kind: String, size: int) -> String:
+	return "%s%s:%d" % [PREFIX, kind, clampi(size, 0, SIZES.size() - 1)]
+
+
+static func is_weapon(id: String) -> bool:
+	return id.begins_with(PREFIX)
+
+
+## [kind, size] of a weapon item id, or [] if it isn't one.
+static func parse(id: String) -> Array:
+	if not is_weapon(id):
+		return []
+	var p := id.substr(PREFIX.length()).split(":")
+	if p.size() != 2 or not Items.WEAPONS.has(p[0]):
+		return []
+	return [p[0], clampi(int(p[1]), 0, SIZES.size() - 1)]
+
+
+static func kind(id: String) -> String:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	return p[0] if not p.is_empty() else ""
+
+
+static func size_of(id: String) -> int:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	return p[1] if not p.is_empty() else 0
+
+
+static func sizes(kind: String) -> Array:
+	var r: Array = MADE_IN.get(kind, [BASE, BASE])
+	return range(r[0], r[1] + 1)
+
+
+static func title(id: String) -> String:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	return "%s %s" % [Items.EQUIPMENT[p[0]]["name"], SIZES[p[1]]] if not p.is_empty() else id
+
+
+static func price(id: String) -> int:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if p.is_empty():
+		return 0
+	# (the Pulse Cannon is free for your first ship: priced as a plasma cannon's two-thirds)
+	var base := float(Items.EQUIPMENT[p[0]]["price"]) if p[0] != "laser" else 400.0
+	return snappedi(roundi(base * pow(PRICE_STEP, p[1] - BASE)), 10)
+
+
+## Its numbers at its size: Items.WEAPONS' entry for the kind with damage,
+## interval, range and speed scaled, and "size".
+static func stats(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if p.is_empty():
+		return Items.WEAPONS["laser"]
+	var w: Dictionary = Items.WEAPONS[p[0]].duplicate()
+	var k: int = p[1] - BASE
+	w["damage"] = float(w["damage"]) * pow(DAMAGE_STEP, k)
+	w["interval"] = float(w["interval"]) * pow(INTERVAL_STEP, k)
+	w["range"] = float(w["range"]) * pow(RANGE_STEP, k)
+	w["speed"] = float(w["speed"]) * pow(SPEED_STEP, k)
+	w["size"] = p[1]
+	return w
+
+
+## Items-style info (Items.info): name, kind "weapon", value, price, desc.
+static func info(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if p.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	var w := stats(id)
+	return {"name": title(id), "kind": "weapon", "value": roundi(price(id) * Gear.SELL_SHARE), "price": price(id),
+		"desc": "A ship weapon, size %s (fits a hardpoint of %s or bigger). %s %s" % [SIZES[p[1]], SIZES[p[1]],
+			Items.EQUIPMENT[p[0]]["desc"], describe(id)]}
+
+
+## Its numbers in words.
+static func describe(id: String) -> String:
+	var w := stats(id)
+	if w["style"] == "beam":
+		return "%.0f damage a second, reach %.0f." % [w["damage"], w["range"]]
+	return "%.0f damage every %.2f s, reach %.0f." % [w["damage"], w["interval"], w["range"]]
+
+
+## The weapon kind's icon with its size on it.
+static func draw_icon(ci: CanvasItem, id: String, rect: Rect2, dim := false) -> void:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if p.is_empty():
+		return
+	Items.draw_icon(ci, p[0], rect, dim)
+	var r := minf(rect.size.x, rect.size.y) * 0.5
+	var col := Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.4) if not dim else Color(0.55, 0.5, 0.35)
+	ci.draw_string(ThemeDB.fallback_font, rect.position + Vector2(rect.size.x - r * 0.95, rect.size.y - r * 0.12), SIZES[p[1]],
+		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, r * 0.9, maxi(9, int(r * 0.46)), col)
+
+
+# --- A class's hardpoints ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The hardpoints' sizes of a ship class (a design id or "player").
+static func layout(ship_class: String) -> Array:
+	if ship_class == "" or ship_class == "player":
+		return LAYOUT["player"]
+	return LAYOUT.get(str(EnemyTypes.get_type(ship_class).get("class", "fighter")), LAYOUT["fighter"])
+
+
+## The hardpoints in words: "2×L 4×M 4×S".
+static func summary(lay: Array) -> String:
+	var counts := {}
+	for z in lay:
+		counts[int(z)] = int(counts.get(int(z), 0)) + 1
+	var keys := counts.keys()
+	keys.sort()
+	keys.reverse()
+	return " ".join(keys.map(func(z): return "%d×%s" % [counts[z], SIZES[z]]))
+
+
+static func fits(id: String, slot_size: int) -> bool:
+	return not parse(id).is_empty() and size_of(id) <= slot_size
+
+
+## Where hardpoint `i` of `n` sits on a hull `half` (half its length, half its
+## width; the nose up, -y): in pairs side by side, from the nose back, the
+## biggest guns along the spine.
+static func mount(i: int, n: int, half: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	if n <= 1:
+		return Vector2(0, -half.y * 0.45)
+	var rows := ceili(n / 2.0)
+	var row := i / 2
+	var side := -1.0 if i % 2 == 0 else 1.0
+	if n % 2 == 1 and i == n - 1:
+		side = 0.0
+	var y := lerpf(-0.5, 0.45, float(row) / maxf(1.0, rows - 1.0)) * half.y
+	var x := side * half.x * lerpf(0.18, 0.55, float(row) / maxf(1.0, rows - 1.0))
+	return Vector2(x, y)
+
+
+# --- The player's hardpoints (PlayerData.weapons) ---------------------------------------
+
+## The fitted weapons, one entry a hardpoint ("" empty), sized to the class.
+static func fitted(data: Node) -> Array:
+	var lay := layout(data.ship_class)
+	if data.weapons.size() != lay.size():
+		data.weapons.resize(lay.size())
+		for i in data.weapons.size():
+			if data.weapons[i] == null:
+				data.weapons[i] = ""
+	return data.weapons
+
+
+## The emptiest hardpoint `id` fits (the smallest that takes it), or -1.
+static func free_slot_for(data: Node, id: String) -> int:
+	var lay := layout(data.ship_class)
+	var ws := fitted(data)
+	var best := -1
+	for i in lay.size():
+		if ws[i] == "" and fits(id, lay[i]) and (best < 0 or lay[i] < lay[best]):
+			best = i
+	return best
+
+
+## Fits weapon `id` from the hold (or bought: `from_hold` false) to hardpoint
+## `slot` (-1: the best free one). False if it doesn't fit.
+static func fit(data: Node, id: String, slot := -1, from_hold := true) -> bool:
+	var lay := layout(data.ship_class)
+	var ws := fitted(data)
+	if slot < 0:
+		slot = free_slot_for(data, id)
+	if slot < 0 or slot >= lay.size() or not fits(id, lay[slot]):
+		return false
+	if from_hold:
+		if data.count(id) <= 0:
+			return false
+		data.remove_item(id)
+	if ws[slot] != "":
+		Inventory.add(data.items, ws[slot], 1, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data))   # (the one there: to the hold)
+	ws[slot] = id
+	data.discovered["gear:" + kind(id)] = true
+	_toolbar_has(data, kind(id))
+	data.changed.emit()
+	return true
+
+
+## Takes hardpoint `slot`'s weapon out into the hold (false: no room).
+static func unfit(data: Node, slot: int) -> bool:
+	var ws := fitted(data)
+	if slot < 0 or slot >= ws.size() or ws[slot] == "":
+		return false
+	if Inventory.room_for(data.items, ws[slot], Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data)) < 1:
+		return false
+	Inventory.add(data.items, ws[slot], 1, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data))
+	ws[slot] = ""
+	data.changed.emit()
+	return true
+
+
+## Is a weapon of `kind` fitted?
+static func has_kind(data: Node, k: String) -> bool:
+	for id in fitted(data):
+		if id != "" and kind(id) == k:
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## A kind on the toolbar (its key switches the kind on and off): put there the
+## first time one is fitted.
+static func _toolbar_has(data: Node, k: String) -> void:
+	if not k in data.toolbar:
+		var free: int = data.toolbar.find("")
+		if free >= 0:
+			data.toolbar[free] = k
+
+
+## A ship changed (bought): its weapons that still fit stay on (biggest into
+## the biggest hardpoints), the rest go to the hold - or are sold, no room.
+## Returns the drachmas the unplaced ones fetched.
+static func refit(data: Node, old: Array) -> int:
+	var lay := layout(data.ship_class)
+	data.weapons = []
+	for i in lay.size():
+		data.weapons.append("")
+	var list := old.filter(func(x): return str(x) != "")
+	list.sort_custom(func(a, b): return size_of(a) > size_of(b))
+	var sold := 0
+	for id in list:
+		var s := free_slot_for(data, id)
+		if s >= 0:
+			data.weapons[s] = id
+		elif Inventory.room_for(data.items, id, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data)) >= 1:
+			Inventory.add(data.items, id, 1, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data))
+		else:
+			sold += roundi(price(id) * Gear.SELL_SHARE)
+	return sold
+
+
+## An older save's weapons ("equipment": the kinds owned, one of each): each
+## fitted at the biggest size its hardpoint takes, the starting Pulse Cannon S
+## first.
+static func from_equipment(data: Node, kinds: Array) -> void:
+	var lay := layout(data.ship_class)
+	data.weapons = []
+	for i in lay.size():
+		data.weapons.append("")
+	var order := KINDS.filter(func(k): return k in kinds or k == "laser")
+	for k in order:
+		var best := -1
+		for i in lay.size():
+			if data.weapons[i] == "" and int(lay[i]) >= int(MADE_IN[k][0]) and (best < 0 or lay[i] > lay[best]):
+				best = i
+		if best >= 0:
+			data.weapons[best] = item_id(k, mini(int(lay[best]), int(MADE_IN[k][1])) if k != "laser" else mini(int(lay[best]), BASE))
+		else:
+			Inventory.add(data.items, item_id(k, maxi(BASE, int(MADE_IN[k][0]))), 1, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data))
+
+
+# --- Other ships' loadouts ----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The weapon kinds an NPC ship carries, by its job (warships the heavy ones).
+const NPC_KINDS := {"patrol": ["laser", "plasma_cannon", "missile_launcher"], "pirate": ["laser", "plasma_cannon"],
+	"trader": ["laser"], "miner": ["laser"], "explorer": ["laser"], "": ["laser", "plasma_cannon", "missile_launcher"]}
+
+## A loadout for a ship of `ship_class` doing `role`: [weapon item id] - one
+## a hardpoint (a civilian fills half of them), the same draw for the same seed.
+static func loadout(ship_class: String, role: String, seed_n: int) -> Array:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = seed_n
+	var lay := layout(ship_class)
+	var kinds: Array = NPC_KINDS.get(role, NPC_KINDS[""])
+	var civil := role in ["trader", "miner", "explorer"]
+	var out := []
+	for i in lay.size():
+		if civil and i % 2 == 1:
+			continue
+		var k: String = kinds[rng.randi() % kinds.size()]
+		var r: Array = MADE_IN[k]
+		if int(lay[i]) < int(r[0]):
+			k = "laser"
+		out.append(item_id(k, clampi(int(lay[i]), int(MADE_IN[k][0]), int(MADE_IN[k][1]))))
+	return out

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): The ship's industry (Ship Computer > INDUSTRY), with the equipment for it: - the REFINERY ("refinery") turns mined fragments (Mining: "frag:<mineral>") into their mineral, a unit each (rubble: scrap, now and then a mineral), REFINE_TIME s a unit (less with the reactor's refinery upgrade); - the FABRICATOR ("fabricator") makes things from minerals and goods (RECIPES): metals and parts for the markets, spare parts for the Repair Bay, missiles and repair kits, small weapons, and UPGRADE KITS; - UPGRADE KITS fit a component upgrade (Upgrades) yourself: a Mk I raises a stat to level 1 or 2, a Mk II to 3 or 4, a Mk III to 5. Work goes on in the background while you fly, a unit at a time (tick()): its inputs are taken when it's ordered; what's made goes into the hold (it waits when the hold is full). The jobs: PlayerData.industry {"queue": [job...]}. A job: {kind: "refine"/"fab", id (the fragment / the recipe), n, done, t}. (Moved from scripts/industry.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,189 @@ 
+class_name Industry
+extends RefCounted
+## The ship's industry (Ship Computer > INDUSTRY), with the equipment for it:
+##  - the REFINERY ("refinery") turns mined fragments (Mining: "frag:<mineral>")
+##    into their mineral, a unit each (rubble: scrap, now and then a mineral),
+##    REFINE_TIME s a unit (less with the reactor's refinery upgrade);
+##  - the FABRICATOR ("fabricator") makes things from minerals and goods
+##    (RECIPES): metals and parts for the markets, spare parts for the Repair
+##    Bay, missiles and repair kits, small weapons, and UPGRADE KITS;
+##  - UPGRADE KITS fit a component upgrade (Upgrades) yourself: a Mk I raises a
+##    stat to level 1 or 2, a Mk II to 3 or 4, a Mk III to 5.
+## Work goes on in the background while you fly, a unit at a time (tick()): its
+## inputs are taken when it's ordered; what's made goes into the hold (it waits
+## when the hold is full). The jobs: PlayerData.industry {"queue": [job...]}.
+## A job: {kind: "refine"/"fab", id (the fragment / the recipe), n, done, t}.
+
+const REFINE_TIME := 1.2
+const KITS := {"upkit_1": [0, 1], "upkit_2": [2, 3], "upkit_3": [4, 4]}   # kit -> the levels it raises from
+
+## id -> [name, category, [output item, count], {input item: count}, seconds a unit]
+const RECIPES := {
+	# Metals and materials (the markets buy them)
+	"bronze_ingots": ["Bronze Ingots", "Materials", ["bronze_ingots", 1], {"copper_ore": 3, "tin_ore": 1}, 4.0],
+	"girders": ["Girders", "Materials", ["girders", 1], {"iron_ore": 5}, 4.0],
+	"hull_plates": ["Hull Plates", "Materials", ["hull_plates", 1], {"iron_ore": 4, "titanium_ore": 2}, 5.0],
+	"rivets": ["Rivets", "Materials", ["rivets", 4], {"iron_ore": 2}, 2.0],
+	"glass": ["Glass", "Materials", ["glass", 1], {"obsidian": 2, "salt": 1}, 3.0],
+	"cables": ["Power Cables", "Materials", ["cables", 1], {"copper_ore": 3}, 3.0],
+	"coolant": ["Coolant", "Materials", ["coolant", 1], {"ice": 4, "sulphur": 1}, 3.0],
+	"fuel": ["Fuel", "Materials", ["fuel", 2], {"ice": 3}, 3.0],
+	"water": ["Water", "Materials", ["water", 2], {"ice": 2}, 2.0],
+	# Components (the markets buy them too)
+	"bearings": ["Gears and Bearings", "Components", ["bearings", 1], {"iron_ore": 2, "cobalt": 1}, 4.0],
+	"circuit_boards": ["Circuit Boards", "Components", ["circuit_boards", 1], {"copper_ore": 1, "silver_ore": 1, "obsidian": 1}, 5.0],
+	"capacitors": ["Capacitor Banks", "Components", ["capacitors", 1], {"titanium_ore": 1, "silver_ore": 1, "cobalt": 1}, 5.0],
+	"processors": ["Processors", "Components", ["processors", 1], {"circuit_boards": 2, "gold_ore": 1}, 7.0],
+	"servos": ["Servos", "Components", ["servos", 1], {"bearings": 1, "cables": 1, "iron_ore": 1}, 6.0],
+	"optic_fibre": ["Optic Fibre", "Components", ["optic_fibre", 2], {"glass": 1, "silver_ore": 1}, 4.0],
+	"tools": ["Tools", "Components", ["tools", 1], {"iron_ore": 2, "bronze_ingots": 1}, 4.0],
+	"reactor_coils": ["Reactor Coils", "Components", ["reactor_coils", 1], {"copper_ore": 4, "cobalt": 2, "titanium_ore": 1}, 7.0],
+	# Spare parts (the Repair Bay)
+	"spare_circuit": ["Spare Circuit Board", "Spare parts", ["spare_circuit", 1], {"circuit_boards": 1, "silver_ore": 1}, 6.0],
+	"spare_conduit": ["Spare Conduit", "Spare parts", ["spare_conduit", 1], {"titanium_ore": 2, "copper_ore": 1}, 5.0],
+	"spare_servo": ["Spare Servo", "Spare parts", ["spare_servo", 1], {"servos": 1}, 4.0],
+	"spare_plate": ["Spare Plate", "Spare parts", ["spare_plate", 1], {"hull_plates": 1}, 4.0],
+	"spare_lens": ["Spare Lens", "Spare parts", ["spare_lens", 1], {"glass": 1, "silver_ore": 1}, 5.0],
+	"spare_cell": ["Spare Power Cell", "Spare parts", ["spare_cell", 1], {"capacitors": 1, "cobalt": 1}, 6.0],
+	# Supplies
+	"missile": ["Missiles", "Supplies", ["missile", 5], {"iron_ore": 2, "sulphur": 1, "circuit_boards": 1}, 6.0],
+	"repair_kit": ["Repair Kit", "Supplies", ["repair_kit", 1], {"titanium_ore": 2, "iron_ore": 3, "circuit_boards": 1}, 6.0],
+	# Weapons (extra small: for the small hardpoints)
+	"wpn_laser": ["Pulse Cannon XS", "Weapons", ["wpn:laser:0", 1], {"iron_ore": 6, "copper_ore": 4, "circuit_boards": 2}, 10.0],
+	"wpn_plasma": ["Plasma Cannon XS", "Weapons", ["wpn:plasma_cannon:0", 1], {"titanium_ore": 4, "cobalt": 2, "capacitors": 2}, 12.0],
+	"wpn_missile": ["Missile Launcher XS", "Weapons", ["wpn:missile_launcher:0", 1], {"iron_ore": 6, "bearings": 2, "circuit_boards": 2}, 12.0],
+	# Upgrade kits (fit an upgrade yourself: KITS)
+	"upkit_1": ["Upgrade Kit Mk I", "Upgrade kits", ["upkit_1", 1], {"processors": 1, "hull_plates": 2, "titanium_ore": 4}, 12.0],
+	"upkit_2": ["Upgrade Kit Mk II", "Upgrade kits", ["upkit_2", 1], {"processors": 2, "capacitors": 2, "platinum_ore": 3, "orichalcum": 1}, 18.0],
+	"upkit_3": ["Upgrade Kit Mk III", "Upgrade kits", ["upkit_3", 1], {"processors": 3, "reactor_coils": 2, "gold_ore": 3, "orichalcum": 3, "quantum_cores": 1}, 25.0],
+}
+const CATEGORIES := ["Materials", "Components", "Spare parts", "Supplies", "Weapons", "Upgrade kits"]
+
+
+static func recipe(id: String) -> Array:
+	return RECIPES.get(id, [])
+
+
+## How many units of recipe `id` the items can pay for.
+static func can_make(items: Dictionary, id: String) -> int:
+	var r := recipe(id)
+	if r.is_empty():
+		return 0
+	var n := 999
+	for k in r[3]:
+		n = mini(n, int(items.get(k, 0)) / int(r[3][k]))
+	return n
+
+
+static func queue_of(data: Node) -> Array:
+	if not data.industry.get("queue") is Array:
+		data.industry["queue"] = []
+	return data.industry["queue"]
+
+
+## Orders `n` units refined (fragments `frag`) or made (recipe `id`): the inputs
+## are taken now. False if there's no refinery / fabricator, or not enough.
+static func order(data: Node, kind: String, id: String, n: int) -> bool:
+	if n <= 0:
+		return false
+	if kind == "refine":
+		if not data.has_equipment("refinery") or not Mining.is_frag(id) or data.count(id) < n:
+			return false
+		data.remove_item(id, n)
+	else:
+		if not data.has_equipment("fabricator") or can_make(data.items, id) < n:
+			return false
+		var r := recipe(id)
+		for k in r[3]:
+			data.remove_item(k, int(r[3][k]) * n)
+	queue_of(data).append({"kind": kind, "id": id, "n": n, "done": 0, "t": 0.0})
+	data.changed.emit()
+	return true
+
+
+## Takes an unfinished job off the queue: what wasn't made yet is given back.
+static func cancel(data: Node, i: int) -> void:
+	var q := queue_of(data)
+	if i < 0 or i >= q.size():
+		return
+	var j: Dictionary = q[i]
+	var left := int(j["n"]) - int(j["done"])
+	if j["kind"] == "refine":
+		data.add_item(j["id"], left)
+	else:
+		var r := recipe(j["id"])
+		for k in r[3]:
+			data.add_item(k, int(r[3][k]) * left)
+	q.remove_at(i)
+	data.changed.emit()
+
+
+## A unit's time: a recipe's, or refining (faster with the reactor's refinery upgrade).
+static func unit_time(data: Node, job: Dictionary) -> float:
+	if job["kind"] == "refine":
+		return REFINE_TIME / (1.0 + data.mod("refine_speed"))
+	return float(recipe(job["id"])[4])
+
+
+## What a unit of the job puts out: [[item, count]...].
+static func output(job: Dictionary, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> Array:
+	if job["kind"] == "refine":
+		var m := Mining.mineral_of(job["id"])
+		if m == "rubble":
+			var out := [["scrap", 1]]
+			if rng.randf() < 0.25:
+				out.append([["iron_ore", "copper_ore", "tin_ore", "sulphur", "salt"][rng.randi() % 5], 1])
+			return out
+		return [[m, 1]]
+	var r := recipe(job["id"])
+	return [[r[2][0], int(r[2][1])]]
+
+
+## The industry goes on: the first job a unit at a time (the others wait their
+## turn). Returns the things made this time ([[item, count]...]).
+static func tick(data: Node, delta: float, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> Array:
+	var made := []
+	var q := queue_of(data)
+	if q.is_empty():
+		return made
+	var j: Dictionary = q[0]
+	var need: bool = (j["kind"] == "refine" and data.has_equipment("refinery")) or (j["kind"] == "fab" and data.has_equipment("fabricator"))
+	if not need:
+		return made
+	j["t"] = float(j["t"]) + delta
+	var ut := unit_time(data, j)
+	while float(j["t"]) >= ut and int(j["done"]) < int(j["n"]):
+		var out := output(j, rng)
+		var cap := Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data)
+		if not out.all(func(o): return Hardpoints.is_weapon(o[0]) or Inventory.room_for(data.items, o[0], cap) >= int(o[1]) or not Items.is_cargo(o[0])):
+			j["t"] = ut   # (the hold's full: it waits)
+			j["waiting"] = true
+			return made
+		j.erase("waiting")
+		j["t"] = float(j["t"]) - ut
+		j["done"] = int(j["done"]) + 1
+		for o in out:
+			data.add_item(o[0], int(o[1]))
+			made.append(o)
+	if int(j["done"]) >= int(j["n"]):
+		q.remove_at(0)
+	if not made.is_empty():
+		data.changed.emit()
+	return made
+
+
+## A kit can raise `id` (body `which`) from its level now?
+static func kit_fits(kit: String, ups: Dictionary, which: String, id: String) -> bool:
+	var l := Upgrades.level(ups, which, id)
+	var band: Array = KITS.get(kit, [9, 9])
+	return l >= int(band[0]) and l <= int(band[1]) and l < Upgrades.MAX_LEVEL
+
+
+## Fits a kit: the stat a level up, the kit used. False if it doesn't fit.
+static func fit_kit(data: Node, kit: String, which: String, id: String) -> bool:
+	if data.count(kit) <= 0 or not kit_fits(kit, data.upgrades, which, id):
+		return false
+	data.remove_item(kit, 1)
+	Upgrades.raise(data.upgrades, which, id)
+	data.changed.emit()
+	return true

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Slot inventories: every item stacks up to STACK in a slot (250 iron ore take 3 slots). Your ship's hold has its class's slots (Shipyard.CLASS_HOLD; Cargo Racks add more), up to SHIP_SLOTS (Shipyard.cargo_capacity); on a planet you carry PLAYER_SLOTS slots of your own (player "carried": {id: n}, saved) - what you pick up there goes to you, and you move it to and from your ship at the ship (TransferPanel). Both toolbars (in space and on foot) have TOOLBAR_SLOTS slots you fill yourself: hover something usable in the inventory and press 1-9 (right-click a slot to empty it). An inventory here is a Dictionary {id: count}; credits are never in one. (Moved from scripts/inventory.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,231 @@ 
+class_name Inventory
+## Slot inventories: every item stacks up to STACK in a slot (250 iron ore
+## take 3 slots). Your ship's hold has its class's slots (Shipyard.CLASS_HOLD;
+## Cargo Racks add more), up to SHIP_SLOTS (Shipyard.cargo_capacity); on a planet you carry PLAYER_SLOTS slots of your
+## own (player "carried": {id: n}, saved) - what you pick up there goes to you,
+## and you move it to and from your ship at the ship (TransferPanel). Both
+## toolbars (in space and on foot) have TOOLBAR_SLOTS slots you fill yourself:
+## hover something usable in the inventory and press 1-9 (right-click a slot
+## to empty it).
+## An inventory here is a Dictionary {id: count}; credits are never in one.
+
+const STACK := 100
+const SHIP_SLOTS := 120          # the most any ship can have (Shipyard.CLASS_HOLD sets each class's)
+const PLAYER_SLOTS := 12
+const TOOLBAR_SLOTS := 9
+## The toolbars as a new pilot has them: the ship's weapons and systems, your
+## rifle and supplies on foot ("" = an empty slot).
+const SHIP_TOOLBAR := ["laser", "plasma_cannon", "missile_launcher", "afterburner", "shield_booster", "repair_kit", "", "", ""]
+const FOOT_TOOLBAR := ["rifle", "medicine", "energy_cell", "", "", "", "", "", ""]
+## What can go on the toolbar on foot.
+const FOOT_USABLE := ["rifle", "medicine", "energy_cell"]
+
+
+## Usable on foot (toolbar, a click in the field inventory): FOOT_USABLE,
+## food and energy drinks (Stamina), and skills ("skill:<id>": Skills).
+static func foot_usable(id: String) -> bool:
+	return id in FOOT_USABLE or Stamina.restores(id) > 0.0 or Skills.valid(id)
+
+
+## Slots an item count takes.
+static func slots_for(n: int) -> int:
+	return ceili(n / float(STACK)) if n > 0 else 0
+
+
+static func slots_used(inv: Dictionary) -> int:
+	var s := 0
+	for id in inv:
+		s += slots_for(int(inv[id]))
+	return s
+
+
+## How many more of `id` fit: the empty slots' worth, and the rest of its last stack.
+static func room_for(inv: Dictionary, id: String, cap: int) -> int:
+	var n := int(inv.get(id, 0))
+	var partial := (STACK - n % STACK) % STACK if n > 0 else 0
+	return maxi(0, cap - slots_used(inv)) * STACK + partial
+
+
+## Puts up to `amount` of `id` in; how many went in.
+static func add(inv: Dictionary, id: String, amount: int, cap: int) -> int:
+	var n := mini(amount, room_for(inv, id, cap))
+	if n > 0:
+		inv[id] = int(inv.get(id, 0)) + n
+	return n
+
+
+static func take(inv: Dictionary, id: String, amount: int) -> int:
+	var n := mini(amount, int(inv.get(id, 0)))
+	if n > 0:
+		inv[id] = int(inv[id]) - n
+		if int(inv[id]) <= 0:
+			inv.erase(id)
+	return n
+
+
+## Moves one stack's worth (up to STACK) of `id` from one inventory to another
+## (as much as it has room for); how many moved.
+static func move_stack(from: Dictionary, to: Dictionary, id: String, to_cap: int) -> int:
+	var n := int(from.get(id, 0))
+	if n <= 0:
+		return 0
+	var stack := n % STACK if n % STACK != 0 else STACK   # (the last, partial stack first)
+	var moved := add(to, id, mini(stack, n), to_cap)
+	take(from, id, moved)
+	return moved
+
+
+## The slots to draw: [[id, count], ...] - full stacks then the remainder,
+## items in name order.
+static func stacks(inv: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var ids := inv.keys().filter(func(id): return int(inv[id]) > 0 and Items.exists(id))
+	ids.sort()
+	for id in ids:
+		var n := int(inv[id])
+		while n > 0:
+			out.append([id, mini(n, STACK)])
+			n -= STACK
+	return out
+
+
+## The slots as laid out: an inventory's slot layout (an Array of ids, one per
+## slot; "" empty) puts each item where you dragged it. Returns `cap` slots,
+## each [id, count] or [] (empty): an item's stacks fill the slots the layout
+## gives it first, in order (full stacks first); what's left goes to the first
+## empty slots (and the layout learns it); slots of items you no longer have
+## are emptied. The layout is resized to `cap` and updated in place.
+static func slots(inv: Dictionary, layout: Array, cap: int) -> Array:
+	layout.resize(cap)
+	for i in cap:
+		if layout[i] == null:
+			layout[i] = ""
+	var left := {}
+	for id in inv:
+		if int(inv[id]) > 0 and Items.exists(id):
+			left[id] = int(inv[id])
+	var out := []
+	out.resize(cap)
+	for i in cap:
+		var id: String = layout[i]
+		if id != "" and int(left.get(id, 0)) > 0:
+			var n := mini(STACK, int(left[id]))
+			out[i] = [id, n]
+			left[id] = int(left[id]) - n
+		else:
+			out[i] = []
+			layout[i] = ""
+	var ids := left.keys().filter(func(id): return int(left[id]) > 0)
+	ids.sort()
+	var free := 0
+	for id in ids:
+		while int(left[id]) > 0:
+			while free < cap and not (out[free] as Array).is_empty():
+				free += 1
+			if free >= cap:
+				return out   # (more than fits: shown as far as it goes)
+			var n := mini(STACK, int(left[id]))
+			out[free] = [id, n]
+			layout[free] = id
+			left[id] = int(left[id]) - n
+	return out
+
+
+## Dragging slot `a` onto slot `b` of the same inventory: they swap places
+## (or the stack moves, if `b` is empty).
+static func swap(layout: Array, a: int, b: int) -> void:
+	if a == b or a < 0 or b < 0 or a >= layout.size() or b >= layout.size():
+		return
+	var t = layout[a]
+	layout[a] = layout[b]
+	layout[b] = t
+
+
+## A drop from one inventory onto slot `slot` of another: one stack of `id`
+## moves across (as far as there's room), into that slot if it's free.
+static func move_stack_into(from: Dictionary, to: Dictionary, id: String, to_cap: int, to_layout: Array, slot: int) -> int:
+	if slot >= 0 and slot < to_layout.size() and str(to_layout[slot]) == "":
+		to_layout[slot] = id
+	return move_stack(from, to, id, to_cap)
+
+
+## A player's layout for an inventory ("hold" or "carried": player
+## "layout_hold" / "layout_carried").
+static func layout(player: Dictionary, which: String) -> Array:
+	var key := "layout_" + which
+	if not player.get(key) is Array:
+		player[key] = []
+	return player[key]
+
+
+## What you carry on a planet (player "carried"; an older save's "pack" moves in).
+static func carried(player: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	if not player.has("carried") or not player["carried"] is Dictionary:
+		player["carried"] = {}
+	var old: Dictionary = player.get("pack", {})
+	if not old.is_empty():
+		for id in old:
+			player["carried"][id] = int(player["carried"].get(id, 0)) + int(old[id])
+		player.erase("pack")
+	return player["carried"]
+
+
+## A toolbar (player "toolbar" in space, "toolbar_foot" on foot): always
+## TOOLBAR_SLOTS entries (an id or "").
+static func toolbar(player: Dictionary, foot: bool) -> Array:
+	var key := "toolbar_foot" if foot else "toolbar"
+	var t: Array = player.get(key, [])
+	if t.size() != TOOLBAR_SLOTS:
+		var base: Array = (FOOT_TOOLBAR if foot else SHIP_TOOLBAR).duplicate()
+		for i in mini(t.size(), TOOLBAR_SLOTS):
+			base[i] = str(t[i])
+		t = base
+		player[key] = t
+	return t
+
+
+## A drop onto toolbar slot `i` (drag and drop): another of its slots - they
+## swap; something usable from an inventory - it goes there (and leaves the
+## slot it was in, if any). True if it was taken. Payloads: {src: "toolbar",
+## which: "ship" / "foot", index, id} or {src: "hold" / "carried" / "gear", id}.
+static func toolbar_drop(bar: Array, i: int, data: Dictionary, foot: bool) -> bool:
+	if i < 0 or i >= bar.size():
+		return false
+	if data.get("src") == "toolbar":
+		if data.get("which") != ("foot" if foot else "ship"):
+			return false
+		var j: int = data.get("index", -1)
+		if j < 0 or j >= bar.size():
+			return false
+		var t = bar[i]
+		bar[i] = bar[j]
+		bar[j] = t
+		return true
+	var id: String = toolbar_id(str(data.get("id", "")), foot)
+	if id == "":
+		return false
+	var was := bar.find(id)
+	if was >= 0:
+		bar[was] = bar[i] if was != i else ""   # (one slot per tool: what was here goes where it came from)
+	bar[i] = id
+	return true
+
+
+## What a dragged thing is on a toolbar ("" - it can't go there).
+static func toolbar_id(id: String, foot: bool) -> String:
+	if foot:
+		if id == "laser" or id == "rifle":
+			return "rifle"
+		return id if foot_usable(id) else ""
+	return id if ship_usable(id) else ""
+
+
+static func toolbar_accepts(data: Dictionary, foot: bool) -> bool:
+	if data.get("src") == "toolbar":
+		return data.get("which") == ("foot" if foot else "ship")
+	return toolbar_id(str(data.get("id", "")), foot) != ""
+
+
+## Can `id` go on the ship's toolbar? (a weapon, a ship system)
+static func ship_usable(id: String) -> bool:
+	return Items.WEAPONS.has(id) or Items.SYSTEMS.has(id)

+## (The toolbars: Inventory.SHIP_TOOLBAR / FOOT_TOOLBAR, filled by the player.)

+
+## A stack's tooltip: its name and count, what it is, what it sells for and
+## `hint` (what clicking / dragging it does here).
+static func tooltip(id: String, n: int, hint := "") -> String:
+	var it: Dictionary = info(id)
+	if it.is_empty():
+		return id
+	var t := "%s  ×%d\n%s" % [it.get("name", id), n, it.get("desc", "")]
+	if Gear.is_gear(id):
+		t += "\n" + Gear.describe(id)
+	elif Hardpoints.is_weapon(id):
+		t += "\n" + Hardpoints.describe(id)
+	t += "\n" + ("Main quest item - cannot be sold." if it.get("kind", "") == "quest" else "Sells for %d drachmas each." % int(it.get("value", 0)))
+	if hint != "":
+		t += "\n" + hint
+	return t
+
+
+## An item's data ({name, kind, value, desc...}): the catalogue's, or a gear
+## item's (Gear: "gear:<kind>:<quality>") - {} if there's no such item.
+static func info(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if ITEMS.has(id):
+		return ITEMS[id]
+	if Gear.is_gear(id):
+		return Gear.info(id)
+	if Hardpoints.is_weapon(id):
+		return Hardpoints.info(id)
+	if Mining.is_frag(id):
+		return Mining.info(id)
+	if NavReports.is_report(id):
+		return NavReports.info(id)
+	if Skills.is_skill(id):
+		return Skills.info(id)
+	return {}
+
+
+## Whether `id` is a known item (the catalogue's or a piece of gear).
+static func exists(id: String) -> bool:
+	return ITEMS.has(id) or not Gear.parse(id).is_empty() or not Hardpoints.parse(id).is_empty() or Mining.valid(id) or NavReports.valid(id) or Skills.valid(id)
+
+
+static func display_name(id: String) -> String:
+	if id == "credits":
+		return "Drachmas"
+	if Gear.is_gear(id):
+		return Gear.title(id)
+	if Hardpoints.is_weapon(id):
+		return Hardpoints.title(id)
+	if Mining.is_frag(id):
+		return str(Mining.info(id).get("name", id))
+	if NavReports.is_report(id):
+		return str(NavReports.info(id).get("name", id))
+	if Skills.is_skill(id):
+		return str(Skills.info(id).get("name", id))
+	if ITEMS.has(id):
+		return ITEMS[id]["name"]
+	if EQUIPMENT.has(id):
+		return EQUIPMENT[id]["name"]
+	return id

+# --- Icons -------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Each icon is drawn once into a small texture (icon_texture: off screen, a
+# SubViewport) and the inventories' slots draw that: a page of slots (the
+# outfitter's 70 cards) costs one draw call a slot instead of half a dozen.
+# Until a texture is ready - and with no renderer (headless) - the slots draw
+# the icon itself (draw_icon).
+
+const ICON_BAKE := 64
+static var _icon_tex := {}         # "id|dim" -> Texture2D, or null while baking / when it can't be
+static var _icon_queue: Array = []
+static var _icon_baking := false
+
+
+class IconDraw extends Control:
+	var id := ""
+	var dim := false
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		Items.draw_icon(self, id, Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), dim)
+
+
+static func icon_texture(id: String, dim := false) -> Texture2D:
+	var key := "%s|%s" % [id, dim]
+	if _icon_tex.has(key):
+		return _icon_tex[key]
+	_icon_tex[key] = null
+	_icon_queue.append([key, id, dim])
+	if not _icon_baking:
+		_bake_icons.call_deferred()
+	return null
+
+
+static func _bake_icons() -> void:
+	var tree := Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree
+	if tree == null or _icon_queue.is_empty():
+		return
+	_icon_baking = true
+	# A few at a time (a screen full of new icons at once - 18 viewports and
+	# read-backs in one frame - was a long frame); the rest in the next batch.
+	var jobs := _icon_queue.slice(0, 4)
+	_icon_queue = _icon_queue.slice(4)
+	var vps := []
+	for j in jobs:
+		var vp := SubViewport.new()
+		vp.size = Vector2i(ICON_BAKE, ICON_BAKE)
+		vp.transparent_bg = true
+		vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+		var d := IconDraw.new()
+		d.id = j[1]
+		d.dim = j[2]
+		d.size = Vector2(ICON_BAKE, ICON_BAKE)
+		vp.add_child(d)
+		tree.root.add_child(vp)
+		vps.append(vp)
+	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
+	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
+	for i in jobs.size():
+		var img: Image = vps[i].get_texture().get_image()
+		vps[i].queue_free()
+		if img != null and not img.is_empty():
+			img.generate_mipmaps()
+			_icon_tex[jobs[i][0]] = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+	_icon_baking = false
+	tree.call_group("item_slots", "queue_redraw")
+	if not _icon_queue.is_empty():
+		_bake_icons()
+

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): What you lose when you die, and win back. Dying - your ship destroyed in space (Main.respawn_state) or knocked out on a planet (PlanetSurface. knocked_out) - loses one thing you carry: a random stack from your inventory (an item and all of its count) or a piece of your toolbar's equipment (a weapon or a ship system - never the basic laser, never a story item). It goes on your lost list (player "lost": [{kind, id, n}], saved). Every NPC you kill yourself - a ship in space, a pirate or an animal on a planet - has a REGAIN_CHANCE chance to bring one lost thing back (a random one); RegainPopup shows "ITEM REGAINED" with its name. Works on the save format of the player (a Dictionary: items {id: n}, equipment [ids], lost [...]) - PlayerData has its own copy of regain. (Moved from scripts/lost_items.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,81 @@ 
+class_name LostItems
+## What you lose when you die, and win back. Dying - your ship destroyed in
+## space (Main.respawn_state) or knocked out on a planet (PlanetSurface.
+## knocked_out) - loses one thing you carry: a random stack from your
+## inventory (an item and all of its count) or a piece of your toolbar's
+## equipment (a weapon or a ship system - never the basic laser, never a story
+## item). It goes on your lost list (player "lost": [{kind, id, n}], saved).
+## Every NPC you kill yourself - a ship in space, a pirate or an animal on a
+## planet - has a REGAIN_CHANCE chance to bring one lost thing back (a random
+## one); RegainPopup shows "ITEM REGAINED" with its name.
+## Works on the save format of the player (a Dictionary: items {id: n},
+## equipment [ids], lost [...]) - PlayerData has its own copy of regain.
+
+const REGAIN_CHANCE := 0.1
+## Equipment never lost (what every ship has).
+const KEPT := ["laser"]
+
+
+## Loses one thing from `player` (the save format) onto its lost list; its
+## name ("" if there was nothing to lose). `from`: "items" - the ship's hold
+## and its equipment (your ship destroyed); "carried" - what you carry on foot
+## (knocked out on a planet).
+static func lose_one(player: Dictionary, roll := -1.0, from := "items") -> String:
+	var choices := []
+	var items: Dictionary = Inventory.carried(player) if from == "carried" else player.get("items", {})
+	for id in items:
+		if int(items[id]) > 0 and Items.info(id).get("kind", "") != "quest":
+			choices.append({"kind": "item", "id": id, "n": int(items[id])})
+	if from == "items":
+		for id in player.get("equipment", []):
+			if not id in KEPT:
+				choices.append({"kind": "equipment", "id": id, "n": 1})
+		# A fitted weapon (Hardpoints) - never a small Pulse Cannon: won back into the hold.
+		var ws: Array = player.get("weapons", [])
+		for i in ws.size():
+			var w := str(ws[i])
+			if w != "" and not (Hardpoints.kind(w) in KEPT and Hardpoints.size_of(w) <= Hardpoints.BASE):
+				choices.append({"kind": "item", "id": w, "n": 1, "slot": i})
+	if choices.is_empty():
+		return ""
+	choices.sort_custom(func(a, b): return str(a["id"]) < str(b["id"]))   # (the same roll, the same pick)
+	var r := roll if roll >= 0.0 else randf()
+	var e: Dictionary = choices[mini(int(r * choices.size()), choices.size() - 1)]
+	if e.has("slot"):
+		player["weapons"][int(e["slot"])] = ""
+		e.erase("slot")
+	elif e["kind"] == "item":
+		items.erase(e["id"])
+	else:
+		var eq: Array = player["equipment"]
+		eq.erase(e["id"])
+	if not player.has("lost"):
+		player["lost"] = []
+	(player["lost"] as Array).append(e)
+	return label(e)
+
+
+## A kill's chance (roll < REGAIN_CHANCE) to win one lost thing back into
+## `player`; its name ("" if not this time).
+static func regain(player: Dictionary, roll := -1.0) -> String:
+	var lost: Array = player.get("lost", [])
+	var r := roll if roll >= 0.0 else randf()
+	if lost.is_empty() or r >= REGAIN_CHANCE:
+		return ""
+	var e: Dictionary = lost.pop_at(int(r / REGAIN_CHANCE * lost.size()) % lost.size())
+	if e["kind"] == "item":
+		var items: Dictionary = player.get("items", {})
+		items[e["id"]] = int(items.get(e["id"], 0)) + int(e["n"])
+		player["items"] = items
+	else:
+		var eq: Array = player.get("equipment", [])
+		if not e["id"] in eq:
+			eq.append(e["id"])
+		player["equipment"] = eq
+	return label(e)
+
+
+## "Repair Kit x2", "Plasma Cannon".
+static func label(e: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var name := Items.display_name(e["id"]) if e["kind"] == "item" else str(Items.EQUIPMENT.get(e["id"], {}).get("name", e["id"]))
+	return name + (" x%d" % int(e["n"]) if int(e["n"]) > 1 else "")

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Mining by hand. A rock is a mix of minerals (COMPOSITION by its kind, each rock its own share of them) and its ore lies in VEINS - seams of one mineral each at places on it, hidden until a prospecting scan (right-click the rock: ShipScanner) shows them and what the rock holds. Cutting a vein (hold the left button on the rock; click near a vein to pick it) heats it: below the vein's band it cuts slowly; in its band (green) it cuts at full speed and builds RESONANCE - the longer you hold it there the faster, up to RESONANCE_MAX; above the band it strains; at the top it FRACTURES - a share of the vein breaks off as worthless rubble and the heat drops. Each vein heats at its own pace (its mineral's HARDNESS). Let go to let it cool. Without a scan you can only hack at the bulk rock: rubble. Cut ore comes off as FRAGMENTS ("frag:<mineral>"): sold as they are they fetch little; an on-board refinery (Industry) turns them into the mineral. (Moved from scripts/mining.gd.)

+## rock its own share of them) and its ore lies in VEINS - seams of one

+	"platinum": {"platinum_ore": 0.45, "gold_ore": 0.2, "silver_ore": 0.15, "orichalcum": 0.1, "cobalt": 0.1},
+	"ice": {"ice": 0.75, "sulphur": 0.1, "salt": 0.1, "obsidian": 0.05},
+}
+## The heat model (per second, at hardness 1): firing heats, it always cools.
+const HEAT := 0.42
+const COOL := 0.2
+const BAND := Vector2(0.55, 0.82)     # the cutting band (green)
+const SLOW_FROM := 0.3                # below this it doesn't cut
+const RATE := 3.6                     # fragments a second in the band (resonance 1)
+const RESONANCE_RATE := 0.3           # resonance a second, held in the band
+const RESONANCE_MAX := 1.6
+const FRACTURE_LOSS := 0.25           # of what's left in the vein, lost as rubble
+const FRAG_SHARE := 0.4               # a fragment sells for this share of its mineral
+
+
+## A rock's veins and composition, from its kind, size and seed: {comp: {mineral: share}, veins: [...]}.
+## A vein: {a (angle on the rock), d (its distance out, x radius), mineral, units, max, heat, res}.
+static func generate(kind: String, radius: float, ore_total: int, seed_n: int) -> Dictionary:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = seed_n * 31 + 7
+	var base: Dictionary = COMPOSITION.get(kind, COMPOSITION["iron"])
+	var comp := {}
+	var sum := 0.0
+	for m in base:
+		var v: float = float(base[m]) * rng.randf_range(0.6, 1.4)
+		comp[m] = v
+		sum += v
+	for m in comp:
+		comp[m] = comp[m] / sum
+	var n := clampi(2 + int(radius / 32.0), 2, 5)
+	var veins := []
+	var vein_units := int(ore_total * 0.75)
+	var minerals: Array = comp.keys()
+	minerals.sort_custom(func(a, b): return comp[a] > comp[b])
+	for i in n:
+		# (the first the main mineral; the rest drawn by share)
+		var m: String = minerals[0]
+		if i > 0:
+			var r := rng.randf()
+			for k in minerals:
+				r -= float(comp[k])
+				if r <= 0.0:
+					m = k
+					break
+		var units := maxi(4, int(vein_units * (0.45 if i == 0 else 0.55 / (n - 1)) * rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.2)))
+		veins.append({"a": TAU * (i + rng.randf_range(0.15, 0.85)) / n, "d": rng.randf_range(0.35, 0.72), "mineral": m,
+			"units": units, "max": units, "heat": 0.0, "res": 1.0, "acc": 0.0, "len": rng.randf_range(0.25, 0.45)})
+	return {"comp": comp, "veins": veins}
+
+
+## How fast a vein cuts at its heat (0: not at all).
+static func cut_rate(heat: float) -> float:
+	if heat < SLOW_FROM:
+		return 0.0
+	if heat < BAND.x:
+		return 0.3
+	if heat <= BAND.y:
+		return 1.0
+	return 0.7
+
+
+static func in_band(heat: float) -> bool:
+	return heat >= BAND.x and heat <= BAND.y
+
+
+# --- Fragments: items "frag:<mineral>" ("frag:rubble": broken rock) --------------------------------
+
+static func frag_id(mineral: String) -> String:
+	return PREFIX + mineral
+
+
+static func is_frag(id: String) -> bool:
+	return id.begins_with(PREFIX)
+
+
+static func mineral_of(id: String) -> String:
+	return id.substr(PREFIX.length()) if is_frag(id) else ""
+
+
+static func valid(id: String) -> bool:
+	var m := mineral_of(id)
+	return m == "rubble" or MINERALS.has(m)
+
+
+static func info(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if not valid(id):
+		return {}
+	var m := mineral_of(id)
+	if m == "rubble":
+		return {"name": "Rubble", "kind": "cargo", "value": 1,
+			"desc": "Broken rock from a fractured vein or the bulk of an unscanned asteroid. A refinery gets a little scrap and the odd mineral out of it."}
+	var mi: Dictionary = Items.ITEMS.get(m, {})
+	return {"name": "%s Fragments" % str(mi.get("name", m)).replace(" Ore", ""), "kind": "cargo",
+		"value": maxi(1, roundi(float(mi.get("value", 10)) * FRAG_SHARE)),
+		"desc": "Cut from an asteroid's vein: %s in raw rock. An on-board refinery (Industry) turns each into a unit of %s - sold as they are they fetch little." % [str(mi.get("name", m)).to_lower(), str(mi.get("name", m)).to_lower()]}
+
+
+## A fragment's icon: a jagged chunk in its mineral's colours, with a glint of it.
+static func draw_icon(ci: CanvasItem, id: String, rect: Rect2, dim := false) -> void:
+	var c := rect.get_center()
+	var s := minf(rect.size.x, rect.size.y) * 0.5
+	var a := 0.4 if dim else 1.0
+	var m := mineral_of(id)
+	var col := mineral_color(m)
+	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = hash(m)
+	for k in 7:
+		pts.append(c + Vector2.from_angle(TAU * k / 7.0 + 0.3) * s * rng.randf_range(0.55, 0.8))
+	ci.draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(0.32, 0.29, 0.27, a))
+	var inner := PackedVector2Array()
+	for p in pts:
+		inner.append(c + (p - c) * 0.55 + Vector2(-0.08, -0.08) * s)
+	if m != "rubble":
+		ci.draw_colored_polygon(inner, Color(col, 0.85 * a))
+		ci.draw_line(c + Vector2(-0.3, -0.25) * s, c + Vector2(0.2, 0.1) * s, Color(col.lightened(0.5), a), maxf(1.0, s * 0.08), true)
+	pts.append(pts[0])
+	ci.draw_polyline(pts, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6 * a), maxf(1.0, s * 0.06), true)
+
+
+static func mineral_color(m: String) -> Color:
+	match m:
+		"iron_ore": return Color(0.85, 0.48, 0.3)
+		"titanium_ore": return Color(0.4, 0.88, 1.0)
+		"platinum_ore": return Color(0.9, 0.9, 0.95)
+		"ice": return Color(0.7, 0.92, 1.0)
+		"copper_ore": return Color(0.9, 0.55, 0.3)
+		"tin_ore": return Color(0.7, 0.72, 0.68)
+		"silver_ore": return Color(0.85, 0.88, 0.92)
+		"gold_ore": return Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.3)
+		"cobalt": return Color(0.3, 0.45, 1.0)
+		"sulphur": return Color(0.95, 0.9, 0.3)
+		"obsidian": return Color(0.35, 0.3, 0.45)
+		"salt": return Color(0.95, 0.95, 0.92)
+		"orichalcum": return Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.35)
+	return Color(0.6, 0.55, 0.5)
