files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Missions (the stations' jobs). Every station offers MISSIONS_PER_STATION; the player can run up to MAX_ACTIVE at once. bounty - destroy N hostile ships of any kind (completes by itself) hunt - destroy N ships of one class (completes by itself) courier - dock at another station (completes on docking there) supply - bring N trade goods to another station (handed over on docking there) salvage - bring N salvage / ore to this station (turn it in here) survey - fly to an uncharted point and scan it (completes on arriving) repair - bring repair materials to this damaged station (turn it in here; mends the station - Galaxy.repair_station) defend - destroy N ships of the empire besieging this station's system War missions (empires with a war on, or an invasion coming - _fill_war): protect - an invasion is coming for a system of theirs: destroy N of the invader's warships there strike - take N% off an enemy station's condition (or destroy it) join - fly with one of their fleets (Fleets) for N seconds attack_fleet - destroy N ships of an enemy fleet, wherever it goes A severely damaged station (Galaxy.DAMAGED) offers only repair and defend missions (crisis_offers) until it's mended. Each mission has a tier (TIERS): the better ones need a good reputation with the station's empire (Galaxy.reputation) and pay more; ones you aren't trusted with yet show greyed out (available() false). Finishing a mission raises your reputation with that empire (more for higher tiers). (Moved from scripts/missions.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,513 @@ 
+extends Node
+## Missions (the stations' jobs). Every station offers MISSIONS_PER_STATION;
+## the player can run up to MAX_ACTIVE at once.
+##   bounty  - destroy N hostile ships of any kind     (completes by itself)
+##   hunt    - destroy N ships of one class            (completes by itself)
+##   courier - dock at another station                 (completes on docking there)
+##   supply  - bring N trade goods to another station  (handed over on docking there)
+##   salvage - bring N salvage / ore to this station   (turn it in here)
+##   survey  - fly to an uncharted point and scan it   (completes on arriving)
+##   repair  - bring repair materials to this damaged station (turn it in here;
+##             mends the station - Galaxy.repair_station)
+##   defend  - destroy N ships of the empire besieging this station's system
+## War missions (empires with a war on, or an invasion coming - _fill_war):
+##   protect     - an invasion is coming for a system of theirs: destroy N of
+##                 the invader's warships there
+##   strike      - take N% off an enemy station's condition (or destroy it)
+##   join        - fly with one of their fleets (Fleets) for N seconds
+##   attack_fleet - destroy N ships of an enemy fleet, wherever it goes
+## A severely damaged station (Galaxy.DAMAGED) offers only repair and defend
+## missions (crisis_offers) until it's mended.
+## Each mission has a tier (TIERS): the better ones need a good reputation
+## with the station's empire (Galaxy.reputation) and pay more; ones you
+## aren't trusted with yet show greyed out (available() false). Finishing a
+## mission raises your reputation with that empire (more for higher tiers).
+
+signal changed
+signal completed(mission: Dictionary)
+
+const MAX_ACTIVE := 5
+const MISSIONS_PER_STATION := 8
+## Tiers: name, the reputation needed, the reward multiplier, the reputation earned.
+## The thresholds are the standing tiers' (Galaxy.REP_TIERS): Routine from
+## Unfriendly, Trusted from Cordial, Honoured from Friendly, Hero when Allied.
+const TIERS := [
+	{"name": "Routine", "rep": -49.0, "pay": 1.0, "earn": 1.0},
+	{"name": "Trusted", "rep": 15.0, "pay": 1.5, "earn": 2.0},
+	{"name": "Honoured", "rep": 40.0, "pay": 2.2, "earn": 3.0},
+	{"name": "Hero", "rep": 70.0, "pay": 3.2, "earn": 4.0},
+]
+## How likely each tier is among a station's offers.
+const TIER_ODDS := [0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1]
+const SURVEY_RANGE := 700.0
+## Flying with a fleet (join missions): within this of one of its ships.
+const JOIN_RANGE := 1600.0
+
+var offers := {}   # station name -> Array of mission dicts
+var active := []   # accepted missions
+var _next_id := 1
+var _check_t := 0.0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_to_group("missions")
+
+
+func _data() -> Node:
+	return get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player_data")
+
+
+## A station's offers (made the first time it's asked; `empire`: who runs it).
+## A burning station (in this system, below Galaxy.DAMAGED) gives only its
+## crisis jobs: repairs, and defence while it's besieged.
+## How dangerous each kind of job is, 0 (safe) to 1 (deadly).
+const DANGER := {"courier": 0.0, "survey": 0.0, "supply": 0.3, "salvage": 0.3, "repair": 0.3,
+	"bounty": 0.7, "join": 0.7, "defend": 0.7, "hunt": 1.0, "protect": 1.0, "strike": 1.0, "attack_fleet": 1.0}
+## The most a job's pay is raised: the hardest (a Hero-tier hunt, strike or raid).
+const PAY_MAX := 10.0
+
+## A job's difficulty, 0..1: its tier (Routine ... Hero) counts most, then how
+## dangerous its kind is.
+static func difficulty(m: Dictionary) -> float:
+	var tier := clampf(float(m.get("tier", 0)) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+	return 0.6 * tier + 0.4 * float(DANGER.get(str(m.get("type", "")), 0.5))
+
+
+## What a job's base reward (worked out by each kind of job from what it asks:
+## goods' values, distances, enemies) is multiplied by: 1 for the easiest up
+## to PAY_MAX for the hardest.
+static func pay_mult(m: Dictionary) -> float:
+	return 1.0 + (PAY_MAX - 1.0) * difficulty(m)
+
+
+## Raises a job's pay by its difficulty - once, as it's made (or as an older
+## save's jobs load).
+func _paid(m: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	if not m.get("pay_raised", false):
+		m["reward"] = roundi(int(m["reward"]) * pay_mult(m))
+		m["pay_raised"] = true
+	return m
+
+
+func offers_for(station_name: String, empire := "") -> Array:
+	var rec := Galaxy.station_by_name(Galaxy.current_system, station_name)
+	if not rec.is_empty() and Galaxy.station_health(rec["id"]) < Galaxy.DAMAGED:
+		return crisis_offers(rec, empire)
+	if not offers.has(station_name):
+		offers[station_name] = []
+		for i in MISSIONS_PER_STATION:
+			offers[station_name].append(_paid(_generate(station_name, empire)))
+	return offers[station_name]
+
+
+## A damaged station's jobs: three repair deliveries and a defence job against
+## each empire besieging its system (kept while they apply).
+func crisis_offers(rec: Dictionary, empire: String) -> Array:
+	var key: String = rec["name"] + "#crisis"
+	var foes: Array = Fleets.besiegers(rec["system"]).filter(func(e): return Galaxy.at_war(e, empire))
+	var list: Array = offers.get(key, []).filter(func(m): return m["type"] == "repair" or m.get("target_empire", "") in foes)
+	while list.filter(func(m): return m["type"] == "repair").size() < 3:
+		list.append(_paid(_repair_job(rec, empire)))
+	for e in foes:
+		if not list.any(func(m): return m["type"] == "defend" and m["target_empire"] == e):
+			list.append(_paid(_defend_job(rec, empire, e)))
+	offers[key] = list
+	return list
+
+
+func _repair_job(rec: Dictionary, empire: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var pick: Array = [["machinery", 4, 8], ["iron_ore", 10, 20], ["titanium_ore", 6, 12], ["energy_cell", 4, 8], ["electronics", 3, 6]].pick_random()
+	var n := randi_range(pick[1], pick[2])
+	var m := {"id": _next_id, "giver": rec["name"], "station_id": rec["id"], "progress": 0, "count": n, "cores": 0, "empire": empire,
+		"tier": 0, "min_rep": -49.0, "type": "repair", "item": pick[0],
+		"repair": 6.0 + n * 1.2,
+		"title": "Repairs: %s" % Items.display_name(pick[0]),
+		"reward": int(Items.ITEMS[pick[0]]["value"] * n * 1.5) + 60}
+	m["desc"] = "%s is burning. Bring %d %s for the repair crews (mends %d%% of the station)." % [rec["name"], n, Items.display_name(pick[0]), int(m["repair"])]
+	_next_id += 1
+	return m
+
+
+func _defend_job(rec: Dictionary, empire: String, foe: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var n := randi_range(3, 6)
+	var m := {"id": _next_id, "giver": rec["name"], "station_id": rec["id"], "progress": 0, "count": n, "cores": 0, "empire": empire,
+		"tier": 0, "min_rep": -49.0, "type": "defend", "target_empire": foe, "system": rec["system"],
+		"title": "Defend %s" % rec["name"],
+		"reward": n * 260 + 100}
+	m["desc"] = "The %s is besieging us. Destroy %d of its warships in this system." % [Galaxy.empire_name(foe), n]
+	_next_id += 1
+	return m
+
+
+## The empire trusts you enough to give you this one.
+func available(m: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	var e: String = m.get("empire", "")
+	if e == "":
+		return true
+	return float(Galaxy.reputation.get(e, 0.0)) >= float(m.get("min_rep", -100.0))
+
+
+## What it takes, for a mission you can't take yet.
+func required_text(m: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var t: Dictionary = TIERS[int(m.get("tier", 0))]
+	return "%s mission: needs reputation %d with the %s (yours: %d)" % [t["name"], int(t["rep"]),
+		Galaxy.empire_name(m.get("empire", "")), int(Galaxy.reputation.get(m.get("empire", ""), 0.0))]
+
+
+func accept(m: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	if active.size() >= MAX_ACTIVE or not available(m):
+		return false
+	var list: Array = offers_for(m["giver"], m.get("empire", ""))
+	list.erase(m)
+	if not m["type"] in ["repair", "defend"]:
+		list.append(_paid(_generate(m["giver"], m.get("empire", ""))))
+	active.append(m)
+	GameLog.post("Mission accepted: %s" % m["title"], "mission")
+	changed.emit()
+	return true
+
+
+func abandon(m: Dictionary) -> void:
+	active.erase(m)
+	GameLog.post("Mission abandoned: %s" % m["title"], "mission")
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+## Enemy ship types wanted by active hunt missions (spawner favours these).
+func wanted_types() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for m in active:
+		if m["type"] == "hunt":
+			out.append(m["target_type"])
+	return out
+
+
+func on_enemy_killed(type_id: String, empire := "", fleet_id := "") -> void:
+	for m in active.duplicate():
+		var defend: bool = m["type"] in ["defend", "protect"] and m["target_empire"] == empire and m.get("system", "") == Galaxy.current_system
+		var fleet: bool = m["type"] == "attack_fleet" and fleet_id != "" and m.get("fleet", "") == fleet_id
+		if defend or fleet or (m["type"] == "bounty" and empire == "pirates") or (m["type"] == "hunt" and m["target_type"] == type_id):
+			m["progress"] += 1
+			if m["progress"] >= m["count"]:
+				_complete(m)
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+func on_docked(station_name: String) -> void:
+	for m in active.duplicate():
+		if m["type"] == "courier" and m["target_station"] == station_name:
+			_complete(m)
+		elif m["type"] == "supply" and m["target_station"] == station_name and _data().count(m["item"]) >= m["count"]:
+			_data().remove_item(m["item"], m["count"])
+			_complete(m)
+
+
+## A strike mission's station hit by you: `pct` of its condition off.
+func on_station_hit(station_id: String, pct: float) -> void:
+	for m in active.duplicate():
+		if m["type"] == "strike" and m.get("station_id", "") == station_id:
+			m["progress"] = minf(float(m["count"]), float(m["progress"]) + pct)
+			if float(m["progress"]) >= float(m["count"]) - 0.01 or not Galaxy.stations.has(station_id):
+				_complete(m)
+			changed.emit()
+
+
+## Survey missions: arriving at the point scans it. Fleet missions: flying
+## with the fleet counts; a fleet that's gone ends its missions.
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_check_t -= delta
+	if _check_t > 0.0:
+		return
+	_check_t = 0.5
+	var ship := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player") as Node2D
+	if ship == null:
+		return
+	for m in active.duplicate():
+		if m["type"] == "survey" and m.get("system", "") == Galaxy.current_system \
+				and ship.global_position.distance_to(Vector2(m["pos"][0], m["pos"][1])) < SURVEY_RANGE:
+			_complete(m)
+		elif m["type"] in ["join", "attack_fleet"] and not Fleets.fleets.has(m.get("fleet", "")):
+			if int(m["progress"]) > 0:
+				GameLog.post("%s: the fleet is gone - what you did counts." % m["title"], "mission")
+				_complete(m)
+			else:
+				active.erase(m)
+				GameLog.post("Mission over: %s - the fleet is gone." % m["title"], "mission")
+				changed.emit()
+		elif m["type"] == "join" and Fleets.fleets[m["fleet"]]["system"] == Galaxy.current_system:
+			var near := false
+			for n in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("neutrals") + get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
+				if n.get("fleet_id") == m["fleet"] and n.is_alive() and n.global_position.distance_to(ship.global_position) < JOIN_RANGE:
+					near = true
+					break
+			if near:
+				m["progress"] = int(m["progress"]) + 1   # (half-seconds)
+				if int(m["progress"]) >= int(m["count"]) * 2:
+					_complete(m)
+				changed.emit()
+		elif m["type"] == "strike" and not Galaxy.stations.has(m.get("station_id", "")):
+			_complete(m)   # (destroyed - by you or by others: the job's done)
+
+
+func can_turn_in(m: Dictionary, station_name: String) -> bool:
+	return m["type"] in ["salvage", "repair"] and m["giver"] == station_name \
+			and _data().count(m["item"]) >= m["count"]
+
+
+func turn_in(m: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if _data().remove_item(m["item"], m["count"]):
+		if m["type"] == "repair":
+			Galaxy.repair_station(m.get("station_id", ""), float(m.get("repair", 10.0)))
+			GameLog.post("%s: repairs under way (+%d%%)." % [m["giver"], int(m.get("repair", 10.0))], "good")
+		_complete(m)
+
+
+func progress_text(m: Dictionary) -> String:
+	match m["type"]:
+		"bounty", "hunt", "defend":
+			return "%d / %d destroyed" % [m["progress"], m["count"]]
+		"protect":
+			return "%d / %d %s warships destroyed  ·  in %s" % [m["progress"], m["count"], Galaxy.EMPIRES[m["target_empire"]]["short"],
+				Galaxy.system(m["system"]).get("name", "?")]
+		"attack_fleet", "join":
+			var f: Dictionary = Fleets.fleets.get(m.get("fleet", ""), {})
+			var where: String = Galaxy.system(f.get("system", "")).get("name", "?") if not f.is_empty() else "gone"
+			if m["type"] == "join":
+				return "%d / %d s with the fleet  ·  it's in %s" % [int(m["progress"]) / 2, m["count"], where]
+			return "%d / %d of its ships destroyed  ·  the fleet is in %s" % [m["progress"], m["count"], where]
+		"strike":
+			return "%d%% / %d%% off %s  ·  in %s" % [int(m["progress"]), m["count"], m["target_station"], Galaxy.system(m["system"]).get("name", "?")]
+		"repair":
+			return "%d / %d %s  ·  bring to %s" % [mini(_data().count(m["item"]), m["count"]), m["count"],
+				Items.display_name(m["item"]), m["giver"]]
+		"courier":
+			return "Dock at %s" % m["target_station"]
+		"supply":
+			return "%d / %d %s  ·  dock at %s" % [mini(_data().count(m["item"]), m["count"]), m["count"],
+				Items.display_name(m["item"]), m["target_station"]]
+		"salvage":
+			return "%d / %d %s  ·  turn in at %s" % [
+				mini(_data().count(m["item"]), m["count"]), m["count"],
+				Items.display_name(m["item"]), m["giver"]]
+		"survey":
+			var ship := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player") as Node2D
+			var p := Vector2(m["pos"][0], m["pos"][1])
+			if ship and m.get("system", "") == Galaxy.current_system:
+				return "Fly to the survey point (%.1fk away, on your map)" % (ship.global_position.distance_to(p) / 1000.0)
+			return "Fly to the survey point in %s" % Galaxy.system(m.get("system", "")).get("name", "?")
+	return ""
+
+
+func reward_text(m: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var t := "%d dr" % m["reward"]
+	if m.get("cores", 0) > 0:
+		t += " + %d Data Core" % m["cores"]
+	return t
+
+
+## Survey points of the active missions in this system (for the maps): [{pos, name}].
+func markers() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for m in active:
+		if m["type"] == "survey" and m.get("system", "") == Galaxy.current_system:
+			out.append({"pos": Vector2(m["pos"][0], m["pos"][1]), "name": m["title"]})
+	return out
+
+
+func _complete(m: Dictionary) -> void:
+	active.erase(m)
+	var data := _data()
+	data.add_credits(m["reward"])
+	if m.get("cores", 0) > 0:
+		data.add_item("data_core", m["cores"])
+	var e: String = m.get("empire", "")
+	if e != "" and e != "pirates":
+		Galaxy.change_reputation(e, TIERS[int(m.get("tier", 0))]["earn"])
+	GameLog.post("Mission complete: %s  (+%s)" % [m["title"], reward_text(m)], "good")
+	completed.emit(m)
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+func _generate(giver: String, empire := "") -> Dictionary:
+	# The tier: routine jobs most often, hero jobs rarely.
+	var r := randf()
+	var tier := 0
+	for k in TIER_ODDS.size():
+		r -= TIER_ODDS[k]
+		if r <= 0.0:
+			tier = k
+			break
+	var td: Dictionary = TIERS[tier]
+	var m := {"id": _next_id, "giver": giver, "progress": 0, "count": 1, "cores": 0, "empire": empire,
+		"tier": tier, "min_rep": td["rep"] if empire != "" else -100.0}
+	_next_id += 1
+	var others := []
+	var here := Vector2.ZERO
+	for st in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stations"):
+		if st.station_name == giver:
+			here = st.global_position
+		else:
+			others.append(st)
+	var hard := 1.0 + tier * 0.5   # higher tiers: more to do
+	var kinds := ["bounty", "bounty", "hunt", "salvage", "salvage", "survey"]
+	if not others.is_empty():
+		kinds += ["courier", "supply", "supply"]
+	if empire in Galaxy.MAJOR and randf() < 0.4 and _fill_war(m, empire, hard):
+		m["reward"] = int(m["reward"] * float(td["pay"]))
+		return m
+	match kinds.pick_random():
+		"bounty":
+			m["type"] = "bounty"
+			m["count"] = int(randi_range(3, 6) * hard)
+			m["title"] = ["Pirate Sweep", "Clear the Lanes", "Raider Patrol", "Convoy Cover"].pick_random()
+			m["desc"] = "Raiders are harassing our traffic. Destroy %d hostile ships of any kind." % m["count"]
+			m["reward"] = m["count"] * 140 + randi_range(0, 4) * 10
+		"hunt":
+			# (raiders fly the Sea Peoples' own designs: the hunted class is one of those)
+			var type_id: String = EnemyTypes.ids().filter(func(id): return ShipDesigns.owner_of(id) == "pirates").pick_random()
+			var t := EnemyTypes.get_type(type_id)
+			m["type"] = "hunt"
+			m["target_type"] = type_id
+			m["count"] = 1 if t["hull"] >= 120.0 else randi_range(1, 2) + tier / 2
+			m["title"] = "Hunt: %s" % t["name"]
+			m["desc"] = "A %s has been attacking convoys. Track it down and destroy %d." % [t["name"], m["count"]]
+			m["reward"] = int(t["hull"] * 2.5) * m["count"] + 80
+			m["cores"] = 1 if t["hull"] >= 150.0 or tier >= 3 else 0
+		"salvage":
+			var pick: Array = [["scrap", 4, 8], ["energy_cell", 3, 5], ["alien_alloy", 2, 3],
+					["iron_ore", 6, 12], ["titanium_ore", 4, 8], ["platinum_ore", 2, 3]].pick_random()
+			m["type"] = "salvage"
+			m["item"] = pick[0]
+			m["count"] = int(randi_range(pick[1], pick[2]) * hard)
+			var ore: bool = str(pick[0]).ends_with("_ore")
+			m["title"] = "Mining Contract" if ore else "Salvage Request"
+			m["desc"] = "Our %s need %d %s. Bring them here." % ["smelters" if ore else "workshops", m["count"], Items.display_name(pick[0])]
+			m["reward"] = int(Items.ITEMS[pick[0]]["value"] * m["count"] * 2.0) + 40
+		"courier":
+			var dest: Node2D = others.pick_random()
+			var dist := here.distance_to(dest.global_position)
+			m["type"] = "courier"
+			m["target_station"] = dest.station_name
+			m["title"] = ["Courier to %s", "Sealed Dispatch: %s", "Diplomatic Pouch: %s"].pick_random() % dest.station_name
+			m["desc"] = "Deliver a sealed package to %s. Dock there to complete the job." % dest.station_name
+			m["reward"] = int(dist / 12.0) + 60
+		"supply":
+			var dest: Node2D = others.pick_random()
+			var item: String = ["food", "water", "medicine", "machinery", "electronics", "fuel"].pick_random()
+			m["type"] = "supply"
+			m["target_station"] = dest.station_name
+			m["item"] = item
+			m["count"] = int(randi_range(5, 12) * hard)
+			m["title"] = "Supply Run: %s" % Items.display_name(item)
+			m["desc"] = "%s is short of %s. Bring them %d (buy them at a market) and dock there." % [dest.station_name, Items.display_name(item).to_lower(), m["count"]]
+			m["reward"] = int(Items.ITEMS[item]["value"] * m["count"] * 1.6 + here.distance_to(dest.global_position) / 20.0) + 50
+		"survey":
+			m["type"] = "survey"
+			m["system"] = Galaxy.current_system
+			var p := Vector2.ZERO
+			for k in 30:   # somewhere you haven't charted yet, if possible
+				p = Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(4000.0, Galaxy.FOG_EXTENT * 0.75)
+				if not Galaxy.explored_at(p):
+					break
+			m["pos"] = [p.x, p.y]
+			m["title"] = ["Survey: Uncharted Sector", "Sensor Sweep", "Chart the Dark"].pick_random()
+			m["desc"] = "Fly to a point we haven't charted (marked on your map) and scan it. Arriving completes the job."
+			m["reward"] = int(here.distance_to(p) / 10.0) + 90
+	m["reward"] = int(m["reward"] * float(td["pay"]))
+	return m
+
+
+## A war mission for `empire` (into m), if there's a war or an invasion to
+## give one: protect a system an invasion is coming for, strike an enemy
+## station, join one of its fleets, attack an enemy fleet - within reach of
+## here. False: nothing to offer.
+func _fill_war(m: Dictionary, empire: String, hard: float) -> bool:
+	var here := Galaxy.current_system
+	var jumps := func(sys: String) -> int:
+		var r := Galaxy.find_route(here, sys)
+		return r.size() - 1 if not r.is_empty() else (0 if sys == here else 99)
+	var choices := []
+	for f in Fleets.fleets.values():
+		if f["mission"] == "invade" and Galaxy.at_war(f["empire"], empire) and Galaxy.owner_of(f["target"]) == empire and jumps.call(f["target"]) <= 3:
+			choices.append(["protect", f])
+		elif Galaxy.at_war(f["empire"], empire) and f["empire"] != "pirates" and jumps.call(f["system"]) <= 3:
+			choices.append(["attack_fleet", f])
+		elif f["empire"] == empire and jumps.call(f["system"]) <= 3:
+			choices.append(["join", f])
+	for sid in Galaxy.stations:
+		var st: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations[sid]
+		var o := Galaxy.station_owner(sid)
+		if o in Galaxy.MAJOR and Galaxy.at_war(o, empire) and st["system"] != Galaxy.HOME and jumps.call(st["system"]) <= 2:
+			choices.append(["strike", sid])
+	if choices.is_empty():
+		return false
+	var c: Array = choices.pick_random()
+	match c[0]:
+		"protect":
+			var f: Dictionary = c[1]
+			m["type"] = "protect"
+			m["target_empire"] = f["empire"]
+			m["system"] = f["target"]
+			m["count"] = int(randi_range(3, 6) * hard)
+			m["title"] = "Protect %s" % Galaxy.system(f["target"])["name"]
+			m["desc"] = "The %s is coming for %s with an invasion. Be there and destroy %d of its warships." % [Galaxy.empire_name(f["empire"]),
+				Galaxy.system(f["target"])["name"], m["count"]]
+			m["reward"] = m["count"] * 300 + 150
+		"attack_fleet":
+			var f: Dictionary = c[1]
+			m["type"] = "attack_fleet"
+			m["fleet"] = f["id"]
+			m["target_empire"] = f["empire"]
+			m["count"] = mini(int(f["size"]), int(randi_range(2, 5) * hard))
+			m["title"] = "Raid: the %s fleet" % Galaxy.EMPIRES[f["empire"]]["short"]
+			m["desc"] = "A %s fleet of %d warships is in %s. Find it - it moves - and destroy %d of its ships." % [Galaxy.EMPIRES[f["empire"]]["short"],
+				int(f["size"]), Galaxy.system(f["system"])["name"], m["count"]]
+			m["reward"] = m["count"] * 340 + 120
+		"join":
+			var f: Dictionary = c[1]
+			m["type"] = "join"
+			m["fleet"] = f["id"]
+			m["count"] = 60 + 30 * int(hard - 1.0)
+			m["title"] = "Join the %s fleet" % ("invasion" if f["mission"] == "invade" else "defence")
+			m["desc"] = "Our %s fleet (%d warships) is in %s. Fly with it - within %d of its ships - for %d seconds, and fight beside it." % [
+				"invasion" if f["mission"] == "invade" else "defence", int(f["size"]), Galaxy.system(f["system"])["name"], int(JOIN_RANGE), m["count"]]
+			m["reward"] = m["count"] * 6 + 200
+		"strike":
+			var sid: String = c[1]
+			var st: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations[sid]
+			m["type"] = "strike"
+			m["station_id"] = sid
+			m["target_station"] = st["name"]
+			m["system"] = st["system"]
+			m["count"] = int(randi_range(8, 15) * hard)
+			m["title"] = "Strike: %s" % st["name"]
+			m["desc"] = "%s in %s serves the %s, our enemy. Take %d%% off its condition (it costs you standing with them)." % [st["name"],
+				Galaxy.system(st["system"])["name"], Galaxy.empire_name(Galaxy.station_owner(sid)), m["count"]]
+			m["reward"] = m["count"] * 60 + 200
+	return true
+
+
+func get_save_data() -> Dictionary:
+	return {"offers": offers, "active": active, "next_id": _next_id}
+
+
+func load_save_data(data: Dictionary) -> void:
+	offers = {}
+	var saved_offers: Dictionary = data.get("offers", {})
+	for station in saved_offers:
+		offers[station] = []
+		for m in saved_offers[station]:
+			offers[station].append(_paid(_fix_numbers(m)))   # (a save from before: its jobs pay the new rate too)
+	active = []
+	for m in data.get("active", []):
+		active.append(_paid(_fix_numbers(m)))
+	_next_id = int(data.get("next_id", 1))
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+## JSON turns ints into floats; restore the integer fields.
+static func _fix_numbers(m: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	for key in ["id", "progress", "count", "reward", "cores", "tier"]:
+		if m.has(key):
+			m[key] = int(m[key])
+	return m

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Navigation reports: scanning a system's navigation beacon (NavBeacon, Main.scan_beacon) makes a report of the system as it is - its stations, planets and moons, jump gates, the ships about (hostile, friendly and neutral, by empire and by trade), monsters, asteroids, wrecks and signals - shown at once (NavReportPanel) and put in your hold as an item, "navrep:<system id>". Stations in OTHER systems buy reports: the further (jumps between the systems) the more they pay; worthless in its own system. One report a visit: a beacon gives another only after you've left the system and come back (Galaxy.jumps). Reports are kept with the galaxy (Galaxy.reports). (Moved from scripts/nav_reports.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,144 @@ 
+class_name NavReports
+extends RefCounted
+## Navigation reports: scanning a system's navigation beacon (NavBeacon,
+## Main.scan_beacon) makes a report of the system as it is - its stations,
+## planets and moons, jump gates, the ships about (hostile, friendly and
+## neutral, by empire and by trade), monsters, asteroids, wrecks and signals -
+## shown at once (NavReportPanel) and put in your hold as an item,
+## "navrep:<system id>". Stations in OTHER systems buy reports: the further
+## (jumps between the systems) the more they pay; worthless in its own system.
+## One report a visit: a beacon gives another only after you've left the system
+## and come back (Galaxy.jumps). Reports are kept with the galaxy (Galaxy.reports).
+
+const PREFIX := "navrep:"
+## A report's price: BASE + PER_JUMP a jump away (+ PER_STATION for each of its
+## system's stations: busier systems' charts sell better).
+const BASE := 60
+const PER_JUMP := 70
+const PER_STATION := 10
+
+
+static func id_for(sys_id: String) -> String:
+	return PREFIX + sys_id
+
+
+static func is_report(id: String) -> bool:
+	return id.begins_with(PREFIX)
+
+
+static func system_of(id: String) -> String:
+	return id.substr(PREFIX.length()) if is_report(id) else ""
+
+
+static func valid(id: String) -> bool:
+	return is_report(id) and Galaxy.SYSTEMS.has(system_of(id))
+
+
+## The item: kind "report" (sold at stations, never in "sell all cargo").
+static func info(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if not valid(id):
+		return {}
+	var sys := system_of(id)
+	var r: Dictionary = Galaxy.reports.get(sys, {})
+	var desc := "A navigation report of the %s system, made at its beacon. Stations in other systems buy it - the further from %s, the more they pay; worthless in its own system." % [name_of(sys), name_of(sys)]
+	if not r.is_empty():
+		desc += "\n%s" % summary(r)
+	return {"name": "Nav Report: %s" % name_of(sys), "kind": "report", "value": 0, "desc": desc}
+
+
+static func name_of(sys: String) -> String:
+	return str(Galaxy.SYSTEMS.get(sys, {}).get("name", sys))
+
+
+## Jumps between two systems (the shortest way along the lanes); -1 if none.
+static func jumps(a: String, b: String) -> int:
+	if a == b:
+		return 0
+	var seen := {a: 0}
+	var q: Array = [a]
+	while not q.is_empty():
+		var s: String = q.pop_front()
+		for n in Galaxy.neighbors(s):
+			if not seen.has(n):
+				seen[n] = seen[s] + 1
+				if n == b:
+					return seen[n]
+				q.append(n)
+	return -1
+
+
+## What a station in system `at` pays for the report of system `sys` (0 there).
+static func price(sys: String, at: String) -> int:
+	var j := jumps(sys, at)
+	if j <= 0:
+		return 0
+	var st: int = Galaxy.system(sys).get("stations", []).size() if Galaxy.systems.has(sys) else 0
+	return BASE + PER_JUMP * j + PER_STATION * st
+
+
+## The report of the system you're in, made from what's in it now (Main's scene).
+static func make(tree: SceneTree, sys: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var r := {"sys": sys, "name": name_of(sys), "owner": Galaxy.empire_name(Galaxy.owner_of(sys)),
+		"stations": [], "bodies": [], "gates": [], "hostile": {}, "friendly": {}, "roles": {},
+		"monsters": [], "rocks": 0, "wrecks": 0, "signals": 0, "made": Time.get_datetime_string_from_system(false, true)}
+	for st in tree.get_nodes_in_group("stations"):
+		r["stations"].append([str(st.get("station_name")), Galaxy.empire_name(str(st.get("empire")))])
+	for b in tree.get_nodes_in_group("planet_bodies"):
+		if str(b.get("title")) == "":
+			continue
+		var parent = b.get("parent_body")
+		var spec = b.get("spec")
+		r["bodies"].append([str(b.title), str(spec.get("name", "")) if spec is Dictionary else "", bool(b.get("landable")),
+			str(parent.title) if parent != null and is_instance_valid(parent) else ""])
+	for g in tree.get_nodes_in_group("gates"):
+		r["gates"].append(str(g.get("target_name")) if str(g.get("target_name")) != "" else name_of(str(g.get("target"))))
+	var main := tree.current_scene
+	for holder in ["enemies", "neutrals"]:
+		var box = main.get(holder) if main else null
+		if box == null:
+			continue
+		for s in (box as Node).get_children():
+			if s.has_method("is_alive") and not s.is_alive():
+				continue
+			if s.get("role") == null:
+				continue
+			if EnemyTypes.MONSTERS.has(str(s.type_id)):   # (a monster)
+				r["monsters"].append(str(s.display_name) if str(s.display_name) != "" else str(EnemyTypes.MONSTERS[s.type_id].get("name", s.type_id)))
+				continue
+			var who: String = Galaxy.empire_name(str(s.empire)) if str(s.empire) != "" else ("Pirates" if str(s.role) == "pirate" else "Independent")
+			var side: String = "hostile" if s.has_method("is_hostile_to_player") and s.is_hostile_to_player() else "friendly"
+			r[side][who] = int(r[side].get(who, 0)) + 1
+			var role: String = str(s.role) if str(s.role) != "" else "other"
+			r["roles"][role] = int(r["roles"].get(role, 0)) + 1
+	r["rocks"] = tree.get_nodes_in_group("asteroids").size()
+	r["wrecks"] = tree.get_nodes_in_group("wrecks").filter(func(w): return not w.get("salvaged")).size()
+	r["signals"] = tree.get_nodes_in_group("signal_beacons").size()
+	return r
+
+
+static func total(d: Dictionary) -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	for k in d:
+		n += int(d[k])
+	return n
+
+
+## "3 stations, 7 planets and moons, 2 gates; 4 hostile ships, 12 others; 40 asteroids".
+static func summary(r: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return "%d stations, %d planets and moons, %d gates; %d hostile ships, %d others%s; %d asteroids" % [
+		r["stations"].size(), r["bodies"].size(), r["gates"].size(), total(r["hostile"]), total(r["friendly"]),
+		(", %d monsters" % r["monsters"].size()) if not r["monsters"].is_empty() else "", int(r["rocks"])]
+
+
+## The item's icon: a chart slate - an orbit, a star, a course across it.
+static func draw_icon(ci: CanvasItem, _id: String, rect: Rect2, dim := false) -> void:
+	var a := 0.35 if dim else 1.0
+	var c := rect.get_center()
+	var s := minf(rect.size.x, rect.size.y) / 2.0
+	var slate := Rect2(c - Vector2(s * 0.78, s * 0.9), Vector2(s * 1.56, s * 1.8))
+	ci.draw_rect(slate, Color(0.08, 0.16, 0.22, 0.95 * a))
+	ci.draw_rect(slate, Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.7, a), false, maxf(1.0, s * 0.08))
+	ci.draw_arc(c + Vector2(0, s * 0.05), s * 0.5, 0, TAU, 24, Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.7, 0.7 * a), maxf(1.0, s * 0.06), true)
+	ci.draw_circle(c + Vector2(0, s * 0.05), s * 0.16, Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.4, a))
+	ci.draw_circle(c + Vector2(s * 0.5, s * 0.05), s * 0.09, Color(0.5, 0.75, 1.0, a))
+	ci.draw_line(c + Vector2(-s * 0.6, s * 0.7), c + Vector2(s * 0.6, -s * 0.65), Color(1.0, 0.7, 0.3, 0.9 * a), maxf(1.0, s * 0.07), true)

@@ -1,0 +1,178 @@ 
+class_name NebulaGen
+## Procedural deep-space backdrops (shaders/nebula.gdshader) from four
+## templates, modelled on the references in external/images/nebula_refs/:
+##   remnant   - supernova remnant: a shell of orange / blue filaments  (ref 1)
+##   planetary - planetary nebula: shells and bubbles, a central star,
+##               twin jets, faint outer rings                          (ref 2)
+##   emission  - emission nebula: pink / red clouds, dust lanes, a
+##               bright core and young stars                           (ref 3)
+##   galaxy    - a tilted spiral galaxy with dust lanes and satellites  (ref 4)
+## generate(template, variant): variant 0 is the template; others borrow
+## features, step round the colour wheel (golden ratio) and change shape,
+## so every nebula is different. for_system(id) gives a system its own set.
+
+const SHADER := preload("res://shaders/nebula.gdshader")
+
+const TEMPLATES := {
+	"remnant": {"name": "Supernova remnant", "mode": 0, "hue_range": 0.5,
+		"color_a": Color(0.95, 0.38, 0.1), "color_b": Color(0.25, 0.55, 1.0), "color_c": Color(0.95, 0.95, 1.0), "color_d": Color(0.55, 0.85, 0.3),
+		"drift": 0.0, "filaments": 0.9, "dust": 0.0, "core": 0.0, "stars": 0.0, "jets": 0.0, "stretch": Vector2(1.0, 0.75), "intensity": 0.8},
+	"planetary": {"name": "Planetary nebula", "mode": 1, "hue_range": 0.6,
+		"color_a": Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.15), "color_b": Color(0.3, 0.7, 1.0), "color_c": Color(0.95, 0.95, 1.0), "color_d": Color(0.15, 0.55, 0.6),
+		"drift": 0.0, "shells": 1.0, "jets": 1.0, "core": 1.0, "stars": 0.0, "rot": -0.75, "stretch": Vector2(1.0, 0.9), "intensity": 0.75},
+	"emission": {"name": "Emission nebula", "mode": 2, "hue_range": 0.4,
+		"color_a": Color(0.85, 0.15, 0.35), "color_b": Color(0.95, 0.4, 0.7), "color_c": Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.85), "color_d": Color(0.2, 0.6, 0.65),
+		"drift": 0.0, "filaments": 0.8, "dust": 0.55, "core": 0.9, "stars": 0.6, "jets": 0.0, "stretch": Vector2(1.15, 0.95), "intensity": 0.9},
+	"galaxy": {"name": "Spiral galaxy", "mode": 3, "hue_range": 0.25,
+		"color_a": Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.45), "color_b": Color(0.45, 0.55, 1.0), "color_c": Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.85), "color_d": Color(1.0, 0.4, 0.7),
+		"arms": 2.0, "wind": 2.6, "incline": 0.38, "dust": 0.7, "core": 0.8, "stars": 0.5, "satellites": 1.0, "jets": 0.0, "rot": -0.6, "intensity": 0.9},
+}
+
+## The editable properties (the zoo's property panel builds itself from
+## these): [key, label, type, min, max, help, kinds it applies to ([] = all)].
+## Types: float, int, color, vec2, enum:<a>,<b>,...  ["#", "Group"] starts a group.
+const PROPERTIES := [
+	["#", "Kind and shape"],
+	["mode", "Kind", "enum:Supernova remnant,Planetary nebula,Emission nebula,Spiral galaxy", 0, 3, "What kind of object this is: each draws differently.", []],
+	["seed", "Seed", "float", 0.0, 100.0, "Offsets every noise pattern: a different cloud with the same settings.", []],
+	["intensity", "Brightness", "float", 0.0, 2.0, "Overall brightness (it's added onto the sky).", []],
+	["rot", "Rotation", "float", -3.15, 3.15, "Turns the whole object (radians).", []],
+	["stretch", "Stretch", "vec2", 0.3, 2.0, "Scales the object across (x) and along (y) - elongates or squashes it.", []],
+	["drift", "Drift", "float", -0.1, 0.1, "Slow rotation over time (radians per second); spins a galaxy's arms.", []],
+	["#", "Colours"],
+	["color_a", "Outer colour", "color", 0, 0, "The outer shell, cloud edges and jets (remnant: orange filaments).", []],
+	["color_b", "Inner colour", "color", 0, 0, "The inner glow (remnant: the blue core; galaxy: the arms).", []],
+	["color_c", "Highlights", "color", 0, 0, "The hottest parts: bright filaments, central star, a galaxy's bulge.", []],
+	["color_d", "Patches", "color", 0, 0, "Patches and knots: green patches, outer rings, pink star-forming knots.", []],
+	["#", "Structure"],
+	["filaments", "Filaments", "float", 0.0, 2.0, "Strength of the glowing web / wisps.", [0, 2]],
+	["dust", "Dust lanes", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "Dark lanes that eat the glow.", [0, 2, 3]],
+	["core", "Core", "float", 0.0, 2.0, "Brightness of the centre (central star, bright core, bulge).", []],
+	["stars", "Stars", "float", 0.0, 2.0, "Young stars sparkling inside it.", []],
+	["jets", "Jets", "float", 0.0, 2.0, "Twin jets along its axis.", []],
+	["shells", "Shells", "float", 0.0, 2.0, "Brightness of the nested shells, bubbles and outer rings.", [1]],
+	["#", "Galaxy"],
+	["arms", "Arms", "float", 1.0, 6.0, "Number of spiral arms.", [3]],
+	["wind", "Winding", "float", 0.5, 6.0, "How tightly the arms wind.", [3]],
+	["incline", "Incline", "float", 0.1, 1.0, "How far we see the disc face-on (1) or edge-on (small).", [3]],
+	["satellites", "Satellites", "float", 0.0, 2.0, "Brightness of the two dwarf satellite galaxies.", [3]],
+]
+## Properties that need the node rebuilt (none: everything is a shader value).
+const STRUCTURAL := []
+
+
+## Applies one property to a nebula node made by make() (live editing).
+static func apply(node: Node, key: String, value: Variant) -> void:
+	var mat: ShaderMaterial = node.material if node is CanvasItem else null
+	if mat:
+		mat.set_shader_parameter(key, value)
+
+
+const MUTATIONS := {
+	"remnant": ["dense web", "faint web", "green patches", "elongated", "bright core"],
+	"planetary": ["no jets", "double rings", "faint rings", "elongated", "bright star"],
+	"emission": ["dusty", "clear", "wispy", "bright core", "star cluster"],
+	"galaxy": ["tight arms", "loose arms", "four arms", "face-on", "edge-on", "no satellites"],
+}
+const META := ["name", "hue_range", "template", "variant", "tags"]
+
+
+static func generate(template: String, variant := 0) -> Dictionary:
+	var t: Dictionary = TEMPLATES.get(template, TEMPLATES["emission"])
+	var p: Dictionary = t.duplicate()
+	p["template"] = template
+	p["variant"] = variant
+	p["seed"] = float(variant) * 3.71 + float(TEMPLATES.keys().find(template)) * 9.1
+	var tags := []
+	if variant != 0:
+		var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		rng.seed = hash(["nebula", template, variant])
+		var list: Array = MUTATIONS[template]
+		tags.append(list[posmod(variant * 3, list.size())])
+		var other = list[rng.randi() % list.size()]
+		if not other in tags and not ([other, tags[0]] in [["tight arms", "loose arms"], ["loose arms", "tight arms"], ["face-on", "edge-on"], ["edge-on", "face-on"],
+				["dusty", "clear"], ["clear", "dusty"], ["dense web", "faint web"], ["faint web", "dense web"]]):
+			tags.append(other)
+		for m in tags:
+			_mutate(p, m, rng)
+		p["rot"] = float(p.get("rot", 0.0)) + rng.randf_range(-1.2, 1.2)
+		var st: Vector2 = p.get("stretch", Vector2.ONE)
+		p["stretch"] = st * Vector2(rng.randf_range(0.85, 1.15), rng.randf_range(0.85, 1.15))
+		var g: float = fposmod(float(variant) * 0.618034, 1.0) - 0.5
+		var shift: float = g * 2.0 * float(t["hue_range"])
+		for k in p:
+			if p[k] is Color and k != "color_c":
+				var c: Color = p[k]
+				p[k] = Color.from_hsv(_nebular(fposmod(c.h + shift, 1.0)), clampf(c.s * rng.randf_range(0.85, 1.1), 0.0, 1.0), c.v)
+	p["tags"] = tags
+	return p
+
+
+## Emission colours: real nebulae glow red, pink, violet, blue and teal,
+## rarely yellow-green - hues in that band are moved toward orange or teal.
+static func _nebular(h: float) -> float:
+	if h > 0.11 and h < 0.24:
+		return lerpf(0.06, 0.1, (h - 0.11) / 0.13)
+	if h >= 0.24 and h < 0.42:
+		return lerpf(0.45, 0.5, (h - 0.24) / 0.18)
+	return h
+
+
+static func describe(p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var s: String = p.get("name", "Nebula")
+	if not p.get("tags", []).is_empty():
+		s += " · " + ", ".join(p["tags"])
+	return s
+
+
+static func _mutate(p: Dictionary, m: String, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> void:
+	match m:
+		"dense web": p["filaments"] = rng.randf_range(1.1, 1.4)
+		"faint web": p["filaments"] = rng.randf_range(0.4, 0.6)
+		"green patches": p["color_d"] = Color.from_hsv(rng.randf_range(0.2, 0.4), 0.7, 0.85)
+		"elongated": p["stretch"] = Vector2(1.0, rng.randf_range(0.5, 0.65))
+		"bright core": p["core"] = rng.randf_range(1.0, 1.4)
+		"no jets": p["jets"] = 0.0
+		"double rings": p["shells"] = rng.randf_range(1.15, 1.3)
+		"faint rings": p["shells"] = rng.randf_range(0.5, 0.7)
+		"bright star": p["core"] = rng.randf_range(1.3, 1.6)
+		"dusty": p["dust"] = rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.0)
+		"clear": p["dust"] = rng.randf_range(0.1, 0.25)
+		"wispy": p["filaments"] = rng.randf_range(1.0, 1.4)
+		"star cluster": p["stars"] = rng.randf_range(1.0, 1.4)
+		"tight arms": p["wind"] = rng.randf_range(3.4, 4.2)
+		"loose arms": p["wind"] = rng.randf_range(1.6, 2.0)
+		"four arms": p["arms"] = 4.0
+		"face-on": p["incline"] = rng.randf_range(0.7, 0.9)
+		"edge-on": p["incline"] = rng.randf_range(0.18, 0.24)
+		"no satellites": p["satellites"] = 0.0
+
+
+## A ColorRect of `size` px showing the nebula (additive, edges faded).
+static func make(p: Dictionary, size: float) -> ColorRect:
+	var rect := ColorRect.new()
+	rect.size = Vector2(size, size)
+	rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	mat.shader = SHADER
+	for k in p:
+		if not k in META:
+			mat.set_shader_parameter(k, p[k])
+	rect.material = mat
+	return rect
+
+
+## The backdrop of system `id`: 2-3 nebulae / galaxies, each a variant no
+## other system uses. [[params, position, size], ...]
+static func for_system(id: String, index: int) -> Array:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = hash(["nebulae", id])
+	var out := []
+	var n := rng.randi_range(2, 3)
+	var kinds := ["emission", "remnant", "planetary", "galaxy"]
+	for i in n:
+		var t: String = kinds[(index + i * 3 + rng.randi() % 2) % kinds.size()]
+		var size := rng.randf_range(1300.0, 1900.0) if t in ["emission", "remnant"] else rng.randf_range(800.0, 1200.0)
+		var pos := Vector2(rng.randf_range(-1600, 1400), rng.randf_range(-1400, 1400))
+		out.append([generate(t, 1 + index * 4 + i), pos, size])
+	return out

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Damage to the parts of your ship and your automaton, and their repair. Each body ("ship", "automaton") is made of PARTS (engines, reactor, legs, optics...), each part of components (circuits, conduits, servos, plates, lenses, power cells). Hits that get through to the hull (or the automaton's frame) can leave FAULTS in a part - a crack, burnt wiring, a leak, a misalignment, or a component wrecked outright - and a part's faults weaken what it does (a cracked engine: less speed; burnt optics: less reach). Faults are hidden until a scanner sees them: each kind shows in one scan mode (SCANS); the built-in scanner has two modes, the Mk II all four, the Mk III reads through a closed casing. They're fixed by hand in the Repair Bay (RepairBay): open the casing, scan, then the tool each fault needs (welder, soldering iron, sealant, calibrator, or forceps and a spare part). The automaton's body is anatomy in four layers (LAYERS: muscles, veins, nerves, skeleton) - its components are structures of a layer, at a place on the body, operated on like surgery (Surgery: SURGERY's tools). The state is one Dictionary - the player's "condition" (PlayerData.condition in space, state["player"]["condition"] on a planet: the same dictionary saved with the game): {"ship": {part_id: {"faults": [fault...], "off": bool}}, "automaton": {...}, "next": int} fault: {"id", "kind", "comp" (component index), "sev" (0.2..1), "found", "seed", "prog"} (Moved from scripts/parts.gd.)

@@ -1,0 +1,584 @@ 
+class_name Parts

+## optics...), each part of components (circuits, conduits, servos, plates,
+## lenses, power cells). Hits that get through to the hull (or the
+## automaton's frame) can leave FAULTS in a part - a crack, burnt wiring, a
+## leak, a misalignment, or a component wrecked outright - and a part's faults
+## weaken what it does (a cracked engine: less speed; burnt optics: less
+## reach). Faults are hidden until a scanner sees them: each kind shows in one
+## scan mode (SCANS); the built-in scanner has two modes, the Mk II all four,
+## the Mk III reads through a closed casing. They're fixed by hand in the
+## Repair Bay (RepairBay): open the casing, scan, then the tool each fault needs
+## (welder, soldering iron, sealant, calibrator, or forceps and a spare part).
+## The automaton's body is anatomy in four layers (LAYERS: muscles, veins,
+## nerves, skeleton) - its components are structures of a layer, at a place on
+## the body, operated on like surgery (Surgery: SURGERY's tools).
+##
+## The state is one Dictionary - the player's "condition" (PlayerData.condition
+## in space, state["player"]["condition"] on a planet: the same dictionary
+## saved with the game):
+##   {"ship": {part_id: {"faults": [fault...], "off": bool}}, "automaton": {...}, "next": int}
+##   fault: {"id", "kind", "comp" (component index), "sev" (0.2..1), "found", "seed", "prog"}
+
+## Scan modes: what each one shows.
+const SCANS := {
+	"structure": {"name": "Structure", "color": Color(0.55, 0.82, 1.0),
+		"desc": "X-rays the frame: cracks and wrecked components show bright."},
+	"thermal": {"name": "Thermal", "color": Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.2),

+}
+const SCAN_ORDER := ["structure", "thermal", "field", "resonance"]

+		"desc": "A burnt-through cable: join each strand to its own colour. Cut the part's power first, or it shocks."},
+	"leak": {"name": "Leak", "scan": "thermal", "tool": "sealant", "weight": 0.22,
+		"desc": "A leaking line: seal it while the pressure is low - sealant put on at high pressure is blown away."},
+	"drift": {"name": "Misalignment", "scan": "resonance", "tool": "calibrator", "weight": 0.2,
+		"desc": "A component knocked out of true: tune its frequency and phase to the reference until they agree."},
+	"wreck": {"name": "Wrecked component", "scan": "structure", "tool": "forceps", "weight": 0.5,
+		"desc": "Beyond repair: release its clamps, lift it out and fit a spare - turned the right way into its socket."},
+}
+
+## Which faults a component kind can have.
+const COMP_FAULTS := {
+	"circuit": ["burn", "crack", "wreck"],
+	"conduit": ["leak", "crack", "wreck"],
+	"servo": ["drift", "crack", "wreck"],

+
+## The bodies. Each part: name, where it sits (the schematic: a polygon in a

+## "side", "any"), what it does (effects at total loss: PlayerData.mod keys -

+const BODIES := {

+				"effects": {"range_mult": -0.35, "scatter": 1.0, "accuracy": -0.25}, "what": "weapon range and aim (shots scatter)",
+				"comps": [["lens", "Primary lens"], ["circuit", "Signal processor"], ["lens", "Rangefinder"], ["cell", "Sensor capacitor"]]},

+				"effects": {"fire_rate_mult": 0.7, "damage_mult": -0.25, "misfire": 1.0}, "what": "rate of fire, damage and fire control (shots go wild)",

+			"shields": {"name": "Shield Emitter", "faces": ["any"], "shape": [[-0.3, -0.62], [0.3, -0.62], [0.3, -0.44], [-0.3, -0.44]],
+				"effects": {"max_shields_mult": -0.55, "regen_delay": 3.0}, "what": "shield strength",
+				"comps": [["lens", "Field projector"], ["circuit", "Emitter driver"], ["cell", "Buffer cell"], ["servo", "Phase rotor"]]},
+			"thrusters": {"name": "Manoeuvring Thrusters", "faces": ["side"], "shape": [[-0.95, 0.12], [-0.62, -0.06], [-0.55, 0.36], [0.55, 0.36], [0.62, -0.06], [0.95, 0.12], [0.85, 0.42], [-0.85, 0.42]],

+			"engines": {"name": "Main Engines", "faces": ["rear"], "shape": [[-0.4, 0.5], [0.4, 0.5], [0.46, 0.98], [-0.46, 0.98]],
+				"effects": {"speed_mult": -0.45}, "what": "top speed",
+				"comps": [["conduit", "Injector"], ["plate", "Nozzle liner"], ["servo", "Thrust vector"], ["circuit", "Ignition board"], ["cell", "Plasma chamber"]]},

+	"automaton": {
+		"name": "Automaton",
+		"parts": {
+			"optics": {"name": "Optic Head", "faces": ["any"], "shape": [[-0.2, -0.98], [0.2, -0.98], [0.24, -0.66], [-0.24, -0.66]],

+# --- The state -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The body's state in `cond` (made if missing): {part_id: {"faults": [], "off": false}}.
+static func body(cond: Dictionary, which: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if not cond.has(which) or not cond[which] is Dictionary:
+		cond[which] = {}
+	var b: Dictionary = cond[which]
+	for pid in BODIES[which]["parts"]:
+		if not b.has(pid) or not b[pid] is Dictionary:
+			b[pid] = {"faults": [], "off": false}
+		var p: Dictionary = b[pid]
+		if not p.get("faults") is Array:
+			p["faults"] = []
+	return b
+
+
+## A saved condition, cleaned up (JSON gives floats for ints; unknown parts and
+## kinds dropped).
+static func load_condition(saved: Variant) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	if not saved is Dictionary:
+		return out
+	out["next"] = int(saved.get("next", 1))
+	for which in BODIES:
+		var b: Variant = saved.get(which)
+		if not b is Dictionary:
+			continue
+		var nb := {}
+		for pid in BODIES[which]["parts"]:
+			var p: Variant = b.get(pid)
+			if not p is Dictionary:
+				continue
+			var fs := []
+			var n_comps: int = BODIES[which]["parts"][pid]["comps"].size()
+			var cs: Array = BODIES[which]["parts"][pid]["comps"]
+			for f in p.get("faults", []):
+				if f is Dictionary and FAULTS.has(str(f.get("kind", ""))) and int(f.get("comp", -1)) in range(n_comps):
+					# (An older save: the part's components were others then. A
+					# fault its component can't have moves to one that can.)
+					if not str(f["kind"]) in COMP_FAULTS[cs[int(f["comp"])][0]]:
+						var to := -1
+						for i in n_comps:
+							if str(f["kind"]) in COMP_FAULTS[cs[i][0]] and not fs.any(func(x): return int(x["comp"]) == i):
+								to = i
+								break
+						if to < 0:
+							continue
+						f["comp"] = to
+					fs.append({"id": int(f.get("id", 0)), "kind": str(f["kind"]), "comp": int(f["comp"]),
+						"sev": clampf(float(f.get("sev", 0.5)), 0.05, 1.0), "found": bool(f.get("found", false)),
+						"seed": int(f.get("seed", 0)), "prog": float(f.get("prog", 0.0))})
+			nb[pid] = {"faults": fs, "off": bool(p.get("off", false))}
+		out[which] = nb
+	return out
+
+
+## The layer component `i` of a part belongs to ("" for the ship's).
+static func comp_layer(which: String, pid: String, i: int) -> String:
+	var c: Array = comps(which, pid)[i]
+	return str(c[2]) if c.size() > 2 else ""
+
+
+## A fault's name, the tool that mends it and what to do - the ship's by its
+## kind (FAULTS), the automaton's by its kind and its layer (SURGERY).
+static func fault_info(which: String, pid: String, f: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var kind := str(f["kind"])
+	var base: Dictionary = FAULTS[kind]
+	if which != "automaton":
+		return {"name": base["name"], "tool": base["tool"], "desc": base["desc"]}
+	var layer := comp_layer(which, pid, int(f["comp"]))
+	var e: Array = SURGERY[kind].get(layer, SURGERY[kind][""])
+	var name: String = e[0]
+	if kind == "drift" and str(comps(which, pid)[int(f["comp"])][1]) == "Heart":
+		name = "Arrhythmia"
+	return {"name": name, "tool": e[1], "desc": e[2]}
+
+
+## The layers your scanner shows faults in.
+static func scan_layers(items: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	for id in SCANNERS:
+		if int(items.get(id, 0)) > 0:
+			return LAYERS
+	return BUILT_IN_LAYERS
+
+
+static func part(cond: Dictionary, which: String, pid: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return body(cond, which)[pid]
+
+
+static func info(which: String, pid: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return BODIES[which]["parts"][pid]
+
+
+static func comps(which: String, pid: String) -> Array:
+	return BODIES[which]["parts"][pid]["comps"]
+
+
+## How well a part works, 0..1 (its faults' weight off 1; switched off: 0).
+static func health(cond: Dictionary, which: String, pid: String) -> float:
+	var p := _peek(cond, which, pid)
+	var loss := 0.0
+	for f in p["faults"]:
+		loss += float(f.get("sev", 0.5)) * float(FAULTS.get(str(f.get("kind", "crack")), FAULTS["crack"])["weight"])
+	return clampf(1.0 - loss, 0.0, 1.0)
+
+
+## The part's working share counting its power (off: none of it).
+static func working(cond: Dictionary, which: String, pid: String) -> float:
+	return 0.0 if _peek(cond, which, pid).get("off", false) else health(cond, which, pid)
+
+
+const _NONE := {"faults": [], "off": false}
+
+## A part's state without making it (none yet: no faults).
+static func _peek(cond: Dictionary, which: String, pid: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var b: Variant = cond.get(which)
+	if b is Dictionary:
+		var p: Variant = b.get(pid)
+		if p is Dictionary and p.get("faults") is Array:
+			return p
+	return _NONE
+
+
+static func fault_count(cond: Dictionary, which: String, found_only := false) -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	if not cond.has(which):
+		return 0
+	for pid in body(cond, which):
+		for f in cond[which][pid]["faults"]:
+			if not found_only or f.get("found", false):
+				n += 1
+	return n
+
+
+## The sum of effect `key` over a body's parts: each part's effect times how
+## much of it is lost (a ship's: added to PlayerData.mod; an automaton's: to
+## its Gear effects).
+static func mod(cond: Dictionary, which: String, key: String) -> float:
+	if cond.is_empty() or not cond.has(which):
+		return 0.0
+	var total := 0.0
+	for pid in BODIES[which]["parts"]:
+		var e: Dictionary = BODIES[which]["parts"][pid]["effects"]
+		if e.has(key):
+			total += float(e[key]) * (1.0 - working(cond, which, pid))
+	return total
+
+
+## Every effect of a body's damage: {key: value} (only those not 0).
+static func effects(cond: Dictionary, which: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	if cond.is_empty() or not cond.has(which):
+		return out
+	for pid in BODIES[which]["parts"]:
+		var loss := 1.0 - working(cond, which, pid)
+		if loss <= 0.0:
+			continue
+		var e: Dictionary = BODIES[which]["parts"][pid]["effects"]
+		for k in e:
+			out[k] = float(out.get(k, 0.0)) + float(e[k]) * loss
+	return out
+
+
+## The scan modes you have (the built-in two, more with a scanner in your items).
+static func scan_modes(items: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = BUILT_IN_SCANS.duplicate()
+	for s in SCANNERS:
+		if int(items.get(s, 0)) > 0:
+			for m in SCANNERS[s]:
+				if not m in out:
+					out.append(m)
+	var sorted := []
+	for m in SCAN_ORDER:
+		if m in out:
+			sorted.append(m)
+	return sorted
+
+
+## Reads through a closed casing (the Mk III)?
+static func deep_scan(items: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	return int(items.get("scanner_mk3", 0)) > 0
+
+
+# --- Damage ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A hit of `amount` (of the body's `max_health`) and type `dtype` from local
+## direction `dir` (the ship: x right, -y ahead; ZERO: anywhere) - may leave a
+## fault in one of the parts it reaches, or worsen one there. Returns the
+## fault made or worsened ({} if none) with "part" added.
+static func hit(cond: Dictionary, which: String, amount: float, max_health: float, dtype := "kinetic", dir := Vector2.ZERO, rng: RandomNumberGenerator = null) -> Dictionary:
+	if amount <= 0.0 or max_health <= 0.0:
+		return {}
+	if rng == null:
+		rng = RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		rng.randomize()
+	var chance := clampf(amount / max_health * HIT_CHANCE, 0.0, 0.85)
+	if rng.randf() >= chance:
+		return {}
+	var pid := _pick_part(which, dir, rng)
+	return add_fault(cond, which, pid, _pick_kind(dtype, rng), -1, rng)
+
+
+## Puts a fault of `kind` in part `pid` (on component `comp`; -1: one that can
+## have it) - or worsens the same fault already there. Returns it ({} if the
+## part is full).
+static func add_fault(cond: Dictionary, which: String, pid: String, kind: String, comp := -1, rng: RandomNumberGenerator = null) -> Dictionary:
+	if rng == null:
+		rng = RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		rng.randomize()
+	var p := part(cond, which, pid)
+	var cs := comps(which, pid)
+	if comp < 0:
+		var fits := []
+		for i in cs.size():
+			if kind in COMP_FAULTS[cs[i][0]]:
+				fits.append(i)
+		if fits.is_empty():
+			kind = "crack"
+			fits = range(cs.size())
+		comp = fits[rng.randi() % fits.size()]
+	for f in p["faults"]:
+		if int(f["comp"]) == comp and (f["kind"] == kind or f["kind"] == "wreck"):
+			if f["kind"] != "wreck":
+				f["sev"] = minf(1.0, float(f["sev"]) + 0.3)
+				if float(f["sev"]) >= 1.0 and rng.randf() < 0.5:
+					f["kind"] = "wreck"   # (beaten past repair: it needs a spare now)
+					f["prog"] = 0.0
+			var r: Dictionary = f.duplicate()
+			r["part"] = pid
+			return r
+	if p["faults"].size() >= MAX_FAULTS:
+		return {}
+	var nid := int(cond.get("next", 1))
+	cond["next"] = nid + 1
+	var f := {"id": nid, "kind": kind, "comp": comp, "sev": snappedf(rng.randf_range(0.35, 0.75) if kind != "wreck" else 1.0, 0.01),
+		"found": false, "seed": rng.randi() % 100000, "prog": 0.0}
+	p["faults"].append(f)
+	var r2 := f.duplicate()
+	r2["part"] = pid
+	return r2
+
+
+## Takes fault `id` out of part `pid` (fixed). True if it was there.
+static func clear_fault(cond: Dictionary, which: String, pid: String, id: int) -> bool:
+	var fs: Array = part(cond, which, pid)["faults"]
+	for i in fs.size():
+		if int(fs[i]["id"]) == id:
+			fs.remove_at(i)
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## Repairs everything (a station's technicians).
+static func clear_all(cond: Dictionary, which: String) -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	for pid in body(cond, which):
+		n += cond[which][pid]["faults"].size()
+		cond[which][pid]["faults"] = []
+		cond[which][pid]["off"] = false
+	return n
+
+
+## What a station's technicians charge for fixing every fault of a body.
+static func service_cost(cond: Dictionary, which: String) -> int:
+	var c := 0.0
+	if not cond.has(which):
+		return 0
+	for pid in body(cond, which):
+		for f in cond[which][pid]["faults"]:
+			c += 60.0 + 140.0 * float(f.get("sev", 0.5)) + (220.0 if f["kind"] == "wreck" else 0.0)
+	return int(c)
+
+
+static func _pick_part(which: String, dir: Vector2, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> String:
+	var face := "any"
+	if dir.length_squared() > 0.0001:
+		var d := dir.normalized()
+		face = "front" if d.y < -0.6 else ("rear" if d.y > 0.6 else "side")
+	var pool := []
+	for pid in BODIES[which]["parts"]:
+		var faces: Array = BODIES[which]["parts"][pid]["faces"]
+		var w := 1.0 if "any" in faces else 0.0
+		if face != "any" and face in faces:
+			w += 2.0
+		elif face == "any":
+			w = 1.0
+		for i in int(w * 2.0):
+			pool.append(pid)
+	return pool[rng.randi() % pool.size()] if not pool.is_empty() else BODIES[which]["parts"].keys()[0]
+
+
+static func _pick_kind(dtype: String, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> String:
+	var kinds: Array = DTYPE_FAULTS.get(dtype, DTYPE_FAULTS["kinetic"])
+	# The first is likeliest: weights 4, 2, 1, 1...
+	var pool := []
+	for i in kinds.size():
+		for k in [4, 2, 1, 1, 1][mini(i, 4)]:
+			pool.append(kinds[i])
+	return pool[rng.randi() % pool.size()]
+
+
+# --- Afflictions: what the damage does, shown under the health bar --------------------------
+# Each damaged part is an affliction (its effects at its loss: weaker, slower,
+# jerking about...), and the first of them is always the same: while anything
+# is damaged the body's self-repair stops (the ship's hull, the automaton's
+# health) - REGEN. They go when the part is mended (the Repair Bay, a station).
+# The worse the body is hurt the more there are: a hit that leaves it below a
+# share of its health brings faults up to that share's count (by_health).
+
+const REGEN_NAME := "Self-repair frozen"
+## Faults a body has at least, by how much of its health is gone: at 100% - 0, below 80% - 1 ... below 15% - 5.
+const HEALTH_STEPS := [0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.25, 0.15]
+
+
+## Is the body's self-repair stopped (anything in it damaged)?
+static func regen_frozen(cond: Dictionary, which: String) -> bool:
+	return fault_count(cond, which) > 0
+
+
+## The afflictions now: [{id, name, desc, part, loss}] - the frozen self-repair
+## first, then a damaged part each, the worst first.
+static func afflictions(cond: Dictionary, which: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	if cond.is_empty() or not cond.has(which) or fault_count(cond, which) == 0:
+		return out
+	var body_name: String = "hull" if which == "ship" else "health"
+	out.append({"id": "regen", "name": REGEN_NAME, "part": "", "loss": 1.0,
+		"desc": "Something is damaged: the %s stops mending itself until every damaged part is repaired." % body_name})
+	var parts := []
+	for pid in BODIES[which]["parts"]:
+		var loss := 1.0 - working(cond, which, pid)
+		var fs: Array = _peek(cond, which, pid)["faults"]
+		if fs.is_empty() and loss <= 0.0:
+			continue
+		parts.append([loss, pid])
+	parts.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a[0] > b[0])
+	for e in parts:
+		var pid: String = e[1]
+		var p: Dictionary = info(which, pid)
+		var fx := []
+		for k in p["effects"]:
+			fx.append(effect_words(k, float(p["effects"][k]) * float(e[0])))
+		var faults := []
+		for f in _peek(cond, which, pid)["faults"]:
+			var fi := fault_info(which, pid, f)
+			faults.append("%s - %s%s" % [fi["name"], str(comps(which, pid)[int(f["comp"])][1]).to_lower(), "" if f.get("found", false) else " (not yet traced)"])
+		var off: bool = _peek(cond, which, pid).get("off", false)
+		out.append({"id": pid, "part": pid, "loss": float(e[0]),
+			"name": "%s %s" % [p["name"], "switched off" if off else "damaged"],
+			"desc": "Working at %d%%: %s.\n%s" % [roundi((1.0 - float(e[0])) * 100.0), ", ".join(fx.filter(func(x): return x != "")),
+				"\n".join(faults.map(func(x): return "  · " + x))]})
+	return out
+
+
+## An effect at its size, in words ("top speed -22%").
+static func effect_words(key: String, v: float) -> String:
+	if absf(v) < 0.005:
+		return ""
+	match key:
+		"speed_mult": return "speed %d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"handling_mult": return "handling %d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"range_mult": return "weapon reach %d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"damage_mult": return "damage %d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"fire_rate_mult": return "rate of fire -%d%%" % roundi(v / (1.0 + v) * 100.0)
+		"shield_regen_mult": return "shield recharge %d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"max_shields_mult": return "shields %d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"regen_delay": return "shields recharge %.1f s later" % v
+		"hull_taken_mult", "hurt_taken_mult": return "damage taken +%d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"regen_mult": return "healing %d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"max_hp": return "health %d" % roundi(v)
+		"fuel_leak": return "leaking fuel"
+		"jitter": return "jerks off course"
+		"misfire": return "fire control loses the target"
+		"scatter": return "shots scatter"
+		"accuracy": return "accuracy %d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+	return "%s %+.0f%%" % [key, v * 100.0]
+
+
+## A hit left the body at `frac` of its health: it has at least as many faults
+## as that's worth (HEALTH_STEPS) - new ones where they're missing. The faults made.
+static func by_health(cond: Dictionary, which: String, frac: float, dtype := "kinetic", rng: RandomNumberGenerator = null) -> Array:
+	var want := 0
+	for st in HEALTH_STEPS:
+		if frac < st:
+			want += 1
+	var made := []
+	var tries := 0
+	while fault_count(cond, which) < want and tries < 12:
+		tries += 1
+		if rng == null:
+			rng = RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+			rng.randomize()
+		var pid := _pick_part(which, Vector2.ZERO, rng)
+		var f := add_fault(cond, which, pid, _pick_kind(dtype, rng), -1, rng)
+		if not f.is_empty():
+			made.append(f)
+	return made
+
+
+## A line for the log when a hit leaves (or worsens) a fault.
+static func hit_text(which: String, f: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var p: Dictionary = info(which, str(f["part"]))
+	return "%s damaged: %s down. Scan it in the Repair Bay." % [p["name"], p["what"].get_slice(" (", 0)]

+		"building_color": Color(0.75, 0.85, 0.95), "light": Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.4),
+	},
+	# The volcanic planet (2026-11-10): Venus-like - basalt, ash and sulphur under
+	# an orange haze, magma for water. Named after Akrotiri, the Minoan town on
+	# Thera buried by the great eruption.
+	"akrotiri": {
+		"name": "Akrotiri", "template": "inferno", "variant": 0, "landable": true, "seed": 505,

+## Ground kinds understood by shaders/ground.gdshader (index = shader id).
+const GROUND_KINDS := ["water", "sand", "grass", "forest", "regolith", "crater", "ice", "snow", "crevasse", "sky", "deck", "solar", "grating"]
+
+
+
+## Things Minoan citizens say (Minoan words, then the translation). The
+## libation formula a-sa-sa-ra-me and ku-ro ("total") are real Linear A.
+const DEFAULT_NPC_LINES := [
+	["A-sa-sa-ra-me!", "Praise to the Lady! (the Linear A libation formula)"],
+	["Ku-ro, ku-ro.", "Everything is counted. The palace stores are full."],
+	["Ta-na-ra-te u-ti-nu.", "Welcome, sky-traveller. Walk in peace."],
+	["Ja-sa-sa-ra-me...", "May the Lady guard your ship."],
+	["Ka-pa da-ku-se-ne.", "The bull dancers leap at the next festival - come and watch."],
+	["I-da-ma-te!", "By the mountain Ida! Your ship is loud."],
+	["Pa-i-to, ku-do-ni-ja.", "Phaistos and Kydonia send their greetings."],
+	["Su-ki-ri-ta.", "The warehouses trade oil, wine and star-metal."],
+	["A-ka-ru da-ku-se.", "Our spirals mark the paths of the sea and the stars."],
+	["Hmm-hm.", "(It rumbles a low, friendly greeting through its beak.)"],
+]
+
+## A named planet's appearance (PlanetGen parameters).
+static func spec(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var p: Dictionary = get_planet(id)
+	return PlanetGen.generate(p.get("template", "barren"), int(p.get("variant", 0)), p.get("look", {}))
+
+
+## A planet node `size` px across (see PlanetGen.make).
+static func make_planet(p: Dictionary, size: float, radius := PlanetGen.DISK, cached := false) -> Control:
+	return PlanetGen.make(p, size, radius, cached)
+
+
+## The planet types of generated systems (Galaxy._generate_planets): each a
+## named planet's surface (`base`: its terrain, tiles, fauna, environment) with
+## its own name, seed and look from space (one of `templates`). Moons are
+## Kamares's kind: grey regolith and craters.
+const TYPES := {
+	"ocean": {"base": "thalassa", "templates": ["ocean"], "label": "ocean world",
+		"desc": "An ocean world of shallow seas, beaches and green islands."},
+	"ice": {"base": "krystallos", "templates": ["glacier"], "label": "ice world",
+		"desc": "A frozen world of snowfields, blue ice and deep crevasses."},
+	"volcanic": {"base": "akrotiri", "templates": ["inferno"], "label": "volcanic world",
+		"desc": "A scorched volcanic world: basalt and ash plains, sulphur flats and rivers of magma."},
+	"gas_giant": {"base": "kronos", "templates": ["ringed_giant", "storm_giant"], "label": "gas giant",
+		"desc": "A banded gas giant. No ground - only refinery platforms hovering in its upper clouds, linked by bridges."},
+	"moon": {"base": "selene", "templates": ["barren"], "label": "moon",
+		"desc": "A small grey moon of %s: regolith, rock and craters."},
+}
+
+## A planet you can land on: a named one (PLANETS) or one of a generated
+## system's (Galaxy.planets: "<system>_p<n>", moons "..m<k>") - its type's
+## surface under its own name and seed. {} if there's no such planet.
+static func get_planet(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if PLANETS.has(id):
+		return PLANETS[id]
+	var rec: Dictionary = Galaxy.planet_record(id)
+	if rec.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	var t: Dictionary = TYPES[rec["type"]]
+	var p: Dictionary = PLANETS[t["base"]].duplicate(true)
+	p.erase("look")
+	var desc := str(t["desc"])
+	if rec["type"] == "moon":
+		desc = desc % str(Galaxy.planet_record(rec["moon_of"]).get("name", "its planet"))
+	p.merge({"name": rec["name"], "template": rec["template"], "variant": rec["variant"], "seed": int(rec["seed"]),
+		"desc": desc, "landable": true, "type": rec["type"]}, true)
+	return p
+
+
+## True if `id` is a planet you can land on.
+static func exists(id: String) -> bool:
+	return not get_planet(id).is_empty()
+
+
+## What a planet's environment does to you on foot, by its tile set:
+##   regen   how fast your health comes back (volcanic: the heat - half as fast)
+##   speed   how fast you walk (ice: slippery footing - 20% slower)
+## A planet's own "environment" entry overrides its set's.
+const ENVIRONMENT := {
+	"vo": {"regen": 0.5, "speed": 1.0, "note": "The heat: your health comes back half as fast."},
+	"ic": {"regen": 1.0, "speed": 0.8, "note": "Slippery ice: you walk 20% slower."},
+}
+
+
+static func environment(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var p := get_planet(id)
+	var e: Dictionary = {"regen": 1.0, "speed": 1.0, "note": ""}
+	e.merge(ENVIRONMENT.get(str(p.get("tiles", "")), {}), true)
+	e.merge(p.get("environment", {}), true)
+	return e
+
+
+# --- Editable interactions (data/interactions.json) -------------------------------
+
+const INTERACTIONS_FILE := "res://data/interactions.json"
+static var NPC_LINES: Array = []
+
+
+static func _static_init() -> void:
+	reload()
+
+
+static func reload() -> void:
+	var d := DataFiles.read(INTERACTIONS_FILE)
+	NPC_LINES = d.get("npc_lines", DEFAULT_NPC_LINES.duplicate(true))
+
+
+static func save_interactions() -> String:
+	return DataFiles.write(INTERACTIONS_FILE, {
+		"_help": "Things Minoan citizens say ([Minoan words, translation]). Edit here or in-game: right-click > Developer Mode.",
+		"npc_lines": NPC_LINES,
+	})
