+	"ringed_giant": {"name": "Ringed giant", "hue_range": 1.0, "mode": 1,
+		"gas_a": Color(0.88, 0.76, 0.55), "gas_b": Color(0.72, 0.58, 0.4), "gas_c": Color(0.96, 0.9, 0.75), "gas_d": Color(0.6, 0.45, 0.3),
+		"band_count": 8.0, "band_turb": 0.25, "storm": 0.35, "storm_pos": Vector2(1.2, -0.3), "storm_size": 0.1,
+		"storm_color": Color(0.82, 0.62, 0.38), "rings": 1.0, "ring_inner": 1.3, "ring_outer": 2.2,
+		"ring_a": Color(0.88, 0.8, 0.68), "ring_b": Color(0.5, 0.45, 0.4), "incline": 0.3, "tilt": -0.18,
+		"atmosphere": Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.7), "atmo_strength": 0.4},
+}
+
+## The editable properties (the zoo's property panel builds itself from
+## these): [key, label, type, min, max, help, modes ([] = both; [0] rocky,
+## [1] gas giant)]. Types: float, int, color, vec2, vec3, enum:<a>,<b>.
+const PROPERTIES := [
+	["#", "Type and view"],
+	["mode", "Type", "enum:Rocky world,Gas giant", 0, 1, "A rocky surface, or a banded gas giant.", []],
+	["seed", "Seed", "float", 0.0, 400.0, "Offsets every noise pattern: a different world with the same settings.", []],
+	["detail", "Detail", "int", 2, 8, "Noise octaves: finer detail (costs more).", []],
+	["spin", "Spin", "float", -0.06, 0.06, "Rotation speed (rad/s); negative turns the other way.", []],
+	["tilt", "Axis tilt", "float", -1.2, 1.2, "Tilt of the axis in the screen plane (rad).", []],
+	["incline", "View incline", "float", 0.05, 1.2, "How far we look down on the equator (rings open wider).", []],
+	["#", "Terrain"],
+	["terrain_scale", "Terrain scale", "float", 0.5, 6.0, "Size of continents and mountain ranges: higher = smaller, more of them.", [0]],
+	["warp", "Warp", "float", 0.0, 1.5, "Twists the terrain into swirls and winding coasts.", [0]],
+	["ridges", "Ridges", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "Rolling hills (0) to sharp mountain ranges (1).", [0]],
+	["relief", "Relief", "float", 0.0, 2.5, "How strongly the terrain is lit as relief.", [0]],
+	["#", "Ground"],
+	["land_low", "Lowlands", "color", 0, 0, "Ground colour of the lowest land.", [0]],
+	["land_mid", "Midlands", "color", 0, 0, "Ground colour of the middle heights.", [0]],
+	["land_high", "Highlands", "color", 0, 0, "Ground colour of the high ground.", [0]],
+	["land_peak", "Peaks", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of the highest peaks.", [0]],
+	["biome", "Biome patches", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "Patches of a second ground colour (deserts, rust, moss).", [0]],
+	["biome_scale", "Patch scale", "float", 0.3, 5.0, "Size of the patches.", [0]],
+	["biome_color", "Patch colour", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of the patches.", [0]],
+	["#", "Water and ice"],
+	["water_level", "Sea level", "float", -1.0, 0.95, "Height of the seas (-1: no water at all).", [0]],
+	["water_shallow", "Shallows", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of shallow water.", [0]],
+	["water_deep", "Deep water", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of deep water.", [0]],
+	["water_glow", "Sea glow", "float", 0.0, 1.5, "Glowing shallows (bioluminescent seas).", [0]],
+	["ice_cover", "Ice cover", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "Snow on the heights and polar ice caps.", [0]],
+	["ice_color", "Ice colour", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of snow and ice.", [0]],
+	["#", "Craters and lava"],
+	["craters", "Craters", "float", 0.0, 1.5, "Depth and number of impact craters.", [0]],
+	["crater_scale", "Crater scale", "float", 0.5, 6.0, "Higher = smaller, more numerous craters.", [0]],
+	["lava", "Lava", "float", 0.0, 1.2, "Glowing lava rivers and pools.", [0]],
+	["lava_scale", "Lava scale", "float", 0.5, 6.0, "Size of the lava network.", [0]],
+	["lava_color", "Lava colour", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of the lava.", [0]],
+	["lava_hot", "Hot lava", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of the hottest lava.", [0]],
+	["#", "Clouds"],
+	["clouds", "Clouds", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "Cloud cover.", [0]],
+	["cloud_scale", "Cloud scale", "float", 0.5, 6.0, "Size of the cloud systems.", [0]],
+	["cloud_color", "Cloud colour", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of the clouds (dark for smoke).", [0]],
+	["cyclone", "Cyclone", "float", 0.0, 1.5, "A spiral storm in the clouds.", [0]],
+	["cyclone_dir", "Cyclone position", "vec3", -1.0, 1.0, "Where the cyclone sits on the sphere (a direction).", [0]],
+	["#", "Bands"],
+	["band_count", "Band count", "float", 1.0, 20.0, "How many cloud bands.", [1]],
+	["band_turb", "Turbulence", "float", 0.0, 2.0, "Calm, straight bands (0) to swirling turbulence (2).", [1]],
+	["gas_a", "Band colour A", "color", 0, 0, "First band colour.", [1]],
+	["gas_b", "Band colour B", "color", 0, 0, "Second band colour.", [1]],
+	["gas_c", "Light bands", "color", 0, 0, "The light zones.", [1]],
+	["gas_d", "Streaks", "color", 0, 0, "Thin streaks between the bands.", [1]],
+	["#", "Great storm"],
+	["storm", "Storm", "float", 0.0, 1.2, "Strength of the great storm.", [1]],
+	["storm_pos", "Storm position", "vec2", -3.15, 3.15, "Longitude (x) and latitude (y) of the storm, radians.", [1]],
+	["storm_size", "Storm size", "float", 0.03, 0.5, "Size of the storm.", [1]],
+	["storm_color", "Storm colour", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of the storm.", [1]],
+	["#", "Rings"],
+	["rings", "Rings", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "Opacity of the rings (0: none).", []],
+	["ring_inner", "Inner edge", "float", 1.05, 3.0, "Inner edge of the rings (planet radii).", []],
+	["ring_outer", "Outer edge", "float", 1.2, 3.5, "Outer edge of the rings (planet radii).", []],
+	["ring_a", "Ring colour A", "color", 0, 0, "Bright ring colour.", []],
+	["ring_b", "Ring colour B", "color", 0, 0, "Dark ring colour.", []],
+	["#", "Atmosphere"],
+	["atmosphere", "Atmosphere", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of the atmosphere's rim and halo.", []],
+	["atmo_strength", "Atmosphere strength", "float", 0.0, 1.5, "Thickness of the atmosphere glow.", []],
+]
+## Properties that change the node's size (rings): rebuilt rather than set.
+const STRUCTURAL := ["rings", "ring_outer", "mode"]
+
+
+## Applies one property to a planet node made by make() (live editing).
+static func apply(node: Node, key: String, value: Variant) -> void:
+	var mat: ShaderMaterial = node.get_meta("planet_mat", null)
+	if mat:
+		mat.set_shader_parameter(key, value)
+
+
+## Features a variant can borrow from the other templates.
+const ROCKY_MUTATIONS := ["craters", "ice caps", "glowing seas", "oceans", "lava rivers", "deserts", "cyclones", "dry", "jagged ranges", "dense clouds"]
+const GAS_MUTATIONS := ["rings", "great storm", "turbulent", "calm", "many bands", "few bands", "dark bands"]
+## Features that don't go together (or with a template).
+const CLASH := [["dry", "oceans"], ["dry", "glowing seas"], ["oceans", "glowing seas"], ["calm", "turbulent"],
+	["many bands", "few bands"], ["inferno", "oceans"], ["inferno", "glowing seas"], ["inferno", "ice caps"],
+	["inferno", "lava rivers"], ["glacier", "lava rivers"], ["ocean", "dry"], ["barren", "craters"],
+	["glacier", "ice caps"], ["ocean", "oceans"], ["ringed_giant", "rings"], ["storm_giant", "great storm"],
+	["alien", "glowing seas"], ["ocean", "cyclones"], ["glowing seas", "lava rivers"]]
+## Keys that aren't shader uniforms.
+const META := ["name", "hue_range", "template", "variant", "tags", "color_light", "color_dark"]
+
+
+## A planet's parameters: the template's, mixed and recoloured for `variant`
+## (0 = the template as it is). `overrides` replace any of them last.
+static func generate(template: String, variant := 0, overrides := {}) -> Dictionary:
+	var t: Dictionary = TEMPLATES.get(template, TEMPLATES["alien"])
+	var p: Dictionary = t.duplicate()
+	p["template"] = template
+	p["variant"] = variant
+	p["seed"] = float(variant) * 7.31 + float(TEMPLATES.keys().find(template)) * 13.7
+	var tags := []
+	var tags_colors := []
+	if variant != 0:
+		var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		rng.seed = hash([template, variant])
+		if int(p["mode"]) == 0:
+			_jitter_rocky(p, rng)
+			for m in _pick(ROCKY_MUTATIONS, 2, variant, rng, template):
+				tags_colors.append_array(_mutate_rocky(p, m, rng))
+				tags.append(m)
+		else:
+			_jitter_gas(p, rng)
+			for m in _pick(GAS_MUTATIONS, 2, variant, rng, template):
+				tags_colors.append_array(_mutate_gas(p, m, rng))
+				tags.append(m)
+		# Palette: a golden-ratio step round the colour wheel per variant, so
+		# no two variants share a hue. Ground and gas colours move freely
+		# (within the template's range, saturation capped); water stays
+		# near blue / teal, ice, lava and clouds stay natural.
+		var g: float = fposmod(float(variant) * 0.618034, 1.0) - 0.5
+		var shift: float = g * 2.0 * float(t["hue_range"])
+		var sat := rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.15)
+		var val := rng.randf_range(0.9, 1.1)
+		var natural := {"water": [0.07, 0.75], "ice": [0.03, 0.35], "lava": [0.04, 1.0], "cloud": [0.0, 0.25], "ring": [shift, 0.6]}
+		for k in p:
+			if not p[k] is Color or k in tags_colors:
+				continue
+			var c: Color = p[k]
+			var dh := shift
+			var smax := 0.6 if int(p["mode"]) == 0 else 0.62
+			for pre in natural:
+				if (k as String).begins_with(pre):
+					dh = g * natural[pre][0] * 2.0 if pre != "ring" else shift
+					smax = natural[pre][1]
+			if k == "atmosphere":
+				dh = shift * 0.5
+			p[k] = Color.from_hsv(fposmod(c.h + dh, 1.0), clampf(c.s * sat, 0.0, smax), clampf(c.v * val, 0.0, 1.0))
+		p["tilt"] = rng.randf_range(-0.5, 0.5)
+		p["incline"] = rng.randf_range(0.2, 0.5)
+		p["spin"] = rng.randf_range(0.006, 0.02) * (1.0 if rng.randf() < 0.8 else -1.0)
+	p["tags"] = tags
+	p.merge(overrides, true)
+	if int(p["mode"]) == 0:
+		p["color_light"] = p.get("land_mid", Color.GRAY).lerp(p.get("land_peak", Color.WHITE), 0.3)
+		p["color_dark"] = p["water_deep"] if float(p.get("water_level", -1.0)) > 0.0 else p.get("land_low", Color.DIM_GRAY)
+	else:
+		p["color_light"] = p["gas_a"]
+		p["color_dark"] = p["gas_b"]
+	return p
+
+
+## A short description of a generated planet ("Ocean world · craters, lava rivers").
+static func describe(p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var s: String = p.get("name", "Planet")
+	if not p.get("tags", []).is_empty():
+		s += " · " + ", ".join(p["tags"])
+	return s
+
+
+## `n` different mutations that don't clash with each other or the template;
+## consecutive variants start at different ones.
+static func _pick(list: Array, n: int, variant: int, rng: RandomNumberGenerator, template: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var tries := 0
+	var first := posmod(variant * 3, list.size())
+	while out.size() < n and tries < 100:
+		var m: String = list[(first + tries) % list.size()] if tries < list.size() and out.is_empty() else list[rng.randi() % list.size()]
+		tries += 1
+		if m in out or _clashes(m, template):
+			continue
+		var ok := true
+		for o in out:
+			if _clashes(m, o):
+				ok = false
+		if ok:
+			out.append(m)
+	return out
+
+
+static func _clashes(a: String, b: String) -> bool:
+	for c in CLASH:
+		if (c[0] == a and c[1] == b) or (c[0] == b and c[1] == a):
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+static func _jitter_rocky(p: Dictionary, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> void:
+	p["terrain_scale"] = float(p["terrain_scale"]) * rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.45)
+	p["warp"] = clampf(float(p["warp"]) + rng.randf_range(-0.25, 0.35), 0.1, 1.2)
+	p["ridges"] = clampf(float(p["ridges"]) + rng.randf_range(-0.3, 0.2), 0.1, 1.0)
+	if float(p.get("water_level", -1.0)) > 0.0:
+		p["water_level"] = clampf(float(p["water_level"]) + rng.randf_range(-0.08, 0.08), 0.3, 0.75)
+	if p.has("clouds"):
+		p["clouds"] = clampf(float(p["clouds"]) + rng.randf_range(-0.15, 0.15), 0.0, 0.8)
+	p["cyclone_dir"] = Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6), rng.randf_range(-0.5, 0.5), 0.8).normalized()
+
+
+static func _jitter_gas(p: Dictionary, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> void:
+	p["band_count"] = float(p["band_count"]) * rng.randf_range(0.75, 1.35)
+	p["band_turb"] = clampf(float(p["band_turb"]) * rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.3), 0.1, 1.4)
+	p["storm_pos"] = Vector2(PI / 2.0 + rng.randf_range(-0.8, 0.8), rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6))
+	p["storm_size"] = float(p["storm_size"]) * rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.4)
+
+
+static func _rand_color(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, s := 0.6, v := 0.75) -> Color:
+	return Color.from_hsv(rng.randf(), clampf(s + rng.randf_range(-0.2, 0.2), 0.0, 1.0), clampf(v + rng.randf_range(-0.15, 0.15), 0.0, 1.0))
+
+
+static func _mutate_rocky(p: Dictionary, m: String, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> Array:
+	var T := TEMPLATES
+	match m:
+		"craters":
+			p["craters"] = rng.randf_range(0.45, 1.0)
+			p["crater_scale"] = rng.randf_range(2.0, 3.6)
+		"ice caps":
+			p["ice_cover"] = rng.randf_range(0.3, 0.65)
+			p["ice_color"] = T["glacier"]["ice_color"]
+		"glowing seas":
+			if float(p.get("water_level", -1.0)) < 0.0:
+				p["water_level"] = rng.randf_range(0.4, 0.52)
+				p["water_deep"] = T["alien"]["water_deep"]
+			p["water_shallow"] = Color.from_hsv(rng.randf_range(0.42, 0.58), 0.8, 0.88)
+			p["water_glow"] = rng.randf_range(0.4, 0.8)
+			return ["water_shallow"]
+		"oceans":
+			p["water_level"] = rng.randf_range(0.52, 0.7)
+			p["water_shallow"] = T["ocean"]["water_shallow"]
+			p["water_deep"] = T["ocean"]["water_deep"]
+		"lava rivers":
+			p["lava"] = rng.randf_range(0.4, 0.9)
+			p["lava_scale"] = rng.randf_range(1.8, 3.2)
+			p["lava_color"] = T["inferno"]["lava_color"]
+			p["lava_hot"] = T["inferno"]["lava_hot"]
+		"deserts":
+			p["biome"] = rng.randf_range(0.55, 1.0)
+			p["biome_scale"] = rng.randf_range(1.0, 2.2)
+			p["biome_color"] = _rand_color(rng, 0.5, 0.65)
+			return ["biome_color"]
+		"cyclones":
+			p["clouds"] = maxf(float(p.get("clouds", 0.0)), rng.randf_range(0.35, 0.55))
+			p["cyclone"] = rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.0)
+		"dry":
+			p["water_level"] = -1.0
+			p["water_glow"] = 0.0
+			p["clouds"] = float(p.get("clouds", 0.0)) * 0.3
+			p["cyclone"] = 0.0
+		"jagged ranges":
+			p["ridges"] = rng.randf_range(0.9, 1.0)
+			p["relief"] = rng.randf_range(1.3, 1.7)
+		"dense clouds":
+			p["clouds"] = rng.randf_range(0.55, 0.75)
+			p["cloud_scale"] = rng.randf_range(1.6, 3.2)
+	return []
+
+
+static func _mutate_gas(p: Dictionary, m: String, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> Array:
+	match m:
+		"rings":
+			p["rings"] = rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.0)
+			p["ring_inner"] = rng.randf_range(1.2, 1.45)
+			p["ring_outer"] = float(p["ring_inner"]) + rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.0)
+			p["ring_a"] = (p["gas_c"] as Color).lerp(Color.WHITE, 0.2)
+			p["ring_b"] = (p["gas_b"] as Color).darkened(0.3)
+		"great storm":
+			p["storm"] = rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.0)
+			p["storm_size"] = rng.randf_range(0.16, 0.28)
+			p["storm_color"] = _rand_color(rng, 0.65, 0.85)
+			return ["storm_color"]
+		"turbulent":
+			p["band_turb"] = rng.randf_range(1.0, 1.4)
+		"calm":
+			p["band_turb"] = rng.randf_range(0.12, 0.3)
+		"many bands":
+			p["band_count"] = rng.randf_range(12.0, 16.0)
+		"few bands":
+			p["band_count"] = rng.randf_range(3.5, 5.5)
+		"dark bands":
+			p["gas_b"] = (p["gas_b"] as Color).darkened(0.45)
+			p["gas_d"] = _rand_color(rng, 0.6, 0.55)
+			return ["gas_d"]
+	return []
+
+
+## A planet node: a Control of `size` px whose disk is `radius` of the
+## half-size (the shader rect is bigger when the planet has rings or a halo).
+## Its material is in meta "planet_mat" (set_light changes the sun's side).
+## `cached`: drawn into a picture a few times a second (ShaderCache - space's
+## planets), not by its shader every frame.
+static func make(p: Dictionary, size: float, radius := DISK, cached := false) -> Control:
+	var holder := Control.new()
+	holder.size = Vector2(size, size)
+	holder.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	var disk := size / 2.0 * radius
+	var ext := 1.12
+	if float(p.get("rings", 0.0)) > 0.0:
+		ext = maxf(ext, float(p.get("ring_outer", 2.2)) * 1.02)
+	var rect := ColorRect.new()
+	rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	rect.size = Vector2.ONE * disk * ext * 2.0
+	rect.position = Vector2.ONE * (size / 2.0 - disk * ext)
+	var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	mat.shader = SHADER
+	for k in p:
+		if not k in META:
+			mat.set_shader_parameter(k, p[k])
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("planet_radius", 1.0 / ext)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("detail", 7 if disk > 250.0 else (6 if disk > 90.0 else 4))
+	rect.material = mat
+	if cached:
+		holder.add_child(ShaderCache.wrap(rect, 12.0, 2048.0))
+	else:
+		holder.add_child(rect)
+	holder.set_meta("planet_mat", mat)
+	return holder
+
+
+## Lights the planet from `dir` (screen direction toward its sun).
+static func set_light(planet: Control, dir: Vector2) -> void:
+	var mat: ShaderMaterial = planet.get_meta("planet_mat", null)
+	if mat and dir != Vector2.ZERO:
+		var d := dir.normalized()
+		mat.set_shader_parameter("light_dir", Vector3(d.x, d.y, 0.55))

+extends Node
+## The player's credits, cargo/consumables and installed equipment.
+## Lives in the game scene (so a new game starts fresh) and is saved with it.
+
+signal changed
+
+const START_CREDITS := 150
+const START_ITEMS := {"repair_kit": 2, "energy_drink": 3}
+## What the ship you start with counts as on a trade-in (it was given to you,
+## so it's worth what a used light fighter fetches - not the shipyard's price
+## for a new Atrapos-class).
+const START_SHIP_VALUE := 2500
+
+var credits := START_CREDITS
+var items: Dictionary = START_ITEMS.duplicate()
+var equipment: Dictionary = {}   # systems and other fittings owned (weapons: `weapons`)
+## The weapons on the ship's hardpoints (Hardpoints: an item id or "" each,
+## one a hardpoint of the class) and the kinds switched off on the toolbar.
+var weapons: Array = Hardpoints.START.duplicate()
+var weapons_off: Dictionary = {}
+## Component upgrades (Upgrades): {"ship": {"<part>:<stat>": level}, "automaton": {...}}.
+var upgrades: Dictionary = {}
+## The ship's industry at work (Industry: the refinery's and fabricator's queue).
+var industry: Dictionary = {}
+var _ind_rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+var tech: Dictionary = {}  # unlocked tech ids
+## The ship you fly ("player" = the Atrapos-class fighter; else a design id)
+## and its fitted modules [{id, rating}] (see Shipyard).
+var ship_class := "player"
+## What your ship is worth on a trade-in (Shipyard.trade_in): what you paid
+## for it, or START_SHIP_VALUE for the one you started with.
+var ship_value := START_SHIP_VALUE
+var modules: Array = []
+## Ship Designer: the look (ShipParts spec overrides) and bought parts / skins.
+var ship_look: Dictionary = {}
+var owned_parts: Array = []
+## What you've discovered, for the Encyclopedia (Discovery: "ship:<id>" ...).
+var discovered: Dictionary = {}
+## What you lost dying and may win back (LostItems): [{kind, id, n}].
+var lost: Array = []
+## What you carry on foot (Inventory.carried: 12 slots, moved to and from the ship at it).
+var carried: Dictionary = {}
+## The automaton's stamina on foot (Stamina).
+var stamina := Stamina.MAX
+## Its skills: level, experience, points, ranks (Skills).
+var skills: Dictionary = {}
+## The toolbars (Inventory.toolbar): 9 slots each, in space and on foot.
+var toolbar: Array = Inventory.SHIP_TOOLBAR.duplicate()
+var toolbar_foot: Array = Inventory.FOOT_TOOLBAR.duplicate()
+## Where things sit in the hold and in what you carry (Inventory.slots: dragged there).
+var layout_hold: Array = []
+var layout_carried: Array = []
+## The automaton's loadout on foot (Gear.LOADOUT slots -> gear item ids).
+var loadout: Dictionary = Gear.DEFAULT_LOADOUT.duplicate()
+
+
+## The industry works on as you fly (Industry.tick) - a few times a second.
+var _ind_t := 0.0
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_ind_t += delta
+	if _ind_t < 0.25:
+		return
+	if industry.get("queue") is Array and not industry["queue"].is_empty():
+		var made := Industry.tick(self, _ind_t, _ind_rng)
+		if not made.is_empty() and industry["queue"].is_empty():
+			GameLog.post("The industry's queue is done.", "good")
+	_ind_t = 0.0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	_ind_rng.randomize()
+	add_to_group("player_data")
+	for id in items:
+		discovered["item:" + id] = true
+	for id in equipment:
+		discovered["gear:" + id] = true
+	for id in weapons:
+		if id != "":
+			discovered["gear:" + Hardpoints.kind(id)] = true
+
+
+func count(id: String) -> int:
+	return items.get(id, 0)
+
+
+func add_item(id: String, amount := 1) -> void:
+	if id == "credits":
+		add_credits(amount)
+		return
+	items[id] = count(id) + amount
+	discovered["item:" + id] = true
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+func remove_item(id: String, amount := 1) -> bool:
+	if count(id) < amount:
+		return false
+	items[id] = count(id) - amount
+	if items[id] <= 0:
+		items.erase(id)
+	changed.emit()
+	return true
+
+
+## Room left in the hold: empty slots' worth of items (Inventory; credits take no room).
+func cargo_free() -> int:
+	return maxi(0, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(self) - Galaxy.cargo_used(self)) * Inventory.STACK
+
+
+## How many more of `id` the hold takes (its last stack's room too).
+func room_for(id: String) -> int:
+	return Inventory.room_for(items, id, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(self))
+
+
+func add_credits(amount: int) -> void:
+	credits += amount
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+func spend(amount: int) -> bool:
+	if credits < amount:
+		return false
+	credits -= amount
+	changed.emit()
+	return true
+
+
+## A kill's chance to win a lost thing back (LostItems.regain, on this data):
+## its name, or "".
+func regain_lost(roll := -1.0) -> String:
+	var d := {"items": items, "equipment": equipment.keys(), "lost": lost}
+	var got := LostItems.regain(d, roll)
+	if got != "":
+		items = d["items"]
+		for id in d["equipment"]:
+			if Items.WEAPONS.has(id):
+				add_equipment(id)   # (an older save's lost weapon kind: back as a weapon - fitted, or into the hold)
+			else:
+				equipment[id] = true
+		changed.emit()
+	return got
+
+
+# --- Fuel ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+## The ship's fuel tank (Shipyard.fuel_capacity): jumps through gates and
+## flying burn it; stations refuel it (the Repair tab), fuel in the hold can
+## be pumped in, and a Star Energizer drains a star's power into it. -1: full
+## (a new game / an older save).
+var fuel := -1.0
+## The damage to your ship's and automaton's parts (Parts: faults, found or not).
+var condition: Dictionary = {}
+
+
+func fuel_max() -> float:
+	return Shipyard.fuel_capacity(self)
+
+
+func fuel_level() -> float:
+	return fuel_max() if fuel < 0.0 else minf(fuel, fuel_max())
+
+
+## Burns `n` fuel; false (and nothing burnt) if there isn't that much.
+func use_fuel(n: float) -> bool:
+	var f := fuel_level()
+	if f < n - 0.001:
+		return false
+	fuel = f - n
+	return true
+
+
+## Burns up to `n` (flying: what's left, if less).
+func drain_fuel(n: float) -> void:
+	fuel = maxf(0.0, fuel_level() - n)
+
+
+func add_fuel(n: float) -> void:
+	fuel = minf(fuel_max(), fuel_level() + n)
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+func has_equipment(id: String) -> bool:
+	if Items.WEAPONS.has(id):
+		return Hardpoints.has_kind(self, id)   # (a weapon: one fitted)
+	return equipment.get(id, false)
+
+
+func add_equipment(id: String) -> void:
+	if Items.WEAPONS.has(id):
+		# A weapon kind: one of it, as big as a free hardpoint takes - fitted
+		# there, or (none free) into the hold.
+		var lay := Hardpoints.layout(ship_class)
+		var r: Array = Hardpoints.MADE_IN[id]
+		var best := -1
+		var ws := Hardpoints.fitted(self)
+		for i in lay.size():
+			if ws[i] == "" and int(lay[i]) >= int(r[0]) and (best < 0 or lay[i] > lay[best]):
+				best = i
+		var size: int = clampi(int(lay[best]) if best >= 0 else Hardpoints.BASE, int(r[0]), int(r[1]))
+		var wid := Hardpoints.item_id(id, size)
+		if best >= 0:
+			Hardpoints.fit(self, wid, best, false)
+		else:
+			Inventory.add(items, wid, 1, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(self))
+			discovered["gear:" + id] = true
+			changed.emit()
+		return
+	equipment[id] = true
+	discovered["gear:" + id] = true
+	# A new weapon or system goes on the toolbar's first free slot.
+	if (Items.WEAPONS.has(id) or Items.SYSTEMS.has(id)) and not id in toolbar:
+		var free := toolbar.find("")
+		if free >= 0:
+			toolbar[free] = id
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+# --- Tech -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func has_tech(id: String) -> bool:
+	return tech.get(id, false)
+
+
+## "owned", "available" (prerequisite met) or "locked".
+func tech_state(id: String) -> String:
+	if has_tech(id):
+		return "owned"
+	var pre := Tech.prerequisite(id)
+	return "available" if pre == "" or has_tech(pre) else "locked"
+
+
+func can_afford_tech(id: String) -> bool:
+	var t: Dictionary = Tech.TECHS[id]
+	return credits >= t["cost"] and count("data_core") >= t["cores"]
+
+
+func unlock_tech(id: String) -> bool:
+	if tech_state(id) != "available" or not can_afford_tech(id):
+		return false
+	var t: Dictionary = Tech.TECHS[id]
+	credits -= t["cost"]
+	if t["cores"] > 0:
+		remove_item("data_core", t["cores"])
+	tech[id] = true
+	GameLog.post("Researched: %s (%s)" % [t["name"], t["short"]], "good")
+	changed.emit()
+	return true
+
+
+## Sum of a modifier over all unlocked techs (see tech.gd for keys).
+func mod(key: String) -> float:
+	var total := 0.0
+	for id in tech:
+		total += Tech.TECHS[id]["effects"].get(key, 0.0)
+	return total + Shipyard.module_effect(self, key) + Parts.mod(condition, "ship", key) + Upgrades.mod(upgrades, condition, "ship", key)
+
+
+## Item ids currently held, in catalogue order (then gear, by name).
+func held_items() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for id in Items.ITEMS:
+		if count(id) > 0:
+			out.append(id)
+	var gear := items.keys().filter(func(id): return Gear.is_gear(str(id)) and count(id) > 0 and Items.exists(id))
+	gear.sort()
+	var reports := items.keys().filter(func(id): return NavReports.is_report(str(id)) and count(id) > 0 and Items.exists(id))
+	reports.sort()
+	return out + gear + reports
+
+
+func _look_json() -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	for k in ship_look:
+		out[k] = ship_look[k].to_html() if ship_look[k] is Color else ship_look[k]
+	return out
+
+
+func get_save_data() -> Dictionary:
+	return {"credits": credits, "items": items, "equipment": equipment.keys(), "weapons": weapons, "weapons_off": weapons_off.keys(), "tech": tech.keys(),
+		"ship_class": ship_class, "ship_value": ship_value, "modules": modules, "ship_look": _look_json(), "owned_parts": owned_parts,
+		"discovered": discovered.keys(), "lost": lost, "carried": carried,
+		"toolbar": toolbar, "toolbar_foot": toolbar_foot, "layout_hold": layout_hold, "layout_carried": layout_carried, "loadout": loadout,
+		"fuel": fuel, "stamina": stamina, "skills": skills, "condition": condition, "upgrades": upgrades, "industry": industry}
+
+
+func load_save_data(data: Dictionary) -> void:
+	credits = int(data.get("credits", START_CREDITS))
+	fuel = float(data.get("fuel", -1.0))
+	stamina = Stamina.of(data)
+	skills = Skills.clean(data.get("skills"))
+	condition = Parts.load_condition(data.get("condition", {}))
+	industry = {}
+	var ind = data.get("industry", {})
+	if ind is Dictionary and ind.get("queue") is Array:
+		industry["queue"] = []
+		for j in ind["queue"]:
+			if j is Dictionary and str(j.get("kind", "")) in ["refine", "fab"]:
+				industry["queue"].append({"kind": str(j["kind"]), "id": str(j["id"]), "n": int(j["n"]), "done": int(j.get("done", 0)), "t": float(j.get("t", 0.0))})
+	upgrades = {}
+	var ups = data.get("upgrades", {})
+	if ups is Dictionary:
+		for w in ["ship", "automaton"]:
+			if ups.get(w) is Dictionary:
+				upgrades[w] = {}
+				for id in ups[w]:
+					if not Upgrades.find(w, str(id)).is_empty():
+						upgrades[w][str(id)] = clampi(int(ups[w][id]), 0, Upgrades.MAX_LEVEL)
+	var d := data.duplicate(true)
+	loadout = Gear.DEFAULT_LOADOUT.duplicate()
+	var lo = d.get("loadout")
+	if lo is Dictionary:
+		for slot in lo:
+			if slot in Gear.LOADOUT and Gear.fits(str(lo[slot]), slot):
+				loadout[slot] = str(lo[slot])
+	carried = {}
+	var saved_carried: Dictionary = Inventory.carried(d)   # (an older save's pack moves in)
+	for id in saved_carried:
+		carried[id] = int(saved_carried[id])
+	toolbar = Inventory.toolbar(d, false).duplicate()
+	toolbar_foot = Inventory.toolbar(d, true).duplicate()
+	layout_hold = Array(d.get("layout_hold", [])).map(func(x): return str(x) if x != null else "")
+	layout_carried = Array(d.get("layout_carried", [])).map(func(x): return str(x) if x != null else "")
+	lost = []
+	for e in data.get("lost", []):
+		lost.append({"kind": str(e["kind"]), "id": str(e["id"]), "n": int(e["n"])})
+	items = {}
+	var saved_items: Dictionary = data.get("items", START_ITEMS)
+	for id in saved_items:
+		items[id] = int(saved_items[id])  # JSON numbers load as floats
+	equipment = {}
+	var old_weapons := []
+	for id in data.get("equipment", []):
+		if Items.WEAPONS.has(id):
+			old_weapons.append(id)   # (an older save: weapon kinds owned, one of each)
+		else:
+			equipment[id] = true
+	ship_class = data.get("ship_class", "player")
+	weapons_off = {}
+	for k in data.get("weapons_off", []):
+		weapons_off[str(k)] = true
+	if data.get("weapons") is Array:
+		weapons = Array(data["weapons"]).map(func(x): return str(x) if x != null and not Hardpoints.parse(str(x)).is_empty() else "")
+		Hardpoints.fitted(self)   # (sized to the class)
+	else:
+		Hardpoints.from_equipment(self, old_weapons)
+	# Older saves: the starting ship at its trade-in value, a bought one at its price.
+	ship_value = int(data.get("ship_value", START_SHIP_VALUE if ship_class == "player" else Shipyard.stats(ship_class)["price"]))
+	ship_look = data.get("ship_look", {})
+	owned_parts = data.get("owned_parts", [])
+	modules = []
+	for m in data.get("modules", []):
+		modules.append({"id": m["id"], "rating": int(m["rating"])})
+	tech = {}
+	for id in data.get("tech", []):
+		if Tech.TECHS.has(id):
+			tech[id] = true
+	discovered = {}
+	for k in data.get("discovered", []):
+		discovered[str(k)] = true
+	for id in items:   # (older saves: what you hold and fly with, you know)
+		discovered["item:" + id] = true
+	for id in equipment:
+		discovered["gear:" + id] = true
+	for id in weapons:
+		if id != "":
+			discovered["gear:" + Hardpoints.kind(id)] = true
+	changed.emit()

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): The probe scanner (equipment "probe_scanner", bought at an outfitter): scan probes launched across the system from the system map (MapPage's PROBES panel). Each probe reads what lies within its reach (`r`); an ANALYSIS (ANALYZE_TIME s) turns every signature in reach into a signal STRENGTH: each probe that covers it adds more the nearer it is to the middle of its reach and the tighter that reach is (REF_R / r), less for a faint kind of signature (KINDS' difficulty: a planet is plain, an anomaly faint), more with the sensors' probe strength (Upgrades). So a wide sweep finds that there's something; probes drawn tight round it pin it down: below 25% - an unknown signature, somewhere in a wide circle 25 - 75% - its kind (anomaly / ship / body / structure), a smaller circle 75 - 100% - what it is, a small circle 100% - located: its name and exact place; an anomaly's beacon appears (Galaxy signals "located"), a ship is tracked, the place is charted - and you can set a course to it. The probes and the results are this system's (cleared on a jump). (Moved from scripts/probe_scanner.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,223 @@ 
+class_name ProbeScanner
+extends Node
+## The probe scanner (equipment "probe_scanner", bought at an outfitter): scan
+## probes launched across the system from the system map (MapPage's PROBES
+## panel). Each probe reads what lies within its reach (`r`); an ANALYSIS
+## (ANALYZE_TIME s) turns every signature in reach into a signal STRENGTH:
+## each probe that covers it adds more the nearer it is to the middle of its
+## reach and the tighter that reach is (REF_R / r), less for a faint kind of
+## signature (KINDS' difficulty: a planet is plain, an anomaly faint), more with
+## the sensors' probe strength (Upgrades). So a wide sweep finds that there's
+## something; probes drawn tight round it pin it down:
+##   below 25%  - an unknown signature, somewhere in a wide circle
+##   25 - 75%   - its kind (anomaly / ship / body / structure), a smaller circle
+##   75 - 100%  - what it is, a small circle
+##   100%       - located: its name and exact place; an anomaly's beacon
+##                appears (Galaxy signals "located"), a ship is tracked, the
+##                place is charted - and you can set a course to it.
+## The probes and the results are this system's (cleared on a jump).
+
+const MAX_PROBES := 5
+const RADII := [1000.0, 2000.0, 4000.0, 8000.0, 16000.0, 32000.0]
+const REF_R := 2000.0
+const PER_PROBE := 0.36
+const ANALYZE_TIME := 3.5
+const PROBE_SPEED := 9000.0
+## Signature kinds: [name, how faint (x: harder), map colour].
+const KINDS := {
+	"anomaly": ["Anomaly", 1.0, Color(0.75, 0.5, 1.0)],
+	"hostile": ["Hostile ship", 0.55, Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.3)],
+	"neutral": ["Ship", 0.55, Color(0.5, 1.0, 0.75)],
+	"body": ["Celestial body", 0.12, Color(0.6, 0.8, 1.0)],
+	"structure": ["Structure", 0.2, Color(0.3, 0.9, 1.0)],
+}
+
+var main: Node
+var ship: Node2D
+var probes: Array = []       # [{pos, r, at (where it is now, flying out)}]
+var results: Array = []      # [{id, kind, name, strength, pos (true), est (estimated), unc (uncertainty radius), node}]
+var analyzing := -1.0        # s into an analysis (-1: none)
+signal changed
+
+
+func fitted() -> bool:
+	var d: Node = main.player_data if main else null
+	return d != null and d.has_equipment("probe_scanner")
+
+
+## The sensors' probe strength (Upgrades) as a factor.
+func strength_k() -> float:
+	var d: Node = main.player_data if main else null
+	return 1.0 + (d.mod("probe_strength") if d else 0.0)
+
+
+## Launches probes to `spots` (each with the reach `r`): from the ship, they fly out.
+func launch(spots: Array, r: float) -> void:
+	for p in spots:
+		if probes.size() >= MAX_PROBES:
+			break
+		probes.append({"pos": p, "r": r, "at": ship.global_position if ship else p})
+	Sfx.play("space/missile", -8.0)
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+## Probes in a ring round `c` (`r` apart): MAX_PROBES of them, one in the middle.
+func launch_pattern(c: Vector2, r: float) -> void:
+	recall()
+	var spots := [c]
+	for i in MAX_PROBES - 1:
+		spots.append(c + Vector2.from_angle(TAU * i / (MAX_PROBES - 1) - PI * 0.5) * r * 0.75)
+	launch(spots, r)
+
+
+func recall() -> void:
+	probes = []
+	analyzing = -1.0
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+## Every probe's reach a step up or down.
+func step_all(d: int) -> void:
+	for p in probes:
+		p["r"] = step(float(p["r"]), d)
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+static func step(r: float, d: int) -> float:
+	var i := RADII.find(r)
+	if i < 0:
+		i = 2
+	return RADII[clampi(i + d, 0, RADII.size() - 1)]
+
+
+func ready_to_analyze() -> bool:
+	return not probes.is_empty() and analyzing < 0.0 and probes.all(func(p): return (p["at"] as Vector2).distance_to(p["pos"]) < 1.0)
+
+
+func analyze() -> void:
+	if probes.is_empty() or analyzing >= 0.0:
+		return
+	analyzing = 0.0
+	Sfx.play("space/scan_pulse", -4.0, 0.02)
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	var moving := false
+	for p in probes:
+		var at: Vector2 = p["at"]
+		if at.distance_to(p["pos"]) > 1.0:
+			p["at"] = at.move_toward(p["pos"], PROBE_SPEED * delta)
+			moving = true
+	if analyzing >= 0.0 and not moving:
+		analyzing += delta
+		if analyzing >= ANALYZE_TIME:
+			analyzing = -1.0
+			_resolve()
+			changed.emit()
+	elif moving:
+		changed.emit()
+
+
+## What there is to find in this system: [{id, kind, name, pos, node}].
+func signatures() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var tree := get_tree()
+	if main and main.get("site") == null:
+		for sg in Galaxy.signals_in():
+			if not sg["done"]:
+				out.append({"id": "sig:%s" % sg["id"], "kind": "anomaly", "name": SignalSites.title(sg), "pos": SignalSites.pos(sg), "sig": sg})
+	for e in tree.get_nodes_in_group("enemies") + tree.get_nodes_in_group("neutrals"):
+		if not e.is_alive() or e.get("untouchable") == true:
+			continue
+		var hostile: bool = not e.is_neutral() or e.is_hostile_to_player()
+		out.append({"id": "ship:%d" % e.get_instance_id(), "kind": "hostile" if hostile else "neutral", "name": e.display_name, "pos": e.global_position, "node": e})
+	for b in tree.get_nodes_in_group("planet_bodies"):
+		out.append({"id": "body:%s" % b.planet_id, "kind": "body", "name": b.title, "pos": b.global_position, "node": b})
+	var star := tree.get_first_node_in_group("star")
+	if star:
+		out.append({"id": "star", "kind": "body", "name": star.star_name + " (star)", "pos": star.global_position, "node": star})
+	for st in tree.get_nodes_in_group("stations"):
+		out.append({"id": "station:%s" % st.station_id, "kind": "structure", "name": st.station_name, "pos": st.global_position, "node": st})
+	for g in tree.get_nodes_in_group("gates"):
+		out.append({"id": "gate:%s" % g.target, "kind": "structure", "name": "Gate to " + g.target_name, "pos": g.global_position, "node": g})
+	for nb in tree.get_nodes_in_group("nav_beacons"):
+		out.append({"id": "nav", "kind": "structure", "name": "Navigation beacon", "pos": nb.global_position, "node": nb})
+	return out
+
+
+## A signature's strength from the probes now (0..1).
+func strength_of(pos: Vector2, kind: String) -> float:
+	var total := 0.0
+	var faint: float = KINDS[kind][1]
+	for p in probes:
+		var r: float = p["r"]
+		var d := (p["pos"] as Vector2).distance_to(pos)
+		if d > r:
+			continue
+		total += PER_PROBE * (1.0 - pow(d / r, 2.0)) * sqrt(REF_R / r) / faint
+	return clampf(total * strength_k(), 0.0, 1.0)
+
+
+## The analysis done: every signature in reach, its strength; what's pinned down is located.
+func _resolve() -> void:
+	var old := {}
+	for r in results:
+		old[r["id"]] = r
+	results = []
+	var located := 0
+	for s in signatures():
+		var st := strength_of(s["pos"], s["kind"])
+		if st <= 0.01:
+			continue
+		# (an estimate: off by more the fainter, the same each analysis for the same probes)
+		var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		rng.seed = hash(str(s["id"]) + str(probes.size()) + str(roundi(st * 20.0)))
+		var avg_r := 0.0
+		for p in probes:
+			avg_r += float(p["r"])
+		avg_r /= maxf(1.0, probes.size())
+		var unc := (1.0 - st) * avg_r * 0.8
+		var est: Vector2 = s["pos"] + Vector2.from_angle(rng.randf() * TAU) * unc * rng.randf_range(0.2, 0.8)
+		var r := {"id": s["id"], "kind": s["kind"], "name": s["name"], "strength": st, "pos": s["pos"], "est": est, "unc": unc, "node": s.get("node")}
+		if s.has("sig"):
+			r["sig"] = s["sig"]
+		results.append(r)
+		if st >= 1.0:
+			if not (old.has(s["id"]) and float(old[s["id"]]["strength"]) >= 1.0):
+				located += 1
+			_located(r)
+	results.sort_custom(func(a, b): return float(a["strength"]) > float(b["strength"]))
+	Sfx.play("space/scan_done", -4.0)
+	GameLog.post("Probe analysis: %d signature%s%s." % [results.size(), "" if results.size() == 1 else "s",
+		(", %d located" % located) if located > 0 else ""], "info")
+
+
+func _located(r: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if r.has("sig") and not r["sig"]["located"]:
+		r["sig"]["located"] = true
+		if main and main.has_method("refresh_beacons"):
+			main.refresh_beacons()
+		GameLog.post("Located: %s - its beacon is on your map. Fly there and ENTER." % r["name"], "mission")
+		Sfx.play("space/signal_found", -3.0)
+	Galaxy.reveal(r["pos"], 900.0)   # (charted round it on the map)
+
+
+## How a result reads at its strength.
+static func label(r: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var st := float(r["strength"])
+	if st >= 1.0:
+		return r["name"]
+	if st >= 0.75:
+		return "%s?" % r["name"]
+	if st >= 0.25:
+		return KINDS[r["kind"]][0]
+	return "Unknown signature"
+
+
+## Results of a kind, for the map's icons: a located one shows exactly, the others as their circle.
+func located(id: String) -> bool:
+	for r in results:
+		if r["id"] == id:
+			return float(r["strength"]) >= 1.0
+	return false

@@ -1,0 +1,160 @@ 
+class_name RepairService
+extends RefCounted
+## A station's repair service: an EVALUATION first - the technicians go over
+## the ship and the automaton and list everything damaged (the hull; each
+## damaged part's affliction and the faults in it, traced or not) with what
+## each costs to put right - then a REPAIR of what you choose (each on its own,
+## a part's faults together, or everything), done by them over time: up to
+## MAX_TIME s, longer the more there is (docked, you wait; undock and what's not
+## done yet is refunded). It's dear: at least MARKUP times what the same repair
+## costs done yourself (manual_cost: the spare part a wreck takes, the
+## materials the rest use; the hull: a Repair Kit's worth).
+##   var ev := RepairService.evaluate(data, ship)   # [item...]
+##   var job := RepairService.start(data, items)    # then tick(job, delta) while docked
+
+const MARKUP := 10.0
+const MAX_TIME := 60.0
+## What mending a fault yourself costs in materials (sealant, solder, welding rod...): by kind, x its severity.
+const MATERIALS := {"crack": 14.0, "burn": 18.0, "leak": 12.0, "drift": 10.0}
+## Hull by hand: a Repair Kit mends 40 for its price.
+const KIT_HULL := 40.0
+
+
+## The materials and parts a fault takes, mended in the Repair Bay.
+static func manual_cost(which: String, pid: String, f: Dictionary) -> float:
+	if str(f["kind"]) == "wreck":
+		var kind: String = Parts.comps(which, pid)[int(f["comp"])][0]
+		return float(Items.ITEMS[Parts.SPARE_OF[kind]]["price"])
+	return float(MATERIALS.get(str(f["kind"]), 12.0)) * (0.5 + float(f.get("sev", 0.5)))
+
+
+## The station's price for it (MARKUP times the manual cost, never less).
+static func price_of(manual: float) -> int:
+	return maxi(10, ceili(manual * MARKUP / 5.0) * 5)
+
+
+## The technicians' time on a fault (s, before the whole job is fitted into MAX_TIME).
+static func time_of(f: Dictionary) -> float:
+	return 14.0 if str(f["kind"]) == "wreck" else 5.0 + 10.0 * float(f.get("sev", 0.5))
+
+
+## Everything damaged, priced: [{key, body, part, kind ("hull"/"fault"), fault (its id),
+## name, detail, price, time, manual}] - the hull first, then each part's faults
+## under it (with its affliction: `part_name`, `affliction`). Traces the hidden faults.
+static func evaluate(data: Node, ship: Node2D) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	if ship != null:
+		var missing := ceilf(float(ship.max_hull) - float(ship.hull))
+		if missing >= 1.0:
+			var manual := missing / KIT_HULL * float(Items.ITEMS["repair_kit"]["price"])
+			out.append({"key": "hull", "body": "ship", "part": "", "kind": "hull", "fault": -1, "name": "Hull breaches",
+				"detail": "%d of %d hull points" % [missing, roundi(float(ship.max_hull))], "manual": manual,
+				"price": price_of(manual), "time": 1.0 + 20.0 * missing / maxf(1.0, float(ship.max_hull))})
+	for which in ["ship", "automaton"]:
+		var cond: Dictionary = data.condition
+		if not cond.has(which):
+			continue
+		for a in Parts.afflictions(cond, which):
+			if a["part"] == "":
+				continue
+			var pid: String = a["part"]
+			for f in Parts.part(cond, which, pid)["faults"]:
+				f["found"] = true   # (the technicians trace everything)
+				var fi := Parts.fault_info(which, pid, f)
+				var manual := manual_cost(which, pid, f)
+				out.append({"key": "%s:%s:%d" % [which, pid, int(f["id"])], "body": which, "part": pid, "kind": "fault", "fault": int(f["id"]),
+					"name": fi["name"], "detail": "%s - severity %d%%" % [Parts.comps(which, pid)[int(f["comp"])][1], roundi(float(f["sev"]) * 100.0)],
+					"part_name": Parts.info(which, pid)["name"], "affliction": a["name"], "manual": manual,
+					"price": price_of(manual), "time": time_of(f)})
+	return out
+
+
+static func total(items: Array) -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	for it in items:
+		n += int(it["price"])
+	return n
+
+
+## The job's time: each item's, the whole fitted into MAX_TIME (at least 3 s).
+static func job_time(items: Array) -> float:
+	var t := 0.0
+	for it in items:
+		t += float(it["time"])
+	return clampf(t, 3.0, MAX_TIME)
+
+
+## A repair job begins: paid for, its items in order, each its share of the time.
+## {} if it can't be paid.
+static func start(data: Node, items: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	if items.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	var cost := total(items)
+	if not data.spend(cost):
+		return {}
+	var raw := 0.0
+	for it in items:
+		raw += float(it["time"])
+	var k := job_time(items) / maxf(0.001, raw)
+	var queue := []
+	for it in items:
+		var q: Dictionary = it.duplicate()
+		q["time"] = float(it["time"]) * k
+		queue.append(q)
+	return {"items": queue, "t": 0.0, "done": 0, "paid": cost, "total": job_time(items)}
+
+
+## Moves the job on by `delta` s: finishes the items whose time has come (the
+## ship's hull, the parts' faults). Returns the items finished this time.
+static func tick(job: Dictionary, delta: float, data: Node, ship: Node2D) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	if job.is_empty():
+		return out
+	job["t"] = float(job["t"]) + delta
+	var items: Array = job["items"]
+	var at := 0.0
+	for i in items.size():
+		at += float(items[i]["time"])
+		if i < int(job["done"]):
+			continue
+		if float(job["t"]) < at:
+			break
+		_finish(items[i], data, ship)
+		job["done"] = i + 1
+		out.append(items[i])
+	return out
+
+
+static func finished(job: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	return not job.is_empty() and int(job["done"]) >= (job["items"] as Array).size()
+
+
+## The share of the job done (0..1).
+static func progress(job: Dictionary) -> float:
+	return clampf(float(job.get("t", 0.0)) / maxf(0.001, float(job.get("total", 1.0))), 0.0, 1.0)
+
+
+## What's not done yet is paid back (undocking mid-job). The refund.
+static func cancel(job: Dictionary, data: Node) -> int:
+	if job.is_empty():
+		return 0
+	var back := 0
+	var items: Array = job["items"]
+	for i in range(int(job["done"]), items.size()):
+		back += int(items[i]["price"])
+	if back > 0:
+		data.add_credits(back)
+	job["items"] = items.slice(0, int(job["done"]))
+	return back
+
+
+static func _finish(it: Dictionary, data: Node, ship: Node2D) -> void:
+	match str(it["kind"]):
+		"hull":
+			if ship:
+				ship.repair(float(ship.max_hull) - float(ship.hull))
+		"fault":
+			Parts.clear_fault(data.condition, it["body"], it["part"], int(it["fault"]))
+	if ship and ship.has_method("apply_tech"):
+		ship.apply_tech()
+	data.changed.emit()

@@ -1,0 +1,128 @@ 
+class_name ShipDesigns
+## The ship classes flown in the game: the hand-traced designs (TracedShips).
+## Independent designs fly for everyone; an empire's own designs (traced with
+## "empire") are flown by that empire first. Civil roles come from the class:
+## freighters trade, explorers / couriers explore, Hornets mine.
+
+const CIVIL := {"freighter": "trader", "explorer": "explorer", "courier": "explorer"}
+const MINERS := ["traced_hornet"]
+## Empires without a reference sheet of their own fly the independent designs
+## that match their colours (Mycenae: olive, gold, bronze and red-cream hulls).
+const AFFINITY := {"mycenae": ["traced_bulwark", "traced_hornet", "traced_ember", "traced_bastion", "traced_atlas", "traced_halo"]}
+
+static var _types := {}
+
+## The capital classes - cruisers, battleships and dreadnoughts, each empire's
+## (and the independents') own: no sheets of their own yet, so each is drawn
+## with one of its empire's biggest hulls ("art"), larger. [name, art, tint].
+const CAPITALS := {
+	"cruiser": {
+		"": ["Citadel", "traced_bastion"], "minoa": ["Knossos", "traced_minoa_taurus"], "pirates": ["Marauder", "traced_pirate_skullsun"],
+		"athens": ["Strategos", "traced_athens_pentathlon"], "sparta": ["Agoge", "traced_sparta_lykourgos"],
+		"ionia": ["Priene", "traced_ionia_miletos"], "cyclades": ["Delos", "traced_cyclades_longboat"]},
+	"battleship": {
+		"": ["Colossus", "traced_bastion"], "minoa": ["Phaistos", "traced_minoa_taurus"], "pirates": ["Warlord", "traced_pirate_ironwheel"],
+		"athens": ["Acropolis", "traced_athens_parthenon_wheel"], "sparta": ["Thermopylae", "traced_sparta_thermopylae"],
+		"ionia": ["Ephesos", "traced_ionia_miletos"], "cyclades": ["Naxos", "traced_cyclades_sanctuary"]},
+	"dreadnought": {
+		"": ["Monolith", "traced_bastion"], "minoa": ["Labyrinth", "traced_minoa_taurus"], "pirates": ["Black Tide", "traced_pirate_galleon"],
+		"athens": ["Pallas", "traced_athens_parthenon_wheel"], "sparta": ["Lykourgos", "traced_sparta_thermopylae"],
+		"ionia": ["Halikarnassos", "traced_ionia_miletos"], "cyclades": ["Santorini", "traced_cyclades_sanctuary"]},
+}
+## Each capital class: [hull, shields, speed, length on screen, list price,
+## the class's name, damage a second (spread over its guns: Enemy batteries)].
+const CAPITAL_STATS := {
+	"cruiser": [450.0, 260.0, 120.0, 330.0, 16000, "Cruiser", 40.0],
+	"battleship": [800.0, 420.0, 95.0, 430.0, 24000, "Battleship", 70.0],
+	"dreadnought": [1300.0, 650.0, 75.0, 540.0, 34000, "Dreadnought", 110.0],
+}
+const CAPITAL_CLASSES := ["cruiser", "battleship", "dreadnought"]
+
+
+static func _ensure() -> void:
+	if not _types.is_empty():
+		return
+	for tid in TracedShips.ids():
+		var t := TracedShips.type_of(tid)
+		var role: String = "miner" if tid in MINERS or TracedShips.def(tid).get("civil", "") == "miner" else CIVIL.get(t["class"], "")
+		if role != "":
+			t["faction"] = "neutral"
+			t["role"] = role
+			t["travel_bias"] = {"trader": 0.85, "miner": 0.5, "explorer": 0.3}[role]
+		_types[tid] = t
+	for cls in CAPITALS:
+		var cs: Array = CAPITAL_STATS[cls]
+		for e in CAPITALS[cls]:
+			var d: Array = CAPITALS[cls][e]
+			if not _types.has(d[1]):
+				continue
+			var art: Dictionary = _types[d[1]]
+			var name := "%s-class %s" % [d[0], cs[5]]
+			_types["cap_%s_%s" % [e if e != "" else "independent", cls]] = {"name": name, "empire_style": e, "class": cls,
+				"art": d[1], "price": cs[4], "capital": true,
+				"desc": ("An independent %s: %s." % [cs[5].to_lower(), name]) if e == "" else ("%s of the %s." % [name, Galaxy.EMPIRES[e]["name"]]),
+				"length": cs[3], "hull": cs[0], "shields": cs[1], "speed": cs[2], "fire_interval": 1.0, "damage": cs[6] / 3.0,
+				"bullet_speed": 650.0, "shots": 3, "aggro": 900.0, "distance": 520.0, "color": art.get("color", Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.2))}
+
+
+static func types() -> Dictionary:
+	_ensure()
+	return _types
+
+
+static func ids() -> Array:
+	_ensure()
+	return _types.keys()
+
+
+## Who flies a design: its empire ("independent" for the unclaimed ones;
+## the designs an empire without a sheet of its own has adopted - AFFINITY -
+## are that empire's).
+static func owner_of(id: String) -> String:
+	_ensure()
+	var t: Dictionary = _types.get(id, {})
+	if t.is_empty():
+		return ""
+	var e: String = t.get("empire_style", "")
+	if e != "":
+		return e
+	for k in AFFINITY:
+		if id in AFFINITY[k]:
+			return k
+	return "independent"
+
+
+## A class for an empire (or "independent") with one of the given hull
+## classes ("fighter", "freighter", ...) or civil roles ("trader", "miner",
+## "explorer"): only that empire's own designs - a ship always looks like
+## who it flies for. (None of its own for that job: an independent one.)
+static func pick(e: String, keys: Array) -> String:
+	_ensure()
+	var own := []
+	var any := []
+	for id in _types:
+		var t: Dictionary = _types[id]
+		if t.get("unique", false) or not (t["class"] in keys or t.get("role", "") in keys):
+			continue
+		var o := owner_of(id)
+		if o == e:
+			own.append(id)
+		elif o == "independent":
+			any.append(id)
+	if not own.is_empty():
+		return own.pick_random()
+	return any.pick_random() if not any.is_empty() else ""
+
+
+static func warship(e: String) -> String:
+	return pick(e, ["fighter", "fighter", "interceptor", "gunship", "frigate"])
+
+
+## A fleet's flagship: a capital ship of the empire's (or the independents')
+## by the fleet's size - a cruiser from 6 ships, a battleship from 9, a
+## dreadnought for a full 12. "" for a smaller fleet.
+static func flagship(e: String, size: int) -> String:
+	if size < 6:
+		return ""
+	var cls := "dreadnought" if size >= 12 else ("battleship" if size >= 9 else "cruiser")
+	return pick(e, [cls])

Ready-made skins are bought once and stay owned (PlayerData.owned_parts); a custom paint job costs PAINT_JOB each time it changes. (Moved from scripts/ship_parts.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,76 @@ 
+class_name ShipParts
+## The station Ship Designer's paint shop: a look recolours your ship's
+## sprite (shaders/ship_paint.gdshader) - hue shift, saturation, brightness
+## and a tint - keeping the art's shading and detail. Ready-made skins are
+## bought once and stay owned (PlayerData.owned_parts); a custom paint job
+## costs PAINT_JOB each time it changes.
+
+const PAINT_JOB := 250
+
+## Ready-made skins (tuned on the orange Atrapos fighter; they recolour any hull).
+const SKINS := {
+	"athenian_owl": {"name": "Athenian Owl", "hue": 0.55, "sat": 0.75, "bright": 1.1, "tint": Color(0.85, 0.9, 1.0), "tint_amt": 0.15, "price": 900},
+	"spartan_bronze": {"name": "Spartan Bronze", "hue": -0.03, "sat": 0.7, "bright": 0.85, "tint": Color(0.8, 0.45, 0.2), "tint_amt": 0.25, "price": 900},
+	"minoan_sea": {"name": "Minoan Sea", "hue": 0.42, "sat": 0.9, "bright": 1.0, "tint": Color(0.3, 0.9, 0.8), "tint_amt": 0.1, "price": 900},
+	"mycenaean_gold": {"name": "Mycenaean Gold", "hue": 0.06, "sat": 0.85, "bright": 1.05, "tint": Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.3), "tint_amt": 0.2, "price": 900},
+	"ionian_lapis": {"name": "Ionian Lapis", "hue": 0.6, "sat": 1.0, "bright": 0.9, "tint": Color(0.25, 0.35, 0.95), "tint_amt": 0.2, "price": 900},
+	"sea_raider": {"name": "Sea Raider", "hue": -0.06, "sat": 0.35, "bright": 0.7, "tint": Color(0.8, 0.15, 0.1), "tint_amt": 0.2, "price": 700},
+	"stealth": {"name": "Nyx Stealth", "hue": 0.0, "sat": 0.1, "bright": 0.5, "tint": Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.28), "tint_amt": 0.2, "price": 1200},
+	"racer": {"name": "Olympic Racer", "hue": 0.0, "sat": 0.08, "bright": 1.35, "tint": Color(1, 1, 1), "tint_amt": 0.1, "price": 800},
+	"olive": {"name": "Olive Grove Camo", "hue": 0.17, "sat": 0.5, "bright": 0.8, "tint": Color(0.45, 0.5, 0.3), "tint_amt": 0.25, "price": 700},
+	"royal": {"name": "Royal Purple", "hue": 0.75, "sat": 0.9, "bright": 0.9, "tint": Color(0.55, 0.25, 0.75), "tint_amt": 0.15, "price": 1100},
+}
+
+const DEFAULT := {"hue": 0.0, "sat": 1.0, "bright": 1.0, "tint": "ffffffff", "tint_amt": 0.0}
+
+
+## A complete paint look ({} / an older-format look = the factory paint).
+static func normalized(look: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := DEFAULT.duplicate()
+	if not look.has("hue"):
+		return out
+	for k in DEFAULT:
+		if look.has(k):
+			out[k] = look[k]
+	if look.has("skin"):
+		out["skin"] = look["skin"]
+	return out
+
+
+static func is_factory(look: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	var n := normalized(look)
+	return is_equal_approx(float(n["hue"]), 0.0) and is_equal_approx(float(n["sat"]), 1.0) \
+		and is_equal_approx(float(n["bright"]), 1.0) and float(n["tint_amt"]) <= 0.001
+
+
+## The paint material for a look (null = factory paint).
+static func material(look: Dictionary) -> ShaderMaterial:
+	if is_factory(look):
+		return null
+	var n := normalized(look)
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = preload("res://shaders/ship_paint.gdshader")
+	m.set_shader_parameter("hue", float(n["hue"]))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("sat", float(n["sat"]))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("bright", float(n["bright"]))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("tint", Color(n["tint"]) if n["tint"] is String else n["tint"])
+	m.set_shader_parameter("tint_amt", float(n["tint_amt"]))
+	return m
+
+
+## A skin as a look.
+static func skin_look(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var sk: Dictionary = SKINS[id]
+	return {"hue": sk["hue"], "sat": sk["sat"], "bright": sk["bright"], "tint": (sk["tint"] as Color).to_html(), "tint_amt": sk["tint_amt"], "skin": id}
+
+
+## Credits to change from one look to another (owned skins are free).
+static func cost(old: Dictionary, new: Dictionary, owned: Array) -> int:
+	var a := normalized(old)
+	var b := normalized(new)
+	if JSON.stringify(a) == JSON.stringify(b):
+		return 0
+	var sk: String = b.get("skin", "")
+	if sk != "":
+		return 0 if owned.has(sk) else int(SKINS[sk]["price"])
+	return 0 if is_factory(b) else PAINT_JOB

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Your ship's scanner (right-click in space, main.gd): - on an asteroid (within ROCK_RANGE): a laser scan sweeps across it for ROCK_TIME s; when it's done the rock stays highlighted with its kind and the ore it holds (Asteroid.scanned). - (empty space: the probe scanner - ProbeScanner, on the system map) - in a signal site, an anomaly's node (anything with on_scanned() and a scan_range) is scanned like a rock. Drawn in the world, above the ships (z_index). (Moved from scripts/ship_scanner.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,153 @@ 
+class_name ShipScanner
+extends Node2D
+## Your ship's scanner (right-click in space, main.gd):
+##  - on an asteroid (within ROCK_RANGE): a laser scan sweeps across it for
+##    ROCK_TIME s; when it's done the rock stays highlighted with its kind and
+##    the ore it holds (Asteroid.scanned).
+##  - (empty space: the probe scanner - ProbeScanner, on the system map)
+##  - in a signal site, an anomaly's node (anything with on_scanned() and a
+##    scan_range) is scanned like a rock.
+## Drawn in the world, above the ships (z_index).
+
+const ROCK_RANGE := 1600.0
+const ROCK_TIME := 1.3
+const CYAN := Color(0.3, 0.9, 1.0)       # (the GUIs cyan)
+const ORANGE := Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.15)
+
+var ship: Node2D
+var minimap: Control
+var main: Node
+var paths: Array = []               # (none now: signals are found by probes - ProbeScanner)
+var _rock: Node2D                   # being scanned
+var _rock_t := -1.0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	z_index = 8
+	z_as_relative = false
+
+
+func scanning() -> bool:
+	return _rock_t >= 0.0
+
+
+## Scans an asteroid (false if it's out of range).
+func scan_rock(rock: Node2D) -> bool:
+	if ship == null or not is_instance_valid(rock):
+		return false
+	var reach: float = float(rock.get("scan_range")) if rock.get("scan_range") != null else ROCK_RANGE
+	if ship.global_position.distance_to(rock.global_position) > reach:
+		ship.message.emit(("Out of scanner range - get within %.1fk of it" % (reach / 1000.0)) if reach >= 1000.0 else "Out of scanner range - fly closer to it")
+		return false
+	_rock = rock
+	_rock_t = 0.0
+	Sfx.play_world("space/scan_laser", rock.global_position, -2.0, 0.03)
+	return true
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _rock_t >= 0.0:
+		_rock_t += delta
+		if not is_instance_valid(_rock) or not _rock.is_inside_tree():
+			_rock_t = -1.0
+		elif _rock_t >= ROCK_TIME:
+			_rock_t = -1.0
+			Sfx.play("space/scan_done", -4.0)
+			if _rock.has_method("on_scanned"):
+				_rock.on_scanned()
+			else:
+				_rock.scanned = true
+				# (the prospecting readout: what it's made of, its veins - Mining)
+				var parts := []
+				var keys: Array = _rock.comp.keys()
+				keys.sort_custom(func(a, b): return _rock.comp[a] > _rock.comp[b])
+				for m in keys:
+					parts.append("%s %d%%" % [Items.display_name(m).replace(" Ore", ""), roundi(float(_rock.comp[m]) * 100.0)])
+				var live: Array = _rock.veins.filter(func(v): return int(v["units"]) > 0)
+				GameLog.post("Prospected: %s - %s. %d vein%s: %s." % [_rock.display_name, ", ".join(parts), live.size(), "" if live.size() == 1 else "s",
+					", ".join(live.map(func(v): return "%s (%d)" % [Items.display_name(v["mineral"]).replace(" Ore", "").to_lower(), int(v["units"])]))], "info")
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if _rock_t >= 0.0 and is_instance_valid(_rock) and ship:
+		_draw_rock_scan()
+
+
+## The asteroid scan, in the console's glowing style: a beam from the ship's
+## nose like a route (soft glow, bright core, pulses running out along it)
+## sweeping across the rock, a bright scan line over it, glowing target rings
+## with light nodes round the rock, an orange arc filling as the scan runs and
+## a readout above. Sizes in screen pixels.
+func _draw_rock_scan() -> void:
+	var px := 1.0 / maxf(get_canvas_transform().get_scale().x, 0.01)
+	var nose: Vector2 = ship.global_transform * Vector2(0, -34.0)
+	var c: Vector2 = _rock.global_position
+	var r: float = _rock.hit_radius
+	var u := _rock_t / ROCK_TIME
+	var dir := nose.direction_to(c)
+	var side := dir.orthogonal()
+	var sweep := sin(u * TAU * 1.5) * 0.9   # back and forth across it
+	var hit := c + side * sweep * r - dir * sqrt(maxf(0.0, 1.0 - sweep * sweep)) * r * 0.6
+	var a := 1.0 - maxf(0.0, u - 0.85) / 0.15
+	# The beam: a faint fan, then a glowing route to where it touches.
+	draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([nose, c + side * r - dir * r * 0.2, c - side * r - dir * r * 0.2]), Color(CYAN, 0.05 * a))
+	draw_line(nose, hit, Color(CYAN, 0.12 * a), 22.0 * px, true)
+	draw_line(nose, hit, Color(CYAN, 0.3 * a), 9.0 * px, true)
+	draw_line(nose, hit, Color(CYAN.lightened(0.5), 0.95 * a), 2.5 * px, true)
+	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
+	for q in 3:
+		var t := fposmod(now * 1.6 + q / 3.0, 1.0)
+		var p := nose.lerp(hit, t)
+		draw_circle(p, 9.0 * px, Color(CYAN, 0.2 * a))
+		draw_circle(p, 3.5 * px, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9 * a))
+	# The scan line over the rock.
+	draw_line(hit - dir * r * 0.9, hit + dir * r * 0.4, Color(CYAN, 0.25 * a), 10.0 * px, true)
+	draw_line(hit - dir * r * 0.9, hit + dir * r * 0.4, Color(CYAN.lightened(0.5), 0.9 * a), 2.0 * px, true)
+	draw_circle(hit, (7.0 + 3.0 * sin(_rock_t * 40.0)) * px, Color(CYAN, 0.35 * a))
+	draw_circle(hit, 3.5 * px, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95 * a))
+	# Target rings with nodes, turning slowly, and the progress arc.
+	var ring := r * 1.25 + 10.0 * px
+	draw_arc(c, ring, 0, TAU, 64, Color(CYAN, 0.14 * a), 12.0 * px, true)
+	draw_arc(c, ring, 0, TAU, 64, Color(CYAN.lightened(0.3), 0.75 * a), 2.0 * px, true)
+	for k in 6:
+		var na := now * 0.6 + k * TAU / 6.0
+		var np := c + Vector2.from_angle(na) * ring
+		draw_circle(np, 7.0 * px, Color(CYAN, 0.25 * a))
+		draw_circle(np, 3.0 * px, Color(CYAN.lightened(0.6), a))
+	var outer := ring + 12.0 * px
+	draw_arc(c, outer, -PI / 2.0, -PI / 2.0 + TAU * u, 64, Color(ORANGE, 0.25 * a), 10.0 * px, true)
+	draw_arc(c, outer, -PI / 2.0, -PI / 2.0 + TAU * u, 64, Color(ORANGE.lightened(0.3), a), 3.0 * px, true)
+	# Readout.
+	var font := NeonTheme.heavy_font()
+	var fs := int(Settings.fs("world", 18) * px)
+	var at := c + Vector2(-160.0 * px, -outer - 16.0 * px)
+	var label := "SCANNING  %d%%" % int(u * 100.0)
+	draw_string_outline(font, at, label, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 320.0 * px, fs, int(5 * px), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.8 * a))
+	draw_string(font, at, label, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 320.0 * px, fs, Color(ORANGE.lightened(0.25), a))
+
+
+## How far signal paths reach, and how close you must be to see a signal on
+## the radar and the system map: a third of the
+## current system across - twice the farthest gate, station or planet from the
+## star, divided by three. Worked out once per system.
+static var _range_sys := ""
+static var _range := 0.0
+
+static func signal_range(tree: SceneTree) -> float:
+	var sys: String = Galaxy.current_system
+	if sys != _range_sys or _range <= 0.0:
+		var far := 0.0
+		for g in ["gates", "stations", "planet_bodies"]:
+			for n in tree.get_nodes_in_group(g):
+				if n.global_position.distance_to(Vector2(240000.0, 240000.0)) > 7000.0 * 2.0:
+					far = maxf(far, n.global_position.length())
+		if far <= 0.0:
+			return 20000.0   # (the system isn't built yet: don't remember this)
+		_range_sys = sys
+		_range = far * 2.0 / 3.0
+	return _range
+
+
+static func signal_visible(tree: SceneTree, at: Vector2, from: Vector2) -> bool:
+	return from.distance_to(at) <= signal_range(tree)
