files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Ships you can fly and the modules you can fit (inspired by the shipyard / outfitting loop of space sims): every class has its own hull, shields, speed, cargo hold and slots - weapon hardpoints, internal slots and utility mounts. Modules come in ratings E (cheap) to A (best). Hardpoints hold the weapons (laser, plasma cannon, missile launcher); utility mounts hold the active systems (afterburner, shield booster) and passive amplifiers; internal slots hold the stat modules below. Module effects use the same keys as the tech tree, so they stack with it. (Moved from scripts/shipyard.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,357 @@ 
+class_name Shipyard
+## Ships you can fly and the modules you can fit (inspired by the shipyard /
+## outfitting loop of space sims): every class has its own hull, shields,
+## speed, cargo hold and slots - weapon hardpoints, internal slots and
+## utility mounts. Modules come in ratings E (cheap) to A (best).
+##
+## Hardpoints hold the weapons (laser, plasma cannon, missile launcher);
+## utility mounts hold the active systems (afterburner, shield booster) and
+## passive amplifiers; internal slots hold the stat modules below. Module
+## effects use the same keys as the tech tree, so they stack with it.
+
+const RATINGS := ["E", "D", "C", "B", "A"]
+const RATING_MULT := [1.0, 1.3, 1.65, 2.05, 2.5]
+const RATING_PRICE := [1.0, 2.4, 5.5, 12.0, 26.0]
+
+## module id -> slot, name, base price, effect per rating step (times RATING_MULT).
+const MODULES := {
+	"shield_generator": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Shield Generator", "price": 600, "effects": {"max_shields": 30.0},
+		"desc": "Extra shield capacity."},
+	"hull_reinforcement": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Hull Reinforcement", "price": 500, "effects": {"max_hull": 35.0},
+		"desc": "Bulkheads and armour plating: more hull."},
+	"cargo_rack": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Cargo Rack", "price": 350, "effects": {"cargo": 40.0},
+		"desc": "More room for trade goods."},
+	"thruster_upgrade": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Enhanced Thrusters", "price": 900, "effects": {"speed_mult": 0.06, "handling_mult": 0.06},
+		"desc": "Faster and more agile."},
+	"shield_cell_bank": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Shield Cell Bank", "price": 700, "effects": {"shield_regen_mult": 0.25},
+		"desc": "Shields recharge faster."},
+	"gimbal_mounts": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Gimballed Mounts", "price": 1100, "effects": {"range_mult": 0.06, "damage_mult": 0.04},
+		"desc": "Weapons track better: more range and damage."},
+	"heat_amplifier": {"slot": "utility", "name": "Shield Amplifier", "price": 800, "effects": {"max_shields": 18.0, "shield_regen_mult": 0.08},
+		"desc": "Utility mount: boosts shield strength."},
+	# Weapon modifiers, resistances and passives (2026-11-11: modules are gear -
+	# items you buy, loot and fit; see Gear).
+	"focusing_lens": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Focusing Lens", "price": 700, "effects": {"damage_mult": 0.05},
+		"desc": "Weapon modifier: every weapon hits harder."},
+	"capacitor_bank": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Capacitor Bank", "price": 750, "effects": {"fire_rate_mult": -0.04},
+		"desc": "Weapon modifier: every weapon fires faster."},
+	"targeting_computer": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Targeting Computer", "price": 650, "effects": {"range_mult": 0.07},
+		"desc": "Weapon modifier: every weapon reaches further."},
+	"ablative_plating": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Ablative Plating", "price": 600, "effects": {"resist_energy": 0.06, "max_hull": 10.0},
+		"desc": "Resistance: lasers and beams do less."},
+	"reactive_armour": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Reactive Armour", "price": 650, "effects": {"resist_kinetic": 0.05, "resist_explosive": 0.05},
+		"desc": "Resistance: rams, bites and missiles do less."},
+	"heat_shield": {"slot": "utility", "name": "Heat Shield", "price": 550, "effects": {"resist_heat": 0.07},
+		"desc": "Resistance: plasma and fire do less."},
+	"cryo_baffles": {"slot": "utility", "name": "Cryo Baffles", "price": 550, "effects": {"resist_cold": 0.07},
+		"desc": "Resistance: frost does less."},
+	"fuel_tank": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Fuel Tank", "price": 450, "effects": {"fuel_capacity": 30.0},
+		"desc": "A bigger tank: more jumps between refuels."},
+	"faraday_mesh": {"slot": "internal", "name": "Faraday Mesh", "price": 600, "effects": {"resist_electric": 0.08},
+		"desc": "A conductive mesh round the hull: electric resistance (Electro weapons)."},
+	"nanite_repair": {"slot": "utility", "name": "Nanite Repair", "price": 900, "effects": {"hull_regen": 0.5},
+		"desc": "Passive: the hull mends itself, slowly."},
+}
+
+## Weapons for hardpoints and actives for utility mounts (Items.EQUIPMENT ids).
+const HARDPOINT_GEAR := ["laser", "plasma_cannon", "missile_launcher", "electro", "bouncer", "beam"]
+const UTILITY_GEAR := ["afterburner", "shield_booster", "star_energizer", "salvage_rig", "cloak", "projection_array", "probe_scanner", "refinery", "fabricator"]
+
+## The fuel tank by hull class (Fuel Tanks add to it): a gate jump costs
+## FUEL_JUMP, flying a trickle (FUEL_FLIGHT a second under way).
+const CLASS_FUEL := {"interceptor": 60.0, "fighter": 80.0, "gunship": 90.0, "courier": 130.0,
+	"explorer": 170.0, "frigate": 140.0, "freighter": 120.0, "cruiser": 180.0, "battleship": 220.0, "dreadnought": 260.0}
+const STARTER_FUEL := 100.0
+const FUEL_JUMP := 10.0
+const FUEL_FLIGHT := 0.05
+## Your ship's shields recharging and its hull mending themselves burn fuel:
+## this much a point (a full 100-point shield: 2 fuel; 100 hull: 5). Out of
+## fuel, neither comes back on its own (Ship._regen_fuel).
+const FUEL_PER_SHIELD := 0.02
+const FUEL_PER_HULL := 0.05
+## A tank unit's price at a station: its market price of a unit of fuel (cargo) over this.
+const FUEL_UNITS_PER_CARGO := 10.0
+
+## Slots / hold / handling per hull class (designs' "class" field).
+## Cargo hold sizes in inventory slots (Inventory: up to 100 of an item per
+## slot) by class, between Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS (12: never less than you
+## carry on foot) and Inventory.SHIP_SLOTS (120: the freighter's). The small
+## ships have far fewer. (Prices still go by CLASS_SLOTS.)
+const CLASS_HOLD := {
+	"interceptor": 12, "fighter": 16, "gunship": 20, "courier": 24,
+	"explorer": 40, "frigate": 60, "freighter": 120, "cruiser": 70, "battleship": 80, "dreadnought": 90,
+}
+const STARTER_HOLD := 16
+## Slots a Cargo Rack's "cargo" effect is worth: one per this many.
+const RACK_UNITS_PER_SLOT := 4.0
+
+## Slots per hull class: [hardpoints, internal, utility, (unused)] - never
+## fewer than the starting Atrapos (3 / 3 / 2) where the class is meant to be
+## strong; the top third of a class (grade) gets one more internal slot. The
+## hardpoints and their sizes: Hardpoints.LAYOUT (the first number is its count).
+const CLASS_SLOTS := {
+	"interceptor": [2, 3, 2, 4], "fighter": [3, 3, 2, 8], "courier": [2, 4, 2, 16], "explorer": [2, 5, 3, 20],
+	"gunship": [4, 4, 3, 12], "freighter": [2, 7, 2, 110], "frigate": [10, 6, 3, 32],
+	"cruiser": [14, 7, 4, 60], "battleship": [18, 8, 4, 80], "dreadnought": [24, 9, 5, 100],
+}
+
+## A class's cheapest design: [hull, shields, speed]. Each is already a step up
+## from the Atrapos (100 / 100 / 420) where the class is strong; the dearer
+## designs of a class (their grade) are better still - up to GRADE_HULL times
+## the hull and shields and GRADE_SPEED times the speed.
+const CLASS_BASE := {
+	"interceptor": [110.0, 100.0, 520.0], "fighter": [150.0, 130.0, 460.0], "courier": [140.0, 130.0, 490.0],
+	"explorer": [210.0, 210.0, 400.0], "gunship": [360.0, 260.0, 320.0], "freighter": [380.0, 160.0, 250.0],
+	"frigate": [700.0, 480.0, 240.0],
+	"cruiser": [1100.0, 800.0, 200.0], "battleship": [1800.0, 1300.0, 170.0], "dreadnought": [2800.0, 2000.0, 140.0],
+}
+const GRADE_HULL := 2.0
+const GRADE_SPEED := 1.15
+## Each empire's yards build to their own taste: [hull, shields, speed].
+const EMPIRE_TASTE := {
+	"sparta": [1.15, 0.95, 0.97], "athens": [1.0, 1.12, 1.0], "ionia": [0.95, 1.05, 1.06],
+	"cyclades": [0.95, 1.0, 1.06], "mycenae": [1.1, 1.0, 0.97], "minoa": [1.0, 1.0, 1.02],
+}
+## A ship's price from what it gives (value(): hull, shields, slots, hold,
+## speed), on a steep curve: the weakest ship you can buy costs MIN_PRICE, the
+## strongest TOP_PRICE, and in between the price multiplies with every step up
+## (value ^ PRICE_POWER) - a better ship is always a real upgrade, and the
+## best are a fortune to save for.
+const MIN_PRICE := 15000.0
+const TOP_PRICE := 3000000.0
+static var _value_range := Vector2.ZERO   # (the weakest and strongest designs' values)
+static var _power := 0.0
+
+## A design's grade in its class, 0 (the class's cheapest) to 1 (its dearest):
+## its listed price's place among the class's designs.
+static var _grades := {}
+
+static func grade(class_id: String) -> float:
+	if _grades.is_empty():
+		var by_class := {}
+		for id in ShipDesigns.ids():
+			var t: Dictionary = EnemyTypes.get_type(id)
+			by_class.get_or_add(str(t.get("class", "fighter")), []).append([float(t.get("price", 0.0)), id])
+		for c in by_class:
+			var l: Array = by_class[c]
+			l.sort()
+			for i in l.size():
+				_grades[l[i][1]] = float(i) / maxf(1.0, l.size() - 1.0)
+	return float(_grades.get(class_id, 0.0))
+
+
+## What a ship gives, in one number (a straight sum - price_of bends it).
+## Its hardpoints count by size (`hp`: their sizes, Hardpoints.LAYOUT): an S
+## one 2500, each size up 1.6x.
+static func value(hull: float, shields: float, speed: float, cargo: int, slots: Array, hp: Array = []) -> float:
+	var guns: float = slots[0] * 2500.0
+	if not hp.is_empty():
+		guns = 0.0
+		for z in hp:
+			guns += 2500.0 * pow(1.6, int(z) - Hardpoints.BASE)
+	return (hull + 1.2 * shields) * 40.0 + guns + slots[1] * 1500.0 + slots[2] * 1500.0 \
+		+ cargo * 50.0 + maxf(0.0, speed - 400.0) * 30.0
+
+
+## What a ship of these stats costs (see MIN_PRICE).
+static func price_of(hull: float, shields: float, speed: float, cargo: int, slots: Array, hp: Array = []) -> int:
+	if _power == 0.0:
+		var lo := INF
+		var hi := 0.0
+		for id in ShipDesigns.ids():
+			if EnemyTypes.get_type(id).get("capital", false):
+				continue   # (the capital ships go past TOP_PRICE: the curve carries on)
+			var v := float(_raw(id)["value"])
+			lo = minf(lo, v)
+			hi = maxf(hi, v)
+		_value_range = Vector2(lo, hi)
+		_power = log(TOP_PRICE / MIN_PRICE) / log(hi / lo) if hi > lo else 1.0
+	var v := value(hull, shields, speed, cargo, slots, hp)
+	var p := MIN_PRICE * pow(v / _value_range.x, _power)
+	var step := 100 if p < 100000.0 else 5000
+	return snappedi(int(p), step)
+
+
+## Stats of a player-flyable class: {name, hull, shields, speed, cargo,
+## hardpoints, internal, utility, price, length, empire, grade}.
+static func stats(class_id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var st := _raw(class_id)
+	st["price"] = price_of(st["hull"], st["shields"], st["speed"], st["cargo"], [st["hardpoints"], st["internal"], st["utility"]], Hardpoints.layout(class_id))
+	return st
+
+
+## stats() without the price.
+static func _raw(class_id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if class_id == "" or class_id == "player":
+		var s0 := [3, 3, 2]
+		return {"name": "Atrapos-class Light Fighter", "hull": 100.0, "shields": 100.0, "speed": 420.0, "cargo": STARTER_HOLD,
+			"hardpoints": 3, "internal": 3, "utility": 2, "value": value(100.0, 100.0, 420.0, STARTER_HOLD, s0),
+			"length": 132.0, "empire": Galaxy.HOME_EMPIRE, "grade": 0.0}
+	var t: Dictionary = EnemyTypes.get_type(class_id)
+	var cls := str(t.get("class", "fighter"))
+	var base: Array = CLASS_BASE.get(cls, CLASS_BASE["fighter"])
+	var g := grade(class_id)
+	var taste: Array = EMPIRE_TASTE.get(str(t.get("empire_style", "")), [1.0, 1.0, 1.0])
+	var hull := roundf(base[0] * lerpf(1.0, GRADE_HULL, g) * taste[0])
+	var shields := roundf(base[1] * lerpf(1.0, GRADE_HULL, g) * taste[1])
+	var speed := roundf(clampf(base[2] * lerpf(1.0, GRADE_SPEED, g) * taste[2], 140.0, 600.0))
+	var slots: Array = CLASS_SLOTS.get(cls, CLASS_SLOTS["fighter"]).duplicate()
+	if g >= 0.66:
+		slots[1] += 1
+	var hp: Array = Hardpoints.LAYOUT.get(cls, Hardpoints.LAYOUT["fighter"])
+	slots[0] = hp.size()
+	var cargo := int(CLASS_HOLD.get(cls, 16))
+	return {"name": t["name"], "hull": hull, "shields": shields, "speed": speed, "cargo": cargo,
+		"hardpoints": slots[0], "internal": slots[1], "utility": slots[2],
+		"value": value(hull, shields, speed, cargo, slots, hp),
+		"length": clampf(t["length"] * 0.9, 110.0, 520.0 if t.get("capital", false) else 300.0), "empire": t.get("empire_style", ""), "grade": g}
+
+
+## Ships a station's shipyard sells: its empire's designs.
+static func for_sale(empire: String) -> Array:
+	var own := []
+	var indie := []
+	for id in ShipDesigns.ids():
+		var e: String = ShipDesigns.types()[id]["empire_style"]
+		if e == empire:
+			own.append(id)
+		elif e == "":
+			indie.append(id)   # independent designs: sold at every shipyard
+	if empire == Galaxy.HOME_EMPIRE:
+		own.push_front("player")
+	return own + indie
+
+
+## What the shipyard gives for your ship when you buy another: 80% of what
+## you paid for it (PlayerData.ship_value).
+static func trade_in(data: Node) -> int:
+	return roundi(int(data.ship_value) * 0.8)
+
+
+## The ship's fuel tank: its class's, and Fuel Tanks'.
+static func fuel_capacity(data: Node) -> float:
+	var cls: String = data.ship_class
+	var base := STARTER_FUEL
+	if cls != "" and cls != "player":
+		base = float(CLASS_FUEL.get(EnemyTypes.get_type(cls).get("class", "fighter"), 80.0))
+	return base + module_effect(data, "fuel_capacity") + Upgrades.mod(data.get("upgrades"), data.condition, "ship", "fuel_capacity")
+
+
+## A tank unit's price at a station (its fuel price, a tenth of a cargo unit).
+static func fuel_unit_price(station_id: String) -> float:
+	var p := 20.0
+	if station_id != "" and Galaxy.stations.has(station_id):
+		p = float(Galaxy.buy_price(station_id, "fuel"))
+	return maxf(0.5, p / FUEL_UNITS_PER_CARGO)
+
+
+static func module_price(id: String, rating: int) -> int:
+	return roundi(MODULES[id]["price"] * RATING_PRICE[rating])
+
+
+static func module_name(m: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return "%s %s" % [MODULES[m["id"]]["name"], RATINGS[m["rating"]]]
+
+
+## Summed effects of the fitted modules (same keys as Tech effects).
+static func module_effect(data: Node, key: String) -> float:
+	var total := 0.0
+	for m in data.modules:
+		var e: Dictionary = MODULES[m["id"]]["effects"]
+		total += e.get(key, 0.0) * RATING_MULT[m["rating"]]
+	return total
+
+
+## The hold's size in slots: the class's, Cargo Racks' extra - from
+## Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS to Inventory.SHIP_SLOTS.
+static func cargo_capacity(data: Node) -> int:
+	return clampi(int(stats(data.ship_class)["cargo"]) + int((module_effect(data, "cargo") + Upgrades.mod(data.get("upgrades"), data.condition, "ship", "cargo")) / RACK_UNITS_PER_SLOT),
+		Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS, Inventory.SHIP_SLOTS)
+
+
+static func used_slots(data: Node, slot: String) -> int:
+	match slot:
+		"hardpoints":
+			return Hardpoints.fitted(data).filter(func(w): return w != "").size()
+		"utility":
+			return UTILITY_GEAR.filter(func(g): return data.has_equipment(g)).size() + data.modules.filter(func(m): return MODULES[m["id"]]["slot"] == "utility").size()
+		_:
+			return data.modules.filter(func(m): return MODULES[m["id"]]["slot"] == "internal").size()
+
+
+# --- Areas (the equipment screen: ShipDoll) --------------------------------------------------
+# A ship's fittings belong to its areas, like a body's: weapons on the WINGS
+# (its hardpoints), weapon modifiers and sensors in the NOSE, armour, shields
+# and repair systems in the HULL, the drive's modules at the THRUSTERS, racks,
+# tanks and the salvage rig in the cargo BAY. Each area has room for so many
+# (area_capacity - from the class's hardpoint / internal / utility counts).
+
+const AREAS := ["nose", "wings", "hull", "thrusters", "bay"]
+const AREA_NAMES := {"nose": "Nose", "wings": "Wings", "hull": "Hull", "thrusters": "Thrusters", "bay": "Cargo bay"}
+const AREA_OF := {
+	"laser": "wings", "plasma_cannon": "wings", "missile_launcher": "wings", "electro": "wings", "bouncer": "wings", "beam": "wings",
+	"focusing_lens": "nose", "capacitor_bank": "nose", "targeting_computer": "nose", "gimbal_mounts": "nose",
+	"shield_generator": "hull", "hull_reinforcement": "hull", "shield_cell_bank": "hull", "heat_amplifier": "hull",
+	"ablative_plating": "hull", "reactive_armour": "hull", "faraday_mesh": "hull", "heat_shield": "hull",
+	"cryo_baffles": "hull", "nanite_repair": "hull", "shield_booster": "hull",
+	"cloak": "hull", "projection_array": "nose", "thruster_upgrade": "thrusters", "afterburner": "thrusters", "star_energizer": "thrusters",
+	"cargo_rack": "bay", "fuel_tank": "bay", "salvage_rig": "bay", "probe_scanner": "nose", "refinery": "bay", "fabricator": "hull",
+}
+
+
+## The area a module / equipment / ship gear item (gear:<module>:<q>) goes in.
+static func area_of(id: String) -> String:
+	if Hardpoints.is_weapon(id):
+		return "wings"
+	if Gear.is_gear(id):
+		var p := Gear.parse(id)
+		id = p[0] if not p.is_empty() else id
+	return str(AREA_OF.get(id, "hull"))
+
+
+## How many fittings an area of this ship takes.
+static func area_capacity(data: Node, area: String) -> int:
+	var cls := stats(data.ship_class)
+	var h := int(cls["hardpoints"])
+	var i := int(cls["internal"])
+	var u := int(cls["utility"])
+	match area:
+		"wings":
+			return h
+		"nose":
+			return 1 if i <= 3 else 2
+		"hull":
+			return maxi(1, i - 1)
+		"thrusters":
+			return maxi(1, u)
+		"bay":
+			return 1 if i <= 3 else 2
+	return 0
+
+
+## What's fitted in an area: [{id, kind ("equipment" / "module"), index (modules)}].
+static func area_fittings(data: Node, area: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	if area == "wings":
+		var ws := Hardpoints.fitted(data)
+		for i in ws.size():
+			if ws[i] != "":
+				out.append({"id": ws[i], "kind": "weapon", "index": i})
+	for g in UTILITY_GEAR:
+		if data.has_equipment(g) and area_of(g) == area:
+			out.append({"id": g, "kind": "equipment"})
+	for k in data.modules.size():
+		var m: Dictionary = data.modules[k]
+		if area_of(m["id"]) == area:
+			out.append({"id": m["id"], "rating": int(m["rating"]), "kind": "module", "index": k})
+	return out
+
+
+## Room left for `id` (an equipment, a module or a ship gear item) in its area.
+static func free_for(data: Node, id: String) -> int:
+	var a := area_of(id)
+	return area_capacity(data, a) - area_fittings(data, a).size()
+
+
+static func free_slots(data: Node, slot: String) -> int:
+	return int(stats(data.ship_class)[slot]) - used_slots(data, slot)

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Signal sources: points of interest hidden in every star system, found by a system scan (ShipScanner, right-click in empty space). Each is a kind of encounter - a classic of space games - played out in a pocket of empty space you drop into from its beacon (SignalBeacon -> SignalSite): stranded a ship out of fuel calls for help (give it fuel: a reward - sometimes it's bait and pirates jump you) under_attack a freighter fighting off pirates (save it: its thanks) wreck a shipwreck with its cargo scattered round it (loot; maybe scavengers) monster an alien creature; it drops rare loot when it dies anomaly a space anomaly: scan its four nodes for research data deathtrap a field of unstable anomalies that drain your shields and burn your hull - cross it to its exit for what's there Each system gets a fresh set every EPOCH seconds of galaxy time (the ones you've found and not finished stay). Galaxy.signals_in() keeps them. Each has a level (LEVELS: easy, moderate, hard, insane - level()), shown wherever it is (its beacon, the scan, the site's panel): its hostile ships and creatures have their hull and shields x mult and deal damage x mult (SignalSite._spawn, Enemy.damage_mult), its hazards burn x mult - and its rewards are x mult too. (Moved from scripts/signal_sites.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,118 @@ 
+class_name SignalSites
+## Signal sources: points of interest hidden in every star system, found by a
+## system scan (ShipScanner, right-click in empty space). Each is a kind of
+## encounter - a classic of space games - played out in a pocket
+## of empty space you drop into from its beacon (SignalBeacon -> SignalSite):
+##   stranded     a ship out of fuel calls for help (give it fuel: a reward -
+##                sometimes it's bait and pirates jump you)
+##   under_attack a freighter fighting off pirates (save it: its thanks)
+##   wreck        a shipwreck with its cargo scattered round it (loot; maybe
+##                scavengers)
+##   monster      an alien creature; it drops rare loot when it dies
+##   anomaly      a space anomaly: scan its four nodes for research data
+##   deathtrap    a field of unstable anomalies that drain your shields and
+##                burn your hull - cross it to its exit for what's there
+## Each system gets a fresh set every EPOCH seconds of galaxy time (the ones
+## you've found and not finished stay). Galaxy.signals_in() keeps them.
+## Each has a level (LEVELS: easy, moderate, hard, insane - level()), shown
+## wherever it is (its beacon, the scan, the site's panel): its hostile ships
+## and creatures have their hull and shields x mult and deal damage x mult
+## (SignalSite._spawn, Enemy.damage_mult), its hazards burn x mult - and its
+## rewards are x mult too.
+
+const EPOCH := 1200.0
+const KINDS := {
+	"stranded": {"name": "Distress call", "detail": "A ship is calling for help - out of fuel.", "color": Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.3)},
+	"under_attack": {"name": "Combat signal", "detail": "Weapons fire - a freighter under attack.", "color": Color(1.0, 0.4, 0.3)},
+	"wreck": {"name": "Debris field", "detail": "A wrecked ship, its cargo drifting round it.", "color": Color(0.7, 0.8, 0.9)},
+	"monster": {"name": "Unknown bio-signature", "detail": "Something alive and very large.", "color": Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55)},
+	"anomaly": {"name": "Anomalous readings", "detail": "A space anomaly - scan it for research data.", "color": Color(0.5, 0.75, 1.0)},
+	"deathtrap": {"name": "Hazard: anomaly field", "detail": "Unstable anomalies drain shields and burn hulls. Something waits at the far side.", "color": Color(0.85, 0.45, 1.0)},
+	# Not a signal: a ringed planet's ring (main.gd puts its beacon on the ring).
+	"ring": {"name": "Ring field", "detail": "The planet's ring: ice asteroids beyond counting, the miners who cut them, the pirates who prey on them.", "color": Color(0.7, 0.9, 1.0)},
+}
+## The kinds signal sources come as (the rings are not signals).
+static func signal_kinds() -> Array:
+	return KINDS.keys().filter(func(k): return k != "ring")
+
+
+const COUNT := [12, 36]          # signals a system has, each epoch
+const RING := [4000.0, 16000.0]  # their distance from the star
+const APART := 1500.0            # at least this far from each other
+
+
+## A system's signals for one epoch: COUNT[0]-COUNT[1] of them - every kind
+## at least once (the first six, shuffled), then kinds at random - RING away
+## from the star and APART from each other (the same every time for the
+## same system and epoch).
+static func generate(sys_id: String, epoch: int) -> Array:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = hash("%s:%d" % [sys_id, epoch])
+	var kinds: Array = signal_kinds()
+	for k in range(kinds.size() - 1, 0, -1):
+		var m := rng.randi() % (k + 1)
+		var t = kinds[k]
+		kinds[k] = kinds[m]
+		kinds[m] = t
+	var n := rng.randi_range(COUNT[0], COUNT[1])
+	var all: Array = signal_kinds()
+	while kinds.size() < n:
+		kinds.append(all[rng.randi() % all.size()])
+	var out := []
+	var spots: Array = []
+	for i in n:
+		var p := Vector2.ZERO
+		for attempt in 40:   # (somewhere not on top of another signal)
+			p = Vector2.from_angle(rng.randf() * TAU) * rng.randf_range(RING[0], RING[1])
+			if spots.all(func(q): return q.distance_to(p) >= APART):
+				break
+		spots.append(p)
+		var sg := {"id": "%s:%d:%d" % [sys_id, epoch, i], "kind": kinds[i], "pos": [p.x, p.y],
+			"located": false, "done": false, "seed": rng.randi()}
+		sg["level"] = level(sg)
+		out.append(sg)
+	return out
+
+
+const LEVELS := {
+	"easy": {"name": "Easy", "mult": 0.75, "color": Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.5)},
+	"moderate": {"name": "Moderate", "mult": 1.0, "color": Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.35)},
+	"hard": {"name": "Hard", "mult": 1.5, "color": Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.2)},
+	"insane": {"name": "Insane", "mult": 2.25, "color": Color(1.0, 0.25, 0.3)},
+}
+const LEVEL_ODDS := [["easy", 30], ["moderate", 35], ["hard", 23], ["insane", 12]]   # (percent)
+
+
+## A signal's level: drawn from its seed (the same every time; old saves'
+## signals get theirs the same way).
+static func level(sig: Dictionary) -> String:
+	if LEVELS.has(sig.get("level", "")):
+		return sig["level"]
+	var roll := absi(hash("level:%s" % str(sig.get("seed", sig.get("id", ""))))) % 100
+	for l in LEVEL_ODDS:
+		roll -= int(l[1])
+		if roll < 0:
+			return l[0]
+	return "moderate"
+
+
+static func level_info(sig: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	return LEVELS[level(sig)]
+
+
+## Hull, shields, damage and rewards are multiplied by this.
+static func mult(sig: Dictionary) -> float:
+	return float(level_info(sig)["mult"])
+
+
+## "Unknown bio-signature (Hard)".
+static func title(sig: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return "%s (%s)" % [info(str(sig.get("kind", "wreck")))["name"], level_info(sig)["name"]]
+
+
+static func info(kind: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return KINDS.get(kind, KINDS["wreck"])
+
+
+static func pos(sig: Dictionary) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(float(sig["pos"][0]), float(sig["pos"][1]))

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): The automaton's skills on foot: martial arts, the leap, and the arcana - what goes on the 9-slot toolbar as "skill:<id>" (PlanetSurface.use_skill performs them; SkillFx draws the spells; the Spell Book - the Field Computer's SKILLS tab, SkillBookPage - is where you learn and raise them). Martial arts are STYLES: each a chain of blows (MOVES) thrown one after the other while you fight in it - click an enemy, or use the style from the toolbar, and the automaton closes in and works through the chain until the enemy falls. Higher ranks add the chain's later blows. pygmachia the boxer's art: jab, cross, hook, uppercut pankration every limb a weapon: elbow, knee, front kick, force palm laktisma the kicker's art: side kick, roundhouse, spinning back kick and single techniques: sweep (all around you, knocks down), comet (a flying kick across the gap), guard (brace: most of the damage shrugged off). Movement: leap - a flip through the air to where you point: bolts fired at you while you're up miss. Arcana: lance (a beam through everything in a line), phlox (a fireball that bursts and burns), keraunos (lightning from the sky, leaping on to others), aegis (a dome that soaks up damage), eidola (spectral fighters at your side). Levels: fighting earns experience (XP: defeating enemies, blows and spells that land); each level (to MAX_LEVEL) gives a skill point, spent in the Spell Book to learn a skill (it needs your level: "level") or raise its rank (to MAX_RANK): more damage (RANK_DAMAGE a rank), shorter cooldowns (RANK_COOLDOWN), and what each skill's "ranks" lines say. Every use costs stamina (Stamina). Kept with the player: "skills" {level, xp, points, ranks}.

@@ -1,0 +1,399 @@ 
+class_name Skills
+extends RefCounted
+## The automaton's skills on foot: martial arts, the leap, and the arcana -

+##
+## Martial arts are STYLES: each a chain of blows (MOVES) thrown one after the
+## other while you fight in it - click an enemy, or use the style from the
+## toolbar, and the automaton closes in and works through the chain until the
+## enemy falls. Higher ranks add the chain's later blows.
+##   pygmachia   the boxer's art: jab, cross, hook, uppercut
+##   pankration  every limb a weapon: elbow, knee, front kick, force palm
+##   laktisma    the kicker's art: side kick, roundhouse, spinning back kick
+## and single techniques: sweep (all around you, knocks down), comet (a flying
+## kick across the gap), guard (brace: most of the damage shrugged off).
+## Movement: leap - a flip through the air to where you point: bolts fired at
+## you while you're up miss.
+## Arcana: lance (a beam through everything in a line), phlox (a fireball that
+## bursts and burns), keraunos (lightning from the sky, leaping on to others),
+## aegis (a dome that soaks up damage), eidola (spectral fighters at your side).
+##
+## Levels: fighting earns experience (XP: defeating enemies, blows and spells
+## that land); each level (to MAX_LEVEL) gives a skill point, spent in the
+## Spell Book to learn a skill (it needs your level: "level") or raise its
+## rank (to MAX_RANK): more damage (RANK_DAMAGE a rank), shorter cooldowns
+## (RANK_COOLDOWN), and what each skill's "ranks" lines say. Every use costs
+## stamina (Stamina). Kept with the player: "skills" {level, xp, points, ranks}.

+const ORDER := ["pygmachia", "pankration", "laktisma", "guard", "sweep", "comet", "leap", "phlox", "lance", "keraunos", "aegis", "eidola"]

+
+# --- Items (the toolbar) -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func is_skill(item: String) -> bool:
+	return item.begins_with(PREFIX)
+
+
+static func id_of(item: String) -> String:
+	return item.substr(PREFIX.length()) if is_skill(item) else ""
+
+
+static func item_of(id: String) -> String:
+	return PREFIX + id
+
+
+static func valid(item: String) -> bool:
+	return SKILLS.has(id_of(item))
+
+
+static func info(item: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var s: Dictionary = SKILLS.get(id_of(item), {})
+	if s.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	return {"name": s["name"], "kind": "skill", "value": 0, "desc": s["desc"]}
+
+
+# --- The player's skills -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The player's skills (made the first time: the starting ones, on the toolbar's free slots).
+static func state(player: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var st = player.get("skills")
+	if not st is Dictionary or not st.get("ranks") is Dictionary:
+		st = {"level": 1, "xp": 0, "points": START_POINTS, "ranks": START.duplicate()}
+		player["skills"] = st
+		var bar: Array = Inventory.toolbar(player, true)
+		for id in START_BAR:
+			var it := item_of(id)
+			if bar.has(it):
+				continue
+			var free := bar.find("")
+			if free >= 0:
+				bar[free] = it
+	return st
+
+
+## A saved "skills" made safe (PlayerData.load_save_data).
+static func clean(d: Variant) -> Dictionary:
+	if not d is Dictionary or not d.get("ranks") is Dictionary:
+		return {}
+	var ranks := {}
+	for id in d["ranks"]:
+		if SKILLS.has(str(id)):
+			ranks[str(id)] = clampi(int(d["ranks"][id]), 0, MAX_RANK)
+	return {"level": clampi(int(d.get("level", 1)), 1, MAX_LEVEL), "xp": maxi(0, int(d.get("xp", 0))),
+		"points": maxi(0, int(d.get("points", 0))), "ranks": ranks}
+
+
+static func rank(player: Dictionary, id: String) -> int:
+	return int(state(player)["ranks"].get(id, 0))
+
+
+static func level(player: Dictionary) -> int:
+	return int(state(player)["level"])
+
+
+## XP from one level to the next.
+static func xp_need(lvl: int) -> int:
+	return roundi(60.0 * pow(float(lvl), 1.3))
+
+
+## What defeating something is worth (its health).
+static func xp_for_kill(max_hp: float) -> int:
+	return clampi(roundi(max_hp * 0.5), 8, 400)
+
+
+## Adds experience; returns the levels gained (a skill point each).
+static func add_xp(player: Dictionary, n: int) -> int:
+	var st := state(player)
+	if int(st["level"]) >= MAX_LEVEL:
+		return 0
+	st["xp"] = int(st["xp"]) + maxi(0, n)
+	var gained := 0
+	while int(st["level"]) < MAX_LEVEL and int(st["xp"]) >= xp_need(int(st["level"])):
+		st["xp"] = int(st["xp"]) - xp_need(int(st["level"]))
+		st["level"] = int(st["level"]) + 1
+		st["points"] = int(st["points"]) + 1
+		gained += 1
+	if int(st["level"]) >= MAX_LEVEL:
+		st["xp"] = 0
+	return gained
+
+
+## Why a skill can't be learned / raised now ("" - it can).
+static func cant_learn(player: Dictionary, id: String) -> String:
+	var st := state(player)
+	if not SKILLS.has(id):
+		return "No such skill."
+	var r := int(st["ranks"].get(id, 0))
+	if r >= MAX_RANK:
+		return "At its highest rank."
+	if int(st["level"]) < int(SKILLS[id]["level"]):
+		return "Needs level %d." % int(SKILLS[id]["level"])
+	if int(st["points"]) <= 0:
+		return "No skill points - fight to earn a level."
+	return ""
+
+
+## Spends a point: learns the skill, or raises its rank. True if it did.
+static func learn(player: Dictionary, id: String) -> bool:
+	if cant_learn(player, id) != "":
+		return false
+	var st := state(player)
+	st["points"] = int(st["points"]) - 1
+	st["ranks"][id] = int(st["ranks"].get(id, 0)) + 1
+	return true
+
+
+# --- What a rank does --------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func damage_mult(r: int) -> float:
+	return 1.0 + RANK_DAMAGE * maxi(0, r - 1)
+
+
+static func cooldown(id: String, r: int) -> float:
+	return float(SKILLS[id].get("cooldown", 0.0)) * (1.0 - RANK_COOLDOWN * maxi(0, r - 1))
+
+
+static func stamina(id: String) -> float:
+	return float(SKILLS[id].get("stamina", 0.0))
+
+
+## A style's blows at a rank.
+static func chain(id: String, r: int) -> Array:
+	var s: Dictionary = SKILLS[id]
+	var n: int = s["open"][clampi(r, 1, MAX_RANK) - 1]
+	return (s["moves"] as Array).slice(0, n)
+
+
+## A blow's damage at a skill's rank.
+static func blow_damage(move: String, r: int) -> float:
+	return float(MOVES[move]["damage"]) * damage_mult(r)
+
+
+static func reach(id: String, r: int) -> float:
+	var base := float(SKILLS[id].get("range", 0.0))
+	match id:
+		"leap":
+			return base + 45.0 * (int(r >= 2) + int(r >= 4))
+		"comet":
+			return base + 50.0 * (int(r >= 3) + int(r >= 5))
+	return base
+
+
+## A spell's numbers at a rank: {damage, radius, time, soak, count, chains, width...}.
+static func spell(id: String, r: int) -> Dictionary:
+	var s: Dictionary = SKILLS[id]
+	var out := {"damage": float(s.get("damage", 0.0)) * damage_mult(r), "range": reach(id, r)}
+	match id:
+		"lance":
+			out["width"] = 26.0 + 9.0 * (int(r >= 3) + int(r >= 5))
+			out["ticks"] = int(s["ticks"])
+		"phlox":
+			out["radius"] = float(s["radius"]) + 20.0 * (int(r >= 3) + int(r >= 5))
+			out["burn"] = float(s["burn"]) * damage_mult(r)
+			out["burn_time"] = float(s["burn_time"])
+		"keraunos":
+			out["chains"] = r
+			out["stun"] = float(s["stun"])
+			out["chain_range"] = float(s["chain_range"])
+		"aegis":
+			out["soak"] = float(s["soak"]) + 25.0 * (r - 1)
+			out["time"] = float(s["time"]) + 1.0 * (r - 1)
+			out["radius"] = float(s["radius"])
+		"eidola":
+			out["count"] = 1 + int(r >= 3) + int(r >= 5)
+			out["time"] = float(s["time"]) + 2.0 * (int(r >= 2) + int(r >= 4)) + 2.0 * int(r >= 4)
+			out["damage"] = float(s["damage"]) * (1.0 + 0.3 * (int(r >= 2) + int(r >= 4)))
+		"guard":
+			out["soak"] = float(s["soak"]) + 0.05 * (r - 1)
+			out["time"] = float(s["time"]) + 0.4 * (int(r >= 3) + int(r >= 5))
+		"sweep":
+			out["radius"] = 100.0 + 18.0 * (int(r >= 3) + int(r >= 5))
+		"leap":
+			out["shock"] = 0.0 if r < 3 else (14.0 if r < 5 else 34.0)
+	return out
+
+
+## A skill's lines for the Spell Book / a tooltip: what it is, its cost, its ranks
+## (the ones you have marked).
+static func describe(id: String, r: int) -> String:
+	var s: Dictionary = SKILLS[id]
+	var lines := PackedStringArray()
+	lines.append(str(s["desc"]))
+	var cost := "Stamina %s%s" % [str(snappedf(stamina(id), 0.1)).trim_suffix(".0"), " a blow" if s["kind"] == "style" else ""]
+	var cd := cooldown(id, maxi(1, r))
+	if cd > 0.0:
+		cost += "  ·  cooldown %s s" % str(snappedf(cd, 0.1)).trim_suffix(".0")
+	lines.append(cost)
+	for i in MAX_RANK:
+		lines.append("%s Rank %d: %s" % ["●" if i < r else "○", i + 1, s["ranks"][i]])
+	return "\n".join(lines)
+

+static func school_color(id: String) -> Color:
+	var sc := str(SKILLS.get(id, {}).get("school", ""))
+	for s in SCHOOLS:
+		if s[0] == sc:
+			return s[2]
+	return Color.WHITE

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): The automaton's stamina on foot (the green ring outside its shield ring on the surface's health gauge): it runs down as you walk the world - DRAIN a second, COMBAT times faster in a fight (hit lately, or firing) - and comes back when you eat: any Food & drink good you carry (FOOD each) or an Energy Drink (DRINK). Empty, you walk at TIRED_SPEED and your health no longer comes back by itself. Kept with the player ("stamina": PlayerData), so it carries over from one landing to the next.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,35 @@ 
+class_name Stamina
+extends RefCounted
+## The automaton's stamina on foot (the green ring outside its shield ring on
+## the surface's health gauge): it runs down as you walk the world - DRAIN a
+## second, COMBAT times faster in a fight (hit lately, or firing) - and comes
+## back when you eat: any Food & drink good you carry (FOOD each) or an
+## Energy Drink (DRINK). Empty, you walk at TIRED_SPEED and your health no
+## longer comes back by itself. Kept with the player ("stamina": PlayerData),
+## so it carries over from one landing to the next.
+
+const MAX := 100.0
+const DRAIN := MAX / 600.0      # a full ring lasts 10 calm minutes
+const COMBAT := 3.0             # x faster while fighting
+const LOW := 20.0               # the ring's rim turns red below it
+const FOOD := 30.0              # a Food & drink good
+const DRINK := 60.0             # an Energy Drink
+const DRINK_ID := "energy_drink"
+const TIRED_SPEED := 0.6
+const COOLDOWN := 1.5           # s between two meals
+
+
+## How much stamina eating / drinking `id` gives back (0: not food).
+static func restores(id: String) -> float:
+	if id == DRINK_ID:
+		return DRINK
+	return FOOD if is_food(id) else 0.0
+
+
+static func is_food(id: String) -> bool:
+	return id in TradeGoods.CATEGORIES[0][1]
+
+
+## The player's stamina (a save's player dictionary; full if never set).
+static func of(player: Dictionary) -> float:
+	return clampf(float(player.get("stamina", MAX)), 0.0, MAX)

+		"axis": 0.65, "beam": 1.0, "beam_width": 0.16, "beam_wobble": 0.25, "beam_color": Color(0.75, 0.88, 1.0)},
+	"magnetar": {"name": "Magnetar", "disc": 0.12,
+		"c_dark": Color(0.08, 0.1, 0.55), "c_mid": Color(0.3, 0.45, 1.0), "c_hot": Color(0.9, 0.92, 1.0), "c_corona": Color(0.45, 0.45, 1.0),
+		"gran_scale": 6.5, "contrast": 1.3, "filaments": 0.75, "active": 0.5, "spots": 0.0, "limb": -0.2,
+		"corona": 0.6, "glow": 1.0, "prominences": 0.0,
+		"loops": 1.0, "loop_density": 1.5, "loop_extent": 5.0, "loop_color": Color(0.25, 0.55, 1.0), "loop_color2": Color(0.62, 0.35, 1.0),
+		"axis": 0.7, "beam": 1.0, "beam_width": 0.12, "beam_wobble": 0.0, "beam_color": Color(0.72, 0.5, 1.0)},

+		"gran_scale": 4.0, "contrast": 1.3, "filaments": 0.8, "active": 0.55, "spots": 0.1, "limb": 0.35,

+## The editable properties (the zoo's property panel builds itself from

+	["c_hot", "Hot colour", "color", 0, 0, "The hottest granules, active regions and the core.", []],
+	["gran_scale", "Granulation", "float", 1.0, 15.0, "Size of the boiling cells: higher = finer cells.", []],
+	["contrast", "Contrast", "float", 0.3, 2.5, "Contrast between dark lanes and hot cells.", []],
+	["filaments", "Filaments", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "Stringy bright and dark lanes across the surface.", []],
+	["active", "Active regions", "float", 0.0, 1.5, "Bright, sparkling active regions.", []],
+	["spots", "Spots", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "Dark starspots.", []],
+	["banded", "Bands", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "Turbulent latitude bands (a brown dwarf's look).", []],
+	["band_count", "Band count", "float", 2.0, 16.0, "How many bands.", []],
+	["limb", "Limb", "float", -0.6, 0.9, "Limb darkening; negative makes the rim brighter (hot white stars).", []],
+	["#", "Corona"],
+	["c_corona", "Corona colour", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of the glow, corona and rays.", []],
+	["corona", "Corona", "float", 0.0, 2.0, "Brightness of the corona and its rays.", []],
+	["glow", "Glow", "float", 0.0, 2.5, "Brightness of the wide glow.", []],
+	["glow_size", "Glow size", "float", 0.3, 2.5, "How far the glow reaches.", []],
+	["prominences", "Prominences", "float", 0.0, 1.5, "Flaming filaments rising from the limb.", []],
+	["prom_size", "Prominence size", "float", 0.3, 2.0, "How high the prominences reach.", []],
+	["#", "Magnetic field and beams"],
+	["loops", "Field loops", "float", 0.0, 1.5, "Brightness of the magnetic field lines (pulsars, magnetars).", []],
+	["loop_density", "Loop density", "float", 0.3, 3.0, "How many field lines.", []],
+	["loop_extent", "Loop reach", "float", 1.2, 7.0, "How far the field lines reach (in disc radii).", []],
+	["loop_color", "Loop colour", "color", 0, 0, "Main colour of the field lines.", []],
+	["loop_color2", "Loop colour 2", "color", 0, 0, "Second colour (the middle family of lines).", []],
+	["axis", "Magnetic axis", "float", -3.15, 3.15, "Angle of the magnetic axis: the loops and beams follow it.", []],
+	["beam", "Beams", "float", 0.0, 1.5, "Brightness of the twin beams.", []],
+	["beam_width", "Beam width", "float", 0.03, 0.4, "Width of the beams.", []],
+	["beam_wobble", "Precession", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "How far the beams sweep back and forth.", []],
+	["beam_color", "Beam colour", "color", 0, 0, "Colour of the beams.", []],
+]
+## Properties that change the node's size: rebuilt rather than set.
+const STRUCTURAL := ["disc"]
+
+
+## Applies one property to a star node made by make() (live editing).
+static func apply(node: Node, key: String, value: Variant) -> void:
+	var mat: ShaderMaterial = node.material if node is CanvasItem else null
+	if mat:
+		mat.set_shader_parameter(key, value)
+
+
+const MUTATIONS := ["flares", "sunspots", "active regions", "stormy bands", "calm surface", "coarse cells", "fine cells", "faint field loops"]
+const NEUTRON_MUTATIONS := ["wide beams", "dense field", "precessing", "two-tone field", "quiet field"]
+const META := ["name", "template", "variant", "tags", "color"]
+
+
+static func generate(template: String, variant := 0, look := {}) -> Dictionary:
+	var p: Dictionary = TEMPLATES.get(template, TEMPLATES["yellow_sun"]).duplicate()
+	p.merge(look, true)
+	p["template"] = template
+	p["variant"] = variant
+	p["seed"] = float(variant) * 5.17 + float(TEMPLATES.keys().find(template)) * 11.3
+	var tags := []
+	if variant != 0:
+		var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		rng.seed = hash(["star", template, variant])
+		var neutron: bool = template in NEUTRON
+		var list: Array = NEUTRON_MUTATIONS if neutron else MUTATIONS
+		var first := posmod(variant * 3, list.size())
+		tags.append(list[first])
+		while tags.size() < 2:
+			var m = list[rng.randi() % list.size()]
+			if not m in tags and not ((m == "fine cells" and "coarse cells" in tags) or (m == "coarse cells" and "fine cells" in tags)):
+				tags.append(m)
+		for m in tags:
+			_mutate(p, m, rng)
+		p["gran_scale"] = float(p.get("gran_scale", 5.0)) * rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.25)
+		p["filaments"] = clampf(float(p.get("filaments", 0.3)) + rng.randf_range(-0.15, 0.15), 0.0, 1.0)
+		p["tilt"] = rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6)
+		p["spin"] = rng.randf_range(0.01, 0.04) * (1.0 if rng.randf() < 0.7 else -1.0)
+		p["axis"] = rng.randf_range(-1.2, 1.2)
+		# Colour: a small, distinct step in temperature tint per variant.
+		var g: float = fposmod(float(variant) * 0.618034, 1.0) - 0.5
+		var val := rng.randf_range(0.92, 1.08)
+		for k in p:
+			if p[k] is Color:
+				var c: Color = p[k]
+				var dh := g * (0.09 if neutron else 0.05)
+				p[k] = Color.from_hsv(fposmod(c.h + dh, 1.0), clampf(c.s * rng.randf_range(0.9, 1.1), 0.0, 1.0), clampf(c.v * val, 0.0, 1.0))
+	p["tags"] = tags
+	p["color"] = (p["c_mid"] as Color).lerp(p["c_hot"], 0.4)
+	return p
+
+
+static func describe(p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var s: String = p.get("name", "Star")
+	if not p.get("tags", []).is_empty():
+		s += " · " + ", ".join(p["tags"])
+	return s
+
+
+static func _mutate(p: Dictionary, m: String, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> void:
+	match m:
+		"flares":
+			p["prominences"] = rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.1)
+			p["prom_size"] = rng.randf_range(0.9, 1.4)
+		"sunspots":
+			p["spots"] = rng.randf_range(0.5, 0.9)
+		"active regions":
+			p["active"] = rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.1)
+		"stormy bands":
+			p["banded"] = maxf(float(p.get("banded", 0.0)), rng.randf_range(0.35, 0.6))
+			p["band_count"] = rng.randf_range(6.0, 11.0)
+		"calm surface":
+			p["filaments"] = 0.05
+			p["active"] = float(p.get("active", 0.5)) * 0.4
+			p["prominences"] = float(p.get("prominences", 0.5)) * 0.3
+		"coarse cells":
+			p["gran_scale"] = float(p.get("gran_scale", 5.0)) * 0.6
+		"fine cells":
+			p["gran_scale"] = float(p.get("gran_scale", 5.0)) * 1.6
+		"faint field loops":
+			p["loops"] = rng.randf_range(0.25, 0.45)
+			p["loop_extent"] = rng.randf_range(1.6, 2.4)
+			p["loop_color"] = p["c_hot"]
+			p["loop_color2"] = p["c_corona"]
+		"wide beams":
+			p["beam_width"] = rng.randf_range(0.2, 0.3)
+		"dense field":
+			p["loop_density"] = rng.randf_range(1.6, 2.2)
+		"precessing":
+			p["beam_wobble"] = rng.randf_range(0.35, 0.6)
+		"two-tone field":
+			p["loop_color2"] = Color.from_hsv(rng.randf_range(0.72, 0.85), 0.7, 1.0)
+		"quiet field":
+			p["loops"] = rng.randf_range(0.45, 0.65)
+			p["loop_extent"] = rng.randf_range(3.0, 3.8)
+
+
+## A ColorRect showing the star, its disc `radius` px, centred on (0, 0).
+static func make(p: Dictionary, radius: float) -> ColorRect:
+	var rect := ColorRect.new()
+	var disc: float = float(p.get("disc", 0.3))
+	var size := radius / disc * 2.0
+	rect.size = Vector2(size, size)
+	rect.position = -rect.size / 2.0
+	rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	mat.shader = SHADER
+	for k in p:
+		if not k in META:
+			mat.set_shader_parameter(k, p[k])
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("detail", 6 if radius > 200.0 else 5)
+	rect.material = mat
+	return rect

+static func ids_in_branch(branch: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []

+		if TECHS[id]["branch"] == branch:
+			out.append(id)
+	out.sort_custom(func(a, b): return TECHS[a]["tier"] < TECHS[b]["tier"])
+	return out

+
+## The tech this one requires (previous tier in the branch), or "".
+static func prerequisite(id: String) -> String:
+	var t: Dictionary = TECHS[id]

+	for b in BRANCHES:

+			ci.draw_polyline(gem + PackedVector2Array([gem[0]]), ink, 1.3, true)

+			for k in 4:

+		"tablet":

+			for k in 5:

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Trade data for the market screen and the maps: commodity categories, galactic average prices, supply / demand levels and trade routes (buy a good at one station, sell it at another, the profit per unit). Everything reads one price table - every station's buy and sell price of every good - built at most once a second (prices move with the economy tick, every 2 s), so a map asking for routes every redraw costs nothing. A route search over the whole galaxy (~50 stations, 14 goods, every destination within reach) is a few thousand table lookups. (Moved from scripts/trade_routes.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,414 @@ 
+class_name TradeRoutes
+extends RefCounted
+## Trade data for the market screen and the maps: commodity categories,
+## galactic average prices, supply / demand levels and trade routes (buy a
+## good at one station, sell it at another, the profit per unit).
+##
+## Everything reads one price table - every station's buy and sell price of
+## every good - built at most once a second (prices move with the economy
+## tick, every 2 s), so a map asking for routes every redraw costs nothing.
+## A route search over the whole galaxy (~50 stations, 14 goods, every
+## destination within reach) is a few thousand table lookups.
+
+## Commodity groups, in the market's order: [title, [item ids]] - ten of
+## fourteen goods each (TradeGoods; the original goods first in each).
+const CATEGORIES := TradeGoods.CATEGORIES
+## A station only sells a good it has at least this much of.
+const MIN_STOCK := 5.0
+## Routes worth showing: at least this many credits a unit.
+const MIN_PROFIT := 3
+
+static var _table := {}          # station id -> {item -> [buy, sell, stock]}
+
+
+## The price table: Galaxy.price_cache (kept up as the stations tick; the
+## galactic averages are kept with it - Galaxy.average_sell).
+static func table() -> Dictionary:
+	var t: Dictionary = Galaxy.price_cache
+	for sid in Galaxy.stations:
+		if not t.has(sid):
+			Galaxy.cache_prices(sid)
+	_table = t
+	return t
+
+
+## Forget the averages and cached routes (the prices just moved).
+static func invalidate() -> void:
+	_routes_at = -1000000
+	_job = {}
+
+
+static func category_of(item: String) -> String:
+	for cat in CATEGORIES:
+		if item in cat[1]:
+			return cat[0]
+	return "Other"
+
+
+## The galactic average price of a good (what stations pay, on average).
+static func average(item: String) -> int:
+	var a := Galaxy.average_sell(item)
+	return roundi(a if a > 0.0 else float(Items.ITEMS.get(item, {}).get("value", 0)))
+
+
+## Supply at a station, 0..3 bars (0: none to sell).
+static func supply_bars(sid: String, item: String) -> int:
+	var stock: float = Galaxy.stations.get(sid, {}).get("stock", {}).get(item, 0.0)
+	var k := 10.0 if item == "alien_alloy" else 100.0
+	if stock < MIN_STOCK * k / 100.0:
+		return 0
+	if stock < k * 0.35:
+		return 1
+	return 2 if stock < k * 1.6 else 3
+
+
+## Demand at a station, 0..3 bars: only goods the station uses (its economy
+## consumes them), more bars the shorter of them it is.
+static func demand_bars(sid: String, item: String) -> int:
+	var st: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations.get(sid, {})
+	if st.is_empty() or not Galaxy.uses(st["economy"], item):
+		return 0
+	var k := 10.0 if item == "alien_alloy" else 100.0
+	var short := clampf(1.0 - float(st["stock"].get(item, 0.0)) / (k * 1.2), 0.0, 1.0)
+	return 1 + roundi(short * 2.0)
+
+
+## Can the player trade at this station? (Not where its owner considers you an
+## enemy, nor at pirate dens.)
+static func open_to_player(sid: String) -> bool:
+	return not Galaxy.is_hostile_to_player(Galaxy.station_owner(sid))
+
+
+## Jumps from `sys_id` to every system within `max_jumps` (BFS over the gate
+## lanes): system id -> jumps.
+static var _reach := {}   # "<system>|<jumps>" -> reach (the lanes never change)
+
+static func reach(sys_id: String, max_jumps: int) -> Dictionary:
+	var key := "%s|%d" % [sys_id, max_jumps]
+	if _reach.has(key):
+		return _reach[key]
+	var out := {sys_id: 0}
+	var frontier := [sys_id]
+	for j in max_jumps:
+		var next := []
+		for s in frontier:
+			for n in Galaxy.neighbors(s):
+				if not out.has(n):
+					out[n] = j + 1
+					next.append(n)
+		frontier = next
+	_reach[key] = out
+	return out
+
+
+## Only what you know (Galaxy.knows_market / knows_station): a route starts
+## at a station whose market you know (docked there, or its empire is
+## Friendly with you) and ends at one you've found.
+##
+## The best routes starting at the stations `from_sids`: for each starting
+## station and good, the destination (within `max_jumps`) paying the most for
+## it (`other_systems`: only in other systems). `item` "" = every good. Sorted by profit per unit, best first.
+## Each: {item, from, to, from_sys, to_sys, buy, sell, profit, jumps, stock}.
+static func routes_from(from_sids: Array, max_jumps := 2, item := "", limit := 10, other_systems := false) -> Array:
+	var t := table()
+	var out := []
+	var reaches := {}
+	for a in from_sids:
+		if not t.has(a):
+			continue
+		var asys: String = Galaxy.stations[a]["system"]
+		if not open_to_player(a) or not Galaxy.knows_market(a):
+			continue
+		if not reaches.has(asys):
+			reaches[asys] = reach(asys, max_jumps)
+		var r: Dictionary = reaches[asys]
+		for c in t[a]:
+			if item != "" and c != item:
+				continue
+			var here: Array = t[a][c]
+			if here[2] < (MIN_STOCK / 10.0 if c == "alien_alloy" else MIN_STOCK):
+				continue
+			var best := {}
+			for bsys in r:
+				if other_systems and bsys == asys:
+					continue
+				for b in Galaxy.system(bsys).get("stations", []):
+					if b == a or not t.has(b) or not t[b].has(c) or not open_to_player(b) or not Galaxy.knows_station(b):
+						continue
+					var profit: int = t[b][c][1] - here[0]
+					if profit >= MIN_PROFIT and (best.is_empty() or profit > best["profit"]):
+						best = {"item": c, "from": a, "to": b, "from_sys": asys, "to_sys": bsys,
+							"buy": here[0], "sell": t[b][c][1], "profit": profit, "jumps": r[bsys], "stock": int(here[2])}
+			if not best.is_empty():
+				out.append(best)
+	out.sort_custom(func(x, y): return x["profit"] > y["profit"])
+	return out.slice(0, limit)
+
+
+## Every station in these systems.
+static func stations_of(systems: Array) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for s in systems:
+		out.append_array(Galaxy.system(s).get("stations", []))
+	return out
+
+
+## Where a good sells best within `max_jumps` of `sys_id` (excluding the
+## station `except`): [{to, to_sys, sell, jumps}], best first.
+static func best_sellers(item: String, sys_id: String, max_jumps := 2, except := "", limit := 4) -> Array:
+	var t := table()
+	var out := []
+	var r := reach(sys_id, max_jumps)
+	for s in r:
+		for b in Galaxy.system(s).get("stations", []):
+			if b != except and t.has(b) and t[b].has(item) and open_to_player(b) and Galaxy.knows_station(b):
+				out.append({"to": b, "to_sys": s, "sell": t[b][item][1], "jumps": r[s]})
+	out.sort_custom(func(x, y): return x["sell"] > y["sell"])
+	return out.slice(0, limit)
+
+
+## The best route between each pair of systems (from all of `systems`'
+## stations, to any system within `max_jumps`), across systems only:
+## [{route...}], best first, at most `limit` (one per system pair).
+## For each system, the best price for each good it has to sell among the
+## systems within reach (other than itself) first, then each station against
+## that. With ~60 goods a station and every market known that's ~60 ms of
+## work, so it's a job done in steps (_job_step): galaxy_routes() finishes it
+## at once; galaxy_routes_spread() - the map, every frame - does ~1 ms a frame
+## and shows the last finished routes meanwhile. Results are good for 2 s
+## (the economy tick) per good and reach.
+static var _routes_at := -1000000
+static var _routes_key := ""
+static var _routes: Array = []
+static var _job := {}
+const JOB_BUDGET_USEC := 1000
+
+
+## The routes, worked out now (however long it takes).
+static func galaxy_routes(item := "", max_jumps := 2, limit := 8) -> Array:
+	var key := _routes_key_for(item, max_jumps, limit)
+	if key == _routes_key and Time.get_ticks_msec() - _routes_at < 2000:
+		return _routes
+	if _job.is_empty() or _job["key"] != key:
+		_job = _new_job(item, max_jumps, limit, key)
+	while not _job.is_empty():
+		_job_step(1000000000)
+	return _routes
+
+
+## The routes without a long frame: the search goes on a little each call
+## (call it every frame); until it's done, the last finished routes for the
+## same good and reach ([] if there are none yet).
+static func galaxy_routes_spread(item := "", max_jumps := 2, limit := 8) -> Array:
+	var key := _routes_key_for(item, max_jumps, limit)
+	var stale := key != _routes_key or Time.get_ticks_msec() - _routes_at >= 2000
+	if stale and (_job.is_empty() or _job["key"] != key):
+		_job = _new_job(item, max_jumps, limit, key)
+	if not _job.is_empty():
+		_job_step(JOB_BUDGET_USEC)
+	return _routes if _routes_key.get_slice("#", 0) == key.get_slice("#", 0) else []
+
+
+static func _routes_key_for(item: String, max_jumps: int, limit: int) -> String:
+	return "%s|%d|%d#%d" % [item, max_jumps, limit, Galaxy.knowledge]
+
+
+static func _new_job(item: String, max_jumps: int, limit: int, key: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var t: Dictionary = table().duplicate()   # (a snapshot: each station's row is replaced whole, never changed)
+	return {"key": key, "item": item, "max_jumps": max_jumps, "limit": limit, "t": t, "stage": 0, "i": 0,
+		"systems": Galaxy.SYSTEMS.keys(), "sids": t.keys(), "own": {}, "buyable": {}, "best_by": {}, "pairs": {}}
+
+
+## Goes on with the search for `budget` microseconds (it may run a little
+## over: one system or station at a time). Stages: each system's best seller
+## per good; each system's goods worth buying; for each of those systems the
+## best price in reach; each station against that; then the result.
+static func _job_step(budget: int) -> void:
+	var j := _job
+	var t: Dictionary = j["t"]
+	var item: String = j["item"]
+	var until := Time.get_ticks_usec() + budget
+	while Time.get_ticks_usec() < until:
+		match int(j["stage"]):
+			0:   # each system's own best seller per good
+				if j["i"] >= j["systems"].size():
+					j["stage"] = 1
+					j["i"] = 0
+					continue
+				var y: String = j["systems"][j["i"]]
+				j["i"] += 1
+				var row := {}
+				for b in Galaxy.system(y).get("stations", []):
+					if not t.has(b) or not open_to_player(b) or not Galaxy.knows_station(b):
+						continue
+					var tb: Dictionary = t[b]
+					for c in ([item] if item != "" else tb.keys()):
+						if not tb.has(c):
+							continue   # (a good this station doesn't deal in)
+						var sell: int = tb[c][1]
+						if not row.has(c) or sell > row[c][0]:
+							row[c] = [sell, b]
+				j["own"][y] = row
+			1:   # the goods worth buying in each system (known, open stations' stock)
+				if j["i"] >= j["sids"].size():
+					j["stage"] = 2
+					j["i"] = 0
+					j["xs"] = j["buyable"].keys()
+					continue
+				var a: String = j["sids"][j["i"]]
+				j["i"] += 1
+				if not Galaxy.stations.has(a) or not open_to_player(a) or not Galaxy.knows_market(a):
+					continue
+				var set: Dictionary = j["buyable"].get_or_add(Galaxy.stations[a]["system"], {})
+				var ta: Dictionary = t[a]
+				for c in ta:
+					if (item == "" or c == item) and ta[c][2] >= (MIN_STOCK / 10.0 if c == "alien_alloy" else MIN_STOCK):
+						set[c] = true
+			2:   # for each such system, the best price for its goods within reach
+				if j["i"] >= j["xs"].size():
+					j["stage"] = 3
+					j["i"] = 0
+					continue
+				var x: String = j["xs"][j["i"]]
+				j["i"] += 1
+				var row := {}
+				var r := reach(x, j["max_jumps"])
+				var wanted: Array = j["buyable"][x].keys()
+				for y in r:
+					if y == x:
+						continue
+					var oy: Dictionary = j["own"].get(y, {})
+					for c in wanted:
+						if oy.has(c) and (not row.has(c) or oy[c][0] > row[c][0]):
+							row[c] = [oy[c][0], oy[c][1], y, r[y]]
+				j["best_by"][x] = row
+			3:   # each station against the best price in reach: the best run per pair of systems
+				if j["i"] >= j["sids"].size():
+					j["stage"] = 4
+					return   # (the sort and the result: a frame of their own)
+				var a: String = j["sids"][j["i"]]
+				j["i"] += 1
+				if not Galaxy.stations.has(a):
+					continue
+				var asys: String = Galaxy.stations[a]["system"]
+				var row: Dictionary = j["best_by"].get(asys, {})
+				if row.is_empty() or not open_to_player(a) or not Galaxy.knows_market(a):
+					continue
+				var ta: Dictionary = t[a]
+				for c in row:
+					if not ta.has(c):
+						continue
+					var here: Array = ta[c]
+					if here[2] < (MIN_STOCK / 10.0 if c == "alien_alloy" else MIN_STOCK):
+						continue
+					var profit: int = row[c][0] - here[0]
+					if profit < MIN_PROFIT:
+						continue
+					var k: String = asys + ">" + row[c][2]
+					if not j["pairs"].has(k) or profit > j["pairs"][k][0]:
+						j["pairs"][k] = [profit, a, c, row[c]]
+			4:
+				_job_finish()
+				return
+
+
+static func _job_finish() -> void:
+	var j := _job
+	var t: Dictionary = j["t"]
+	var pairs: Dictionary = j["pairs"]
+	var keys: Array = pairs.keys()
+	keys.sort_custom(func(x, y): return pairs[x][0] > pairs[y][0])
+	var out := []
+	for k in keys.slice(0, j["limit"]):
+		var p: Array = pairs[k]
+		var a: String = p[1]
+		var c: String = p[2]
+		var best: Array = p[3]
+		out.append({"item": c, "from": a, "to": best[1], "from_sys": Galaxy.stations[a]["system"], "to_sys": best[2],
+			"buy": t[a][c][0], "sell": best[0], "profit": p[0], "jumps": best[3], "stock": int(t[a][c][2])})
+	_routes_key = j["key"]
+	_routes_at = Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	_routes = out
+	_job = {}
+
+
+static func station_name(sid: String) -> String:
+	return Galaxy.stations.get(sid, {}).get("name", "?")
+
+
+static func system_name(sys_id: String) -> String:
+	return Galaxy.SYSTEMS.get(sys_id, {}).get("name", "?")
+
+
+# --- Drawing (the maps) --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+const RUN_COLOR := Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55)
+
+
+## A trade run along `pts` (screen points, start to end): a glowing line,
+## chevrons streaming toward the end (`t`: seconds, animates them) and an
+## arrowhead. `k` 0..1: how good the run is (brighter, thicker).
+static func draw_run(ci: CanvasItem, pts: PackedVector2Array, k: float, t: float) -> void:
+	if pts.size() < 2:
+		return
+	var col := RUN_COLOR.lerp(Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.4), clampf(k, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.5)
+	var w := 1.5 + 2.5 * k
+	ci.draw_polyline(pts, Color(col, 0.16), w * 4.0, true)
+	ci.draw_polyline(pts, Color(col, 0.9), w, true)
+	# Chevrons every 28 px, sliding along.
+	var total := 0.0
+	for i in pts.size() - 1:
+		total += pts[i].distance_to(pts[i + 1])
+	var gap := 28.0
+	var d := fposmod(t * 40.0, gap)
+	while d < total - 14.0:
+		var at := _along(pts, d)
+		_chevron(ci, at[0], at[1], 5.0 + w, Color(col, 0.95))
+		d += gap
+	var end := pts[-1]
+	var dir := (pts[-1] - pts[-2]).normalized()
+	var s := 9.0 + w * 1.5
+	ci.draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([end, end - dir * s + dir.orthogonal() * s * 0.6, end - dir * s - dir.orthogonal() * s * 0.6]), col)
+
+
+static func _along(pts: PackedVector2Array, d: float) -> Array:
+	for i in pts.size() - 1:
+		var l := pts[i].distance_to(pts[i + 1])
+		if d <= l:
+			var dir := (pts[i + 1] - pts[i]) / maxf(l, 0.001)
+			return [pts[i] + dir * d, dir]
+		d -= l
+	return [pts[-1], (pts[-1] - pts[-2]).normalized()]
+
+
+static func _chevron(ci: CanvasItem, at: Vector2, dir: Vector2, s: float, col: Color) -> void:
+	var n := dir.orthogonal()
+	ci.draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([at - dir * s * 0.5 + n * s * 0.6, at + dir * s * 0.4, at - dir * s * 0.5 - n * s * 0.6]), col, 2.0, true)
+
+
+## A small label box (a run's good and profit) centred on `at` - moved down
+## (or up) out of the way of the boxes already in `taken` (it joins them).
+static func draw_tag(ci: CanvasItem, at: Vector2, text: String, fs: int, taken: Array = []) -> void:
+	var font := NeonTheme.heavy_font()
+	var sz := font.get_string_size(text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs)
+	var r := Rect2(at - Vector2(sz.x / 2.0 + 6.0, fs * 0.5 + 3.0), Vector2(sz.x + 12.0, fs + 6.0))
+	var start := r.position
+	for i in 12:
+		var hit := false
+		for o in taken:
+			if r.grow(2.0).intersects(o):
+				hit = true
+				break
+		if not hit:
+			break
+		var k := (i / 2 + 1) * (1 if i % 2 == 0 else -1)
+		r.position = start + Vector2(0, k * (fs + 9.0))
+	taken.append(r)
+	ci.draw_rect(r, Color(0.0, 0.05, 0.02, 0.85))
+	ci.draw_rect(r, Color(RUN_COLOR, 0.7), false, 1.0)
+	ci.draw_string(font, Vector2(r.position.x + 6.0, r.position.y + fs * 0.85 + 2.0), text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, RUN_COLOR.lightened(0.3))
+
+
+## "FOOD +23" - a run's tag.
+static func tag_text(r: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return "%s +%d" % [Items.display_name(r["item"]).to_upper(), r["profit"]]

files.explanation: The game's rules and data (no visuals): Component upgrades: every part of the ship and the automaton carries stats that can be raised, up to MAX_LEVEL levels each (STATS: some fifty, from hull and shields to accuracy, critical hits, every resistance, fuel use and mining yield). An upgrade lives in its part: while the part is damaged its upgrades give only as much as it works (Parts.working). Bought at a station's repair service (UPGRADES) or fitted on board from a manufactured Upgrade Kit (Industry: Manufacturing). The levels: the player's "upgrades" {"ship": {"<part>:<stat>": level}, "automaton": {...}}. Upgrades.mod(data.upgrades, data.condition, "ship", "accuracy") (Moved from scripts/upgrades.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,138 @@ 
+class_name Upgrades
+extends RefCounted
+## Component upgrades: every part of the ship and the automaton carries stats
+## that can be raised, up to MAX_LEVEL levels each (STATS: some fifty, from
+## hull and shields to accuracy, critical hits, every resistance, fuel use and
+## mining yield). An upgrade lives in its part: while the part is damaged its
+## upgrades give only as much as it works (Parts.working). Bought at a
+## station's repair service (UPGRADES) or fitted on board from a manufactured
+## Upgrade Kit (Industry: Manufacturing).
+## The levels: the player's "upgrades" {"ship": {"<part>:<stat>": level}, "automaton": {...}}.
+##   Upgrades.mod(data.upgrades, data.condition, "ship", "accuracy")
+
+const MAX_LEVEL := 5
+const PRICE_GROWTH := 1.7
+
+## body -> part -> [[stat key, name, per level, base price, how it shows ("%", "+", "-%", "s")]]
+const STATS := {
+	"ship": {
+		"sensors": [["accuracy", "Accuracy", 0.02, 900, "%"], ["range_mult", "Weapon range", 0.04, 800, "%"],
+			["crit_chance", "Critical chance", 0.02, 1100, "%"], ["probe_strength", "Probe strength", 0.12, 900, "%"], ["mining_yield", "Ore yield", 0.08, 700, "%"]],
+		"weapons": [["damage_mult", "Weapon damage", 0.04, 1200, "%"], ["fire_rate_mult", "Rate of fire", -0.03, 1100, "-%"],
+			["crit_mult", "Critical damage", 0.12, 900, "%"], ["mining_speed", "Mining speed", 0.08, 700, "%"]],
+		"reactor": [["shield_regen_mult", "Shield recharge", 0.08, 900, "%"], ["hull_regen", "Hull self-repair", 0.15, 1000, "+/s"],
+			["afterburner_cd_mult", "System cooldowns", -0.06, 800, "-%"], ["refine_speed", "Refinery speed", 0.1, 700, "%"]],
+		"shields": [["max_shields", "Shield strength", 12.0, 900, "+"], ["regen_delay", "Shield recharge delay", -0.3, 800, "s"],
+			["resist_energy", "Energy resistance", 0.03, 800, "%"], ["resist_beam", "Beam resistance", 0.03, 800, "%"]],
+		"thrusters": [["handling_mult", "Handling", 0.05, 800, "%"], ["evasion", "Evasion", 0.02, 1000, "%"]],
+		"engines": [["speed_mult", "Top speed", 0.04, 1000, "%"], ["fuel_efficiency", "Fuel efficiency", 0.06, 700, "%"]],
+		"fuel": [["fuel_capacity", "Fuel tank", 15.0, 600, "+"], ["cargo", "Hold space", 4.0, 900, "slot"]],
+		"plating": [["max_hull", "Hull strength", 15.0, 900, "+"], ["hull_taken_mult", "Armour", -0.03, 1000, "-%"],
+			["resist_kinetic", "Kinetic resistance", 0.03, 800, "%"], ["resist_explosive", "Explosive resistance", 0.03, 800, "%"],
+			["resist_heat", "Heat resistance", 0.03, 700, "%"], ["resist_cold", "Cold resistance", 0.03, 700, "%"],
+			["resist_electric", "Electric resistance", 0.03, 800, "%"]],
+	},
+	"automaton": {
+		"optics": [["accuracy", "Accuracy", 0.02, 500, "%"], ["range_mult", "Weapon reach", 0.04, 450, "%"], ["crit_chance", "Critical chance", 0.02, 600, "%"]],
+		"core": [["max_hp", "Health", 10.0, 500, "+"], ["regen_mult", "Healing", 0.1, 450, "%"], ["overcharge_mult", "Overcharge time", 0.1, 400, "%"]],
+		"arms": [["damage_mult", "Damage", 0.04, 600, "%"], ["fire_rate_mult", "Rate of fire", -0.03, 550, "-%"], ["crit_mult", "Critical damage", 0.12, 450, "%"]],
+		"cooling": [["resist_heat", "Heat resistance", 0.03, 400, "%"], ["resist_cold", "Cold resistance", 0.03, 400, "%"], ["resist_energy", "Energy resistance", 0.03, 450, "%"]],
+		"legs": [["speed_mult", "Walking speed", 0.04, 500, "%"], ["evasion", "Evasion", 0.02, 550, "%"]],
+		"frame": [["hurt_taken_mult", "Armour", -0.03, 550, "-%"], ["resist_kinetic", "Kinetic resistance", 0.03, 450, "%"],
+			["resist_explosive", "Explosive resistance", 0.03, 450, "%"], ["resist_electric", "Electric resistance", 0.03, 450, "%"],
+			["resist_beam", "Beam resistance", 0.03, 450, "%"]],
+	},
+}
+## Critical hits: a shot's chance to strike a weak spot (no upgrades: CRIT_BASE) for CRIT_MULT x damage.
+const CRIT_BASE := 0.04
+const CRIT_MULT := 1.6
+
+
+## Every stat a body's parts carry: [{part, key, name, per, price, fmt, id ("<part>:<key>")}].
+static func list(which: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for pid in STATS[which]:
+		for st in STATS[which][pid]:
+			out.append({"part": pid, "key": st[0], "name": st[1], "per": st[2], "price": st[3], "fmt": st[4], "id": "%s:%s" % [pid, st[0]]})
+	return out
+
+
+static func find(which: String, id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	for st in list(which):
+		if st["id"] == id:
+			return st
+	return {}
+
+
+## A stat's level now.
+static func level(ups: Variant, which: String, id: String) -> int:
+	if not ups is Dictionary or not (ups as Dictionary).get(which) is Dictionary:
+		return 0
+	return int(ups[which].get(id, 0))
+
+
+## The price of its next level (0 at the top).
+static func price(which: String, id: String, lvl: int) -> int:
+	var st := find(which, id)
+	if st.is_empty() or lvl >= MAX_LEVEL:
+		return 0
+	return snappedi(roundi(float(st["price"]) * pow(PRICE_GROWTH, lvl)), 10)
+
+
+## Raises a stat a level (the levels in `ups`, made if missing). False at the top.
+static func raise(ups: Dictionary, which: String, id: String) -> bool:
+	if find(which, id).is_empty():
+		return false
+	if not ups.get(which) is Dictionary:
+		ups[which] = {}
+	var l := int(ups[which].get(id, 0))
+	if l >= MAX_LEVEL:
+		return false
+	ups[which][id] = l + 1
+	return true
+
+
+## The sum of a stat over a body's upgraded parts, each times how well its part works.
+static func mod(ups: Variant, cond: Variant, which: String, key: String) -> float:
+	if not ups is Dictionary or not (ups as Dictionary).get(which) is Dictionary:
+		return 0.0
+	var total := 0.0
+	var levels: Dictionary = ups[which]
+	for id in levels:
+		var l := int(levels[id])
+		if l <= 0 or str(id).get_slice(":", 1) != key:
+			continue
+		var pid := str(id).get_slice(":", 0)
+		var st := find(which, str(id))
+		if st.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var work := Parts.working(cond, which, pid) if cond is Dictionary else 1.0
+		total += float(st["per"]) * l * work
+	return total
+
+
+## Every upgraded stat's total ({key: value}) - for the automaton's gear effects.
+static func effects(ups: Variant, cond: Variant, which: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	for st in list(which):
+		if level(ups, which, st["id"]) > 0:
+			out[st["key"]] = mod(ups, cond, which, st["key"])
+	return out
+
+
+## A value of a stat in words ("+6%", "-0.6 s", "+30").
+static func words(st: Dictionary, v: float) -> String:
+	match str(st["fmt"]):
+		"%": return "%+d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"-%": return "%d%%" % roundi(v * 100.0)
+		"s": return "%+.1f s" % v
+		"+/s": return "%+.2f /s" % v
+		"slot": return "%+d slot%s" % [roundi(v / Shipyard.RACK_UNITS_PER_SLOT), "" if roundi(v / Shipyard.RACK_UNITS_PER_SLOT) == 1 else "s"]
+	return "%+d" % roundi(v)
+
+
+## A shot's damage with a chance of a critical hit (`crit_chance` / `crit_mult` added to the base). [damage, critical?]
+static func crit(dmg: float, chance_add: float, mult_add: float) -> Array:
+	if randf() < CRIT_BASE + chance_add:
+		return [dmg * (CRIT_MULT + mult_add), true]
+	return [dmg, false]

Looked at four times a second; rebuilt only when they change. `source` gives the condition (PlayerData's / the surface's). var bar := AfflictionBar.new(); bar.which = "ship"; bar.source = func(): return data.condition (Moved from scripts/affliction_bar.gd.)

@@ -1,0 +1,123 @@ 
+class_name AfflictionBar
+extends HBoxContainer
+## The afflictions under the health bar (the space HUD's hull, the surface
+## HUD's health): an icon each (Parts.afflictions) - the frozen self-repair
+## first, then each damaged part, the worst first - its tooltip what it does
+## and what's wrong in it. Looked at four times a second; rebuilt only when
+## they change. `source` gives the condition (PlayerData's / the surface's).
+##   var bar := AfflictionBar.new(); bar.which = "ship"; bar.source = func(): return data.condition
+
+var which := "ship"
+var source: Callable
+const ICON := 26.0
+var _sig := "-"   # (not yet looked: the first refresh always sets it up)
+var _t := 0.0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t -= delta
+	if _t > 0.0:
+		return
+	_t = 0.25
+	refresh()
+
+
+func refresh() -> void:
+	if not source.is_valid():
+		return
+	var cond = source.call()
+	var list: Array = Parts.afflictions(cond, which) if cond is Dictionary else []
+	var sig := ",".join(list.map(func(a): return "%s:%d" % [a["id"], roundi(float(a["loss"]) * 20.0)]))
+	if sig == _sig:
+		return
+	_sig = sig
+	for c in get_children():
+		c.queue_free()
+	for a in list:
+		add_child(icon_for(a, which))
+	visible = not list.is_empty()
+
+
+## One affliction's badge (Parts.afflictions' entry), with its tooltip - the bar's, and HealthGauge's round its circle.
+static func icon_for(a: Dictionary, which_: String) -> Control:
+	var ic := Icon.new()
+	ic.which = which_
+	ic.id = a["id"]
+	ic.loss = a["loss"]
+	ic.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(ICON, ICON)
+	ic.size = Vector2(ICON, ICON)
+	ic.tooltip_text = "%s\n%s\nRepair it: the Repair Bay (%s > Repair), or a station's repair service." % [a["name"], a["desc"],
+		"Ship Computer" if which_ == "ship" else "Field Computer / Ship Computer"]
+	return ic
+
+
+## One affliction's badge: a glyph for its part (or the frozen self-repair), amber to red by how bad.
+class Icon extends Control:
+	var which := "ship"
+	var id := ""
+	var loss := 0.5
+	var _t := 0.0
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+
+	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+		if loss > 0.6:   # (a bad one throbs)
+			_t += delta
+			if UI.redraw_due(self, 20.0):
+				queue_redraw()
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		var r := Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size)
+		var c := size * 0.5
+		var s := minf(size.x, size.y) * 0.5
+		var col := Color(1.0, 0.78, 0.25).lerp(Color(1.0, 0.25, 0.2), clampf(loss, 0.0, 1.0))
+		if id == "regen":
+			col = Color(0.45, 0.8, 1.0)
+		var a := 1.0 if loss <= 0.6 else 0.75 + 0.25 * sin(_t * 6.0)
+		draw_rect(r, Color(0.04, 0.03, 0.03, 0.85))
+		draw_rect(r, Color(col, 0.22 * a))
+		draw_rect(r.grow(-0.5), Color(col, a), false, 1.5)
+		var g := Color(col.lightened(0.35), a)
+		var w := maxf(1.5, s * 0.14)
+		match id:
+			"regen":   # a cross (repair) with a snowflake's bar through it: frozen
+				draw_line(c + Vector2(0, -s * 0.6), c + Vector2(0, s * 0.6), g, w * 1.4)
+				draw_line(c + Vector2(-s * 0.6, 0), c + Vector2(s * 0.6, 0), g, w * 1.4)
+				for k in 3:
+					var d := Vector2.from_angle(PI / 6.0 + k * PI / 3.0) * s * 0.55
+					draw_line(c - d, c + d, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8 * a), w * 0.6)
+			"engines", "legs":   # a nozzle / a leg: down-pointing chevrons (speed)
+				for k in 2:
+					var y := c.y - s * 0.35 + k * s * 0.42
+					draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(-s * 0.5, y - c.y), c + Vector2(0, y - c.y + s * 0.35), c + Vector2(s * 0.5, y - c.y)]), g, w)
+			"thrusters":
+				draw_arc(c, s * 0.5, -PI * 0.9, PI * 0.4, 12, g, w)
+				draw_line(c + Vector2.from_angle(PI * 0.4) * s * 0.5, c + Vector2.from_angle(PI * 0.4) * s * 0.5 + Vector2(-s * 0.3, 0), g, w)
+			"shields":
+				draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(-s * 0.5, -s * 0.5), c + Vector2(s * 0.5, -s * 0.5), c + Vector2(s * 0.45, s * 0.1), c + Vector2(0, s * 0.6),
+					c + Vector2(-s * 0.45, s * 0.1), c + Vector2(-s * 0.5, -s * 0.5)]), g, w)
+				draw_line(c + Vector2(-s * 0.3, -s * 0.2), c + Vector2(s * 0.2, s * 0.3), g, w)
+			"weapons", "arms":   # crosshair
+				draw_arc(c, s * 0.45, 0, TAU, 16, g, w)
+				for d in [Vector2.UP, Vector2.DOWN, Vector2.LEFT, Vector2.RIGHT]:
+					draw_line(c + d * s * 0.25, c + d * s * 0.65, g, w)
+			"sensors", "optics":   # an eye
+				draw_arc(c + Vector2(0, s * 0.35), s * 0.6, -PI * 0.8, -PI * 0.2, 10, g, w)
+				draw_arc(c - Vector2(0, s * 0.35), s * 0.6, PI * 0.2, PI * 0.8, 10, g, w)
+				draw_circle(c, s * 0.18, g)
+			"reactor", "core":   # a heart / a power cell: a bolt
+				draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(s * 0.1, -s * 0.65), c + Vector2(-s * 0.3, s * 0.05), c + Vector2(s * 0.15, s * 0.05), c + Vector2(-s * 0.1, s * 0.65)]), g, w)
+			"fuel", "cooling":   # a drop
+				draw_arc(c + Vector2(0, s * 0.15), s * 0.38, -PI * 0.15, PI * 1.15, 12, g, w)
+				draw_line(c + Vector2(-s * 0.36, s * 0.05), c + Vector2(0, -s * 0.6), g, w)
+				draw_line(c + Vector2(s * 0.36, s * 0.05), c + Vector2(0, -s * 0.6), g, w)
+			_:   # plating, frame: a cracked plate
+				draw_rect(Rect2(c - Vector2(s * 0.5, s * 0.5), Vector2(s, s)), g, false, w)
+				draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(-s * 0.1, -s * 0.5), c + Vector2(s * 0.1, -s * 0.1), c + Vector2(-s * 0.05, s * 0.15), c + Vector2(s * 0.15, s * 0.5)]), g, w * 0.8)
