files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The automaton's anatomy, for its operating table (Surgery): four pictures of the whole body - its muscles, its vessels and heart, its nerves with the brain and the spinal cord, its skeleton - each modelled and rendered in Blender (external/blender/anatomy/build.py) from the front, the body lying with its head to the LEFT. They're big (4096 x 1848, 10 MB each compressed on the card), so they load in the background, one at a time (pump()), and tex() gives null until one is in. They're asked for at the TITLE SCREEN (MainMenu): the second big picture to reach the card costs one long frame (~90 ms, once a run - the driver making room; measured: the first and all later ones ~1 ms) - there, not in play. The Repair Bay's Surgery pumps too (a game started without the title: tests, a scene run directly). The body's own coordinates (Parts' automaton components): metres, x across (+ its left side - the picture's top) and z up from the soles (the crown at 1.80 - the picture's left). px() turns them into a picture's pixels. (Moved from scripts/anatomy_art.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,119 @@ 
+class_name AnatomyArt
+extends RefCounted
+## The automaton's anatomy, for its operating table (Surgery): four pictures
+## of the whole body - its muscles, its vessels and heart, its nerves with the
+## brain and the spinal cord, its skeleton - each modelled and rendered in
+## Blender (external/blender/anatomy/build.py) from the front, the body lying
+## with its head to the LEFT. They're big (4096 x 1848, 10 MB each compressed
+## on the card), so they load in the background, one at a time (pump()), and
+## tex() gives null until one is in. They're asked for at the TITLE SCREEN
+## (MainMenu): the second big picture to reach the card costs one long frame
+## (~90 ms, once a run - the driver making room; measured: the first and all
+## later ones ~1 ms) - there, not in play. The Repair Bay's Surgery pumps too
+## (a game started without the title: tests, a scene run directly).
+##
+## The body's own coordinates (Parts' automaton components): metres, x across
+## (+ its left side - the picture's top) and z up from the soles (the crown at
+## 1.80 - the picture's left). px() turns them into a picture's pixels.
+
+const DIR := "res://art/anatomy/"
+const SIZE := Vector2(4096, 1848)
+## Pixels a metre, and the picture's left edge (z) and top edge (x): build.py's PPM, Z_HI, X_HI.
+const PPM := 2100.0
+const Z_HI := 0.845 + 4096.0 / 2100.0 / 2.0
+const X_HI := 1848.0 / 2100.0 / 2.0
+
+## In a web build (phones among them) the pictures are half the size (art/anatomy/web/:
+## 2048 px, 2.5 MB each on the card instead of 10 - the full ones aren't in that build).
+## SIZE stays the body's frame: region() scales a rectangle in it to the picture's pixels.
+static func path(layer: String) -> String:
+	return DIR + ("web/" if OS.has_feature("web") else "") + layer + ".png"
+
+
+## A rectangle in SIZE's pixels as the loaded picture's pixels (the same on the full ones).
+static func region(r: Rect2) -> Rect2:
+	var t: Texture2D = _tex.get("muscles")
+	if t == null or t.get_width() == int(SIZE.x):
+		return r
+	var k := float(t.get_width()) / SIZE.x
+	return Rect2(r.position * k, r.size * k)
+
+
+static var _tex := {}       # layer -> Texture2D
+static var _loading := ""   # the layer being loaded now
+static var _wanted := false
+static var _rest := 0       # frames to leave between two pictures
+
+
+## Ask for the pictures (they come in over the next frames: pump()).
+static func warm() -> void:
+	_wanted = true
+
+
+## Moves the loading on: call every frame while the pictures may be wanted
+## (the Repair Bay's Surgery does). One picture at a time, a few frames apart.
+static func pump() -> void:
+	if not _wanted:
+		return
+	if _loading != "":
+		if ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path(_loading)) == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_LOADED:
+			_tex[_loading] = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(path(_loading))
+			_pool(_loading)
+			_loading = ""
+			_rest = 6
+		return
+	if _rest > 0:
+		_rest -= 1
+		return
+	for l in Parts.LAYERS:
+		if not _tex.has(l) and ResourceLoader.exists(path(l)):
+			_loading = l
+			ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path(l))
+			return
+	_wanted = false   # (all in)
+
+
+## What the four take on the card (bytes; compressed, a byte a pixel - half the size each way on the web).
+static func expected_bytes() -> int:
+	var k := 0.25 if OS.has_feature("web") else 1.0
+	return int(SIZE.x * SIZE.y * k) * Parts.LAYERS.size()
+
+
+## In the memory pool - pinned (one costs a long frame to load again: never unloaded).
+static func _pool(l: String) -> void:
+	var t: Texture2D = _tex.get(l)
+	if t:
+		AssetPool.add("anatomy_" + l, t.get_width() * t.get_height(), Callable(), Callable(), true, "Anatomy: " + l)
+
+
+## A layer's picture - null while it's still on its way (never waits for it).
+static func tex(layer: String) -> Texture2D:
+	return _tex.get(layer)
+
+
+## Every layer in (the table can be drawn whole)?
+static func ready() -> bool:
+	for l in Parts.LAYERS:
+		if not _tex.has(l):
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+## All of them now (waits: tests, the doc shots).
+static func load_now() -> void:
+	for l in Parts.LAYERS:
+		if not _tex.has(l) and ResourceLoader.exists(path(l)):
+			_tex[l] = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(path(l)) if _loading == l else load(path(l))
+			_pool(l)
+	_loading = ""
+	_wanted = false
+
+
+## The body's (x, z) in metres -> a picture's pixel.
+static func px(x: float, z: float) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2((Z_HI - z) * PPM, (X_HI - x) * PPM)
+
+
+## The way a structure runs (degrees: 0 along the body, 90 across it) as a direction in the picture.
+static func axis(deg: float) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2.from_angle(deg_to_rad(deg))

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The Archive: all of the game's documentation in one place - a shelf of books, one browser for them all: - Pilot's Guide (data/docs/game.md), Tutorial (data/docs/tutorial.md) and the Talos Manual (data/docs/editor.md) - chapters and sections in the docs' Markdown subset (EditorDocs); - the Encyclopedia (Encyclopedia: what you've discovered, with its picture); - Controls (every action and the keys bound to it now - Keybinds); - Versions (each version of the game and its patches - data/patches). On the left: the title, a search across every book, the shelf and the open book's contents; on the right: where you are (book, chapter), the page, its picture and the pages before and after. Links ([..](doc:id)) go anywhere - another book's page too; Back / Forward (Alt + arrows, the mouse's side buttons) like a web browser. It's a tab of the Ship Computer and the Field Computer (embedded), and a window over anything else: F1, the Guide buttons, the tooltips' documentation links, the main menu (Archive.open). (Moved from scripts/archive.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,688 @@ 
+class_name Archive
+extends HBoxContainer
+## The Archive: all of the game's documentation in one place - a shelf of
+## books, one browser for them all:
+##   - Pilot's Guide (data/docs/game.md), Tutorial (data/docs/tutorial.md) and
+##     the Talos Manual (data/docs/editor.md) - chapters and sections in the
+##     docs' Markdown subset (EditorDocs);
+##   - the Encyclopedia (Encyclopedia: what you've discovered, with its picture);
+##   - Controls (every action and the keys bound to it now - Keybinds);
+##   - Versions (each version of the game and its patches - data/patches).
+## On the left: the title, a search across every book, the shelf and the open
+## book's contents; on the right: where you are (book, chapter), the page, its
+## picture and the pages before and after. Links ([..](doc:id)) go anywhere -
+## another book's page too; Back / Forward (Alt + arrows, the mouse's side
+## buttons) like a web browser. It's a tab of the Ship Computer and the Field
+## Computer (embedded), and a window over anything else: F1, the Guide
+## buttons, the tooltips' documentation links, the main menu (Archive.open).
+
+## The shelf. `file`: a docs Markdown book (EditorDocs); the others are made here.
+const BOOKS := [
+	{"id": "guide", "title": "Pilot's Guide", "icon": "ui_guide", "file": "res://data/docs/game.md",
+		"blurb": "How everything works: flying, fighting, stations, the computers, planets."},
+	{"id": "tutorial", "title": "Tutorial", "icon": "help", "file": "res://data/docs/tutorial.md",
+		"blurb": "First steps, lesson by lesson, in the order you'll need them."},
+	{"id": "encyclopedia", "title": "Encyclopedia", "icon": "ui_codex",
+		"blurb": "Ships, stations, gear, worlds and the lore of ancient Greece - what you've discovered."},
+	{"id": "controls", "title": "Controls", "icon": "key",
+		"blurb": "Every action and the keys and buttons bound to it now."},
+	{"id": "versions", "title": "Versions", "icon": "patch",
+		"blurb": "What each version of the game brought, patch by patch."},
+	{"id": "talos", "title": "Talos Manual", "icon": "docs", "file": "res://data/docs/editor.md",
+		"blurb": "The game's editor: data, sprites, the Library, scenarios, levels, SVG."},
+]
+
+## The page contract of the computers' tabs (set before it's added).
+var data: Node
+var ship: Node2D
+var surface: Node
+## Shown as a window of its own (Archive.open) rather than a computer's tab.
+var windowed := false
+signal close_requested
+
+var book := "guide"
+var _current := ""            # "book/page"
+var _back: Array = []
+var _forward: Array = []
+var _shelf := {}              # book id -> its button
+var _toc: Tree
+var _items := {}              # page -> TreeItem
+var _search: LineEdit
+var _crumb: RichTextLabel
+var _title: Label
+var _text: RichTextLabel
+var _foot: RichTextLabel
+var _pic_box: PanelContainer
+var _pic: Encyclopedia.Preview
+var _back_btn: Button
+var _fwd_btn: Button
+var _enc := {}                # encyclopedia page -> entry
+var _enc_cats: Array = []
+var _versions: Array = []     # [{id, title, date, summary, patches: [patch...]}]
+var _built := false
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
+	size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	# Left: title, search, shelf, contents.
+	var left := VBoxContainer.new()
+	left.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(360, 0)
+	left.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	add_child(left)
+	var head := Label.new()
+	head.text = "THE ARCHIVE"
+	head.add_theme_font_override("font", NeonTheme.heavy_font())
+	head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 26)
+	head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	left.add_child(head)
+	left.add_child(UI.label("Every book of the game in one place.", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	_search = LineEdit.new()
+	_search.placeholder_text = "Search every book..."
+	_search.clear_button_enabled = true
+	_search.text_changed.connect(func(_t): _fill_toc())
+	_search.tooltip_text = "Finds pages in every book whose text has all these words."
+	left.add_child(_search)
+	var shelf := GridContainer.new()
+	shelf.columns = 2
+	shelf.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 6)
+	shelf.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 6)
+	for b in BOOKS:
+		var btn := EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", open_book.bind(b["id"]), 15), b["icon"], "%s\n%s" % [b["title"], b["blurb"]], b["title"])
+		btn.toggle_mode = true
+		btn.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
+		btn.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 40)
+		btn.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+		shelf.add_child(btn)
+		_shelf[b["id"]] = btn
+	left.add_child(shelf)
+	_toc = Tree.new()
+	_toc.hide_root = true
+	_toc.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_toc.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 360)
+	_toc.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	_toc.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
+	_toc.item_selected.connect(func():
+		var it := _toc.get_selected()
+		if it and str(it.get_metadata(0)) != "" and str(it.get_metadata(0)) != _current:
+			show_page.call_deferred(str(it.get_metadata(0))))
+	left.add_child(_toc)
+	# Right: where you are, the page, the way on.
+	var right := VBoxContainer.new()
+	right.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	right.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	add_child(right)
+	var bar := HBoxContainer.new()
+	bar.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	_back_btn = EditorIcons.dress(Button.new(), "back", "Back      [Alt+Left]\nThe page you were reading before (like a web browser). The mouse's back button works too.")
+	_back_btn.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	_back_btn.pressed.connect(go_back)
+	bar.add_child(_back_btn)
+	_fwd_btn = EditorIcons.dress(Button.new(), "forward", "Forward      [Alt+Right]\nForward again to the page you came back from. The mouse's forward button works too.")
+	_fwd_btn.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	_fwd_btn.pressed.connect(go_forward)
+	bar.add_child(_fwd_btn)
+	_crumb = _rich(15)
+	_crumb.fit_content = true
+	_crumb.scroll_active = false
+	_crumb.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
+	_crumb.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_crumb.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	bar.add_child(_crumb)
+	if windowed:
+		var x := EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", func(): close_requested.emit(), 16), "close", "Close the Archive      [Esc]")
+		x.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+		bar.add_child(x)
+	right.add_child(bar)
+	_title = Label.new()
+	_title.add_theme_font_override("font", NeonTheme.heavy_font())
+	_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
+	_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.INFO)
+	_title.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	right.add_child(_title)
+	var rule := ColorRect.new()
+	rule.color = Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.45)
+	rule.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 2)
+	right.add_child(rule)
+	var body := HBoxContainer.new()
+	body.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	body.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
+	right.add_child(body)
+	_text = _rich(17)
+	_text.threaded = true   # (a long page laid out off the main thread: opening it no long frame)
+	_text.progress_bar_delay = 400
+	_text.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_text.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_text.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 420)
+	body.add_child(_text)
+	_pic_box = PanelContainer.new()
+	_pic_box.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", NeonTheme.box(Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.6), NeonTheme.BG, 1, 4))
+	_pic_box.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
+	_pic = Encyclopedia.Preview.new()
+	_pic.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(240, 240)
+	_pic_box.add_child(_pic)
+	_pic_box.hide()
+	body.add_child(_pic_box)
+	_foot = _rich(15)
+	_foot.fit_content = true
+	_foot.scroll_active = false
+	right.add_child(_foot)
+	_built = true
+	if _current == "":
+		open_book(book)
+	else:
+		var start := _current
+		_current = ""
+		_go(start)
+
+
+func _rich(fs: int) -> RichTextLabel:
+	var r := RichTextLabel.new()
+	r.bbcode_enabled = true
+	r.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", fs)
+	r.add_theme_font_size_override("bold_font_size", fs)
+	r.add_theme_font_size_override("italics_font_size", fs)
+	r.meta_clicked.connect(_on_link)
+	return r
+
+
+## (A computer's tab:) shown again, or the player's data changed - the
+## encyclopedia follows your discoveries; the page stays.
+func refresh() -> void:
+	if not _built:
+		return
+	_enc_cats = []
+	if book == "encyclopedia" or _search.text != "":
+		_fill_toc()
+	if _current.begins_with("encyclopedia/"):
+		_show(_current)
+
+
+# --- Opening a window -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Opens the Archive over everything (a layer of its own) at `page_id` ("book/page",
+## or a page of `book_id`, or the book's first page). One window at a time.
+static func open(owner: Node, book_id := "guide", page_id := "") -> Archive:
+	var tree := owner.get_tree()
+	if page_id != "" and not page_id.contains("/"):
+		page_id = book_id + "/" + page_id
+	for w in tree.get_nodes_in_group("archive_window"):
+		var a: Archive = w.archive
+		if page_id != "":
+			a.show_page(page_id)
+		else:
+			a.open_book(book_id)
+		return a
+	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
+	layer.layer = 120
+	layer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	tree.root.add_child(layer)
+	var w := Window_.new()
+	w.archive.book = book_id
+	if page_id != "":
+		w.archive.show_page(page_id)   # (before it's built: it opens there, no other page laid out first)
+	layer.add_child(w)
+	return w.archive
+
+
+## The window form: the game dimmed behind, the Archive in a panel; Esc closes.
+class Window_ extends Control:
+	var archive: Archive
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		add_to_group("archive_window")
+		set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+		theme = NeonTheme.build()
+		var dim := ColorRect.new()
+		dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.72)
+		dim.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+		add_child(dim)
+		var panel := PanelContainer.new()
+		panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", NeonTheme.box(Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.8), Color(NeonTheme.BG, 0.985), 2, 10))
+		panel.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+		panel.offset_left = 150
+		panel.offset_right = -150
+		panel.offset_top = 70
+		panel.offset_bottom = -70
+		add_child(panel)
+		var m := MarginContainer.new()
+		for k in ["margin_left", "margin_right", "margin_top", "margin_bottom"]:
+			m.add_theme_constant_override(k, 16)
+		panel.add_child(m)
+		archive = Archive.new()
+		archive.windowed = true
+		archive.close_requested.connect(close)
+		m.add_child(archive)
+
+	func close() -> void:
+		get_parent().queue_free()
+
+	func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+		if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
+			close()
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+			return
+		if archive._history_keys(event):
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if windowed or not is_visible_in_tree():
+		return
+	if _history_keys(event):
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+func _history_keys(event: InputEvent) -> bool:
+	var k := event as InputEventKey
+	var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+	var back: bool = (k != null and k.pressed and k.alt_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_LEFT) or (mb != null and mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON1)
+	var fwd: bool = (k != null and k.pressed and k.alt_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_RIGHT) or (mb != null and mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON2)
+	if back:
+		go_back()
+	elif fwd:
+		go_forward()
+	return back or fwd
+
+
+# --- Navigation -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func open_book(id: String) -> void:
+	book = id
+	if not _built:
+		return
+	var toc := contents(id)
+	var first := ""
+	for ch in toc:
+		if ch["id"] != "":
+			first = ch["id"]
+			break
+		if not ch["pages"].is_empty():
+			first = ch["pages"][0][0]
+			break
+	if first != "":
+		show_page(first)
+	else:
+		_fill_toc()
+
+
+## Opens a page ("book/page"), remembering the current one for Back.
+func show_page(pid: String) -> void:
+	if not pid.contains("/"):
+		pid = resolve(pid)
+	if not _built:
+		_current = pid
+		book = pid.get_slice("/", 0)
+		return
+	if pid == _current:
+		return
+	if _current != "":
+		_back.append(_current)
+		_forward.clear()
+	_go(pid)
+
+
+func go_back() -> void:
+	if _back.is_empty():
+		return
+	_forward.append(_current)
+	_go(_back.pop_back())
+
+
+func go_forward() -> void:
+	if _forward.is_empty():
+		return
+	_back.append(_current)
+	_go(_forward.pop_back())
+
+
+func _go(pid: String) -> void:
+	var b := pid.get_slice("/", 0)
+	var changed := b != book
+	book = b
+	_current = pid
+	for k in _shelf:
+		_shelf[k].set_pressed_no_signal(k == book)
+	if changed or not _items.has(pid):
+		_fill_toc()
+	var it: TreeItem = _items.get(pid)
+	if it:
+		var p := it.get_parent()
+		while p:
+			p.collapsed = false
+			p = p.get_parent()
+		it.select(0)
+		_toc.scroll_to_item(it)
+	_show(pid)
+	_back_btn.disabled = _back.is_empty()
+	_fwd_btn.disabled = _forward.is_empty()
+
+
+## A link: "doc:id" - a page of the book it's in, else of whichever book has it.
+func _on_link(meta: Variant) -> void:
+	var m := str(meta)
+	if m.begins_with("doc:"):
+		show_page(resolve(m.substr(4)))
+
+
+## "book/page" for a bare page id: the current book's if it has it, else the first book that does.
+func resolve(id: String) -> String:
+	if id.contains("/"):
+		return id
+	var order := [book] + BOOKS.map(func(b): return b["id"])
+	for b in order:
+		if has_page(b + "/" + id):
+			return b + "/" + id
+	return book + "/" + id
+
+
+func has_page(pid: String) -> bool:
+	var b := pid.get_slice("/", 0)
+	var id := pid.substr(b.length() + 1)
+	var f := _file(b)
+	if f != "":
+		EditorDocs.use(f)
+		return EditorDocs.has(id)
+	return not page(pid).is_empty()
+
+
+# --- The books --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _book(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	for b in BOOKS:
+		if b["id"] == id:
+			return b
+	return {}
+
+
+func _file(id: String) -> String:
+	return str(_book(id).get("file", ""))
+
+
+## A book's contents: [{id (its own page, or ""), title, pages: [[page, title]...], hint}].
+func contents(b: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var f := _file(b)
+	if f != "":
+		EditorDocs.use(f)
+		for c in EditorDocs.chapters():
+			var pages := []
+			for s in c["sections"]:
+				pages.append([b + "/" + s, EditorDocs.numbered(s)])
+			out.append({"id": b + "/" + c["id"], "title": EditorDocs.numbered(c["id"]), "pages": pages})
+		return out
+	match b:
+		"encyclopedia":
+			for cat in _enc_categories():
+				var pages := []
+				for e in cat["entries"]:
+					pages.append(["encyclopedia/" + str(e["id"]), e["title"]])
+				out.append({"id": "", "title": cat["title"], "pages": pages, "hint": cat["hint"] if pages.is_empty() else ""})
+		"controls":
+			var pages := [["controls/overview", "Mouse and keys at a glance"]]
+			for g in _key_groups():
+				pages.append(["controls/" + g.to_lower(), g])
+			out.append({"id": "", "title": "Controls", "pages": pages})
+		"versions":
+			for v in _versions_list():
+				var pages := []
+				for p in v["patches"]:
+					pages.append(["versions/patch:" + str(p["id"]), "%s  %s" % [p["id"], p["title"]]])
+				out.append({"id": "versions/" + str(v["id"]), "title": "Version %s  ·  %s" % [v["id"], v["title"]], "pages": pages})
+	return out
+
+
+## A page: {title, chapter (its chapter's page or ""), body (BBCode), entry (a picture's, or {}), text (searched)}.
+## (`full` false: without the body - for the search.)
+func page(pid: String, full := true) -> Dictionary:
+	var b := pid.get_slice("/", 0)
+	var id := pid.substr(b.length() + 1)
+	var f := _file(b)
+	if f != "":
+		EditorDocs.use(f)
+		if not EditorDocs.has(id):
+			return {}
+		var ch := EditorDocs.chapter_of(id)
+		return {"title": ("Chapter " + EditorDocs.numbered(id)) if id.begins_with("ch:") else EditorDocs.numbered(id),
+			"chapter": (b + "/" + ch) if ch != "" else "", "body": EditorDocs.body(id) if full else "", "entry": {}, "text": EditorDocs.text_of(id)}
+	match b:
+		"encyclopedia":
+			_enc_categories()
+			if not _enc.has(pid):
+				return {}
+			var e: Dictionary = _enc[pid]
+			return {"title": e["title"], "chapter": "", "crumb": e.get("_cat", ""), "body": e["text"], "entry": e, "text": e["title"] + " " + e["text"]}
+		"controls":
+			if id == "overview":
+				EditorDocs.use(_file("guide"))
+				var t := EditorDocs.body("controls") if EditorDocs.has("controls") else ""
+				return {"title": "Mouse and keys at a glance", "chapter": "", "body": t + "\n\n[color=#8fa3b8]Rebind any key or pad button in [b]Settings > Controls[/b] (the Esc menu). The other pages here list every action and what it's bound to now.[/color]", "entry": {}, "text": "controls mouse keys " + t}
+			for g in _key_groups():
+				if g.to_lower() == id:
+					var lines := []
+					var search: String = g
+					for a in _kb().ACTIONS:
+						if a[1] != g:
+							continue
+						var keys := _keys_of(a[0])
+						lines.append("[cell][color=#e8d8c0]%s[/color][/cell][cell][b][color=#ffd27a]%s[/color][/b][/cell]" % [a[2], keys if keys != "" else "[color=#6a6a70]-[/color]"])
+						search += " " + a[2] + " " + keys
+					var body := "[table=2]" + "".join(lines) + "[/table]\n\n[color=#8fa3b8]As bound now. Rebind them in [b]Settings > Controls[/b].[/color]"
+					return {"title": g, "chapter": "", "body": body, "entry": {}, "text": search}
+		"versions":
+			for v in _versions_list():
+				if id == str(v["id"]):
+					var lines := ["[color=#8fa3b8]%s[/color]\n" % v["date"], str(v["summary"]), "", "[b]Its patches[/b]"]
+					for p in v["patches"]:
+						lines.append("  •  [color=#7fd6ff][url=doc:versions/patch:%s]%s  %s[/url][/color]  [color=#8fa3b8](%s)[/color]" % [p["id"], p["id"], p["title"], p["date"]])
+					lines.append("\n[color=#8fa3b8]The step-by-step infographics and the code review of every patch: [b]Talos > Versions[/b] (F7).[/color]")
+					return {"title": "Version %s  ·  %s" % [v["id"], v["title"]], "chapter": "", "body": "\n".join(lines), "entry": {}, "text": v["title"] + " " + str(v["summary"])}
+				for p in v["patches"]:
+					if id == "patch:" + str(p["id"]):
+						var body2 := "[color=#8fa3b8]%s  ·  in version %s[/color]\n\n%s\n\n[color=#8fa3b8]Its infographic and code review: [b]Talos > Versions[/b] (F7).[/color]" % [p["date"], v["id"], p["summary"]]
+						return {"title": "Patch %s  ·  %s" % [p["id"], p["title"]], "chapter": "versions/" + str(v["id"]), "body": body2, "entry": {}, "text": p["title"] + " " + str(p["summary"])}
+	return {}
+
+
+func _enc_categories() -> Array:
+	if _enc_cats.is_empty() and is_inside_tree():
+		_enc_cats = Encyclopedia.categories(get_tree())
+		_enc = {}
+		for cat in _enc_cats:
+			for e in cat["entries"]:
+				e["_cat"] = cat["title"]
+				_enc["encyclopedia/" + str(e["id"])] = e
+	return _enc_cats
+
+
+## The Keybinds autoload (by path: this class mustn't need it to compile).
+func _kb() -> Node:
+	return get_node("/root/Keybinds")
+
+
+func _key_groups() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for a in _kb().ACTIONS:
+		if not a[1] in out:
+			out.append(a[1])
+	return out
+
+
+func _keys_of(id: String) -> String:
+	var kb := get_node_or_null("/root/Keybinds")
+	if kb == null:
+		return ""
+	var parts := []
+	var binds: Array = kb.binds.get(id, ["", "", ""])
+	for i in binds.size():
+		var t: String = kb.spec_text(str(binds[i]))
+		if t != "":
+			parts.append(t if i < 2 else t + " (pad)")
+	return "  ·  ".join(parts)
+
+
+## The versions (newest first) with their patches, read from data/patches.
+func _versions_list() -> Array:
+	if not _versions.is_empty():
+		return _versions
+	var patches := {}
+	var versions := []
+	var dir := "res://data/patches/"
+	for f in ResourceLoader.list_directory(dir):
+		if not str(f).ends_with(".json"):
+			continue
+		var d: Variant = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(dir + str(f)))
+		if not d is Dictionary:
+			continue
+		if d.get("kind", "") == "version":
+			versions.append(d)
+		else:
+			patches[str(d.get("id", ""))] = d
+	versions.sort_custom(func(a, b): return str(a.get("date", "")) + str(a["id"]) > str(b.get("date", "")) + str(b["id"]))
+	var used := {}
+	for v in versions:
+		var ps := []
+		for pid in v.get("patches", []):
+			if patches.has(str(pid)):
+				ps.append(patches[str(pid)])
+				used[str(pid)] = true
+		_versions.append({"id": v["id"], "title": v.get("title", ""), "date": v.get("date", ""), "summary": v.get("summary", ""), "patches": ps})
+	var loose := []
+	for pid in patches:
+		if not used.has(pid):
+			loose.append(patches[pid])
+	if not loose.is_empty():
+		loose.sort_custom(func(a, b): return str(a["id"]) > str(b["id"]))
+		_versions.push_front({"id": "next", "title": "Not yet in a version", "date": "", "summary": "Patches published since the last version.", "patches": loose})
+	return _versions
+
+
+# --- Showing ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The contents tree: the open book's chapters and pages - or, searching,
+## the pages of every book that have all the words.
+func _fill_toc() -> void:
+	_toc.clear()
+	_items.clear()
+	var root := _toc.create_item()
+	var q := _search.text.strip_edges().to_lower()
+	if q == "":
+		for ch in contents(book):
+			var ci := _toc.create_item(root)
+			ci.set_text(0, ch["title"])
+			ci.set_custom_color(0, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+			ci.set_custom_font(0, NeonTheme.heavy_font())
+			ci.set_metadata(0, ch["id"])
+			ci.set_selectable(0, ch["id"] != "")
+			if ch["id"] != "":
+				_items[ch["id"]] = ci
+			for p in ch["pages"]:
+				var pi := _toc.create_item(ci)
+				pi.set_text(0, p[1])
+				pi.set_metadata(0, p[0])
+				_items[p[0]] = pi
+			if str(ch.get("hint", "")) != "":
+				var hi := _toc.create_item(ci)
+				hi.set_text(0, ch["hint"])
+				hi.set_selectable(0, false)
+				hi.set_custom_color(0, Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.55))
+			ci.collapsed = book in ["versions", "encyclopedia"] and _current.get_slice("/", 0) == book and not ch["pages"].any(func(p): return p[0] == _current)
+		return
+	var words := Array(q.split(" ", false))
+	var found := 0
+	for b in BOOKS:
+		var bi: TreeItem = null
+		for ch in contents(b["id"]):
+			var pages: Array = ([[ch["id"], ch["title"]]] if ch["id"] != "" else []) + ch["pages"]
+			for p in pages:
+				var pg := page(p[0], false)
+				if pg.is_empty():
+					continue
+				var t := (str(pg["title"]) + " " + str(pg["text"])).to_lower()
+				if words.all(func(w): return t.contains(w)):
+					if bi == null:
+						bi = _toc.create_item(root)
+						bi.set_text(0, b["title"])
+						bi.set_custom_color(0, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+						bi.set_custom_font(0, NeonTheme.heavy_font())
+						bi.set_selectable(0, false)
+						bi.set_metadata(0, "")
+					var it := _toc.create_item(bi)
+					it.set_text(0, p[1])
+					it.set_metadata(0, p[0])
+					_items[p[0]] = it
+					found += 1
+	if found == 0:
+		var none := _toc.create_item(root)
+		none.set_text(0, "Nothing in any book has all of: " + q)
+		none.set_selectable(0, false)
+		none.set_custom_color(0, Color(0.6, 0.6, 0.62))
+
+
+func _show(pid: String) -> void:
+	var pg := page(pid)
+	var b := _book(pid.get_slice("/", 0))
+	if pg.is_empty():
+		_title.text = "Not found"
+		_text.text = "[color=#8fa3b8]This page isn't in the Archive (%s).[/color]" % pid
+		_crumb.text = ""
+		_foot.text = ""
+		_pic_box.hide()
+		return
+	# Where you are: the book, the chapter (or the encyclopedia's category).
+	var crumb := "[color=#ffb060]%s[/color]" % b.get("title", "")
+	if str(pg.get("chapter", "")) != "":
+		crumb += "  [color=#6a5a48]›[/color]  [color=#7fd6ff][url=doc:%s]%s[/url][/color]" % [pg["chapter"], page(pg["chapter"]).get("title", "")]
+	elif str(pg.get("crumb", "")) != "":
+		crumb += "  [color=#6a5a48]›[/color]  [color=#c8b8a0]%s[/color]" % pg["crumb"]
+	_crumb.text = crumb
+	_title.text = str(pg["title"])
+	var e: Dictionary = pg["entry"]
+	_pic_box.visible = not e.is_empty()
+	if not e.is_empty():
+		_pic.show_entry(e)
+	var w := DocPictures.width_for(_text) if _text.size.x > 100 else 900.0
+	_text.text = DocPictures.expand(str(pg["body"]), w, true)   # (pictures not loaded yet: in the background - _process)
+	_text.scroll_to_line(0)
+	_pictures_for = pid if not DocPictures.loaded(str(pg["body"])) else ""
+	# The pages before and after (in the book's reading order).
+	var order := []
+	for ch in contents(pid.get_slice("/", 0)):
+		if ch["id"] != "":
+			order.append(ch["id"])
+		for p in ch["pages"]:
+			order.append(p[0])
+	var i := order.find(pid)
+	var nav := []
+	if i > 0:
+		nav.append("[url=doc:%s]◀  %s[/url]" % [order[i - 1], _short(order[i - 1])])
+	if i >= 0 and i < order.size() - 1:
+		nav.append("[url=doc:%s]%s  ▶[/url]" % [order[i + 1], _short(order[i + 1])])
+	_foot.text = "[color=#3a4a5c]────────────────────────────────[/color]\n[color=#7fd6ff]%s[/color]" % "          ".join(nav) if not nav.is_empty() else ""
+
+
+var _pictures_for := ""   # the page shown while its pictures load (shown again when they're in)
+var _pic_t := 0.0
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _pictures_for == "" or not is_visible_in_tree():
+		return
+	_pic_t -= delta
+	if _pic_t > 0.0:
+		return
+	_pic_t = 0.1
+	if _pictures_for != _current:
+		_pictures_for = ""
+		return
+	var pg := page(_current)
+	if DocPictures.loaded(str(pg.get("body", ""))):
+		var line := _text.get_v_scroll_bar().value
+		_text.text = DocPictures.expand(str(pg["body"]), DocPictures.width_for(_text) if _text.size.x > 100 else 900.0)
+		_text.get_v_scroll_bar().value = line
+		_pictures_for = ""
+
+
+func _short(pid: String) -> String:
+	return str(page(pid).get("title", pid)).trim_prefix("Chapter ")

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The comms window: a dinosaur-headed contact's portrait, who they are, what they say and your reply options. Pauses the game while open. options: [[label, Callable or null], ...] - each closes the window. (Moved from scripts/comms.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,66 @@ 
+class_name Comms
+## The comms window: a dinosaur-headed contact's portrait, who they are, what
+## they say and your reply options. Pauses the game while open.
+## options: [[label, Callable or null], ...] - each closes the window.
+
+
+static func open(owner: Node, seed_: String, empire: String, role_line: String, text: String, options: Array, species := "", person := "") -> void:
+	var tree := owner.get_tree()
+	var was_paused := tree.paused
+	tree.paused = true
+	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
+	layer.layer = 40
+	layer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	owner.add_child(layer)
+	var root := Control.new()
+	root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	layer.add_child(root)
+	var col := Galaxy.empire_color(empire) if empire != "" else NeonTheme.HEAD
+	var box := UI.modal(root, col, Vector2(860, 0))
+	var head := UI.label("INCOMING TRANSMISSION", 15, col.lightened(0.3))
+	box.add_child(head)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
+	box.add_child(row)
+	var pic := Portrait.new().setup(seed_, empire, species, person)
+	pic.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(220, 264)
+	row.add_child(pic)
+	var right := VBoxContainer.new()
+	right.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	right.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	row.add_child(right)
+	right.add_child(UI.label(pic.person_name.to_upper(), 26, Color.WHITE))
+	var who := UI.label("%s  ·  %s" % [pic.species_name(), role_line], 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	who.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	right.add_child(who)
+	var msg := RichTextLabel.new()
+	msg.bbcode_enabled = true
+	msg.fit_content = true
+	msg.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 110)
+	msg.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 18)
+	msg.text = "[i]\"%s\"[/i]" % text
+	right.add_child(msg)
+	var buttons := VBoxContainer.new()
+	buttons.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	right.add_child(buttons)
+	var close := func():
+		Voice.stop()
+		tree.paused = was_paused
+		layer.queue_free()
+	if options.is_empty():
+		options = [["Close channel", null]]
+	var first: Button = null
+	for o in options:
+		var cb: Variant = o[1]
+		var b := UI.button(o[0], func():
+			close.call()
+			if cb is Callable:
+				(cb as Callable).call(), 16)
+		b.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
+		buttons.add_child(b)
+		if first == null:
+			first = b
+	UI.scale_fonts(root, "menu", 1.5)
+	Voice.speak(text, pic.person_name)   # (if the line has a recording)
+	if first:
+		first.grab_focus()

@@ -1,0 +1,43 @@ 
+class_name CrtFilter
+extends CanvasLayer
+## The CRT filter (shaders/crt.gdshader) over the whole window: Settings
+## adds one to the root at startup, so it lasts across every scene. It shows
+## when Settings.crt_on is set, during attract mode when Settings.crt_attract
+## is (the default), and while the CRT settings page is open (a preview).
+## Its parameters come from Settings.crt (see Settings.CRT_PARAMS).
+
+const SHADER := preload("res://shaders/crt.gdshader")
+
+var rect: ColorRect
+var _applied := {}
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	layer = 127   # over everything but the scene-change fades (128)
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	rect = ColorRect.new()
+	rect.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	rect.material = ShaderMaterial.new()
+	rect.material.shader = SHADER
+	add_child(rect)
+	_update()
+
+
+func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
+	_update()
+
+
+## Whether the filter is showing right now.
+static func wanted() -> bool:
+	return Settings.crt_on or Settings.crt_preview
+
+
+func _update() -> void:
+	visible = wanted()
+	if not visible:
+		return
+	for k in Settings.crt:
+		if _applied.get(k) != Settings.crt[k]:
+			_applied[k] = Settings.crt[k]
+			rect.material.set_shader_parameter(k, Settings.crt[k])

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: What near-death looks like (space: the hull, on foot: the health): the whole window starts failing like a broken monitor - static, rolling tear lines, a flicker (shaders/damage_screen.gdshader) - and cracks run across the glass. It starts below START of health and is worst at the end, but never so much you can't see what's happening (the shader caps it). More cracks the lower it goes; they stay until you're mended above START. var ds := DamageScreen.new(); ds.health = func(): return hull / max_hull; add_child(ds) (Moved from scripts/damage_screen.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,132 @@ 
+class_name DamageScreen
+extends CanvasLayer
+## What near-death looks like (space: the hull, on foot: the health): the
+## whole window starts failing like a broken monitor - static, rolling tear
+## lines, a flicker (shaders/damage_screen.gdshader) - and cracks run across
+## the glass. It starts below START of health and is worst at the end, but
+## never so much you can't see what's happening (the shader caps it). More
+## cracks the lower it goes; they stay until you're mended above START.
+##   var ds := DamageScreen.new(); ds.health = func(): return hull / max_hull; add_child(ds)
+
+const START := 0.3
+var health: Callable
+var _rect: ColorRect
+var _cracks: Cracks
+var _k := 0.0
+
+## The shader, kept for the run once loaded (Warmup loads it at the title: parsing
+## it in the frame a new game's scene was made cost ~8 ms there).
+static var _shader: Shader
+
+static func shader() -> Shader:
+	if _shader == null:
+		_shader = load("res://shaders/damage_screen.gdshader")
+	return _shader
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	layer = 4   # (over the world and the HUD; under the menus)
+	_rect = ColorRect.new()
+	_rect.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = shader()
+	m.set_shader_parameter("seed", randf() * 100.0)
+	_rect.material = m
+	_rect.visible = false
+	add_child(_rect)
+	_cracks = Cracks.new()
+	_cracks.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	_cracks.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	add_child(_cracks)
+
+
+## How bad it looks at `frac` of the health: 0 above START, 1 at 0.
+static func level(frac: float) -> float:
+	return clampf((START - frac) / START, 0.0, 1.0)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not health.is_valid():
+		return
+	var want := level(float(health.call()))
+	_k = move_toward(_k, want, delta * 1.5)
+	_rect.visible = _k > 0.01
+	if _rect.visible:
+		(_rect.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("k", _k * 0.85)
+	_cracks.set_level(want)
+
+
+## The glass's cracks: each from a point of impact, branching - drawn once
+## when one more appears (not every frame).
+class Cracks extends Control:
+	var _lines: Array = []    # [PackedVector2Array, width]
+	var _shown := 0
+	var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		_rng.randomize()
+
+	## Cracks for a level 0..1: none above 0, up to 5 at the end; they go when you're mended.
+	func set_level(l: float) -> void:
+		var want := 0 if l <= 0.0 else 1 + int(l * 4.0)
+		if want == _shown:
+			return
+		if want < _shown and want == 0:
+			_lines.clear()
+		elif want > _shown:
+			for i in want - _shown:
+				_crack()
+		_shown = want
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	func _crack() -> void:
+		var sz := get_viewport_rect().size
+		# (the impact toward an edge or a corner: the middle - where you fly - stays clear)
+		var at := Vector2(_rng.randf_range(0.05, 0.95) * sz.x, _rng.randf_range(0.08, 0.92) * sz.y)
+		var from_c := (at - sz * 0.5) / (sz * 0.5)
+		if maxf(absf(from_c.x), absf(from_c.y)) < 0.55:
+			at = sz * 0.5 + from_c.normalized() * sz * 0.5 * _rng.randf_range(0.6, 0.9) if from_c.length() > 0.01 else Vector2(sz.x * 0.12, sz.y * 0.2)
+		for j in _rng.randi_range(4, 6):
+			_branch(at, Vector2.from_angle(_rng.randf() * TAU), _rng.randf_range(0.06, 0.16) * sz.y, 1.8, 1)
+		# a little star of shatter round the impact
+		for j in 10:
+			var d := Vector2.from_angle(_rng.randf() * TAU) * _rng.randf_range(8.0, 30.0)
+			_lines.append([PackedVector2Array([at, at + d]), 1.2])
+
+	func _branch(from: Vector2, dir: Vector2, length: float, width: float, depth: int) -> void:
+		var pts := PackedVector2Array([from])
+		var p := from
+		var steps := int(length / 22.0) + 2
+		for i in steps:
+			dir = dir.rotated(_rng.randf_range(-0.35, 0.35))
+			p += dir * length / steps
+			pts.append(p)
+			if depth > 0 and _rng.randf() < 0.12:
+				_branch(p, dir.rotated(_rng.randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)), length * 0.4, width * 0.6, depth - 1)
+		_lines.append([pts, width])
+
+	## (All the cracks' segments gathered, thick and thin, and drawn as a few
+	## multilines - one draw call a layer, not hundreds of polylines.)
+	var _thick := PackedVector2Array()
+	var _thin := PackedVector2Array()
+
+	func _gather() -> void:
+		_thick = PackedVector2Array()
+		_thin = PackedVector2Array()
+		for l in _lines:
+			var pts: PackedVector2Array = l[0]
+			var to: PackedVector2Array = _thick if float(l[1]) >= 1.5 else _thin
+			for i in pts.size() - 1:
+				to.append(pts[i])
+				to.append(pts[i + 1])
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		_gather()
+		if not _thick.is_empty():
+			draw_multiline(_thick, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 4.0)
+			draw_multiline(_thick, Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.0, 0.55), 1.8)
+			draw_multiline(_thick, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35), 0.7)
+		if not _thin.is_empty():
+			draw_multiline(_thin, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 3.0)
+			draw_multiline(_thin, Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.0, 0.5), 1.1)

+extends Control
+## Story dialogue box for the main quest. Shows lines one at a time
+## ([speaker, bbcode text]); click, Space or Enter to continue, or Skip.
+## Esc opens the Esc menu on top (it never closes the dialogue).
+## Pauses the game while open, and works on top of other paused panels
+## (it only unpauses if it was the one that paused).
+## Speakers with a picture in PORTRAITS are shown beside their lines.
+
+signal finished
+
+const GOLD := Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.38)
+## Speaker -> portrait (shown left of the text while they speak).
+const PORTRAITS := {"Kilon Alios": "res://art/kilon/kilon_portrait.png"}
+const TEXT_WIDTH := 1100.0
+const PORTRAIT_SIZE := 150.0
+
+var _lines: Array = []
+var _index := 0
+var _paused_by_me := false
+var _on_done: Callable
+
+var _speaker: Label
+var _portrait: TextureRect
+var _portrait_box: PanelContainer
+var _text: RichTextLabel
+var _counter: Label
+var _next: Button
+var _exit: Button                  # preview only: leave the preview
+var _banner: Label                 # preview only
+## Previewing (the editor): an exit button and banner, and Esc exits.
+var preview := false
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_to_group("dialogue_boxes")
+	hide()
+	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	_build()
+	UI.scale_fonts(self, "dialogue")
+	Settings.text_scale_changed.connect(func(): UI.scale_fonts(self, "dialogue"))
+
+
+func _build() -> void:
+	var dim := ColorRect.new()
+	dim.color = Color(NeonTheme.BG, 0.45)
+	dim.set_anchors_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	dim.gui_input.connect(_on_click)
+	add_child(dim)
+
+	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
+	var style := UI.panel_style(GOLD.darkened(0.2))
+	style.bg_color = Color(0.05, 0.04, 0.06, 0.97)
+	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

+	panel.anchor_right = 0.5

+	panel.anchor_bottom = 1.0

+	panel.offset_right = 600

+	panel.offset_bottom = -130
+	panel.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN  # bigger text grows it upward
+	panel.gui_input.connect(_on_click)
+	add_child(panel)
+
+	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
+	for side in ["left", "right", "bottom"]:
+		margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_" + side, 26)
+	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 6)
+	panel.add_child(margin)
+
+	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	margin.add_child(v)
+	v.add_child(Meander.new())
+
+	# The speaker's portrait (if they have one) beside their name and line.
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
+	v.add_child(row)
+	_portrait_box = PanelContainer.new()
+	var frame := UI.panel_style(GOLD.darkened(0.25))
+	frame.bg_color = Color(0.1, 0.08, 0.07)
+	_portrait_box.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", frame)
+	_portrait_box.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
+	_portrait_box.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_portrait_box.visible = false
+	row.add_child(_portrait_box)
+	_portrait = TextureRect.new()
+	_portrait.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(PORTRAIT_SIZE, PORTRAIT_SIZE)
+	_portrait.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
+	_portrait.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
+	_portrait.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_portrait_box.add_child(_portrait)
+	var words := VBoxContainer.new()
+	words.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	words.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	row.add_child(words)
+	_speaker = UI.label("", 22, GOLD)
+	words.add_child(_speaker)
+	_text = RichTextLabel.new()
+	_text.bbcode_enabled = true
+	_text.fit_content = true
+	_text.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(TEXT_WIDTH, 90)
+	_text.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_text.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 19)

+	_banner = UI.label("PREVIEW", 14, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	_banner.visible = false
+	footer.add_child(_banner)
+	footer.add_child(UI.label("Click, Space or Enter to continue", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	footer.add_child(UI.spacer())
+	_counter = UI.label("", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	footer.add_child(_counter)
+	var skip := EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", _finish, 14), "skip", EditorIcons.tip("Skip", "", "Ends the conversation now, skipping the remaining lines. The story goes on as if you'd read them\n(the quest journal keeps the text)."))
+	skip.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	footer.add_child(skip)
+	_next = EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", advance, 16), "next", EditorIcons.tip("Continue", "Space  ·  Enter  ·  click", "Shows the next line of the conversation (the last line closes it)."))
+	_next.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	footer.add_child(_next)
+	_exit = EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", _finish, 16), "exit", EditorIcons.tip("Exit preview", "Esc", "Stops the preview and returns to the editor.\nNothing changes in the quest - a preview only shows the lines as the player would see them."))
+	_exit.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	_exit.visible = false
+	footer.add_child(_exit)
+	v.add_child(footer)
+
+
+## Show `lines` ([speaker, text] pairs); `on_done` runs after the last one.
+func play(lines: Array, on_done := Callable(), as_preview := false) -> void:
+	preview = as_preview
+	_exit.visible = as_preview
+	_banner.visible = as_preview
+	if lines.is_empty():
+		if on_done.is_valid():
+			on_done.call()
+		return
+	_lines = lines
+	_index = 0
+	_on_done = on_done
+	_paused_by_me = not get_tree().paused
+	get_tree().paused = true
+	# A conversation never keeps the mouse: if it opened while you were holding
+	# the button to steer (the cursor hidden), the release would land here and
+	# the cursor would stay hidden - so steering ends and the cursor shows.
+	get_tree().call_group("steering", "release_steering")
+	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE
+	Input.set_custom_mouse_cursor(null, Input.CURSOR_ARROW)
+	show()
+	_show_line()
+
+
+## The portrait of a speaker (null if they have none).
+static func portrait_for(speaker: String) -> Texture2D:
+	var path: String = PORTRAITS.get(speaker, "")
+	return load(path) if path != "" and ResourceLoader.exists(path) else null
+
+
+func is_open() -> bool:
+	return visible
+
+
+func advance() -> void:
+	_index += 1
+	if _index >= _lines.size():
+		_finish()
+	else:
+		_show_line()
+
+
+func _show_line() -> void:
+	var line: Array = _lines[_index]
+	_speaker.text = line[0]
+	_text.text = line[1]
+	Voice.speak(line[1], line[0])   # (its recording, in the speaker's voice)
+	var pic := portrait_for(line[0])
+	_portrait.texture = pic
+	_portrait_box.visible = pic != null
+	_text.custom_minimum_size.x = TEXT_WIDTH - (PORTRAIT_SIZE + 30.0 if pic else 0.0)
+	_counter.text = "%d / %d" % [_index + 1, _lines.size()]
+	var last := _index >= _lines.size() - 1
+	_next.icon = EditorIcons.get_icon("close" if last else "next")
+	_next.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Close" if last else "Continue", "Space  ·  Enter  ·  click",
+		"Closes the conversation (this is its last line)." if last else "Shows the next line of the conversation (the last line closes it).")
+	_next.set_meta("tip", "")
+
+
+func _finish() -> void:
+	hide()
+	Voice.stop()
+	if _paused_by_me:
+		get_tree().paused = false
+	var cb := _on_done
+	_on_done = Callable()
+	finished.emit()
+	if cb.is_valid():
+		cb.call()
+
+
+func _on_click(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+		advance()
+		accept_event()
+
+
+# _input so it wins over other open panels (station menu etc.).
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not visible or UI.esc_menu_open():
+		return  # the Esc menu on top handles input
+	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
+		if preview:
+			_finish()   # Esc leaves a preview
+		else:
+			UI.open_esc_menu()
+	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo \
+			and event.keycode in [KEY_SPACE, KEY_ENTER, KEY_KP_ENTER]:
+		advance()
+	elif event is InputEventKey:
+		pass  # swallow other keys while talking
+	else:
+		return
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+## Greek key (meander) band, drawn along the top of the dialogue box.
+class Meander extends Control:
+	func _init() -> void:
+		custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 18)
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		var col := Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.38, 0.75)
+		var u := 6.0   # unit size
+		var x := 0.0
+		var y0 := 2.0
+		while x + u * 4 <= size.x:
+			# One meander unit: a squared spiral hook.
+			var pts := PackedVector2Array([
+				Vector2(x, y0 + u * 2), Vector2(x, y0), Vector2(x + u * 3, y0),
+				Vector2(x + u * 3, y0 + u * 2), Vector2(x + u, y0 + u * 2),
+				Vector2(x + u, y0 + u), Vector2(x + u * 2, y0 + u)])
+			draw_polyline(pts, col, 1.6)
+			draw_line(Vector2(x, y0 + u * 2), Vector2(x + u * 4, y0 + u * 2), col, 1.6)
+			x += u * 4

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,93 @@ 
+class_name DocPictures
+## Screenshots of the game in the guide (F1), the tutorial and the
+## encyclopedia: where their text has  ![caption](shot:id)  the picture
+## (data/docs/shots/<id>.jpg - taken and annotated by tools/doc_shots.py,
+## listed in data/docs/shots.json) shows, as wide as the text, its caption
+## under it. A shot not taken yet shows as a dim line instead.
+
+const DIR := "res://data/docs/shots/"
+static var _re: RegEx
+
+
+## `text` with every shot marker made a picture `width` px wide. `defer`: a
+## picture not loaded yet isn't loaded now (a 1920 x 1080 picture read and
+## decoded in the frame: a long one) - it's asked for in the background and a
+## line stands in for it; loaded(text) says when to show the text again.
+static func expand(text: String, width := 900.0, defer := false) -> String:
+	if not text.contains("](shot:"):
+		return text
+	if _re == null:
+		_re = RegEx.create_from_string("!\\[([^\\]]*)\\]\\(shot:([a-z0-9_]+)\\)")
+	var out := ""
+	var last := 0
+	for m in _re.search_all(text):
+		out += text.substr(last, m.get_start() - last)
+		out += block(m.get_string(2), m.get_string(1), width, defer)
+		last = m.get_end()
+	return out + text.substr(last)
+
+
+## The BBCode of one picture and its caption.
+static func block(id: String, caption: String, width: float, defer := false) -> String:
+	if caption.strip_edges() == "":
+		caption = caption_of(id)
+	var path := DIR + id + ".jpg"
+	if not ResourceLoader.exists(path):
+		return "[color=#6f6455][i](picture: %s - not taken yet)[/i][/color]" % caption
+	if defer and not _ready_now(path):
+		return "\n[center][color=#6f6455][i](loading the picture: %s)[/i][/color][/center]\n" % caption
+	var w := int(clampf(width, 320.0, 1280.0))
+	return "\n[center][img=%dx%d]%s[/img]\n[font_size=%d][color=#c9b48f][i]%s[/i][/color][/font_size][/center]\n" % [
+		w, int(w * 9 / 16.0), path, Settings.fs("menu", 15), caption]
+
+
+## A shot's caption from data/docs/shots.json (an empty marker's: ![](shot:id)).
+static var _captions := {}
+
+static func caption_of(id: String) -> String:
+	if _captions.is_empty():
+		var d: Variant = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://data/docs/shots.json"))
+		if d is Dictionary:
+			for k in d.get("shots", {}):
+				_captions[k] = str(d["shots"][k].get("caption", ""))
+	return str(_captions.get(id, ""))
+
+
+## Pictures loaded in the background, kept (so the text's [img] finds them in the cache).
+static var _held := {}
+
+## Loaded (or asked for in the background now, and false until it's there).
+static func _ready_now(path: String) -> bool:
+	if _held.has(path) or ResourceLoader.has_cached(path):
+		return true
+	var st := ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path)
+	if st == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE:
+		ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path)
+		return false
+	if st == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_LOADED:
+		_held[path] = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(path)
+		return true
+	return false
+
+
+## Every picture `text` shows is loaded (expand with `defer` shows them all now).
+static func loaded(text: String) -> bool:
+	for id in ids_in(text):
+		var path := DIR + str(id) + ".jpg"
+		if ResourceLoader.exists(path) and not _ready_now(path):
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+## The ids of the shots `text` shows.
+static func ids_in(text: String) -> Array:
+	if _re == null:
+		_re = RegEx.create_from_string("!\\[([^\\]]*)\\]\\(shot:([a-z0-9_]+)\\)")
+	return _re.search_all(text).map(func(m): return m.get_string(2))
+
+
+## A width for pictures in a text box: its width less a margin (or `fallback`
+## before it's laid out), at most 1000.
+static func width_for(box: Control, fallback := 860.0) -> float:
+	var w: float = box.size.x - 40.0 if box and box.size.x > 100.0 else fallback
+	return minf(w, 1000.0)

+class_name EquipDoll
+extends Control
+## An equipment screen in the manner of action RPGs: the ship (or the
+## automaton - you on a planet) drawn large in the middle, and round it its
+## areas' slots - each group placed beside its area and joined to it by a
+## line. Ships: nose, wings, hull, thrusters, cargo bay (Shipyard.AREAS);
+## the automaton: head, back, torso, arms, hand, legs (Gear.AREA_OF_SLOT).
+## The slots are ItemSlots made by the page that shows the doll (it knows
+## what dragging onto them and right-clicking them does):
+##   var d := EquipDoll.new()
+##   d.picture = tex
+##   d.add_group("nose", "NOSE", Vector2(0.5, 0.0), Vector2(0.5, 0.1), false, [slot, slot])
+## `at`: where the group sits in the doll (0..1 each way: its edge-most
+## point); `anchor`: the spot it belongs to on the picture (0..1 of it);
+## vertical: the slots stacked (else side by side).
+
+const MAX_RUN := 4
+const GAP := 12.0     # between the slots and the picture's frame - the same for every group
+const FRAME := 14.0   # the frame drawn round the picture
+const SPREAD := 8.0   # between groups on the same side
+var picture: Texture2D
+## The character's 3D model instead of the picture (ModelView: turned by dragging) - laid where the picture goes.
+var view: Control:
+	set(v):
+		view = v
+		if v and v.get_parent() == null:
+			add_child(v)
+			move_child(v, 0)
+		_layout()
+var picture_scale := 0.62            # of the doll's height
+var groups: Array = []               # [{key, name, at, anchor, vertical, box: Container}]
+var _pic_rect := Rect2()
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(470, 360)
+	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
+
+
+func add_group(key: String, title: String, at: Vector2, anchor: Vector2, vertical: bool, slots: Array) -> void:
+	# Up to MAX_RUN slots in a line; more (an over-full area) wrap into more lines.
+	var box := GridContainer.new()
+	box.columns = (ceili(slots.size() / float(MAX_RUN)) if vertical else mini(slots.size(), MAX_RUN)) if not slots.is_empty() else 1
+	box.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 3)
+	box.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 3)
+	var cap := UI.label(title, 11, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	cap.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	var holder := VBoxContainer.new()
+	holder.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 1)
+	holder.add_child(cap)
+	box.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER   # (its slots centred under the caption: a side's line up)
+	holder.add_child(box)
+	for s in slots:
+		box.add_child(s)
+	add_child(holder)
+	groups.append({"key": key, "name": title, "at": at, "anchor": anchor, "vertical": vertical, "box": holder})
+	_layout.call_deferred()
+
+
+func _notification(what: int) -> void:
+	if what == NOTIFICATION_RESIZED:
+		_layout()
+
+
+func _layout() -> void:
+	# The picture in the middle, as big as fits once the slot groups have
+	# room round it; every group then sits the same distance (GAP) from the
+	# picture's frame: left groups just left of it, right ones just right, the
+	# top one just above, the bottom one just below - each along that side at
+	# its own spot (`at`).
+	var left := 0.0
+	var right := 0.0
+	var top := 0.0
+	var bottom := 0.0
+	for g in groups:
+		var ms: Vector2 = (g["box"] as Control).get_combined_minimum_size()
+		match _side(g):
+			"left": left = maxf(left, ms.x)
+			"right": right = maxf(right, ms.x)
+			"top": top = maxf(top, ms.y)
+			"bottom": bottom = maxf(bottom, ms.y)
+	var room := FRAME + GAP
+	var aspect := 1.0
+	if picture:
+		aspect = picture.get_width() / maxf(1.0, picture.get_height())
+	var h := minf(size.y * picture_scale, size.y - top - bottom - room * 2.0)
+	var w := h * aspect
+	var max_w := size.x - maxf(left, right) * 2.0 - room * 2.0   # (centred: room for the wider side on both)
+	if w > max_w:
+		w = max_w
+		h = w / aspect
+	w = maxf(w, 10.0)
+	h = maxf(h, 10.0)
+	var cy := top + room + (size.y - top - bottom - room * 2.0) / 2.0
+	_pic_rect = Rect2(Vector2(size.x / 2.0 - w / 2.0, cy - h / 2.0), Vector2(w, h))
+	var frame := _pic_rect.grow(FRAME)
+	# Along each side: each group at its own spot, then spread so none overlap
+	# (in order; pulled back inside the doll if they run past its edge).
+	var sides := {"left": [], "right": [], "top": [], "bottom": []}
+	for g in groups:
+		sides[_side(g)].append(g)
+	for side in sides:
+		var along_y: bool = side in ["left", "right"]
+		var lo: float = frame.position.y if along_y else frame.position.x
+		var hi: float = frame.end.y if along_y else frame.end.x
+		var items := []
+		var thick := 0.0   # the side's widest (left / right) or tallest (top / bottom) group: all made that size
+		for g in sides[side]:
+			var ms: Vector2 = (g["box"] as Control).get_combined_minimum_size()
+			thick = maxf(thick, ms.x if along_y else ms.y)
+			items.append([0.0, ms.y if along_y else ms.x, g, ms, Vector2(g["at"]).y if along_y else Vector2(g["at"]).x])
+		items.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a[4] < b[4])
+		# Evenly spread along the frame's side (equal space between them and
+		# at the ends); with too little room, stacked SPREAD apart.
+		var total := 0.0
+		for it in items:
+			total += it[1]
+		var free_len: float = (hi - lo) - total
+		var step: float = free_len / (items.size() + 1) if free_len > SPREAD * (items.size() + 1) else SPREAD
+		var cur: float = lo + step if free_len > SPREAD * (items.size() + 1) else lo + (hi - lo - total - SPREAD * (items.size() - 1)) / 2.0
+		for it in items:
+			it[0] = cur
+			cur += it[1] + step
+			# (every group on the side as wide - or as tall - as the biggest: their slots share a centre line)
+			it[3] = Vector2(thick, it[3].y) if along_y else Vector2(it[3].x, thick)
+		var limit: float = size.y if along_y else size.x
+		if not items.is_empty() and items[0][0] < 0.0:
+			var under: float = -items[0][0]
+			for it in items:
+				it[0] += under
+		if not items.is_empty() and items[-1][0] + items[-1][1] > limit:
+			var over: float = items[-1][0] + items[-1][1] - limit
+			for it in items:
+				it[0] = maxf(0.0, it[0] - over)
+		for it in items:
+			var ms: Vector2 = it[3]
+			var pos := Vector2.ZERO
+			match side:
+				"left": pos = Vector2(frame.position.x - GAP - ms.x, it[0])
+				"right": pos = Vector2(frame.end.x + GAP, it[0])
+				"top": pos = Vector2(it[0], frame.position.y - GAP - ms.y)
+				_: pos = Vector2(it[0], frame.end.y + GAP)
+			var box: Control = it[2]["box"]
+			box.position = pos.clamp(Vector2.ZERO, (size - ms).max(Vector2.ZERO))
+			box.size = ms
+	if view:
+		# (the model's frame wider than the picture's: room to turn round, its rifle out to the side)
+		var r := _pic_rect.grow_individual(_pic_rect.size.x * 0.35, 0.0, _pic_rect.size.x * 0.35, 0.0)
+		view.position = r.position
+		view.size = r.size
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+## Which side of the picture a group sits on (from its `at`).
+func _side(g: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var at := Vector2(g["at"])
+	if at.x <= 0.05:
+		return "left"
+	if at.x >= 0.95:
+		return "right"
+	return "top" if at.y < 0.5 else "bottom"
+
+
+## The point a group's line leaves from (the side of its box facing the picture).
+func _box_point(g: Dictionary) -> Vector2:
+	var box: Control = g["box"]
+	var r := Rect2(box.position, box.size)
+	var c := _pic_rect.get_center()
+	var p := r.get_center()
+	if absf(p.x - c.x) > absf(p.y - c.y) * 1.2:
+		return Vector2(r.end.x if p.x < c.x else r.position.x, p.y)
+	return Vector2(p.x, r.end.y if p.y < c.y else r.position.y)
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	# A faint frame of the console behind the picture.
+	draw_rect(_pic_rect.grow(FRAME), Color(NeonTheme.BG_LIGHT, 0.5))
+	draw_rect(_pic_rect.grow(FRAME), Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.25), false, 1.0)
+	if picture and view == null:
+		draw_texture_rect(picture, _pic_rect, false)
+	for g in groups:
+		var a: Vector2 = _pic_rect.position + _pic_rect.size * Vector2(g["anchor"])
+		var b := _box_point(g)
+		var col := Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.55)
+		draw_line(b, a, col, 1.5, true)
+		draw_circle(a, 4.0, col)
+		draw_arc(a, 7.0, 0, TAU, 16, Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.3), 1.0, true)
