files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The console (bottom left of the HUD): two tabs, picked by their icons at its top - the EVENT LOG (anything in the game posts to it with the static helpers, e.g. GameLog.post("Docked at Helios Dock"); rapid repeated events - damage, loot - merged per second into one line) and the LOADING console (LoadBar: what's loaded, unloaded and made, the memory pool, the work's progress bar and the memory map). The loading tab's icon shows the progress while you're on the log. L hides the console. (Moved from scripts/event_log.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,634 @@ 
+class_name GameLog
+extends PanelContainer
+## The console (bottom left of the HUD): two tabs, picked by their icons at its
+## top - the EVENT LOG (anything in the game posts to it with the static
+## helpers, e.g. GameLog.post("Docked at Helios Dock"); rapid repeated events -
+## damage, loot - merged per second into one line) and the LOADING console
+## (LoadBar: what's loaded, unloaded and made, the memory pool, the work's
+## progress bar and the memory map). The loading tab's icon shows the progress
+## while you're on the log. L hides the console.
+
+const MAX_LINES := 100
+const MERGE_WINDOW := 1.0  # seconds
+
+## Line colours by kind of event.
+const COLORS := {
+	"info": Color(0.86, 0.78, 0.68),
+	"combat": Color(1.0, 0.65, 0.4),
+	"danger": Color(1.0, 0.38, 0.32),
+	"good": Color(0.5, 1.0, 0.6),
+	"loot": Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.38),
+	"mission": Color(0.5, 0.76, 1.0),
+	"quest": Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.45),
+}
+
+var _text: RichTextLabel
+## History and clock are static, so the log continues between space and
+## planet surfaces. clear_history() starts a fresh log (new game / load).
+static var _lines: Array[String] = []
+static var _time := 0.0
+var _merge_t := 0.0
+## Pending merged events: key -> {kind, format, values...}
+var _dealt := {}    # target name -> [shields, hull]
+var _taken := {}    # attacker name -> [shields, hull]
+var _loot := {}     # item name -> amount
+
+
+# --- Static API ----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func clear_history() -> void:
+	_lines.clear()
+	_time = 0.0
+
+
+static func _log() -> GameLog:
+	var tree := Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree
+	return tree.get_first_node_in_group("event_log") as GameLog if tree else null
+
+
+## Post a line. kind: info, combat, danger, good, loot, mission, quest.
+static func post(text: String, kind := "info") -> void:
+	var l := _log()
+	if l:
+		l._flush()  # write pending merged lines first, so cause comes before effect
+		l._add(text, kind)
+
+
+## Damage the player dealt to `target` (merged per second).
+static func damage_dealt(target: String, shields: float, hull: float) -> void:
+	var l := _log()
+	if l:
+		var d: Array = l._dealt.get(target, [0.0, 0.0])
+		l._dealt[target] = [d[0] + shields, d[1] + hull]
+
+
+## Damage the player took from `attacker` (merged per second).
+static func damage_taken(attacker: String, shields: float, hull: float) -> void:
+	var l := _log()
+	if l:
+		var d: Array = l._taken.get(attacker, [0.0, 0.0])
+		l._taken[attacker] = [d[0] + shields, d[1] + hull]
+
+
+## Something collected (merged per second).
+static func loot(item: String, amount: int) -> void:
+	var l := _log()
+	if l:
+		l._loot[item] = l._loot.get(item, 0) + amount
+
+
+# --- Place on screen -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Pinned to the bottom-left corner, `want` in size - but never reaching the
+## toolbar `bar` (centred along the bottom): its width stops GAP short of the
+## bar's left edge. Placed again whenever the bar or the window changes size.
+const GAP := 12.0
+var _want := Vector2(440, 220)
+var _load_bar: LoadBar
+var _bar: Control
+## The tab shown ("events" or "loading"), kept while the game runs (every scene's console the same).
+static var tab := "events"
+var _tabs := {}          # tab -> its icon button
+var _title: Label
+
+func place(want: Vector2, bar: Control = null) -> void:
+	_want = want
+	if bar != _bar:
+		if _bar and _bar.resized.is_connected(_fit):
+			_bar.resized.disconnect(_fit)
+		_bar = bar
+		if _bar:
+			_bar.resized.connect(_fit)
+	if is_inside_tree() and not get_viewport().size_changed.is_connected(_fit):
+		get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_fit)
+	_fit()
+
+
+func _fit() -> void:
+	var w := _want.x
+	if _bar and _bar.is_inside_tree() and _bar.size.x > 0.0:
+		# (in this control's parent's space: the bar's left edge)
+		var origin: float = (get_parent() as Control).get_global_rect().position.x if get_parent() is Control else 0.0
+		var left: float = _bar.get_global_rect().position.x - origin
+		w = minf(w, left - 16.0 - GAP)
+	w = maxf(w, 200.0)
+	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(w, _want.y)
+	anchor_left = 0.0
+	anchor_right = 0.0
+	anchor_top = 1.0
+	anchor_bottom = 1.0
+	offset_left = 16
+	offset_right = 16 + w
+	offset_bottom = -16
+	offset_top = -16 - _want.y
+	size = Vector2(w, _want.y)
+
+
+# --- Console -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_to_group("event_log")
+	if not SaveGame.travelling and not _built_ahead():
+		clear_history()  # new game or loaded save: start a fresh log
+	add_to_group("neon_restyle")
+	restyle()
+
+	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 3)
+	add_child(v)
+	# The tabs: an icon each, then the shown one's name.
+	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
+	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	v.add_child(head)
+	for t in [["events", "ui_journal", EditorIcons.tip("Event log", "", "What just happened: fights, loot, missions, news.")],
+			["loading", "reload", EditorIcons.tip("Loading console", "", "What's loaded, unloaded and made in the background, the memory pool,\nthe work under way and the memory map. The line under this icon: its progress.")]]:
+		var b := Button.new()
+		b.toggle_mode = true
+		b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(30, 24)
+		EditorIcons.dress_tab(b, t[1], t[2])
+		for c in ["icon_normal_color", "icon_pressed_color", "icon_hover_color", "icon_hover_pressed_color", "icon_focus_color"]:
+			b.add_theme_color_override(c, Color.WHITE)   # (the theme dims a pressed icon: the shown tab's must be the bright one)
+		var on := NeonTheme.box(Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.6), Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.16), 1, 4, 4)
+		var off := StyleBoxEmpty.new()
+		var hover := NeonTheme.box(Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.3), Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.08), 1, 4, 4)
+		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", on)
+		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover_pressed", on)
+		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", off)
+		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
+		b.pressed.connect(show_tab.bind(t[0]))
+		if t[0] == "loading":
+			b.draw.connect(_draw_load_progress.bind(b))
+		head.add_child(b)
+		_tabs[t[0]] = b
+	_title = Label.new()
+	_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
+	_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.8))
+	_title.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_title.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	head.add_child(_title)
+	_text = RichTextLabel.new()
+	_text.bbcode_enabled = true
+	_text.scroll_active = true          # vertical scroll bar when there's more to read
+	_text.scroll_following = false      # we follow manually (only while at the bottom)
+	_text.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_text.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP  # mouse wheel / dragging scrolls the log
+	_style_scrollbar(_text.get_v_scroll_bar())
+	_text.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 13)
+	_text.add_theme_constant_override("line_separation", 1)
+	v.add_child(_text)
+	# The loading console: the other tab's page (LoadBar).
+	_load_bar = LoadBar.new()
+	_load_bar.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	v.add_child(_load_bar)
+	show_tab(tab)
+	if _lines.is_empty() and not _built_ahead():
+		(func(): post(welcome_line(), "good")).call_deferred()   # (after the scene's _ready: a loaded save's system known)
+	else:
+		_text.append_text("\n".join(_lines))
+		_scroll_to_end.call_deferred()
+
+
+## In a planet's surface built ahead (hidden, under the space scene): the log's
+## history is the game's (static) - that one mustn't clear it or welcome you again.
+func _built_ahead() -> bool:
+	var n := get_parent()
+	while n:
+		if n.get("prebuilding") == true and n != get_tree().current_scene:
+			return true
+		n = n.get_parent()
+	return false
+
+
+## Shows a tab: "events" (the event log) or "loading" (the loading console).
+func show_tab(which: String) -> void:
+	tab = which if which in ["events", "loading"] else "events"
+	_text.visible = tab == "events"
+	_load_bar.visible = tab == "loading"
+	for t in _tabs:
+		(_tabs[t] as Button).button_pressed = t == tab
+		(_tabs[t] as Button).modulate = Color.WHITE if t == tab else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.5)
+	_title.text = ("EVENT LOG" if tab == "events" else "LOADING") + "   (L to hide)"
+	if tab == "events":
+		_scroll_to_end.call_deferred()
+	else:
+		_load_bar.to_end.call_deferred()
+
+
+## The loading tab's icon: a line under it as long as the work under way is done.
+func _draw_load_progress(b: Button) -> void:
+	if _load_bar == null or not _load_bar.busy:
+		return
+	var w := b.size.x - 6.0
+	b.draw_rect(Rect2(3, b.size.y - 3.0, w, 2.0), Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.25))
+	b.draw_rect(Rect2(3, b.size.y - 3.0, w * clampf(_load_bar._share, 0.0, 1.0), 2.0), NeonTheme.CYAN)
+
+
+var _busy_was := false
+var _share_was := -1.0
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _load_bar and (_load_bar.busy != _busy_was or _load_bar._share != _share_was):
+		_busy_was = _load_bar.busy
+		_share_was = _load_bar._share
+		(_tabs["loading"] as Button).queue_redraw()
+	_time += delta
+	_merge_t += delta
+	if _merge_t >= MERGE_WINDOW:
+		_merge_t = 0.0
+		_flush()
+
+
+func _flush() -> void:
+	for target in _dealt:
+		var d: Array = _dealt[target]
+		_add("You dealt %d damage to %s%s" % [roundi(d[0] + d[1]), target, _split(d)], "combat")
+	for attacker in _taken:
+		var d: Array = _taken[attacker]
+		_add("%s hit you for %d%s" % [attacker, roundi(d[0] + d[1]), _split(d)], "danger" if d[1] > 0.0 else "combat")
+	for item in _loot:
+		_add("+%d %s" % [_loot[item], item], "loot")
+	_dealt.clear()
+	_taken.clear()
+	_loot.clear()
+
+
+static func _split(d: Array) -> String:
+	if d[0] > 0.0 and d[1] > 0.0:
+		return "  (shields %d, hull %d)" % [roundi(d[0]), roundi(d[1])]
+	return "  (shields)" if d[0] > 0.0 else "  (hull)"
+
+
+func _add(text: String, kind: String) -> void:
+	var col: Color = COLORS.get(kind, COLORS["info"])
+	var stamp := "%02d:%02d" % [int(_time / 60.0), int(_time) % 60]
+	var line := "[color=#6b7a8f]%s[/color]  [color=#%s]%s[/color]" % [stamp, col.to_html(false), text]
+	_lines.append(line)
+	if _text == null:
+		return
+	# Follow new lines only if the reader is already at the bottom; if they
+	# scrolled up to read older entries, leave the view where it is.
+	var bar := _text.get_v_scroll_bar()
+	var at_bottom := bar.value >= bar.max_value - bar.page - 4.0
+	if _lines.size() > MAX_LINES:
+		_lines.remove_at(0)
+		_text.remove_paragraph(0)
+	_text.append_text(("\n" if _lines.size() > 1 else "") + line)
+	if at_bottom:
+		_scroll_to_end.call_deferred()
+
+
+func _scroll_to_end() -> void:
+	var bar := _text.get_v_scroll_bar()
+	bar.value = bar.max_value
+
+
+## Panel style in the GUI palette (NeonTheme).
+func restyle() -> void:
+	var style := NeonTheme.box(Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.45), Color(NeonTheme.BG, 0.66), 1, 6, 10)
+	style.content_margin_left = 10
+	style.content_margin_right = 8
+	style.content_margin_top = 6
+	style.content_margin_bottom = 6
+	add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
+	for bar in find_children("*", "VScrollBar", true, false):
+		_style_scrollbar(bar)
+
+
+## A visible scroll bar that matches the HUD.
+static func _style_scrollbar(bar: VScrollBar) -> void:
+	bar.custom_minimum_size.x = 10
+	var track := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	track.bg_color = Color(NeonTheme.BG_LIGHT, 0.6)
+	track.border_color = Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.2)
+	track.set_border_width_all(1)
+	var grab := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	grab.bg_color = Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.7)
+	grab.corner_radius_top_left = 4
+	grab.corner_radius_bottom_right = 4
+	grab.corner_detail = 1
+	var grab_hover := grab.duplicate()
+	grab_hover.bg_color = NeonTheme.PINK
+	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("scroll", track)
+	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("scroll_focus", track)
+	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("grabber", grab)
+	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("grabber_highlight", grab_hover)
+	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("grabber_pressed", grab_hover)
+
+
+## The log's first line: where you are now (a new game starts in Knossos, the
+## Atrapos sector; a save loads wherever it was made).
+static func welcome_line() -> String:
+	var sys: String = Galaxy.current_system
+	var name := str(Galaxy.system(sys).get("name", "")) if Galaxy.systems.has(sys) else ""
+	if name == "":
+		return "Systems online. Welcome to New Hellas."
+	var owner := Galaxy.owner_of(sys)
+	var who := (" - " + Galaxy.empire_name(owner)) if owner != "" and owner != "independent" else ""
+	if sys == Galaxy.HOME:
+		return "Systems online. Welcome to New Hellas - you are in the %s system, its Atrapos sector%s." % [name, who]
+	return "Systems online. Welcome to New Hellas - you are in the %s system%s." % [name, who]
+
+
+## The console's LOADING tab: the history of what's been loaded, unloaded and
+## made (AssetPool.events: each sprite, each planet's plan and ground chunks,
+## each piece of a solar system) with a scroll bar like the log's - kept for the
+## whole session, there to look through after the loading's done; the memory
+## pool's total (AssetPool.summary); a progress bar (a planet being built, the
+## system streaming in, the ground round you on a planet, the pictures); and the
+## memory map. It keeps up with the work while the other tab is shown (the
+## tab's icon shows the progress).
+class LoadBar extends VBoxContainer:
+	const BAR_H := 18.0
+	const POOL_H := 16.0
+	const MAP_H := 12.0
+	const MAX_LINES := 1000
+	var busy := false
+	var _share := 0.0
+	var _text := ""
+	var _t := 0.0
+	var _seen := 0
+	var _lines := 0
+	var _log: Lines
+	var _pool: Control
+	var _bar: Control
+	var _map: MemMap
+	var _pool_text := ""
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		add_theme_constant_override("separation", 3)
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		_log = Lines.new()
+		_log.custom_minimum_size.y = 30.0
+		_log.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		add_child(_log)
+		_pool = Control.new()
+		_pool.custom_minimum_size.y = POOL_H
+		_pool.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		_pool.draw.connect(_draw_pool)
+		add_child(_pool)
+		_bar = Control.new()
+		_bar.custom_minimum_size.y = BAR_H
+		_bar.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		_bar.draw.connect(_draw_bar)
+		add_child(_bar)
+		# The memory map: the pool's room, by kind of asset (hover: what's in each).
+		_map = MemMap.new()
+		_map.custom_minimum_size.y = MAP_H
+		add_child(_map)
+		# The session's history so far (the console of the scene before had it too).
+		_take_events(AssetPool.events.size())
+		_seen = AssetPool.serial
+		_fit_text()
+		_log.to_end.call_deferred()
+
+	func to_end() -> void:
+		if _log:
+			_log.to_end()
+
+	## Its text's size: the event log's (13 at the HUD's text size - Settings).
+	static func fs() -> int:
+		return Settings.fs("hud", 13)
+
+	var _fs_was := 0
+
+	## The rows and bars sized to the text (again when the HUD's text size changes).
+	func _fit_text() -> void:
+		var f := fs()
+		if f == _fs_was:
+			return
+		_fs_was = f
+		_pool.custom_minimum_size.y = f + 4.0
+		_bar.custom_minimum_size.y = f + 6.0
+		_map.custom_minimum_size.y = maxf(MAP_H, f * 0.8)
+		_log.queue_redraw()
+		_log._fit_bar()
+		_pool.queue_redraw()
+		_bar.queue_redraw()
+
+	## The newest `n` notes added to the history.
+	func _take_events(n: int) -> void:
+		var ev: Array = AssetPool.events
+		var from := maxi(0, ev.size() - n)
+		var rows: Array = []
+		for k in range(from, ev.size()):
+			var e: Array = ev[k]
+			var col := Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.35) if e[2] == "unload" else (Color(0.62, 0.82, 1.0) if e[2] == "load" else Color(0.92, 0.95, 1.0))
+			var t := float(e[0])
+			rows.append(["%02d:%02d" % [int(t / 60.0), int(t) % 60], str(e[1]), col])
+		_log.add(rows)
+
+	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+		_t -= delta
+		if _t > 0.0:
+			return
+		_t = 0.25
+		_fit_text()
+		if AssetPool.serial != _seen:
+			_take_events(AssetPool.serial - _seen)
+			_seen = AssetPool.serial
+		var was := [busy, _share, _text, _pool_text]
+		busy = false
+		# A planet's surface being built (ahead, or for the landing under way)
+		# comes first - what it's doing; then the system streaming in; then the
+		# ground being made round you on a planet; else the pictures loading.
+		var scene := get_tree().current_scene
+		var pre = null
+		for k in ["_landing_surface", "_prebuilt"]:
+			var n = scene.get(k) if scene else null
+			if n != null and is_instance_valid(n) and n.get("is_built") == false:
+				pre = n
+				break
+		if scene and scene.has_method("stream_progress"):
+			var c: Vector2i = scene.stream_progress()
+			if c.x < c.y:
+				busy = true
+				_share = float(c.x) / maxf(1.0, c.y)
+				_text = "%s system: streaming in  (%d / %d pieces)" % [str(Galaxy.SYSTEMS[Galaxy.current_system]["name"]), c.x, c.y]
+		if not busy and pre != null:
+			busy = true
+			_share = float(pre.build_progress)
+			var pname := str(Planets.get_planet(str(pre.planet_id)).get("name", ""))
+			_text = "%s: %s  %d%%" % [pname, str(pre.build_stage) if str(pre.build_stage) != "" else "preparing", roundi(_share * 100.0)]
+		if not busy and scene and scene.has_method("near_progress") and str(scene.get("build_stage")) != "":
+			var c: Vector2i = scene.near_progress()
+			if c.x < c.y:
+				busy = true
+				_share = float(c.x) / maxf(1.0, c.y)
+				_text = "%s: making the ground round you  (%d / %d chunks)" % [str(scene.pdata.get("name", "")), c.x, c.y]
+		if not busy and not ProcArt.all_ready():
+			busy = true
+			_share = ProcArt.overall()
+			var c: Vector2i = ProcArt.counts()
+			_text = "Loading %s  (%d / %d)" % [ProcArt.stage, c.x, c.y] if not ProcArt.ready_done or ProcArt.stage != "Ready" else "Loading the game's scenes"
+		if not busy:
+			_share = 1.0
+			_text = "All loaded"
+		_pool_text = AssetPool.summary()
+		if [busy, _share, _text, _pool_text] != was:
+			_bar.queue_redraw()
+			_pool.queue_redraw()
+
+	func _draw_bar() -> void:
+		var r := Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, _bar.size)
+		var font := get_theme_default_font()
+		_bar.draw_rect(r, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35))
+		_bar.draw_rect(Rect2(r.position, Vector2(r.size.x * clampf(_share, 0.0, 1.0), r.size.y)), Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.55 if busy else 0.25))
+		_bar.draw_rect(r, Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.5), false, 1.0)
+		_bar.draw_string(font, Vector2(5, (r.size.y + fs() * 0.72) / 2.0), _text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, r.size.x - 10.0, fs(), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.92))
+
+	func _draw_pool() -> void:
+		var w := _pool.size.x
+		var font := get_theme_default_font()
+		# A thin gauge of used / budget under its line (orange past 90%).
+		var k := clampf(float(AssetPool.used) / maxf(1.0, AssetPool.budget), 0.0, 1.0)
+		var h := _pool.size.y
+		_pool.draw_rect(Rect2(0, h - 2.0, w, 2.0), Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.15))
+		_pool.draw_rect(Rect2(0, h - 2.0, w * k, 2.0), Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.35, 0.8) if k > 0.9 else Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.6))
+		_pool.draw_string(font, Vector2(0, h - 4.0), _pool_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, w, fs(), Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.95))
+
+
+## The memory pool's map (the loading console, under its bar): its whole room
+## (AssetPool.budget) as a strip, each kind of asset an area as wide as the
+## memory it takes, in its colour (AssetPool.KINDS), the free room dark. Over
+## an area: a tooltip - how many, how much, its share, its biggest assets with
+## their sizes and priorities.
+class MemMap extends Control:
+	var _parts: Array = []
+	var _t := 0.0
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		tooltip_text = " "   # (tooltips on: the text comes from _get_tooltip)
+
+	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+		_t -= delta
+		if _t > 0.0 or not is_visible_in_tree():
+			return
+		_t = 0.5
+		_parts = AssetPool.breakdown()
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	## [kind's dictionary, x0, x1] along the strip.
+	func _spans() -> Array:
+		var out := []
+		var room := maxf(1.0, float(maxi(AssetPool.budget, AssetPool.used)))
+		var x := 0.0
+		for d in _parts:
+			var w: float = size.x * float(d["bytes"]) / room
+			out.append([d, x, x + w])
+			x += w
+		return out
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		var r := Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size)
+		draw_rect(r, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45))
+		var hot := get_local_mouse_position() if Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size).has_point(get_local_mouse_position()) else Vector2(-1, -1)
+		for sp in _spans():
+			var c: Color = sp[0]["color"]
+			var box := Rect2(sp[1], 0.0, maxf(1.0, sp[2] - sp[1]), size.y)
+			draw_rect(box, c.lightened(0.25) if box.has_point(hot) else Color(c, 0.85))
+			if box.size.x > 3.0:
+				draw_line(Vector2(box.end.x, 0), Vector2(box.end.x, size.y), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 1.0)
+		draw_rect(r, Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.5), false, 1.0)
+
+	func _gui_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
+		if e is InputEventMouseMotion:
+			queue_redraw()
+
+	func _get_tooltip(at: Vector2) -> String:
+		for sp in _spans():
+			if at.x >= sp[1] and at.x < sp[2]:
+				var d: Dictionary = sp[0]
+				var lines := PackedStringArray()
+				lines.append("%s - %d assets, %s  (%d%% of the pool's room)" % [d["name"], d["count"], AssetPool.mb(d["bytes"]),
+					roundi(100.0 * d["bytes"] / maxf(1.0, AssetPool.budget))])
+				lines.append("The biggest (size, priority - the least used are unloaded first if the pool runs out of room):")
+				for it in d["top"]:
+					lines.append("   %s   %s   priority %.1f" % [it[0], AssetPool.mb(it[1]), it[2]])
+				return "\n".join(lines)
+		return "Free room: %s of %s  (the pool keeps twice what the game usually needs)" % [
+			AssetPool.mb(maxi(0, AssetPool.budget - AssetPool.used)), AssetPool.mb(AssetPool.budget)]
+
+
+## The loading console's history: lines kept in a list, only the rows in view
+## drawn (a label holding 1000 lines laid all its text out again whenever lines
+## came and old ones went: a 45 ms frame every second while planets were built).
+## A scroll bar (styled like the event log's) and the mouse wheel move it; it
+## follows new lines only while you're at the bottom.
+class Lines extends Control:
+	const MAX := 1000
+	var rows: Array = []   # [stamp, text, colour]
+	var _bar: VScrollBar
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		clip_contents = true
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		_bar = VScrollBar.new()
+		GameLog._style_scrollbar(_bar)
+		_bar.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_RIGHT_WIDE)
+		_bar.offset_left = -10
+		_bar.step = 1.0
+		_bar.value_changed.connect(func(_v): queue_redraw())
+		add_child(_bar)
+		resized.connect(_fit_bar)
+
+	## A row's height: the text's size (the HUD's) and a little.
+	func _row() -> float:
+		return LoadBar.fs() + 3.0
+
+	func _visible_rows() -> int:
+		return maxi(1, floori(size.y / _row()))
+
+	func _fit_bar() -> void:
+		_bar.max_value = rows.size()
+		_bar.page = _visible_rows()
+		_bar.visible = rows.size() > _visible_rows()
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	func at_end() -> bool:
+		return _bar.value >= _bar.max_value - _bar.page - 0.5
+
+	func to_end() -> void:
+		_bar.value = maxf(0.0, _bar.max_value - _bar.page)
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	func add(new_rows: Array) -> void:
+		if new_rows.is_empty():
+			return
+		var follow := at_end()
+		rows.append_array(new_rows)
+		var cut := rows.size() - MAX
+		if cut > 0:
+			rows = rows.slice(cut)
+			if not follow:
+				_bar.value = maxf(0.0, _bar.value - cut)   # (the lines you're reading stay in view)
+		_fit_bar()
+		if follow:
+			to_end()
+
+	func _gui_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
+		if e is InputEventMouseButton and e.pressed:
+			if e.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
+				_bar.value -= 3
+				accept_event()
+			elif e.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
+				_bar.value += 3
+				accept_event()
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		var font := get_theme_default_font()
+		var first := int(_bar.value)
+		var w := size.x - (14.0 if _bar.visible else 2.0)
+		var f := LoadBar.fs()
+		var row := _row()
+		var gap := font.get_string_size("00:00  ", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, f).x
+		for i in _visible_rows():
+			var k := first + i
+			if k >= rows.size():
+				break
+			var r: Array = rows[k]
+			var y := i * row + row - 3.0
+			draw_string(font, Vector2(0, y), r[0], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, f, Color(0.42, 0.48, 0.56))
+			draw_string(font, Vector2(gap, y), r[1], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, w - gap, f, r[2])
+

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: A ship's exhaust trail, after the reference sheet (Downloads, 80s-anime jets): a billowing, lumpy cloud of exhaust in the trail's colour, darker and more smoky as it drifts back, with crackling lightning-like streaks of light running through it, a white-hot plume at the nozzle, and a thin curling tip. It follows where the nozzle has been (world space), so turns leave curves; each puff leaves the nozzle with the ship's own velocity plus a push out backward (EJECT), then slows to rest (DRAG) - so it streams straight out behind the nozzle whichever way the ship points, even turning hard at full speed (the flame and the trail agree), and settles along the path behind - and every part fades with age - a trail is a few hundred px long, never the whole window. Styles: "blue", "orange", "magenta" (the reference's three). Added to a ship by ExhaustTrail.attach(ship, style); reads the ship's nozzle position, heading and thrust each frame (player Ship or Enemy). (Moved from scripts/exhaust_trail.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,399 @@ 
+class_name ExhaustTrail
+extends Node2D
+## A ship's exhaust trail, after the reference sheet (Downloads, 80s-anime
+## jets): a billowing, lumpy cloud of exhaust in the trail's colour, darker and
+## more smoky as it drifts back, with crackling lightning-like streaks of light
+## running through it, a white-hot plume at the nozzle, and a thin curling tip.
+## It follows where the nozzle has been (world space), so turns leave curves;
+## each puff leaves the nozzle with the ship's own velocity plus a push out
+## backward (EJECT), then slows to rest (DRAG) - so it streams straight out
+## behind the nozzle whichever way the ship points, even turning hard at full
+## speed (the flame and the trail agree), and settles along the path behind -
+## and every part fades with age - a trail is a few hundred px long, never
+## the whole window. Styles: "blue", "orange", "magenta" (the reference's three).
+##
+## Added to a ship by ExhaustTrail.attach(ship, style); reads the ship's
+## nozzle position, heading and thrust each frame (player Ship or Enemy).
+
+const STYLES := {
+	# cloud near the nozzle, cloud far back, streaks / core, plume tip
+	"blue": [Color(0.16, 0.56, 1.0), Color(0.12, 0.3, 0.8), Color(0.72, 0.95, 1.0), Color(0.35, 0.8, 1.0)],
+	"orange": [Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.1), Color(0.8, 0.28, 0.12), Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.55), Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.2)],
+	"magenta": [Color(0.98, 0.28, 0.78), Color(0.56, 0.3, 0.9), Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.96), Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.85)],
+}
+const LIFE := 1.6                   # seconds a puff of exhaust lasts
+const SPACING := 12.0               # px between trail points (the puffs overlap well: fewer to draw)
+const STREAKS := 3
+const EJECT := 2.2                  # a puff's speed out of the nozzle at full thrust: max_len per second this many (far quicker than the ship: a straight jet)
+const ATTACH := 0.25                # s: fresh exhaust drawn fixed to the nozzle, easing free
+const DRAG := 5.0                   # how fast it slows (per second: it comes to rest ~EJECT/DRAG max_len out)
+
+var ship: Node2D
+var style := "blue"
+var width := 14.0                   # the cloud's half-width at its fullest
+var max_len := 600.0                # never longer than this (px)
+# The trail's points, newest first (packed arrays: dictionaries per point
+# were most of a trail's cost): where, born when, thrust 0..1, its puff's seed.
+var _pp := PackedVector2Array()
+var _pt := PackedFloat32Array()
+var _pk := PackedFloat32Array()
+var _ps := PackedFloat32Array()
+var _pv := PackedVector2Array()     # each point's drift (px/s: thrown out of the nozzle)
+var _moved_at := -1.0               # (_time the points last drifted)
+var _time := 0.0
+var _glow: Node2D                   # additive layer: streaks and core
+var _plume: Node2D                  # additive layer: the plume at the nozzle (every frame)
+## The cloud and its streaks are redrawn this often (a second): the points
+## move on every frame, but a picture of the cloud 60 times a second is what
+## a screen shows - at 240 FPS, redrawing every trail every frame was the
+## biggest cost of a battle.
+const CLOUD_HZ := 60.0
+var _flick := 0                     # re-jags the streaks a few times a second
+var _seed := 0
+var _count := 0                    # points made so far (puffs follow it)
+
+
+## Gives `ship` a trail (sized from its length): returns it.
+static func attach(s: Node2D, trail_style: String, ship_length: float) -> ExhaustTrail:
+	var t := ExhaustTrail.new()
+	t.ship = s
+	t.style = trail_style if STYLES.has(trail_style) else "blue"
+	t.width = clampf(ship_length * 0.22, 11.0, 50.0)
+	t.max_len = clampf(ship_length * 5.0, 320.0, 760.0)
+	s.add_child(t)
+	return t
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	name = "ExhaustTrail"
+	top_level = true                # (world coordinates: the trail stays where it was left)
+	z_as_relative = true
+	z_index = -1
+	texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS   # (the puffs' disc, small far back)
+	_seed = randi()
+	_glow = Node2D.new()
+	_glow.top_level = true
+	_glow.z_index = -1
+	var m := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
+	m.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
+	_glow.material = m
+	_glow.draw.connect(_draw_glow)
+	add_child(_glow)
+	_plume = Node2D.new()
+	_plume.top_level = true
+	_plume.z_index = -1
+	_plume.material = m
+	_plume.draw.connect(_draw_plume)
+	add_child(_plume)
+
+
+## The ship's nozzle (world), backwards direction, thrust 0..1 and velocity.
+func _engine() -> Array:
+	if ship.get("engine_offset") != null:   # the player's Ship: rotates as a whole, nose to -Y
+		var back: Vector2 = (ship.global_transform.basis_xform(Vector2(0, 1))).normalized()
+		var nozzle: Vector2 = ship.global_transform * (ship.engine_offset + Vector2(0, 4))
+		var boost := 1.25 if float(ship.get("boost_time")) > 0.0 else 1.0
+		var sv: Vector2 = ship.get("velocity") if ship.get("velocity") != null else Vector2.ZERO
+		return [nozzle, back, clampf(float(ship.thrust) * boost, 0.0, 1.3), sv]
+	# An Enemy: its body turns (nose to -Y), the node doesn't.
+	var body: Node2D = ship.get("body")
+	var rot: float = body.global_rotation if body else 0.0
+	var back2 := Vector2(0, 1).rotated(rot)
+	var half: float = float(ship.get("_half_height")) if ship.get("_half_height") != null else 40.0
+	var v: Vector2 = ship.get("velocity") if ship.get("velocity") != null else Vector2.ZERO
+	var top: float = maxf(float(ship.get("max_speed")), 1.0)
+	return [ship.global_position + back2 * half * 0.82, back2, clampf(v.length() / top, 0.0, 1.0), v]
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_time += delta
+	global_position = Vector2.ZERO
+	global_rotation = 0.0
+	_glow.global_position = Vector2.ZERO
+	# The plume rides the nozzle: its node moved there each frame (no redraw),
+	# its picture redrawn CLOUD_HZ times a second like the cloud (redrawing
+	# every ship's plume every frame was a battle's biggest drawing cost).
+	var live: bool = is_instance_valid(ship) and ship.has_method("is_alive") and ship.is_alive()
+	if live:
+		var pe := _engine()
+		if (pe[0] as Vector2).is_finite() and (pe[1] as Vector2).length() > 0.5:
+			_plume.global_position = pe[0]
+			_plume.global_rotation = (pe[1] as Vector2).angle() - PI * 0.5   # (its +Y: backward out of the nozzle)
+			_plume_k = pe[2]
+	# (the cloud: kept up and redrawn CLOUD_HZ times a second for your ship;
+	# others' half as often, and off screen just kept up, 10 times a second -
+	# the trails were the biggest script cost in space)
+	var hz := CLOUD_HZ if ship != null and ship.get("engine_offset") != null else (CLOUD_HZ * 0.5 if _on_screen() else 10.0)
+	if not UI.redraw_due(self, hz):
+		return
+	_plume.queue_redraw()
+	# The exhaust drifts the way it was thrown, slowing.
+	var dt := clampf(_time - _moved_at, 0.0, 0.1) if _moved_at >= 0.0 else 0.0
+	_moved_at = _time
+	if dt > 0.0:
+		var slow := exp(-DRAG * dt)
+		for i in range(1, _pp.size()):
+			_pp[i] += _pv[i] * dt
+			_pv[i] *= slow
+	var alive: bool = is_instance_valid(ship) and ship.has_method("is_alive") and ship.is_alive() and ship.visible
+	if alive:
+		var e := _engine()
+		var nozzle: Vector2 = e[0]
+		var k: float = e[2]
+		# (Pushed out hard even at low thrust - turning, the ship throttles back,
+		# and a weak push would leave the newest exhaust on the old path, off
+		# the flame; low thrust shows as faint exhaust instead.)
+		var thrown: Vector2 = e[3] + e[1] * EJECT * max_len * (0.6 + 0.4 * minf(k, 1.0))
+		# The newest point rides the nozzle; once it's SPACING past the last
+		# fixed one it stays put and a new one starts.
+		if _pp.size() < 2 or nozzle.distance_to(_pp[1]) >= SPACING:
+			_count += 1
+			_pp.insert(0, nozzle)
+			_pt.insert(0, _time)
+			_pk.insert(0, k)
+			_ps.insert(0, float(_count))
+			_pv.insert(0, thrown)
+		else:
+			_pp[0] = nozzle
+			_pk[0] = k
+			_pt[0] = _time
+			_pv[0] = thrown
+	# Old puffs fade out; the trail never reaches past max_len from the nozzle
+	# (straight out: measured along it, a spin's spray of exhaust - zigzagging
+	# from one direction to the next - would be cut off early).
+	var keep := 0
+	for i in _pp.size():
+		if _time - _pt[i] > LIFE or (i > 0 and _pp[i].distance_to(_pp[0]) > max_len):
+			break
+		keep = i + 1
+	_pp.resize(keep)
+	_pt.resize(keep)
+	_pk.resize(keep)
+	_ps.resize(keep)
+	_pv.resize(keep)
+	if Engine.get_process_frames() % 4 == 0:
+		_flick += 1
+	queue_redraw()
+	_glow.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _on_screen() -> bool:
+	if _pp.is_empty():
+		return false
+	var vr := get_viewport_rect()
+	var ct := get_canvas_transform()
+	var p: Vector2 = ct * _pp[0]
+	return vr.grow(max_len * ct.get_scale().x + 50.0).has_point(p)
+
+
+## Per point (worked out once a frame - the cloud and the glow both use it):
+## its place, side vector, distance along the trail (0..1), age (0..1), fade
+## and the cloud's half-width there.
+var _fp := PackedVector2Array()
+var _fs := PackedVector2Array()
+var _fu := PackedFloat32Array()
+var _fa := PackedFloat32Array()
+var _ff := PackedFloat32Array()
+var _fh := PackedFloat32Array()
+var _f_at := -1
+
+func _frame() -> void:
+	var now := Engine.get_process_frames()
+	if now == _f_at:
+		return
+	_f_at = now
+	var n := _pp.size()
+	_fp = _pp.duplicate()   # (packed arrays are shared, not copied, by `=`: the points may change before it's drawn)
+	# The fresh exhaust is drawn as a flame fixed to the nozzle: straight out
+	# behind it (at each puff's own distance), easing over ATTACH seconds into
+	# where it has really drifted - so however hard the ship turns or changes
+	# speed, the trail leaves the nozzle along the flame, then bends away.
+	if n > 1 and is_instance_valid(ship) and ship.has_method("is_alive") and ship.is_alive():
+		var e := _engine()
+		var nozzle: Vector2 = e[0]
+		var back: Vector2 = e[1]
+		for i in range(1, n):
+			var w := 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, ATTACH, _time - _pt[i])
+			if w <= 0.0:
+				break
+			_fp[i] = _pp[i].lerp(nozzle + back * nozzle.distance_to(_pp[i]), w)
+	_fs.resize(n)
+	_fu.resize(n)
+	_fa.resize(n)
+	_ff.resize(n)
+	_fh.resize(n)
+	var along := 0.0
+	var inv := 1.0 / maxf(max_len, 1.0)
+	for i in n:
+		var p: Vector2 = _fp[i]
+		if i > 0:
+			along += p.distance_to(_fp[i - 1])
+		var dir: Vector2 = _fp[mini(i + 1, n - 1)] - _fp[maxi(i - 1, 0)]
+		if dir.length() < 0.01:
+			dir = Vector2(0, 1)
+		_fs[i] = dir.normalized().orthogonal()
+		var age := (_time - _pt[i]) / LIFE
+		var u := along * inv
+		_fu[i] = u
+		_fa[i] = age
+		# (sqrt: turning, the ship throttles right back - its exhaust still shows,
+		# streaming out along the flame, instead of only the jet from before the turn)
+		_ff[i] = pow(clampf(1.0 - age, 0.0, 1.0), 1.4) * clampf(sqrt(maxf(_pk[i], 0.0)) * 1.4, 0.0, 1.0)
+		_fh[i] = _half(u, age, _ps[i])
+
+
+## The cloud's half-width at a point: narrow at the nozzle, billowing out as
+## it spreads with age, lumpy (each puff its own size), tapering to a thin tip.
+func _half(u: float, age: float, seed: float) -> float:
+	var grow := 0.3 + 0.7 * smoothstep(0.0, 0.28, u)
+	var tip := pow(1.0 - smoothstep(0.42, 1.0, u), 1.2)
+	# Puffs: round billows of different sizes, fixed to the exhaust as it drifts.
+	var lump := 0.78 + 0.22 * sin(seed * 0.83) + 0.12 * sin(seed * 2.1 + 1.0)
+	return width * grow * tip * lump * (1.0 + 1.1 * age * (1.0 - u * 0.6))
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if not _on_screen() or _pp.size() < 2:
+		return
+	var s: Array = STYLES[style]
+	_frame()
+	var n := _fp.size()
+	# The billowing exhaust, cel-shaded like the reference: round puffs in three
+	# flat tones - a darker shade on one side, the body, a light band along the
+	# other - drawn tail first so the fresh puffs sit on top.
+	var c0: Color = s[0]
+	var c1: Color = s[1]
+	var cols := PackedColorArray()
+	var alpha := PackedFloat32Array()
+	cols.resize(n)
+	alpha.resize(n)
+	for i in n:
+		cols[i] = c0.lerp(c1, clampf(_fu[i] * 1.2, 0.0, 1.0))
+		alpha[i] = clampf(_ff[i] * 1.8, 0.0, 1.0)   # (opaque, like the reference, until the tail fades)
+	var tex := disc()
+	for tone in 3:
+		for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
+			var a: float = alpha[i]
+			var r: float = _fh[i]
+			if a <= 0.02 or r < 0.8:
+				continue
+			var side: Vector2 = _fs[i]
+			var at: Vector2
+			var rr: float
+			var c: Color
+			match tone:
+				0:
+					at = _fp[i] + side * r * 0.18
+					rr = r * 1.06
+					c = Color(cols[i].darkened(0.42), 0.9 * a)
+				1:
+					at = _fp[i] - side * r * 0.04
+					rr = r * 0.9
+					c = Color(cols[i], 0.92 * a)
+				_:
+					at = _fp[i] - side * r * 0.34
+					rr = r * 0.46
+					c = Color(cols[i].lightened(0.3), 0.8 * a)
+			draw_texture_rect(tex, Rect2(at.x - rr, at.y - rr, rr * 2.0, rr * 2.0), false, c)
+
+
+## A puff: the baked disc (one texture for every puff of every trail - Godot
+## batches them into a few draw calls; anti-aliased draw_circle()s, hundreds a
+## frame, cost a battle half its frame time).
+func _puff(at: Vector2, r: float, c: Color) -> void:
+	draw_texture_rect(disc(), Rect2(at - Vector2(r, r), Vector2(r, r) * 2.0), false, c)
+
+
+static var _disc: Texture2D
+
+## A white disc with a one-pixel soft edge (as draw_circle's anti-aliasing), 128 px.
+static func disc() -> Texture2D:
+	if _disc == null:
+		var n := 128
+		var img := Image.create(n, n, true, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+		var c := (n - 1) * 0.5
+		for y in n:
+			for x in n:
+				var d := Vector2(x - c, y - c).length()
+				img.set_pixel(x, y, Color(1, 1, 1, clampf(c - d + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)))
+		img.generate_mipmaps()
+		_disc = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+	return _disc
+
+
+func _draw_glow() -> void:
+	if not _on_screen() or _pp.size() < 2:
+		return
+	var s: Array = STYLES[style]
+	_frame()
+	var n := _fp.size()
+	var ci := _glow
+	var hot: Color = s[2]
+	# The hot core: white-hot near the nozzle, gone a quarter of the way back.
+	var core := PackedVector2Array()
+	var core_c := PackedColorArray()
+	for i in n:
+		if _fu[i] > 0.28:
+			break
+		core.append(_fp[i])
+		core_c.append(Color(hot, _ff[i] * 0.8 * (1.0 - _fu[i] / 0.28)))
+	if core.size() >= 2:
+		ci.draw_polyline_colors(core, core_c, width * 0.45, true)
+	# Lightning-like streaks crackling through the cloud (re-jagged often) -
+	# all three in one pass over the points, the jags from a cheap hash.
+	var l0 := PackedVector2Array()
+	var l1 := PackedVector2Array()
+	var l2 := PackedVector2Array()
+	var k0 := PackedColorArray()
+	var k1 := PackedColorArray()
+	var k2 := PackedColorArray()
+	var ph0 := fposmod(sin(float(_seed % 9973) * 0.731) * 43758.5453, 1.0) * TAU
+	var ph1 := fposmod(sin(float(_seed % 9973) * 0.731 + 12.9898) * 43758.5453, 1.0) * TAU
+	var ph2 := fposmod(sin(float(_seed % 9973) * 0.731 + 25.9796) * 43758.5453, 1.0) * TAU
+	var flick := float(_flick) * 37.719
+	var t3 := _time * 3.0
+	for i in range(0, n, 2):   # (every other point: jagged enough, half the cost - the costliest drawing of a battle)
+		var u: float = _fu[i]
+		if u > 0.9:
+			break
+		var w: float = _fh[i] * 0.7
+		var sw: Vector2 = _fs[i] * w
+		var base: float = _ff[i] * (1.0 - u * 0.8)
+		var fi := i * 12.9898 + flick
+		l0.append(_fp[i] + sw * (sin(ph0 + u * 9.0 + t3) * 0.55 + fposmod(sin(fi) * 43758.5453, 1.0) * 0.5 - 0.25))
+		l1.append(_fp[i] + sw * (sin(ph1 + u * 13.0 + t3) * 0.55 + fposmod(sin(fi + 78.233) * 43758.5453, 1.0) * 0.5 - 0.25))
+		l2.append(_fp[i] + sw * (sin(ph2 + u * 17.0 + t3) * 0.55 + fposmod(sin(fi + 156.466) * 43758.5453, 1.0) * 0.5 - 0.25))
+		k0.append(Color(hot, base))
+		k1.append(Color(hot, base * 0.8))
+		k2.append(Color(hot, base * 0.6))
+	if l0.size() >= 2:
+		ci.draw_polyline_colors(l0, k0, 2.2, true)
+		ci.draw_polyline_colors(l1, k1, 1.4, true)
+		ci.draw_polyline_colors(l2, k2, 1.4, true)
+
+
+## The plume: white-hot at the nozzle, a flame of the trail's colour behind -
+## redrawn every frame (it rides the nozzle; the cloud behind it at CLOUD_HZ).
+var _plume_k := 0.0   # the thrust the plume shows (set each frame)
+
+func _draw_plume() -> void:
+	var s: Array = STYLES[style]
+	var ci := _plume
+	if not _on_screen():
+		return
+	if is_instance_valid(ship) and ship.has_method("is_alive") and ship.is_alive():
+		var k2 := _plume_k
+		if k2 > 0.03:
+			# (In the plume node's own space - it sits on the nozzle, +Y backward -
+			# which also keeps the small triangles precise far out, at the signal sites.)
+			var back := Vector2(0, 1)
+			var side := Vector2(1, 0)
+			var length := width * (2.2 + 2.0 * k2) * randf_range(0.9, 1.1)
+			var wd := width * 0.5
+			if length < 2.0:
+				return
+			ci.draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([side * wd, -side * wd, back * length]), Color(s[3], 0.55 * k2))
+			ci.draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([side * wd * 0.5, -side * wd * 0.5, back * length * 0.6]), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.75 * k2))
+			var dt := disc()
+			ci.draw_texture_rect(dt, Rect2(-Vector2.ONE * wd * 1.6, Vector2.ONE * wd * 3.2), false, Color(s[3], 0.22 * k2))
+			ci.draw_texture_rect(dt, Rect2(-Vector2.ONE * wd * 0.75, Vector2.ONE * wd * 1.5), false, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.65 * k2))

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The FPS counter: a small readout at the top right - frames a second and the frame time - over every scene (Settings adds one to the root at startup, like the CRT filter). Shown while Settings.fps_counter is on (the settings page's "FPS counter" switch); the number is refreshed EVERY s, coloured green at 60 and above, amber down to 45, red below. (Moved from scripts/fps_counter.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,123 @@ 
+class_name FpsCounter
+extends CanvasLayer
+## The FPS counter: a small readout at the top right -
+## frames a second and the frame time - over every scene (Settings adds one
+## to the root at startup, like the CRT filter). Shown while
+## Settings.fps_counter is on (the settings page's "FPS counter" switch);
+## the number is refreshed EVERY s, coloured green at 60 and above, amber
+## down to 45, red below.
+
+const EVERY := 0.25
+
+var label: Label
+var graph: Graph
+var _t := 0.0
+var _frames := 0
+var _time := 0.0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	layer = 4   # (over the HUD - under the full-screen windows: the computers, a station, the Esc menu)
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	label = Label.new()
+	# Top right, left of the tutorial's icon and the missions.
+	label.anchor_left = 1.0
+	label.anchor_right = 1.0
+	label.anchor_top = 0.0
+	label.anchor_bottom = 0.0
+	label.offset_left = -470
+	label.offset_right = -330
+	label.offset_top = 10
+	label.offset_bottom = 34
+	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
+	label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
+	label.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 4)
+	label.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.8))
+	add_child(label)
+	# The live graph under it: each frame's time, the last SAMPLES frames.
+	graph = Graph.new()
+	graph.anchor_left = 1.0
+	graph.anchor_right = 1.0
+	graph.offset_left = -470
+	graph.offset_right = -330
+	graph.offset_top = 36
+	graph.offset_bottom = 84
+	graph.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	add_child(graph)
+	_update()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	visible = Settings.fps_counter
+	if not visible:
+		return
+	_frames += 1
+	_time += delta
+	_t += delta
+	graph.push(delta * 1000.0)
+	if _t >= EVERY:
+		_update()
+
+
+## The readout from the frames counted since the last one.
+func _update() -> void:
+	var fps := _frames / _time if _time > 0.0 else Engine.get_frames_per_second()
+	var ms := _time / _frames * 1000.0 if _frames > 0 else 0.0
+	label.text = "%d FPS  %.1f ms" % [roundi(fps), ms]
+	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55) if fps >= 59.0 else (Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.3) if fps >= 45.0 else Color(1.0, 0.4, 0.35)))
+	_t = 0.0
+	_frames = 0
+	_time = 0.0
+
+
+## The real-time frame-time graph: the last SAMPLES frames (newest at the
+## right), on a scale that fits the worst of them (8, 17, 34 or 67 ms - shown
+## top left), with lines at 600, 240 and 60 FPS (1.7, 4.2 and 16.7 ms); a frame
+## over even 67 ms shows a red bar at the top. Redrawn 30 times
+## a second (one polyline - it mustn't cost what it measures).
+class Graph extends Control:
+	const SAMPLES := 140
+	const TOP := 8.0   # ms at the top of the graph
+	var _ms := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var _i := 0
+	var _t := 0.0
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		_ms.resize(SAMPLES)
+
+	func push(ms: float) -> void:
+		_ms[_i] = ms
+		_i = (_i + 1) % SAMPLES
+		_t += ms / 1000.0
+		if _t >= 1.0 / 30.0:
+			_t = 0.0
+			queue_redraw()
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		var w := size.x
+		var h := size.y
+		draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45))
+		var worst := 0.0
+		for v in _ms:
+			worst = maxf(worst, v)
+		# The scale: the smallest of these that holds the worst recent frame.
+		var top := TOP
+		for t in [8.0, 17.0, 34.0, 67.0]:
+			top = t
+			if worst <= t:
+				break
+		for ref in [[1000.0 / 600.0, Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55, 0.45)], [1000.0 / 240.0, Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.3, 0.45)], [1000.0 / 60.0, Color(1.0, 0.4, 0.35, 0.45)]]:
+			if float(ref[0]) < top:
+				var y: float = h - h * float(ref[0]) / top
+				draw_line(Vector2(0, y), Vector2(w, y), ref[1], 1.0)
+		var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+		pts.resize(SAMPLES)
+		for k in SAMPLES:
+			var v := _ms[(_i + k) % SAMPLES]
+			pts[k] = Vector2(w * k / float(SAMPLES - 1), h - h * minf(v, top) / top)
+		draw_polyline(pts, Color(0.55, 0.85, 1.0), 1.0)
+		if worst > top:
+			draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, w, 2), Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.3))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.15), false, 1.0)
+		draw_string(ThemeDB.fallback_font, Vector2(3, 11), "%d ms" % roundi(top), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 10, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55))

+		"border_width": 0.7, "glow": 1.6, "sheen": 0.7, "tooltip_color": Color(0.75, 0.9, 1.0)}
+	t["mono"] = {"name": "Monochrome", "main_color": Color(0.85, 0.85, 0.88), "highlight_color": Color(1, 1, 1),

+	["bg_color", "Panel background", "color", 0, 0, "The dark glass of panels and windows.", []],
+	["bg_light", "Light background", "color", 0, 0, "Lighter areas: input fields, list rows, raised panels.", []],
+	["panel_alpha", "Panel opacity", "float", 0.3, 1.0, "How see-through panels are (1: solid).", []],
+	["button_fill", "Button fill", "color", 0, 0, "The inside of buttons.", []],
+	["#", "Shape and glow"],
+	["corner_cut", "Corner cut", "float", 0.0, 3.0, "Size of the cut corners (0: square corners).", []],
+	["border_width", "Border width", "float", 0.3, 3.0, "Thickness of every border.", []],
+	["glow", "Glow", "float", 0.0, 3.0, "Width of the neon glow around boxes.", []],
+	["sheen", "Sheen", "float", 0.0, 1.0, "The light sheen along the top of buttons.", []],
+]
+const STRUCTURAL := []
+
+
+static func base_value(key: String) -> Variant:
+	return BASE.get(key)
+
+
+static func generate(template: String, variant := 0) -> Dictionary:
+	var p: Dictionary = BASE.duplicate()
+	p.merge(TEMPLATES.get(template, TEMPLATES["neon"]), true)
+	p["template"] = template
+	p["variant"] = variant
+	if variant != 0:
+		var g: float = fposmod(float(variant) * 0.618034, 1.0)
+		for k in ["main_color", "highlight_color", "tooltip_color"]:
+			var c: Color = p[k]
+			p[k] = Color.from_hsv(fposmod(c.h + g, 1.0), c.s, c.v)
+	return p
+
+
+static func describe(p: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return "%s - the look of every window, button and tooltip (applies at once)" % p.get("name", "GUI")
+
+
+## Applies a whole look to the interface.
+static func apply_all(look: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var l := {}
+	for k in BASE:
+		l[k] = look.get(k, BASE[k])
+	NeonTheme.apply_look(l)
+
+
+## One property (live editing): `node` keeps the look in meta "look".
+static func apply(node: Node, key: String, value: Variant) -> void:
+	if node == null:
+		return
+	var look: Dictionary = node.get_meta("look", {})
+	look[key] = value
+	node.set_meta("look", look)
+	apply_all(look)

+## the circle, clockwise from the top, an icon for each affliction (a damaged

+## A ship's gauge (`fuel` given) has a third ring outside the shield's: its

+var silhouette: Texture2D:
+	set(t):

+var _shape: TextureRect
+var _icons: Control

+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	var side := _outer() + 2.0 * (AfflictionBar.ICON + ICON_GAP)
+	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(side, side)
+	mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	if fuel.is_valid():
+		var d := _outer()
+		_fuel_ring = ColorRect.new()
+		_fuel_ring.size = Vector2(d, d)
+		_fuel_ring.position = Vector2((side - d) / 2.0, (side - d) / 2.0)
+		_fuel_ring.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		var fm_ := ShaderMaterial.new()
+		fm_.shader = RING_SHADER

+		fm_.set_shader_parameter("inner", (RING / 2.0 + 3.0) / (d / 2.0))

+		fm_.set_shader_parameter("liquid", fuel_liquid)
+		fm_.set_shader_parameter("rim", fuel_rim)

+func refresh() -> void:

+	if read.is_valid():

+		# (no numbers drawn: they're in the ring's tooltip)

+## The numbers (none drawn) in the rings' tooltip.
+func _retip() -> void:
+	var t := "%s %d / %d    %s %d / %d" % [hull_name.capitalize(), ceili(float(_vals[0])), ceili(float(_vals[1])),

+			fuel_low_note if _fuel_f.size() > 2 and float(_fuel_f[0]) < float(_fuel_f[2]) else ""]
+	t += "\n" + (tooltip_text if tooltip_text != "" else ("Fuel (the amber ring), shields (the blue ring) and hull (the red inside)" if _fuel_ring else "Shields (the blue ring) and hull (the red inside)"))
+	_ring.tooltip_text = t
+	if _fuel_ring:
+		_fuel_ring.tooltip_text = t

+
+## The afflictions round the circle, clockwise from the top (rebuilt only when they change).
+func _refresh_icons() -> void:
+	var cond = condition.call() if condition.is_valid() else null
+	var list: Array = Parts.afflictions(cond, which) if cond is Dictionary else []
+	var sig := ",".join(list.map(func(a): return "%s:%d" % [a["id"], roundi(float(a["loss"]) * 20.0)]))
+	if sig == _sig:
+		return
+	_sig = sig
+	for c in _icons.get_children():
+		c.queue_free()

+	var r := _outer() / 2.0 + ICON_GAP + AfflictionBar.ICON / 2.0

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: A curtain of hexagon tiles that a full-screen menu opens and closes with (the Ship Computer, the Field Computer). Opening (play): the tiles grow from nothing - the ones in the middle first, then outward to both sides like curtains drawn apart, each a little at random - and the menu shows only where they've opened, each tile's rim glowing as it does. Closing (play(menu, true, hide)): the same backwards, a little quicker, then the menu hides; Tab again meanwhile turns it round where it is. How: while it plays, the menu's material is the curtain shader (shaders/hex_reveal.gdshader) and every part of the menu uses it (use_parent_material) - each pixel shows only if its tile has opened; the game behind shows through the rest. Done, every part gets its own look back: an open menu costs nothing more. (Headless - the tests - menus open and close at once.) (Moved from scripts/hex_reveal.gd.)

@@ -1,0 +1,125 @@ 
+class_name HexReveal
+extends Node
+## A curtain of hexagon tiles that a full-screen menu opens and closes with
+## (the Ship Computer, the Field Computer). Opening (play): the tiles grow
+## from nothing - the ones in the middle first, then outward to both sides
+## like curtains drawn apart, each a little at random - and the menu shows
+## only where they've opened, each tile's rim glowing as it does. Closing
+## (play(menu, true, hide)): the same backwards, a little quicker, then the
+## menu hides; Tab again meanwhile turns it round where it is.
+## How: while it plays, the menu's material is the curtain shader
+## (shaders/hex_reveal.gdshader) and every part of the menu uses it
+## (use_parent_material) - each pixel shows only if its tile has opened; the
+## game behind shows through the rest. Done, every part gets its own look
+## back: an open menu costs nothing more. (Headless - the tests - menus open
+## and close at once.)
+
+const R := 56.0                  # a tile's radius (corner to centre), px
+const SPREAD := 0.36             # s: from the middle tiles to the edge ones
+const JITTER := 0.08             # s: each tile's own bit of randomness
+const GROW := 0.26               # s: one tile, nothing to full size
+const REVEAL_TIME := SPREAD + JITTER + GROW
+const CLOSE_SPEED := 1.4         # closing this many times quicker
+
+var _menu: Control
+var _reverse := false
+var _done: Callable
+var _t := 0.0
+var _parts: Array = []           # the menu's parts that use its material meanwhile
+var _old_material: Material
+var _blocker: Control            # (closing: clicks don't reach the menu)
+
+
+## Plays the curtain on `menu`: opening (it was just shown), or `reverse` -
+## closing, then `done` (hide it). Already playing: turns round where it is.
+static func play(menu: Control, reverse := false, done := Callable()) -> void:
+	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
+		if done.is_valid():
+			done.call()
+		return
+	var t := 0.0
+	var old := menu.get_node_or_null("HexReveal") as HexReveal
+	if old:
+		t = REVEAL_TIME - old._t if old._reverse != reverse else old._t   # (the same tiles open)
+		old.finish(false)
+	var h := HexReveal.new()
+	h.name = "HexReveal"
+	h._menu = menu
+	h._reverse = reverse
+	h._done = done
+	h._t = t
+	menu.add_child(h)
+
+
+## Ends `menu`'s curtain now (its menu whole - or hidden, if it was closing).
+static func stop(menu: Control) -> void:
+	var h := menu.get_node_or_null("HexReveal") as HexReveal
+	if h:
+		h.finish(true)
+
+
+## (Playing on `menu`? closing?)
+static func running(menu: Control) -> bool:
+	return menu.get_node_or_null("HexReveal") != null
+
+
+static func closing(menu: Control) -> bool:
+	var h := menu.get_node_or_null("HexReveal") as HexReveal
+	return h != null and h._reverse
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	var sm := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	sm.shader = preload("res://shaders/hex_reveal.gdshader")
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("r", R)
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("spread", SPREAD)
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("jitter", JITTER)
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("grow", GROW)
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("edge", NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("size", _menu.get_viewport_rect().size)
+	_old_material = _menu.material
+	_menu.material = sm
+	var stack: Array = _menu.get_children()
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		stack.append_array(n.get_children())
+		if n is CanvasItem and not n.use_parent_material and n.material == null:
+			n.use_parent_material = true
+			_parts.append(n)
+	if _reverse:
+		_blocker = Control.new()
+		_blocker.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		_menu.add_child(_blocker)
+		_blocker.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	_update()
+
+
+func _update() -> void:
+	(_menu.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("t", REVEAL_TIME - _t if _reverse else _t)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if is_queued_for_deletion():
+		return   # (finished: the menu has its own material back)
+	_t += delta * (CLOSE_SPEED if _reverse else 1.0)
+	if _t >= REVEAL_TIME:
+		finish(true)
+		return
+	_update()
+
+
+## Ends it: every part its own look back; closing - `call_done`: the menu hidden.
+func finish(call_done := true) -> void:
+	for n in _parts:
+		if is_instance_valid(n):
+			n.use_parent_material = false
+	_parts.clear()
+	if is_instance_valid(_menu) and _menu.material is ShaderMaterial and (_menu.material as ShaderMaterial).shader == preload("res://shaders/hex_reveal.gdshader"):
+		_menu.material = _old_material
+	if is_instance_valid(_blocker):
+		_blocker.queue_free()
+	name = "HexReveal_done"
+	queue_free()
+	if call_done and _done.is_valid():
+		_done.call()

+	EditorIcons.dress(%RestartButton, "restart", EditorIcons.tip("Respawn", "", "A new ship at the nearest station. Your main quest, missions, reputation and everything else\nare kept; you lose your cargo and pay 10% of your drachmas in insurance.\n(A new game: Main Menu > New Game.)"))
+	EditorIcons.dress(%LoadButton, "reload", EditorIcons.tip("Load saved game", "", "Continues from your last save (made from the Esc menu).\nDisabled when there is no saved game."))
+	EditorIcons.dress(%MenuButton, "menu", EditorIcons.tip("Main menu", "", "Returns to the title screen. Unsaved progress is lost."))
+
+
+func bind(ship: Node2D, data: Node) -> void:
+	toolbar.ship = ship
+	toolbar.data = data
+	ship.health_changed.connect(_on_health_changed)
+	ship.message.connect(flash_message)
+	_on_health_changed(ship.hull, ship.max_hull, ship.shields, ship.max_shields)
+	data.changed.connect(func(): credits_value.text = UI.money(data.credits))
+	credits_value.text = UI.money(data.credits)
+	# The health gauge in place of the shield and hull bars: the ship's outline
+	# filled red as high as its hull, in a blue ring filled as high as its
+	# shields, the afflictions round it (HealthGauge).
+	gauge = HealthGauge.new()
+	gauge.which = "ship"
+	gauge.fuel = func(): return [data.fuel_level(), data.fuel_max(), Shipyard.FUEL_JUMP]   # (the amber ring outside the shield's)
+	gauge.read = func(): return [ship.hull, ship.max_hull, ship.shields, ship.max_shields]
+	gauge.condition = func(): return data.condition
+	gauge.shape_source = func(): return ship.sprite.texture if is_instance_valid(ship) and ship.sprite else null
+	gauge.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	$Status/Margin/Rows.add_child(gauge)
+	$Status/Margin/Rows.move_child(gauge, 0)
+	$Status/Margin/Rows/ShieldRow.visible = false
+	$Status/Margin/Rows/HullRow.visible = false
+	$Status/Margin/Rows/CreditsRow.visible = false   # (your drachmas: at stations and in the inventory)
+	$Status/Margin/Rows/FuelRow.visible = false      # (fuel: the gauge's outer ring)
+
+
+func bind_missions(missions: Node) -> void:
+	var update := func():
+		var lines := []
+		if not missions.active.is_empty():
+			lines.append("MISSIONS")
+		for m in missions.active:
+			lines.append("%s  -  %s" % [m["title"], missions.progress_text(m)])
+		mission_tracker.text = "\n".join(lines)
+	missions.changed.connect(update)
+	get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player_data").changed.connect(update)  # salvage counts
+	missions.completed.connect(func(m): flash_message("Mission complete: %s   +%s" % [m["title"], missions.reward_text(m)]))
+	update.call()
+
+
+## Main-quest tracker (top right) and boss health bar.
+func bind_quest(quest: Node) -> void:
+	_quest = quest
+
+	# Objectives column at the top right (like most RPGs): main quest first,
+	# side missions below it. A VBox, so they stack at any text size.
+	var column := VBoxContainer.new()
+	column.anchor_left = 1.0
+	column.anchor_right = 1.0
+	column.offset_left = -436
+	column.offset_right = -16
+	column.offset_top = 76   # (under the tutorial's icon)
+	column.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN
+	column.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	column.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
+	add_child(column)
+	_quest_title = _tracker_label(15, Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.38))
+	column.add_child(_quest_title)
+	_quest_objective = _tracker_label(17, Color.WHITE)
+	column.add_child(_quest_objective)
+	var gap := Control.new()
+	_quest_gap = gap
+	gap.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 10)
+	gap.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	column.add_child(gap)
+	# Move the side-mission tracker into the column, below the main quest.
+	mission_tracker.get_parent().remove_child(mission_tracker)
+	mission_tracker.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
+	mission_tracker.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	column.add_child(mission_tracker)
+
+	# Boss health bar: top centre, under the system name.
+	_boss_bar = BossBar.new()
+	_boss_bar.anchor_left = 0.5
+	_boss_bar.anchor_right = 0.5
+	_boss_bar.offset_left = -300
+	_boss_bar.offset_right = 300
+	_boss_bar.offset_top = 52   # (below the system's name)
+	_boss_bar.offset_bottom = 90
+	add_child(_boss_bar)
+
+	var update := func():
+		# (the main quest done: no more of it - side missions move up)
+		_quest_title.text = "" if quest.finished else ("MAIN QUEST  ·  " + quest.chapter_title() if quest.stage >= 0 else "MAIN QUEST")
+		_quest_title.visible = _quest_title.text != ""
+		_quest_objective.text = "" if quest.finished else quest.objective_text()
+		_quest_objective.visible = not quest.finished
+		_quest_gap.visible = not quest.finished
+	quest.changed.connect(update)
+	get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player_data").changed.connect(update)  # delivery progress
+	update.call()
+	_apply_text_size()  # the tracker labels were just created
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _boss_bar == null:
+		return
+	# Show the nearest story boss within range.
+	var player := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player") as Node2D
+	var boss: Node2D = null
+	if player:
+		for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
+			if e.boss and e.is_alive() and e.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) < 1800.0:
+				boss = e
+	_boss_bar.boss = boss
+	_boss_bar.visible = boss != null
+	if boss:
+		_boss_bar.queue_redraw()
+
+
+## Right-aligned, wrapping label for the objectives column.
+func _tracker_label(size: int, color: Color) -> Label:
+	var l := Label.new()
+	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
+	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
+	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
+	l.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 5)
+	l.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color.BLACK)
+	return l
+
+
+## Event log console in the bottom-left corner. It grows upward with
+## bigger text, and its width stops short of the toolbar (GameLog.place).
+func _build_left_column() -> void:
+	event_log = GameLog.new()
+	event_log.anchor_left = 0.0
+	event_log.anchor_right = 0.0
+	event_log.anchor_top = 1.0
+	event_log.anchor_bottom = 1.0
+	event_log.offset_left = 16
+	event_log.offset_bottom = -16
+	event_log.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_END
+	event_log.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN
+	add_child(event_log)
+
+
+## Show/hide the event log (L key).
+func toggle_event_log() -> void:
+	event_log.visible = not event_log.visible
+
+
+## HUD text uses the "HUD" text size setting.
+func _apply_text_size() -> void:
+	UI.scale_fonts(self, "hud")
+	if event_log:
+		var k := Settings.font_scale("hud")
+		# Grows with the text, but stops short of the toolbar (GameLog.place).
+		event_log.place(Vector2(440 * clampf(k, 1.0, 1.45), 220 * clampf(k, 1.0, 1.8)), toolbar)
+
+
+## Shows the docking prompt for `station` (or hides it when null).
+func show_dock_prompt(station: Node2D) -> void:
+	dock_prompt.visible = station != null
+	if station:
+		dock_prompt.text = "Press E to dock at %s" % station.station_name
+
+
+func flash_message(text: String) -> void:
+	message.text = text
+	message.modulate.a = 1.0
+	if _message_tween:
+		_message_tween.kill()
+	_message_tween = create_tween()
+	_message_tween.tween_interval(1.8)
+	_message_tween.tween_property(message, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.6)
+
+
+func _on_health_changed(hull: float, max_hull: float, shields: float, max_shields: float) -> void:
+	shield_bar.max_value = max_shields
+	shield_bar.value = shields
+	shield_value.text = "%d" % ceilf(shields)
+	hull_bar.max_value = max_hull
+	hull_bar.value = hull
+	hull_value.text = "%d" % ceilf(hull)
+	# Hull bar goes from green to red as it drops.
+	var fill := hull_bar.get_theme_stylebox("fill") as StyleBoxFlat
+	fill.bg_color = Color(0.95, 0.25, 0.2).lerp(Color(0.3, 0.9, 0.4), hull / max_hull)
+
+
+func show_game_over(kills: int) -> void:
+	hint.hide()
+	dock_prompt.hide()
+	toolbar.hide()
+	%GameOverStats.text = "Enemies destroyed: %d" % kills
+	%LoadButton.disabled = not SaveGame.has_save()
+	game_over.show()
+	%RestartButton.grab_focus()
+
+
+## Respawn (was Restart, which started a new game and threw your progress
+## away): a new ship at the nearest station, your progress kept (main.respawn).
+func _on_restart() -> void:
+	var main := get_tree().current_scene
+	if main and main.has_method("respawn"):
+		main.respawn()
+	else:
+		SaveGame.pending = {}
+		get_tree().change_scene_to_file(GAME_SCENE)
+
+
+func _on_load() -> void:
+	SaveGame.load_slot()
+
+
+func _on_menu() -> void:
+	get_tree().change_scene_to_file(MENU_SCENE)
+
+
+## Big health bar for story bosses (name, shields, hull).
+class BossBar extends Control:
+	var boss: Node2D
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		visible = false
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		if boss == null or not is_instance_valid(boss):
+			return
+		var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
+		var w := size.x
+		draw_string_outline(font, Vector2(0, 14), boss.display_name.to_upper(), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, w, Settings.fs("hud", 16), 5, Color.BLACK)
+		draw_string(font, Vector2(0, 14), boss.display_name.to_upper(), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, w, Settings.fs("hud", 16), Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.5))
+		var y := 20.0
+		draw_rect(Rect2(0, y, w, 6), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(0, y, w * clampf(boss.shields / maxf(1.0, boss.max_shields), 0, 1), 6), Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.3))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(0, y + 9, w, 9), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(0, y + 9, w * clampf(boss.hull / boss.max_hull, 0, 1), 9), Color(0.95, 0.25, 0.2))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(0, y, w, 18), Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.5, 0.5), false, 1.0)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,101 @@ 
+class_name Icons
+## Small GUI icons (checkboxes, switches, slider grabbers, the reset arrow)
+## painted straight into images: filled polygons and stroked lines,
+## supersampled 4x for smooth edges.
+
+const SS := 4
+
+
+## layers: [{"pts": PackedVector2Array, "fill": Color, "stroke": Color,
+## "width": float, "closed": bool}, ...] in icon pixels; drawn in order.
+static func paint(w: int, h: int, layers: Array) -> ImageTexture:
+	# Painted once ever: the picture is kept on disk under a hash of what it
+	# draws (painting one in script takes ~10 ms - a screen of icons, half a
+	# second - loading it back, a fraction of a millisecond).
+	var key := "%s%d_%d_%d_%d.png" % [CACHE_DIR, VERSION, w, h, var_to_str(layers).hash()]
+	if FileAccess.file_exists(key):
+		var cached := Image.load_from_file(key)
+		if cached != null and cached.get_width() == w and cached.get_height() == h:
+			return ImageTexture.create_from_image(cached)
+	var img := _paint(w, h, layers)
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(CACHE_DIR)
+	img.save_png(key)
+	return ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+
+
+## Paints an icon not yet on disk on a worker thread (the painter only uses
+## Images: safe off the main thread), so paint() finds it there later.
+static func warm(w: int, h: int, layers: Array) -> void:
+	if layers.is_empty():
+		return
+	var key := "%s%d_%d_%d_%d.png" % [CACHE_DIR, VERSION, w, h, var_to_str(layers).hash()]
+	if FileAccess.file_exists(key):
+		return
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(CACHE_DIR)
+	tasks.append(WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func():
+		var img := _paint(w, h, layers)
+		img.save_png(key + ".tmp")
+		DirAccess.rename_absolute(key + ".tmp", key)))   # (whole or not at all: paint() never reads half a file)
+
+
+## The painting tasks (waited for at exit: Settings).
+static var tasks: Array = []
+
+static func wait_all() -> void:
+	for t in tasks:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(t)
+	tasks.clear()
+
+
+const CACHE_DIR := "user://cache/icons/"
+const VERSION := 1   # (raise it if the painter changes how things look)
+
+
+static func _paint(w: int, h: int, layers: Array) -> Image:
+	var big := Image.create_empty(w * SS, h * SS, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+	# Each layer only where it can touch: its bounds (and half its stroke).
+	var boxes := []
+	for l in layers:
+		var pts: PackedVector2Array = l["pts"]
+		var r := Rect2(pts[0], Vector2.ZERO) if not pts.is_empty() else Rect2()
+		for q in pts:
+			r = r.expand(q)
+		boxes.append(r.grow(float(l.get("width", 0.0)) * 0.5 + 0.5))
+	for y in h * SS:
+		for x in w * SS:
+			var p := (Vector2(x, y) + Vector2(0.5, 0.5)) / SS
+			var c := Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+			for li in layers.size():
+				if not (boxes[li] as Rect2).has_point(p):
+					continue
+				var l: Dictionary = layers[li]
+				var pts: PackedVector2Array = l["pts"]
+				var closed: bool = l.get("closed", true)
+				var fill: Color = l.get("fill", Color(0, 0, 0, 0))
+				if closed and fill.a > 0.0 and Geometry2D.is_point_in_polygon(p, pts):
+					c = c.blend(fill)
+				var sw: float = l.get("width", 0.0)
+				if sw > 0.0:
+					var n := pts.size() if closed else pts.size() - 1
+					for i in n:
+						var q := Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(p, pts[i], pts[(i + 1) % pts.size()])
+						if p.distance_to(q) <= sw * 0.5:
+							c = c.blend(l["stroke"])
+							break
+			big.set_pixel(x, y, c)
+	big.resize(w, h, Image.INTERPOLATE_CUBIC)
+	return big
+
+
+static func poly(pts: Array) -> PackedVector2Array:
+	var out := PackedVector2Array()
+	for p in pts:
+		out.append(Vector2(p[0], p[1]))
+	return out
+
+
+static func arc(c: Vector2, r: float, a0: float, a1: float, n := 24) -> PackedVector2Array:
+	var out := PackedVector2Array()
+	for i in n + 1:
+		out.append(c + Vector2.from_angle(lerpf(a0, a1, float(i) / n)) * r)
+	return out

+class_name ItemPortrait
+extends Control
+## A large framed picture of an item - the outfitter's selection: the item
+## drawn big over a dark radial backdrop, a slow glow and bob, a frame in
+## its quality's colour with corner brackets, and its quality's letter.
+## Redrawn at most at 60 Hz (UI.redraw_due).
+
+var item_id := ""
+var accent := Color(0.4, 0.85, 1.0)
+var badge := ""   # (a quality letter in the corner, or "")
+var _t := 0.0
+static var _backdrop: GradientTexture2D
+
+
+func show_item(id: String) -> void:
+	item_id = id
+	accent = Color(0.4, 0.85, 1.0)
+	badge = ""
+	if Gear.is_gear(id):
+		var q := Gear.quality(id)
+		accent = Gear.QUALITY_COLORS[q]
+		badge = Gear.QUALITY[q]
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	if _backdrop == null:
+		var g := Gradient.new()
+		g.set_color(0, Color(0.16, 0.2, 0.3))
+		g.set_color(1, Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.06))
+		_backdrop = GradientTexture2D.new()
+		_backdrop.gradient = g
+		_backdrop.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_RADIAL
+		_backdrop.fill_from = Vector2(0.5, 0.45)
+		_backdrop.fill_to = Vector2(1.0, 1.0)
+		_backdrop.width = 128
+		_backdrop.height = 128
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t += delta
+	if is_visible_in_tree() and UI.redraw_due(self):
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	var r := Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size)
+	draw_texture_rect(_backdrop, r, false)
+	# A soft glow behind the item, breathing.
+	var c := size / 2.0
+	var s := minf(size.x, size.y)
+	var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 1.6)
+	draw_circle(c, s * 0.36, Color(accent, 0.07 + 0.05 * pulse))
+	draw_circle(c, s * 0.26, Color(accent, 0.08 + 0.05 * pulse))
+	draw_arc(c, s * 0.40, 0.0, TAU, 64, Color(accent, 0.25), 1.5, true)
+	draw_arc(c, s * 0.40, _t * 0.4, _t * 0.4 + 1.2, 24, Color(accent, 0.8), 2.5, true)
+	draw_arc(c, s * 0.40, _t * 0.4 + PI, _t * 0.4 + PI + 1.2, 24, Color(accent, 0.8), 2.5, true)
+	if item_id != "":
+		var k := s * 0.56
+		var bob := Vector2(0, sin(_t * 1.2) * s * 0.015)
+		Items.draw_icon(self, item_id, Rect2(c - Vector2(k, k) / 2.0 + bob, Vector2(k, k)))
+	# The frame: a thin line round it, brackets at the corners.
+	draw_rect(r.grow(-1), Color(accent, 0.45), false, 1.5)
+	var b := s * 0.12
+	for corner in [Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(1, 0), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2(1, 1)]:
+		var p := Vector2(corner.x * size.x, corner.y * size.y)
+		var dx := Vector2(b if corner.x == 0 else -b, 0)
+		var dy := Vector2(0, b if corner.y == 0 else -b)
+		var q := p + Vector2(3 if corner.x == 0 else -3, 3 if corner.y == 0 else -3)
+		draw_line(q, q + dx, accent, 3.0)
+		draw_line(q, q + dy, accent, 3.0)
+	if badge != "":
+		var f := ThemeDB.fallback_font
+		var fs := maxi(Settings.MIN_FONT, int(s * 0.1))
+		draw_string(f, Vector2(size.x - fs * 1.4, fs * 1.5), badge, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, accent)

@@ -1,0 +1,91 @@ 
+class_name ItemSlot
+extends Control
+## A square slot showing an item icon and count. Used in the inventory and
+## station screens. Drag and drop: a slot with a `payload` can be dragged (its
+## icon follows the mouse); a slot with `on_drop` takes drops (on_drop.call(
+## payload) - true if it took it; `accepts` decides what it will take).
+## A click is a press and release without a drag.
+
+signal hovered(id: String)
+signal clicked(id: String)
+
+var item_id := ""
+var count := 0
+var dim := false
+var show_count := true
+var payload := {}                   # what dragging this slot carries ({} - not draggable)
+var on_drop := Callable()           # (payload) -> bool: a drop onto this slot
+var accepts := Callable()           # (payload) -> bool: will it take this drop? (default: anything)
+var _hover := false
+var _pressed := false
+
+
+static func make(id: String, n := 0, size := 64.0, is_dim := false) -> ItemSlot:
+	var s := ItemSlot.new()
+	s.item_id = id
+	s.count = n
+	s.dim = is_dim
+	s.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(size, size)
+	return s
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_to_group("item_slots")   # (redrawn when the icons' textures are baked: Items.icon_texture)
+	texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
+	mouse_entered.connect(func(): _hover = true; hovered.emit(item_id); queue_redraw())
+	mouse_exited.connect(func(): _hover = false; queue_redraw())
+
+
+func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+		if event.pressed:
+			_pressed = true
+		elif _pressed:
+			_pressed = false
+			if not get_viewport().gui_is_dragging():
+				clicked.emit(item_id)
+		accept_event()
+
+
+func _get_drag_data(_at: Vector2) -> Variant:
+	_pressed = false
+	if payload.is_empty() or item_id == "":
+		return null
+	var ghost := ItemSlot.make(item_id, count, size.x * 0.9)
+	ghost.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8)
+	var holder := Control.new()
+	holder.add_child(ghost)
+	ghost.position = -ghost.custom_minimum_size * 0.5
+	set_drag_preview(holder)
+	return payload
+
+
+func _can_drop_data(_at: Vector2, data: Variant) -> bool:
+	if not on_drop.is_valid() or not data is Dictionary:
+		return false
+	return accepts.call(data) if accepts.is_valid() else true
+
+
+func _drop_data(_at: Vector2, data: Variant) -> void:
+	on_drop.call(data)
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	var r := Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size)
+	draw_rect(r, Color(NeonTheme.BG_LIGHT, 0.95))
+	var border := Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.9) if _hover and item_id != "" else Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.35)
+	draw_rect(r, border, false, 1.5)
+	if item_id == "":
+		return
+	var pad := size.x * 0.16
+	var ir := Rect2(Vector2(pad, pad * 0.8), size - Vector2(pad, pad) * 2.0)
+	var tex := Items.icon_texture(item_id, dim)
+	if tex:
+		draw_texture_rect(tex, ir, false)   # (baked once: one draw call)
+	else:
+		Items.draw_icon(self, item_id, ir, dim)
+	if show_count and count > 1:
+		var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
+		var text := str(count)
+		draw_string_outline(font, Vector2(0, size.y - 5), text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, size.x - 5, Settings.fs("menu", 14), 4, Color.BLACK)
+		draw_string(font, Vector2(0, size.y - 5), text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, size.x - 5, Settings.fs("menu", 14), Color.WHITE)
