Drag a piece of gear from the grid onto a slot that takes it (or click it in the grid: Gear.slot_for); click a slot (or right-click it, or drag it back onto the grid: the grid's drop calls take_off) to take it off into the grid. Below: what the loadout gives you. var p := LoadoutPanel.new(); p.setup(loadout, inv, cap, src, on_change) (Moved from scripts/loadout_panel.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,157 @@ 
+class_name LoadoutPanel
+extends VBoxContainer
+## The automaton's loadout (Gear.LOADOUT: weapon, two weapon mods, armour,
+## core, two passives) as an equipment screen (EquipDoll): the automaton drawn
+## large - its actual 3D model (ModelView: drag to turn it round) - each slot beside its area of the body (Gear.AREA_OF_SLOT: the rifle
+## in the right arm, the core in the head...) - in the Ship Computer's
+## inventory (gear from the hold) and the Field Computer's (gear you carry). Drag a piece of
+## gear from the grid onto a slot that takes it (or click it in the grid:
+## Gear.slot_for); click a slot (or right-click it, or drag it back onto the
+## grid: the grid's drop calls take_off) to take it off into the grid. Below:
+## what the loadout gives you.
+##   var p := LoadoutPanel.new(); p.setup(loadout, inv, cap, src, on_change)
+
+const SLOT := 52.0
+
+var lo: Dictionary            # the loadout {slot: gear item id}
+var inv: Dictionary           # where gear comes from / goes back to
+var cap := 12                 # its slots
+var src := "hold"             # the grid's drag source ("hold" / "carried")
+var on_change := Callable()   # after a change (refresh the page, the stats)
+## How tall the automaton's screen is (px; its picture grows with it) - a
+## page with room makes it bigger.
+var doll_height := 350.0
+## The how-to line under the automaton.
+const HINT := "Click gear in your items (or drag it onto the automaton) to equip it; click its slot (or drag it back to your items) to take it off."
+
+var _doll: EquipDoll
+var _stats: Label
+## Where each slot's group sits round the automaton and the spot on it it
+## belongs to: [at (0..1 of the doll), anchor (0..1 of the picture), vertical].
+const PLACES := {
+	"core": [Vector2(0.5, 0.0), Vector2(0.5, 0.12), false],
+	"passive2": [Vector2(0.0, 0.06), Vector2(0.42, 0.3), true],
+	"armour": [Vector2(1.0, 0.18), Vector2(0.52, 0.4), true],
+	"weapon": [Vector2(0.0, 0.42), Vector2(0.26, 0.46), true],
+	"mod1": [Vector2(0.0, 0.78), Vector2(0.22, 0.62), true],
+	"mod2": [Vector2(1.0, 0.58), Vector2(0.74, 0.46), true],
+	"passive1": [Vector2(0.5, 1.0), Vector2(0.5, 0.84), false],
+}
+
+
+## The automaton's picture (you on foot, facing the camera).
+static func picture() -> Texture2D:
+	var path := AssetCatalog.first_file(["res://art/player/player_idle_s.png", "res://art/player/player_aim_s.png",
+		"res://art/player/player_walk_s_0.png"])
+	return load(path) if path != "" else null
+
+
+func setup(loadout: Dictionary, inventory: Dictionary, slots: int, source: String, changed: Callable) -> void:
+	lo = loadout
+	inv = inventory
+	cap = slots
+	src = source
+	on_change = changed
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+
+
+func refresh() -> void:
+	UI.clear(self)   # (out at once: freed later, the old screen would sit under the new one for a frame - the page jumping)
+	add_child(UI.section("AUTOMATON  ·  EQUIPMENT"))
+	_doll = EquipDoll.new()
+	_doll.picture = picture()
+	_doll.picture_scale = 0.7
+	_doll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(470, doll_height)   # (the head and legs slots above and below the picture)
+	add_child(_doll)
+	if ModelView.available("player"):    # (the actual 3D model, turned by dragging)
+		var mv := ModelView.new()
+		mv.model_id = "player"
+		_doll.view = mv
+	for s in Gear.LOADOUT:
+		var id := str(lo.get(s, ""))
+		var slot := ItemSlot.make(id, 0, SLOT)
+		slot.tooltip_text = "%s  ·  %s\n%s" % [Gear.AREA_OF_SLOT[s], Gear.SLOT_NAMES[s], (Gear.title(id) + "\n" + Gear.describe(id) + "\nClick (or drag it back to your items): take it off.") if id != "" else "Empty - drag %s gear here." % Gear.SLOT_KIND[s]]
+		if id != "":
+			slot.payload = {"src": "loadout", "slot": s, "id": id}
+		slot.accepts = func(d): return d.get("src") == src and Gear.fits(str(d.get("id", "")), s)
+		slot.on_drop = func(d): take_from_grid(str(d["id"]), s)
+		slot.gui_input.connect(_slot_input.bind(s))
+		slot.clicked.connect(func(_id): take_off(s))
+		var place: Array = PLACES[s]
+		_doll.add_group(s, Gear.AREA_OF_SLOT[s].to_upper(), place[0], place[1], place[2], [slot])
+	add_child(UI.note(HINT, 12, 420))
+	_stats = UI.label(summary(lo), 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	_stats.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	_stats.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(420, 0)
+	add_child(_stats)
+	UI.scale_fonts(self, "menu")   # (rebuilt after every change: at the player's text size again, as the menu around it)
+
+
+func _slot_input(event: InputEvent, s: String) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
+		take_off(s)
+		accept_event()
+
+
+## Takes off what's in slot `slot` into the grid. True if done (false: an
+## empty slot, the standard rifle, or no room - said in the log).
+func take_off(slot: String) -> bool:
+	var id := str(lo.get(slot, ""))
+	if id == "" or (slot == "weapon" and id == Gear.DEFAULT_LOADOUT["weapon"]):
+		return false
+	if not Gear.unequip(lo, inv, cap, slot):
+		GameLog.post("No room to take off the %s (%d slots full)." % [Gear.title(id), cap], "danger")
+		return false
+	Sfx.play("pirate/loot_take", -8.0)
+	_changed()
+	return true
+
+
+## Whether a drop on the grid is gear taken off this loadout.
+func is_mine(d: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	return d.get("src") == "loadout" and lo.get(str(d.get("slot", ""))) == d.get("id")
+
+
+## Equips gear `id` from the grid into `slot` (or the slot it fits). True if done.
+func take_from_grid(id: String, slot := "") -> bool:
+	if slot == "":
+		slot = Gear.slot_for(lo, id)
+	if slot == "" or not Gear.equip(lo, inv, cap, id, slot):
+		return false
+	Sfx.play("pirate/loot_take", -8.0)
+	_changed()
+	return true
+
+
+func _changed() -> void:
+	refresh()
+	if on_change.is_valid():
+		on_change.call()
+
+
+## What a loadout gives you, in words.
+static func summary(loadout: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var w := Gear.weapon_stats(str(loadout.get("weapon", Gear.DEFAULT_LOADOUT["weapon"])))
+	var fx := Gear.loadout_effects(loadout)
+	var dmg: float = w["damage"] * (1.0 + float(fx.get("damage_mult", 0.0)))
+	var rate: float = 1.0 / (w["interval"] * maxf(0.25, 1.0 + float(fx.get("fire_rate_mult", 0.0))))
+	var reach: float = w["range"] * (1.0 + float(fx.get("range_mult", 0.0)))
+	var parts := ["%.0f %s damage, %.1f shots/s, reach %.0f" % [dmg, Gear.TYPE_NAMES[w["type"]].to_lower(), rate, reach],
+		"health %.0f" % (100.0 + float(fx.get("max_hp", 0.0))),
+		"accuracy %d%%" % roundi(clampf(Accuracy.BASE_FOOT + float(fx.get("accuracy", 0.0)), 0.2, 0.99) * 100.0)]
+	if fx.get("regen_mult", 0.0) > 0.0:
+		parts.append("healing +%d%%" % roundi(fx["regen_mult"] * 100.0))
+	if fx.get("speed_mult", 0.0) > 0.0:
+		parts.append("speed +%d%%" % roundi(fx["speed_mult"] * 100.0))
+	var res := []
+	for t in Gear.DAMAGE_TYPES:
+		var r := clampf(float(fx.get("resist_" + t, 0.0)), 0.0, Gear.RESIST_CAP)
+		if r > 0.0:
+			res.append("%s %d%%" % [t, roundi(r * 100.0)])
+	if not res.is_empty():
+		parts.append("resists: " + ", ".join(res))
+	return "  ·  ".join(parts)

@@ -1,0 +1,1275 @@ 
+extends Control
+## Main menu. Also used in-game as the pause menu (overlay = true): the game
+## stays loaded and paused underneath, and "Start Game" becomes "Resume".
+
+const GAME_SCENE := "res://scenes/world/cosmos.tscn"
+const EDITOR_SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/editor.tscn"
+const LATER_SCENES := ["res://scenes/world/cosmos.tscn", "res://scenes/ui/station_menu.tscn", "res://scenes/ui/ship_menu.tscn"]
+
+## True when this menu is shown on top of a paused game.
+@export var overlay := false
+
+@onready var main_buttons: Control = %MainButtons
+@onready var settings_panel: Control = %SettingsPanel
+@onready var resolution_option: OptionButton = %ResolutionOption
+@onready var fullscreen_check: CheckButton = %FullscreenCheck
+
+## Text-size sliders: category -> [HSlider, value Label, reset Button] (built in code).
+## Volume sliders: "master" / "music" / "sfx" -> [HSlider, value Label, reset Button].
+var _volume_sliders := {}
+var _text_sliders := {}
+var _settings_hint: Label
+## The CRT filter: its own settings page (built in code), its switch on the
+## main settings page, and its sliders: id -> [HSlider, value Label, reset Button].
+var crt_panel: PanelContainer
+var _crt_check: CheckButton
+var _fps_check: CheckButton
+var _graphics_pick: OptionButton
+var _terrain_check: CheckButton
+var _aa_pick: OptionButton
+var _crt_switches := {}
+var _crt_sliders := {}
+
+var _resolutions: Array[Vector2i] = []
+var _was_paused := false
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	AnatomyArt.warm()
+	if get_tree().current_scene == self:
+		NeonTheme.set_empire("")   # title screen: the neutral neon look
+	%StartButton.pressed.connect(_on_start)
+	%SaveButton.pressed.connect(_on_save)
+	%LoadButton.pressed.connect(_on_load)
+	%SettingsButton.pressed.connect(_open_settings)
+	%QuitToMenuButton.pressed.connect(_on_quit_to_menu)
+	%ExitButton.pressed.connect(get_tree().quit)
+	if Settings.on_web():
+		%ExitButton.visible = false   # (a browser tab: closed by the browser, not the game)
+		resolution_option.get_parent().visible = false   # (the Resolution row: the page sets the size)
+	%BackButton.pressed.connect(_close_settings)
+	resolution_option.item_selected.connect(_on_resolution_selected)
+	fullscreen_check.toggled.connect(_on_fullscreen_toggled)
+
+	# Pause-only buttons.
+	%SaveButton.visible = overlay
+	%QuitToMenuButton.visible = overlay
+	# Talos, the game's editor (game data, sprites, the asset Library...): from
+	# the title screen; in a game (the Esc menu, or F8) it saves the game first
+	# and leaving Talos brings you back to it (SaveGame.open_talos).
+	var fs: int = %SettingsButton.get_theme_font_size("font_size")
+	var editor := Button.new()
+	editor.name = "EditorButton"
+	editor.text = "Talos"
+	editor.tooltip_text = "The game's editor. Leaving it brings you back here." if overlay else "The game's editor: quests, lore, sprites, scenarios, the asset Library, Versions."
+	if overlay:
+		editor.pressed.connect(func(): SaveGame.open_talos())
+	else:
+		editor.pressed.connect(_open_talos_when_ready)
+	editor.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
+	main_buttons.add_child(editor)
+	main_buttons.move_child(editor, %SettingsButton.get_index() + 1)
+	# The Archive: every book of the game (the guide, tutorial, encyclopedia, controls, versions, Talos manual).
+	var books := Button.new()
+	books.name = "ArchiveButton"
+	books.text = "Archive"
+	books.tooltip_text = "Every book of the game in one place: the pilot's guide, the tutorial, the encyclopedia, the controls, the versions and the Talos manual (F1 anywhere)."
+	books.pressed.connect(func(): Archive.open(self, "guide"))
+	books.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
+	main_buttons.add_child(books)
+	main_buttons.move_child(books, editor.get_index() + 1)
+	# Title screen: Continue - straight into the latest save (shown when there is one).
+	if not overlay:
+		var cont := Button.new()
+		cont.name = "ContinueButton"
+		cont.text = "Continue"
+		cont.pressed.connect(func(): SaveGame.load_slot(-1))
+		cont.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
+		main_buttons.add_child(cont)
+		main_buttons.move_child(cont, %StartButton.get_index())
+
+	if not overlay:
+		Galaxy.active = false   # no game running behind the title screen
+	if overlay:
+		add_to_group("esc_menu")
+		%StartButton.text = "Resume"
+		$Background.hide()  # let the paused game show through instead
+		$Dim.show()
+
+	_apply_look()
+	if not overlay:
+		_refresh_load_button()   # (the Esc menu: when it opens - open())
+		# The title screen: the game's first-use drawing (shaders, a station's
+		# labels, particles) done here, one thing a frame, unseen - not in the
+		# first frame of a new game (Warmup: once a run).
+		_start_warmup()   # (the GPU's first-use work, at the title)
+		ProcArt.load_scenes(LATER_SCENES)   # (the game's scenes, behind the menu - no loading screen)
+
+	_resolutions = Settings.available_resolutions()
+	for r in _resolutions:
+		resolution_option.add_item("%d × %d" % [r.x, r.y])
+
+	Keybinds.register_menu(self)   # (WASD / D-pad move between the buttons)
+	Settings.text_scale_changed.connect(_apply_text_size)
+	# The Esc menu in a game: its settings pages built (and its text sized)
+	# the first time it opens, not with every scene - a jump, a landing.
+	if overlay:
+		_lazy = true
+		settings_panel.hide()
+	else:
+		_build_settings()
+
+
+var _lazy := false
+
+func _build_settings() -> void:
+	_lazy = false
+	_build_text_settings()
+	_build_crt_settings()
+	_tabify_settings()
+	_apply_text_size()
+	_close_settings()
+
+
+## 80s look: chrome title, synthwave backdrop (title screen), slanted neon
+## buttons and a neon settings panel.
+func _apply_look() -> void:
+	if not overlay:
+		var sw := Synthwave.new()
+		$Background.add_child(sw)
+	var old: Control = $Center/Layout/Title
+	var title := RetroTitle.new()
+	if overlay:
+		title.big_size = 96
+		title.small_size = 30
+	old.get_parent().add_child(title)
+	old.get_parent().move_child(title, old.get_index())
+	old.queue_free()
+	$Center/Layout.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 26 if not overlay else 22)
+	var styles := NeonTheme.menu_button_styles()
+	for b in main_buttons.get_children():
+		if b is Button:
+			for k in styles:
+				b.add_theme_stylebox_override(k, styles[k])
+			b.add_theme_font_override("font", NeonTheme.heavy_font())
+			b.text = b.text.to_upper()
+			b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(380, 54)
+	main_buttons.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
+	settings_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", NeonTheme.box(Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.75), NeonTheme.BG, 2, 12, 14))
+	%StatusLabel.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.PINK)
+	var heading: Label = settings_panel.get_node("Margin/Rows/Heading")
+	heading.text = heading.text.to_upper()
+	heading.add_theme_font_override("font", NeonTheme.heavy_font())
+	heading.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.HEAD)
+
+
+## Pause the game and show this menu (overlay mode). It can open on top of
+## other paused panels (dialogue, Ship Computer, station); resuming returns
+## to them still paused.
+func open() -> void:
+	if _lazy:
+		_build_settings()
+	if not visible:   # (already open: it keeps what it'll go back to)
+		_was_paused = get_tree().paused
+	get_tree().paused = true
+	show()
+	_refresh_load_button()
+	_close_settings()
+
+
+## Hide this menu and go back to whatever was open (overlay mode).
+func resume() -> void:
+	hide()
+	Settings.crt_preview = false
+	get_tree().paused = _was_paused
+
+
+## The game's first-use drawing (Warmup), on the title screen.
+func _start_warmup() -> void:
+	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
+		return
+	if not CosmosWarm.done:
+		add_child(CosmosWarm.new())   # (the 3D game's: its shaders, noise, spheres)
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	Settings.crt_preview = false
+
+
+## Attract mode: the title screen left alone for AttractMode.IDLE seconds
+## starts the game playing itself (any input meanwhile restarts the count).
+var _idle := 0.0
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	AnatomyArt.pump()   # (the automaton's anatomy: its big pictures come in here, one at a time - not during play)
+	if overlay or not visible or get_tree().current_scene != self:
+		_idle = 0.0
+		return
+	_idle += delta   # (the old game's attract mode is gone)
+
+
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if _listen_id != "" and _listen(event):
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+		return
+	if event is InputEventKey or event is InputEventMouseButton or event is InputEventJoypadButton \
+			or (event is InputEventMouseMotion and event.relative.length() > 1.0):
+		_idle = 0.0
+
+
+func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not visible or not event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
+		return
+	if SaveGame.talos_overlay() != null or SaveGame.talos_closed_frame == Engine.get_process_frames():
+		return   # (Talos over the game has the keys - this Esc was for it, the menu waits under it)
+	if crt_panel.visible:
+		_close_crt()
+	elif _slots_panel and _slots_panel.visible:
+		_close_slots()
+	elif settings_panel.visible:
+		_close_settings()
+	elif overlay:
+		resume()
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+## Talos from the title screen - once the game's art is in (it shows all of it).
+func _open_talos_when_ready() -> void:
+	# (at once: the art goes on loading behind it)
+	get_tree().change_scene_to_file(EDITOR_SCENE)
+
+
+func _on_start() -> void:
+	if overlay:
+		resume()
+	else:
+		# A new game: the galaxy made behind the loading screen, a little a
+		# frame (Galaxy.new_game_async), then the game.
+		SaveGame.pending = {}
+		SaveGame.travelling = false
+		_on_space3d(false)
+
+
+## The 3D game: the latest save continued (its galaxy loaded under the veil),
+## or a new game (a new galaxy charted under the veil).
+func _on_space3d(continue_save := false) -> void:
+	Cosmos.arrive_from = ""
+	if continue_save:
+		LoadVeil.change_to(Cosmos.SCENE, "Continue", func(_progress): CosmosGame.begin(true), "Loading your save")
+	else:
+		LoadVeil.change_to(Cosmos.SCENE, "New game", func(progress):
+			await Galaxy.new_game_async(progress, true)
+			CosmosGame.begin(false), "Charting the galaxy")
+
+
+func _on_save() -> void:
+	var game := get_tree().current_scene
+	if game.has_method("can_save") and not game.can_save():
+		_flash_status("Can't save now")
+		return
+	_open_slots("save")
+
+
+func _on_load() -> void:
+	_open_slots("load")
+
+
+## Saves the game into a slot (asked first when it would overwrite one).
+func _save_to(slot: int) -> void:
+	var game := get_tree().current_scene
+	if not game.has_method("get_save_data"):
+		return
+	if SaveGame.has_save(slot) and _slot_confirm != slot:
+		_slot_confirm = slot   # (a second click on it saves)
+		_fill_slots()
+		return
+	_slot_confirm = 0
+	if SaveGame.save_game(game.get_save_data(), slot):
+		_flash_status("Game saved (slot %d)" % slot)
+		GameLog.post("Game saved in slot %d" % slot, "info")
+		_close_slots()
+	else:
+		_flash_status("Save failed!")
+	_refresh_load_button()
+
+
+func _load_from(slot: int) -> void:
+	# (Re)loads the game scene, under a loading screen; it applies
+	# SaveGame.pending in _ready() - a save made on a planet takes you back
+	# down there.
+	if not SaveGame.load_slot(slot):
+		_flash_status("No valid save in slot %d" % slot)
+		_refresh_load_button()
+
+
+# --- The slot lists (Save / Load) -------------------------------------------------------------
+# SaveGame.SLOTS slots, each a row: its number, when it was saved and where
+# you were (the system, the planet if you were on one), your ship and
+# credits; Save into it (an occupied one asks first: click again) or Load it,
+# and a delete button. Esc or Back closes the list.
+
+var _slots_panel: PanelContainer
+var _slots_rows: VBoxContainer
+var _slots_mode := "save"
+var _slot_confirm := 0
+
+
+func _open_slots(mode: String) -> void:
+	_slots_mode = mode
+	_slot_confirm = 0
+	if _slots_panel == null:
+		_slots_panel = PanelContainer.new()
+		_slots_panel.name = "SlotsPanel"
+		_slots_panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(900, 0)
+		_slots_panel.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+		var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+		v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+		_slots_panel.add_child(v)
+		_slots_rows = VBoxContainer.new()
+		_slots_rows.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+		v.add_child(_slots_rows)
+		var back := UI.button("Back", _close_slots, 18)
+		back.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 44)
+		v.add_child(back)
+		main_buttons.get_parent().add_child(_slots_panel)
+		main_buttons.get_parent().move_child(_slots_panel, main_buttons.get_index() + 1)
+	main_buttons.hide()
+	_slots_panel.show()
+	_fill_slots()
+
+
+func _close_slots() -> void:
+	if _slots_panel:
+		_slots_panel.hide()
+	main_buttons.show()
+	if is_visible_in_tree():
+		var cont: Button = main_buttons.get_node_or_null("ContinueButton")
+		(cont if cont and cont.visible else %StartButton).grab_focus()
+
+
+func _fill_slots() -> void:
+	UI.clear(_slots_rows)
+	_slots_rows.add_child(UI.section("SAVE GAME  ·  choose a slot" if _slots_mode == "save" else "LOAD GAME  ·  choose a save"))
+	# (loading: the quicksave and the autosave first; saving: the numbered slots)
+	var list: Array = SaveGame.all_slots() if _slots_mode == "load" else range(1, SaveGame.SLOTS + 1)
+	for s_id in list:
+		var slot: int = s_id
+		var info := SaveGame.slot_info(slot)
+		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+		var num := UI.label({SaveGame.QUICK: "Q", SaveGame.AUTO: "A"}.get(slot, "%d" % slot), 22, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+		num.tooltip_text = SaveGame.slot_name(slot)
+		num.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
+		num.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(36, 0)
+		num.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+		row.add_child(num)
+		var text := VBoxContainer.new()
+		text.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		text.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
+		if info.is_empty():
+			text.add_child(UI.label({SaveGame.QUICK: "No quicksave yet (F5)", SaveGame.AUTO: "No autosave yet"}.get(slot, "Empty slot"), 17, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+		else:
+			var sm: Dictionary = info.get("summary", {})
+			var where := str(sm.get("system", "?"))
+			if str(sm.get("planet", "")) != "":
+				where = "on %s  ·  %s" % [sm["planet"], where]
+			text.add_child(UI.label(("%s  ·  " % SaveGame.slot_name(slot) if slot > SaveGame.SLOTS else "") + where, 17))
+			text.add_child(UI.label("%s  ·  %s  ·  %d drachmas" % [str(info.get("saved_at", "")).replace("T", "  "), sm.get("ship", "?"), int(sm.get("credits", 0))], 13, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+		row.add_child(text)
+		var b: Button
+		if _slots_mode == "save":
+			var confirming := _slot_confirm == slot
+			b = UI.button("Overwrite?" if confirming else ("Save here" if info.is_empty() else "Save over"), _save_to.bind(slot), 16)
+			if confirming:
+				b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.4))
+		else:
+			b = UI.button("Load", _load_from.bind(slot), 16)
+			b.disabled = info.is_empty()
+		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(170, 44)
+		row.add_child(b)
+		var del := UI.button("", _delete_slot.bind(slot), 14)
+		del.icon = EditorIcons.get_icon("delete")
+		del.tooltip_text = "Delete this save (click twice)."
+		del.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(44, 44)
+		del.disabled = info.is_empty()
+		row.add_child(del)
+		_slots_rows.add_child(row)
+	if _slots_rows.get_child_count() > 1:
+		var first: Control = _slots_rows.get_child(1)
+		var btn := first.get_child(2) as Button
+		if btn and not btn.disabled:
+			btn.grab_focus.call_deferred()
+
+
+var _delete_confirm := 0
+
+func _delete_slot(slot: int) -> void:
+	if _delete_confirm != slot:
+		_delete_confirm = slot
+		_flash_status("Click delete again to erase %s" % SaveGame.slot_name(slot).to_lower())
+		return
+	_delete_confirm = 0
+	SaveGame.delete_slot(slot)
+	_flash_status("%s deleted" % SaveGame.slot_name(slot))
+	_fill_slots()
+	_refresh_load_button()
+
+
+func _on_quit_to_menu() -> void:
+	get_tree().paused = false
+	get_tree().change_scene_to_file(scene_file_path)
+
+
+func _refresh_load_button() -> void:
+	var stamp := SaveGame.saved_at()   # (the newest save)
+	%LoadButton.disabled = stamp.is_empty()
+	var cont: Button = main_buttons.get_node_or_null("ContinueButton")
+	if cont:
+		cont.visible = not stamp.is_empty()
+		var latest := SaveGame.latest_slot()
+		var sm: Dictionary = SaveGame.slot_info(latest).get("summary", {}) if latest > 0 else {}
+		cont.tooltip_text = "Loads your latest save: %s%s%s." % [SaveGame.slot_name(latest),
+			(" - " + str(sm.get("planet", "")) + ", " if str(sm.get("planet", "")) != "" else " - ") + str(sm.get("system", "")) if not sm.is_empty() else "",
+			"  (" + stamp.replace("T", " ") + ")" if stamp != "" else ""]
+	if overlay:
+		return
+	# On the title screen, show when the save was made.
+	%StatusLabel.text = "Latest save: %s" % stamp.replace("T", "  ") if stamp else ""
+
+
+func _flash_status(message: String) -> void:
+	var label: Label = %StatusLabel
+	label.text = message
+	label.modulate.a = 1.0
+	var tween := create_tween()
+	tween.tween_interval(1.2)
+	tween.tween_property(label, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.5)

+		slider.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(240, 32)
+		slider.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		slider.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+		row.add_child(slider)
+		var value := Label.new()
+		value.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(70, 0)
+		value.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
+		value.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
+		row.add_child(value)
+		# Icon-only button: put this slider back to its default (100%).
+		var reset := Button.new()
+		reset.icon = UI.reset_icon()
+		reset.tooltip_text = "Reset to default (100%)"
+		reset.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(40, 36)
+		reset.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+		reset.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+		reset.pressed.connect(func(): slider.value = 100.0)
+		row.add_child(reset)
+		slider.value_changed.connect(func(v):
+			value.text = "%d%%" % roundi(v)
+			reset.disabled = is_equal_approx(v, 100.0)
+			Settings.set_text_scale(category, v / 100.0))
+		rows.add_child(row)
+		rows.move_child(row, at)
+		at += 1
+		_text_sliders[category] = [slider, value, reset]
+	# Sound: master, music and effects volumes (effects play a sample as you move them).
+	var sh := Label.new()
+	sh.text = "SOUND"
+	sh.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
+	sh.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	rows.add_child(sh)
+	rows.move_child(sh, at)
+	at += 1
+	for kind in Settings.VOLUMES:
+		var srow := HBoxContainer.new()
+		srow.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
+		var slabel := Label.new()
+		slabel.text = Settings.VOLUMES[kind]
+		slabel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(170, 0)
+		slabel.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
+		srow.add_child(slabel)
+		var slider := HSlider.new()
+		slider.min_value = 0.0
+		slider.max_value = 100.0
+		slider.step = 5.0
+		slider.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(240, 32)
+		slider.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		slider.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+		slider.tooltip_text = {"master": "Everything's volume (0% = silent).", "music": "The music's volume (0% = off).",
+			"sfx": "Sound effects volume (0% = off) - a sample plays as you move it.",
+			"voice": "The characters' spoken dialogue (0% = off) - Kilon says a few words as you move it."}[kind]
+		srow.add_child(slider)
+		var value := Label.new()
+		value.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(70, 0)
+		value.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
+		value.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
+		srow.add_child(value)
+		var reset := Button.new()
+		reset.icon = UI.reset_icon()
+		reset.tooltip_text = "Reset to default (%d%%)" % roundi(Settings.VOLUME_DEFAULTS[kind] * 100)
+		reset.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(40, 36)
+		reset.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+		reset.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+		reset.pressed.connect(func(): slider.value = Settings.VOLUME_DEFAULTS[kind] * 100.0)
+		srow.add_child(reset)
+		slider.value = Settings.volume(kind) * 100.0
+		value.text = "%d%%" % roundi(slider.value)
+		reset.disabled = is_equal_approx(slider.value, Settings.VOLUME_DEFAULTS[kind] * 100.0)
+		var sample_t := [0]
+		slider.value_changed.connect(func(v):
+			value.text = "%d%%" % roundi(v)
+			reset.disabled = is_equal_approx(v, Settings.VOLUME_DEFAULTS[kind] * 100.0)
+			Settings.set_volume(kind, v / 100.0)
+			if kind != "music" and Time.get_ticks_msec() - sample_t[0] > 250:   # (a sample at the new volume)
+				sample_t[0] = Time.get_ticks_msec()
+				if kind == "voice":
+					if not Voice._player.playing:
+						Voice.speak("The thread is in your hands.", "Kilon Alios")
+				else:
+					Sfx.play("pirate/shot"))
+		rows.add_child(srow)
+		rows.move_child(srow, at)
+		at += 1
+		_volume_sliders[kind] = [slider, value, reset]

+	hint.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.TEXT)
+	footer.add_child(hint)
+	_settings_hint = hint
+	# Resets every setting: resolution, fullscreen and all text sizes.
+	var defaults := Button.new()
+	defaults.text = "Restore Defaults"
+	defaults.tooltip_text = "Resolution 1920 × 1080, windowed, all text at 100%, volumes: master 100%, music 70%, effects 100%, voices 80%; CRT filter off (on in attract mode), at its default look"
+	defaults.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
+	defaults.pressed.connect(_restore_defaults)
+	footer.add_child(defaults)

+	rows.move_child(footer, at)

+## The settings panel never grows past 150%, so it always fits on screen
+## (you can't push the sliders out of reach); the rest of the menu goes to 200%.
+## The Controls page's action names (their width follows the text size).
+var _bind_names: Array[Label] = []
+
+
+static func _bind_name_width() -> float:
+	return 140.0 * clampf(Settings.font_scale("menu"), 1.0, 1.45)
+
+
+func _apply_text_size() -> void:
+	if _lazy:
+		return   # (sized when it's built)
+	for l in _bind_names:
+		if is_instance_valid(l):
+			l.custom_minimum_size.x = _bind_name_width()
+	UI.scale_fonts(self, "menu", 2.0)
+	UI.scale_fonts(settings_panel, "menu", 1.5)
+	if crt_panel:
+		UI.scale_fonts(crt_panel, "menu", 1.5)
+	_fit.call_deferred()   # (bigger text: taller pages)
+
+
+func _restore_defaults() -> void:
+	Settings.reset_to_defaults()
+	_sync_settings_ui()
+	_sync_game_settings()
+	_settings_hint.text = "All settings restored to default."
+	var tween := create_tween()
+	tween.tween_interval(2.0)
+	tween.tween_callback(func(): _settings_hint.text = "Changes apply immediately.")
+
+
+## Show the current settings in the controls (without triggering changes).
+func _sync_settings_ui() -> void:
+	for kind in _volume_sliders:
+		var v := Settings.volume(kind) * 100.0
+		_volume_sliders[kind][0].set_value_no_signal(v)
+		_volume_sliders[kind][1].text = "%d%%" % roundi(v)
+		_volume_sliders[kind][2].disabled = is_equal_approx(v, Settings.VOLUME_DEFAULTS[kind] * 100.0)
+	for category in _text_sliders:
+		var v := Settings.font_scale(category) * 100.0
+		_text_sliders[category][0].set_value_no_signal(v)
+		_text_sliders[category][1].text = "%d%%" % roundi(v)
+		_text_sliders[category][2].disabled = is_equal_approx(v, 100.0)
+	var index := _resolutions.find(Settings.resolution)
+	resolution_option.select(index if index >= 0 else _resolutions.size() - 1)
+	fullscreen_check.set_pressed_no_signal(Settings.fullscreen)
+	resolution_option.disabled = Settings.fullscreen
+	_sync_crt_ui()
+
+
+func _open_settings() -> void:
+	if _lazy:
+		_build_settings()   # (the Esc menu builds its settings when first wanted)
+	_sync_settings_ui()
+	_sync_game_settings()
+
+	main_buttons.hide()
+	settings_panel.show()
+	_fit()
+	if settings_tab == 0:
+		resolution_option.grab_focus()
+
+
+func _close_settings() -> void:
+	settings_panel.hide()
+	if crt_panel:
+		crt_panel.hide()
+	_listen_id = ""
+	Settings.crt_preview = false
+	main_buttons.show()
+	_fit()
+	if is_visible_in_tree():
+		%StartButton.grab_focus()
+
+
+func _on_resolution_selected(index: int) -> void:
+	Settings.resolution = _resolutions[index]
+	Settings.apply()
+	Settings.save_settings()
+
+
+func _on_fullscreen_toggled(on: bool) -> void:
+	Settings.fullscreen = on
+	resolution_option.disabled = on
+	Settings.apply()
+	Settings.save_settings()

+	# The planets' ground as 3D geometry, or the 2D tiles.

+	# Anti-aliasing (the 3D view).

+## A CRT parameter's value as shown: 0.38 -> "38%", 3.0 -> "3.0 px".
+func _crt_text(p: Array, v: float) -> String:
+	var shown: float = v * float(p[6])
+	if p[7] == "%":
+		return "%d%%" % roundi(shown)
+	if p[7] == "":
+		return "%.1f" % shown
+	return "%.1f%s" % [shown, p[7]]

+		return
+	for i in Settings.CHARACTER_GRAPHICS.size():
+		if Settings.CHARACTER_GRAPHICS[i][0] == Settings.character_graphics:
+			_graphics_pick.select(i)

+func _sync_crt_ui() -> void:

+	for attract in _crt_switches:
+		_crt_switches[attract].set_pressed_no_signal(Settings.crt_attract if attract else Settings.crt_on)
+	for id in _crt_sliders:
+		var e: Array = _crt_sliders[id]
+		var v: float = Settings.crt.get(id, e[3][5])
+		e[0].set_value_no_signal(v)

+## its two keys and its gamepad input. Click a binding, then press the key /
+## button to put there (Esc cancels; right-click clears it). Clashes within a

+var _pad_label: Label
+var _listen_id := ""

+
+

+
+func _build_controls() -> VBoxContainer:
+	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
+	box.name = "ControlsPage"
+	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
+	var top := HBoxContainer.new()

+	all.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)

+				var tl := Label.new()

+				tl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)

+func _sync_controls() -> void:
+	if _lazy:
+		_build_settings()   # (the Esc menu builds its settings when first wanted)
+	_pad_label.text = ("Gamepad: " + Input.get_joy_name(Input.get_connected_joypads()[0]) + "  ") if Keybinds.pad_connected() else "No gamepad  "
+	for a in Keybinds.ACTIONS:
+		for slot in 3:
+			var b: Button = _bind_buttons["%s|%d" % [a[0], slot]]
+			var spec: String = Keybinds.binds[a[0]][slot]
+			var listening: bool = _listen_id == a[0] and _listen_slot == slot
+			b.text = "press..." if listening else (Keybinds.spec_text(spec) if spec != "" else "-")
+			var clash := not listening and not Keybinds.clashes(a[0], spec).is_empty()
+			if clash:
+				b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.4, 0.3))
+			else:
+				b.remove_theme_color_override("font_color")
+	if _listen_id == "":
+		_controls_hint.text = "Click a binding, then press the key or gamepad input. Right-click clears one; red: used twice."
+
+
+func _start_listen(id: String, slot: int) -> void:
+	_listen_id = id
+	_listen_slot = slot
+	_controls_hint.text = "Press the %s for \"%s\" - Esc cancels." % ["gamepad button, stick or trigger" if slot == 2 else "key", Keybinds.label(id)]
+	_sync_controls()
+
+
+## While listening: the input pressed becomes the binding. True if it used the event.
+func _listen(ev: InputEvent) -> bool:
+	if ev is InputEventMouse:
+		return false
+	if ev is InputEventKey and ev.pressed and ev.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
+		_listen_id = ""
+		_sync_controls()
+		return true
+	var pad := _listen_slot == 2
+	if pad != (ev is InputEventJoypadButton or ev is InputEventJoypadMotion):
+		return ev is InputEventKey or ev is InputEventJoypadButton   # (the wrong kind: swallowed, still listening)
+	var spec := Keybinds.spec_of(ev)
+	if spec == "":
+		return true
+	var id := _listen_id
+	var b: Button = _bind_buttons["%s|%d" % [id, _listen_slot]]
+	Keybinds.set_bind(id, _listen_slot, spec)
+	_listen_id = ""
+	_sync_controls()
+	var others := Keybinds.clashes(id, spec)
+	if not others.is_empty():
+		_controls_hint.text = "%s is also used for: %s." % [Keybinds.spec_text(spec), ", ".join(others.map(func(o): return Keybinds.label(o)))]
+	b.grab_focus.call_deferred()
+	return true
+

+func _tabify_settings() -> void:
+	var rows: VBoxContainer = %BackButton.get_parent()
+	var pages: Array[VBoxContainer] = []
+	for i in SETTINGS_TABS.size():
+		var pg := VBoxContainer.new()
+		pg.name = SETTINGS_TABS[i].capitalize() + "Page"
+		pg.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 11)
+		pages.append(pg)
+	# The rows as built, in order: heading, display rows, TEXT SIZE + its
+	# sliders, SOUND + its sliders, the footer, Back.
+	var page := 0
+	for c in rows.get_children():
+		if c.name == "Heading" or c == %BackButton or (c is HBoxContainer and c.get_child_count() > 0 and c.get_child(0) == _settings_hint):
+			continue
+		if c is Label and c.text == "TEXT SIZE":
+			page = 1
+		elif c is Label and c.text == "SOUND":
+			page = 2
+		if c is Label and c.text in ["TEXT SIZE", "SOUND"]:
+			c.queue_free()   # (the tab says it)
+			continue
+		rows.remove_child(c)
+		pages[page].add_child(c)
+	pages[3].add_child(_build_controls())
+	pages[4].add_child(_build_game_settings())
+	_settings_bar = UI.tab_bar(SETTINGS_TABS, show_settings_tab, Color(), true)
+	rows.add_child(_settings_bar)
+	rows.move_child(_settings_bar, rows.get_node("Heading").get_index() + 1)
+	_settings_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
+	_settings_scroll.name = "SettingsScroll"
+	_settings_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
+	_settings_scroll.follow_focus = true
+	rows.add_child(_settings_scroll)
+	rows.move_child(_settings_scroll, _settings_bar.get_index() + 1)
+	var holder := MarginContainer.new()
+	holder.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	holder.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 14)   # (clear of the scroll bar)
+	_settings_scroll.add_child(holder)
+	for pg in pages:
+		holder.add_child(pg)
+		_settings_pages.append(pg)
+	settings_panel.custom_minimum_size.x = 860
+	# The CRT page: its rows scroll too.
+	var box: VBoxContainer = crt_panel.get_child(0).get_child(0)
+	var margin: MarginContainer = crt_panel.get_child(0)
+	margin.remove_child(box)
+	_crt_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
+	_crt_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
+	_crt_scroll.follow_focus = true
+	box.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_crt_scroll.add_child(box)
+	margin.add_child(_crt_scroll)
+	get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_fit)
+	show_settings_tab(0)

+func show_settings_tab(i: int) -> void:

+func cycle_tab(d: int) -> void:
+	if _lazy:
+		_build_settings()   # (the Esc menu builds its settings when first wanted)
+	if settings_panel.visible:
+		show_settings_tab(wrapi(settings_tab + d, 0, SETTINGS_TABS.size()))
+
+
+## Sizes the settings' and the CRT page's scroll areas so their panels fit
+## the window (with a margin): as tall as the tab showing when there's room,
+## else the window's height less the panel's own chrome. The title hides
+## while either shows (it alone is a quarter of the window).
+func _fit() -> void:
+	if _settings_scroll == null or not is_inside_tree():
+		return
+	var avail := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.y - 48.0
+	$Center/Layout.get_child(0).visible = not (settings_panel.visible or crt_panel.visible)
+	var tallest := 0.0
+	var widest := 0.0
+	for pg in _settings_pages:
+		var m := pg.get_combined_minimum_size()
+		widest = maxf(widest, m.x)   # (one width for every tab: the panel doesn't jump sideways)
+	tallest = _settings_pages[settings_tab].get_combined_minimum_size().y   # (the tab showing)
+	_settings_scroll.custom_minimum_size.x = widest + 14.0
+	var box: Control = _crt_scroll.get_child(0)
+	_crt_scroll.custom_minimum_size.x = box.get_combined_minimum_size().x
+	# Everything else in the layout (the status line, the spacing) counts too.
+	var layout: Control = $Center/Layout
+	_settings_scroll.custom_minimum_size.y = 0.0
+	_crt_scroll.custom_minimum_size.y = 0.0
+	var chrome := layout.get_combined_minimum_size().y
+	if settings_panel.visible:
+		_settings_scroll.custom_minimum_size.y = maxf(120.0, minf(tallest, avail - chrome))
+	if crt_panel.visible:
+		_crt_scroll.custom_minimum_size.y = maxf(120.0, minf(box.get_combined_minimum_size().y, avail - chrome))
+	layout.reset_size()

+## the galaxy map, drawn on any CanvasItem:
+##   MapIcons.badge(ci, at, radius, colour, kind)
+##   MapIcons.glyph(ci, at, size, colour, kind)       (the glyph alone)
+## Kinds: temple, city, ship, you, warning, star, planet, moon, ringed,

+			line.call([[0.0, -0.95], [0.95, 0.0], [0.0, 0.95], [-0.95, 0.0]], true)

+			line.call([[-0.75, -0.55], [0.75, -0.55], [0.75, 0.65], [-0.75, 0.65]], true)

+		_:

+static func _ellipse(ci: CanvasItem, at: Vector2, r: Vector2, col: Color, w: float, rot := 0.0) -> void:
+	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+	for k in 33:
+		var a := k * TAU / 32.0
+		pts.append(at + Vector2(cos(a) * r.x, sin(a) * r.y).rotated(rot))
+	ci.draw_polyline(pts, col, w, true)

+
+## A route between two points: a glowing orange curve (or a dotted cyan one),
+## bowed sideways by `bend` px, with small nodes along it.
+static func route(ci: CanvasItem, a: Vector2, b: Vector2, col: Color, bend := 0.0, dotted := false, width := 3.0) -> void:
+	var mid := (a + b) * 0.5 + (b - a).orthogonal().normalized() * bend
+	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+	var n := 28
+	for i in n + 1:
+		var u := float(i) / n
+		pts.append(a.lerp(mid, u).lerp(mid.lerp(b, u), u))

+		for i in range(0, n, 2):
+			ci.draw_line(pts[i], pts[i + 1], Color(col, 0.85), width * 0.6, true)

+	ci.draw_polyline(pts, Color(col, 0.18), width * 4.0, true)
+	ci.draw_polyline(pts, Color(col, 0.35), width * 2.0, true)
+	ci.draw_polyline(pts, col.lightened(0.15), width, true)
+	for i in [7, 14, 21]:
+		ci.draw_circle(pts[i], width * 1.3, col.lightened(0.4))

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: While a full-screen menu is open (the Ship Computer, a station's window, the Field Computer): the world behind it shown as a picture taken as the menu opened, the world itself not drawn - the game goes on all the same (a hit still closes the menu, which brings the world back). Drawing a whole planet or a battle under a menu that hides all but its edges cost a quarter to half the frame rate. MenuBackdrop.watch(menu, world) (world: the scene root under the menu) What it hides: the world's own drawn children (culled, not made invisible), and its CanvasLayers below the menu's (backgrounds, the HUD). Not headless. (Moved from scripts/menu_backdrop.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,136 @@ 
+class_name MenuBackdrop
+extends RefCounted
+## While a full-screen menu is open (the Ship Computer, a station's window,
+## the Field Computer): the world behind it shown as a picture taken as the
+## menu opened, the world itself not drawn - the game goes on all the same
+## (a hit still closes the menu, which brings the world back). Drawing a whole
+## planet or a battle under a menu that hides all but its edges cost a
+## quarter to half the frame rate.
+##   MenuBackdrop.watch(menu, world)   (world: the scene root under the menu)
+## What it hides: the world's own drawn children (culled, not made invisible),
+## and its CanvasLayers below the menu's (backgrounds, the HUD). Not headless.
+
+var _rect: TextureRect
+var _hidden: Array = []
+
+
+static func watch(menu: Control, world: Node) -> MenuBackdrop:
+	var b := MenuBackdrop.new()
+	b._menu = weakref(menu)
+	b._world = weakref(world)
+	menu.set_meta("menu_backdrop", b)   # (kept as long as the menu is)
+	# (a method of its own, not a lambda holding the menu and the world: taken
+	# apart with the scene, the menu's last visibility_changed found them freed)
+	menu.visibility_changed.connect(b._on_visibility)
+	return b
+
+
+var _menu: WeakRef
+var _world: WeakRef
+
+func _on_visibility() -> void:
+	var menu: Control = _menu.get_ref() if _menu else null
+	var world: Node = _world.get_ref() if _world else null
+	if menu == null or world == null or menu.is_queued_for_deletion() or menu.has_meta("prewarm"):
+		return   # (gone - or shown for a frame unseen, to draw once: ShipMenu.prewarm)
+	set_on(menu, world, menu.visible)
+
+
+func is_on() -> bool:
+	return _rect != null
+
+
+## The world's drawn children are put on HIDDEN_LAYER (their visibility
+## layer) and the viewport stops drawing that layer: hidden without being
+## made invisible - showing a planet again after `visible = false` redrew every
+## piece of scenery and rebuilt the ground's tiles (a 150 ms frame).
+const HIDDEN_LAYER := 1 << 19
+
+func set_on(menu: Control, world: Node, on: bool) -> void:
+	if (on and _rect != null) or not menu.is_inside_tree() or not is_instance_valid(world):
+		return
+	var vp := menu.get_viewport()
+	if not on:
+		_token = 0   # (a picture still coming: not wanted now)
+		if _rect == null:
+			return
+		_rect.queue_free()
+		_rect = null
+		for e in _hidden:
+			if is_instance_valid(e[0]):
+				if e[0] is CanvasLayer:
+					e[0].visible = true
+				else:
+					e[0].visibility_layer = e[1]
+		_hidden = []
+		vp.canvas_cull_mask = vp.canvas_cull_mask | HIDDEN_LAYER
+		return
+	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless" or _capturing:
+		return
+	# The picture read back from the GPU without waiting for it (a plain
+	# read stalls the frame ~13 ms): it arrives a frame or two later - the
+	# world keeps drawing under the menu until then.
+	var rd := RenderingServer.get_rendering_device()
+	var tex := vp.get_texture()
+	var rid := RenderingServer.texture_get_rd_texture(tex.get_rid()) if rd else RID()
+	var tf: RDTextureFormat = rd.texture_get_format(rid) if rid.is_valid() else null
+	var fmt: int = tf.format if tf else -1
+	# (The size of the texture the pixels are read from - not the viewport's:
+	# just after the window is resized the two differ, and the picture's bytes
+	# didn't match its size: "Expected Image data size of 1916x1079 ... got 1918x1080's".)
+	var w: int = tf.width if tf else tex.get_width()
+	var h: int = tf.height if tf else tex.get_height()
+	if fmt in [RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB]:
+		_capturing = true
+		var token := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		_token = token
+		# (weak references: the picture can arrive after the scene is gone)
+		var wm: WeakRef = weakref(menu)
+		var ww: WeakRef = weakref(world)
+		rd.texture_get_data_async(rid, 0, func(data: PackedByteArray):
+			_capturing = false
+			var m: Control = wm.get_ref()
+			var wo: Node = ww.get_ref()
+			if token != _token or _rect != null or m == null or not m.visible or wo == null:
+				return   # (closed meanwhile)
+			if data.size() != w * h * 4:
+				return   # (not the size it was asked at: the world goes on drawing under the menu)
+			_show(m, wo, m.get_viewport(), Image.create_from_data(w, h, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8, data)))
+		return
+	var img: Image = tex.get_image()
+	if img == null or img.is_empty():
+		return
+	_show(menu, world, vp, img)
+
+
+var _capturing := false
+var _token := 0
+
+func _show(menu: Control, world: Node, vp: Viewport, img: Image) -> void:
+	_rect = TextureRect.new()
+	_rect.texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+	_rect.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
+	_rect.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_SCALE
+	_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_rect.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	var holder := menu.get_parent()
+	holder.add_child(_rect)
+	holder.move_child(_rect, 0)   # (under the menu)
+	var layer := _layer_of(menu)
+	for c in world.get_children():
+		if c is CanvasItem and c.visible and not c.is_ancestor_of(menu):
+			_hidden.append([c, c.visibility_layer])
+			c.visibility_layer = HIDDEN_LAYER
+		elif c is CanvasLayer and c.visible and not c.is_ancestor_of(menu) and c.layer < layer:
+			# (backgrounds and the HUD below the menu: hidden - space's starfield is no small thing to draw)
+			_hidden.append([c, 0])
+			c.visible = false
+	vp.canvas_cull_mask = vp.canvas_cull_mask & ~HIDDEN_LAYER
+
+
+static func _layer_of(n: Node) -> int:
+	while n:
+		if n is CanvasLayer:
+			return n.layer
+		n = n.get_parent()
+	return 0

+	_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
+	add_child(_vp)
+	var env := Environment.new()
+	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
+	env.background_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
+	env.ambient_light_color = Color(0.55, 0.6, 0.7)
+	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.55
+	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC
+	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
+	we.environment = env
+	_vp.add_child(we)
+	_cam = Camera3D.new()
+	_cam.projection = Camera3D.PROJECTION_ORTHOGONAL
+	_cam.size = STAND_M * 1.06
+	_cam.near = 0.1
+	_cam.far = 40.0
+	_vp.add_child(_cam)
+	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()       # (as the stage's: from the upper left, fixed to the camera)
+	sun.shadow_enabled = false
+	_vp.add_child(sun)
+	sun.look_at_from_position(Vector3(-3.4, 3.2, 2.4), Vector3.ZERO, Vector3.UP)
+	_pivot = Node3D.new()
+	_vp.add_child(_pivot)
+	if Stage3D.has_model(model_id):
+		var model: Node3D = Stage3D._scene(model_id).instantiate()
+		_pivot.add_child(model)
+		var mesh: MeshInstance3D = model.find_child("Body", true, false)
+		var mats := Stage3D.materials(model_id, mesh.mesh)
+		for i in mats.size():
+			mesh.set_surface_override_material(i, mats[i])
+		mesh.extra_cull_margin = 2.0
+		_anim = model.find_child("AnimationPlayer", true, false)
+		if _anim:
+			_anim.callback_mode_process = AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_MANUAL
+			var clip := CLIP if _anim.has_animation(CLIP) else "idle"
+			if _anim.has_animation(clip):
+				_anim.get_animation(clip).loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR
+				_anim.play(clip)
+				_anim.advance(0.0)
+	_aim()
+	_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+
+
+## The camera from the game's angle, a little above, turned by the drag.
+func _aim() -> void:
+	if _cam == null:
+		return
+	_pivot.rotation.y = yaw
+	var el := deg_to_rad(Stage3D.ELEVATION * 0.5) + pitch
+	var target := Vector3(0.0, STAND_M * 0.5, 0.0)
+	_cam.look_at_from_position(target + Vector3(0.0, sin(el), cos(el)) * 12.0, target, Vector3.UP)
+
+
+func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+		_dragging = event.pressed
+		accept_event()
+	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion and _dragging:
+		yaw = wrapf(yaw + event.relative.x * TURN, -PI, PI)
+		pitch = clampf(pitch + event.relative.y * TURN * 0.5, -0.45, 0.6)
+		_aim()
+		_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+		accept_event()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not is_visible_in_tree():
+		return
+	_t += delta
+	if _t < 1.0 / REDRAW_HZ:
+		return
+	if _anim and _anim.is_playing():
+		_anim.advance(_t)
+	_t = 0.0
+	_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The navigation beacon by every system's star: scan it (right-click) and it charts the system for good (Galaxy.chart_system) - the fog gone from its maps, every star, planet, moon, station and jump gate shown. Its picture (half a station's size) turning slowly, amber-labelled until it's scanned. Once it has charted the system (a pulse of light sweeps out over it), it comes alive, green: a glow, a pulsating ring (ticks and brackets turning round it), and scanning waves leaving in random directions that fade fast, each leaving a trail of holographic nebula gas (shaders/nav_trail.gdshader) that lingers and fades. Labelled CHARTED. Main places it (place()) and handles the right-click (_nav_beacon_at / chart_with_beacon). (Moved from scripts/nav_beacon.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,302 @@ 
+class_name NavBeacon
+extends Node2D
+## The navigation beacon by every system's star: scan it (right-click) and it charts the
+## system for good (Galaxy.chart_system) - the fog gone from its maps, every
+## star, planet, moon, station and jump gate shown. Its picture (half a
+## station's size) turning slowly, amber-labelled until it's scanned. Once
+## it has charted the system (a pulse of light sweeps out over it), it comes
+## alive, green: a glow, a pulsating ring (ticks and brackets turning round
+## it), and scanning waves leaving in random directions that fade fast, each
+## leaving a trail of holographic nebula gas (shaders/nav_trail.gdshader)
+## that lingers and fades. Labelled CHARTED. Main places it (place()) and handles the right-click
+## (_nav_beacon_at / chart_with_beacon).
+
+## Its size: half a station's (a station's picture is ~440 across), about
+## twice your ship.
+const SIZE := 220.0
+const RADIUS := SIZE * 0.5
+## A click this near its centre hits it (a bit more than the picture: easy to hit).
+const CLICK_RADIUS := 130.0
+## Scanning it (right-click): this long, from within this range (Main.scan_beacon).
+const SCAN_TIME := 6.0
+const SCAN_RANGE := 1600.0
+const PULSE_TIME := 2.2          # s: the charting pulse
+const PULSE_REACH := 2400.0
+## Scanning waves (once charted), each in a random direction: one every WAVE_EVERY s, out to WAVE_REACH, gone in WAVE_TIME.
+## (Slowed down SLOW times; one every WAVE_EVERY so at most about two trails overlap.)
+const SLOW := 6.0
+const WAVE_EVERY := 11.0
+const WAVE_TIME := 1.5 * SLOW
+const WAVE_REACH := 1100.0
+## The nebula a wave leaves behind it (shaders/nav_trail.gdshader) lasts this long where the front passed.
+const FOAM_TIME := 2.6 * SLOW
+const TRAIL_SEGMENTS := 20       # (quads across a wave's arc)
+
+var sys_id := ""
+var _tex: Texture2D               # data/sprites/nav_beacon.png (cut from external/images/nav_beacon.png)
+var _t := 0.0
+var _pulse := -1.0               # time since charting, < 0 = none
+var scan := -1.0                 # being scanned: 0..1 done (Main sets it); < 0 = not
+var scanner: Node2D              # the ship scanning it (for the beam)
+var _fx: Node2D                  # the waves' fronts, added on (they glow)
+var _trail: Node2D               # the nebula trails behind them (a shader)
+
+
+## Where it stands: by the star (the star's radius + a gap), at an angle of
+## its own for each system.
+static func place(sys: String, star_radius: float) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2.from_angle(float(hash(sys + ":nav") % 6283) / 1000.0) * (star_radius + 650.0)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_to_group("nav_beacons")
+	z_index = -3
+	_tex = ProcArt.sprite("nav_beacon")
+	_t = randf() * 10.0
+	# The nebula trails: a shader on a layer of their own, under the fronts.
+	_trail = Node2D.new()
+	_trail.z_index = -2
+	var sm := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	sm.shader = preload("res://shaders/nav_trail.gdshader")
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("noise", _noise())
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("wave_time", WAVE_TIME)
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("foam_time", FOAM_TIME)
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("slow", SLOW)
+	sm.set_shader_parameter("drift", 0.02 / SLOW)
+	_trail.material = sm
+	_trail.draw.connect(func(): _draw_trails(_trail))
+	add_child(_trail)
+	# The waves' fronts draw on a layer of their own, blended additively:
+	# light added to what's behind, so they glow.
+	_fx = Node2D.new()
+	_fx.z_index = -1
+	var add := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
+	add.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
+	_fx.material = add
+	_fx.draw.connect(func(): _draw_waves(_fx, _color()))
+	add_child(_fx)
+	var enabler := VisibleOnScreenEnabler2D.new()   # (still off screen: no redraws)
+	enabler.rect = Rect2(-Vector2.ONE * PULSE_REACH, Vector2.ONE * PULSE_REACH * 2.0)
+	add_child(enabler)
+
+
+func charted() -> bool:
+	return Galaxy.charted.has(sys_id)
+
+
+## (Charted just now) The pulse of light sweeping out over the system.
+func pulse() -> void:
+	_pulse = 0.0
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t += delta
+	if _pulse >= 0.0:
+		_pulse += delta
+		if _pulse > PULSE_TIME:
+			_pulse = -1.0
+	if _pulse >= 0.0 or scan >= 0.0 or UI.redraw_due(self):
+		queue_redraw()
+		var on := charted()   # (the animation only once it's scanned the system)
+		for layer in [_fx, _trail]:
+			if layer:
+				layer.visible = on
+				if on:
+					layer.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _color() -> Color:
+	return Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.7) if charted() else Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.3)
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	var c := _color()
+	var done := charted()
+	var beat := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 1.3)   # (the pulse: 0..1)
+	var rr := RADIUS * 1.12 + 6.0 * beat
+	# Charted: a soft glow behind it, breathing with the pulse (before, just the beacon).
+	if done:
+		var gr := RADIUS * (2.0 + 0.15 * beat)
+		draw_texture_rect(_glow(), Rect2(-gr, -gr, gr * 2.0, gr * 2.0), false, Color(c, 0.28 + 0.14 * beat))
+	# The beacon itself, turning slowly.
+	if _tex:
+		var k := SIZE / maxf(_tex.get_width(), _tex.get_height())
+		draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, _t * 0.15, Vector2(k, k))
+		draw_texture(_tex, -_tex.get_size() / 2.0)
+		draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)
+	else:
+		draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, RADIUS * 0.6, Color(0.9, 0.85, 0.7))
+	if scan >= 0.0 and not done:
+		_draw_scan()
+	if done:
+		# The pulsating ring: a wide faint glow, a narrower one and a bright core line.
+		draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rr, 0, TAU, 64, Color(c, 0.08 + 0.06 * beat), 18.0, true)
+		draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rr, 0, TAU, 64, Color(c, 0.2 + 0.15 * beat), 7.0, true)
+		draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rr, 0, TAU, 64, Color(c.lightened(0.35), 0.75 + 0.25 * beat), 2.0, true)
+		# Ticks round it, turning one way; three brackets further out, the other.
+		var ticks := PackedVector2Array()
+		for i in 36:
+			var a := i * TAU / 36.0 + _t * 0.2
+			var long := 9.0 if i % 3 == 0 else 4.0
+			ticks.append(Vector2.from_angle(a) * (rr + 13.0))
+			ticks.append(Vector2.from_angle(a) * (rr + 13.0 + long))
+		draw_multiline(ticks, Color(c, 0.55), 1.5)
+		for i in 3:
+			var a0 := i * TAU / 3.0 - _t * 0.35
+			draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rr + 32.0, a0, a0 + 0.9, 16, Color(c, 0.12), 8.0, true)
+			draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rr + 32.0, a0, a0 + 0.9, 16, Color(c, 0.7), 2.0, true)
+	# The charting pulse: rings of light sweeping out over the system.
+	if _pulse >= 0.0:
+		for k2 in 3:
+			var f := _pulse / PULSE_TIME - k2 * 0.18
+			if f > 0.0 and f < 1.0:
+				draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, RADIUS + f * PULSE_REACH, 0, TAU, 96, Color(c, (1.0 - f) * 0.6), 6.0 * (1.0 - f) + 2.0, true)
+	var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
+	var label := "NAV BEACON  ·  CHARTED" if done else ("NAV BEACON  ·  SCANNING  %d%%" % int(scan * 100.0) if scan >= 0.0 else "NAV BEACON  ·  RIGHT-CLICK TO SCAN")
+	var fs := Settings.fs("world", 20)
+	var ly := (rr + 70.0) if done else (RADIUS * 1.45 + 30.0 if scan >= 0.0 else RADIUS + 34.0)
+	draw_string_outline(font, Vector2(-220, ly), label, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 440, fs, 5, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.85))
+	draw_string(font, Vector2(-220, ly), label, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 440, fs, c.lightened(0.2))
+
+
+## Being scanned: a beam from the ship, a scan line sweeping up and down
+## over the beacon with a band of light behind it, a ring filling round it
+## as the scan goes (amber, a bright head), and its corners bracketed.
+func _draw_scan() -> void:
+	var c := Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.3)
+	var cyan := Color(0.4, 0.95, 1.0)
+	var flick := 0.75 + 0.25 * sin(_t * 23.0)
+	# The beam from the ship: a glow, a core, light running along it.
+	if is_instance_valid(scanner):
+		var from := to_local(scanner.global_position)
+		var to := from.normalized() * RADIUS * 0.9 if from.length() > 1.0 else Vector2.ZERO
+		draw_line(from, to, Color(cyan, 0.12 * flick), 14.0, true)
+		draw_line(from, to, Color(cyan, 0.7 * flick), 2.5, true)
+		var along := to - from
+		for i in 5:
+			var f := fmod(_t * 1.6 + i / 5.0, 1.0)
+			draw_circle(from + along * f, 4.0, Color(cyan.lightened(0.4), 0.8 * flick))
+	# The scan line sweeping over the beacon, up and down (twice a second), its chord across the disc.
+	var sweep := sin(_t * TAU * 0.5)
+	var y := sweep * RADIUS * 0.85
+	var half := sqrt(maxf(RADIUS * RADIUS - y * y, 0.0))
+	for k in 6:   # (a band of light trailing it)
+		var yy := y - signf(cos(_t * TAU * 0.5)) * k * 6.0
+		var hh := sqrt(maxf(RADIUS * RADIUS - yy * yy, 0.0))
+		draw_line(Vector2(-hh, yy), Vector2(hh, yy), Color(cyan, 0.12 * (1.0 - k / 6.0)), 6.0, true)
+	draw_line(Vector2(-half, y), Vector2(half, y), Color(cyan.lightened(0.5), 0.9), 2.5, true)
+	# The progress ring, filling from the top, a bright head where it's got to.
+	var rr := RADIUS * 1.18
+	draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rr, 0, TAU, 64, Color(c, 0.15), 6.0, true)
+	var a1 := -PI / 2.0 + TAU * scan
+	draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rr, -PI / 2.0, a1, 64, Color(c, 0.3), 14.0, true)
+	draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, rr, -PI / 2.0, a1, 64, Color(c.lightened(0.3), 0.95), 4.0, true)
+	draw_circle(Vector2.from_angle(a1) * rr, 7.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9))
+	# Corner brackets, closing in as it goes.
+	var bs := RADIUS * (1.45 - 0.2 * scan)
+	for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		for sy in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var p := Vector2(sx, sy) * bs
+			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([p - Vector2(sx * 22.0, 0), p, p - Vector2(0, sy * 22.0)]), Color(cyan, 0.85), 2.5, true)
+
+
+## The waves (once charted): every WAVE_EVERY seconds one leaves the ring in
+## a direction of its own (random - its number seeds it: no state kept),
+## widening as it goes and fading fast (WAVE_TIME); behind it a nebula trail
+## (_draw_trails) lingers FOAM_TIME. Its front: a glowing arc with
+## holographic fringes, cyan inside and violet outside.
+func _wave(k: int) -> Array:   # [direction, spread, seed 0..1]
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = hash(sys_id) ^ (k * 7919)
+	return [rng.randf() * TAU, rng.randf_range(0.35, 0.7), rng.randf()]
+
+
+func _waves_alive() -> Array:   # [[k, age]...]
+	var out := []
+	var now_k := floori(_t / WAVE_EVERY)
+	for back in ceili((WAVE_TIME + FOAM_TIME) / WAVE_EVERY) + 1:
+		var k := now_k - back
+		var age := _t - k * WAVE_EVERY
+		if age >= 0.0 and age <= WAVE_TIME + FOAM_TIME:
+			out.append([k, age])
+	return out
+
+
+func _draw_waves(ci: CanvasItem, c: Color) -> void:
+	var r0 := RADIUS * 1.2
+	for ka in _waves_alive():
+		var f: float = ka[1] / WAVE_TIME
+		if f >= 1.0:
+			continue
+		var w := _wave(ka[0])
+		var dir: float = w[0]
+		var fade := pow(1.0 - f, 1.6)
+		var r := r0 + f * WAVE_REACH
+		var half: float = w[1] * (0.6 + 0.4 * f)
+		var th := 1.0 + f * 1.5
+		ci.draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, r, dir - half, dir + half, 40, Color(c, 0.14 * fade), 44.0 * th, true)
+		ci.draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, r, dir - half, dir + half, 40, Color(c, 0.3 * fade), 16.0 * th, true)
+		ci.draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, r - 5.0 * th, dir - half * 0.9, dir + half * 0.9, 40, Color(0.35, 0.95, 1.0, 0.55 * fade), 2.5, true)
+		ci.draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, r + 5.0 * th, dir - half * 0.9, dir + half * 0.9, 40, Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.95, 0.45 * fade), 2.5, true)
+		ci.draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, r, dir - half * 0.85, dir + half * 0.85, 40, Color(c.lightened(0.6), fade), 3.0, true)
+
+
+## The nebula trails: for each wave a sector of quads over the whole way it
+## goes - the shader (nav_trail.gdshader) shows the gas only where the front
+## has passed, and fades it. UV: x across the arc, y out along the way; the
+## vertex colour: r the wave's age (of its whole life), g its seed.
+func _draw_trails(ci: CanvasItem) -> void:
+	var r0 := RADIUS * 1.2
+	var r1 := r0 + WAVE_REACH
+	var life := WAVE_TIME + FOAM_TIME
+	(ci.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("tint", _color())
+	for ka in _waves_alive():
+		var w := _wave(ka[0])
+		var col := Color(ka[1] / life, w[2], 0.0, 1.0)
+		var cols := PackedColorArray([col, col, col, col])
+		var span: float = w[1] * 1.15
+		for i in TRAIL_SEGMENTS:
+			var u0 := float(i) / TRAIL_SEGMENTS
+			var u1 := float(i + 1) / TRAIL_SEGMENTS
+			var a0: float = w[0] - span + u0 * span * 2.0
+			var a1: float = w[0] - span + u1 * span * 2.0
+			var d0 := Vector2.from_angle(a0)
+			var d1 := Vector2.from_angle(a1)
+			ci.draw_primitive(PackedVector2Array([d0 * r0, d1 * r0, d1 * r1, d0 * r1]), cols,
+				PackedVector2Array([Vector2(u0, 0.0), Vector2(u1, 0.0), Vector2(u1, 1.0), Vector2(u0, 1.0)]), _noise())   # (a texture: else the UVs are dropped)
+
+
+## The trails' noise: soft fractal noise that tiles, made once, shared.
+static var _noise_tex: NoiseTexture2D
+static func _noise() -> NoiseTexture2D:
+	if _noise_tex == null:
+		var fn := FastNoiseLite.new()
+		fn.noise_type = FastNoiseLite.TYPE_SIMPLEX_SMOOTH
+		fn.frequency = 0.012
+		fn.fractal_type = FastNoiseLite.FRACTAL_FBM
+		fn.fractal_octaves = 5
+		fn.seed = 1717
+		_noise_tex = NoiseTexture2D.new()
+		_noise_tex.width = 256
+		_noise_tex.height = 256
+		_noise_tex.seamless = true
+		_noise_tex.generate_mipmaps = true
+		_noise_tex.noise = fn
+	return _noise_tex
+
+
+## The glow: one radial gradient (white to clear), shared by every beacon.
+static var _glow_tex: GradientTexture2D
+static func _glow() -> GradientTexture2D:
+	if _glow_tex == null:
+		var g := Gradient.new()
+		g.offsets = PackedFloat32Array([0.0, 0.35, 1.0])
+		g.colors = PackedColorArray([Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.0)])
+		_glow_tex = GradientTexture2D.new()
+		_glow_tex.gradient = g
+		_glow_tex.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_RADIAL
+		_glow_tex.fill_from = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
+		_glow_tex.fill_to = Vector2(1.0, 0.5)
+		_glow_tex.width = 128
+		_glow_tex.height = 128
+	return _glow_tex

@@ -1,0 +1,141 @@ 
+class_name NavReportPanel
+extends PanelContainer
+## A navigation report on screen (NavReports): the system's stations and jump
+## gates, its planets and moons, the traffic (hostile ships by who they are,
+## friendly and neutral ones by empire and by trade, monsters) and what else is
+## there (asteroids, wrecks, signals); under it, what the copy in your hold
+## sells for. Opened when the nav beacon's scan is done (Main.chart_with_beacon)
+## and by right-clicking a scanned beacon again; ✕ or Esc closes it. The game
+## goes on behind it.
+
+var report: Dictionary = {}

+	var friendly: Dictionary = report.get("friendly", {})

Its own touches, all optional: rail a lit bar down the left edge (buttons: where the eye starts) accent bracket corners just outside the two square corners (top-right, bottom-left) and, on boxes big enough, a hatch of slanted ticks in the top-right corner - the signature of every panel skew a slant (tabs, menu buttons); border_width_bottom: a thick bottom edge (selected tabs) A box with `fill_solid` is lit all over in its border colour (hovered buttons, the selected tab) - text on it uses NeonTheme.INK. (Moved from scripts/neon_box.gd.)

@@ -1,0 +1,137 @@ 
+class_name NeonBox
+extends StyleBox
+## The GUI's panel / button box (the "Helm" look - NeonTheme): dark smoked
+## glass with two chamfered corners (top-left, bottom-right), a thin amber
+## border and only a faint glow. Its own touches, all optional:
+##   rail     a lit bar down the left edge (buttons: where the eye starts)
+##   accent   bracket corners just outside the two square corners (top-right,
+##            bottom-left) and, on boxes big enough, a hatch of slanted ticks
+##            in the top-right corner - the signature of every panel
+##   skew     a slant (tabs, menu buttons); border_width_bottom: a thick
+##            bottom edge (selected tabs)
+## A box with `fill_solid` is lit all over in its border colour (hovered
+## buttons, the selected tab) - text on it uses NeonTheme.INK.
+
+## Darkest colour (bottom of the gradient); its alpha is the box's opacity.
+@export var bg_color := Color(0.03, 0.018, 0.008, 0.92)
+@export var border_color := Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.1)
+@export var border_width := 1.0
+## Thicker bottom edge (tabs); <= border_width to disable.
+@export var border_width_bottom := -1.0
+## Width of the outer glow in px (0 = none).
+@export var glow := 4.0
+@export var cut := 10.0
+## Horizontal slant, as StyleBoxFlat.skew.
+@export var skew := Vector2.ZERO
+@export var draw_center := true
+## How much of the border colour lights the top of the gradient (0..1).
+@export var light := 0.12
+## Bracket corners and the corner hatch, in this colour. Clear = none.
+@export var accent := Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+## The lit bar down the left edge, px (0 = none).
+@export var rail := 0.0
+## Filled with the border colour (a lit button / tab).
+@export var fill_solid := false
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	content_margin_left = 12
+	content_margin_right = 12
+	content_margin_top = 6
+	content_margin_bottom = 6
+
+
+## StyleBoxFlat-compatible helper.
+func set_border_width_all(w: int) -> void:
+	border_width = w
+
+
+func _shape(r: Rect2, grow := 0.0) -> PackedVector2Array:
+	r = r.grow(grow)
+	var c := minf(cut + grow * 0.4, minf(r.size.x, r.size.y) / 3.0)
+	var pts := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(r.position.x + c, r.position.y), Vector2(r.end.x, r.position.y),
+		Vector2(r.end.x, r.end.y - c), Vector2(r.end.x - c, r.end.y), Vector2(r.position.x, r.end.y),
+		Vector2(r.position.x, r.position.y + c)])
+	_slant(pts, r.get_center().y)
+	return pts
+
+
+func _slant(pts: PackedVector2Array, cy: float) -> void:
+	if skew.x != 0.0:
+		for i in pts.size():
+			pts[i].x += skew.x * (cy - pts[i].y)
+
+
+func _draw(ci: RID, rect: Rect2) -> void:
+	if rect.size.x < 2.0 or rect.size.y < 2.0:
+		return
+	var pts := _shape(rect)
+	var loop := pts.duplicate()
+	loop.append(pts[0])
+	var cy := rect.get_center().y
+	# Faint glow: a few translucent outlines, widest first.
+	if glow > 0.0 and border_color.a > 0.0:
+		for k in range(3, 0, -1):
+			RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_polyline(ci, loop, PackedColorArray([Color(border_color, border_color.a * 0.08)]), glow * 2.0 * k / 3.0, true)
+	if draw_center and (bg_color.a > 0.0 or fill_solid):
+		var top: Color
+		var bottom: Color
+		if fill_solid:
+			# Lit: the border colour itself, a touch brighter at the top.
+			top = border_color.lightened(0.12)
+			bottom = border_color.darkened(0.1)
+			top.a = maxf(bg_color.a, 0.92)
+			bottom.a = top.a
+		else:
+			top = bg_color.lerp(Color(border_color.r, border_color.g, border_color.b, bg_color.a), light)
+			top.a = bg_color.a
+			bottom = bg_color.darkened(0.3)
+			bottom.a = bg_color.a
+		var cols := PackedColorArray()
+		for p in pts:
+			cols.append(top.lerp(bottom, clampf((p.y - rect.position.y) / rect.size.y, 0.0, 1.0)))
+		if not Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon(pts).is_empty():   # (a box too thin to fill: skip the fill)
+			RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_polygon(ci, pts, cols)
+	# The rail: a lit bar just inside the left edge (below the top-left chamfer).
+	if rail > 0.0 and border_color.a > 0.0 and rect.size.y > 10.0:
+		var c := minf(cut, minf(rect.size.x, rect.size.y) / 3.0)
+		var x := rect.position.x + rail / 2.0 + 2.0
+		var seg := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(x, rect.position.y + c + 3.0), Vector2(x, rect.end.y - 3.0)])
+		_slant(seg, cy)
+		RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_line(ci, seg[0], seg[1], Color(border_color, minf(1.0, border_color.a * 1.6)), rail)
+	# Border (and the optional thick bottom edge).
+	if border_width > 0.0 and border_color.a > 0.0:
+		RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_polyline(ci, loop, PackedColorArray([border_color]), border_width, true)
+	if border_width_bottom > border_width:
+		var a := pts[4] + Vector2(0, -border_width_bottom / 2.0)
+		var b := pts[3] + Vector2(0, -border_width_bottom / 2.0)
+		RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_line(ci, a, b, border_color, border_width_bottom, true)
+	if accent.a > 0.0 and rect.size.x > 60.0 and rect.size.y > 40.0:
+		_brackets(ci, rect, cy)
+		if rect.size.x > 160.0 and rect.size.y > 120.0:   # (short bars keep their corner free for a button)
+			_hatch(ci, rect, cy)
+
+
+## Bracket corners: short L's just outside the two square corners (top-right
+## and bottom-left), standing off the border by a few px.
+func _brackets(ci: RID, r: Rect2, cy: float) -> void:
+	var run := clampf(minf(r.size.x, r.size.y) * 0.18, 10.0, 34.0)
+	var o := 4.0
+	var w := maxf(1.5, border_width + 0.5)
+	for b in [[Vector2(r.end.x - run, r.position.y - o), Vector2(r.end.x + o, r.position.y - o), Vector2(r.end.x + o, r.position.y + run)],
+			[Vector2(r.position.x + run, r.end.y + o), Vector2(r.position.x - o, r.end.y + o), Vector2(r.position.x - o, r.end.y - run)]]:
+		var line := PackedVector2Array(b)
+		_slant(line, cy)
+		RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_polyline(ci, line, PackedColorArray([accent]), w, true)
+
+
+## The corner hatch: six slanted ticks inside the top-right corner, fading
+## toward the corner.
+func _hatch(ci: RID, r: Rect2, cy: float) -> void:
+	var h := 7.0
+	var y := r.position.y + border_width + 5.0
+	for i in 6:
+		var x := r.end.x - 14.0 - i * 7.0
+		var seg := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(x, y + h), Vector2(x + 4.0, y)])
+		_slant(seg, cy)
+		RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_line(ci, seg[0], seg[1], Color(accent, accent.a * (0.9 - i * 0.12)), 2.0, true)

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The game's GUI look, "Helm": a ship's console in amber on smoked black glass. Panels have two chamfered corners, a thin amber border with only a faint glow, bracket corners standing off the two square corners and a hatch of slanted ticks in the top-right corner (NeonBox); buttons have a lit rail down their left edge and light up solid amber (dark ink text) under the mouse; the selected tab is solid amber. Steel blue (INFO) is the second colour: data, friendly things, shields. Rajdhani headings and the chrome title font. build() makes a Theme that the Settings autoload puts on the root window, so every Control in every scene (menus, HUD, panels, popups, tooltips) follows it; the code-built panels use box() for the same style. (The variable names CYAN / PINK are older than the palette: CYAN is the main colour - amber - and PINK the highlight - pale gold.) (Moved from scripts/neon_theme.gd.)
