+## box's corner cut, border width and glow; panel opacity; the button fill,
+## the top-edge sheen and the tooltip border ("" colour: the highlight).
+static var CUT_K := 1.0
+static var BORDER_K := 1.0
+static var GLOW_K := 1.0
+static var PANEL_ALPHA := 0.93
+static var BUTTON_FILL := Color(0.05, 0.028, 0.01, 0.92)
+static var SHEEN := 0.12
+static var TOOLTIP := Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+## The look last applied (apply_look), re-applied over empire palettes.
+static var custom := {}
+
+static var _theme: Theme
+static var _title_font: Font
+static var _heavy_font: Font
+
+
+## A neon box (see NeonBox): cut corners, a light-to-dark gradient of its own
+## colour, a glowing border and a soft glow around it.
+static func box(border: Color, bg := BG, width := 2, glow := 6, cut := CUT) -> NeonBox:
+	var s := NeonBox.new()
+	s.bg_color = bg
+	s.border_color = border
+	s.border_width = width * BORDER_K
+	s.cut = cut * CUT_K
+	s.glow = maxf(glow * 0.45, 2.0) * GLOW_K   # a faint glow; highlighted boxes a little more
+	s.light = SHEEN
+	return s
+
+
+## A lit box: filled solid with `color` (hovered buttons, the selected tab).
+## Text on it: INK.
+static func lit(color: Color, width := 1, cut := 7) -> NeonBox:
+	var s := box(color, Color(color, 0.95), width, 8, cut)
+	s.fill_solid = true
+	return s
+
+
+## A button's resting box: dark, a thin border, the lit rail down its left edge.
+static func railed(border: Color, bg := BUTTON_FILL, cut := 7) -> NeonBox:
+	var s := box(border, bg, 1, 0, cut)
+	s.rail = 3.0
+	s.content_margin_left = 16
+	return s
+
+
+## Slanted (parallelogram) button boxes for the big menu buttons.
+static func menu_button_styles() -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	var defs := {"normal": [Color(CYAN, 0.6), Color(BG, 0.94), 0],
+		"hover": [CYAN, Color(CYAN, 0.95), 12],
+		"pressed": [PINK, Color(PINK, 0.95), 10],
+		"hover_pressed": [PINK, Color(PINK, 0.95), 12],
+		"focus": [Color(PINK, 0.9), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 0],
+		"disabled": [Color(DISABLED, 0.4), Color(BG, 0.85), 0]}
+	for k in defs:
+		var d: Array = defs[k]
+		var s := box(d[0], d[1], 1, d[2], 12)
+		s.fill_solid = k in ["hover", "pressed", "hover_pressed"]
+		s.rail = 4.0 if k == "normal" else 0.0
+		s.skew = Vector2(0.28, 0)
+		s.content_margin_left = 24
+		s.content_margin_right = 24
+		if k == "focus":
+			s.draw_center = false
+		out[k] = s
+	return out
+
+
+## A cut-corner frame: fill, outline, optional inner shape.
+static func _frame_icon(w: int, h: int, outline: Array, fill: Color, stroke: Color, inner: Array = [], inner_col := Color(0, 0, 0, 0)) -> ImageTexture:
+	var layers := [{"pts": Icons.poly(outline), "fill": fill, "stroke": stroke, "width": 2.0}]
+	if not inner.is_empty():
+		layers.append({"pts": Icons.poly(inner), "fill": inner_col})
+	return Icons.paint(w, h, layers)
+
+
+## The heavy chrome title font (Noto Sans Black, slanted and emboldened).
+static func title_font() -> Font:
+	if _title_font == null:
+		var base: FontFile = load("res://assets/fonts/NotoSans-Black.ttf")
+		var v := FontVariation.new()
+		v.base_font = base
+		v.variation_embolden = 0.6
+		v.variation_transform = Transform2D(Vector2(1, 0), Vector2(0.24, 1), Vector2.ZERO)   # italic slant
+		v.spacing_glyph = 2
+		_title_font = v
+	return _title_font
+
+
+## Headings, tabs and big buttons: Rajdhani Bold - the squared techno face
+## of the reference console (SIL OFL), letter-spaced.
+static func heavy_font() -> Font:
+	if _heavy_font == null:
+		var v := FontVariation.new()
+		v.base_font = load("res://assets/fonts/Rajdhani-Bold.ttf")
+		v.spacing_glyph = 2
+		_heavy_font = v
+	return _heavy_font
+
+
+## A dark background tinted with the highlight colour (hover, selection).
+## Greyed-out things (disabled buttons).
+static var DISABLED := Color(0.5, 0.42, 0.36)
+
+
+static func hi_bg(alpha: float, k := 0.16) -> Color:
+	return Color(PINK.r * k, PINK.g * k, PINK.b * k, alpha)
+
+
+## The symbols the UI uses (arrows ▲ ▼ ◀ ▶, ✓ ✕, ●, ─, Greek capitals...)
+## that the game's fonts don't have, from two small bundled fonts: without
+## them every piece of text holding one asked the system's fontconfig for a
+## font that has it - each time it was laid out (a rule card in the Scenario
+## Editor: ~60 ms, three quarters of it in fontconfig). Given to the default
+## font and to every bundled one, so text finds them before the system.
+const SYMBOL_FONTS := ["res://assets/fonts/DejaVuSans-Symbols.ttf", "res://assets/fonts/NotoSansMath-Arrows.ttf"]
+static var _fallbacks_done := false
+
+static func install_fallbacks() -> void:
+	if _fallbacks_done:
+		return
+	_fallbacks_done = true
+	var syms: Array[Font] = []
+	for path in SYMBOL_FONTS:
+		var f: Font = load(path)
+		if f:
+			syms.append(f)
+	var fonts: Array = [ThemeDB.fallback_font]
+	for path in ["res://assets/fonts/Rajdhani-Bold.ttf", "res://assets/fonts/Rajdhani-SemiBold.ttf", "res://assets/fonts/NotoSans-Black.ttf"]:
+		fonts.append(load(path))
+	for f in fonts:
+		if f is Font and f.fallbacks.is_empty():
+			f.fallbacks = syms
+
+
+static func build() -> Theme:
+	install_fallbacks()
+	if _theme != null:
+		return _theme
+	var t := Theme.new()
+	_theme = t
+
+	# Buttons (also OptionButton / MenuButton / CheckBox texts).
+	# Resting: dark with a thin amber edge and the lit rail; under the mouse
+	# the whole button lights up amber (dark ink text); pressed: pale gold.
+	var bn := railed(Color(CYAN, 0.6))
+	var bh := lit(CYAN)
+	bh.content_margin_left = 16
+	var bp := lit(PINK)
+	bp.content_margin_left = 16
+	var bhp := lit(PINK.lightened(0.1))
+	bhp.content_margin_left = 16
+	var bd := railed(Color(DISABLED, 0.3), Color(BG, 0.6))
+	var bf := box(Color(PINK, 0.9), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 1, 0, 7)
+	bf.draw_center = false
+	for type in ["Button", "OptionButton", "MenuButton", "ColorPickerButton"]:
+		t.set_stylebox("normal", type, bn)
+		t.set_stylebox("hover", type, bh)
+		t.set_stylebox("pressed", type, bp)
+		t.set_stylebox("hover_pressed", type, bhp)
+		t.set_stylebox("disabled", type, bd)
+		t.set_stylebox("focus", type, bf)
+		t.set_color("font_color", type, TEXT)
+		t.set_color("font_hover_color", type, INK)
+		t.set_color("font_pressed_color", type, INK)
+		t.set_color("font_hover_pressed_color", type, INK)
+		t.set_color("font_focus_color", type, TEXT)
+		t.set_color("font_disabled_color", type, Color(DISABLED, 0.7))
+		t.set_color("font_outline_color", type, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.0))
+		t.set_color("icon_normal_color", type, TEXT)
+		t.set_color("icon_hover_color", type, INK)
+		t.set_color("icon_pressed_color", type, INK)
+		t.set_color("icon_hover_pressed_color", type, INK)
+
+	# Check boxes / toggle switches: transparent, neon icons.
+	var clear := StyleBoxEmpty.new()
+	clear.content_margin_left = 4
+	clear.content_margin_right = 4
+	for type in ["CheckBox", "CheckButton"]:
+		for k in ["normal", "hover", "pressed", "hover_pressed", "disabled"]:
+			t.set_stylebox(k, type, clear)
+		t.set_stylebox("focus", type, StyleBoxEmpty.new())
+		t.set_color("font_color", type, TEXT)
+		t.set_color("font_hover_color", type, HEAD)
+		t.set_color("font_pressed_color", type, TEXT)
+		t.set_color("font_hover_pressed_color", type, HEAD)
+		t.set_color("font_focus_color", type, TEXT)
+	var box := [[5, 2], [20, 2], [20, 17], [17, 20], [2, 20], [2, 5]]
+	var check_off := _frame_icon(22, 22, box, Color(BG, 1.0), Color(CYAN, 0.75))
+	var check_on := Icons.paint(22, 22, [{"pts": Icons.poly(box), "fill": Color(BG_LIGHT, 1.0), "stroke": CYAN, "width": 2.0},
+		{"pts": Icons.poly([[6, 11], [10, 15], [17, 6]]), "closed": false, "stroke": PINK, "width": 3.0}])
+	t.set_icon("unchecked", "CheckBox", check_off)
+	t.set_icon("checked", "CheckBox", check_on)
+	t.set_icon("radio_unchecked", "CheckBox", check_off)
+	t.set_icon("radio_checked", "CheckBox", check_on)
+	var sw_track := [[8, 2], [44, 2], [44, 16], [38, 22], [2, 22], [2, 8]]
+	var sw_off := _frame_icon(46, 24, sw_track, Color(BG, 1.0), Color(CYAN, 0.5), [[8, 6], [18, 6], [18, 18], [6, 18], [6, 8]], Color(DISABLED, 0.8))
+	var sw_on := _frame_icon(46, 24, sw_track, hi_bg(1.0, 0.25), CYAN, [[30, 6], [40, 6], [40, 16], [38, 18], [28, 18], [28, 8]], PINK)
+	for k in ["checked", "checked_mirrored"]:
+		t.set_icon(k, "CheckButton", sw_on)
+	for k in ["unchecked", "unchecked_mirrored"]:
+		t.set_icon(k, "CheckButton", sw_off)
+
+	# Panels and popups.
+	var panel := box(Color(CYAN, 0.55), BG, 1, 6)
+	panel.accent = Color(CYAN, 0.9)
+	panel.content_margin_left = 0
+	panel.content_margin_right = 0
+	panel.content_margin_top = 0
+	panel.content_margin_bottom = 0
+	t.set_stylebox("panel", "Panel", panel)
+	t.set_stylebox("panel", "PanelContainer", panel)
+	var pop := box(Color(CYAN, 0.7), Color(BG, 0.97), 1, 6, 6)
+	pop.content_margin_top = 6
+	pop.content_margin_bottom = 6
+	t.set_stylebox("panel", "PopupMenu", pop)
+	t.set_stylebox("panel", "PopupPanel", pop)
+	t.set_stylebox("panel", "TooltipPanel", box(Color(TOOLTIP if TOOLTIP.a > 0.0 else CYAN, 0.8), Color(BG, 0.97), 1, 4, 5))
+	t.set_color("font_color", "TooltipLabel", TEXT)
+	var pop_hover := lit(CYAN, 1, 4)
+	pop_hover.content_margin_left = 4
+	t.set_stylebox("hover", "PopupMenu", pop_hover)
+	var sep := StyleBoxLine.new()
+	sep.color = Color(CYAN, 0.3)
+	sep.thickness = 1
+	t.set_stylebox("separator", "PopupMenu", sep)
+	var lsep := StyleBoxLine.new()
+	lsep.color = Color(PINK, 0.5)
+	lsep.thickness = 1
+	t.set_stylebox("labeled_separator_left", "PopupMenu", lsep)
+	t.set_stylebox("labeled_separator_right", "PopupMenu", lsep)
+	t.set_color("font_color", "PopupMenu", TEXT)
+	t.set_color("font_disabled_color", "PopupMenu", Color(TEXT_DIM, 0.6))
+	t.set_constant("v_separation", "PopupMenu", 10)
+	t.set_constant("item_start_padding", "PopupMenu", 14)
+	t.set_constant("item_end_padding", "PopupMenu", 18)
+	t.set_constant("h_separation", "PopupMenu", 8)
+	t.set_color("font_hover_color", "PopupMenu", INK)
+	t.set_color("font_separator_color", "PopupMenu", TEXT_DIM)
+
+	# Text fields.
+	var le := box(Color(CYAN, 0.35), Color(BG.darkened(0.3), 0.95), 1, 0, 6)
+	var lef := box(PINK, Color(BG_LIGHT, 0.98), 1, 6, 6)
+	for type in ["LineEdit", "TextEdit", "SpinBox"]:
+		t.set_stylebox("normal", type, le)
+		t.set_stylebox("focus", type, lef)
+		t.set_stylebox("read_only", type, le)
+		t.set_color("font_color", type, TEXT)
+		t.set_color("caret_color", type, PINK)
+		t.set_color("selection_color", type, Color(PINK, 0.35))
+		t.set_color("font_placeholder_color", type, Color(TEXT_DIM, 0.6))
+
+	# Sliders: thin neon track, diamond grabber.
+	var track := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	track.bg_color = Color(BG_LIGHT, 0.9)
+	track.border_color = Color(CYAN, 0.3)
+	track.set_border_width_all(1)
+	track.content_margin_top = 3
+	track.content_margin_bottom = 3
+	var fill := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	fill.bg_color = Color(CYAN, 0.75)
+	fill.shadow_color = Color(CYAN, 0.35)
+	fill.shadow_size = 4
+	fill.content_margin_top = 3
+	fill.content_margin_bottom = 3
+	var fill_hi := fill.duplicate()
+	fill_hi.bg_color = PINK
+	fill_hi.shadow_color = Color(PINK, 0.4)
+	t.set_stylebox("slider", "HSlider", track)
+	t.set_stylebox("grabber_area", "HSlider", fill)
+	t.set_stylebox("grabber_area_highlight", "HSlider", fill_hi)
+	var diamond := [[11, 1], [21, 11], [11, 21], [1, 11]]
+	var gem := [[11, 6], [16, 11], [11, 16], [6, 11]]
+	var grab := _frame_icon(22, 22, diamond, Color(BG, 1.0), CYAN, gem, CYAN)
+	var grab_hi := _frame_icon(22, 22, diamond, hi_bg(1.0, 0.18), PINK, gem, PINK)
+	t.set_icon("grabber", "HSlider", grab)
+	t.set_icon("grabber_highlight", "HSlider", grab_hi)
+
+	# Scroll bars.
+	for type in ["VScrollBar", "HScrollBar"]:
+		var sc := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+		sc.bg_color = Color(BG, 0.7)
+		sc.border_color = Color(CYAN, 0.2)
+		sc.set_border_width_all(1)
+		sc.content_margin_left = 5
+		sc.content_margin_right = 5
+		sc.content_margin_top = 5
+		sc.content_margin_bottom = 5
+		var g := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+		g.bg_color = Color(CYAN, 0.6)
+		g.corner_radius_top_left = 4
+		g.corner_radius_bottom_right = 4
+		g.corner_detail = 1
+		var gh := g.duplicate()
+		gh.bg_color = PINK
+		gh.shadow_color = Color(PINK, 0.4)
+		gh.shadow_size = 4
+		t.set_stylebox("scroll", type, sc)
+		t.set_stylebox("scroll_focus", type, sc)
+		t.set_stylebox("grabber", type, g)
+		t.set_stylebox("grabber_highlight", type, gh)
+		t.set_stylebox("grabber_pressed", type, gh)
+
+	# Lists and trees.
+	var lst := box(Color(CYAN, 0.35), Color(BG.darkened(0.3), 0.9), 1, 0, 6)
+	var sel := lit(Color(CYAN, 0.85), 1, 4)
+	var sel_f := lit(CYAN, 1, 4)
+	for type in ["ItemList", "Tree"]:
+		t.set_stylebox("panel", type, lst)
+		t.set_stylebox("focus", type, StyleBoxEmpty.new())
+		t.set_stylebox("selected", type, sel)
+		t.set_stylebox("selected_focus", type, sel_f)
+		t.set_stylebox("cursor", type, StyleBoxEmpty.new())
+		t.set_stylebox("cursor_unfocused", type, StyleBoxEmpty.new())
+		t.set_color("font_color", type, TEXT)
+		t.set_color("font_selected_color", type, INK)
+		t.set_color("font_hovered_color", type, HEAD)
+	var hov := box(Color(CYAN, 0.4), hi_bg(0.6, 0.2), 1, 0, 4)
+	t.set_stylebox("hovered", "ItemList", hov)
+	t.set_stylebox("hovered", "Tree", hov)
+	t.set_color("guide_color", "Tree", Color(CYAN, 0.12))
+	t.set_color("relationship_line_color", "Tree", Color(CYAN, 0.25))
+	t.set_stylebox("title_button_normal", "Tree", box(Color(CYAN, 0.4), BG_LIGHT, 1, 0, 4))
+
+	# Progress bars and tabs (TabContainer / TabBar, where used).
+	var pbg := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	pbg.bg_color = Color(BG_LIGHT, 0.9)
+	pbg.border_color = Color(CYAN, 0.35)
+	pbg.set_border_width_all(1)
+	pbg.corner_radius_top_left = 5
+	pbg.corner_radius_bottom_right = 5
+	pbg.corner_detail = 1
+	var pfill := pbg.duplicate()
+	pfill.bg_color = CYAN
+	pfill.border_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35)
+	pfill.shadow_color = Color(CYAN, 0.35)
+	pfill.shadow_size = 4
+	t.set_stylebox("background", "ProgressBar", pbg)
+	t.set_stylebox("fill", "ProgressBar", pfill)
+	t.set_stylebox("tab_selected", "TabContainer", lit(CYAN, 1, 6))
+	t.set_stylebox("tab_unselected", "TabContainer", box(Color(CYAN, 0.4), BG, 1, 0, 6))
+	t.set_stylebox("tab_hovered", "TabContainer", box(CYAN, hi_bg(0.9, 0.25), 1, 4, 6))
+	t.set_color("font_selected_color", "TabContainer", INK)
+	t.set_color("font_hovered_color", "TabContainer", HEAD)
+	t.set_color("font_unselected_color", "TabContainer", TEXT_DIM)
+	t.set_stylebox("panel", "TabContainer", panel)
+
+	# Labels: default text colour and a faint dark outline for legibility.
+	t.set_color("font_color", "Label", TEXT)
+	t.set_color("font_outline_color", "Label", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55))
+	t.set_color("default_color", "RichTextLabel", TEXT)
+	t.set_color("font_outline_color", "RichTextLabel", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5))
+	return t

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: Before and after: what fitting (or taking out) a weapon, system or module does to your ship, or a piece of gear to your automaton - the outfitter's comparison. Each row is [label, before, after, format, higher_is_better] (before / after: numbers, or null for "none"); only rows that change. The "after" is worked out the game's own way: the item is fitted to the player's data for a moment (data.modules / equipment / loadout), the stats read with the same formulas the ship and the automaton use, then put back. (Moved from scripts/outfit_compare.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,164 @@ 
+class_name OutfitCompare
+## Before and after: what fitting (or taking out) a weapon, system or module
+## does to your ship, or a piece of gear to your automaton - the outfitter's
+## comparison. Each row is [label, before, after, format, higher_is_better]
+## (before / after: numbers, or null for "none"); only rows that change.
+##
+## The "after" is worked out the game's own way: the item is fitted to the
+## player's data for a moment (data.modules / equipment / loadout), the stats
+## read with the same formulas the ship and the automaton use, then put back.
+
+## The ship's numbers: {key: [label, value, format, higher_is_better]}.
+static func ship_stats(data: Node, base: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var cls := Shipyard.stats(data.ship_class)
+	var m := func(k: String) -> float: return data.mod(k)
+	var out := {
+		"hull": ["Hull", float(cls["hull"]) + m.call("max_hull"), "%.0f", true],
+		"shields": ["Shields", float(cls["shields"]) + m.call("max_shields"), "%.0f", true],
+		"recharge": ["Shield recharge /s", float(base.get("regen", 10.0)) * (1.0 + m.call("shield_regen_mult")), "%.1f", true],
+		"repair": ["Hull repair /s", m.call("hull_regen"), "%.1f", true],
+		"speed": ["Top speed", float(cls["speed"]) * (1.0 + m.call("speed_mult")), "%.0f", true],
+		"handling": ["Handling", 100.0 * (1.0 + m.call("handling_mult")), "%.0f%%", true],
+		"damage": ["Weapon damage", 100.0 * (1.0 + m.call("damage_mult")), "%.0f%%", true],
+		"rate": ["Fire rate", 100.0 / maxf(0.2, 1.0 + m.call("fire_rate_mult")), "%.0f%%", true],
+		"range": ["Weapon range", 100.0 * (1.0 + m.call("range_mult")), "%.0f%%", true],
+		"accuracy": ["Accuracy", 100.0 * clampf(Accuracy.BASE_SHIP + m.call("accuracy"), 0.2, 0.99), "%.0f%%", true],
+		"evasion": ["Evasion", 100.0 * clampf(m.call("evasion"), 0.0, 0.6), "%.0f%%", true],
+		"crit": ["Critical chance", 100.0 * (Upgrades.CRIT_BASE + m.call("crit_chance")), "%.0f%%", true],
+		"hold": ["Hold (slots)", float(Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data)), "%.0f", true],
+		"fuel": ["Fuel tank", Shipyard.fuel_capacity(data), "%.0f", true],
+		"weapons": ["Weapons fitted", float(Shipyard.used_slots(data, "hardpoints")), "%.0f", true],
+		"firepower": ["Firepower (damage /s)", firepower(data), "%.0f", true],
+	}
+	for t in Gear.DAMAGE_TYPES:
+		out["res_" + t] = ["%s resistance" % t.capitalize(), 100.0 * clampf(m.call("resist_" + t), 0.0, Gear.RESIST_CAP), "%.0f%%", true]
+	return out
+
+
+## Every fitted ship weapon's damage a second together, with your modifiers
+## (they all fire at once: Hardpoints).
+static func firepower(data: Node) -> float:
+	var total := 0.0
+	for id in Hardpoints.fitted(data):
+		if id != "":
+			total += weapon_dps(data, id)
+	return total
+
+
+## The strongest fitted ship weapon's damage a second.
+static func best_dps(data: Node) -> float:
+	var best := 0.0
+	for id in Hardpoints.fitted(data):
+		if id != "":
+			best = maxf(best, weapon_dps(data, id))
+	return best
+
+
+## A weapon's damage a second (`id`: a weapon item, or a kind at size S).
+static func weapon_dps(data: Node, id: String) -> float:
+	var w: Dictionary = Hardpoints.stats(id) if Hardpoints.is_weapon(id) else Items.WEAPONS[id]
+	var dmg: float = float(w.get("damage", 0.0)) * (1.0 + data.mod("damage_mult"))
+	var interval: float = float(w.get("interval", 1.0)) * maxf(0.2, 1.0 + data.mod("fire_rate_mult"))
+	return dmg / maxf(0.01, interval)
+
+
+## The automaton's numbers from a loadout (as LoadoutPanel.summary works them out).
+static func foot_stats(lo: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var w := Gear.weapon_stats(str(lo.get("weapon", Gear.DEFAULT_LOADOUT["weapon"])))
+	var fx := Gear.loadout_effects(lo)
+	var dmg: float = w["damage"] * (1.0 + float(fx.get("damage_mult", 0.0)))
+	var rate: float = 1.0 / (w["interval"] * maxf(0.25, 1.0 + float(fx.get("fire_rate_mult", 0.0))))
+	var out := {
+		"health": ["Health", 100.0 + float(fx.get("max_hp", 0.0)), "%.0f", true],
+		"damage": ["Damage a shot", dmg, "%.0f", true],
+		"rate": ["Shots /s", rate, "%.1f", true],
+		"dps": ["Damage /s", dmg * rate, "%.0f", true],
+		"reach": ["Reach", w["range"] * (1.0 + float(fx.get("range_mult", 0.0))), "%.0f", true],
+		"accuracy": ["Accuracy", 100.0 * clampf(Accuracy.BASE_FOOT + float(fx.get("accuracy", 0.0)), 0.2, 0.99), "%.0f%%", true],
+		"healing": ["Healing", 100.0 * (1.0 + float(fx.get("regen_mult", 0.0))), "%.0f%%", true],
+		"speed": ["Speed", 100.0 * (1.0 + float(fx.get("speed_mult", 0.0))), "%.0f%%", true],
+	}
+	for t in Gear.DAMAGE_TYPES:
+		out["res_" + t] = ["%s resistance" % t.capitalize(), 100.0 * clampf(float(fx.get("resist_" + t, 0.0)), 0.0, Gear.RESIST_CAP), "%.0f%%", true]
+	return out
+
+
+## Rows that differ between two stat tables (same keys).
+static func diff(before: Dictionary, after: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var rows := []
+	for k in before:
+		var a: float = before[k][1]
+		var b: float = after[k][1]
+		if absf(a - b) > 0.0005 * maxf(1.0, absf(a)):
+			rows.append([before[k][0], a, b, before[k][2], before[k][3]])
+	return rows
+
+
+## Fitting `id` to the ship: a module (Shipyard.MODULES id, at `rating`), ship
+## gear ("gear:<module>:<q>") or a weapon / system (equipment). `remove`: a
+## fitted module's index - the rows are then for taking it out.
+## A weapon item (Hardpoints) goes in the best free hardpoint it fits;
+## `remove_weapon`: a hardpoint whose weapon is taken out.
+static func ship_rows(data: Node, base: Dictionary, id: String, rating := 0, remove := -1, remove_weapon := -1) -> Array:
+	var before := ship_stats(data, base)
+	var mods: Array = data.modules
+	var saved_mods: Array = mods.duplicate(true)
+	var saved_eq: Dictionary = data.equipment.duplicate()
+	var ws := Hardpoints.fitted(data)
+	var saved_ws: Array = ws.duplicate()
+	if remove_weapon >= 0 and remove_weapon < ws.size():
+		ws[remove_weapon] = ""
+	elif Hardpoints.is_weapon(id):
+		var slot := Hardpoints.free_slot_for(data, id)
+		if slot >= 0:
+			ws[slot] = id
+	elif remove >= 0 and remove < mods.size():
+		mods.remove_at(remove)
+	elif Gear.is_gear(id):
+		var p := Gear.parse(id)
+		if not p.is_empty() and Shipyard.MODULES.has(p[0]):
+			mods.append({"id": p[0], "rating": Gear.quality(id)})
+	elif Shipyard.MODULES.has(id):
+		mods.append({"id": id, "rating": rating})
+	elif Items.EQUIPMENT.has(id):
+		data.equipment[id] = true
+	var after := ship_stats(data, base)
+	data.modules.assign(saved_mods)
+	data.equipment = saved_eq
+	data.weapons.assign(saved_ws)
+	return diff(before, after)
+
+
+## Equipping automaton gear `id` (in the slot it would go in - see
+## Gear.slot_for: what's there now is what it replaces).
+static func foot_rows(lo: Dictionary, id: String) -> Array:
+	var slot := Gear.slot_for(lo, id)
+	if slot == "":
+		return []
+	var after_lo := lo.duplicate()
+	after_lo[slot] = id
+	return diff(foot_stats(lo), foot_stats(after_lo))
+
+
+## What a ship weapon is on its own: [label, value, format] rows.
+static func weapon_facts(data: Node, id: String) -> Array:
+	if not Items.WEAPONS.has(id) and not Hardpoints.is_weapon(id):
+		return []
+	var w: Dictionary = Hardpoints.stats(id) if Hardpoints.is_weapon(id) else Items.WEAPONS[id]
+	var dmg: float = float(w.get("damage", 0.0)) * (1.0 + data.mod("damage_mult"))
+	var interval: float = float(w.get("interval", 1.0)) * maxf(0.2, 1.0 + data.mod("fire_rate_mult"))
+	return [["Damage a shot", dmg, "%.0f"], ["Shots /s", 1.0 / maxf(0.01, interval), "%.1f"],
+		["Range", float(w.get("range", 0.0)) * (1.0 + data.mod("range_mult")), "%.0f"], ["Damage /s", dmg / maxf(0.01, interval), "%.0f"]]
+
+
+## What a ship system does: [label, value, format] rows.
+static func system_facts(id: String) -> Array:
+	if not Items.SYSTEMS.has(id):
+		return []
+	var s: Dictionary = Items.SYSTEMS[id]
+	var rows := []
+	if s.has("cooldown"):
+		rows.append(["Cooldown", float(s["cooldown"]), "%.0f s"])
+	if s.has("duration"):
+		rows.append(["Lasts", float(s["duration"]), "%.1f s"])
+	return rows

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: Ship Computer tab: the galaxy map. Star systems coloured by owner, gate lanes, empire territories, wars, system states and pirate activity. Click a system for details and to plot a route (your course is set to the first gate; after each jump the next gate is targeted); Shift + click adds a system to the end of the route (a waypoint). Right column: diplomacy (who is at war), your reputation and the galactic news feed. TRADE ROUTES (the button under the system info, or T): the map shows the best trade runs between systems (TradeRoutes.galaxy_routes - buy at one station, sell at a station up to two jumps away) as green arrows with their good and profit a unit, for every good or one; the right column lists them (click one to plot a route to where you buy). (Moved from scripts/pages/galaxy_page.gd.)

@@ -1,0 +1,503 @@ 
+extends HBoxContainer
+## Ship Computer tab: the galaxy map. Star systems coloured by owner, gate
+## lanes, empire territories, wars, system states and pirate activity.
+## Click a system for details and to plot a route (your course is set to the
+## first gate; after each jump the next gate is targeted); Shift + click adds
+## a system to the end of the route (a waypoint). Right column:
+## diplomacy (who is at war), your reputation and the galactic news feed.
+## TRADE ROUTES (the button under the system info, or T): the map shows the
+## best trade runs between systems (TradeRoutes.galaxy_routes - buy at one
+## station, sell at a station up to two jumps away) as green arrows with their
+## good and profit a unit, for every good or one; the right column lists them
+## (click one to plot a route to where you buy).
+
+var data: Node
+var ship: Node2D
+
+var _view: GalaxyView
+var _info: RichTextLabel
+var _diplo: RichTextLabel
+var _news: RichTextLabel
+var _plot: Button
+var selected := ""
+var trade := false              # the trade layer on
+var trade_item := ""            # "" = every good
+var routes: Array = []          # the runs shown (TradeRoutes.galaxy_routes)
+var _trade_btn: Button
+var _goods: OptionButton
+var _trade_box: Control
+var _trade_text: RichTextLabel
+var _plain_box: Array = []      # diplomacy & news (hidden while trading)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
+	_view = GalaxyView.new()
+	_view.page = self
+	_view.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(780, 590)
+	_view.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	add_child(_view)
+	var col := VBoxContainer.new()
+	col.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(420, 0)
+	col.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	add_child(col)
+	col.add_child(UI.section("SYSTEM"))
+	_info = _rich(150)
+	col.add_child(_info)
+	_plot = EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", _plot_route, 15), "next", "", "Plot route")
+	_plot.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	col.add_child(_plot)
+	var tr := HBoxContainer.new()
+	tr.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	_trade_btn = EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("TRADE ROUTES", toggle_trade, 15), "buy",
+		EditorIcons.tip("Trade routes", "T", "Shows the best trade runs between systems: where to buy a good and where, up to two jumps on, to sell it - green arrows with the profit a unit.\nPrices change as traders (and you) move goods: the routes follow."))
+	_trade_btn.toggle_mode = true
+	_trade_btn.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	_trade_btn.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	tr.add_child(_trade_btn)
+	_goods = OptionButton.new()
+	_goods.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	_goods.add_item("All goods")
+	for c in Galaxy.COMMODITIES:
+		_goods.add_item(Items.display_name(c))
+	_goods.tooltip_text = "Show the runs for one good, or the best of every good."
+	_goods.item_selected.connect(func(i): trade_item = "" if i == 0 else Galaxy.COMMODITIES[i - 1]; refresh())
+	tr.add_child(_goods)
+	col.add_child(tr)
+	_trade_box = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_trade_box.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_trade_box.visible = false
+	_trade_box.add_child(UI.section("BEST TRADE RUNS  ·  PROFIT A UNIT"))
+	_trade_text = _rich(300)
+	_trade_text.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_trade_text.meta_clicked.connect(_on_route_clicked)
+	_trade_box.add_child(_trade_text)
+	col.add_child(_trade_box)
+	var dh := UI.section("DIPLOMACY  ·  YOUR STANDING")
+	col.add_child(dh)
+	_diplo = _rich(130)
+	col.add_child(_diplo)
+	var nh := UI.section("GALACTIC NEWS")
+	col.add_child(nh)
+	_news = _rich(170)
+	_news.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	col.add_child(_news)
+	_plain_box = [dh, _diplo, nh, _news]
+
+
+func _rich(h: float) -> RichTextLabel:
+	var r := RichTextLabel.new()
+	r.bbcode_enabled = true
+	r.fit_content = false
+	r.scroll_active = true
+	r.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, h)
+	r.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 14)
+	r.add_theme_font_size_override("bold_font_size", 14)
+	return r
+
+
+func refresh() -> void:
+	if selected == "":
+		selected = Galaxy.current_system
+	_update_trade()
+	_update_info()
+	_update_diplo()
+	var lines := []
+	for n in Galaxy.news.slice(0, 25):
+		var col: String = {"danger": "#ff7a6a", "good": "#7dffa0"}.get(n["kind"], "#c7d6ea")
+		lines.append("[color=#6f8199]%s[/color]  [color=%s]%s[/color]" % [_clock(n["t"]), col, n["text"]])
+	_news.text = "\n".join(lines) if not lines.is_empty() else "[color=#6f8199]No news yet.[/color]"
+	_view.queue_redraw()
+	_view._top_sig = ""   # (and its top: redrawn next frame)
+
+
+func toggle_trade() -> void:
+	trade = not trade
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _update_trade() -> void:
+	_trade_btn.set_pressed_no_signal(trade)
+	_trade_box.visible = trade
+	for n in _plain_box:
+		n.visible = not trade
+	routes = TradeRoutes.galaxy_routes_spread(trade_item, 2, 10) if trade else []
+	if not trade:
+		return
+	var lines := []
+	for i in routes.size():
+		var r: Dictionary = routes[i]
+		lines.append("[url=%d][color=#7dffa0][b]+%d dr[/b][/color]  [color=#ffcf6a]%s[/color][/url]\n   %s (%s) › %s (%s)  ·  %d → %d dr  ·  %d jump%s" % [i, r["profit"],
+			Items.display_name(r["item"]), TradeRoutes.station_name(r["from"]), TradeRoutes.system_name(r["from_sys"]),
+			TradeRoutes.station_name(r["to"]), TradeRoutes.system_name(r["to_sys"]), r["buy"], r["sell"], r["jumps"], "" if r["jumps"] == 1 else "s"])
+	_trade_text.text = "\n".join(lines) if not lines.is_empty() else "[color=#6f8199]No profitable runs you know of%s. Runs start at stations whose market you know - dock at them (or become Friendly with an empire: it shares all of its own) - and end at stations you've found.[/color]" % ("" if trade_item == "" else " for " + Items.display_name(trade_item))
+	_trade_text.text += "\n\n[color=#6f8199]Click a run to plot a route to where you buy. Within one system, see the sector map's trade layer (M).[/color]"
+
+
+## A run clicked in the list: plot a route to its start (or, there already, to its end).
+func _on_route_clicked(meta) -> void:
+	var i := int(str(meta))
+	if i < 0 or i >= routes.size():
+		return
+	var r: Dictionary = routes[i]
+	var to: String = r["from_sys"] if r["from_sys"] != Galaxy.current_system else r["to_sys"]
+	selected = to
+	Galaxy.route = Galaxy.find_route(Galaxy.current_system, to)
+	if Galaxy.route.size() >= 2:
+		if ship and ship.is_alive():
+			ship.move_to(Galaxy.system(Galaxy.current_system)["gates"][Galaxy.route[1]])
+		GameLog.post("Trade run: buy %s at %s, sell at %s (+%d dr a unit). Route plotted to %s." % [Items.display_name(r["item"]),
+			TradeRoutes.station_name(r["from"]), TradeRoutes.station_name(r["to"]), r["profit"], TradeRoutes.system_name(to)], "mission")
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _clock(t: float) -> String:
+	return "%02d:%02d" % [int(t / 60.0), int(t) % 60]
+
+
+func select(id: String) -> void:
+	selected = id
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _update_info() -> void:
+	var sys: Dictionary = Galaxy.system(selected)
+	if sys.is_empty():
+		return
+	var owner: String = sys["owner"]
+	var col: String = Galaxy.empire_color(owner).to_html(false)
+	var path := Galaxy.find_route(Galaxy.current_system, selected)
+	var t := "[b][font_size=20]%s[/font_size][/b]   [color=#%s]%s[/color]\n" % [sys["name"].to_upper(), col, Galaxy.empire_name(owner)]
+	var n_moons: int = 1 if selected == Galaxy.HOME else sys["planets"].filter(func(pl): return pl["moon_of"] != "").size()
+	var n_planets: int = (Planets.PLANETS.size() - 1) if selected == Galaxy.HOME else sys["planets"].size() - n_moons
+	t += "The star %s (%s)  ·  %d planet%s%s  ·  %d stations\n" % [sys["name"], Galaxy.STARS[sys["star"]]["name"].to_lower(), n_planets,
+		"" if n_planets == 1 else "s", ("  ·  %d moon%s" % [n_moons, "" if n_moons == 1 else "s"]) if n_moons > 0 else "", sys["stations"].size()]
+	var st: String = Galaxy.state_of(selected)
+	if st != "none":
+		t += "State: [color=#ffcf6a]%s[/color] - %s\n" % [Galaxy.STATES[st]["name"], Galaxy.STATES[st]["desc"]]
+	var danger: float = sys["pirates"]
+	t += "Pirate activity: %s\n" % ["low", "moderate", "high", "extreme"][clampi(int(danger * 3.99), 0, 3)]
+	var econs := []
+	for sid in sys["stations"]:
+		var e := Galaxy.station_owner(sid)
+		var pres := Galaxy.presence_label(Galaxy.station_presence(sid))
+		econs.append("%s (%s%s)" % [Galaxy.stations[sid]["name"], Galaxy.ECONOMIES[Galaxy.stations[sid]["economy"]]["name"].to_lower(),
+			(", [color=#%s]%s[/color]" % [Galaxy.empire_color(e).to_html(false), pres if e == "independent" else "%s %s" % [Galaxy.EMPIRES[e]["short"], pres]]) if pres != "" else ""])
+	t += "Stations: " + ", ".join(econs) + "\n"
+	if selected == Galaxy.current_system:
+		t += "[color=#7dd8ff]You are here.[/color]"
+	elif path.is_empty():
+		t += "[color=#ff7a6a]No route.[/color]"
+	else:
+		t += "Route: %s  (%d jumps)" % [" › ".join(path.map(func(p): return Galaxy.SYSTEMS[p]["name"])), path.size() - 1]
+	_info.text = t
+	_plot.disabled = selected == Galaxy.current_system or path.is_empty()
+	var clearing: bool = not Galaxy.route.is_empty() and Galaxy.route[-1] == selected
+	_plot.icon = EditorIcons.get_icon("abandon" if clearing else "next")
+	_plot.text = "Clear" if clearing else "Plot route"
+	_plot.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Clear route" if clearing else "Plot route to %s" % sys["name"], "",
+		"Removes the route to %s: the HUD stops pointing the way." % sys["name"] if clearing else
+		"Plans the shortest way through the jump gates to %s. The HUD then points you to each gate in turn.\nUnavailable for the system you're in, or when no gates lead there." % sys["name"])
+
+
+func _update_diplo() -> void:
+	var t := ""
+	var m: Array = Galaxy.MAJOR
+	for i in m.size():
+		for j in range(i + 1, m.size()):
+			var a: String = m[i]
+			var b: String = m[j]
+			var war: bool = Galaxy.at_war(a, b)
+			var rel := Galaxy.relation(a, b)
+			var mood := "[color=#ff6a5a]AT WAR[/color]" if war else ("[color=#7dffa0]allied[/color]" if rel > 40 else ("peace" if rel > -10 else "[color=#ffcf6a]tense[/color]"))
+			t += "%s – %s: %s\n" % [Galaxy.EMPIRES[a]["short"], Galaxy.EMPIRES[b]["short"], mood]
+	t += "Everyone – Sea Peoples: [color=#ff6a5a]AT WAR[/color]\n"
+	t += "Independents: neutral with everyone, at war with no one\n"
+	for e in m + ["independent"]:
+		var rep: float = Galaxy.reputation.get(e, 0.0)
+		t += "You – [color=#%s]%s[/color]: %+d (%s)\n" % [Galaxy.empire_color(e).to_html(false), Galaxy.EMPIRES[e]["short"], int(rep), Galaxy.standing(e)]
+	_diplo.text = t
+
+
+## Shift + click: the route goes on from where it ends now (or from here)
+## to this system - a waypoint; plain Plot route replaces it.
+func add_to_route(id: String) -> void:
+	var start: String = Galaxy.route[-1] if not Galaxy.route.is_empty() else Galaxy.current_system
+	selected = id
+	if start == id:
+		refresh()
+		return
+	var leg := Galaxy.find_route(start, id)
+	if leg.is_empty():
+		GameLog.post("No route from %s to %s." % [Galaxy.SYSTEMS[start]["name"], Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["name"]], "danger")
+		refresh()
+		return
+	var was_empty := Galaxy.route.is_empty()
+	if was_empty:
+		Galaxy.route = leg
+	else:
+		Galaxy.route = Galaxy.route + leg.slice(1)
+	if was_empty and Galaxy.route.size() >= 2 and ship and ship.is_alive():
+		ship.move_to(Galaxy.system(Galaxy.current_system)["gates"][Galaxy.route[1]])
+	GameLog.post("Waypoint: %s added to the route (%d jumps in all)." % [Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["name"], Galaxy.route.size() - 1], "mission")
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _plot_route() -> void:
+	if not Galaxy.route.is_empty() and Galaxy.route[-1] == selected:
+		Galaxy.route = []
+		GameLog.post("Route cleared", "info")
+	else:
+		Galaxy.route = Galaxy.find_route(Galaxy.current_system, selected)
+		if Galaxy.route.size() >= 2:
+			var gate: Vector2 = Galaxy.system(Galaxy.current_system)["gates"][Galaxy.route[1]]
+			if ship and ship.is_alive():
+				ship.move_to(gate)
+			GameLog.post("Route plotted to %s: %d jumps. Course set to the %s gate." % [Galaxy.SYSTEMS[selected]["name"], Galaxy.route.size() - 1, Galaxy.SYSTEMS[Galaxy.route[1]]["name"]], "mission")
+	refresh()
+
+
+class GalaxyView extends Control:
+	var page: Node
+	var _hover := ""
+	var _t := 0.0
+	var _back: Control            # the still part (console grid, stars, territories), behind
+	var _back_sig := ""           # what it was drawn for
+	var _top: Control             # the systems' badges and names, the route, the legend, on top
+	var _top_sig := ""
+	var _xf_cache := Transform2D()
+	var _xf_size := Vector2(-1, -1)
+	## The still layers are drawn into two off-screen pictures (SubViewports,
+	## rendered once each time what they show changes) and the view draws those
+	## two textures: a galaxy of 58 systems is ~1,100 vector draw calls (badges,
+	## names, lanes) - every frame, they cost more than the rest of the game.
+	var _svp_back: SubViewport
+	var _svp_top: SubViewport
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		clip_contents = true
+		_svp_back = _layer(false)
+		_back = _svp_back.get_child(0)
+		_back.draw.connect(_draw_back)
+		_svp_top = _layer(true)
+		_top = _svp_top.get_child(0)
+		_top.draw.connect(_draw_top)
+
+	func _layer(transparent: bool) -> SubViewport:
+		var v := SubViewport.new()
+		v.transparent_bg = transparent
+		v.disable_3d = true
+		v.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
+		v.size = Vector2i(8, 8)
+		var c := Control.new()
+		c.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		v.add_child(c)
+		add_child(v)
+		return v
+
+	## Redraws a still layer's picture (at the view's size).
+	func _refresh_layer(v: SubViewport) -> void:
+		var sz := Vector2i(maxi(8, int(size.x)), maxi(8, int(size.y)))
+		if v.size != sz:
+			v.size = sz
+		var c: Control = v.get_child(0)
+		c.size = Vector2(sz)
+		c.queue_redraw()
+		v.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+
+	## (Redrawn every frame for the pulses; the still back only when its size or
+	## the territories change - all of it every frame was half the frame.)
+	var _owners_t := 0.0
+	var _owners_sig := ""
+
+	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+		if not is_visible_in_tree():
+			return   # (another tab: nothing to draw)
+		_t += delta
+		if UI.redraw_due(self):   # (60 pictures a second - every frame at 600 FPS was ten times that)
+			queue_redraw()
+		if page.trade and is_visible_in_tree():
+			# (every frame: the search goes on ~1 ms a frame, and the routes
+			# shown are the last it finished - prices move every 2 s)
+			var now: Array = TradeRoutes.galaxy_routes_spread(page.trade_item, 2, 10)
+			if not is_same(now, page.routes):
+				page._update_trade()   # (a search finished: the list beside the map too)
+		# (who owns what: looked at twice a second, not every frame - a string
+		# of 58 owners made each frame)
+		_owners_t -= delta
+		if _owners_t <= 0.0 or _owners_sig == "":
+			_owners_t = 0.5
+			_owners_sig = str(Galaxy.SYSTEMS.keys().map(func(id): return Galaxy.owner_of(id)))
+		var sig := str(size) + _owners_sig
+		if sig != _back_sig:
+			_back_sig = sig
+			_refresh_layer(_svp_back)
+		var top := sig + str([_hover, page.selected, Galaxy.route, Settings.fs("menu", 15), page.trade])
+		if top != _top_sig:
+			_top_sig = top
+			_refresh_layer(_svp_top)
+
+	## Fits every system (plus a margin for names) into the page.
+	func _xf() -> Transform2D:
+		if size == _xf_size:
+			return _xf_cache
+		_xf_size = size
+		_xf_cache = _fit()
+		return _xf_cache
+
+	func _fit() -> Transform2D:
+		var box := Rect2(Galaxy.SYSTEMS.values()[0]["pos"], Vector2.ZERO)
+		for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+			box = box.expand(Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["pos"])
+		box = box.grow(80.0)
+		var k := minf(size.x / box.size.x, size.y / box.size.y)
+		return Transform2D(0.0, Vector2(k, k), 0.0, (size - box.size * k) / 2.0 - box.position * k)
+
+	func _pos(id: String) -> Vector2:
+		return _xf() * Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["pos"]
+
+	func _gui_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+		if ev is InputEventMouseMotion:
+			_hover = _pick(ev.position)
+		elif ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+			var id := _pick(ev.position)
+			if id != "" and ev.shift_pressed:
+				page.add_to_route(id)
+			elif id != "":
+				page.select(id)
+			accept_event()
+
+	func _pick(at: Vector2) -> String:
+		for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+			if _pos(id).distance_to(at) < 22.0:
+				return id
+		return ""
+
+	## The still back: the console grid, faint stars, the territories.
+	func _draw_back() -> void:
+		var ci := _back
+		ci.draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), NeonTheme.BG)
+		var gc := Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.06)   # the console grid
+		for gx in range(0, int(size.x), 48):
+			ci.draw_line(Vector2(gx, 0), Vector2(gx, size.y), gc, 1.0)
+		for gy in range(0, int(size.y), 48):
+			ci.draw_line(Vector2(0, gy), Vector2(size.x, gy), gc, 1.0)
+		# Faint background stars and the territories (soft discs in the owner's
+		# colour): one texture (ExhaustTrail.disc), so they batch into a draw
+		# call or two instead of one each (a galaxy of 58 systems: hundreds).
+		var disc := ExhaustTrail.disc()
+		var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		rng.seed = 99
+		for i in 220:
+			var r := rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.4)
+			var at := Vector2(rng.randf() * size.x, rng.randf() * size.y)
+			ci.draw_texture_rect(disc, Rect2(at - Vector2(r, r), Vector2(r, r) * 2.0), false, Color(1, 1, 1, rng.randf_range(0.1, 0.45)))
+		var k_ := _xf().get_scale().x
+		for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+			var c := Galaxy.empire_color(Galaxy.owner_of(id))
+			for k in 4:
+				var r := (70.0 - k * 14.0) * clampf(k_ * 1.6, 0.5, 1.0)
+				ci.draw_texture_rect(disc, Rect2(_pos(id) - Vector2(r, r), Vector2(r, r) * 2.0), false, Color(c, 0.035))
+		# Gate lanes at peace, dotted - every dash of every lane in one draw
+		# call (the war fronts pulse: drawn every frame).
+		var dashes := PackedVector2Array()
+		for l in Galaxy.LINKS:
+			if _war(l):
+				continue
+			var a := _pos(l[0])
+			var b := _pos(l[1])
+			var n := maxi(2, int(a.distance_to(b) / 9.0))
+			for i in range(0, n, 2):
+				dashes.append(a.lerp(b, float(i) / n))
+				dashes.append(a.lerp(b, float(i + 1) / n))
+		if not dashes.is_empty():
+			ci.draw_multiline(dashes, Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.47), 1.5)
+
+	## Every frame: the war fronts' pulse, the system states' turning arcs, your
+	## system's pulse (between the still back and the top).
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		draw_texture(_svp_back.get_texture(), Vector2.ZERO)   # (the still back: its picture)
+		for l in Galaxy.LINKS:
+			if _war(l):
+				MapIcons.route(self, _pos(l[0]), _pos(l[1]), Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.25, 0.55 + 0.25 * sin(_t * 3.0)), 0.0, true, 3.0)
+		for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+			var p := _pos(id)
+			if Galaxy.state_of(id) != "none":
+				draw_arc(p, 21.0, _t, _t + 4.5, 24, Color(MapIcons.ORANGE, 0.85), 2.0, true)
+			if id == Galaxy.current_system:
+				var pulse := 25.0 + 3.0 * sin(_t * 4.0)
+				draw_arc(p, pulse, 0, TAU, 40, MapIcons.ORANGE, 2.5, true)
+				draw_arc(p, pulse + 5.0, 0, TAU, 40, Color(MapIcons.ORANGE, 0.3), 4.0, true)
+		if page.trade:
+			_draw_trade()
+		draw_texture(_svp_top.get_texture(), Vector2.ZERO)   # (the badges, names, route, legend: their picture, on top)
+
+	## The trade runs: along the gate lanes from where you buy to where you
+	## sell, side by side where they share a lane, the best brightest.
+	func _draw_trade() -> void:
+		var rs: Array = page.routes
+		if rs.is_empty():
+			return
+		var top: float = rs[0]["profit"]
+		var lanes := {}   # lane key -> runs drawn on it so far (to set them side by side)
+		var fs := Settings.fs("menu", 13)
+		var taken := []
+		for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:   # (the systems' names: tags keep clear of them)
+			taken.append(Rect2(_pos(id) + Vector2(-60, 26), Vector2(120, 20)))
+		for r in rs:
+			var path := Galaxy.find_route(r["from_sys"], r["to_sys"])
+			if path.size() < 2:
+				continue
+			var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+			for i in path.size():
+				var p := _pos(path[i])
+				var off := Vector2.ZERO
+				if i < path.size() - 1:
+					var key: String = path[i] + "|" + path[i + 1] if path[i] < path[i + 1] else path[i + 1] + "|" + path[i]
+					var n: int = lanes.get(key, 0)
+					lanes[key] = n + 1
+					var dir := (_pos(path[i + 1]) - p).normalized()
+					off = dir.orthogonal() * (n * 9.0 - 4.0)
+				pts.append(p + off)
+			# Start and end clear of the system badges.
+			pts[0] += (pts[1] - pts[0]).normalized() * 22.0
+			pts[-1] -= (pts[-1] - pts[-2]).normalized() * 24.0
+			TradeRoutes.draw_run(self, pts, r["profit"] / maxf(1.0, top), _t)
+			TradeRoutes.draw_tag(self, pts[0].lerp(pts[1], 0.5), TradeRoutes.tag_text(r), fs, taken)
+
+	func _war(l: Array) -> bool:
+		return Galaxy.at_war(Galaxy.owner_of(l[0]), Galaxy.owner_of(l[1])) and Galaxy.owner_of(l[0]) != Galaxy.owner_of(l[1])
+
+	## The top (redrawn when what it shows changes): the planned route, the
+	## systems' badges and names, the legend.
+	func _draw_top() -> void:
+		var ci := _top
+		var font := NeonTheme.heavy_font()
+		var fs := Settings.fs("menu", 15)
+		var r: Array = Galaxy.route
+		for i in r.size() - 1:
+			MapIcons.route(ci, _pos(r[i]), _pos(r[i + 1]), MapIcons.ORANGE, 0.0, false, 3.0)
+		for id in Galaxy.SYSTEMS:
+			var p := _pos(id)
+			var star: Dictionary = Galaxy.STARS[Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["star"]]
+			var oc := Galaxy.empire_color(Galaxy.owner_of(id))
+			# A circled star in the console's style; the ring in the owner's colour.
+			MapIcons.badge(ci, p, 15.0, oc.lerp(MapIcons.CYAN, 0.25), "star")
+			ci.draw_circle(p, 3.5, star["color"])
+			if id == page.selected:
+				ci.draw_arc(p, 33.0, 0, TAU, 32, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8), 1.5, true)
+			var label: String = Galaxy.SYSTEMS[id]["name"].to_upper()
+			ci.draw_string_outline(font, p + Vector2(-80, 40), label, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 160, fs, 4, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.9))
+			ci.draw_string(font, p + Vector2(-80, 40), label, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 160, fs, oc.lightened(0.45) if id != _hover else Color.WHITE)
+		# The galaxy's name, top right.
+		var tfs := Settings.fs("menu", 22)
+		ci.draw_string(NeonTheme.heavy_font(), Vector2(0, tfs + 6), "NEW HELLAS", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, size.x - 14, tfs, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+		ci.draw_string(font, Vector2(0, tfs + 10 + fs), "%d star systems" % Galaxy.systems.size(), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, size.x - 14, fs, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+		# Legend (a row per empire, spaced by the text size).
+		var y := float(fs) + 4.0
+		for e in Galaxy.EMPIRES:
+			ci.draw_circle(Vector2(18, y - fs * 0.32), 5.0, Galaxy.empire_color(e))
+			ci.draw_string(font, Vector2(30, y), Galaxy.empire_name(e), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, NeonTheme.TEXT)
+			y += fs + 4.0
+		ci.draw_string(font, Vector2(14, size.y - 12), "orange ring: you  ·  orange arc: system state  ·  red lane: war front  ·  Shift + click: add to the route" + ("  ·  green: trade run (good, profit a unit)" if page.trade else ""), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, maxi(Settings.MIN_FONT, fs - 1), NeonTheme.HEAD)

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: Ship Computer tab: the ship's INDUSTRY (Industry) - the REFINERY (mined fragments into minerals), the FABRICATOR (recipes: materials, components, spare parts, supplies, weapons, Upgrade Kits) and KITS (fit an upgrade yourself). The work goes on while you fly; the queue shows here. (Moved from scripts/pages/industry_page.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,253 @@ 
+extends VBoxContainer
+## Ship Computer tab: the ship's INDUSTRY (Industry) - the REFINERY (mined
+## fragments into minerals), the FABRICATOR (recipes: materials, components,
+## spare parts, supplies, weapons, Upgrade Kits) and KITS (fit an upgrade
+## yourself). The work goes on while you fly; the queue shows here.
+
+var data: Node
+var ship: Node2D
+
+const PAGES := ["REFINERY", "FABRICATOR", "KITS"]
+var _page := 0
+var _cat := 0
+var _kit_body := "ship"
+var _body: VBoxContainer
+var _queue_box: VBoxContainer
+var _bars := []
+var _tab_btns := []
+var _t := 0.0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	var tabs := HBoxContainer.new()
+	tabs.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	var group := ButtonGroup.new()
+	for i in PAGES.size():
+		var b := UI.button(PAGES[i], func():
+			_page = i
+			refresh(), 15)
+		b.toggle_mode = true
+		b.button_group = group
+		b.button_pressed = i == 0
+		b.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 36)
+		tabs.add_child(b)
+		_tab_btns.append(b)
+	add_child(tabs)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
+	row.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	add_child(row)
+	_body = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_body.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_body.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	row.add_child(_body)
+	var right := VBoxContainer.new()
+	right.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(380, 0)
+	right.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	row.add_child(right)
+	right.add_child(UI.section("AT WORK"))
+	_queue_box = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_queue_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	right.add_child(_queue_box)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not is_visible_in_tree():
+		return
+	_t += delta
+	var q := Industry.queue_of(data)
+	if q.size() != _bars.size():
+		_fill_queue()
+	elif not q.is_empty() and _bars.size() > 0 and _bars[0] is ProgressBar:
+		var j: Dictionary = q[0]
+		_bars[0].value = (int(j["done"]) + float(j["t"]) / maxf(0.01, Industry.unit_time(data, j))) / maxf(1.0, int(j["n"]))
+	if _t > 1.0:
+		_t = 0.0
+		_fill_queue()
+
+
+func refresh() -> void:
+	if _body == null:
+		return
+	UI.clear(_body)
+	for i in _tab_btns.size():
+		_tab_btns[i].set_pressed_no_signal(i == _page)
+	match _page:
+		0:
+			_refinery()
+		1:
+			_fabricator()
+		2:
+			_kits()
+	_fill_queue()
+
+
+func _fill_queue() -> void:
+	UI.clear(_queue_box)
+	_bars = []
+	var q := Industry.queue_of(data)
+	if q.is_empty():
+		_queue_box.add_child(UI.label("Nothing - the refinery and the fabricator are idle.", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+		return
+	for i in q.size():
+		var j: Dictionary = q[i]
+		var name: String = ("Refining " + Items.display_name(j["id"]).to_lower()) if j["kind"] == "refine" else ("Making " + str(Industry.recipe(j["id"])[0]))
+		var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+		var l := UI.label("%s  %d / %d%s" % [name, int(j["done"]), int(j["n"]), "  (hold full)" if j.get("waiting", false) else ""], 14, Color.WHITE if i == 0 else UI.TEXT_DIM)
+		l.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+		h.add_child(l)
+		var x := UI.button("✕", func():
+			Industry.cancel(data, i)
+			refresh(), 13)
+		x.tooltip_text = "Stop it: what isn't made yet is given back."
+		h.add_child(x)
+		_queue_box.add_child(h)
+		if i == 0:
+			var bar := ProgressBar.new()
+			bar.max_value = 1.0
+			bar.show_percentage = false
+			bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 8)
+			_queue_box.add_child(bar)
+			_bars.append(bar)
+		else:
+			_bars.append(null)
+
+
+func _need_equipment(id: String) -> bool:
+	if data.has_equipment(id):
+		return false
+	_body.add_child(UI.note("No %s fitted - outfitters sell them (SYSTEMS). %s" % [Items.EQUIPMENT[id]["name"].to_lower(), Items.EQUIPMENT[id]["desc"]], 15, 800))
+	return true
+
+
+func _refinery() -> void:
+	_body.add_child(UI.section("REFINERY  ·  fragments into minerals"))
+	if _need_equipment("refinery"):
+		return
+	_body.add_child(UI.note("Each fragment becomes a unit of its mineral (rubble: scrap, now and then a mineral), %.1f s a unit (the reactor's refinery upgrade makes it faster)." % (Industry.REFINE_TIME / (1.0 + data.mod("refine_speed"))), 14, 800))
+	var frags: Array = data.held_items().filter(func(x): return Mining.is_frag(x))
+	if frags.is_empty():
+		_body.add_child(UI.label("No fragments in the hold - mine an asteroid's veins (prospect it with a right-click, then hold the button on it).", 15, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+		return
+	for id in frags:
+		var n: int = data.count(id)
+		var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+		h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+		var icon := ItemSlot.make(id, n, 40.0)
+		h.add_child(icon)
+		var m := Mining.mineral_of(id)
+		var l := UI.label("%s  ×%d   →  %s" % [Items.display_name(id), n, "scrap and odd minerals" if m == "rubble" else "%d %s (%d dr each)" % [n, Items.display_name(m), int(Items.info(m).get("value", 0))]], 15, Color.WHITE)
+		l.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		h.add_child(l)
+		for k in [10, n]:
+			if k > n or (k == 10 and n <= 10):
+				continue
+			var b := UI.button("Refine %s" % ("all" if k == n else str(k)), func():
+				Industry.order(data, "refine", id, k)
+				refresh(), 14)
+			h.add_child(b)
+		_body.add_child(h)
+
+
+func _fabricator() -> void:
+	_body.add_child(UI.section("FABRICATOR  ·  make things from minerals and goods"))
+	if _need_equipment("fabricator"):
+		return
+	var cats := HBoxContainer.new()
+	cats.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	var group := ButtonGroup.new()
+	for i in Industry.CATEGORIES.size():
+		var b := UI.button(Industry.CATEGORIES[i], func():
+			_cat = i
+			refresh(), 14)
+		b.toggle_mode = true
+		b.button_group = group
+		b.button_pressed = i == _cat
+		b.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		cats.add_child(b)
+	_body.add_child(cats)
+	var grid := GridContainer.new()
+	grid.columns = 2
+	grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 10)
+	grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 6)
+	_body.add_child(grid)
+	for id in Industry.RECIPES:
+		var r: Array = Industry.RECIPES[id]
+		if r[1] != Industry.CATEGORIES[_cat]:
+			continue
+		var card := PanelContainer.new()
+		UI.light_panel(card)
+		card.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+		h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+		card.add_child(h)
+		h.add_child(ItemSlot.make(r[2][0], int(r[2][1]), 44.0))
+		var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+		v.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		h.add_child(v)
+		var worth := int(Items.info(r[2][0]).get("value", 0)) * int(r[2][1])
+		v.add_child(UI.label("%s%s  ·  %.0f s%s" % [r[0], ("  ×%d" % int(r[2][1])) if int(r[2][1]) > 1 else "", float(r[4]), ("  ·  sells ~%d dr" % worth) if worth > 0 else ""], 15, Color.WHITE))
+		var ins := []
+		for k in r[3]:
+			var have: int = data.count(k)
+			ins.append("%s %d/%d" % [Items.display_name(k), have, int(r[3][k])])
+		var il := UI.label(",  ".join(ins), 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+		il.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+		v.add_child(il)
+		var can := Industry.can_make(data.items, id)
+		var bs := HBoxContainer.new()
+		for k in [1, 5]:
+			var b := UI.button("Make %d" % k, func():
+				Industry.order(data, "fab", id, k)
+				refresh(), 13)
+			b.disabled = can < k
+			bs.add_child(b)
+		v.add_child(bs)
+		grid.add_child(card)
+
+
+func _kits() -> void:
+	_body.add_child(UI.section("UPGRADE KITS  ·  fit a component upgrade yourself"))
+	var held := []
+	for k in Industry.KITS:
+		held.append("%s ×%d" % [Items.display_name(k), data.count(k)])
+	_body.add_child(UI.note("You carry: %s. A Mk I raises a stat from level 0 or 1, a Mk II from 2 or 3, a Mk III from 4 to the top. The fabricator makes them; stations upgrade for drachmas (Repair > Upgrades)." % ", ".join(held), 14, 900))
+	var top := HBoxContainer.new()
+	for w in ["ship", "automaton"]:
+		var b := UI.button(Parts.BODIES[w]["name"].to_upper(), func():
+			_kit_body = w
+			refresh(), 14)
+		b.toggle_mode = true
+		b.button_pressed = w == _kit_body
+		top.add_child(b)
+	_body.add_child(top)
+	var grid := GridContainer.new()
+	grid.columns = 3
+	grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 10)
+	grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 4)
+	_body.add_child(grid)
+	for st in Upgrades.list(_kit_body):
+		var lvl := Upgrades.level(data.upgrades, _kit_body, st["id"])
+		var kit := ""
+		for k in Industry.KITS:
+			if Industry.kit_fits(k, data.upgrades, _kit_body, st["id"]):
+				kit = k

@@ -1,0 +1,380 @@ 
+extends HBoxContainer
+## Ship Computer tab: ship status, weapons, systems, the toolbar (9 slots you
+## fill: hover a weapon, a system or repair kits and press 1-9; right-click a
+## toolbar slot to empty it), the cargo hold (its class's slots, up to 100 of
+## an item each - Inventory) and what you carry on foot (click a stack to put
+## it in the hold). Click a repair kit to use it, fuel to pump a unit into the tank.
+
+var data: Node
+var ship: Node2D
+
+var _stats: Label
+var _weapons: VBoxContainer
+var _systems: VBoxContainer
+var _grid: GridContainer
+var _doll_holder: VBoxContainer
+var _loadout: LoadoutPanel
+var _details: Label
+var _bar: HBoxContainer
+var _hold_label: Label
+var _carried: GridContainer
+var _hovered := ""
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 30)
+	# Three columns, nothing to scroll: the ship (its equipment screen and
+	# stats) | the hold, what you carry, the weapons and systems and the
+	# toolbar | the automaton (its equipment screen) and the hovered item's details.
+	var left := VBoxContainer.new()
+	left.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(470, 0)
+	left.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	add_child(left)
+
+	# The ship's equipment screen (EquipDoll): its areas' slots round it.
+	left.add_child(UI.section("SHIP  ·  EQUIPMENT"))
+	_doll_holder = VBoxContainer.new()
+	left.add_child(_doll_holder)
+	_stats = UI.note("", 14, 470)
+	left.add_child(_stats)
+	left.add_child(UI.note("Weapons on the hardpoints (a weapon fits one its size or bigger), sensors in the nose, armour in the hull, drives at the thrusters, racks and tanks in the bay: drag ship gear from the hold onto a free slot of its area (or click it); right-click a module to take it out.", 12, 470))
+	var mid := VBoxContainer.new()
+	mid.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	add_child(mid)
+	mid.add_child(UI.section("CARGO HOLD"))
+	_hold_label = UI.note("", 13, 400)
+	mid.add_child(_hold_label)
+	_grid = GridContainer.new()
+	_grid.columns = 12   # (up to 120 slots, a freighter's: 10 rows)
+	_grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 4)
+	_grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 4)
+	mid.add_child(_grid)
+	mid.add_child(UI.section("YOU CARRY ON FOOT"))
+	_carried = GridContainer.new()
+	_carried.columns = 12
+	_carried.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 4)
+	mid.add_child(_carried)
+	# The weapons and the toolbar under the hold (the ship's column is full).
+	mid.add_child(UI.section("WEAPONS & SYSTEMS"))
+	_weapons = VBoxContainer.new()
+	mid.add_child(_weapons)
+	_systems = VBoxContainer.new()   # (kept for older code paths: the row above holds them all)
+	mid.add_child(UI.section("TOOLBAR  ·  9 SLOTS"))
+	_bar = HBoxContainer.new()
+	_bar.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	mid.add_child(_bar)
+	mid.add_child(UI.note("Drag a weapon, a system or repair kits onto a slot (or hover it and press 1-9); drag slots to swap them; right-click a slot to empty it.", 12, 400))
+
+	var right := VBoxContainer.new()
+	right.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	add_child(right)
+	_loadout = LoadoutPanel.new()
+	_loadout.doll_height = 480.0
+	right.add_child(_loadout)
+	_details = UI.label("Hover an item for details.", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	_details.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	_details.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(440, 80)
+	right.add_child(_details)
+
+
+func refresh() -> void:
+	_stats.text = "Hull %d / %d  ·  Shields %d / %d  ·  Fuel %d / %d  ·  Speed %d\nWeapons %d fitted  ·  firepower %.0f /s  ·  reach %.0f  ·  accuracy %d%%  ·  evasion %d%%\nDrachmas %d  ·  cargo worth %d dr" % [
+		ceilf(ship.hull), ship.max_hull, ceilf(ship.shields), ship.max_shields, floori(data.fuel_level()), roundi(data.fuel_max()),
+		ship.max_speed, Shipyard.used_slots(data, "hardpoints"), OutfitCompare.firepower(data),
+		ship.weapon_range, roundi(ship.accuracy() * 100.0), roundi(ship.evasion * 100.0), data.credits, _cargo_value()]
+
+	# Weapon kinds and systems: one row of icons (greyed: none fitted), each
+	# draggable onto the toolbar (a kind's key switches it on / off); the kinds firing lit.
+	UI.clear(_weapons)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	_weapons.add_child(row)
+	for id in Items.WEAPONS.keys() + ["afterburner", "shield_booster", "star_energizer", "cloak", "projection_array"]:
+		var owned: bool = data.has_equipment(id)
+		var name: String = Items.WEAPONS[id]["name"] if Items.WEAPONS.has(id) else Items.EQUIPMENT[id]["name"]
+		var n := Hardpoints.fitted(data).filter(func(w): return w != "" and Hardpoints.kind(w) == id).size()
+		var status := ("%d fitted  ·  %s" % [n, "firing" if ship.weapon_on(id) else "switched off"]) if Items.WEAPONS.has(id) and owned \
+			else ("installed" if owned else "not installed - buy one at a station's Outfitting")
+		if id == "missile_launcher" and owned:
+			status += "  ·  %d missiles" % data.count("missile")
+		var icon := ItemSlot.make(id, 0, 42.0, not owned)
+		icon.payload = {"src": "gear", "id": id}   # (drag it onto the toolbar)
+		icon.hovered.connect(func(_i): _hovered = id)
+		icon.mouse_exited.connect(func(): _hovered = "")
+		icon.tooltip_text = "%s  ·  %s\n%s\nDrag it onto the toolbar, or hover it and press 1-9." % [name, status, Items.EQUIPMENT[id]["desc"]]
+		if Items.WEAPONS.has(id) and owned and ship.weapon_on(id):
+			icon.modulate = Color(1.25, 1.15, 0.9)
+		row.add_child(icon)
+
+	# The ship's equipment screen: every area's fittings and free slots.
+	UI.clear(_doll_holder)
+	var sd := ship_doll(data, ship, _ship_gear_input, _fit)
+	sd.custom_minimum_size.y = 440.0   # (the column has the room: the ship drawn larger)
+	_doll_holder.add_child(sd)
+	# The automaton's loadout, from the hold.
+	_loadout.setup(data.loadout, data.items, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data), "hold", func(): data.changed.emit())
+	# The toolbar.
+	UI.clear(_bar)
+	for i in data.toolbar.size():
+		var tid: String = data.toolbar[i]
+		var ts := ItemSlot.make(tid, 0, 42.0)
+		ts.tooltip_text = "%d  %s\nDrag to another slot; right-click: empty it." % [i + 1, Items.display_name(tid) if tid != "" else "empty"]
+		ts.gui_input.connect(_bar_input.bind(i))
+		ts.payload = {"src": "toolbar", "which": "ship", "index": i, "id": tid}
+		ts.accepts = func(d): return Inventory.toolbar_accepts(d, false)
+		ts.on_drop = func(d): Inventory.toolbar_drop(data.toolbar, i, d, false); refresh()
+		_bar.add_child(ts)
+	# The hold: its class's slots, stacks of up to 100.
+	UI.clear(_grid)
+	var cap := Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data)
+	var hold := Inventory.slots(data.items, data.layout_hold, cap)
+	_hold_label.text = "%d / %d slots, up to %d of an item in each - drag stacks to arrange them" % [Inventory.slots_used(data.items), cap, Inventory.STACK]
+	for i in cap:
+		var st: Array = hold[i]
+		var slot := ItemSlot.make(st[0] if not st.is_empty() else "", int(st[1]) if not st.is_empty() else 0, 48.0)
+		if not st.is_empty():
+			slot.tooltip_text = Items.tooltip(st[0], int(st[1]), _hold_hint(st[0]))
+			slot.hovered.connect(_show_details)
+			slot.mouse_exited.connect(func(): _hovered = "")
+			slot.clicked.connect(_on_item_clicked)
+			slot.payload = {"src": "hold", "index": i, "id": st[0]}
+		slot.accepts = func(d): return d.get("src") in ["hold", "carried"] or _loadout.is_mine(d)
+		slot.on_drop = _drop_on_hold.bind(i)
+		_grid.add_child(slot)
+	# What you carry on foot (aboard: click a stack to stow it in the hold).
+	UI.clear(_carried)
+	var mine := Inventory.slots(data.carried, data.layout_carried, Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS)
+	for i in Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS:
+		var st: Array = mine[i]
+		var cs := ItemSlot.make(st[0] if not st.is_empty() else "", int(st[1]) if not st.is_empty() else 0, 40.0)
+		if not st.is_empty():
+			cs.tooltip_text = Items.tooltip(st[0], int(st[1]), "Click (or drag it into the hold) to stow it.")
+			cs.clicked.connect(_stow)
+			cs.payload = {"src": "carried", "index": i, "id": st[0]}
+		cs.accepts = func(d): return d.get("src") in ["hold", "carried"]
+		cs.on_drop = _drop_on_carried.bind(i)
+		_carried.add_child(cs)
+
+
+func _row(id: String, title: String, status: String, dim: bool, highlight: bool) -> Control:
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	var icon := ItemSlot.make(id, 0, 40.0, dim)
+	icon.payload = {"src": "gear", "id": id}   # (drag it onto the toolbar)
+	icon.hovered.connect(func(_i): _hovered = id)
+	icon.mouse_exited.connect(func(): _hovered = "")
+	icon.tooltip_text = "%s\nPress 1-9 to put it on that toolbar slot." % title
+	row.add_child(icon)
+	var text := VBoxContainer.new()
+	text.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
+	text.add_child(UI.label(title, 16, Color.WHITE if not dim else Color(0.6, 0.6, 0.65)))
+	text.add_child(UI.label(status, 13, NeonTheme.HEAD if highlight else UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	row.add_child(text)
+	return row
+
+
+## What clicking a stack in the hold does.
+func _hold_hint(id: String) -> String:
+	if Gear.side(id) == "ship":
+		return "Click (or drag it onto a free slot of its area) to fit it."
+	if Gear.side(id) == "foot":
+		return "Click (or drag it onto the automaton) to equip it."
+	if id == "repair_kit":
+		return "Click to use it (+40 hull); press 1-9 to put it on that toolbar slot."
+	if id == "fuel":
+		return "Click to pump a unit into the tank (+%d fuel)." % Shipyard.FUEL_UNITS_PER_CARGO
+	return "Drag it to arrange the hold."
+
+
+func _show_details(id: String) -> void:
+	_hovered = id
+	var it: Dictionary = Items.info(id)
+	var price := "Main quest item - cannot be sold." if it["kind"] == "quest" else "Sells for %d drachmas each." % it["value"]
+	_details.text = "%s  ×%d\n%s\n%s" % [it["name"], data.count(id), it["desc"], price]
+
+
+## Where each ship area's slots sit round the ship (pointing up) and the spot
+## on it they belong to: [at (0..1 of the doll), anchor (0..1 of the ship), vertical].
+const SHIP_PLACES := {
+	"nose": [Vector2(0.5, 0.0), Vector2(0.5, 0.06), false],
+	"wings": [Vector2(0.0, 0.5), Vector2(0.16, 0.62), true],
+	"hull": [Vector2(1.0, 0.18), Vector2(0.5, 0.42), true],
+	"bay": [Vector2(1.0, 0.8), Vector2(0.5, 0.66), true],
+	"thrusters": [Vector2(0.5, 1.0), Vector2(0.5, 0.95), false],
+}
+
+
+## The ship's equipment screen (EquipDoll): `on_module(event, index)` for
+## a fitted module's slot input, `on_fit(item_id)` for gear dropped on a
+## free slot.
+static func ship_doll(data: Node, ship: Node2D, on_module: Callable, on_fit: Callable) -> EquipDoll:
+	var d := EquipDoll.new()
+	var tex: Texture2D = ship.sprite.texture if ship and ship.get("sprite") and ship.sprite is Sprite2D else ProcArt.get_tex("ship_player")
+	d.picture = tex
+	for area in Shipyard.AREAS:
+		var slots := []
+		var name: String = Shipyard.AREA_NAMES[area]
+		if area == "wings":
+			slots = _hardpoint_slots(data, on_fit)
+			var place0: Array = SHIP_PLACES[area]
+			d.add_group(area, "%s  %d/%d" % ["HARDPOINTS", Shipyard.used_slots(data, "hardpoints"), slots.size()], place0[0], place0[1], place0[2], slots)
+			continue
+		for f in Shipyard.area_fittings(data, area):
+			if f["kind"] == "module":
+				var gid := Gear.item_id(f["id"], int(f["rating"]))
+				var gs := ItemSlot.make(gid, 0, 44.0)
+				gs.tooltip_text = "%s  ·  %s\n%s\nRight-click: take it out into the hold." % [name, Gear.title(gid), Gear.describe(gid)]
+				gs.gui_input.connect(on_module.bind(int(f["index"])))
+				slots.append(gs)
+			else:
+				var es := ItemSlot.make(f["id"], 0, 44.0)
+				es.payload = {"src": "gear", "id": f["id"]}   # (drag it onto the toolbar)
+				es.tooltip_text = "%s  ·  %s\n%s\n(Sold back at a station's Outfitting.)" % [name, Items.EQUIPMENT[f["id"]]["name"], Items.EQUIPMENT[f["id"]]["desc"]]
+				slots.append(es)
+		for k in maxi(0, Shipyard.area_capacity(data, area) - slots.size()):
+			var free := ItemSlot.make("", 0, 44.0)
+			free.tooltip_text = "%s  ·  free\nDrag ship gear for the %s here from the hold." % [name, name.to_lower()]
+			free.accepts = func(dd): return dd.get("src") == "hold" and Gear.side(str(dd.get("id", ""))) == "ship" and Shipyard.area_of(str(dd["id"])) == area
+			free.on_drop = func(dd): on_fit.call(str(dd["id"]))
+			slots.append(free)
+		var place: Array = SHIP_PLACES[area]
+		d.add_group(area, "%s  %d/%d" % [name.to_upper(), mini(slots.size(), Shipyard.area_fittings(data, area).size()), Shipyard.area_capacity(data, area)],
+			place[0], place[1], place[2], slots)
+	return d
+
+
+## A slot a hardpoint (Hardpoints): its weapon (drag it to the toolbar - its
+## kind's switch; right-click: into the hold) or, free, a place to drop a
+## weapon from the hold that fits its size. Smaller the more there are.
+static func _hardpoint_slots(data: Node, on_fit: Callable) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var lay := Hardpoints.layout(data.ship_class)
+	var ws := Hardpoints.fitted(data)
+	var px := 44.0 if lay.size() <= 6 else (34.0 if lay.size() <= 12 else 28.0)
+	for i in lay.size():
+		var z: int = lay[i]
+		var id: String = ws[i]
+		var sl := ItemSlot.make(id, 0, px)
+		if id != "":
+			sl.payload = {"src": "gear", "id": Hardpoints.kind(id)}   # (onto the toolbar: its kind's switch)
+			sl.tooltip_text = "Hardpoint %d (%s)  ·  %s\n%s\nRight-click: take it out into the hold. Drag it to the toolbar: a key to switch its kind on and off." % [
+				i + 1, Hardpoints.SIZES[z], Hardpoints.title(id), Hardpoints.describe(id)]
+			sl.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
+				if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
+					if Hardpoints.unfit(data, i):
+						GameLog.post("%s taken out into your hold" % Hardpoints.title(id), "info")
+					else:
+						GameLog.post("No room in the hold for it", "danger"))
+		else:
+			sl.tooltip_text = "Hardpoint %d (%s)  ·  free\nDrag a weapon of size %s or smaller here from the hold." % [i + 1, Hardpoints.SIZES[z], Hardpoints.SIZES[z]]
+			sl.accepts = func(dd): return dd.get("src") == "hold" and Hardpoints.fits(str(dd.get("id", "")), z)
+			sl.on_drop = func(dd):
+				if Hardpoints.fit(data, str(dd["id"]), i):
+					GameLog.post("Fitted %s" % Hardpoints.title(str(dd["id"])), "good")
+		out.append(sl)
+	return out
+
+
+func _ship_gear_input(event: InputEvent, i: int) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
+		var m: Dictionary = data.modules[i]
+		if Gear.unfit(data, i):
+			GameLog.post("%s taken out into your hold" % Shipyard.module_name(m), "info")
+			data.changed.emit()
+		else:
+			GameLog.post("No room in the hold for it", "danger")
+		refresh()
+
+
+func _fit(id: String) -> void:
+	if Gear.fit(data, id):
+		GameLog.post("Fitted %s" % Gear.title(id), "good")
+		data.changed.emit()
+	else:
+		GameLog.post("No room in the %s for %s" % [Shipyard.AREA_NAMES[Shipyard.area_of(id)].to_lower(), Gear.title(id)], "danger")
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _on_item_clicked(id: String) -> void:
+	if Hardpoints.is_weapon(id):   # (a weapon in the hold: onto a free hardpoint that takes it)
+		if Hardpoints.fit(data, id):
+			GameLog.post("Fitted %s" % Hardpoints.title(id), "good")
+		else:
+			GameLog.post("No free hardpoint of size %s or bigger for %s" % [Hardpoints.SIZES[Hardpoints.size_of(id)], Hardpoints.title(id)], "danger")
+		refresh()
+		return
+	if Gear.side(id) == "ship":
+		_fit(id)
+		return
+	if Gear.side(id) == "foot":
+		if _loadout.take_from_grid(id):
+			GameLog.post("Equipped %s" % Gear.title(id), "good")
+		refresh()
+		return
+	if id == "repair_kit":
+		ship.use_system("repair_kit")
+	elif id == "fuel" and data.fuel_level() < data.fuel_max() - 0.5:
+		# Fuel in the hold: a unit pumped into the tank (Shipyard.FUEL_UNITS_PER_CARGO).
+		if data.remove_item("fuel", 1):
+			data.add_fuel(Shipyard.FUEL_UNITS_PER_CARGO)
+			GameLog.post("Pumped a unit of fuel into the tank (%d / %d)" % [floori(data.fuel_level()), roundi(data.fuel_max())], "info")
+		refresh()
+
+
+func _bar_input(event: InputEvent, i: int) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
+		data.toolbar[i] = ""
+		refresh()
+
+
+## A stack dropped on a hold slot: from the hold - they swap; from what you
+## carry - it's stowed there.
+func _drop_on_hold(d: Dictionary, i: int) -> void:
+	if _loadout.is_mine(d):
+		_loadout.take_off(str(d["slot"]))   # (gear dragged off the automaton)
+	elif d.get("src") == "hold":
+		Inventory.swap(data.layout_hold, int(d["index"]), i)
+	else:
+		Inventory.move_stack_into(data.carried, data.items, d["id"], Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data), data.layout_hold, i)
+		data.changed.emit()
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _drop_on_carried(d: Dictionary, i: int) -> void:
+	if d.get("src") == "carried":
+		Inventory.swap(data.layout_carried, int(d["index"]), i)
+	else:
+		Inventory.move_stack_into(data.items, data.carried, d["id"], Inventory.PLAYER_SLOTS, data.layout_carried, i)
+		data.changed.emit()
+	refresh()
+
+
+## Something you carry on foot into the hold (one stack).
+func _stow(id: String) -> void:
+	if Inventory.move_stack(data.carried, data.items, id, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data)) > 0:
+		data.changed.emit()
+	else:
+		GameLog.post("Cargo hold full (%d slots)" % Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data), "danger")
+	refresh()
+
+
+## 1-9 over a weapon, a system or repair kits: it goes on that toolbar slot.
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not is_visible_in_tree() or _hovered == "" or not (event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo):
+		return
+	if event.keycode < KEY_1 or event.keycode > KEY_9 or not Inventory.ship_usable(_hovered):
+		return
+	var i: int = event.keycode - KEY_1
+	var was: int = data.toolbar.find(_hovered)
+	if was >= 0:
+		data.toolbar[was] = ""   # (one slot per tool: it moves)
+	data.toolbar[i] = _hovered
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _cargo_value() -> int:
+	var total := 0
+	for id in data.held_items():
+		total += Items.info(id)["value"] * data.count(id)
+	return total

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: Ship Computer tab: the sector map. Stations, planets (where to fly to reach them), asteroid fields, ships, the quest objective and your course. Wheel to zoom, drag to pan, click to set a course (the ship flies there), Shift + click to add a waypoint to it (the course runs through them in order), Shift + drag a waypoint (or the course's end) to move it. Fog of war (Galaxy.fog): only what your sensors have swept shows; the rest of the system is dark until you fly there. Signal sources a scan located show (above the fog) and can be clicked to fly to. PROBES (the button, or a right-click on empty space in flight): the probe scanner's panel beside the map (ProbeScanner) - launch probes where the map is looking, drag them about, the wheel over one sets its reach, ANALYZE; its findings show on the map (a circle where a signature might be; exact once located) and in the panel's list. TRADE ROUTES (the button, or T): green arrows for the best trade runs from this system's stations - to another station here, or (to the gate on the way) to a station up to two jumps away - with the good and the profit a unit. (Moved from scripts/pages/map_page.gd.)
