@@ -1,0 +1,916 @@ 
+extends VBoxContainer
+## Ship Computer tab: the sector map. Stations, planets (where to fly to
+## reach them), asteroid fields, ships, the quest objective and your course.
+## Wheel to zoom, drag to pan, click to set a course (the ship flies there),
+## Shift + click to add a waypoint to it (the course runs through them in order),
+## Shift + drag a waypoint (or the course's end) to move it.
+## Fog of war (Galaxy.fog): only what your sensors have swept shows; the rest
+## of the system is dark until you fly there. Signal sources a scan located
+## show (above the fog) and can be clicked to fly to.
+## PROBES (the button, or a right-click on empty space in flight): the probe
+## scanner's panel beside the map (ProbeScanner) - launch probes where the map
+## is looking, drag them about, the wheel over one sets its reach, ANALYZE;
+## its findings show on the map (a circle where a signature might be; exact once
+## located) and in the panel's list.
+## TRADE ROUTES (the button, or T): green arrows for the best trade runs from
+## this system's stations - to another station here, or (to the gate on the
+## way) to a station up to two jumps away - with the good and the profit a unit.
+
+var data: Node
+var ship: Node2D
+
+var _view: MapView
+var _info: Label
+var trade := false
+var _trade_btn: Button
+var _probe_btn: Button
+var _probe_panel: ProbePanel
+
+
+## The probe scanner (main's ProbeScanner), or null (not in space).
+func probes() -> ProbeScanner:
+	var m := get_tree().current_scene if is_inside_tree() else null
+	return m.get("probes") if m and m.get("probes") is ProbeScanner else null
+
+
+## The PROBES panel shown (or hidden).
+func show_probes(on: bool) -> void:
+	_probe_panel.visible = on
+	_probe_btn.set_pressed_no_signal(on)
+	_view.probing = on
+	if on:
+		_probe_panel.rebuild()
+	_view.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func toggle_trade() -> void:
+	trade = not trade
+	_trade_btn.set_pressed_no_signal(trade)
+	_view.routes = []
+	_view._trade_t = 0.0
+	_view.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	var top := HBoxContainer.new()
+	top.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	# (the help wraps to the room the legend and buttons leave it)
+	_info = UI.note("Wheel: zoom  ·  drag: pan  ·  click: set a course  ·  Shift + click: add a waypoint  ·  Shift + drag a waypoint: move it", 14, 300)
+	_info.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_info.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	top.add_child(_info)
+	top.add_child(_legend(MapIcons.ORANGE, "Objective / landable"))
+	top.add_child(_legend(MapIcons.CYAN, "Station / planet / gate"))
+	top.add_child(_legend(MapIcons.RED, "Hostile"))
+	top.add_child(_legend(Color(0.5, 1.0, 0.75), "Neutral"))
+	top.add_child(_legend(Color(0.85, 0.65, 0.4), "Asteroid"))
+	_trade_btn = EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("TRADE", toggle_trade, 14), "buy", EditorIcons.tip("Trade routes", "T", "Green arrows for the best trade runs from this system's stations: to another station here, or out through a gate to a station up to two jumps away.\nEach shows the good to carry and the profit a unit."))
+	_trade_btn.toggle_mode = true
+	_trade_btn.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	top.add_child(_trade_btn)
+	_probe_btn = EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("PROBES", func(): show_probes(not _probe_panel.visible), 14), "scan", EditorIcons.tip("Probe scanner", "right-click in flight",
+		"Scan probes: launch them across the system, drag them into place - one at a time, or all together by the handle above them -\nset their reach (the wheel over one) and analyze.\nEvery signature they read gets a strength: tight probes round it pin it down - at 100% it's located.\nNeeds a Probe Scanner (outfitters, SYSTEMS)."))
+	_probe_btn.toggle_mode = true
+	_probe_btn.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	top.add_child(_probe_btn)
+	var fit := EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", func(): _view.fit(), 14), "fit_all", EditorIcons.tip("Whole sector", "", "Zooms the map out to show the whole sector: every station, planet and jump gate.\nWheel: zoom · drag: pan."))
+	fit.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	top.add_child(fit)
+	var ctr := EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", func(): _view.centre_on_ship(), 14), "ship", EditorIcons.tip("Centre on your ship", "", "Moves the map to your ship's position (keeping the zoom)."))
+	ctr.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	top.add_child(ctr)
+	add_child(top)
+	_view = MapView.new()
+	_view.page = self
+	_view.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(1240, 590)
+	_view.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_view.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	row.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	add_child(row)
+	row.add_child(_view)
+	_probe_panel = ProbePanel.new()
+	_probe_panel.page = self
+	_probe_panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(330, 0)
+	_probe_panel.visible = false
+	row.add_child(_probe_panel)
+
+
+func _legend(c: Color, text: String) -> HBoxContainer:
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	var dot := ColorRect.new()
+	dot.color = c
+	dot.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(10, 10)
+	dot.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	h.add_child(dot)
+	h.add_child(UI.label(text, 13, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	return h
+
+
+func refresh() -> void:
+	_view.ship = ship
+	_view.rebuild()
+
+
+## The current system's planets (they orbit the star; positions are live).
+static func planet_targets(tree: SceneTree, _from: Vector2) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for b in tree.get_nodes_in_group("planet_bodies"):
+		var look: Dictionary = b.spec
+		out.append({"id": b.planet_id, "name": b.title, "pos": b.global_position, "landable": b.landable,
+			"radius": b.radius, "orbit": b.orbit, "center": b.parent_body.global_position if b.parent_body else Vector2.ZERO,
+			"color": look.get("color_light", Color(0.65, 0.75, 0.85)), "color2": look.get("color_dark", Color(0.25, 0.3, 0.4)),
+			"moon": b.parent_body != null, "rings": float(b.spec.get("rings", 0.0)) > 0.0})
+	return out
+
+
+class MapView extends Control:
+	const GOLD := Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.38)
+	var page: Node
+	var ship: Node2D
+	var center := Vector2.ZERO
+	var scale_ := 0.05            # screen px per world unit
+	var _bounds := Rect2()
+	var _planets := []
+	var _hover := {}
+
+	var routes: Array = []      # the trade runs shown (page.trade)
+	var probing := false        # the PROBES panel open: probes can be dragged, the wheel sizes them
+	var picked_id := ""         # the signature picked in the panel's list (drawn out)
+	var _probe_drag := -1
+	var _trade_t := 0.0
+
+	## The game goes on while the map is open: you, the ships and your course move on it.
+	func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
+		# (30 pictures a second of the moving system - a map; the heavy redraw
+		# frames at 60 were one in eight of 700 a second)
+		if UI.redraw_due(self, 30.0):
+			queue_redraw()
+		if is_visible_in_tree():
+			_overlay_due()
+		if _trading() and is_visible_in_tree():
+			_trade_t -= _delta
+			if _trade_t <= 0.0:
+				_trade_t = 2.0   # (prices move every economy tick)
+				var here := TradeRoutes.stations_of([Galaxy.current_system])
+				routes = TradeRoutes.routes_from(here, 0, "", 6) + TradeRoutes.routes_from(here, 2, "", 5, true)
+
+	func _trading() -> bool:
+		return is_instance_valid(page) and page.trade
+
+	## The trade runs: station to station, or station to the gate toward the
+	## system where it sells.
+	func _draw_trade(font: Font, fs: int) -> void:
+		if routes.is_empty():
+			return
+		var where := {}
+		for st in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stations"):
+			where[st.station_id] = st.global_position
+		var gates := {}
+		for g in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("gates"):
+			gates[g.target] = g.global_position
+		var top := 1.0
+		for r in routes:
+			top = maxf(top, r["profit"])
+		var t := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
+		var n := 0
+		var taken := []
+		for r in routes:
+			if not where.has(r["from"]) or not _seen(where[r["from"]]):
+				continue   # (from stations you've charted; where it sells may be out in the dark)
+			var a := to_screen(where[r["from"]])
+			var b: Vector2
+			var tag := TradeRoutes.tag_text(r)
+			if r["to_sys"] == Galaxy.current_system:
+				if not where.has(r["to"]):
+					continue
+				b = to_screen(where[r["to"]])
+			else:
+				var path := Galaxy.find_route(Galaxy.current_system, r["to_sys"])
+				if path.size() < 2 or not gates.has(path[1]):
+					continue
+				b = to_screen(gates[path[1]])
+				tag += " › " + TradeRoutes.system_name(r["to_sys"]).to_upper()
+			var d := (b - a).normalized()
+			var off := d.orthogonal() * ((n % 3) - 1) * 8.0
+			n += 1
+			var pts := PackedVector2Array([a + d * 22.0 + off, b - d * 24.0 + off])
+			if pts[0].distance_to(pts[1]) < 30.0:
+				continue
+			TradeRoutes.draw_run(self, pts, r["profit"] / top, t)
+			TradeRoutes.draw_tag(self, pts[0].lerp(pts[1], 0.3 + 0.12 * (n % 3)), tag, fs, taken)
+	var _press := Vector2.ZERO
+	var _dragging := false
+	var _pressed := false
+	var _fitted := false
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		clip_contents = true
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		_overlay = ProbeOverlay.new()
+		_overlay.view = self
+		_overlay.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		_overlay.set_anchors_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+		add_child(_overlay)
+
+	## The probes and their findings on their own layer, redrawn only when they
+	## (or the view) change - not with the moving system 60 times a second:
+	## dozens of signatures' circles and names were 3 ms a redraw.
+	var _overlay: ProbeOverlay
+	var _overlay_sig := ""
+
+	func _overlay_due() -> void:
+		var ps: ProbeScanner = page.probes() if is_instance_valid(page) else null
+		if ps == null:
+			return
+		var sig := "%s|%s|%d|%d|%s|%s|%s" % [center, scale_, ps.probes.size(), ps.results.size(), picked_id, probing, _group_drag]
+		for p in ps.probes:
+			sig += "|%s,%s" % [p["at"], p["r"]]
+		var anim := ps.analyzing >= 0.0
+		if sig != _overlay_sig or (anim and UI.redraw_due(_overlay, 30.0)):
+			_overlay_sig = sig
+			_overlay.repaint()
+
+	func rebuild() -> void:
+		if ship == null:
+			return
+		_planets = MapPage_targets()
+		var b := Rect2(ship.global_position, Vector2.ZERO)
+		for st in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stations"):
+			if _seen(st.global_position):
+				b = b.expand(st.global_position)
+		for r in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("asteroids"):
+			if _seen(r.global_position):
+				b = b.expand(r.global_position)
+		for p in _planets:
+			if _seen(p["pos"]):
+				b = b.expand(p["pos"])
+		for g in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("gates"):
+			if _seen(g.global_position):
+				b = b.expand(g.global_position)
+		var q := _quest()
+		if q and q.target_position() != null:
+			b = b.expand(q.target_position())
+		_bounds = b.grow(1200)
+		if not _fitted:
+			_fitted = true
+			fit.call_deferred()
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	## Explored (out of the fog).
+	func _seen(p: Vector2) -> bool:
+		return Galaxy.explored_at(p)
+
+	func MapPage_targets() -> Array:
+		return page.planet_targets(get_tree(), ship.global_position)
+
+	func _quest() -> Node:
+		return get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("quest")
+
+	func fit() -> void:
+		if size.x < 10 or _bounds.size.x <= 0:
+			return
+		center = _bounds.get_center()
+		scale_ = minf(size.x / _bounds.size.x, size.y / _bounds.size.y) * 0.95
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	func centre_on_ship() -> void:
+		if ship:
+			center = ship.global_position
+			scale_ = maxf(scale_, 0.12)
+			queue_redraw()
+
+	func to_screen(w: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+		return size / 2.0 + (w - center) * scale_
+
+	func to_world(s: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+		return center + (s - size / 2.0) / scale_
+
+	# --- Input -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+	func _gui_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+		if ev is InputEventMouseButton:
+			var mb := ev as InputEventMouseButton
+			var pi := _probe_at(mb.position) if probing else -1
+			var on_group := probing and _group_handle_at(mb.position)
+			if mb.pressed and mb.button_index in [MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP, MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN] and on_group:
+				# (the wheel over the group's handle: the formation spread out / drawn in round its middle)
+				_spread_group(1.25 if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP else 0.8)
+			elif mb.pressed and mb.button_index in [MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP, MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN] and pi >= 0 and mb.shift_pressed:
+				page.probes().step_all(1 if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP else -1)   # (Shift: every probe's reach)
+				queue_redraw()
+			elif mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and mb.pressed and (on_group or (pi >= 0 and mb.shift_pressed)):
+				_group_drag = true   # (the handle, or Shift + a probe: the whole group moves)
+				_group_last = to_world(mb.position)
+			elif mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and not mb.pressed and _group_drag:
+				_group_drag = false
+				page.probes().changed.emit()
+			elif mb.pressed and mb.button_index in [MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP, MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN] and pi >= 0:
+				# (the wheel over a probe: its reach a step bigger / smaller)
+				var pr: Dictionary = page.probes().probes[pi]
+				pr["r"] = ProbeScanner.step(float(pr["r"]), 1 if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP else -1)
+				page.probes().changed.emit()
+				queue_redraw()
+			elif mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and mb.pressed and pi >= 0:
+				_probe_drag = pi   # (drag a probe to move it)
+			elif mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and not mb.pressed and _probe_drag >= 0:
+				_probe_drag = -1
+				page.probes().changed.emit()
+			elif mb.pressed and mb.button_index in [MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP, MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN]:
+				var w := to_world(mb.position)
+				scale_ = clampf(scale_ * (1.2 if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP else 1.0 / 1.2), 0.005, 1.0)
+				center = w - (mb.position - size / 2.0) / scale_
+				queue_redraw()
+			elif UI.middle_click(self, mb):
+				fit()   # (the middle button: the whole map again)
+			elif mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+				if mb.pressed and mb.shift_pressed and _course_point_at(mb.position) >= 0:
+					_wp_drag = _course_point_at(mb.position)   # (Shift + drag a course point: move it)
+					_wp_moved = false
+				elif mb.pressed:
+					_pressed = true
+					_dragging = false
+					_press = mb.position
+				elif _wp_drag >= 0:
+					if _wp_moved:
+						_drop_course_point(mb.position)
+					_wp_drag = -1
+				else:
+					if _pressed and not _dragging:
+						_set_course(mb.position, mb.shift_pressed)
+					_pressed = false
+					_dragging = false
+			accept_event()
+		elif ev is InputEventMouseMotion:
+			var mm := ev as InputEventMouseMotion
+			if _group_drag and page.probes():
+				var w := to_world(mm.position)
+				var d := w - _group_last
+				_group_last = w
+				for pr in page.probes().probes:
+					pr["pos"] = (pr["pos"] as Vector2) + d
+					pr["at"] = pr["pos"]   # (already out there: moved, not relaunched)
+				queue_redraw()
+				accept_event()
+				return
+			if _probe_drag >= 0 and page.probes() and _probe_drag < page.probes().probes.size():
+				var pr: Dictionary = page.probes().probes[_probe_drag]
+				pr["pos"] = to_world(mm.position)
+				pr["at"] = pr["pos"]   # (it's already out there: moved, not relaunched)
+				queue_redraw()
+				accept_event()
+				return
+			if _wp_drag >= 0:
+				_wp_moved = true
+				ship.set_course_point(_wp_drag, to_world(mm.position))
+				queue_redraw()
+				accept_event()
+				return
+			# Shift over a course point, the probes' group handle, Shift over a probe: the move cursor (they can be dragged).
+			var movable := (mm.shift_pressed and _course_point_at(mm.position) >= 0) or (probing and (_group_handle_at(mm.position) or (mm.shift_pressed and _probe_at(mm.position) >= 0)))
+			mouse_default_cursor_shape = CURSOR_MOVE if movable else CURSOR_ARROW
+			if _pressed and (_dragging or mm.position.distance_to(_press) > 5.0):
+				_dragging = true
+				center -= mm.relative / scale_
+			_hover = _pick(mm.position)
+			queue_redraw()
+			accept_event()
+
+	var _wp_drag := -1      # the course point being dragged (Shift + drag), -1: none
+	var _group_drag := false   # the probes moved as a group (their handle, or Shift + drag a probe)
+	var _group_last := Vector2.ZERO
+
+	## The probes' middle (world), the group handle's place.
+	func _group_centre() -> Vector2:
+		var ps: ProbeScanner = page.probes()
+		var c := Vector2.ZERO
+		if ps == null:
+			return c
+		for pr in ps.probes:
+			c += pr["at"] as Vector2
+		return c / maxf(1.0, ps.probes.size())
+
+	## The group handle's place (screen): above the topmost probe, in line with
+	## their middle (clear of every probe's marker - the pattern has one in the middle).
+	func _group_handle_pos() -> Vector2:
+		var ps: ProbeScanner = page.probes()
+		var top := INF
+		for pr in ps.probes:
+			top = minf(top, to_screen(pr["at"]).y)
+		return Vector2(to_screen(_group_centre()).x, top - 34.0)
+
+	## Over the group handle (shown with two probes or more)?
+	func _group_handle_at(at: Vector2) -> bool:
+		if not is_instance_valid(page) or page.probes() == null or page.probes().probes.size() < 2:
+			return false
+		return _group_handle_pos().distance_to(at) < 13.0
+
+	## The formation spread out (k > 1) or drawn in round its middle.
+	func _spread_group(k: float) -> void:
+		var ps: ProbeScanner = page.probes()
+		if ps == null:
+			return
+		var c := _group_centre()
+		for pr in ps.probes:
+			pr["pos"] = c + ((pr["pos"] as Vector2) - c) * k
+			pr["at"] = pr["pos"]
+		ps.changed.emit()
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	## The probe under `at` (its marker, or its reach's rim), -1: none.
+	func _probe_at(at: Vector2) -> int:
+		if not is_instance_valid(page):
+			return -1
+		var ps: ProbeScanner = page.probes()
+		if ps == null:
+			return -1
+		for i in range(ps.probes.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+			var c := to_screen(ps.probes[i]["at"])
+			var rr: float = float(ps.probes[i]["r"]) * scale_
+			var d := c.distance_to(at)
+			if d < 14.0 or absf(d - rr) < 8.0:
+				return i
+		return -1
+
+	## The probes (their reach, where they are) and what they've found.
+	func _draw_probes(font: Font, fs: int, ci: CanvasItem) -> void:
+		if not is_instance_valid(page):
+			return
+		var ps: ProbeScanner = page.probes()
+		if ps == null:
+			return
+		var t := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
+		for r in ps.results:
+			var col: Color = ProbeScanner.KINDS[r["kind"]][2]
+			var st := float(r["strength"])
+			var lbl := "%s  %d%%" % [ProbeScanner.label(r), roundi(st * 100.0)]
+			if st >= 1.0:

+## located one can be flown to).
+class ProbePanel extends VBoxContainer:
+	var page: Node
+	var _status: Label
+	var _bar: ProgressBar
+	var _list: VBoxContainer
+	var _reach := 8000.0
+	var _t := 0.0
+	var _bound := false
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+
+	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+		if not is_visible_in_tree():
+			return
+		var ps: ProbeScanner = page.probes()
+		if ps and not _bound:
+			_bound = true
+			ps.changed.connect(func(): if is_visible_in_tree(): rebuild())
+		if ps and ps.analyzing >= 0.0 and _bar:
+			_bar.value = ps.analyzing / ProbeScanner.ANALYZE_TIME
+
+	func rebuild() -> void:
+		for c in get_children():
+			c.queue_free()
+		_bar = null
+		var ps: ProbeScanner = page.probes()
+		add_child(UI.section("PROBE SCANNER"))
+		if ps == null or not ps.fitted():
+			add_child(UI.note("No probe scanner fitted. Outfitters sell them (SYSTEMS): scan probes that find anomalies, ships, planets and structures anywhere in the system.", 14, 320))
+			return
+		add_child(UI.note("Launch the probes where the map is looking; drag one to move it, the wheel over one changes its reach. Move them all together: drag the gold handle above them (or Shift + drag any probe); the wheel over the handle spreads them out or draws them in, Shift + wheel over a probe changes every reach. Tight probes round a signature raise its strength - at 100% it's located.", 13, 320))
+		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+		row.add_child(UI.button("-", func():
+			_reach = ProbeScanner.step(_reach, -1)
+			ps.step_all(-1), 15))
+		var rl := UI.label("reach %.0fk" % (_reach / 1000.0), 15, Color.WHITE)
+		rl.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(110, 0)
+		rl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+		row.add_child(rl)
+		row.add_child(UI.button("+", func():
+			_reach = ProbeScanner.step(_reach, 1)
+			ps.step_all(1), 15))
+		add_child(row)
+		var launch := UI.button("Launch %d probes here" % ProbeScanner.MAX_PROBES, func():
+			ps.launch_pattern(page._view.center, _reach), 15)
+		launch.tooltip_text = "Probes fly out to where the map is centred, in a ring of the reach shown, one in the middle."
+		add_child(launch)
+		var go := UI.button("ANALYZE" if ps.analyzing < 0.0 else "Analyzing...", ps.analyze, 16)
+		go.disabled = ps.probes.is_empty() or ps.analyzing >= 0.0
+		go.tooltip_text = "Reads every signature within the probes' reach (%.1f s once they're in place)." % ProbeScanner.ANALYZE_TIME
+		add_child(go)
+		if ps.analyzing >= 0.0:
+			_bar = ProgressBar.new()
+			_bar.max_value = 1.0
+			_bar.show_percentage = false
+			_bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 10)
+			add_child(_bar)
+		var rc := UI.button("Recall probes", ps.recall, 14)
+		rc.disabled = ps.probes.is_empty()
+		add_child(rc)
+		add_child(UI.section("SIGNATURES  ·  %d" % ps.results.size()))
+		var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
+		scroll.name = "Signatures"
+		scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
+		scroll.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		_list = VBoxContainer.new()
+		_list.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		scroll.add_child(_list)
+		add_child(scroll)
+		if ps.results.is_empty():
+			_list.add_child(UI.label("None yet - launch probes and analyze.", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+		for ri in mini(ps.results.size(), LIST_MAX):
+			var r: Dictionary = ps.results[ri]
+			var st := float(r["strength"])
+			var col: Color = ProbeScanner.KINDS[r["kind"]][2]
+			var b := UI.button("%3d%%   %s" % [roundi(st * 100.0), ProbeScanner.label(r)], _pick.bind(r), 14)
+			b.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
+			b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col if st < 1.0 else col.lightened(0.35))
+			b.tooltip_text = ("Located: click to set a course to it." if st >= 1.0 else "Click: the map centres on where it might be. Draw probes tighter round it to pin it down.")
+			_list.add_child(b)
+		if ps.results.size() > LIST_MAX:
+			_list.add_child(UI.label("... and %d fainter ones (on the map)" % (ps.results.size() - LIST_MAX), 13, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+
+	const LIST_MAX := 14   # (the strongest; the rest on the map)
+
+	func _pick(r: Dictionary) -> void:
+		var v = page._view
+		if float(r["strength"]) >= 1.0 and page.ship and page.ship.is_alive():
+			var to: Vector2 = r["node"].global_position if is_instance_valid(r.get("node")) else r["pos"]
+			page.ship.move_to(to)
+			GameLog.post("Course set for %s (%.1fk)." % [r["name"], page.ship.global_position.distance_to(to) / 1000.0], "info")
+		v.center = r["est"] if float(r["strength"]) < 1.0 else r["pos"]
+		v.picked_id = r["id"]
+		v._fitted = true   # (keep this view: not refitted)
+		v.queue_redraw()
+
+
+
+class ProbeOverlay extends Control:
+	## (Painted off screen - a SubViewport - when it changes, shown as one
+	## picture: the dozens of circles and names were a thousand draw calls a frame.)
+	var view: Control
+	var _vp: SubViewport
+	var _paint: Painter
+
+	class Painter extends Control:
+		var view: Control
+		func _draw() -> void:
+			if view and view.ship:
+				view._draw_probes(NeonTheme.heavy_font(), Settings.fs("menu", 15), self)
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		_vp = SubViewport.new()
+		_vp.transparent_bg = true
+		_vp.disable_3d = true
+		_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+		add_child(_vp)
+		_paint = Painter.new()
+		_paint.view = view
+		_vp.add_child(_paint)
+		resized.connect(_fit)
+		_fit()
+
+	func _fit() -> void:
+		_vp.size = Vector2i(maxi(8, int(size.x)), maxi(8, int(size.y)))
+		_paint.size = size
+		repaint()
+
+	func repaint() -> void:
+		if _paint:
+			_paint.queue_redraw()
+			_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+			queue_redraw()
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		if _vp:
+			draw_texture(_vp.get_texture(), Vector2.ZERO)

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The station's commodity market (Station menu > MARKET): a trading terminal. Left: every good in a table, grouped by category - what the station pays (SELL) and asks (BUY), the galactic average and how far this price is from it, the station's supply and demand (bars) and what you carry. Right: the selected good - its prices, a quantity picker, Buy / Sell and where it sells best within two jumps (plot a route there). Keys (Keybinds, rebindable): W/S or the arrows / D-pad pick a good, A/D the quantity, Enter / pad A buy, Backspace / pad X sell. The selection and quantity stay while the page is rebuilt (every trade rebuilds it). (Moved from scripts/pages/market_page.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,388 @@ 
+extends HBoxContainer
+class_name MarketPage
+## The station's commodity market (Station menu > MARKET): a trading terminal.
+## Left: every good in a table, grouped by category - what the station pays
+## (SELL) and asks (BUY), the galactic average and how far this price is from
+## it, the station's supply and demand (bars) and what you carry. Right: the
+## selected good - its prices, a quantity picker, Buy / Sell and where it
+## sells best within two jumps (plot a route there).
+## Keys (Keybinds, rebindable): W/S or the arrows / D-pad pick a good, A/D the
+## quantity, Enter / pad A buy, Backspace / pad X sell. The selection and quantity stay while the page is rebuilt (every
+## trade rebuilds it).
+
+const GREEN := Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55)
+const RED := Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.35)
+## Column widths at text scale 1 (the commodity column takes the rest).
+const COLS := [["SELL", 84], ["BUY", 84], ["GALACTIC AVG", 150], ["SUPPLY", 120], ["DEMAND", 110], ["CARGO", 72]]
+
+static var selected := "food"
+static var qty := 1
+## The category shown (TradeRoutes.CATEGORIES index): one tab each.
+static var category := 0
+
+var menu: Node            # the station menu (data, station, refresh)
+var data: Node
+var sid := ""
+var _rows := {}           # item -> its row button
+var _k := 1.0             # text scale
+
+
+func setup(m: Node) -> void:
+	menu = m
+	data = m.data
+	sid = m.station.station_id
+	_k = Settings.font_scale("menu")
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
+	size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	category = clampi(category, 0, TradeRoutes.CATEGORIES.size() - 1)
+	var goods := _goods()
+	if not selected in goods:
+		selected = goods[0] if not goods.is_empty() else Galaxy.COMMODITIES[0]
+	add_child(_table())
+	add_child(_detail())
+
+
+# --- The table -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The goods of the category shown that this station deals in.
+func _goods() -> Array:
+	var stock: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations[sid]["stock"]
+	return TradeRoutes.CATEGORIES[category][1].filter(func(c): return stock.has(c))
+
+
+func _table() -> Control:
+	var col := VBoxContainer.new()
+	col.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	col.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
+	# A tab per category, with how many of its goods this station deals in.
+	var stock: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations[sid]["stock"]
+	var names := TradeRoutes.CATEGORIES.map(func(cat): return "%s %d" % [cat[0], cat[1].filter(func(c): return stock.has(c)).size()])
+	var tabs: Container = menu._sub_tabs(names, category, func(i):
+		category = i
+		menu.refresh(), 2)
+	col.add_child(tabs)
+	var gap := Control.new()
+	gap.custom_minimum_size.y = 4
+	col.add_child(gap)
+	col.add_child(_header())
+	var rec: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations[sid]
+	var goods := _goods()
+	for c in goods:
+		col.add_child(_row(c, rec))
+	if goods.is_empty():
+		col.add_child(UI.label("This station doesn't trade in %s." % TradeRoutes.CATEGORIES[category][0].to_lower(), 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	return col
+
+
+func _header() -> Control:
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
+	var name := UI.label("COMMODITY", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	name.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	name.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 10)
+	var pad := MarginContainer.new()
+	pad.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 46)
+	pad.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	pad.add_child(name)
+	h.add_child(pad)
+	for c in COLS:
+		var l := UI.label(c[0], 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+		l.custom_minimum_size.x = c[1] * _k
+		l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT if c[0] in ["SELL", "BUY", "CARGO"] else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+		h.add_child(l)
+	var m := MarginContainer.new()
+	m.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 4)
+	m.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 10)
+	m.add_child(h)
+	return m
+
+
+## One good: a flat button (click / Enter selects it) holding the columns.
+func _row(c: String, rec: Dictionary) -> Button:
+	var t: Dictionary = TradeRoutes.table()[sid]
+	var buy: int = t[c][0]
+	var sell: int = t[c][1]
+	var avg := TradeRoutes.average(c)
+	var sup := TradeRoutes.supply_bars(sid, c)
+	var dem := TradeRoutes.demand_bars(sid, c)
+	var have: int = data.count(c)
+	var sel := c == selected
+	var ink: Color = NeonTheme.INK if sel else Color.WHITE
+	var dim: Color = Color(NeonTheme.INK, 0.75) if sel else UI.TEXT_DIM
+
+	var b := Button.new()
+	b.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE   # (the keys move the selection: handle_key)
+	b.custom_minimum_size.y = 24 * minf(_k, 1.25)   # (no taller past 125%: the text fits) (a line of text and a little air: every good on the page)
+	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _row_box(sel, false))
+	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _row_box(sel, true))
+	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _row_box(true, true))
+	b.pressed.connect(func(): _select(c))
+	b.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip(Items.display_name(c), "W / S", "%s\n%s" % [Items.ITEMS[c]["desc"], _tag(c, rec)])
+	_rows[c] = b
+
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	h.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	h.offset_left = 6
+	h.offset_right = -10
+	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
+	h.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	b.add_child(h)
+	var icon := ItemSlot.make(c, 0, 22.0 * minf(_k, 1.25))
+	icon.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	h.add_child(icon)
+	var name := UI.label("  " + Items.display_name(c), 16, ink)
+	name.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	h.add_child(name)
+	var tag := UI.label(_short_tag(c, rec), 12, dim)
+	h.add_child(tag)
+	h.add_child(_cell(str(sell), COLS[0][1], ink, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT))
+	h.add_child(_cell(str(buy) if sup > 0 else "-", COLS[1][1], ink if sup > 0 else dim, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT))
+	# Galactic average, and how this station's sell price compares with it.
+	var diff := roundi(100.0 * (sell - avg) / maxf(1.0, avg))
+	var arrow := "▲" if diff > 0 else ("▼" if diff < 0 else " ")
+	var dcol: Color = (GREEN if diff > 0 else RED) if diff != 0 else dim
+	if sel:
+		dcol = NeonTheme.INK
+	h.add_child(_cell("%d  %s%d%%" % [avg, arrow, absi(diff)], COLS[2][1], dcol, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER))
+	h.add_child(_bars(sup, COLS[3][1], int(rec["stock"].get(c, 0.0)), ink, dim))
+	h.add_child(_bars(dem, COLS[4][1], -1, ink, dim))
+	h.add_child(_cell(str(have) if have > 0 else "", COLS[5][1], ink, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT))
+	for n in h.get_children():
+		n.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	return b
+
+
+func _row_box(sel: bool, hover: bool) -> StyleBox:
+	if sel:
+		var s := NeonTheme.lit(NeonTheme.CYAN, 1, 4)
+		s.content_margin_left = 0
+		return s
+	var f := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	f.bg_color = NeonTheme.hi_bg(0.6, 0.35) if hover else Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+	f.border_color = Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.12)
+	f.border_width_bottom = 1
+	return f
+
+
+func _cell(text: String, w: float, col: Color, align: HorizontalAlignment) -> Label:
+	var l := UI.label(text, 15, col)
+	l.custom_minimum_size.x = w * _k
+	l.horizontal_alignment = align
+	l.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	return l
+
+
+## Three bars (lit: `n` of them), the stock beside them (`count` >= 0).
+func _bars(n: int, w: float, count: int, ink: Color, dim: Color) -> Control:
+	var c := Control.new()
+	c.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(w * _k, 20)
+	c.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	var k := _k
+	c.draw.connect(func():
+		var x0 := c.size.x / 2.0 - (40.0 * k if count >= 0 else 16.0 * k)
+		for i in 3:
+			var hgt := (6.0 + i * 4.0) * k
+			var r := Rect2(x0 + i * 10.0 * k, c.size.y / 2.0 + 8.0 * k - hgt, 7.0 * k, hgt)
+			c.draw_rect(r, ink if i < n else Color(dim, 0.25))
+		if count >= 0:
+			var f := NeonTheme.heavy_font()
+			c.draw_string(f, Vector2(x0 + 36.0 * k, c.size.y / 2.0 + 6.0 * k), str(count) if n > 0 else "-", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, roundi(14 * k), ink if n > 0 else dim))
+	return c
+
+
+func _short_tag(c: String, rec: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return "MADE HERE  " if Galaxy.makes(rec["economy"], c) else ""
+
+
+func _tag(c: String, rec: Dictionary) -> String:
+	if Galaxy.makes(rec["economy"], c):
+		return "Made here: cheap to buy."
+	if Galaxy.uses(rec["economy"], c):
+		return "Used here: the station pays more the shorter it is."
+	return "Neither made nor used here."
+
+
+# --- The selected good -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _detail() -> Control:
+	var c: String = selected
+	var t: Dictionary = TradeRoutes.table()[sid]
+	var buy: int = t[c][0]
+	var sell: int = t[c][1]
+	var stock := int(t[c][2])
+	var have: int = data.count(c)
+	var avg := TradeRoutes.average(c)
+	var cap := Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data)
+	var used := Galaxy.cargo_used(data)
+
+	var p := PanelContainer.new()
+	p.custom_minimum_size.x = 440 * _k
+	var box := NeonTheme.box(Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.6), NeonTheme.BG_LIGHT, 1, 4)
+	box.content_margin_left = 16
+	box.content_margin_right = 16
+	box.content_margin_top = 12
+	box.content_margin_bottom = 14
+	p.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", box)
+	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	p.add_child(v)
+
+	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
+	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
+	head.add_child(ItemSlot.make(c, have, 56.0))
+	var names := VBoxContainer.new()
+	names.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
+	names.add_child(UI.label(Items.display_name(c).to_upper(), 24, NeonTheme.HEAD))
+	names.add_child(UI.label(TradeRoutes.category_of(c), 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	head.add_child(names)
+	v.add_child(head)
+	var desc := UI.label(Items.ITEMS[c]["desc"], 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	desc.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	v.add_child(desc)
+
+	# Prices.
+	var g := GridContainer.new()
+	g.columns = 2
+	g.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 20)
+	g.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 2)
+	for pair in [["Buy price", "%d dr" % buy if stock >= 1 else "none in stock"], ["Sell price", "%d dr" % sell],
+			["Galactic average", "%d dr" % avg], ["Station stock", str(stock)], ["In your hold", str(have)],
+			["Cargo hold", "%d / %d slots" % [used, cap]]]:
+		g.add_child(UI.label(pair[0], 15, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+		g.add_child(UI.label(pair[1], 15, Color.WHITE))
+	v.add_child(g)
+
+	# Quantity and the transaction.
+	v.add_child(UI.section("TRANSACTION"))
+	var max_buy := mini(stock, mini(data.room_for(c), data.credits / maxi(1, buy)))
+	qty = clampi(qty, 1, 999)
+	var q := HBoxContainer.new()
+	q.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	q.add_child(_small("−", func(): _set_qty(qty - (10 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) else 1)), "Less (A; Shift: 10 less)"))
+	var ql := UI.label(str(qty), 22, Color.WHITE)
+	ql.custom_minimum_size.x = 64 * _k
+	ql.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	q.add_child(ql)
+	q.add_child(_small("+", func(): _set_qty(qty + (10 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) else 1)), "More (D; Shift: 10 more)"))
+	q.add_child(_small("MAX", func(): _set_qty(maxi(1, maxi(max_buy, have))), "As many as you can buy - or sell, when you can't buy any"))
+	q.add_child(UI.spacer())
+	q.add_child(UI.label("≈ %d dr" % (qty * buy), 16, UI.GOLD))
+	v.add_child(q)
+	var acts := HBoxContainer.new()
+	acts.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	var bb := EditorIcons.action(UI.button("", _buy, 16), "buy", "Buy %d" % mini(qty, max_buy) if max_buy > 0 else "Buy",
+		EditorIcons.tip("Buy %s" % Items.display_name(c), "Enter", "Buys up to %d at about %d dr each (fewer if the stock, your drachmas or your hold run out).\nEvery unit you buy raises the price here; it recovers over a few minutes." % [qty, buy]))
+	bb.disabled = max_buy < 1
+	bb.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	acts.add_child(bb)
+	var sb := EditorIcons.action(UI.button("", _sell, 16), "sell", "Sell %d" % mini(qty, have) if have > 0 else "Sell",
+		EditorIcons.tip("Sell %s" % Items.display_name(c), "Backspace", "Sells up to %d of the %d you carry at about %d dr each.\nEvery unit you sell lowers the price here - spread a big load over several stations." % [qty, have, sell]))
+	sb.disabled = have < 1
+	sb.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	acts.add_child(sb)
+	v.add_child(acts)
+
+	# Where it sells best (trade routes for this good from here).
+	v.add_child(UI.section("BEST PRICES WITHIN 2 JUMPS"))
+	var sys: String = Galaxy.stations[sid]["system"]
+	var any := false
+	for s in TradeRoutes.best_sellers(c, sys, 2, sid, 4):
+		any = true
+		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+		var where := "%s  ·  %s" % [TradeRoutes.station_name(s["to"]), "this system" if s["jumps"] == 0 else "%s, %d jump%s" % [TradeRoutes.system_name(s["to_sys"]), s["jumps"], "" if s["jumps"] == 1 else "s"]]
+		var wl := UI.label(where, 14, Color.WHITE)
+		wl.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		wl.clip_text = true
+		row.add_child(wl)
+		var profit: int = s["sell"] - buy
+		row.add_child(UI.label("%d dr" % s["sell"], 14, UI.GOLD))
+		row.add_child(UI.label(("%+d" % profit) if stock >= 1 else "", 14, GREEN if profit > 0 else RED))
+		if s["to_sys"] != sys:
+			var plot := EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", _plot.bind(s["to_sys"]), 12), "next",
+				EditorIcons.tip("Plot route to %s" % TradeRoutes.system_name(s["to_sys"]), "", "Sets your route through the jump gates; the HUD points the way once you undock."))
+			plot.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+			row.add_child(plot)
+		v.add_child(row)
+	if not any:
+		v.add_child(UI.label("No other market within reach.", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	var tip := UI.label("Buy where it's made, sell where it's used. The galaxy map's trade layer (G) shows the best runs.", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	tip.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	v.add_child(tip)
+	return p
+
+
+func _small(text: String, f: Callable, tip: String) -> Button:
+	var b := UI.button(text, f, 16)
+	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(40, 34) * _k
+	b.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	b.tooltip_text = tip
+	return b
+
+
+# --- Actions ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _select(c: String) -> void:
+	if c == selected:
+		return
+	selected = c
+	menu.refresh()
+
+
+func _set_qty(n: int) -> void:
+	qty = clampi(n, 1, 999)
+	menu.refresh()
+
+
+func _buy() -> void:
+	var got := Galaxy.player_buy(sid, selected, qty, data)
+	TradeRoutes.invalidate()
+	if got > 0:
+		GameLog.post("Bought %d %s" % [got, Items.display_name(selected)], "info")
+	elif data.room_for(selected) < 1:
+		GameLog.post("Cargo hold full (%d slots)" % Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data), "danger")
+	menu.refresh()
+
+
+func _sell() -> void:
+	var n := mini(qty, data.count(selected))
+	var earned := Galaxy.player_sell(sid, selected, n, data)
+	TradeRoutes.invalidate()
+	if earned > 0:
+		GameLog.post("Sold %d %s for %d dr" % [n, Items.display_name(selected), earned], "loot")
+	menu.refresh()
+
+
+func _plot(sys_id: String) -> void:
+	Galaxy.route = Galaxy.find_route(Galaxy.current_system, sys_id)
+	GameLog.post("Route plotted to %s: %d jump%s." % [TradeRoutes.system_name(sys_id), Galaxy.route.size() - 1, "" if Galaxy.route.size() == 2 else "s"], "mission")
+
+
+## Keys (the station menu passes them on while this page shows): W/S or the
+## arrows move the selection, A/D the quantity, Enter buys, Backspace sells.
+## Returns true when it used the event.
+func handle_key(ev: InputEvent) -> bool:
+	if Keybinds.pressed_repeat(ev, "menu_up"):
+		_step(-1)
+	elif Keybinds.pressed_repeat(ev, "menu_down"):
+		_step(1)
+	elif Keybinds.pressed_loose(ev, "menu_left"):
+		_set_qty(qty - (10 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) else 1))
+	elif Keybinds.pressed_loose(ev, "menu_right"):
+		_set_qty(qty + (10 if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) else 1))
+	elif Keybinds.pressed(ev, "menu_accept"):
+		_buy()
+	elif Keybinds.pressed(ev, "menu_secondary"):
+		_sell()
+	else:
+		return false
+	return true
+
+
+func _step(d: int) -> void:
+	var order := _goods()
+	if order.is_empty():
+		return
+	var i := order.find(selected)
+	selected = order[wrapi(i + d, 0, order.size())]
+	menu.refresh()

The wheel zooms in round you (or the middle of the view), dragging pans, the middle button puts it back.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,232 @@ 
+class_name PlanetMapPage
+extends VBoxContainer
+## Ship Computer tab, on a planet (on foot, or landed): the planet's map - the
+## whole world in latitude and longitude (the HUD's: north up, east right),
+## drawn from its real ground (PlanetShape, on a worker the first time, kept):
+## seas and shallows, the land shaded by its height and its relief, ice,
+## lava - and on it its towns (named), the pirate camps, your ship and you
+## (your heading). The wheel zooms in round you (or the middle of the view),
+## dragging pans, the middle button puts it back.
+
+const W := 512
+const H := 256
+
+var data: Node
+var ship: Node2D
+var world: Node                  # (the 3D game - Cosmos)
+
+static var _maps := {}           # planet name -> ImageTexture
+static var _tasks := {}          # planet name -> [task id, Image]
+
+var _view: Control
+var _info: Label
+var _zoom := 1.0
+var _pan := Vector2.ZERO          # (the view's middle: map 0..1)
+var _drag := false
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_info = Label.new()
+	_info.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	add_child(_info)
+	_view = Control.new()
+	_view.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(900, 470)
+	_view.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_view.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_view.clip_contents = true
+	_view.draw.connect(_draw_map)
+	_view.gui_input.connect(_input_map)
+	add_child(_view)
+
+
+func cosmos() -> Node:
+	var c := world if world else get_tree().current_scene
+	return c if c and c.has_method("planet_below") else null
+
+
+## The planet you're on (on foot, landed, or low over it), or null.
+func planet() -> CosmosPlanet:
+	var c := cosmos()
+	if c == null:
+		return null
+	if c.walker and c.walker.planet:
+		return c.walker.planet
+	return c.planet_below(c.ship.global_position, 3000.0) if c.ship else null
+
+
+func refresh() -> void:
+	var pl := planet()
+	if pl == null:
+		_info.text = "No planet under you"
+		_view.queue_redraw()
+		return
+	_info.text = "%s  -  %s   (wheel: zoom, drag: pan, middle button: the whole world)" % [str(pl.rec.get("name", "")), Planets.TYPES.get(str(pl.rec.get("type", "")), {}).get("label", str(pl.rec.get("type", "")))]
+	_ensure(pl)
+	_view.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
+	if visible:
+		var pl := planet()
+		if pl and not _maps.has(pl.name) and _tasks.has(pl.name) and WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_tasks[pl.name][0]):
+			WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_tasks[pl.name][0])
+			_maps[pl.name] = ImageTexture.create_from_image(_tasks[pl.name][1])
+			_tasks.erase(pl.name)
+		if UI.redraw_due(self):
+			_view.queue_redraw()
+
+
+## The planet's picture: made on a worker the first time.
+func _ensure(pl: CosmosPlanet) -> void:
+	if _maps.has(pl.name) or _tasks.has(pl.name):
+		return
+	var img := Image.create(W, H, false, Image.FORMAT_RGB8)
+	var shape := pl.shape
+	var id := WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): _paint(img, shape), false, "planet map")
+	_tasks[pl.name] = [id, img]
+
+
+static func _paint(img: Image, shape: PlanetShape) -> void:
+	var L := shape.look
+	var lo: Color = L.get("land_low", Color(0.3, 0.45, 0.2))
+	var mid: Color = L.get("land_mid", Color(0.45, 0.42, 0.3))
+	var hi: Color = L.get("land_high", Color(0.5, 0.48, 0.45))
+	var peak: Color = L.get("land_peak", Color(0.9, 0.9, 0.92))
+	var shallow: Color = L.get("water_shallow", Color(0.15, 0.45, 0.6))
+	var deep: Color = L.get("water_deep", Color(0.03, 0.12, 0.3))
+	var heights := PackedFloat32Array()
+	heights.resize(W * H)
+	for y in H:
+		var lat := deg_to_rad(90.0 - (y + 0.5) * 180.0 / H)
+		for x in W:
+			var lon := deg_to_rad((x + 0.5) * 360.0 / W - 180.0)
+			var d := Vector3(cos(lat) * sin(lon), sin(lat), cos(lat) * cos(lon))
+			heights[y * W + x] = shape.height(d)
+	for y in H:
+		for x in W:
+			var h := heights[y * W + x]
+			var c: Color
+			if shape.sea == 1 and h < 0.0:
+				c = shallow.lerp(deep, clampf(-h / (shape.amp * 0.4), 0.0, 1.0))
+			elif shape.sea == 3 and h < 0.0:
+				c = Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.05).lerp(Color(0.5, 0.08, 0.02), clampf(-h / (shape.amp * 0.3), 0.0, 1.0))
+			else:
+				var k := clampf(h / (shape.amp * 1.6), 0.0, 1.0)
+				c = lo.lerp(mid, smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, k)).lerp(hi, smoothstep(0.3, 0.7, k)).lerp(peak, smoothstep(0.7, 1.0, k))
+				if shape.sea == 2 and h < shape.amp * 0.05:
+					c = c.lerp(Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.0), 0.7)
+				# (relief: lit from the north-west)
+				var e := heights[y * W + mini(x + 1, W - 1)] - heights[mini(y + 1, H - 1) * W + x]
+				c = c * clampf(1.0 - e / (shape.amp * 0.08), 0.6, 1.35)
+			img.set_pixel(x, y, c)
+
+
+## Planet-local direction -> map position (0..1).
+static func uv(d: Vector3) -> Vector2:
+	var lat := rad_to_deg(asin(clampf(d.y, -1.0, 1.0)))
+	var lon := rad_to_deg(atan2(d.x, d.z))
+	return Vector2((lon + 180.0) / 360.0, (90.0 - lat) / 180.0)
+
+
+func _rect() -> Rect2:
+	var vs := _view.size
+	var sz := Vector2(vs.x, vs.x * 0.5) * _zoom
+	if sz.y < vs.y and _zoom <= 1.0:
+		sz = Vector2(vs.y * 2.0, vs.y)
+	return Rect2(vs * 0.5 - _pan * sz, sz)
+
+
+func _to_screen(m: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	var r := _rect()
+	return r.position + m * r.size
+
+
+func _draw_map() -> void:
+	var v := _view
+	v.draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, v.size), NeonTheme.BG)
+	var pl := planet()
+	if pl == null:
+		return
+	if _pan == Vector2.ZERO:
+		_pan = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
+	var r := _rect()
+	var tex: Texture2D = _maps.get(pl.name)
+	if tex:
+		for k in [-1, 0, 1]:   # (round the world: east wraps to west)
+			v.draw_texture_rect(tex, Rect2(r.position + Vector2(r.size.x * k, 0), r.size), false)
+	else:
+		v.draw_string(ThemeDB.fallback_font, v.size * 0.5 - Vector2(80, 0), "Charting the world...", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 18, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	# The grid: every 30 degrees.
+	for i in range(1, 12):
+		var x := r.position.x + r.size.x * i / 12.0
+		v.draw_line(Vector2(x, r.position.y), Vector2(x, r.end.y), Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.12))
+	for i in range(1, 6):
+		var y := r.position.y + r.size.y * i / 6.0
+		v.draw_line(Vector2(r.position.x, y), Vector2(r.end.x, y), Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.12 if i != 3 else 0.3))
+	var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
+	var c := cosmos()
+	# The towns.
+	for s in pl.towns:
+		var p := _to_screen(uv(s["dir"]))
+		var city: bool = str(s["kind"]) == "city"
+		var rr := 7.0 if city else 5.0
+		v.draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(rr, rr), Vector2(rr, rr) * 2.0), Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.9), false, 2.0)
+		if city:
+			v.draw_line(p + Vector2(-rr, -rr - 4), p + Vector2(rr, -rr - 4), NeonTheme.HEAD, 2.0)
+		v.draw_string(font, p + Vector2(rr + 4, 5), ("Palace of %s" if city else "%s") % s["name"], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 15, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	# The pirate camps.
+	if c:
+		for camp in c.camps_of(pl):
+			var p := _to_screen(uv((camp[0] as Vector3).normalized()))
+			v.draw_line(p + Vector2(-5, -5), p + Vector2(5, 5), Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.3), 2.0)
+			v.draw_line(p + Vector2(-5, 5), p + Vector2(5, -5), Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.3), 2.0)
+	# Your ship, and you.
+	if c and c.ship:
+		var sp := _to_screen(uv((c.ship.global_position - pl.global_position).normalized()))
+		v.draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([sp + Vector2(0, -9), sp + Vector2(7, 7), sp + Vector2(-7, 7)]), NeonTheme.INFO)
+		v.draw_string(font, sp + Vector2(10, 5), "Your ship", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 15, NeonTheme.INFO)
+	if c and c.walker and c.walker.planet == pl:
+		var wl: Vector3 = c.walker.global_position - pl.global_position
+		var u := wl.normalized()
+		var wp := _to_screen(uv(u))
+		var east := Vector3.UP.cross(u).normalized()
+		var north := u.cross(east)
+		var f: Vector3 = c.walker.facing
+		var ang := atan2(f.dot(east), f.dot(north))
+		var dir := Vector2(sin(ang), -cos(ang))
+		v.draw_circle(wp, 6.0, Color.WHITE)
+		v.draw_line(wp, wp + dir * 16.0, Color.WHITE, 2.0)
+
+
+func _input_map(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed:
+		match ev.button_index:
+			MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
+				_zoom_at(1.25)
+			MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
+				_zoom_at(0.8)
+			MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE:
+				_zoom = 1.0
+				_pan = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
+		_drag = ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
+		_view.queue_redraw()
+	elif ev is InputEventMouseButton and not ev.pressed:
+		_drag = false
+	elif ev is InputEventMouseMotion and _drag:
+		_pan -= ev.relative / _rect().size
+		_pan.y = clampf(_pan.y, 0.0, 1.0)
+		_view.queue_redraw()
+
+
+## Zooming centres on you the first time in (else the view's middle stays).
+func _zoom_at(k: float) -> void:
+	var c := cosmos()
+	var pl := planet()
+	if _zoom <= 1.0 and k > 1.0 and c and pl:
+		var who: Node3D = c.walker if c.walker else c.ship
+		_pan = uv((who.global_position - pl.global_position).normalized())
+	_zoom = clampf(_zoom * k, 1.0, 16.0)
+	if _zoom <= 1.0:
+		_pan = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)

+	_title.text = quest.chapter_title()

+		if s["chapter"] != last_chapter:

+			lines.append("\n[color=#ffd166][b]%s[/b][/color]" % QuestData.CHAPTERS[last_chapter])
+		for line in s.get("dialogue", []):
+			lines.append("[color=#ffd166]%s:[/color] %s" % [line[0], line[1]])
+	_journal.text = "\n".join(lines).strip_edges()

+	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)

+	sub.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

+		bar[bar.find("")] = item

+## 1-9 over a skill you know: it goes on that toolbar slot.
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not is_visible_in_tree() or _hovered == "" or not (event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo):

+	if event.keycode < KEY_1 or event.keycode > KEY_9 or Skills.rank(surface.state["player"], Skills.id_of(_hovered)) <= 0:

+	if was >= 0:
+		bar[was] = ""
+	bar[i] = _hovered
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+	refresh()

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: Small immediate-mode painting helpers for things drawn live on screen (comms portraits of the other empires): filled polygons and ellipses with a flat colour or a linear / radial gradient, outlines and soft lights. Gradients are evaluated per vertex (polygons are tessellated finely enough). (Moved from scripts/paint.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,92 @@ 
+class_name Paint
+## Small immediate-mode painting helpers for things drawn live on screen
+## (comms portraits of the other empires): filled polygons and ellipses with
+## a flat colour or a linear / radial gradient, outlines and soft lights.
+## Gradients are evaluated per vertex (polygons are tessellated finely enough).
+
+
+## Linear gradient from a to b. stops: [[t, Color], ...]
+static func linear(a: Vector2, b: Vector2, stops: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"type": "linear", "a": a, "b": b, "stops": stops}
+
+
+## Radial gradient around c of radius r; ratio < 1 squashes it vertically.
+static func radial(c: Vector2, r: float, stops: Array, ratio := 1.0) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"type": "radial", "c": c, "r": r, "stops": stops, "ratio": ratio}
+
+
+static func _stop_color(stops: Array, t: float) -> Color:
+	t = clampf(t, 0.0, 1.0)
+	var prev: Array = stops[0]
+	if t <= float(prev[0]):
+		return prev[1]
+	for s in stops:
+		if t <= float(s[0]):
+			var span := float(s[0]) - float(prev[0])
+			return (prev[1] as Color).lerp(s[1], (t - float(prev[0])) / span if span > 0.0 else 1.0)
+		prev = s
+	return prev[1]
+
+
+static func color_at(fill: Variant, p: Vector2) -> Color:
+	if fill is Color:
+		return fill
+	var f: Dictionary = fill
+	if f["type"] == "linear":
+		var d: Vector2 = f["b"] - f["a"]
+		var t: float = (p - f["a"]).dot(d) / maxf(d.length_squared(), 0.0001)
+		return _stop_color(f["stops"], t)
+	var q: Vector2 = p - f["c"]
+	q.y /= maxf(float(f["ratio"]), 0.01)
+	return _stop_color(f["stops"], q.length() / maxf(float(f["r"]), 0.0001))
+
+
+## Subdivides a polygon's edges so gradients shade smoothly.
+static func _fine(pts: PackedVector2Array, step := 10.0) -> PackedVector2Array:
+	var out := PackedVector2Array()
+	for i in pts.size():
+		var a := pts[i]
+		var b := pts[(i + 1) % pts.size()]
+		var n := maxi(1, int(a.distance_to(b) / step))
+		for k in n:
+			out.append(a.lerp(b, float(k) / n))
+	return out
+
+
+static func gpoly(ci: CanvasItem, pts: PackedVector2Array, fill: Variant, stroke := Color(0, 0, 0, 0), width := 0.0, _name := "") -> void:
+	if pts.size() < 3:
+		return
+	if fill is Color:
+		if (fill as Color).a > 0.0 and not Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon(pts).is_empty():
+			ci.draw_colored_polygon(pts, fill)
+	else:
+		# Fan from the centroid with per-vertex colours.
+		var fine := _fine(pts)
+		var c := Vector2.ZERO
+		for p in pts:
+			c += p
+		c /= pts.size()
+		var cc := color_at(fill, c)
+		for i in fine.size():
+			var a := fine[i]
+			var b := fine[(i + 1) % fine.size()]
+			ci.draw_polygon(PackedVector2Array([c, a, b]), PackedColorArray([cc, color_at(fill, a), color_at(fill, b)]))
+	if width > 0.0 and stroke.a > 0.0:
+		var line := pts.duplicate()
+		line.append(pts[0])
+		ci.draw_polyline(line, stroke, width, true)
+
+
+static func gellipse(ci: CanvasItem, c: Vector2, rx: float, ry: float, fill: Variant, stroke := Color(0, 0, 0, 0), width := 0.0, _name := "") -> void:
+	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+	var n := clampi(int((rx + ry) * 0.5), 16, 64)
+	for i in n:
+		var a := TAU * i / n
+		pts.append(c + Vector2(cos(a) * rx, sin(a) * ry))
+	gpoly(ci, pts, fill, stroke, width)
+
+
+## A soft light: a radial disc with a white-hot centre.
+static func glow(ci: CanvasItem, p: Vector2, col: Color, r: float) -> void:
+	gellipse(ci, p, r * 2.8, r * 2.8, radial(p, r * 2.8, [[0.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95)], [0.14, Color(col.lightened(0.4), 1.0)],
+		[0.34, Color(col, 0.75)], [0.6, Color(col, 0.2)], [1.0, Color(col, 0.0)]]))

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The editor screens' tooltips. It takes over every tooltip under it (a control's tooltip_text, or a "tip_fn" meta Callable(local_pos) -> String for per-item tips), so Godot's own tooltip never shows, and draws its own: - after HOVER seconds over a control: its tooltip (title, shortcut, description) with a bar filling toward pinning; - after PIN more seconds: the tooltip pins - it stays (and can be clicked) until its ✕ is pressed, it's right-clicked, you click outside it, or another tooltip opens; - every tooltip links to the editor documentation (EditorDocs): the section its title is about and the screen's own section. Tooltip text format: "Title [keys]\nDescription..." (EditorIcons.tip). (Moved from scripts/pin_tips.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,412 @@ 
+class_name PinTips
+extends CanvasLayer
+## The editor screens' tooltips. It takes over every tooltip under it (a
+## control's tooltip_text, or a "tip_fn" meta Callable(local_pos) -> String
+## for per-item tips), so Godot's own tooltip never shows, and draws its own:
+##   - after HOVER seconds over a control: its tooltip (title, shortcut,
+##     description) with a bar filling toward pinning;
+##   - after PIN more seconds: the tooltip pins - it stays (and can be
+##     clicked) until its ✕ is pressed, it's right-clicked, you click
+##     outside it, or another tooltip opens;
+##   - every tooltip links to the editor documentation (EditorDocs): the
+##     section its title is about and the screen's own section.
+## Tooltip text format: "Title      [keys]\nDescription..." (EditorIcons.tip).
+
+const HOVER := 0.45
+const PIN := 12.0                   # seconds of hovering (after it shows) until it pins
+const WIDTH := 460.0
+
+## The documentation section for this screen (always linked), and its book.
+var screen_doc := "overview"
+var book := EditorDocs.FILE
+var _text := ""                     # the tooltip under the mouse
+var _t := 0.0
+var _panel: PanelContainer
+var _bar: ColorRect
+var _pinned_text := ""             # don't re-show the one just pinned until the mouse leaves
+var _src: Control                   # the control the tooltip belongs to
+var _used: Control                  # just clicked: no tooltip for it until the mouse leaves it
+
+
+## book: EditorDocs.FILE (editor screens) or EditorDocs.GAME (the game). The
+## editor's take precedence while they're shown (the level editor inside a planet).
+static func install(owner: Node, doc: String, book_file := EditorDocs.FILE) -> PinTips:
+	var p := PinTips.new()
+	p.screen_doc = doc
+	p.book = book_file
+	if book_file == EditorDocs.FILE:
+		p.add_to_group("pin_tips_editor")
+	owner.add_child(p)
+	return p
+
+
+## In the game: F1 opens the guide at the page this returns (paused or not).
+var f1_page := Callable()
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	layer = 110
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+
+
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	# Typing hides the tooltip that's waiting or showing (pinned ones stay).
+	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not (event as InputEventKey).keycode == KEY_F1:
+		var f := get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()
+		if f is LineEdit or f is TextEdit:
+			_hide()
+			_t = 0.0
+	# Pinned tooltips close on a right-click (anywhere), or a click outside them.
+	var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+	if mb and mb.pressed and mb.button_index in [MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT, MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT]:
+		# Using a control: its tooltip goes away until the mouse leaves it.
+		_hide()
+		_t = 0.0
+		if _src != null and is_instance_valid(_src) and _src.get_global_rect().has_point(mb.position):
+			_used = _src
+	if mb and mb.pressed and mb.button_index in [MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT, MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT, MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE]:
+		var on_tip := false
+		for n in get_children():
+			if not n.is_in_group("pin_tip") or n == _panel or n.is_queued_for_deletion():
+				continue
+			var inside: bool = (n as Control).get_global_rect().has_point(mb.position)
+			if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT or not inside:
+				n.queue_free()
+				_pinned_text = ""
+			if inside:
+				on_tip = true
+		if on_tip and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()   # (that right-click was for the tooltip)
+		return
+	var k := event as InputEventKey
+	if f1_page.is_valid() and k and k.pressed and not k.echo and k.keycode == KEY_F1:
+		var page: String = f1_page.call()
+		if page != "":
+			EditorDocs.open(self, page, book)
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+## The tooltip of the control under the mouse (taking it over from Godot).
+## True while you're busy with the GUI: a drop-down list or menu is open,
+## or a mouse button is held (dragging a slider, scrolling, drawing...).
+func _busy() -> bool:
+	for w in get_viewport().get_embedded_subwindows():
+		if w.visible and w is Popup:
+			return true
+	return Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) or Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT) \
+		or Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE)
+
+
+func _hovered_tip() -> String:
+	var vp := get_viewport()
+	if _busy():
+		return ""
+	var c := vp.gui_get_hovered_control()
+	# Typing into a field: no tooltip for it (nor for the spin box around it).
+	var focus := vp.gui_get_focus_owner()
+	if focus is LineEdit or focus is TextEdit:
+		var n: Node = c
+		while n != null:
+			if n == focus or n == focus.get_parent() and n is SpinBox:
+				return ""
+			n = n.get_parent()
+	while c != null:
+		if _is_ours(c):
+			return ""
+		if c.has_meta("tip_fn"):
+			var t: String = (c.get_meta("tip_fn") as Callable).call(c.get_local_mouse_position())
+			if t != "":
+				_src = c
+				return t
+		if c.tooltip_text != "":
+			c.set_meta("tip", c.tooltip_text)
+			c.tooltip_text = ""   # (Godot's tooltip would show it too)
+		if c.has_meta("tip") and str(c.get_meta("tip")) != "":
+			_src = c
+			return str(c.get_meta("tip"))
+		c = c.get_parent() as Control
+	return ""
+
+
+func _is_ours(c: Control) -> bool:
+	var n: Node = c
+	while n != null:
+		if n == self or n.is_in_group("pin_tip") or n.is_in_group("archive_window"):
+			return true
+		n = n.get_parent()
+	return false
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	var host := get_parent() as CanvasItem
+	var yield_to_editor := false
+	if book != EditorDocs.FILE:
+		for o in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("pin_tips_editor"):
+			var oh := o.get_parent() as CanvasItem
+			if oh and oh.is_visible_in_tree():
+				yield_to_editor = true
+	if host and not host.is_visible_in_tree() or yield_to_editor:
+		_text = ""
+		_hide()
+		return
+	# Pinned tooltips close with the screen their control was on.
+	for n in get_children():
+		if n.is_in_group("pin_tip") and n != _panel and n.has_meta("src"):
+			var sc: Variant = n.get_meta("src")
+			if not is_instance_valid(sc) or not (sc as Control).is_visible_in_tree():
+				n.queue_free()
+	var tip := _hovered_tip()
+	if _used != null and (not is_instance_valid(_used) or _src != _used or tip == ""):
+		if not _busy():
+			_used = null    # the mouse left the control you used
+	if _used != null and is_instance_valid(_used) and _src == _used:
+		tip = ""
+	if tip != _text:
+		_text = tip
+		_t = 0.0
+		_hide()
+		if tip != _pinned_text:
+			_pinned_text = ""
+	if _text == "" or _text == _pinned_text:
+		return
+	_t += delta
+	if _t >= HOVER and _panel == null:
+		_close_pinned()   # a new tooltip replaces the one pinned before
+		_panel = _make(_text, false)
+		_place(_panel)
+	if _panel:
+		var k := clampf((_t - HOVER) / PIN, 0.0, 1.0)
+		_bar.size.x = (_panel.size.x - 20.0) * k
+		if k >= 1.0:
+			_pin(_panel)
+			_pinned_text = _text
+			_panel = null
+
+
+## Closes every pinned tooltip.
+func _close_pinned() -> void:
+	for n in get_children():
+		if n != _panel and n.is_in_group("pin_tip"):
+			n.queue_free()
+
+
+func _hide() -> void:
+	if _panel:
+		_panel.queue_free()
+		_panel = null
+
+
+## Shrinks a panel to its content once its text has wrapped (rich text
+## measures its height only after it knows its width).
+func _fit(p: Control) -> void:
+	for i in 2:
+		await get_tree().process_frame
+		if not is_instance_valid(p):
+			return
+		p.reset_size()
+
+
+## Shows a pinned tooltip once it has shrunk to its content.
+func _reveal(p: Control) -> void:
+	await _fit(p)
+	if is_instance_valid(p):
+		p.modulate.a = 1.0
+
+
+func _place(p: Control) -> void:
+	await _fit(p)
+	if not is_instance_valid(p):
+		return
+	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
+	var m := get_viewport().get_mouse_position() + Vector2(18, 22)
+	if m.x + p.size.x > vp.x - 8:
+		m.x = vp.x - 8 - p.size.x
+	if m.y + p.size.y > vp.y - 8:
+		m.y = get_viewport().get_mouse_position().y - p.size.y - 12
+	p.position = m.max(Vector2(8, 8))
+	p.modulate.a = 1.0
+
+
+## Parses "Title      [keys]\nbody" -> [title, keys, body].
+static func parse(tip: String) -> Array:
+	var lines := tip.split("\n", true, 1)
+	var head := lines[0]
+	var keys := ""
+	var i := head.find("      [")
+	if i >= 0 and head.ends_with("]"):
+		keys = head.substr(i + 7, head.length() - i - 8)
+		head = head.substr(0, i)
+	return [head.strip_edges(), keys, lines[1] if lines.size() > 1 else ""]
+
+
+func _make(tip: String, pinned: bool) -> PanelContainer:
+	var parts := parse(tip)
+	var p := PanelContainer.new()
+	p.add_to_group("pin_tip")
+	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	sb.bg_color = Color(NeonTheme.BG, 0.97)
+	sb.border_color = Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.85) if not pinned else Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.3, 0.95)
+	sb.set_border_width_all(2 if pinned else 1)
+	sb.set_corner_radius_all(6)
+	sb.set_content_margin_all(10)
+	sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
+	sb.shadow_size = 8
+	p.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
+	p.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(WIDTH, 0)
+	p.modulate.a = 0.0   # shown once it's laid out and in place (see _place, _pin)
+	p.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE if not pinned else Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	v.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	p.add_child(v)
+	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
+	head.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	v.add_child(head)
+	var t := Label.new()
+	t.text = parts[0]
+	t.add_theme_font_override("font", NeonTheme.heavy_font())
+	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
+	t.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	t.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	t.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	head.add_child(t)
+	if parts[1] != "":
+		var k := Label.new()
+		k.text = " " + parts[1] + " "
+		k.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
+		k.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.08, 0.06, 0.02))
+		var ks := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+		ks.bg_color = Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.4)
+		ks.set_corner_radius_all(4)
+		ks.set_content_margin_all(2)
+		k.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", ks)
+		k.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+		head.add_child(k)
+	if pinned:
+		var x := CloseX.new()
+		x.pressed.connect(p.queue_free)
+		head.add_child(x)
+	var body := RichTextLabel.new()
+	body.bbcode_enabled = true
+	body.fit_content = true
+	body.scroll_active = false
+	body.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	body.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(WIDTH - 20, 0)
+	body.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 14)
+	body.add_theme_color_override("default_color", NeonTheme.TEXT)
+	body.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE if not pinned else Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	body.text = str(parts[2]).replace("[", "[lb]")
+	v.add_child(body)
+	# Links to the documentation: the topic, and this screen's section.
+	EditorDocs.use(book)
+	var links := []
+	var topic := EditorDocs.topic(parts[0])
+	for id in [topic, screen_doc, "tooltips" if book == EditorDocs.FILE else "guide-tooltips"]:
+		if id != "" and EditorDocs.has(id) and not id in links:
+			links.append(id)
+	var docs := RichTextLabel.new()
+	docs.bbcode_enabled = true
+	docs.fit_content = true
+	docs.scroll_active = false
+	docs.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	docs.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(WIDTH - 20, 0)
+	docs.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 13)
+	docs.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE if not pinned else Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	var parts_l := links.map(func(id): return "[url=doc:%s]%s[/url]" % [id, EditorDocs.title(id)])
+	docs.text = "[color=#8fa3b8]Documentation:[/color]  [color=#7fd6ff]%s[/color]" % "   ·   ".join(parts_l)
+	if not pinned:
+		docs.text += "\n[color=#6f7f90][i]Keep hovering to pin this tooltip and click its links.[/i][/color]"
+	var bk := book
+	docs.meta_clicked.connect(func(m): if str(m).begins_with("doc:"): EditorDocs.open(self, str(m).substr(4), bk))
+	v.add_child(docs)
+	if not pinned:
+		var track := Control.new()
+		track.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 3)
+		track.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		_bar = ColorRect.new()
+		_bar.color = Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.3)
+		_bar.size = Vector2(0, 3)
+		_bar.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		track.add_child(_bar)
+		v.add_child(track)
+	add_child(p)
+	return p
+
+
+## Turns the hovering tooltip into a pinned one (same place).
+func _pin(p: PanelContainer) -> void:
+	var at := p.position
+	var tip := _text
+	p.queue_free()
+	var q := _make(tip, true)
+	q.position = at
+	q.set_meta("src", _src)
+	_reveal(q)
+	# Pinned tooltips can be dragged by their title.
+	q.gui_input.connect(func(e):
+		if e is InputEventMouseMotion and e.button_mask & MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT:
+			q.position += e.relative)
+
+
+## The pinned tooltip's close button: a red ✕ that slowly blinks, with an
+## orange glow circling around it. Brighter when hovered.
+class CloseX extends Control:
+	signal pressed
+	const BLINK := 1.6               # seconds per blink
+	const ORBIT := 2.4               # seconds per turn of the glow
+	var _t := 0.0
+	var _hover := false
+	var _box: StyleBoxFlat
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		custom_minimum_size = Vector2(34, 34)
+		# A bluish button face, like the rest of the GUI.
+		_box = StyleBoxFlat.new()
+		_box.bg_color = NeonTheme.BG_LIGHT
+		_box.border_color = Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 0.75)
+		_box.set_border_width_all(1)
+		_box.set_corner_radius_all(6)
+		_box.shadow_color = Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.25)
+		_box.shadow_size = 3
+		size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		mouse_default_cursor_shape = CURSOR_POINTING_HAND
+		mouse_entered.connect(func(): _hover = true)
+		mouse_exited.connect(func(): _hover = false)
+
+	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+		_t += delta
+		queue_redraw()
+
+	func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+		if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and not event.pressed:
+			pressed.emit()
+			accept_event()
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		var c := size / 2.0
+		var blink := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * TAU / BLINK)      # 0..1, slow
+		_box.bg_color = NeonTheme.BG_LIGHT if _hover else NeonTheme.BG_LIGHT
+		_box.border_color = Color(NeonTheme.HEAD, 1.0 if _hover else 0.75)
+		draw_style_box(_box, Rect2(Vector2(1, 1), size - Vector2(2, 2)))
+		var r := 11.0
+		# Soft red halo that breathes with the blink.
+		for i in 4:
+			draw_circle(c, r + 2.0 - i * 2.5, Color(1.0, 0.15, 0.1, 0.05 + 0.05 * blink))
+		# The orange glow orbiting: a bright head with a fading tail.
+		var a0 := _t * TAU / ORBIT
+		var n := 14
+		for i in n:
+			var k := float(i) / n
+			var a := a0 - k * 2.2
+			var col := Color(1.0, 0.55 + 0.25 * (1.0 - k), 0.15, (1.0 - k) * 0.85)
+			draw_circle(c + Vector2.from_angle(a) * r, 2.6 * (1.0 - k * 0.7), col)
+		draw_circle(c + Vector2.from_angle(a0) * r, 4.5, Color(1.0, 0.7, 0.3, 0.35))
+		# The ✕, blinking between deep and bright red.
+		var x := lerpf(0.45, 1.0, blink) if not _hover else 1.0
+		var red := Color(1.0, 0.18, 0.12).lerp(Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.4), 0.0 if not _hover else 0.5) * Color(x, x, x, 1.0)
+		red.a = lerpf(0.55, 1.0, blink) if not _hover else 1.0
+		var d := 5.5
+		for w in [[5.0, Color(red, red.a * 0.35)], [2.6, red]]:
+			draw_line(c + Vector2(-d, -d), c + Vector2(d, d), w[1], w[0], true)
+			draw_line(c + Vector2(d, -d), c + Vector2(-d, d), w[1], w[0], true)
