+			draw_polyline(closed, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 3.5 if pid != bay.pid else 5.0, true)
+			draw_polyline(closed, Color(col, 0.85) if pid != bay.pid else Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.45), 1.5 if pid != bay.pid else 2.5, true)
+			var fs: Array = Parts.part(c, bay.which, pid)["faults"]
+			if fs.any(func(f): return not f.get("found", false)):
+				var ctr := Vector2.ZERO
+				for p in poly:
+					ctr += p
+				ctr /= poly.size()
+				draw_string(font, ctr + Vector2(-5, 6), "?", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 18, Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.35))
+		draw_string(font, Vector2(8, size.y - 8), "click a part to put it on the table", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 13, Color(0.6, 0.75, 0.9, 0.7))
+
+	## The ship's own picture (nose up), behind its parts.
+	func _picture() -> Texture2D:
+		if bay.which != "ship" or bay.ship == null or bay.ship.get("sprite") == null:
+			return null
+		return (bay.ship.sprite as Sprite2D).texture
+
+	func _area(pid: String) -> float:
+		var poly := _shape(pid)
+		var r := Rect2(poly[0], Vector2.ZERO)
+		for p in poly:
+			r = r.expand(p)
+		return r.get_area()
+
+
+class Vitals extends Control:
+	var bay: RepairBay
+	var _trace := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var _t := 0.0
+	var _beat := 0.0
+
+	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+		if not is_visible_in_tree() or bay == null or bay.pid == "":
+			return
+		var o := bay.op()
+		var heat := float(o["heat"])
+		_t += delta
+		var rate := 1.0 + heat / 45.0 + float(o["shock"]) * 2.0
+		_beat = fmod(_beat + delta * rate, 1.0)
+		var v := 0.0
+		if _beat < 0.06:
+			v = -1.0
+		elif _beat < 0.1:
+			v = 0.7
+		elif _beat < 0.16:
+			v = -0.2
+		v += (randf() - 0.5) * (0.06 + float(o["shock"]) * 0.8)
+		if not bay.powered() and bay.which != "automaton":
+			v = (randf() - 0.5) * 0.03
+		_trace.append(v)
+		if _trace.size() > 160:
+			_trace = _trace.slice(_trace.size() - 160)
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		if bay == null or bay.pid == "":
+			return
+		var o := bay.op()
+		draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(0.02, 0.04, 0.03))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(0.3, 0.9, 0.5, 0.4), false, 1.0)
+		var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
+		var heat := float(o["heat"])
+		var tr := Rect2(8, 8, size.x - 112, 62)
+		var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+		for i in _trace.size():
+			pts.append(Vector2(tr.position.x + tr.size.x * i / 159.0, tr.get_center().y + _trace[i] * tr.size.y * 0.45))
+		var col := Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.55).lerp(Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.25), clampf(heat / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0))
+		if pts.size() > 1:
+			draw_polyline(pts, col, 1.5, true)
+		var bpm := roundi(60.0 * (1.0 + heat / 45.0 + float(o["shock"]) * 2.0)) if bay.powered() or bay.which == "automaton" else 0
+		draw_string(font, Vector2(size.x - 94, 24), "%d /min" % bpm, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 15, col)
+		# Temperature, pressure, integrity bars; the power lamp.
+		var leaks: int = bay.faults().filter(func(f): return f["kind"] == "leak").size()
+		var rows := [["TEMP", heat / 100.0, Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.25) if heat < 70.0 else Color(1.0, 0.25, 0.2), "%d°" % roundi(20 + heat * 4.0)],
+			["PRESS", clampf(1.0 - leaks * 0.22, 0.0, 1.0), Color(0.45, 0.75, 1.0), "%d%%" % roundi(clampf(1.0 - leaks * 0.22, 0.0, 1.0) * 100.0)],
+			["WORK", Parts.health(bay.cond(), bay.which, bay.pid), Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55), "%d%%" % roundi(Parts.health(bay.cond(), bay.which, bay.pid) * 100.0)]]
+		for i in rows.size():
+			var y := 82.0 + i * 20.0
+			draw_string(font, Vector2(8, y + 12), rows[i][0], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 13, Color(0.7, 0.8, 0.75))
+			var br := Rect2(62, y + 2, size.x - 140, 12)
+			draw_rect(br, Color(0.1, 0.12, 0.12))
+			draw_rect(Rect2(br.position, Vector2(br.size.x * clampf(rows[i][1], 0.0, 1.0), br.size.y)), rows[i][2])
+			draw_string(font, Vector2(size.x - 70, y + 12), rows[i][3], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 13, Color(0.85, 0.9, 0.85))
+		var on: bool = bay.powered()
+		draw_string(font, Vector2(size.x - 94, 56), "FEELS" if bay.which == "automaton" else "POWER", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 13, Color(0.7, 0.8, 0.75))
+		draw_circle(Vector2(size.x - 24, 51), 7.0, Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.5) if on else Color(0.35, 0.1, 0.1))
+
+
+class SpareIcon extends Control:
+	var kind := "circuit"
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		RepairArt.component(self, kind, size * 0.5, minf(size.x, size.y) * 0.4)

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The 80s game title: "SPACE" in spaced-out neon letters over a huge, slanted, heavy "ATRAPOS" with a chrome blue-to-red gradient, a dark outline and a pulsing pink / violet neon glow. (Moved from scripts/retro_title.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,94 @@ 
+class_name RetroTitle
+extends Control
+## The 80s game title: "SPACE" in spaced-out neon letters over a huge,
+## slanted, heavy "ATRAPOS" with a chrome blue-to-red gradient, a dark
+## outline and a pulsing pink / violet neon glow.
+
+@export var big_size := 150
+@export var small_size := 44
+@export var top_text := "SPACE"
+@export var main_text := "ATRAPOS"
+
+var _small_font: FontVariation
+var _fill: Control
+var _t := 0.0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_small_font = FontVariation.new()
+	_small_font.base_font = NeonTheme.title_font()
+	_small_font.spacing_glyph = int(small_size * 0.55)
+	var f := NeonTheme.title_font()
+	var main_w := f.get_string_size(main_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, big_size).x
+	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(main_w + big_size * 0.6, small_size * 1.4 + big_size * 1.15)
+	# The gradient letters are a child, so the glow (drawn here) sits behind them.
+	_fill = Control.new()
+	_fill.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_fill.set_anchors_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	mat.shader = preload("res://shaders/chrome_text.gdshader")
+	_fill.material = mat
+	_fill.draw.connect(_draw_fill)
+	add_child(_fill)
+	resized.connect(_update_shader)
+	_update_shader()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t += delta
+	if is_visible_in_tree():   # (the Esc menu's title: hidden most of the game)
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+## Baseline position of the main word.
+func _main_pos() -> Vector2:
+	var f := NeonTheme.title_font()
+	var w := f.get_string_size(main_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, big_size).x
+	return Vector2((size.x - w) / 2.0 - big_size * 0.08, small_size * 1.4 + f.get_ascent(big_size) * 0.92)
+
+
+func _update_shader() -> void:
+	var f := NeonTheme.title_font()
+	var p := _main_pos()
+	var mat := _fill.material as ShaderMaterial
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("top", p.y - f.get_ascent(big_size) * 0.78)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("bottom", p.y + f.get_descent(big_size) * 0.1)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("width", maxf(size.x, 1.0))
+	_fill.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	var f := NeonTheme.title_font()
+	var p := _main_pos()
+	var pulse := 0.85 + 0.15 * sin(_t * 2.2)
+	# Layered neon glow behind the letters.
+	for g in [[54, Color(0.55, 0.2, 1.0, 0.06)], [38, Color(1.0, 0.2, 0.7, 0.09)], [24, Color(1.0, 0.25, 0.75, 0.16)], [14, Color(0.35, 0.8, 1.0, 0.25)]]:
+		var c: Color = g[1]
+		c.a *= pulse
+		draw_string_outline(f, p, main_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, big_size, g[0], c)
+	# Dark chrome edge with a thin light rim, plus a drop shadow.
+	draw_string(f, p + Vector2(6, 8), main_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, big_size, Color(0.05, 0.0, 0.12, 0.8))
+	draw_string_outline(f, p, main_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, big_size, 9, Color(0.04, 0.02, 0.14))
+	draw_string_outline(f, p, main_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, big_size, 4, Color(0.85, 0.9, 1.0, 0.9))
+	# "SPACE": neon tube letters with lines either side.
+	var sw := _small_font.get_string_size(top_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, small_size).x
+	var sp := Vector2((size.x - sw) / 2.0 + _small_font.spacing_glyph * 0.5, small_size * 1.05)
+	var cyan := Color(0.3, 0.9, 1.0)
+	for g in [[22, Color(cyan, 0.08)], [12, Color(cyan, 0.18)], [6, Color(cyan, 0.4)]]:
+		var c: Color = g[1]
+		c.a *= pulse
+		draw_string_outline(_small_font, sp, top_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, small_size, g[0], c)
+	draw_string_outline(_small_font, sp, top_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, small_size, 2, Color(0.6, 1.0, 1.0))
+	draw_string(_small_font, sp, top_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, small_size, Color(0.92, 1.0, 1.0))
+	var ly := sp.y - small_size * 0.35
+	for side in [-1, 1]:
+		var x0: float = size.x / 2.0 + side * (sw / 2.0 + 24)
+		var x1: float = size.x / 2.0 + side * (size.x * 0.45)
+		draw_line(Vector2(x0, ly), Vector2(x1, ly), Color(1.0, 0.25, 0.75, 0.25 * pulse), 7.0)
+		draw_line(Vector2(x0, ly), Vector2(x1, ly), Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.85), 2.0)
+		draw_line(Vector2(x0, ly + 9), Vector2(lerpf(x0, x1, 0.7), ly + 9), Color(0.3, 0.9, 1.0, 0.8), 1.5)
+
+
+func _draw_fill() -> void:
+	_fill.draw_string(NeonTheme.title_font(), _main_pos(), main_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, big_size, Color.WHITE)

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: A text field for BBCode text (lore, dialogue): it shows the text as the player sees it - bold, italic, colours - with an Edit button beside it; Edit shows the source, the tags dimmed so the words stand out, with B / I buttons (Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I) that wrap the selection. Done (or Esc, or a click elsewhere) shows the formatted text again. var f := RichField.new(); f.setup(text, func(t): ..., 200.0, true) (Moved from scripts/rich_field.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,196 @@ 
+class_name RichField
+extends VBoxContainer
+## A text field for BBCode text (lore, dialogue): it shows the text as the
+## player sees it - bold, italic, colours - with an Edit button beside it;
+## Edit shows the source, the tags dimmed so the words stand out, with B / I
+## buttons (Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I) that wrap the selection. Done (or Esc, or a
+## click elsewhere) shows the formatted text again.
+##   var f := RichField.new(); f.setup(text, func(t): ..., 200.0, true)
+
+signal changed(text: String)
+
+var text := ""
+var on_change := Callable()
+var _view: RichTextLabel
+var _edit: TextEdit
+var _tools: VBoxContainer          # (the B / I buttons, while editing)
+var _edit_btn: Button              # Edit / Done
+var _expand := false
+const TAG := Color(0.55, 0.5, 0.42, 0.75)        # (the tags while editing: dim)
+const PLACEHOLDER := "[color=#7a6a55][i]Empty - press Edit to write. [b]Bold[/b] and [i]italic[/i] with Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I.[/i][/color]"
+
+
+## `height`: the least height; `expand`: fill the space it's given (the lore
+## page) rather than fit its text (dialogue lines).
+func setup(t: String, cb: Callable, height := 0.0, expand := false) -> RichField:
+	text = t
+	on_change = cb
+	_expand = expand
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
+	size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	if expand:
+		size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	# The text (formatted, or its source) and beside it its buttons: Edit /
+	# Done, and while editing B / I. (None of them takes the focus: the
+	# selection stays.)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	row.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	if expand:
+		row.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	add_child(row)
+	var body := VBoxContainer.new()
+	body.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	if expand:
+		body.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	row.add_child(body)
+	var side := VBoxContainer.new()
+	side.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	side.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
+	row.add_child(side)
+	_edit_btn = Button.new()
+	_edit_btn.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	_edit_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(92, 32)
+	_edit_btn.pressed.connect(func(): _show_view() if editing() else _show_edit())
+	side.add_child(_edit_btn)
+	_tools = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_tools.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	_tools.visible = false
+	for spec in [["B", "b", "Bold (Ctrl+B): wraps the selected words in [b]...[/b]."], ["I", "i", "Italic (Ctrl+I): wraps the selected words in [i]...[/i]."]]:
+		var b := Button.new()
+		b.text = spec[0]
+		b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(92, 28)
+		b.tooltip_text = spec[2]
+		b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
+		b.pressed.connect(_wrap.bind(spec[1]))
+		_tools.add_child(b)
+	side.add_child(_tools)
+	_dress_button()
+
+	_edit = TextEdit.new()
+	_edit.text = t
+	_edit.wrap_mode = TextEdit.LINE_WRAPPING_BOUNDARY
+	_edit.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(300, height)
+	_edit.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	if expand:
+		_edit.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	else:
+		_edit.scroll_fit_content_height = true
+	_edit.syntax_highlighter = tag_highlighter()
+	_edit.visible = false
+	_edit.text_changed.connect(func():
+		text = _edit.text
+		if on_change.is_valid():
+			on_change.call(text)
+		changed.emit(text))
+	_edit.focus_exited.connect(_show_view)
+	_edit.gui_input.connect(_edit_keys)
+	body.add_child(_edit)
+
+	_view = RichTextLabel.new()
+	_view.bbcode_enabled = true
+	_view.selection_enabled = false
+	_view.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(300, maxf(height, 34.0))
+	_view.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	if expand:
+		_view.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	else:
+		_view.fit_content = true
+		_view.scroll_active = false
+	body.add_child(_view)
+	_style_view.call_deferred()
+	_render()
+	return self
+
+
+## The formatted view in the look of a text box (so it reads as a field).
+func _style_view() -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_view):
+		return
+	var sb := _edit.get_theme_stylebox("normal")
+	if sb:
+		_view.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", sb)
+		_view.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", sb)
+	var fs := _edit.get_theme_font_size("font_size")
+	if fs > 0:
+		for k in ["normal_font_size", "bold_font_size", "italics_font_size", "bold_italics_font_size"]:
+			_view.add_theme_font_size_override(k, fs)
+	_view.add_theme_color_override("default_color", _edit.get_theme_color("font_color"))
+
+
+## A highlighter for BBCode source: the tags dimmed, the words as they are.
+static func tag_highlighter() -> CodeHighlighter:
+	var hl := CodeHighlighter.new()
+	hl.add_color_region("[", "]", TAG)
+	hl.number_color = Color.WHITE   # (numbers as the rest of the text)
+	hl.symbol_color = Color.WHITE
+	hl.function_color = Color.WHITE
+	hl.member_variable_color = Color.WHITE
+	return hl
+
+
+## The Edit / Done button's look for the mode.
+func _dress_button() -> void:
+	if editing():
+		EditorIcons.dress(_edit_btn, "accept", EditorIcons.tip("Done", "Esc", "Shows the text formatted again, as the player will read it."), "Done")
+	else:
+		EditorIcons.dress(_edit_btn, "pencil", EditorIcons.tip("Edit", "", "Shows the text's source to change it: the formatting tags show, dimmed -\n[b]bold[/b], [i]italic[/i], [color=gold]colour[/color]; Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I (or B / I) wrap the selected words."), "Edit")
+
+
+func _render() -> void:
+	_view.text = text if text.strip_edges() != "" else PLACEHOLDER
+
+
+func _show_edit() -> void:
+	_edit.text = text
+	_view.visible = false
+	_edit.visible = true
+	_tools.visible = true
+	_dress_button()
+	_edit.grab_focus()
+	_edit.set_caret_line(_edit.get_line_count() - 1)
+	_edit.set_caret_column(_edit.get_line(_edit.get_line_count() - 1).length())
+
+
+func _show_view() -> void:
+	_render()
+	_edit.visible = false
+	_tools.visible = false
+	_view.visible = true
+	_dress_button()
+
+
+## Whether the source is showing (being edited).
+func editing() -> bool:
+	return _edit != null and _edit.visible
+
+
+func _edit_keys(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not ev is InputEventKey or not ev.pressed:
+		return
+	var k := ev as InputEventKey
+	if k.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
+		_edit.release_focus()   # (done: the formatted text - not Talos's Esc)
+		_edit.accept_event()
+	elif k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_B:
+		_wrap("b")
+		_edit.accept_event()
+	elif k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_I:
+		_wrap("i")
+		_edit.accept_event()
+
+
+## Wraps the selection in [tag]...[/tag] (no selection: the tags, the caret
+## between them).
+func _wrap(tag: String) -> void:
+	var open := "[%s]" % tag
+	var close := "[/%s]" % tag
+	if _edit.has_selection():
+		var sel := _edit.get_selected_text()
+		_edit.delete_selection()
+		_edit.insert_text_at_caret(open + sel + close)
+	else:
+		_edit.insert_text_at_caret(open + close)
+		_edit.set_caret_column(_edit.get_caret_column() - close.length())
+	_edit.grab_focus()

+	preload("res://scripts/ui/pages/tech_page.gd"),
+	preload("res://scripts/ui/repair_bay.gd"),
+	preload("res://scripts/ui/archive.gd"),
+	preload("res://scripts/ui/pages/industry_page.gd"),
+]
+
+var data: Node
+var ship: Node2D
+
+var current := 0
+var _bar: HBoxContainer
+var _header: Control
+var _pages: Array[Control] = []
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	hide()
+	set_anchors_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	Keybinds.register_menu(self)   # (WASD / D-pad move the focus; Q / E or LB / RB switch tabs)
+
+
+func cycle_tab(d: int) -> void:
+	show_tab(wrapi(current + d, 0, TABS.size()))
+
+
+## Pages are built on first open (they need data/ship set by the game).
+func _build() -> void:
+	var root := UI.modal(self, Color(NeonTheme.TEXT_DIM, 0.9), Vector2.ZERO, true)
+
+	var header := HBoxContainer.new()
+	header.add_child(UI.label("SHIP COMPUTER", 28, NeonTheme.HEAD))
+	header.add_child(UI.spacer())
+	header.add_child(UI.label("1-8 switch tabs  ·  M map  ·  G galaxy  ·  F1 pilot's guide  ·  Tab / Esc to close  ·  hover any icon for help", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	header.add_child(EditorIcons.docs_button(self, "computer", EditorDocs.GAME))
+	header.add_child(EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", close), "close", EditorIcons.tip("Close the Ship Computer", "Tab  ·  Esc", "Closes this window (the game goes on while it's open - it closes by itself if you're attacked).\nTab, I, or M / G on their own tabs also close it.")))
+	root.add_child(header)
+
+	_bar = UI.tab_bar(TABS, show_tab)
+	var tab_info := [["ui_cargo", "Everything you carry: cargo, loot, missiles and repair kits, and your fitted equipment."],
+		["ui_system", "The map of this sector: stations, planets, ships, asteroids and your objective."],
+		["ui_galaxy", "The galaxy map: every system, who owns it, routes between them, diplomacy and news."],
+		["ui_journal", "The main quest's journal: chapters, the current objective and what happened so far."],
+		["ui_tech", "Research upgrades with Data Cores: stronger weapons, shields and engines."],
+		["repair", "The Repair Bay: scan your ship's and automaton's parts for faults and repair them by hand - welding, soldering, sealing, calibrating, fitting spare parts."],
+		["ui_codex", "The Archive: every book of the game in one place - the pilot's guide, the tutorial, the encyclopedia of what you've discovered, the controls, the versions and the Talos manual. Search them all at once."],
+		["ui_industry", "The ship's industry: the refinery turns mined fragments into minerals, the fabricator makes things from them, Upgrade Kits fit upgrades yourself."]]
+	for i in _bar.get_child_count():
+		EditorIcons.dress_tab(_bar.get_child(i), tab_info[i][0], EditorIcons.tip(TABS[i].capitalize(), str(i + 1) + ("  ·  M" if i == MAP_TAB else ("  ·  G" if i == GALAXY_TAB else "")), tab_info[i][1]))
+	root.add_child(_bar)
+
+	# Pages scroll when large text makes them bigger than the window.
+	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
+	scroll.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	scroll.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	root.add_child(scroll)
+	_header = header
+	var content := MarginContainer.new()
+	content.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 8)
+	content.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	content.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	scroll.add_child(content)
+	_content = content
+	for script in PAGES:
+		_pages.append(null)   # (each page built the first time its tab shows: page())
+	data.changed.connect(_refresh_current)
+	Settings.text_scale_changed.connect(_refresh_current)
+
+
+## Made ahead, unseen (a scene built a piece a frame under the loading veil -
+## main.gd): the window, then the pages the keys open directly (Tab / I: the
+## inventory with its slots and their icons baked; M: the map; G: the galaxy)
+## one a frame - a page made at its first showing was the long frame of a
+## first Tab or G (the galaxy: 20 ms to make, then as much to draw).
+## Each step a frame of its own (all in one: a 40-60 ms frame): the window,
+## the inventory page, then the window shown for two frames unseen (its layout
+## and text done now, not in the frame of the first Tab - MenuBackdrop leaves
+## it be: "prewarm"), the slots' icons a few ms a frame, then the maps.
+const ICONS_US := 3000
+var _warming := false
+
+func prewarm() -> void:
+	if data == null or not is_inside_tree():
+		return
+	if _pages.is_empty():
+		_build()
+		await get_tree().process_frame
+		if not is_inside_tree():
+			return
+	var p := page(INVENTORY_TAB)
+	await get_tree().process_frame
+	if not is_inside_tree():
+		return
+	if not visible:
+		_warming = true
+		set_meta("prewarm", true)
+		modulate.a = 0.01   # (all but invisible - but drawn: at 0 it's skipped, and nothing's made ahead)
+		show()
+		show_tab(INVENTORY_TAB)
+		await get_tree().process_frame
+		if not is_inside_tree() or not _warming:
+			return
+		HexReveal.play(self)   # (its curtain too: every part drawn through its shader once - their pipelines made now)
+		for i in 2:
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			if not is_inside_tree() or not _warming:
+				return
+		_end_warming(true)
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for s in p.find_children("*", "", true, false):
+		var id = s.get("item_id")
+		if id is String and id != "":
+			Items.icon_texture(id, s.get("dim") == true)
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > ICONS_US:
+			await get_tree().process_frame
+			if not is_inside_tree():
+				return
+			t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for tab in [MAP_TAB, GALAXY_TAB]:
+		await get_tree().process_frame
+		if not is_inside_tree():
+			return
+		page(tab)
+
+
+## The unseen showing over (prewarm) - or cut short: opened or closed meanwhile.
+func _end_warming(hide_it: bool) -> void:
+	if not _warming:
+		return
+	_warming = false
+	HexReveal.stop(self)
+	if hide_it:
+		hide()
+	remove_meta("prewarm")
+	modulate.a = 1.0
+
+
+## Opens on `tab` - the Inventory unless told otherwise (Tab, I); M / G open
+## it on the maps.
+func open(tab := INVENTORY_TAB) -> void:
+	_end_warming(true)   # (shown unseen just now: opened for real - the backdrop and the curtain too)
+	if _pages.is_empty():
+		_build()
+	var was_open := visible and not HexReveal.closing(self)
+	show()
+	show_tab(INVENTORY_TAB if tab < 0 else tab)
+	if not was_open:
+		HexReveal.play(self)   # (a curtain of hexagon tiles reveals it - or, closing, turns round)
+
+
+## Closes it - the hexagon curtain backwards, then hidden.
+func close() -> void:
+	if _warming:
+		_end_warming(true)
+		return
+	if not visible:
+		return
+	if HexReveal.closing(self):
+		open(current)   # (Tab again while it closes: it turns round)
+		return
+	HexReveal.play(self, true, hide)
+
+
+func show_tab(index: int) -> void:
+	current = index
+	UI.select_tab(_bar, index)
+	# On a planet the MAP tab is the planet's map (PlanetMapPage), else the sector's.
+	var on_planet := index == MAP_TAB and _planet_here()
+	if on_planet and _planet_page == null:
+		_planet_page = PlanetMapPage.new()
+		_planet_page.world = world
+		_planet_page.data = data
+		_planet_page.ship = ship
+		_content.add_child(_planet_page)
+	if not on_planet:
+		page(index)
+	for i in _pages.size():
+		if _pages[i] != null:
+			_pages[i].visible = i == index and not on_planet
+	if _planet_page:
+		_planet_page.visible = on_planet
+		if on_planet:
+			_planet_page.refresh()
+	_refresh_current()
+
+
+var _planet_page: Control
+## The 3D game (Cosmos) - set by it: on a planet, the MAP tab is the planet's.
+var world: Node
+
+
+## On a planet (the 3D game: on foot, landed or low over it).
+func _planet_here() -> bool:
+	var c := world if world else get_tree().current_scene
+	if c == null or not c.has_method("planet_below"):
+		return false
+	if c.walker and c.walker.get("planet"):
+		return true
+	return c.ship != null and c.planet_below(c.ship.global_position, 3000.0) != null
+
+
+var _content: Control
+
+## Page `index` - built now if it hasn't been yet (opening the computer built
+## all seven at once: a long first frame).
+func page(index: int) -> Control:
+	if _pages[index] == null:
+		var p: Control = PAGES[index].new()
+		p.data = data
+		p.ship = ship
+		p.hide()
+		_content.add_child(p)
+		_pages[index] = p
+	return _pages[index]
+
+
+func _refresh_current() -> void:
+	if visible and not _pages.is_empty() and _pages[current] != null:
+		_pages[current].refresh()
+		# Menus & panels text size (pages rebuild rows on refresh). The header
+		# and tabs stop at 150% so they always fit; the pages scroll.
+		UI.scale_fonts(_pages[current], "menu")
+		UI.scale_fonts(_header, "menu", 1.5)
+		UI.scale_fonts(_bar, "menu", 1.5)
+
+
+# _input (not _unhandled_input) so Tab isn't swallowed by GUI focus navigation.
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not visible or _warming or UI.esc_menu_open():
+		return  # the Esc menu on top handles input
+	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
+		close()   # (Esc or pad B closes it - Esc again: the Esc menu)
+	elif Keybinds.pressed(event, "computer") or Keybinds.pressed(event, "inventory"):
+		close()
+	elif Keybinds.pressed(event, "trade_layer") and current in [MAP_TAB, GALAXY_TAB]:
+		_pages[current].toggle_trade()
+	elif Keybinds.pressed(event, "sector_map"):
+		if current == MAP_TAB:
+			close()
+		else:
+			show_tab(MAP_TAB)
+	elif Keybinds.pressed(event, "galaxy_map"):
+		if current == GALAXY_TAB:
+			close()
+		else:
+			show_tab(GALAXY_TAB)
+	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode >= KEY_1 and event.keycode < KEY_1 + TABS.size():
+		show_tab(event.keycode - KEY_1)
+	else:
+		return
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: Endless parallax starfield, drawn in screen space (put it in a CanvasLayer behind the game). Each layer's stars are rendered once into a seamless tiling texture at startup, so drawing is just one tiled texture per layer per frame (instead of hundreds of individual circles). (Moved from scripts/starfield.gd.)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,82 @@ 
+extends Node2D
+## Endless parallax starfield, drawn in screen space (put it in a CanvasLayer
+## behind the game). Each layer's stars are rendered once into a seamless
+## tiling texture at startup, so drawing is just one tiled texture per layer
+## per frame (instead of hundreds of individual circles).
+
+const TILE := 1024
+const CELL := 256.0  # star density is defined per 256x256 cell
+
+## Each layer: [parallax factor, stars per cell, radius, brightness]
+var layers := [
+	[0.15, 6, 1.0, 0.45],
+	[0.35, 3, 1.5, 0.7],
+	[0.6, 1, 2.2, 1.0],
+]
+
+## Scroll speed used when there is no camera (e.g. in the main menu).
+@export var drift := Vector2.ZERO
+
+var _scroll := Vector2.ZERO
+var _textures: Array[ImageTexture] = []
+
+
+## Baked once a run (the same stars every time - a scene built again, after
+## a jump or taking off, reuses them: ~10 ms of its first frame).
+static var _baked := {}
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	texture_repeat = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_REPEAT_ENABLED
+	for i in layers.size():
+		var key := var_to_str(layers[i]) + str(i)
+		if not _baked.has(key):
+			_baked[key] = _bake_layer(i)
+		_textures.append(_baked[key])
+
+
+func _bake_layer(index: int) -> ImageTexture:
+	var count: int = layers[index][1] * int((TILE / CELL) * (TILE / CELL))
+	var radius: float = layers[index][2]
+	var brightness: float = layers[index][3]
+	var img := Image.create_empty(TILE, TILE, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = 1000 + index
+	for s in count:
+		var c := Vector2(rng.randf() * TILE, rng.randf() * TILE)
+		var tint := Color(rng.randf_range(0.75, 1.0), rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.0), 1.0)
+		var reach := int(ceil(radius + 1.0))
+		for dx in range(-reach, reach + 1):
+			for dy in range(-reach, reach + 1):
+				var px := int(floor(c.x)) + dx
+				var py := int(floor(c.y)) + dy
+				var d := Vector2(px + 0.5, py + 0.5).distance_to(c)
+				var a := clampf(radius + 0.5 - d, 0.0, 1.0) * brightness  # anti-aliased disc
+				if a <= 0.0:
+					continue
+				# Wrap around the edges so the tile repeats seamlessly.
+				var x := posmod(px, TILE)
+				var y := posmod(py, TILE)
+				var old := img.get_pixel(x, y)
+				if a > old.a:
+					img.set_pixel(x, y, Color(tint, a))
+	return ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_scroll += drift * delta
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	var cam := get_viewport().get_camera_2d()
+	var cam_pos := cam.get_screen_center_position() if cam else _scroll
+	var size := get_viewport_rect().size
+	var half := size / 2.0
+
+	for i in layers.size():
+		var factor: float = layers[i][0]
+		var offset := half - cam_pos * factor
+		# Top-left of the first visible tile, then one big tiled rect.
+		var start := Vector2(fposmod(offset.x, TILE), fposmod(offset.y, TILE)) - Vector2(TILE, TILE)
+		draw_texture_rect(_textures[i], Rect2(start, size + Vector2(TILE, TILE) * 2.0), true)

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: Station facilities, shown while docked (game paused). Tabs: Repair (hull repair; shields recharge free on docking), Buy (ammo, kits, equipment), Sell (cargo market) and Missions (job board + active jobs). (Moved from scripts/station_menu.gd.)

@@ -1,0 +1,1677 @@ 
+extends Control
+## Station facilities, shown while docked (game paused). Tabs:
+## Repair (hull repair; shields recharge free on docking), Buy (ammo, kits,
+## equipment), Sell (cargo market) and Missions (job board + active jobs).
+
+const REPAIR_COST_PER_POINT := 2
+const SUPPLIES := [["missile", 5], ["repair_kit", 1], ["energy_drink", 3], ["spare_circuit", 1], ["spare_conduit", 1], ["spare_servo", 1],
+	["spare_plate", 1], ["spare_lens", 1], ["spare_cell", 1], ["scanner_mk2", 1], ["scanner_mk3", 1]]  # [item id, amount per purchase]
+const OUTFITTING := ["plasma_cannon", "missile_launcher", "afterburner", "shield_booster"]
+const TABS := ["REPAIR", "MARKET", "OUTFITTING", "SHIPYARD", "DESIGNER", "SELL", "REPUTATION", "MAIN QUESTS", "MISSIONS"]
+
+var data: Node
+var ship: Node2D
+var missions: Node
+var quest: Node
+var station: Node2D
+
+var current := 0
+var _subtitle: Label
+var _dockmaster: Portrait
+var _title: Label
+var _credits: Label
+var _bar: HBoxContainer
+var _content: VBoxContainer
+var _panel_style: StyleBox
+var _built := false
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	hide()
+	set_anchors_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	Keybinds.register_menu(self)   # (WASD / D-pad move the focus; Q / E or LB / RB switch tabs)
+
+
+func cycle_tab(d: int) -> void:
+	show_tab(wrapi(current + d, 0, TABS.size()))
+
+
+func open(st: Node2D) -> void:
+	if not _built:
+		_build()
+	station = st
+	show()
+	ship.invulnerable = true   # (docked: a safe zone - the game goes on round you)
+	ship.recharge_shields()  # free service on docking
+	_title.text = st.station_name.to_upper()
+	_dockmaster.setup(st.station_name + "-dockmaster", st.empire)
+	_dockmaster.tooltip_text = "%s, dockmaster" % _dockmaster.person_name
+	var rec: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations.get(st.station_id, {})
+	if not rec.is_empty():
+		var pres := Galaxy.presence_label(Galaxy.station_presence(st.station_id))
+		var hp := Galaxy.station_health(st.station_id)
+		_subtitle.text = "%s  ·  %s%s  ·  your standing: %s  ·  condition %d%%%s  ·  docked" % [Galaxy.ECONOMIES[rec["economy"]]["name"], Galaxy.empire_name(st.empire),
+			(" (" + pres + ")") if pres != "" else "", Galaxy.standing(st.empire), int(hp), "  ·  BURNING" if hp < Galaxy.DAMAGED else ""]
+	# The station's empire shows in the bracket corners; the rest is the theme's.
+	_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	_panel_style.set("accent", st.accent)
+	_eval = []
+	_eval_done = false
+	_job = {}
+	show_tab(0)
+
+
+## Emitted when you undock (the menu closes).
+signal undocked(station: Node2D)
+
+
+func close() -> void:
+	if not _job.is_empty() and not RepairService.finished(_job):
+		var back := RepairService.cancel(_job, data)
+		if back > 0:
+			GameLog.post("Undocked mid-repair: %d dr paid back for what wasn't done." % back, "info")
+	_job = {}
+	var was_open := visible
+	if visible and station:
+		GameLog.post("Undocked from %s" % station.station_name, "mission")
+	hide()
+	if was_open and is_instance_valid(ship):
+		ship.invulnerable = false
+	if was_open and station:
+		undocked.emit(station)
+
+
+func show_tab(index: int) -> void:
+	current = index
+	UI.select_tab(_bar, index)
+	refresh()
+
+
+func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not visible or UI.esc_menu_open():
+		return  # the Esc menu on top handles input
+	var key: bool = event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo
+	var mp := market_page() if current == 1 else null
+	if Keybinds.pressed(event, "undock"):
+		close()   # (first: Shift+D isn't the market's D)
+	elif mp and mp.handle_key(event):
+		pass
+	elif event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
+		close()   # (Esc leaves the menu - undocks, as the Undock button)
+	elif key and event.keycode >= KEY_1 and event.keycode <= KEY_9:
+		show_tab(event.keycode - KEY_1)
+	else:
+		return
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+func _build() -> void:
+	_built = true
+	var root := UI.modal(self, NeonTheme.HEAD, Vector2.ZERO, true)
+	_panel_style = root.get_parent().get_parent().get_theme_stylebox("panel")
+
+	var header := HBoxContainer.new()
+	header.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
+	_dockmaster = Portrait.new()
+	_dockmaster.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(84, 100)
+	header.add_child(_dockmaster)
+	var titles := VBoxContainer.new()
+	titles.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
+	_title = UI.label("STATION", 30)
+	titles.add_child(_title)
+	_subtitle = UI.label("Docked  ·  shields recharged  ·  safe zone", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	titles.add_child(_subtitle)
+	header.add_child(titles)
+	header.add_child(UI.spacer())
+	_credits = UI.label("", 22, UI.GOLD)
+	header.add_child(_credits)
+	root.add_child(header)
+
+	_bar = UI.tab_bar(TABS, show_tab)
+	var tab_info := [["repair", "Repair your hull for drachmas (shields recharge for free when you dock)."],
+		["buy", "Buy and sell trade goods. Prices follow each station's supply: buy where goods are made, sell where they're needed."],
+		["rating", "Fit weapons, utility systems and modules (ratings E to A), and buy missiles and repair kits."],
+		["ship", "Buy a new ship class; your current ship is traded in."],
+		["paint", "Repaint your ship: hue, saturation, brightness and a tint, or a ready-made skin."],
+		["sell", "Sell cargo and loot at this station's prices."],
+		["pledge", "Who runs this station, and your reputation with every empire and the independents: what it does for you and how it moves."],
+		["quest", "The main story campaign, The Thread of Ariadne."],
+		["accept", "Missions offered here (greyed out: the empire doesn't trust you enough yet), and your active ones (turn them in or abandon them)."]]
+	for i in _bar.get_child_count():
+		EditorIcons.dress_tab(_bar.get_child(i), tab_info[i][0], EditorIcons.tip(TABS[i].capitalize(), str(i + 1), tab_info[i][1]))
+	root.add_child(_bar)
+
+	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
+	scroll.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	# (sideways too: at a big text size a page may be wider than the window -
+	# it scrolls rather than pushing the window past the screen's edge)
+	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_AUTO
+	scroll.follow_focus = true   # (keys / pad moving the focus scroll the page)
+	root.add_child(scroll)
+	var pad := MarginContainer.new()
+	pad.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	pad.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 18)   # clear of the scrollbar
+	scroll.add_child(pad)
+	_content = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_content.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_content.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	pad.add_child(_content)
+
+	var footer := HBoxContainer.new()
+	var keys := UI.label("", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	_keys_hint = keys
+	_update_keys_hint()
+	Keybinds.changed.connect(_update_keys_hint)   # (rebound in Settings: the hint follows)
+	keys.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART   # (big text: wraps, never wider than the window)
+	keys.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	keys.custom_minimum_size.x = 200
+	footer.add_child(keys)
+	footer.add_child(EditorIcons.docs_button(self, "stations", EditorDocs.GAME))
+	footer.add_child(EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("Undock", close, 18), "undock", EditorIcons.tip("Undock", Keybinds.keys_text("undock") + " / Esc", "Leaves the station and returns to space, next to it.\nYour purchases, repairs and accepted quests are kept; the station's safe zone protects you for a moment.")))
+	root.add_child(footer)
+
+	data.changed.connect(_refresh_soon)   # (once at the end of the frame, however many changes)
+	missions.changed.connect(_refresh_soon)
+	Settings.text_scale_changed.connect(refresh)
+
+
+var _keys_hint: Label
+
+func _update_keys_hint() -> void:
+	_keys_hint.text = "1-9 or %s / %s switch tabs  ·  WASD / arrows / D-pad move  ·  %s to undock  ·  F1 pilot's guide  ·  hover any icon for help (keep hovering to pin it)" % [
+		Keybinds.keys_text("menu_tab_prev").get_slice(" /", 0), Keybinds.keys_text("menu_tab_next").get_slice(" /", 0), Keybinds.keys_text("undock").get_slice(" /", 0)]
+
+
+## Asks for one refresh at the end of the frame. Selling all cargo changes the
+## hold once per good: a whole rebuild of the page each time (dozens, in one
+## click, from inside the clicked button's own signal) overflowed Godot's
+## message queue and crashed the game - now it's one rebuild.
+var _refresh_queued := false
+
+func _refresh_soon() -> void:
+	if _refresh_queued:
+		return
+	_refresh_queued = true
+	(func():
+		_refresh_queued = false
+		refresh()).call_deferred()
+
+
+func refresh() -> void:
+	if not visible:
+		return
+	_credits.text = "%s drachmas" % UI.money(data.credits)
+	UI.clear(_content)
+	match current:
+		0: _page_repair()
+		1:
+			_page_market()
+			# (the market's keys pick goods: a focused button would take the arrows / Enter)
+			var f := get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()
+			if f and is_ancestor_of(f):
+				f.release_focus()
+		2: _page_buy()
+		3: _page_shipyard()
+		4: _page_designer()
+		5: _page_sell()

+	b.disabled = need < 0.5 or units < 0.5
+	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(300, 50)
+	row.add_child(b)
+	var held: int = data.count("fuel")
+	var pump := mini(held, ceili(need / Shipyard.FUEL_UNITS_PER_CARGO))
+	var pb := EditorIcons.action(UI.button("", _pump_fuel.bind(pump), 18), "cargo", "%d" % pump,
+		EditorIcons.tip("Pump from the hold", "", "Each unit of fuel in your hold fills %d of the tank. You carry %d." % [Shipyard.FUEL_UNITS_PER_CARGO, held]))
+	pb.text = "Pump %d fuel from the hold" % pump if pump > 0 else "No fuel in the hold"
+	pb.disabled = pump <= 0
+	pb.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(300, 50)
+	row.add_child(pb)
+	_content.add_child(row)
+
+
+func _refuel(units: float, cost: int) -> void:
+	if units > 0.0 and data.spend(cost):
+		data.add_fuel(units)
+		GameLog.post("Refuelled: %d units for %d dr" % [roundi(units), cost], "info")
+		Sfx.play("space/repair")
+		refresh()
+
+
+func _pump_fuel(n: int) -> void:
+	if n > 0 and data.remove_item("fuel", n):
+		data.add_fuel(n * Shipyard.FUEL_UNITS_PER_CARGO)
+		GameLog.post("Pumped %d fuel from the hold into the tank" % n, "info")
+		refresh()
+
+
+func _repair(points: int, cost: int) -> void:
+	if data.spend(cost):
+		GameLog.post("Repaired %d hull for %d dr" % [points, cost], "info")
+		ship.repair(points)
+		refresh()

+func _outfit_specs_for(tab: int) -> Array:
+	var out := []

+		0:   # your ship: fitted modules (to the hold / sold back), ship gear in the hold (fit)

+					"actions": [{"icon": "cargo", "text": "To hold", "call": _unfit_module.bind(i), "tip": "Into your hold (it's gear: refit it any time).",

+			for id in data.held_items().filter(func(x): return Hardpoints.is_weapon(x)):
+				var slot := Hardpoints.free_slot_for(data, id)

+## A spec's buttons (made fresh: one set on the card, one in the detail).
+func _outfit_buttons(sp: Dictionary, font := 12) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for a in sp.get("actions", []):
+		var b := EditorIcons.action(UI.button("", a["call"], font), a["icon"], a["text"], EditorIcons.tip(sp["title"], "", "%s\n%s" % [sp["desc"], a["tip"]]))
+		b.disabled = a["disabled"]
+		out.append(b)
+	return out

+## A card of the outfitter's list: click it to see it in the detail.
+func _outfit_card(sp: Dictionary) -> Control:
+	var card := PanelContainer.new()
+	card.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	card.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL   # (the cards share the row: names whole)
+	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _outfit_card_style(sp["key"] == _outfit_sel))
+	card.add_child(_card(sp["icon"], sp["title"], sp["sub"], sp["desc"], _outfit_buttons(sp)))
+	card.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
+		if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+			_select_outfit(sp["key"]))
+	return card
+
+
+func _select_outfit(key: String) -> void:
+	if key == _outfit_sel:
+		return
+	if _outfit_cards.has(_outfit_sel) and is_instance_valid(_outfit_cards[_outfit_sel]):
+		_outfit_cards[_outfit_sel].add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _outfit_card_style(false))
+	_outfit_sel = key
+	if _outfit_cards.has(key):
+		_outfit_cards[key].add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _outfit_card_style(true))
+	_show_outfit_detail()
+
+
+static var _card_styles := {}
+
+static func _outfit_card_style(selected: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
+	if not _card_styles.has(selected):
+		var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+		sb.bg_color = Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.16) if selected else Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+		sb.border_color = Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.9) if selected else Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+		sb.set_border_width_all(2)
+		sb.set_corner_radius_all(4)
+		sb.content_margin_left = 4
+		sb.content_margin_right = 4
+		sb.content_margin_top = 2
+		sb.content_margin_bottom = 2
+		_card_styles[selected] = sb
+	return _card_styles[selected]

+## A row of small tabs inside a page (the outfitter's categories, the
+## shipyard's classes): `on_select(i)`.
+func _sub_tabs(names: Array, current_i: int, on_select: Callable, rows := 1) -> Container:
+	var box := VBoxContainer.new()   # (`rows` rows of tabs, sharing them out)
+	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	var bar: HBoxContainer
+	var per_row := ceili(names.size() / float(rows))
+	var group := ButtonGroup.new()
+	for i in names.size():
+		if i % per_row == 0:
+			bar = HBoxContainer.new()
+			bar.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+			box.add_child(bar)
+		var b := UI.button(str(names[i]), on_select.bind(i), 14)
+		b.toggle_mode = true
+		b.button_group = group
+		b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+		b.button_pressed = i == current_i
+		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 34)
+		b.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		# (they share the row: at big text a long name ends in "..." - its
+		# tooltip has it whole - rather than pushing the page wider)
+		b.clip_text = true
+		b.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
+		b.tooltip_text = str(names[i])
+		# (the chosen one: dark text on its lit face)
+		b.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", NeonTheme.INK)
+		b.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_pressed_color", NeonTheme.INK)
+		b.add_theme_color_override("icon_pressed_color", NeonTheme.INK)
+		bar.add_child(b)
+	return box

+func _card(icon_id: String, title: String, sub: String, desc: String, buttons: Array) -> Control:

+	text.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)

+func _buy_ship(id: String, cost: int) -> void:
+	if cost > 0 and not data.spend(cost):
+		return
+	if cost < 0:
+		data.add_credits(-cost)
+	var old := Shipyard.stats(data.ship_class)
+	var old_weapons: Array = data.weapons.duplicate()
+	data.ship_class = id
+	var st := Shipyard.stats(id)
+	data.ship_value = int(st["price"])
+	# Move what fits; sell the rest at 80%.
+	# What fits each area of the new ship stays (equipment first, then
+	# modules in order); the rest is sold back at 80%.
+	var refund := Hardpoints.refit(data, old_weapons)   # (the weapons onto its hardpoints; what doesn't fit to the hold)
+	var used := {}
+	for g in Shipyard.UTILITY_GEAR:
+		if data.has_equipment(g):
+			var ga := Shipyard.area_of(g)
+			if int(used.get(ga, 0)) < Shipyard.area_capacity(data, ga):
+				used[ga] = int(used.get(ga, 0)) + 1
+			else:
+				data.equipment.erase(g)
+				refund += roundi(Items.EQUIPMENT[g]["price"] * 0.8)
+	var kept := []
+	for m in data.modules:
+		var ma := Shipyard.area_of(m["id"])
+		if int(used.get(ma, 0)) < Shipyard.area_capacity(data, ma):
+			kept.append(m)
+			used[ma] = int(used.get(ma, 0)) + 1
+		else:
+			refund += roundi(Shipyard.module_price(m["id"], m["rating"]) * 0.8)
+	data.modules = kept
+	if refund > 0:
+		data.add_credits(refund)
+	GameLog.post("New ship: %s (traded in your %s%s)" % [st["name"], old["name"], (", modules sold for %d dr" % refund) if refund > 0 else ""], "good")
+	data.changed.emit()
+	ship.repair(99999.0)
+	ship.recharge_shields()

+	if data.spend(price):
+		GameLog.post("Installed %s (%d dr)" % [Items.EQUIPMENT[id]["name"], price], "good")
+		data.add_equipment(id)
+
+
+# --- Sell --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _page_sell() -> void:
+	# Compact cards, four to a row (the page never scrolls); "Sell all" on top.
+	var total := 0
+	var sellable := []
+	for id in data.held_items():
+		var it: Dictionary = Items.info(id)
+		if it["kind"] == "quest":
+			continue  # story items can't be sold
+		sellable.append(id)
+		if it["kind"] == "cargo":
+			total += _sell_value(id) * data.count(id)
+	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
+	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
+	var sec := UI.section("CARGO MARKET  ·  this station's prices")
+	sec.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	head.add_child(sec)
+	var all := EditorIcons.action(UI.button("", _sell_all_cargo, 16), "sellall", "+%d" % total, EditorIcons.tip("Sell all cargo", "", "Sells every trade good and piece of loot in your hold for %d drachmas in total.\nKeeps your missiles, repair kits, gear and story items." % total))
+	all.disabled = total == 0
+	all.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(300, 40)
+	head.add_child(all)
+	_content.add_child(head)
+	if sellable.is_empty():
+		_content.add_child(UI.label("Cargo hold is empty. Destroy enemies to collect loot.", 16, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+		return
+	var grid := GridContainer.new()
+	grid.columns = 4
+	grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 14)
+	grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 4)
+	_content.add_child(grid)
+	for id in sellable:
+		var it: Dictionary = Items.info(id)
+		var n: int = data.count(id)
+		var each := _sell_value(id)
+		var one := EditorIcons.action(UI.button("", _sell_item.bind(id, 1), 12), "sell", "1", EditorIcons.tip("Sell 1 %s" % it["name"], "", "Sells one for %d drachmas at this station's price." % each))
+		var every := EditorIcons.action(UI.button("", _sell_item.bind(id, n), 12), "sellall", str(n), EditorIcons.tip("Sell all %s" % it["name"], "", "Sells all %d for %d drachmas." % [n, each * n]))
+		var sub := "%d dr each  ·  %d total" % [each, each * n]
+		if NavReports.is_report(id):   # (worth more the further from its system; nothing in it)
+			var j := NavReports.jumps(NavReports.system_of(id), _here_system())
+			sub = ("%d dr  ·  %d %s from %s" % [each, j, "jump" if j == 1 else "jumps", NavReports.name_of(NavReports.system_of(id))]) if each > 0 else "Worthless here: its own system"
+			for bt in [one, every]:
+				bt.disabled = each <= 0
+		var card := _card(id, "%s  ×%d" % [it["name"], n], sub, it.get("desc", ""), [one, every])
+		for bt in [one, every]:
+			bt.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(56, 34)
+		grid.add_child(card)
+
+
+## This station's system.
+func _here_system() -> String:
+	return str(Galaxy.stations.get(station.station_id, {}).get("system", Galaxy.current_system))
+
+
+## What this station pays for one unit (live market price for trade goods; a
+## navigation report by how far its system is from here).
+func _sell_value(id: String) -> int:
+	if NavReports.is_report(id):
+		return NavReports.price(NavReports.system_of(id), _here_system())
+	if Galaxy.stations.has(station.station_id) and id in Galaxy.COMMODITIES:
+		return Galaxy.sell_price(station.station_id, id)
+	return Items.info(id)["value"]
+
+
+func _sell_item(id: String, n: int) -> void:
+	if Galaxy.stations.has(station.station_id) and id in Galaxy.COMMODITIES:
+		var earned := Galaxy.player_sell(station.station_id, id, n, data)
+		if earned > 0:
+			GameLog.post("Sold %d %s for %d dr" % [n, Items.display_name(id), earned], "loot")
+		return
+	var each := _sell_value(id)
+	if NavReports.is_report(id) and each <= 0:
+		return   # (worthless in its own system)
+	if data.remove_item(id, n):
+		GameLog.post("Sold %d %s for %d dr" % [n, Items.display_name(id), each * n], "loot")
+		data.add_credits(each * n)
+
+
+func _sell_all_cargo() -> void:
+	for id in data.held_items():
+		if Items.info(id)["kind"] == "cargo":
+			_sell_item(id, data.count(id))
+
+
+# --- Missions ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _page_missions() -> void:
+	var cols := HBoxContainer.new()
+	cols.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 30)
+	_content.add_child(cols)
+
+	var avail := VBoxContainer.new()
+	avail.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL   # (the offers take the room the active list doesn't need)
+	avail.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	cols.add_child(avail)
+	avail.add_child(UI.section("MISSIONS AT %s" % station.station_name.to_upper()))
+	var e: String = station.empire
+	if e != "":
+		avail.add_child(UI.label("Your reputation with the %s: %d  ·  better missions need more" % [Galaxy.empire_name(e), int(Galaxy.reputation.get(e, 0.0))], 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	if station.health() < Galaxy.DAMAGED:
+		var crisis := UI.label("THE STATION IS BURNING (%d%%): only repair and defence jobs until it's mended. Repairs raise your standing with the %s." % [int(station.health()), Galaxy.empire_name(e)], 15, Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.3))
+		crisis.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+		avail.add_child(crisis)
+	var full: bool = missions.active.size() >= missions.MAX_ACTIVE
+	# The ones you can take first, then the ones you aren't trusted with yet (greyed out).
+	var list: Array = missions.offers_for(station.station_name, e).duplicate()
+	list.sort_custom(func(a, b): return int(missions.available(a)) * 10 - int(a.get("tier", 0)) > int(missions.available(b)) * 10 - int(b.get("tier", 0)))
+	# Two columns of offers: the page never scrolls.
+	var offer_grid := GridContainer.new()
+	offer_grid.columns = 2
+	offer_grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 12)
+	offer_grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 4)
+	avail.add_child(offer_grid)
+	for m in list:
+		var ok: bool = missions.available(m)
+		var b := EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", _accept.bind(m), 15), "accept", EditorIcons.tip("Accept mission", "",
+			("Takes this mission (up to %d at a time). Its goal and progress appear under ACTIVE MISSIONS\nand at the top right of the screen; finishing it pays the reward and raises your reputation with the %s." % [missions.MAX_ACTIVE, Galaxy.empire_name(e)]) if ok
+			else ("Not available: " + missions.required_text(m) + ".\nFinish missions for them (or fight their enemies) to earn their trust.")))
+		b.disabled = full or not ok
+		var card := _mission_card(m, [b], "" if ok else missions.required_text(m), not ok)
+		card.custom_minimum_size.x = 420
+		card.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		offer_grid.add_child(card)
+	if full:
+		avail.add_child(UI.label("You already have %d active missions." % missions.MAX_ACTIVE, 14, Color(1, 0.6, 0.5)))
+
+	var act := VBoxContainer.new()
+	act.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(380, 0)
+	act.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
+	cols.add_child(act)
+	act.add_child(UI.section("ACTIVE MISSIONS  (%d / %d)" % [missions.active.size(), missions.MAX_ACTIVE]))
+	if missions.active.is_empty():
+		act.add_child(UI.label("No active missions.", 15, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	for m in missions.active:
+		var buttons := []
+		if missions.can_turn_in(m, station.station_name):
+			buttons.append(EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", _turn_in.bind(m), 15), "turnin", EditorIcons.tip("Turn in", "", "Completes the mission here and collects its reward (delivered items are taken from your cargo).")))
+		buttons.append(EditorIcons.dress(UI.button("", _abandon.bind(m), 15), "abandon", EditorIcons.tip("Abandon", "", "Gives up this mission: it's removed from your list and frees a slot. No penalty, no reward.")))
+		act.add_child(_mission_card(m, buttons, missions.progress_text(m)))
+
+
+# --- Main quests ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _page_main_quests() -> void:
+	var gold := Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.38)
+	_content.add_child(UI.section("MAIN QUESTS", gold))
+	var card := {"title": "The Thread of Ariadne",
+		"desc": "For three nights a strange spiral signal has repeated across the sector, and Kephala Outpost is asking independent pilots for help. A story of Bronze Age Crete: the Minoans, Linear A, the Minotaur, Daedalus, Talos and the Labyrinth of Knossos.",
+		"reward_text": "story campaign in 7 chapters  ·  drachmas, Data Cores, equipment and history entries"}
+	if quest.stage < 0:
+		# Kilon Alios gives it, in person (QuestData.GIVER, planet_surface.gd).
+		var g: Dictionary = QuestData.GIVER
+		_content.add_child(_mission_card(card, [], "Offered by %s: land on %s and talk to him by the landing pad." % [g["name"], Planets.get_planet(str(g["planet"]))["name"]]))
+	elif quest.finished:
+		_content.add_child(_mission_card(card, [], "Completed - the archive awaits."))
+	else:
+		_content.add_child(_mission_card(card, [], "%s  -  %s" % [quest.chapter_title(), quest.objective_text()]))
+		_content.add_child(UI.label("In progress. Press Tab and open the QUEST tab for the full journal.", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+
+
+# --- Shared cards ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _mission_card(m: Dictionary, buttons: Array, progress: String, locked := false) -> Control:
+	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
+	if locked:   # greyed out: the empire doesn't trust you with it yet
+		panel.modulate = Color(0.55, 0.55, 0.6, 0.75)
+	var style := UI.panel_style(Color(0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.6))
+	style.bg_color = NeonTheme.BG_LIGHT
+	style.content_margin_left = 14
+	style.content_margin_right = 14
+	style.content_margin_top = 7
+	style.content_margin_bottom = 7
+	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
+	panel.add_child(row)
+	# The contact offering the job.
+	var giver := Portrait.new().setup(str(m.get("title", "")) + str(m.get("giver", "")), station.empire if station else "athens")
+	giver.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(52, 62)
+	giver.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN   # (its own size, at the top - not stretched down a tall card)
+	giver.tooltip_text = "%s (%s)" % [giver.person_name, giver.species_name()]
+	row.add_child(giver)
+	var text := VBoxContainer.new()
+	text.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	text.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
+	var tier: int = int(m.get("tier", -1))
+	var tname: String = ("  ·  " + missions.TIERS[tier]["name"].to_upper()) if tier >= 0 and m.has("empire") else ""
+	var title := UI.label(m["title"] + tname, 17, [Color.WHITE, NeonTheme.INFO, Color(0.75, 0.6, 1.0), UI.GOLD][maxi(tier, 0)] if tname != "" else Color.WHITE)
+	title.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	text.add_child(title)
+	text.custom_minimum_size.x = 240
+	if locked:   # (not yours to take yet: what it needs, the rest in the tooltip - a compact card)
+		panel.tooltip_text = str(m["desc"])
+	else:
+		var desc := UI.label(m["desc"], 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+		desc.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+		# (two lines at most - the whole of it in the card's tooltip: a station
+		# with long offers at large text made the page scroll)
+		desc.max_lines_visible = 2
+		desc.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
+		panel.tooltip_text = str(m["desc"])
+		text.add_child(desc)
+	if progress != "":
+		var pl := UI.label(progress, 14, Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.45) if locked else NeonTheme.HEAD)
+		pl.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+		text.add_child(pl)
+	# The reward, and the card's buttons beside it (not a column of their own:
+	# the text gets the card's width).
+	var reward: String = m["reward_text"] if m.has("reward_text") else missions.reward_text(m)
+	# (a flow: in a narrow card - the active list, two buttons - the buttons
+	# drop under the reward instead of squeezing it to a letter a line)
+	var foot := HFlowContainer.new()
+	foot.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 8)
+	foot.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 4)
+	var rl := UI.label("Reward: " + reward, 14, UI.GOLD)
+	rl.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	rl.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	rl.custom_minimum_size.x = minf(rl.get_theme_font("font").get_string_size(rl.text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 14).x + 4.0, 200.0)
+	rl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	foot.add_child(rl)
+	for b in buttons:
+		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(100, 32)
+		b.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_END
+		foot.add_child(b)
+	text.add_child(foot)
+	row.add_child(text)
+	return panel
+
+
+func _accept(m: Dictionary) -> void:
+	missions.accept(m)
+
+
+func _turn_in(m: Dictionary) -> void:
+	missions.turn_in(m)
+
+
+func _abandon(m: Dictionary) -> void:
+	missions.abandon(m)
+
+
+# --- Shared ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _item_row(id: String, n: int, title: String, subtitle: String) -> HBoxContainer:
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
+	var icon := ItemSlot.make(id, n, 48.0)
+	icon.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	row.add_child(icon)
+	var text := VBoxContainer.new()
+	text.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	text.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
+	text.add_child(UI.label(title, 16))
+	var sub := UI.label(subtitle, 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	sub.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	text.add_child(sub)
+	row.add_child(text)
+	return row

files.explanation: The menus and the HUD: The automaton on the operating table (the Repair Bay's table when the body is the automaton): its anatomy in four layers - muscles, veins, nerves, skeleton (Parts.LAYERS; the bay's layer buttons choose which is shown) - the body lying with its head to the left (AnatomyArt), seen close on the part being worked on (part_view). Each of the part's components is a structure of one layer at its place on the body (its "site"); its faults show there once the scanner has found them (the lens finds the faults of the layer shown, where your scanner reads that layer). Surgery: the muscles are the surface - worked on directly. A fault deeper (a vessel, a nerve, a bone) is reached through an INCISION: trace the dashed line over its site with the scalpel; the wound is held open (retractors) and shows the layers beneath. Then the fault's tool (Parts.fault_info): suture - a tear in soft tissue: a stitch at each mark; also closes an incision fuser - a fracture: traced slowly along the break (it heats: the vitals) clamp - on a bleeding vessel, upstream: the pressure stays down while it holds (not for long) sealant - the vessel's hole, held while the pressure is low splicer - a burnt nerve: each fibre to its own colour (the region numbed first - the nerve block - or it shocks) tuner - a spasm: rate and phase onto the reference wave, and held forceps - a destroyed structure: its two ties undone, lifted out, a spare grafted in - turned the way the tissue runs - and tied Mistakes cost work, never a new fault (RepairBay.mishap). Leaving the part closes its incisions. (Moved from scripts/surgery.gd.)
