+## Fade to black, switch scene, fade back in. The overlay lives on the root
+## viewport, so it survives the scene change.
+static func fade_change_scene(path: String, duration := 0.35) -> void:
+	var tree := Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree
+	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
+	layer.layer = 128
+	layer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	var black := ColorRect.new()
+	black.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+	black.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	black.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP  # no clicks mid-transition
+	layer.add_child(black)
+	tree.root.add_child(layer)
+	var t := layer.create_tween()
+	t.tween_property(black, "color:a", 1.0, duration)
+	await t.finished
+	tree.paused = false
+	await switch_scene(path)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	await tree.process_frame
+	var t2 := layer.create_tween()
+	t2.tween_property(black, "color:a", 0.0, duration)
+	await t2.finished
+	layer.queue_free()
+
+
+## The scene changed to `path` over several frames: the old one freed first
+## (thousands of nodes leaving: a few ms a frame), then the new one made
+## (change_scene_to_file does both in one long frame) - and a scene that
+## builds itself a piece a frame (`staging` is on while it enters the tree:
+## the space scene, main.gd) waited for until it's all there (build_settled).
+static var staging := false
+
+static func switch_scene(path: String) -> Node:
+	var tree := Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree
+	var old := tree.current_scene
+	if old != null:
+		tree.current_scene = null   # (none for a few frames: what asks for it copes with none)
+		await dismantle(old)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	var ps: PackedScene = load(path)
+	var n := ps.instantiate()
+	staging = true   # (a scene that builds itself a piece a frame does so now: main.gd)
+	tree.root.add_child(n)
+	staging = false
+	tree.current_scene = n
+	var waited := 0
+	while is_instance_valid(n) and n.has_method("build_settled") and not n.build_settled() and waited < 600:
+		await tree.process_frame
+		waited += 1
+	return n
+
+
+## Frees a scene a few milliseconds a frame (a planet's 5000+ nodes freed at
+## once: an 80 ms frame): it stops and hides first, then goes node by node
+## from the leaves up (the last child's last child... first) - and the node
+## itself last. Await it.
+static func dismantle(n: Node, budget_us := 5000) -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(n):
+		return
+	if not n.is_inside_tree():
+		# (out of the tree - its parent being taken away, say: freed the safe
+		# way, at the end of the frame - freeing its pieces now, mid-removal,
+		# was a double free)
+		if not n.is_queued_for_deletion():
+			n.queue_free()
+		return
+	var tree := n.get_tree()
+	n.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
+	if n is CanvasItem:
+		(n as CanvasItem).visible = false
+	for l in n.find_children("*", "CanvasLayer", true, false):
+		(l as CanvasLayer).visible = false
+	# (freed from the next frame: a piece may be mid-call now - the button or
+	# signal that started this - and a node can't be freed while it is)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	if not is_instance_valid(n) or not n.is_inside_tree():
+		if is_instance_valid(n) and not n.is_queued_for_deletion():
+			n.queue_free()
+		return
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	while is_instance_valid(n) and n.is_inside_tree() and n.get_child_count() > 0:
+		var piece := n.get_child(n.get_child_count() - 1)
+		while piece.get_child_count() > 0:   # (from the leaves up: no one free is big)
+			piece = piece.get_child(piece.get_child_count() - 1)
+		piece.free()
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0 > budget_us:
+			await tree.process_frame
+			t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	# (the node itself at the frame's end: it may be the one that asked for this,
+	# mid-call - a surface taking itself apart - and its pieces are gone by now)
+	if is_instance_valid(n) and not n.is_queued_for_deletion():
+		n.queue_free()
+
+
+## Like fade_change_scene, to a scene already built (e.g. a planet surface
+## prebuilt in the background): it's taken out of its current parent.
+static func fade_change_scene_to_node(node: Node, duration := 0.35) -> void:
+	var tree := Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree
+	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
+	layer.layer = 128
+	layer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	var black := ColorRect.new()
+	black.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+	black.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	black.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	layer.add_child(black)
+	tree.root.add_child(layer)
+	var t := layer.create_tween()
+	t.tween_property(black, "color:a", 1.0, duration)
+	await t.finished
+	tree.paused = false
+	if node.get_parent() == tree.root:
+		# Already in the tree (built there): made the scene where it is - no
+		# leaving and entering the tree again - and the old scene freed.
+		var old := tree.current_scene
+		tree.current_scene = node
+		if old != null and old != node:
+			dismantle(old, 2000)   # (a little a frame, under the fade - little: the new scene's first frames are busy)
+	else:
+		if node.get_parent():
+			node.get_parent().remove_child(node)
+		tree.change_scene_to_node(node)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	if node.has_method("show_world"):
+		node.show_world()
+	await tree.process_frame
+	await tree.process_frame
+	# (a world that draws itself in over a few frames: black until it's there)
+	var waited := 0
+	while is_instance_valid(node) and node.has_method("world_settled") and not node.world_settled() and waited < 60:
+		await tree.process_frame
+		waited += 1
+	var t2 := layer.create_tween()
+	t2.tween_property(black, "color:a", 0.0, duration)
+	await t2.finished
+	layer.queue_free()
+
+
+static func spacer() -> Control:
+	var c := Control.new()
+	c.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	return c
+
+
+## For things that animate by redrawing: true (and the clock reset) when it's
+## time for the next picture - at most `hz` a second, and only while it can be
+## seen. Each redraw of a hundred little animations every frame adds up at
+## 240 FPS; their looks don't change faster than this.
+##   if UI.redraw_due(self, 60.0): queue_redraw()
+## The middle mouse button clicked (pressed and let go without dragging):
+## every view that zooms with the wheel resets its zoom on it. Call with
+## every mouse button event; true on the release of such a click. (Views
+## that pan with a middle drag keep panning: a drag isn't a click.)
+static func middle_click(n: Object, mb: InputEventMouseButton) -> bool:
+	if mb.button_index != MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE:
+		return false
+	if mb.pressed:
+		n.set_meta("_mid_at", [mb.position, Time.get_ticks_msec()])
+		return false
+	var at: Variant = n.get_meta("_mid_at", null)
+	if at != null:
+		n.remove_meta("_mid_at")
+	return at != null and mb.position.distance_to(at[0]) < 6.0 and Time.get_ticks_msec() - int(at[1]) < 600
+
+
+## Whether `n` (a thing in the world) is on the screen or within `margin` px of
+## it - things drawn round their own position, no bigger than that.
+static func near_view(n: CanvasItem, margin := 300.0) -> bool:
+	var p := n.get_global_transform_with_canvas().origin
+	var size := n.get_viewport_rect().size
+	return p.x > -margin and p.y > -margin and p.x < size.x + margin and p.y < size.y + margin
+
+
+static func redraw_due(ci: CanvasItem, hz := 60.0) -> bool:
+	if not ci.is_visible_in_tree():
+		return false
+	var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	var period := int(1e6 / hz)
+	if not ci.has_meta("_redrawn_at"):
+		# (A random phase each: not all of them redrawing in the same frame.)
+		ci.set_meta("_redrawn_at", now - randi() % period)
+		return true
+	var last: int = ci.get_meta("_redrawn_at")
+	if now - last < period:
+		return false
+	ci.set_meta("_redrawn_at", last + period * maxi(1, (now - last) / period))   # (keeps its phase)
+	return true

@@ -1,0 +1,111 @@ 
+class_name CosmosGame
+extends RefCounted
+## The game behind the 3D game (stage 5): YOUR game - the same save as the 2D
+## game's. "3D Space - Continue" loads the latest save (the galaxy, your
+## credits, cargo and gear - PlayerData - and the system you're in); saving
+## (docking, jumping, the Save terminal, the Esc menu) writes the game back
+## in the same format, every section the 3D game doesn't touch carried over
+## as it was - so the 2D game loads it too (your ship where you were, in its
+## map units). The 3D game's own things - its ship's upgrades, a bounty
+## contract, hull and shields - ride along in the save's "cosmos3d" section.
+##   CosmosGame.begin(true)   # (the title: continue the latest save)
+
+const SLOT := SaveGame.AUTO
+static var state := {}            # the save as loaded (its other sections kept as they were)
+static var data: Node             # PlayerData: credits, cargo, gear (in the tree, under the root)
+static var missions: Node         # Missions (the 2D game's: offers, active ones) - under the root too
+static var quest: CosmosQuest     # the main quest's stage
+static var extra := {}            # the 3D game's own: {upgrades, contract, hull, shield}
+static var from_save := false
+static var started := false
+
+
+## A game from a save's state (SaveGame.load_slot: the slot's "state").
+static func begin_state(st: Dictionary) -> void:
+	_fresh_data()
+	state = st
+	extra = st.get("cosmos3d", {}).duplicate(true)
+	from_save = not st.is_empty()
+	Cosmos._placed_from_save = false
+	if st.has("galaxy"):
+		Galaxy.load_save_data(st["galaxy"])
+	if st.has("player"):
+		data.load_save_data(st["player"])
+	if st.has("missions"):
+		missions.load_save_data(st["missions"])
+	if st.has("quest"):
+		quest.load_save_data(st["quest"])
+	started = true
+
+
+## A game for the 3D world: the latest save continued, or a new one.
+static func begin(continue_save: bool) -> void:
+	_fresh_data()
+	state = {}
+	extra = {}
+	from_save = false
+	Cosmos._placed_from_save = false
+	if continue_save:
+		var parsed := SaveGame.read_save(-1)
+		if not parsed.is_empty():
+			state = parsed.get("state", {})
+			if state.has("galaxy"):
+				Galaxy.load_save_data(state["galaxy"])
+			if state.has("player"):
+				data.load_save_data(state["player"])
+			if state.has("missions"):
+				missions.load_save_data(state["missions"])
+			if state.has("quest"):
+				quest.load_save_data(state["quest"])
+			extra = state.get("cosmos3d", {}).duplicate(true)
+			from_save = true
+	started = true
+
+
+static func _fresh_data() -> void:
+	for n in [data, missions, quest]:
+		if n and is_instance_valid(n):
+			n.queue_free()
+	var root := (Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree).root
+	data = load("res://scripts/sim/player_data.gd").new()
+	data.name = "CosmosPlayerData"
+	root.add_child.call_deferred(data)
+	missions = load("res://scripts/sim/missions.gd").new()
+	missions.name = "CosmosMissions"
+	root.add_child.call_deferred(missions)
+	quest = CosmosQuest.new()
+	quest.name = "CosmosQuest"
+	root.add_child.call_deferred(quest)
+
+
+## Makes sure there's a game (a scene run on its own, a test).
+static func ensure() -> void:
+	if not started or data == null or not is_instance_valid(data):
+		begin(false)
+
+
+## The game as a save: the loaded state, brought up to date.
+static func snapshot(c: Node) -> Dictionary:
+	var st := state.duplicate(true)
+	st["player"] = data.get_save_data()
+	st["missions"] = missions.get_save_data()
+	st["quest"] = quest.get_save_data()
+	st["galaxy"] = Galaxy.get_save_data()
+	var ship: Dictionary = st.get("ship", {})
+	var p: Vector3 = c.system_position()
+	ship["position"] = [p.x / PlanetShape.PX_TO_M, p.z / PlanetShape.PX_TO_M]
+	ship["velocity"] = [0.0, 0.0]
+	ship["has_target"] = false
+	st["ship"] = ship
+	extra["hull"] = c.ship.hull
+	extra["shield"] = c.ship.shield
+	st["cosmos3d"] = extra.duplicate(true)
+	return st
+
+
+static func save(c: Node) -> bool:
+	var st := snapshot(c)
+	var ok := SaveGame.save_game(st, SLOT)
+	if ok:
+		state = st
+	return ok

+class_name CosmosQuest

+## The main quest as the 3D game carries it (stage 5): its stage and whether

+	var s: float = float(k["size"]) * float(k["scale"])
+	var root := Node3D.new()
+	root.scale = Vector3.ONE * s
+	add_child(root)
+	var b: Vector3 = k["body"]
+	var legs: int = k["legs"]
+	var ll: float = k["leg_len"]
+	var hip := ll if legs > 0 else b.y * 0.45
+	_body = Node3D.new()
+	_body.position.y = hip + b.y * 0.35
+	root.add_child(_body)
+	_part(_ball, _body, Vector3.ZERO, b)
+	if k["crest"]:
+		_part(_cone, _body, Vector3(0, b.y * 0.5, 0), Vector3(0.12, b.y * 0.6, b.z * 0.6))
+	# Legs: pairs along the body.
+	var pairs := legs / 2
+	for i in pairs:
+		var z := 0.0 if pairs == 1 else lerpf(-b.z * 0.32, b.z * 0.32, float(i) / (pairs - 1))
+		for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var piv := Node3D.new()
+			piv.position = Vector3(side * b.x * 0.38, 0.0, z)
+			_body.add_child(piv)
+			_part(_limb, piv, Vector3(0, -ll * 0.5 - b.y * 0.1, 0), Vector3(k["leg_w"], (ll + b.y * 0.3) * 0.5, k["leg_w"]))
+			if k.get("splay", false):
+				piv.rotation.z = side * 0.75   # (an insect's legs, out to the sides)
+			_legs.append([piv, (0.0 if side < 0 else PI) + i * PI * 0.5])
+	# Neck and head (forward is -z).
+	var neck: float = k["neck"]
+	var hs: float = k["head"]
+	_head = Node3D.new()
+	_head.position = Vector3(0, b.y * 0.25 + neck * 0.7, -b.z * 0.5 - neck * 0.3)
+	_body.add_child(_head)
+	if neck > 0.15:
+		var n := _part(_limb, _body, (_head.position + Vector3(0, 0, -b.z * 0.35)) * 0.5, Vector3(hs * 0.45, neck * 0.45 + 0.1, hs * 0.45))
+		n.rotation.x = -0.5
+	_part(_ball, _head, Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(hs, hs * 0.85, hs * 1.1))
+	if float(k["snout"]) > 0.1:
+		_part(_ball, _head, Vector3(0, -hs * 0.1, -hs * 0.55), Vector3(hs * 0.6, hs * 0.5, float(k["snout"]) + hs * 0.4))
+	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		var e := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		e.mesh = _ball
+		e.material_override = eye
+		e.position = Vector3(side * hs * 0.3, hs * 0.18, -hs * 0.42)
+		e.scale = Vector3.ONE * hs * 0.22
+		e.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+		_head.add_child(e)
+	if float(k.get("ears", 0.0)) > 0.0:
+		for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var ear := _part(_cone, _head, Vector3(side * hs * 0.25, hs * 0.5, hs * 0.15), Vector3(hs * 0.18, float(k["ears"]), hs * 0.1))
+			ear.rotation = Vector3(0.35, 0, -side * 0.25)
+	if float(k.get("antlers", 0.0)) > 0.0:
+		var a: float = k["antlers"]
+		for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var beam := _part(_limb, _head, Vector3(side * hs * 0.35, hs * 0.5 + a * 0.35, hs * 0.2), Vector3(0.05, a * 0.4, 0.05))
+			beam.rotation = Vector3(0.45, 0, -side * 0.55)
+			for t in 3:
+				var tine := _part(_cone, _head, Vector3(side * (hs * 0.35 + a * (0.12 + t * 0.12)), hs * 0.5 + a * (0.3 + t * 0.2), hs * 0.2 + a * 0.1 * t), Vector3(0.06, a * 0.3, 0.06))
+				tine.rotation = Vector3(-0.3, 0, -side * 0.2)
+	if float(k.get("shell", 0.0)) > 0.0:
+		var sh: float = k["shell"]
+		_part(_ball, _body, Vector3(0, b.y * 0.2, 0), Vector3(b.x * 1.18, b.y * (0.6 + 0.5 * sh), b.z * 1.08))
+	if float(k.get("cap", 0.0)) > 0.0:
+		var cap := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		var cm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+		cm.albedo_color = k["c2"]
+		cm.roughness = 0.7
+		cap.mesh = _ball
+		cap.material_override = cm
+		cap.position = Vector3(0, b.y * 0.55, 0)
+		cap.scale = Vector3(b.x * 1.8, 0.35 + b.y * 0.3, b.z * 1.15) * float(k["cap"])
+		cap.visibility_range_end = 220.0
+		_body.add_child(cap)
+	if float(k.get("wings", 0.0)) > 0.0:
+		var span: float = k["wings"]
+		for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var piv := Node3D.new()
+			piv.position = Vector3(side * b.x * 0.35, b.y * 0.2, -b.z * 0.05)
+			_body.add_child(piv)
+			_part(_ball, piv, Vector3(side * span * 0.5, 0, 0), Vector3(span, 0.05, b.z * 0.75))
+			_wings.append([piv, side])
+	for i in int(k.get("tentacles", 0)):
+		var a := TAU * i / float(k["tentacles"])
+		var piv := Node3D.new()
+		piv.position = Vector3(cos(a) * b.x * 0.3, -b.y * 0.3, sin(a) * b.z * 0.3)
+		_body.add_child(piv)
+		_part(_limb, piv, Vector3(0, -0.6, 0), Vector3(0.05, 0.6, 0.05))
+		_tentacles.append([piv, a])
+	for h in int(k["horns"]):
+		var side := -1.0 if h == 0 else 1.0
+		var horn := _part(_cone, _head, Vector3(side * hs * 0.3, hs * 0.55, 0), Vector3(hs * 0.18, hs * 0.9, hs * 0.18))
+		horn.rotation.z = -side * 0.4
+	if float(k["tail"]) > 0.15:
+		_tail = Node3D.new()
+		_tail.position = Vector3(0, b.y * 0.1, b.z * 0.5)
+		_body.add_child(_tail)
+		var t := _part(_cone, _tail, Vector3(0, 0, float(k["tail"]) * 0.5), Vector3(b.x * 0.35, float(k["tail"]), b.x * 0.35))
+		t.rotation.x = PI * 0.5 + 0.3
+	reach = maxf(b.z, b.x) * 0.55 * s + 0.2
+	_new_goal()
+
+
+func _part(mesh: Mesh, parent: Node3D, at: Vector3, size: Vector3) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.mesh = mesh
+	mi.material_override = _mat
+	mi.position = at
+	mi.scale = size
+	mi.visibility_range_end = 220.0
+	if size.length() < 0.5:
+		mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	parent.add_child(mi)
+	return mi
+
+
+func up() -> Vector3:
+	return (global_position - planet.global_position).normalized()
+
+
+func _new_goal() -> void:
+	var u := up() if planet and is_inside_tree() else Vector3.UP
+	var t := u.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(u.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized().rotated(u, _rng.randf() * TAU)
+	_goal = (global_position - planet.global_position) + t * _rng.randf_range(8.0, 30.0) if planet and is_inside_tree() else Vector3.ZERO
+	_t = _rng.randf_range(3.0, 8.0)
+	state = "wander" if _rng.randf() < 0.7 else "idle"
+
+
+## A hit: `dmg` from `from` (a world point).
+func hurt(dmg: float, from: Vector3) -> void:
+	if dead:
+		return
+	hp -= dmg
+	_hurt = 0.25
+	if hp <= 0.0:
+		dead = true
+		state = "dead"
+		_dead_t = 0.0
+		if cosmos:
+			cosmos.creature_died(self)
+		return
+	if kind["temper"] == "predator":
+		state = "hunt"
+	else:
+		state = "flee"
+		_t = 6.0
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	delta = minf(delta, 0.05)
+	if planet == null:
+		return
+	var u := up()
+	if dead:
+		_dead_t += delta
+		_body.rotation.z = lerpf(_body.rotation.z, PI * 0.5, 1.0 - exp(-delta * 5.0))
+		if _dead_t > 4.0:
+			_body.position.y -= delta * 0.6
+		if _dead_t > 7.0:
+			queue_free()
+		return
+	_hurt = maxf(0.0, _hurt - delta)
+	_mat.set_shader_parameter("flash", _hurt * 4.0)
+	_bite_cd = maxf(0.0, _bite_cd - delta)
+	var me := global_position - planet.global_position
+	var player: Node3D = cosmos.walker if cosmos else null
+	var to_player := Vector3.ZERO
+	var pd := INF
+	if player and not player.get("downed"):
+		to_player = player.global_position - global_position
+		pd = to_player.length()
+	var sight: float = SIGHT[kind["temper"]] * (1.4 if kind["monster"] else 1.0)
+	var want := Vector3.ZERO
+	var speed := 0.0
+	match state:
+		"wander", "idle":
+			_t -= delta
+			if _t <= 0.0:
+				_new_goal()
+			if state == "wander":
+				var g := _goal - me
+				g -= u * g.dot(u)
+				if g.length() < 1.5:
+					state = "idle"
+				else:
+					want = g.normalized()
+					speed = float(kind["walk"])
+			if pd < sight:
+				state = "hunt" if kind["temper"] == "predator" else "flee"
+				_t = 6.0
+		"flee":
+			_t -= delta
+			if pd < INF:
+				var away := -to_player
+				away -= u * away.dot(u)
+				want = away.normalized()
+			speed = float(kind["run"])
+			if _t <= 0.0 and pd > sight * 1.5:
+				_new_goal()
+		"hunt":
+			if pd > sight * 2.2:
+				_new_goal()
+			elif pd < INF:
+				var go := to_player - u * to_player.dot(u)
+				want = go.normalized()
+				var bite_at := reach + 0.9
+				speed = float(kind["run"]) if pd > bite_at else 0.0
+				if pd <= bite_at + 0.3:
+					facing = want
+					if _bite_cd <= 0.0:
+						_bite_cd = 1.2
+						player.hurt(float(kind["bite"]), self)
+						_head.position.z -= 0.15
+	var flat := velocity - u * velocity.dot(u)
+	flat = flat.move_toward(want * speed, 10.0 * delta)
+	velocity = flat
+	global_position += velocity * delta
+	# Stand on the ground (out of the sea: grazers don't swim - turn back).
+	var local := global_position - planet.global_position
+	var d := local.normalized()
+	var h := planet.shape.height(d)
+	if planet.shape.sea > 0 and h < 0.3:
+		global_position -= velocity * delta * 2.0
+		velocity = -velocity * 0.5
+		_new_goal()
+		local = global_position - planet.global_position
+		d = local.normalized()
+		h = maxf(planet.shape.height(d), 0.3)
+	# Flying or floating: its height over the ground (birds take off when they flee).
+	var fly_to := float(kind.get("alt", 0.0))
+	if state == "hunt":
+		fly_to = minf(fly_to, 0.4)   # (hunters come down to bite)
+	if _wings.size() > 0 and fly_to <= 0.0 and state == "flee":
+		fly_to = 7.0
+	_alt = lerpf(_alt, fly_to, 1.0 - exp(-delta * 1.5))
+	var bob := sin(_phase * 0.3) * 0.25 if fly_to > 0.0 else 0.0
+	global_position = planet.global_position + d * (planet.radius + h + _alt + bob)
+	if flat.length() > 0.3:
+		facing = facing.slerp(flat.normalized(), 1.0 - exp(-delta * 6.0)) if facing.dot(flat.normalized()) > -0.95 else flat.normalized()
+	facing = (facing - d * facing.dot(d)).normalized()
+	if facing.length() < 0.5:
+		facing = d.cross(Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+	global_basis = Basis.looking_at(facing, d)
+	# The gait.
+	var v := flat.length()
+	_phase += delta * (2.0 + v * 2.2 / maxf(float(kind["size"]) * float(kind["scale"]), 0.5))
+	var swing := clampf(v / maxf(float(kind["walk"]), 0.5), 0.0, 1.6) * 0.45
+	for l in _legs:
+		(l[0] as Node3D).rotation.x = sin(_phase + l[1]) * swing
+	_body.position.y += (absf(sin(_phase)) * 0.06 * swing - (_body.position.y - _body_base())) * minf(1.0, delta * 10.0)
+	if _tail:
+		_tail.rotation.y = sin(_phase * 0.5) * 0.4
+	var flying := _alt > 0.5
+	for w in _wings:
+		(w[0] as Node3D).rotation.z = float(w[1]) * (sin(_phase * (2.5 if flying else 0.6)) * (0.6 if flying else 0.08) + (0.0 if flying else 0.9))
+	for t in _tentacles:
+		(t[0] as Node3D).rotation = Vector3(sin(_phase * 0.8 + float(t[1])) * 0.3, 0, cos(_phase * 0.7 + float(t[1])) * 0.3)
+	_head.rotation.x = sin(_phase * 0.5) * 0.08 + (0.25 if state == "idle" else 0.0)
+	_head.position.z = lerpf(_head.position.z, -float(kind["body"].z) * 0.5 - float(kind["neck"]) * 0.3, delta * 4.0)
+
+
+func _body_base() -> float:
+	var b: Vector3 = kind["body"]
+	var ll: float = kind["leg_len"]
+	return (ll if int(kind["legs"]) > 0 else b.y * 0.45) + b.y * 0.35

files.explanation: The 3D world - life on the planets: A cave system or a dungeon under a planet (the 3D game), entered from its mouth on the surface (Cosmos.dungeons_of / enter_dungeon): a world of its own, set far off out of sight, walked as a deck (the walker's floor_y / ceiling_y / confine - like the station's hangar). Laid out by its seed on a grid: rooms joined by corridors (a tree from the entrance - its stairs back up - to the deepest room, where its chest waits). Built from the towns' pieces (CosmosTown.Builder: one mesh, the building shader in its own palette - "dungeon": the old labyrinths, dressed stone, red pillars, horns; "cave": rough rock, boulders, stalagmites), its walls solid (you, your bolts, the camera). Torches burn on the walls (a few lights, no shadows). Its dead walk in it: skeleton warriors in the rooms, demons deeper in, a demon lord by the chest (CosmosNpc, roles skeleton / demon).

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,416 @@ 
+class_name CosmosDungeon
+extends Node3D
+## A cave system or a dungeon under a planet (the 3D game), entered from its
+## mouth on the surface (Cosmos.dungeons_of / enter_dungeon): a world of its
+## own, set far off out of sight, walked as a deck (the walker's floor_y /
+## ceiling_y / confine - like the station's hangar). Laid out by its seed on a
+## grid: rooms joined by corridors (a tree from the entrance - its stairs back
+## up - to the deepest room, where its chest waits). Built from the towns'
+## pieces (CosmosTown.Builder: one mesh, the building shader in its own
+## palette - "dungeon": the old labyrinths, dressed stone, red pillars,
+## horns; "cave": rough rock, boulders, stalagmites), its walls solid (you,
+## your bolts, the camera). Torches burn on the walls (a few lights, no
+## shadows). Its dead walk in it: skeleton warriors in the rooms, demons
+## deeper in, a demon lord by the chest (CosmosNpc, roles skeleton / demon).
+
+const CELL := 15.0             # m: a grid cell (a room and the way to the next)
+const H := 4.6                 # m: the ceiling's height
+const WALL := 0.6
+const LAMPS := 6               # torch lights at once (the nearest torches')
+
+var style := "dungeon"
+var planet: CosmosPlanet
+var site := {}
+var built := false
+var start := Vector3.ZERO      # (dungeon-local) where you come down
+var exit_at := Vector3.ZERO    # the stairs back up
+var chest_at := Vector3.ZERO
+var chest_open := false
+var rooms: Array = []          # [Rect2 (x, z), depth from the entrance]
+var spots: Array = []
+var lights: Array = []         # torch positions (dungeon-local)
+var _solids: Array = []
+var _grid := {}
+var _task := -1
+var _out := {}
+var _lamps: Array = []         # the torches' lights: on the torches nearest you
+var _lamp_t := 0.0
+
+
+func setup(pl: CosmosPlanet, s: Dictionary) -> void:
+	planet = pl
+	site = s
+	style = str(s.get("kind", "dungeon"))
+	name = "Dungeon" if style == "dungeon" else "Cave"
+	add_to_group("cam_solid")
+	set_meta("cam_reach", CELL * 8.0)
+	var seed: int = s["seed"]
+	var st := style
+	_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): _out = _make(st, seed), false, "dungeon")
+
+
+func poll() -> bool:
+	if built:
+		return true
+	if _task < 0 or not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_task):
+		return false
+	WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+	_task = -1
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.mesh = _out["mesh"]
+	mi.material_override = CosmosTown.material(style)
+	add_child(mi)
+	var flames := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	flames.mesh = _out["flames"]
+	var fm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	fm.albedo_color = Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.12)
+	fm.emission_enabled = true
+	fm.emission = Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.08) * 2.5
+	flames.material_override = fm
+	flames.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	add_child(flames)
+	var rocks: PackedFloat32Array = _out["rocks"]
+	if rocks.size() > 0:   # (a cave's boulders, one draw)
+		var mm := MultiMesh.new()
+		mm.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+		mm.mesh = CosmosPlanet.rock_mesh()
+		mm.instance_count = rocks.size() / 12
+		mm.buffer = rocks
+		var mmi := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+		mmi.multimesh = mm
+		mmi.material_override = CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.3, 0.26, 0.22), 0.0, 0.92)
+		add_child(mmi)
+	_solids = _out["solids"]
+	_grid = _out["grid"]
+	spots = _out["spots"]
+	rooms = _out["rooms"]
+	start = _out["start"]
+	exit_at = _out["exit"]
+	chest_at = _out["chest"]
+	lights = _out["lights"]
+	for p in lights.slice(0, LAMPS):   # (the torches' light, no shadows: moved to the ones round you)
+		var l := OmniLight3D.new()
+		l.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.3)
+		l.light_energy = 4.0
+		l.omni_range = 12.0
+		l.omni_attenuation = 1.0
+		l.shadow_enabled = false
+		l.position = p
+		add_child(l)
+		_lamps.append(l)
+	_out = {}
+	built = true
+	return true
+
+
+## Every so often the lights go to the torches nearest the camera (paced by time).
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not built or lights.size() <= LAMPS:
+		return
+	_lamp_t -= delta
+	if _lamp_t > 0.0:
+		return
+	_lamp_t = 0.4
+	var cam := get_viewport().get_camera_3d()
+	if cam == null:
+		return
+	var at := to_local(cam.global_position)
+	var near := lights.duplicate()
+	near.sort_custom(func(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): return a.distance_squared_to(at) < b.distance_squared_to(at))
+	for i in _lamps.size():
+		(_lamps[i] as OmniLight3D).position = near[i]
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	if _task >= 0:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+
+
+# --- The walker's deck --------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func floor_y(hl: Vector3) -> float:
+	return floor_top(hl)
+
+
+func ceiling_y(hl: Vector3) -> float:
+	var best := H + 3.0
+	for i in _grid.get(_cell(hl), PackedInt32Array()):
+		var b: AABB = _solids[i]
+		if hl.x > b.position.x and hl.z > b.position.z and hl.x < b.end.x and hl.z < b.end.z and b.position.y > hl.y + 1.0:
+			best = minf(best, b.position.y)
+	return best
+
+
+func confine(hl: Vector3, r: float) -> Vector3:
+	return hl + push(hl, r)
+
+
+func _cell(p: Vector3) -> Vector2i:
+	return Vector2i(floori(p.x / CosmosTown.CELL), floori(p.z / CosmosTown.CELL))
+
+
+func floor_top(p: Vector3) -> float:
+	var best := -50.0
+	for i in _grid.get(_cell(p), PackedInt32Array()):
+		var b: AABB = _solids[i]
+		if p.x < b.position.x or p.z < b.position.z or p.x > b.end.x or p.z > b.end.z:
+			continue
+		if b.end.y <= p.y + CosmosTown.STEP and b.end.y > best:
+			best = b.end.y
+	return best
+
+
+func push(p: Vector3, r: float) -> Vector3:
+	var out := Vector3.ZERO
+	for i in _grid.get(_cell(p), PackedInt32Array()):
+		var b: AABB = _solids[i]
+		if b.end.y <= p.y + CosmosTown.STEP or b.position.y >= p.y + 1.8:
+			continue
+		var q := p + out
+		var dx0 := q.x - (b.position.x - r)
+		var dx1 := (b.end.x + r) - q.x
+		var dz0 := q.z - (b.position.z - r)
+		var dz1 := (b.end.z + r) - q.z
+		if dx0 <= 0.0 or dx1 <= 0.0 or dz0 <= 0.0 or dz1 <= 0.0:
+			continue
+		var m := minf(minf(dx0, dx1), minf(dz0, dz1))
+		if m == dx0:
+			out.x -= dx0
+		elif m == dx1:
+			out.x += dx1
+		elif m == dz0:
+			out.z -= dz0
+		else:
+			out.z += dz1
+	return out
+
+
+## A line through it (the camera, your bolts, the sights): where it first meets a block, or INF.
+func cam_hit(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, limit: float) -> float:
+	if not built:
+		return INF
+	var lo := to_local(o)
+	var ld := global_basis.inverse() * dir
+	var seen := {}
+	var best := INF
+	var steps := int(limit / (CosmosTown.CELL * 0.5)) + 1
+	for k in mini(steps, 60) + 1:
+		var p := lo + ld * minf(k * CosmosTown.CELL * 0.5, limit)
+		for i in _grid.get(_cell(p), PackedInt32Array()):
+			if seen.has(i):
+				continue
+			seen[i] = true
+			var t := CosmosTown._ray_box(lo, ld, _solids[i], minf(limit, best))
+			if t < best:
+				best = t
+	return best
+
+
+## Indoors everywhere (the light that goes with you).
+func indoors(_p: Vector3) -> bool:
+	return true
+
+
+# --- The layout (on a worker) ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func _make(st: String, seed: int) -> Dictionary:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = seed
+	var n := 5
+	# A tree of rooms over the grid, from the entrance (west edge, middle).
+	var start_c := Vector2i(0, n / 2)
+	var depth := {start_c: 0}
+	var parent := {}
+	var frontier: Array = [start_c]
+	var want := rng.randi_range(9, 13)
+	while depth.size() < want and not frontier.is_empty():
+		var c: Vector2i = frontier[rng.randi() % frontier.size()]
+		var opts: Array = []
+		for d in [Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(-1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), Vector2i(0, -1)]:
+			var nb: Vector2i = c + d
+			if nb.x >= 0 and nb.y >= 0 and nb.x < n and nb.y < n and not depth.has(nb):
+				opts.append(nb)
+		if opts.is_empty():
+			frontier.erase(c)
+			continue
+		var nb: Vector2i = opts[rng.randi() % opts.size()]
+		depth[nb] = int(depth[c]) + 1
+		parent[nb] = c
+		frontier.append(nb)
+	var deepest := start_c
+	for c in depth:
+		if int(depth[c]) > int(depth[deepest]):
+			deepest = c
+	var b := CosmosTown.Builder.new()
+	b.rng.seed = seed + 1
+	b.taper = 1.35
+	var W := CELL * n
+	# The floor and the roof over all of it.
+	b.box(Vector3(-2, -0.6, -2), Vector3(W + 2, 0.0, W + 2), CosmosTown.STONE)
+	b.box(Vector3(-2, H, -2), Vector3(W + 2, H + 0.6, W + 2), CosmosTown.ROOF)
+	var rects := {}
+	var out_rooms: Array = []
+	for c in depth:
+		var size := Vector2(rng.randf_range(8.0, 12.0), rng.randf_range(8.0, 12.0)) if c != start_c else Vector2(9, 9)
+		var ctr := Vector2((c.x + 0.5) * CELL, (c.y + 0.5) * CELL)
+		var r := Rect2(ctr - size * 0.5, size)
+		rects[c] = r
+		out_rooms.append([r, int(depth[c])])
+	# Walls round every room, a doorway where a corridor meets it; the corridors' walls.
+	var links := {}
+	for c in parent:
+		links[[c, parent[c]]] = true
+		links[[parent[c], c]] = true
+	var flames: Array = []
+	var torch_pos: Array = []
+	var rocks := PackedFloat32Array()   # (a cave's: boulders lining its walls, lumps overhead - one multimesh)
+	for c in depth:
+		var r: Rect2 = rects[c]
+		for side in 4:
+			var d: Vector2i = [Vector2i(-1, 0), Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(0, -1), Vector2i(0, 1)][side]
+			var open := links.has([c, c + d])
+			_room_wall(b, r, side, open)
+			if open and (side == 1 or side == 3):
+				_corridor(b, r, rects[c + d], side == 1)
+		# Its torches (two a room), its dressing.
+		for k in 2:
+			var tp := Vector3(r.position.x + WALL + 0.25, 2.6, r.position.y + r.size.y * (0.3 + 0.4 * k)) if k == 0 else Vector3(r.end.x - WALL - 0.25, 2.6, r.position.y + r.size.y * 0.6)
+			b.box(tp + Vector3(-0.08, -0.5, -0.08), tp + Vector3(0.08, 0.0, 0.08), CosmosTown.BLACK, false)
+			flames.append(tp)
+			torch_pos.append(tp + Vector3(0, 0.3, 0))
+		if st == "cave":
+			var per := 2.0 * (r.size.x + r.size.y)
+			for k in int(per / 1.4):
+				var t := float(k) / int(per / 1.4) * per
+				var p: Vector3
+				if t < r.size.x:
+					p = Vector3(r.position.x + t, 0, r.position.y)
+				elif t < r.size.x + r.size.y:
+					p = Vector3(r.end.x, 0, r.position.y + t - r.size.x)
+				elif t < 2.0 * r.size.x + r.size.y:
+					p = Vector3(r.end.x - (t - r.size.x - r.size.y), 0, r.end.y)
+				else:
+					p = Vector3(r.position.x, 0, r.end.y - (t - 2.0 * r.size.x - r.size.y))
+				# (not in a doorway)
+				var c2 := r.get_center()
+				if (absf(p.x - c2.x) < 2.0 and (absf(p.z - r.position.y) < 0.1 or absf(p.z - r.end.y) < 0.1)) or (absf(p.z - c2.y) < 2.0 and (absf(p.x - r.position.x) < 0.1 or absf(p.x - r.end.x) < 0.1)):
+					continue
+				var sc := rng.randf_range(0.55, 1.0)
+				var bas := Basis.from_euler(Vector3(rng.randf() * TAU, rng.randf() * TAU, rng.randf() * TAU)).scaled(Vector3(sc, sc * rng.randf_range(1.0, 1.8), sc))
+				var outward := (p - Vector3(c2.x, 0, c2.y))
+				outward = Vector3(signf(outward.x) if absf(p.x - r.position.x) < 0.1 or absf(p.x - r.end.x) < 0.1 else 0.0, 0,
+					signf(outward.z) if absf(p.z - r.position.y) < 0.1 or absf(p.z - r.end.y) < 0.1 else 0.0)
+				_rock(rocks, Transform3D(bas, p + outward * 0.5 + Vector3(0, rng.randf_range(0.0, 2.2), 0)))   # (set into the wall)
+			for k in int(r.size.x * r.size.y / 14.0):   # (lumps overhead)
+				var p := Vector3(rng.randf_range(r.position.x, r.end.x), H - 0.2, rng.randf_range(r.position.y, r.end.y))
+				var sc := rng.randf_range(0.6, 1.3)
+				_rock(rocks, Transform3D(Basis.from_euler(Vector3(rng.randf() * TAU, rng.randf() * TAU, 0)).scaled(Vector3(sc, sc * 0.5, sc)), p + Vector3(0, 0.3, 0)))
+			for k in rng.randi_range(4, 9):   # (boulders along the walls, stalagmites)
+				var p := Vector3(rng.randf_range(r.position.x + 1.0, r.end.x - 1.0), 0, rng.randf_range(r.position.y + 1.0, r.end.y - 1.0))
+				var near_edge := minf(minf(p.x - r.position.x, r.end.x - p.x), minf(p.z - r.position.y, r.end.y - p.z)) < 2.2
+				if near_edge:
+					var sz := rng.randf_range(0.8, 2.2)
+					b.box(p - Vector3(sz, 0, sz) * 0.5, p + Vector3(sz * 0.5, sz * rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.2), sz * 0.5), CosmosTown.WALL)
+				elif rng.randf() < 0.5:
+					var hh := rng.randf_range(0.6, 2.4)
+					b.box(p - Vector3(0.25, 0, 0.25), p + Vector3(0.25, hh, 0.25), CosmosTown.STONE)
+					b.box(p - Vector3(0.12, -hh, 0.12), p + Vector3(0.12, hh + 0.4, 0.12), CosmosTown.STONE)
+				var drip := p + Vector3(rng.randf_range(-1, 1), 0, rng.randf_range(-1, 1))   # (stalactites, overhead)
+				b.box(drip + Vector3(-0.2, H - rng.randf_range(0.6, 1.6), -0.2), drip + Vector3(0.2, H, 0.2), CosmosTown.STONE, false)
+		elif r.size.x > 9.5 and r.size.y > 9.5 and c != start_c:
+			for k in 4:   # (the old labyrinth's pillars - red, wider at the top)
+				var p := Vector3(r.position.x + r.size.x * (0.3 if k % 2 == 0 else 0.7), 0, r.position.y + r.size.y * (0.3 if k < 2 else 0.7))
+				b.column(p, H, 0.35)
+		b.spots.append(Vector3(r.get_center().x, 0, r.get_center().y))
+	# The entrance: stairs up against the west wall of the first room.
+	var sr: Rect2 = rects[start_c]
+	b.stairs(Vector3(sr.position.x + WALL + 0.3, 0.0, sr.get_center().y), Vector3(1, 0, 0), 6, 2.4, 0.4, 0.5)
+	var exit := Vector3(sr.position.x + WALL + 3.6, 0.0, sr.get_center().y)
+	var start := Vector3(sr.position.x + WALL + 4.5, 0.0, sr.get_center().y)
+	# The chest in the deepest room, on a dais; horns on it in the labyrinth.
+	var dr: Rect2 = rects[deepest]
+	var chest := Vector3(dr.get_center().x, 0.3, dr.get_center().y)
+	b.box(chest + Vector3(-1.6, -0.3, -1.2), chest + Vector3(1.6, 0.0, 1.2), CosmosTown.STONE)
+	b.box(chest + Vector3(-0.6, 0.0, -0.4), chest + Vector3(0.6, 0.7, 0.4), CosmosTown.WOOD)
+	b.box(chest + Vector3(-0.65, 0.7, -0.45), chest + Vector3(0.65, 0.8, 0.45), CosmosTown.TRIM, false)
+	if st == "dungeon":
+		b.horns(chest + Vector3(0, 0.0, -1.0), true)
+	# The flames: a separate mesh (they glow).
+	var fb := CosmosTown.Builder.new()
+	for p: Vector3 in flames:
+		fb.box(p + Vector3(-0.1, 0.0, -0.1), p + Vector3(0.1, 0.32, 0.1), 0, false)
+	return {"mesh": b.mesh(), "flames": fb.mesh(), "solids": b.solids, "grid": b.grid(), "spots": b.spots, "rooms": out_rooms,
+		"start": start, "exit": exit, "chest": chest, "lights": torch_pos, "rocks": rocks}
+
+
+## A labyrinth room's things: storage jars in its corners, the bones of the
+## ones who came before (heaps of them, a skull), a bench along a wall.
+static func _dress(b: CosmosTown.Builder, rng: RandomNumberGenerator, r: Rect2) -> void:
+	var m := 1.0
+	var corners := [Vector3(r.position.x + m, 0, r.position.y + m), Vector3(r.end.x - m, 0, r.position.y + m),
+		Vector3(r.position.x + m, 0, r.end.y - m), Vector3(r.end.x - m, 0, r.end.y - m)]
+	for k in corners.size():
+		match rng.randi() % 3:
+			0:
+				b._jar(corners[k])
+				if rng.randf() < 0.5:
+					b._jar(corners[k] + Vector3(0.9 * (1.0 if k % 2 == 0 else -1.0), 0, 0))
+			1:   # (bones: long ones strewn, a skull)
+				var at: Vector3 = corners[k] + Vector3(0.6 * (1.0 if k % 2 == 0 else -1.0), 0, 0.6 * (1.0 if k < 2 else -1.0))
+				for j in rng.randi_range(3, 6):
+					var o := at + Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.7, 0.7), 0.0, rng.randf_range(-0.7, 0.7))
+					if rng.randf() < 0.5:
+						b.box(o + Vector3(-0.35, 0, -0.04), o + Vector3(0.35, 0.07, 0.04), CosmosTown.HORNS, false)
+					else:
+						b.box(o + Vector3(-0.04, 0, -0.35), o + Vector3(0.04, 0.07, 0.35), CosmosTown.HORNS, false)
+				b.box(at + Vector3(-0.1, 0, -0.12), at + Vector3(0.1, 0.18, 0.12), CosmosTown.HORNS, false)
+	if rng.randf() < 0.5:   # (a stone bench)
+		var z := r.position.y + 0.3
+		b.box(Vector3(r.get_center().x - 1.8, 0, z), Vector3(r.get_center().x - 0.6, 0.45, z + 0.5), CosmosTown.STONE)
+		b.box(Vector3(r.get_center().x + 0.6, 0, z), Vector3(r.get_center().x + 1.8, 0.45, z + 0.5), CosmosTown.STONE)
+
+
+static func _rock(buf: PackedFloat32Array, t: Transform3D) -> void:
+	var b := t.basis
+	buf.append_array([b.x.x, b.y.x, b.z.x, t.origin.x, b.x.y, b.y.y, b.z.y, t.origin.y, b.x.z, b.y.z, b.z.z, t.origin.z])
+
+
+## One side of a room's walls (0 -x, 1 +x, 2 -z, 3 +z), a doorway in its middle if `open`.
+static func _room_wall(b: CosmosTown.Builder, r: Rect2, side: int, open: bool) -> void:
+	var gap := 3.0
+	var a: Vector3
+	var e: Vector3
+	match side:
+		0: a = Vector3(r.position.x - WALL, 0, r.position.y - WALL); e = Vector3(r.position.x, H, r.end.y + WALL)
+		1: a = Vector3(r.end.x, 0, r.position.y - WALL); e = Vector3(r.end.x + WALL, H, r.end.y + WALL)
+		2: a = Vector3(r.position.x, 0, r.position.y - WALL); e = Vector3(r.end.x, H, r.position.y)
+		_: a = Vector3(r.position.x, 0, r.end.y); e = Vector3(r.end.x, H, r.end.y + WALL)
+	if not open:
+		b.box(a, e, CosmosTown.WALL)
+		return
+	var ax := 2 if side < 2 else 0
+	var mid := (a[ax] + e[ax]) * 0.5
+	var e1 := e
+	e1[ax] = mid - gap * 0.5
+	b.box(a, e1, CosmosTown.WALL)
+	var a2 := a
+	a2[ax] = mid + gap * 0.5
+	b.box(a2, e, CosmosTown.WALL)
+
+
+## The walls of the way from room `r` to the next (`along_x`: to the east, else south).
+static func _corridor(b: CosmosTown.Builder, r: Rect2, r2: Rect2, along_x: bool) -> void:
+	var gap := 3.0
+	if along_x:
+		var z := r.get_center().y
+		var x0 := r.end.x + WALL
+		var x1 := r2.position.x - WALL
+		b.box(Vector3(x0, 0, z - gap * 0.5 - WALL), Vector3(x1, H, z - gap * 0.5), CosmosTown.WALL)
+		b.box(Vector3(x0, 0, z + gap * 0.5), Vector3(x1, H, z + gap * 0.5 + WALL), CosmosTown.WALL)
+	else:
+		var x := r.get_center().x
+		var z0 := r.end.y + WALL
+		var z1 := r2.position.y - WALL
+		b.box(Vector3(x - gap * 0.5 - WALL, 0, z0), Vector3(x - gap * 0.5, H, z1), CosmosTown.WALL)
+		b.box(Vector3(x + gap * 0.5, 0, z0), Vector3(x + gap * 0.5 + WALL, H, z1), CosmosTown.WALL)

+## (stripes, spots, plain) from the planet's palette, a temper (grazers that

files.explanation: The 3D world - life on the planets: A planet's plants in the 3D game (stage 3): a handful of species designed from the planet's seed and type - trees (round-crowned or spired), bushes, grass, crystals, fungi, cacti - each its own small mesh built here (vertex colours from the planet's palette, an alien hue now and then), and the rules for where it grows (heights, slopes, how thick). CosmosPlanet builds the designs on a worker at its setup and scatters them on its finest patches (MultiMeshes - one draw a species a patch); they sway in the wind (flora.gdshader). Thread-safe: designs are plain data (mesh arrays). var species := CosmosFlora.design(shape, seed) # [{kind, arrays, ...}]

@@ -1,0 +1,264 @@ 
+class_name CosmosFlora
+extends RefCounted
+## A planet's plants in the 3D game (stage 3): a handful of species designed
+## from the planet's seed and type - trees (round-crowned or spired), bushes,
+## grass, crystals, fungi, cacti - each its own small mesh built here (vertex
+## colours from the planet's palette, an alien hue now and then), and the
+## rules for where it grows (heights, slopes, how thick). CosmosPlanet builds
+## the designs on a worker at its setup and scatters them on its finest
+## patches (MultiMeshes - one draw a species a patch); they sway in the wind
+## (flora.gdshader). Thread-safe: designs are plain data (mesh arrays).
+##   var species := CosmosFlora.design(shape, seed)   # [{kind, arrays, ...}]
+
+const KINDS_BY_TYPE := {
+	"ocean": ["tree", "bush", "grass", "flower"],
+	"ice": ["spire", "crystal", "grass"],
+	"volcanic": ["crystal", "fungus", "cactus"],
+	"moon": ["crystal"],
+	"rocky": ["cactus", "fungus", "grass"],
+}
+
+
+## The species of a planet (its PlanetShape and seed).
+static func design(shape: PlanetShape, seed: int, type: String) -> Array:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = seed * 31 + 7
+	var kinds: Array = KINDS_BY_TYPE.get(type, KINDS_BY_TYPE["rocky"])
+	var L := shape.look
+	var leaf: Color = L.get("land_mid", Color(0.3, 0.5, 0.3))
+	var alt: Color = L.get("biome_color", leaf)
+	var out: Array = []
+	for i in kinds.size():
+		var kind: String = kinds[i]
+		var c1 := leaf.lerp(alt, rng.randf() * 0.6)
+		if rng.randf() < 0.25:
+			c1 = Color.from_hsv(rng.randf(), rng.randf_range(0.4, 0.8), rng.randf_range(0.4, 0.8))   # (an alien hue)
+		c1 = c1.lightened(rng.randf_range(-0.1, 0.15))
+		var sp := {"kind": kind, "color": c1, "density": 1.0, "min_h": 0.05, "max_h": 1.6, "max_slope": 0.35,
+			"size": Vector2(0.8, 1.3), "solid": 0.0, "glow": 0.0}
+		match kind:
+			"tree":
+				sp["arrays"] = _tree(rng, c1, Color(0.35, 0.24, 0.16).lerp(c1, 0.15))
+				sp["density"] = rng.randf_range(0.25, 0.9)
+				sp["size"] = Vector2(0.7, 1.5)
+				sp["solid"] = 0.45
+			"spire":
+				sp["arrays"] = _spire(rng, c1.darkened(0.2), Color(0.3, 0.22, 0.16))
+				sp["density"] = rng.randf_range(0.25, 0.8)
+				sp["size"] = Vector2(0.7, 1.4)
+				sp["solid"] = 0.35
+			"bush":
+				sp["arrays"] = _blob(rng, c1.darkened(0.1), 0.9, 0.7)
+				sp["density"] = rng.randf_range(1.0, 3.0)
+				sp["size"] = Vector2(0.5, 1.4)
+			"grass":
+				sp["arrays"] = _grass(rng, c1.lightened(0.05))
+				sp["density"] = rng.randf_range(12.0, 22.0)
+				sp["size"] = Vector2(0.7, 1.3)
+				sp["max_slope"] = 0.45
+			"flower":
+				sp["arrays"] = _flower(rng, Color.from_hsv(rng.randf(), 0.7, 0.95), c1)
+				sp["density"] = rng.randf_range(2.0, 6.0)
+				sp["size"] = Vector2(0.7, 1.2)
+			"crystal":
+				var cc := Color.from_hsv(rng.randf(), rng.randf_range(0.5, 0.9), 0.95)
+				if type == "volcanic":
+					cc = (L.get("lava_color", Color(1.0, 0.4, 0.1)) as Color)
+				sp["arrays"] = _crystal(rng, cc)
+				sp["density"] = rng.randf_range(0.4, 1.5)
+				sp["size"] = Vector2(0.5, 2.0)
+				sp["glow"] = 1.6
+				sp["min_h"] = -0.2
+				sp["max_slope"] = 0.7
+				sp["solid"] = 0.3
+			"fungus":
+				sp["arrays"] = _fungus(rng, Color.from_hsv(rng.randf(), 0.6, 0.85), Color(0.85, 0.8, 0.7))
+				sp["density"] = rng.randf_range(0.8, 3.0)
+				sp["size"] = Vector2(0.6, 2.2)
+				sp["glow"] = 0.6 if rng.randf() < 0.5 else 0.0
+				sp["min_h"] = -0.3
+			"cactus":
+				sp["arrays"] = _cactus(rng, c1.darkened(0.15))
+				sp["density"] = rng.randf_range(0.4, 1.4)
+				sp["size"] = Vector2(0.7, 1.5)
+				sp["solid"] = 0.35
+		out.append(sp)
+	return out
+
+
+# --- Meshes (unit-ish, standing on y = 0) -----------------------------------------
+
+static func _begin() -> SurfaceTool:
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	return st
+
+
+static func _end(st: SurfaceTool) -> Array:
+	st.generate_normals()
+	return st.commit_to_arrays()
+
+
+## One triangle, wound so its front faces `out` (Godot's front faces wind
+## clockwise: their normal is (c - a) x (b - a)).
+static func _tri(st: SurfaceTool, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, out: Vector3, cols: Array, glow: float) -> void:
+	var pts := [a, b, c]
+	var order := [0, 1, 2] if (c - a).cross(b - a).dot(out) >= 0.0 else [0, 2, 1]
+	for k in order:
+		st.set_color(cols[k])
+		st.set_uv(Vector2(glow, (pts[k] as Vector3).y))
+		st.add_vertex(pts[k])
+
+
+## A tapered tube from `a` to `b`, radii ra -> rb, n sides.
+static func _tube(st: SurfaceTool, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, ra: float, rb: float, n: int, col: Color, glow := 0.0) -> void:
+	var ax := (b - a).normalized()
+	var p := ax.cross(Vector3.RIGHT if absf(ax.x) < 0.9 else Vector3.FORWARD).normalized()
+	var q := ax.cross(p)
+	for i in n:
+		var a0 := TAU * i / n
+		var a1 := TAU * (i + 1) / n
+		var d0 := p * cos(a0) + q * sin(a0)
+		var d1 := p * cos(a1) + q * sin(a1)
+		var v := [a + d0 * ra, b + d0 * rb, b + d1 * rb, a + d1 * ra]
+		var out := (d0 + d1).normalized()
+		_tri(st, v[0], v[1], v[2], out, [col, col, col], glow)
+		_tri(st, v[0], v[2], v[3], out, [col, col, col], glow)
+
+
+## A lumpy ball (an icosphere-ish sphere pushed about), centre `c`, radii `r`.
+static func _lump(st: SurfaceTool, rng: RandomNumberGenerator, c: Vector3, r: Vector3, col: Color, glow := 0.0, seg := 7) -> void:
+	var bumps := [rng.randf() * TAU, rng.randf() * TAU, rng.randf_range(0.1, 0.25)]
+	var pts := []
+	for j in seg + 1:
+		var row := []
+		var th := PI * j / seg
+		for i in seg * 2:
+			var ph := TAU * i / (seg * 2)
+			var d := Vector3(sin(th) * cos(ph), cos(th), sin(th) * sin(ph))
+			var k: float = 1.0 + bumps[2] * sin(ph * 3.0 + bumps[0]) * sin(th * 2.0 + bumps[1])
+			row.append(c + d * r * k)
+		pts.append(row)
+	for j in seg:
+		for i in seg * 2:
+			var i2 := (i + 1) % (seg * 2)
+			var v := [pts[j][i], pts[j][i2], pts[j + 1][i2], pts[j + 1][i]]
+			var shade := 0.8 + 0.25 * (1.0 - float(j) / seg)
+			var cc := col * Color(shade, shade, shade)
+			var out: Vector3 = (v[0] + v[2]) * 0.5 - c
+			_tri(st, v[0], v[1], v[2], out, [cc, cc, cc], glow)
+			_tri(st, v[0], v[2], v[3], out, [cc, cc, cc], glow)
+
+
+static func _tree(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, leaf: Color, bark: Color) -> Array:
+	var st := _begin()
+	var h := rng.randf_range(4.0, 8.0)
+	var bend := Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6), 0, rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6))
+	_tube(st, Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(0, h * 0.55, 0) + bend * 0.5, 0.35, 0.22, 6, bark)
+	_tube(st, Vector3(0, h * 0.55, 0) + bend * 0.5, Vector3(0, h * 0.85, 0) + bend, 0.22, 0.12, 6, bark)
+	var crowns := rng.randi_range(2, 5)
+	for i in crowns:
+		var r := rng.randf_range(1.2, 2.2) * h / 6.0
+		var at := Vector3(rng.randf_range(-1.2, 1.2), h * rng.randf_range(0.65, 0.95), rng.randf_range(-1.2, 1.2)) + bend
+		_lump(st, rng, at, Vector3(r, r * rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.0), r), leaf.lightened(rng.randf_range(-0.12, 0.12)))
+	return _end(st)
+
+
+static func _spire(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, leaf: Color, bark: Color) -> Array:
+	# A conifer: stacked cones round a trunk.
+	var st := _begin()
+	var h := rng.randf_range(5.0, 10.0)
+	_tube(st, Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(0, h * 0.3, 0), 0.3, 0.25, 6, bark)
+	var tiers := rng.randi_range(3, 5)
+	for i in tiers:
+		var y := h * (0.2 + 0.75 * float(i) / tiers)
+		var r := (1.0 - float(i) / tiers) * h * 0.28 + 0.3
+		_tube(st, Vector3(0, y, 0), Vector3(0, y + h * 0.32, 0), r, 0.05, 8, leaf.lightened(0.05 * i))
+	return _end(st)
+
+
+static func _blob(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, col: Color, w: float, hh: float) -> Array:
+	var st := _begin()
+	for i in rng.randi_range(2, 4):
+		var r := rng.randf_range(0.4, 0.75) * w
+		_lump(st, rng, Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.5, 0.5), r * hh, rng.randf_range(-0.5, 0.5)), Vector3(r, r * hh, r), col.lightened(rng.randf_range(-0.1, 0.1)), 0.0, 5)
+	return _end(st)
+
+
+static func _grass(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, col: Color) -> Array:
+	# A tuft of blades, each a thin bent triangle (both sides).
+	var st := _begin()
+	for i in rng.randi_range(6, 11):
+		var a := rng.randf() * TAU
+		var base := Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)) * rng.randf_range(0.0, 0.25)
+		var lean := Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)) * rng.randf_range(0.1, 0.35)
+		var h := rng.randf_range(0.35, 0.8)
+		var side := Vector3(-sin(a), 0, cos(a)) * 0.05
+		var tip := base + lean + Vector3(0, h, 0)
+		var c := col.lightened(rng.randf_range(-0.12, 0.12))
+		for tri in [[base - side, tip, base + side], [base + side, tip, base - side]]:
+			for v in tri:
+				st.set_color(c * Color(0.7, 0.7, 0.7) if v != tip else c)
+				st.set_uv(Vector2(0.0, (v as Vector3).y))
+				st.add_vertex(v)
+	return _end(st)
+
+
+static func _flower(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, petal: Color, stem: Color) -> Array:
+	var st := _begin()
+	for i in rng.randi_range(2, 5):
+		var at := Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.3, 0.3), 0, rng.randf_range(-0.3, 0.3))
+		var h := rng.randf_range(0.3, 0.7)
+		_tube(st, at, at + Vector3(0, h, 0), 0.025, 0.02, 4, stem)
+		_lump(st, rng, at + Vector3(0, h, 0), Vector3(0.12, 0.06, 0.12), petal, 0.15, 4)
+	return _end(st)
+
+
+static func _crystal(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, col: Color) -> Array:
+	var st := _begin()
+	for i in rng.randi_range(3, 7):
+		var dir := Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.5, 0.5), 1.0, rng.randf_range(-0.5, 0.5)).normalized()
+		var h := rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.6)
+		var r := rng.randf_range(0.08, 0.22)
+		var base := Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.25, 0.25), -0.1, rng.randf_range(-0.25, 0.25))
+		var c := col.lightened(rng.randf_range(-0.15, 0.2))
+		_tube(st, base, base + dir * h, r, r, 6, c, 1.0)
+		_tube(st, base + dir * h, base + dir * (h + r * 2.2), r, 0.0, 6, c.lightened(0.2), 1.0)
+	return _end(st)
+
+
+static func _fungus(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, cap: Color, stem: Color) -> Array:
+	var st := _begin()
+	for i in rng.randi_range(1, 4):
+		var at := Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6), 0, rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6))
+		var h := rng.randf_range(0.4, 1.6)
+		var r := rng.randf_range(0.3, 0.8) * h
+		_tube(st, at, at + Vector3(0, h, 0), r * 0.2, r * 0.15, 6, stem)
+		_lump(st, rng, at + Vector3(0, h, 0), Vector3(r, r * 0.45, r), cap.lightened(rng.randf_range(-0.1, 0.1)), 0.5, 6)
+	return _end(st)
+
+
+static func _cactus(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, col: Color) -> Array:
+	var st := _begin()
+	var h := rng.randf_range(1.5, 3.5)
+	_tube(st, Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(0, h, 0), 0.3, 0.26, 8, col)
+	_lump(st, rng, Vector3(0, h, 0), Vector3(0.26, 0.2, 0.26), col, 0.0, 4)
+	for i in rng.randi_range(0, 3):
+		var a := rng.randf() * TAU
+		var d := Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a))
+		var y := h * rng.randf_range(0.3, 0.6)
+		var elbow := Vector3(0, y, 0) + d * 0.7
+		_tube(st, Vector3(0, y, 0), elbow, 0.16, 0.16, 6, col)
+		_tube(st, elbow, elbow + Vector3(0, rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.0), 0), 0.16, 0.13, 6, col)
+	return _end(st)
+
+
+## Where a species grows: `h` metres above the sea (or the radius), `slope`
+## 0 flat .. 1 sheer, `snow` true over the snow line.
+static func grows(sp: Dictionary, shape: PlanetShape, h: float, slope: float) -> bool:
+	var hn := h / maxf(shape.amp, 1.0)
+	if hn < float(sp["min_h"]) or hn > float(sp["max_h"]) or slope > float(sp["max_slope"]):
+		return false
+	if shape.sea > 0 and h < 0.6 and sp["kind"] != "crystal":
+		return false
+	return true

files.explanation: The 3D world - life on the planets: A pirate android on a planet in the 3D game (stage 3): its actual model (art/pirate_3d - rendered from Blender's pirate.blend; its cel shaders and clips: walk, guard, gun_idle, gun_walk, fire, hit, ko). It guards its camp - pacing about it - until you come within SIGHT: then it raises its rifle, keeps 14-26 m from you, strafing, and fires bolts (CosmosBolt, a little wide - the further, the wider). Hit, it flinches; at no health it drops (ko) and is gone a few seconds later. Or a town's citizen (citizen_of): the automaton's model in its empire's colours (CosmosModels' recolouring), walking between the town's open spots, pausing, turning to look at you when you come close.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,406 @@ 
+class_name CosmosNpc
+extends Node3D
+## A pirate android on a planet in the 3D game (stage 3): its actual model
+## (art/pirate_3d - rendered from Blender's pirate.blend; its cel shaders and
+## clips: walk, guard, gun_idle, gun_walk, fire, hit, ko). It guards its camp
+## - pacing about it - until you come within SIGHT: then it raises its rifle,
+## keeps 14-26 m from you, strafing, and fires bolts (CosmosBolt, a little
+## wide - the further, the wider). Hit, it flinches; at no health it drops
+## (ko) and is gone a few seconds later.
+## Or a town's citizen (citizen_of): the automaton's model in its empire's
+## colours (CosmosModels' recolouring), walking between the town's open
+## spots, pausing, turning to look at you when you come close.
+
+const SIGHT := 48.0
+const SPEED := 3.0
+const FIRE_EVERY := 1.15
+const DAMAGE := 7.0
+
+var planet: CosmosPlanet
+var cosmos: Node
+var camp := Vector3.ZERO         # planet-local
+var hp := 80.0
+var max_hp := 80.0
+var dead := false
+var reach := 0.55
+var facing := Vector3.FORWARD
+var _goal := Vector3.ZERO
+var _t := 0.0
+var _fire := 0.0
+var _anim: AnimationPlayer
+var _clip := ""
+var _strafe := 1.0
+var _dead_t := 0.0
+var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+var label := "Pirate android"
+var town: CosmosTown = null      # (a citizen's)
+var _tl := Vector3.ZERO          # (a citizen's place, town-local)
+var _wait := 0.0
+
+
+var model_id := "pirate"
+var weapon := ""                 # (a townsperson's: rifle, bow, axe - or none)
+var role := "pirate"             # pirate, guard (armed townsfolk), kilon
+var _foe: Node3D = null
+var _scan := 0.0
+const WEAPON_HIDE := {"rifle": ["MIN_Bow", "MIN_Axe"], "bow": ["MIN_Rifle", "MIN_Axe"], "axe": ["MIN_Rifle", "MIN_Bow"]}
+const WEAPON_NAME := {"rifle": "laser rifle", "bow": "laser bow", "axe": "labrys"}
+
+
+var dungeon: CosmosDungeon = null   # (the dead's: a skeleton's, a demon's)
+var scale_k := 1.0
+
+
+## One of a dungeon's dead: "skeleton" (a sword and a shield), "demon"
+## (claws and fire), `boss`: the demon lord by its chest.
+func foe_of(d: CosmosDungeon, seed: int, kind: String, boss := false) -> void:
+	dungeon = d
+	planet = d.planet
+	_rng.seed = seed
+	role = kind
+	model_id = kind
+	if kind == "skeleton":
+		label = "Skeleton warrior"
+		max_hp = 60.0
+	else:
+		label = "Demon lord" if boss else "Demon"
+		max_hp = 600.0 if boss else 150.0
+		scale_k = 1.7 if boss else 1.25
+	hp = max_hp
+	reach = 0.55 * scale_k
+	name = label.replace(" ", "_")
+	_fire = _rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.5)
+
+
+## One of a town's people: in a Minoan town its palace guards and its
+## androids (laser rifle, laser bow or labrys), in another empire's the
+## android in that empire's colours; `kind` "kilon": Kilon Alios.
+func citizen_of(t: CosmosTown, seed: int, kind := "") -> void:
+	town = t
+	planet = t.planet
+	_rng.seed = seed
+	_wait = _rng.randf_range(0.0, 3.0)
+	var empire := str(t.site["empire"])
+	if kind == "kilon":
+		role = "kilon"
+		model_id = "kilon"
+		label = QuestData.KILON
+		name = "KilonAlios"
+		return
+	role = "guard"
+	name = "Citizen"
+	if empire == "minoa" and _rng.randf() < 0.35:
+		model_id = "guard"
+		weapon = "rifle"
+		label = "Minoan palace guard"
+		return
+	model_id = "minoan"
+	weapon = ["rifle", "bow", "axe"][_rng.randi() % 3]
+	label = "%s android (%s)" % [Galaxy.EMPIRES.get(empire, {}).get("short", "Independent"), WEAPON_NAME[weapon]]
+
+
+func setup(pl: CosmosPlanet, camp_local: Vector3, seed: int) -> void:
+	planet = pl
+	camp = camp_local
+	_rng.seed = seed
+	_fire = _rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.5)
+	name = "Pirate"
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	var id := model_id
+	if not Stage3D.has_model(id):
+		id = "player"
+	if Stage3D.has_model(id):
+		var model: Node3D = Stage3D._scene(id).instantiate()
+		model.rotation.y = PI
+		model.scale = Vector3.ONE * scale_k
+		add_child(model)
+		if dungeon:
+			CosmosModels.apply(model, id)
+		elif town:
+			var hide: Array = WEAPON_HIDE.get(weapon, [])
+			var recolor: Array = []
+			var empire := str(town.site["empire"])
+			if id == "minoan" and empire != "minoa":   # (the android in this empire's colours: its slots)
+				var L: Array = CosmosTown.LOOKS.get(empire, CosmosTown.LOOKS[""])
+				var main: Array = L[CosmosTown.WALL]
+				var acc: Array = L[CosmosTown.RED]
+				recolor = [Color(main[0], main[1], main[2], 0.85), Color(acc[0], acc[1], acc[2], 1.0), Color(Galaxy.empire_color(empire), 0.8)]
+			CosmosModels.apply(model, id, recolor, hide)
+			_tl = town.to_local(global_position) if is_inside_tree() else Vector3.ZERO
+		else:
+			CosmosModels.apply(model, id)   # (two draws: its parts merged, colours in the vertices)
+		_anim = model.find_child("AnimationPlayer", true, false)
+		if _anim:
+			for c in ["walk", "guard", "idle", "gun_idle", "gun_walk", "run"]:
+				if _anim.has_animation(c):
+					_anim.get_animation(c).loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR
+	else:
+		var cap := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		var cm := CapsuleMesh.new()
+		cm.radius = 0.4
+		cm.height = 1.9
+		cap.mesh = cm
+		cap.position.y = 0.95
+		add_child(cap)
+	_play("guard" if dungeon else (("gun_idle" if weapon != "" else "idle") if town else "guard"))
+
+
+func up() -> Vector3:
+	if dungeon:
+		return dungeon.global_basis.y
+	return (global_position - planet.global_position).normalized()
+
+
+func hurt(dmg: float, _from: Vector3) -> void:
+	if dead:
+		return
+	hp -= dmg
+	_play("hit", true)
+	_t = 0.0
+	if hp <= 0.0:
+		dead = true
+		_play("ko", true)
+		if cosmos:
+			cosmos.npc_died(self)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	delta = minf(delta, 0.05)
+	if planet == null:
+		return
+	if dead:
+		_dead_t += delta
+		if _dead_t > 6.0:
+			queue_free()
+		return
+	if town:
+		_citizen(delta)
+		return
+	if dungeon:
+		_dungeon_fight(delta)
+		return
+	var u := up()
+	var me := global_position - planet.global_position
+	var player: Node3D = cosmos.walker if cosmos else null
+	var to := Vector3.ZERO
+	var pd := INF
+	if player and not player.get("downed"):
+		to = player.global_position - global_position
+		pd = to.length()
+	var move := Vector3.ZERO
+	var busy := _anim != null and _clip in ["hit", "fire"] and _anim.is_playing()
+	if pd < SIGHT:
+		var flat := to - u * to.dot(u)
+		facing = flat.normalized()
+		var side := facing.cross(u) * _strafe
+		var want := 0.0
+		if pd > 26.0:
+			want = 1.0
+		elif pd < 14.0:
+			want = -1.0
+		move = facing * want + side * 0.6
+		_t -= delta
+		if _t <= 0.0:
+			_t = _rng.randf_range(1.5, 3.5)
+			_strafe = -_strafe
+		_fire -= delta
+		if _fire <= 0.0 and not busy:
+			_fire = FIRE_EVERY * _rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.3)
+			var muzzle := global_position + u * 1.35 + facing * 0.7
+			var aim: Vector3 = player.global_position + player.up() * 1.1 - muzzle
+			var spread := 0.008 + pd * 0.0004
+			aim = aim.normalized() + Vector3(_rng.randfn(0, spread), _rng.randfn(0, spread), _rng.randfn(0, spread))
+			CosmosBolt.fire(cosmos, muzzle, aim, "enemy", DAMAGE)
+			_play("fire", true)
+		elif not busy:
+			_play("gun_walk" if move.length() > 0.3 else "gun_idle")
+	else:
+		# On guard: pacing about the camp.
+		_t -= delta
+		if _t <= 0.0:
+			_t = _rng.randf_range(3.0, 7.0)
+			var t := u.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(u.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized().rotated(u, _rng.randf() * TAU)
+			_goal = camp + t * _rng.randf_range(3.0, 14.0)
+		var g := _goal - me
+		g -= u * g.dot(u)
+		if g.length() > 1.0:
+			move = g.normalized() * 0.6
+			facing = g.normalized()
+		if not busy:
+			_play("walk" if move.length() > 0.1 else "guard")
+	global_position += move * SPEED * delta
+	var local := global_position - planet.global_position
+	var d := local.normalized()
+	global_position = planet.global_position + d * (planet.radius + maxf(planet.shape.height(d), 0.0))
+	facing = (facing - d * facing.dot(d)).normalized()
+	if facing.length() < 0.5:
+		facing = d.cross(Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+	global_basis = Basis.looking_at(facing, d)
+
+
+## A citizen's day: to a spot, a pause, the next; facing you when you're near.
+## Armed, it takes on the pirates and the hunting beasts that come near (rifle
+## and bow fire; the labrys closes in and strikes). Kilon Alios stays where he
+## stands, watching you.
+func _citizen(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(town) or not town.built:
+		return
+	_tl = town.to_local(global_position)
+	_tl.y = 0.0
+	var me: Node3D = cosmos.walker if cosmos else null
+	var move := Vector3.ZERO
+	var speed := 1.3
+	var near := me != null and me.global_position.distance_to(global_position) < (9.0 if role == "kilon" else 3.5)
+	var armed := weapon != ""
+	_scan -= delta
+	if role == "guard" and _scan <= 0.0:
+		_scan = 0.4
+		_foe = _nearest_foe(45.0)
+	if role == "guard" and _foe and is_instance_valid(_foe) and not _foe.get("dead"):
+		var to: Vector3 = town.to_local(_foe.global_position) - _tl
+		to.y = 0.0
+		facing = to.normalized() if to.length() > 0.1 else facing
+		_fire -= delta
+		if weapon == "axe":
+			if to.length() > 2.0:
+				move = to.normalized()
+				speed = 4.5
+				_play("run")
+			elif _fire <= 0.0:
+				_fire = 1.1
+				_foe.hurt(18.0, global_position)
+				_play("cross", true)
+		else:
+			if _fire <= 0.0:
+				_fire = (1.0 if weapon == "rifle" else 1.6) * _rng.randf_range(0.85, 1.2)
+				var muzzle := global_position + up() * 1.35 + (town.global_basis * facing) * 0.7
+				var aim: Vector3 = _foe.global_position + (_foe.up() if _foe.has_method("up") else Vector3.UP) * 0.8 - muzzle
+				var b := CosmosBolt.fire(cosmos, muzzle, aim, "player", 14.0 if weapon == "rifle" else 22.0)
+				if weapon == "bow":
+					b.tint = Color(0.4, 0.95, 1.0)
+				_play("fire", true)
+			elif not (_clip == "fire" and _anim and _anim.is_playing()):
+				_play("gun_idle")
+	elif near:
+		var to: Vector3 = town.to_local(me.global_position) - _tl
+		to.y = 0.0
+		if to.length() > 0.1:
+			facing = facing.slerp(to.normalized(), 1.0 - exp(-delta * 5.0)).normalized()
+		_play("gun_idle" if armed else "idle")
+	elif role == "kilon" or _wait > 0.0:
+		_wait -= delta
+		_play("gun_idle" if armed else "idle")
+	else:
+		var g := _goal - _tl
+		g.y = 0.0
+		_t -= delta
+		if g.length() < 1.0 or _t <= 0.0:
+			_goal = town.spots[_rng.randi() % town.spots.size()] + Vector3(_rng.randf_range(-3, 3), 0, _rng.randf_range(-3, 3))
+			_t = 25.0
+			_wait = _rng.randf_range(1.0, 6.0) if _rng.randf() < 0.6 else 0.0
+		else:
+			move = g.normalized()
+			facing = facing.slerp(move, 1.0 - exp(-delta * 5.0)).normalized()
+			_play("gun_walk" if armed else "walk")
+	_tl += move * speed * delta
+	_tl += town.push(_tl, 0.4)
+	var r: float = town.site["r"]
+	_tl.x = clampf(_tl.x, -r, r)
+	_tl.z = clampf(_tl.z, -r, r)
+	global_position = town.to_global(_tl)
+	var u := town.global_basis.y
+	var f := town.global_basis * facing
+	f = (f - u * f.dot(u)).normalized()
+	if f.length() > 0.5:
+		global_basis = Basis.looking_at(f, u)
+
+
+## A dungeon's dead: they come for you when you're near (in its rooms), the
+## skeletons with their swords, the demons hurling fire from afar and clawing
+## up close.
+func _dungeon_fight(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(dungeon) or not dungeon.built:
+		return
+	_tl = dungeon.to_local(global_position)
+	var me: Node3D = cosmos.walker if cosmos else null
+	var to := Vector3.ZERO
+	var d := INF
+	if me and me.get("deck") == dungeon and not me.get("downed"):
+		to = dungeon.to_local(me.global_position) - _tl
+		to.y = 0.0
+		d = to.length()
+	# (rooms away, behind its walls: not drawn, not animated - nor moving, it waits)
+	var far := d > 36.0 * scale_k
+	if visible == far:
+		visible = not far
+		if _anim:
+			_anim.active = not far
+	if far:
+		return
+	var move := Vector3.ZERO
+	var speed := 1.0
+	var demon := role == "demon"
+	_fire -= delta
+	var busy := _anim != null and _clip in ["jab", "cross", "hook", "hit"] and _anim.is_playing()
+	if d < (30.0 if scale_k > 1.5 else 22.0):
+		facing = to.normalized() if d > 0.1 else facing
+		var hit_at := 1.7 * scale_k
+		if d > hit_at:
+			move = facing
+			speed = 3.9 if demon else 3.3
+			if demon and d > 5.0 and _fire <= 0.0:
+				_fire = _rng.randf_range(2.2, 3.2)
+				var muzzle := global_position + up() * 1.6 * scale_k + (dungeon.global_basis * facing) * 0.6 * scale_k
+				var aim: Vector3 = me.global_position + me.up() * 1.0 - muzzle
+				var b := CosmosBolt.fire(cosmos, muzzle, aim, "enemy", 12.0 * (2.0 if scale_k > 1.5 else 1.0))
+				b.tint = Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.1)
+				_play("cross", true)
+			elif not busy:
+				_play("run")
+		else:
+			if _fire <= 0.0:
+				_fire = 1.1 if demon else 1.3
+				me.hurt((16.0 if demon else 10.0) * (2.0 if scale_k > 1.5 else 1.0), self)
+				_play(["jab", "cross", "hook"][_rng.randi() % 3], true)
+			elif not busy:
+				_play("guard")
+	elif not busy:
+		_play("guard")
+	_tl += move * speed * delta
+	_tl += dungeon.push(_tl, 0.4 * scale_k)
+	_tl.y = dungeon.floor_top(_tl + Vector3(0, 0.05, 0))   # (up a step at most, like you)
+	global_position = dungeon.to_global(_tl)
+	var u := dungeon.global_basis.y
+	var f := dungeon.global_basis * facing
+	f = (f - u * f.dot(u)).normalized()
+	if f.length() > 0.5:
+		global_basis = Basis.looking_at(f, u)
+
+
+## The nearest pirate or hunting beast within `reach` m.
+func _nearest_foe(reach: float) -> Node3D:
+	var best: Node3D = null
+	var bd := reach
+	for list in [cosmos.npcs, cosmos.creatures]:
+		for x in list:
+			if not is_instance_valid(x) or x.get("dead") or x == self:
+				continue
+			if x is CosmosCreature and (x as CosmosCreature).kind.get("temper") != "predator":
+				continue
+			var d: float = x.global_position.distance_to(global_position)
+			if d < bd:
+				bd = d
+				best = x
+	return best
+
+
+func _play(clip: String, restart := false) -> void:
+	if _anim == null or not _anim.has_animation(clip):
+		return
+	if clip != _clip or restart:
+		_anim.play(clip, 0.15)
+		if restart:
+			_anim.seek(0.0, true)
+		_clip = clip

files.explanation: The 3D world - life on the planets: A town on a planet (the 3D game): the Aegean towns of the 2D game in 3D - a city round a palace, or a village - in the empire's looks (its palette: BuildingLook's themes - Minoan ochre walls and red columns, Athenian white and blue, Spartan bronze...). Assembled from modular pieces by its seed: the palace - wings of 1-3 storeys round a central court (stepped masses, fresco bands, cornices, windows, horns of consecration on the roofs), a colonnade of Aegean columns (wider at the top, dark capitals), a gateway, an altar, a grand staircase up onto the roofs; houses - flat-roofed blocks of 1-3 storeys on lots along lanes, doors, windows, parapets, now and then horns, a roof pergola; a shrine (three rooms, the middle one tallest, columns in front), a storehouse with its jars (pithoi), a landing field for your ship. Every piece is a box or a column in the town's frame (y up, 0 the ground): all drawn as one mesh - colours in its vertices as slots (building shader: the palette's colours are shader parameters - recolour a town by setting them), built on a worker. The same pieces are solid (Cosmos: walker_bumps, the camera) and low ones are floors: stairs, roofs. The ground under a town is levelled (PlanetShape.flats).

+static func sites(shape: PlanetShape, rec: Dictionary, empire: String, day := Vector3.ZERO) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	var type := str(rec.get("type", ""))
+	if shape.kind != "rocky" or empire == "pirates" or type in ["moon", "volcanic", "akrotiri", "selene"]:
+		return out
+	if not (shape.sea in [1, 2] or type in ["ocean", "ice", "thalassa", "krystallos"]):
+		return out
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = int(rec.get("seed", 1)) * 31 + 7
+	var want := rng.randi_range(3, 5)
+	var tries := 0
+	while out.size() < want and tries < 120:
+		tries += 1
+		var kind := "city" if out.is_empty() else "village"
+		var r := 175.0 if kind == "city" else 130.0     # (the town, its landing field)

+		var far := true
+		for o in out:

+		var hi := h0
