+static func frame(s: Dictionary, radius: float) -> Transform3D:
+	var u: Vector3 = s["dir"]
+	var x: Vector3 = (s["t1"] as Vector3).rotated(u, float(s["yaw"]))
+	return Transform3D(Basis(x, u, x.cross(u)), u * (radius + float(s["h"])))
+
+
+func setup(pl: CosmosPlanet, s: Dictionary) -> void:
+	planet = pl
+	site = s
+	name = str(s["name"]).replace(" ", "_")
+	add_to_group("cam_solid")
+	set_meta("cam_reach", float(s["r"]) + 60.0)
+
+
+
+## Its buildings wanted (near) or not (far): built on a worker, or let go.
+func want(on: bool) -> void:
+	if on and not built and _task < 0:
+		var seed: int = site["seed"]
+		var kind: String = site["kind"]
+		var empire: String = site["empire"]
+		_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): _out = _make(kind, seed, empire), false, "town")
+	elif not on and built:
+		for ch in get_children():
+			ch.queue_free()
+		_solids = []
+		_grid = {}
+		built = false
+
+
+## Its name on the HUD: the palace's for a city.
+func title() -> String:
+	return ("Palace of %s" if str(site["kind"]) == "city" else "%s") % str(site["name"])
+
+
+## Its meshes and solids in, once the worker's done (Cosmos checks).
+func poll() -> bool:
+	if built:
+		return true
+	if _task < 0 or not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_task):
+		return false
+	WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+	_task = -1
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.name = "Buildings"
+	mi.mesh = _out["mesh"]
+	mi.material_override = material(str(site["empire"]))
+	mi.visibility_range_end = 6000.0
+	add_child(mi)
+	_solids = _out["solids"]
+	_grid = _out["grid"]
+	spots = _out["spots"]
+	port = _out["port"]
+	_out = {}
+	built = true
+	return true
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	if _task >= 0:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+
+
+## The building shader with an empire's palette (shared by its towns).
+static func material(empire: String) -> ShaderMaterial:
+	if _mats.has(empire):
+		return _mats[empire]
+	var L: Array = LOOKS.get(empire, LOOKS[""])
+	var cols := PackedColorArray()
+	var looks := PackedVector4Array()
+	for i in 12:
+		var c: Array = L[i]
+		cols.append(Color(c[0], c[1], c[2]).srgb_to_linear())
+		looks.append(Vector4(ROUGH[i], 0.85 if (i == BLACK and empire in ["sparta", "mycenae", "ionia"]) else 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = SHADER
+	m.set_shader_parameter("slot_color", cols)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("slot_look", looks)
+	_mats[empire] = m
+	return m
+
+
+# --- Walking: floors and walls ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The highest floor under town-local `p` that's not above its feet + STEP
+## (the ground 0, steps, roofs), town-local y.
+func floor_top(p: Vector3) -> float:
+	var best := 0.0
+	for i in _grid.get(Vector2i(floori(p.x / CELL), floori(p.z / CELL)), PackedInt32Array()):
+		var b: AABB = _solids[i]
+		if p.x < b.position.x or p.z < b.position.z or p.x > b.end.x or p.z > b.end.z:
+			continue
+		var top := b.end.y
+		if top <= p.y + STEP and top > best:
+			best = top
+	return best
+
+
+## How far to move a body (town-local `p` its feet, radius `r`, 1.8 m tall)
+## out of the blocks round it (town-local, along the ground).
+func push(p: Vector3, r: float) -> Vector3:
+	var out := Vector3.ZERO
+	for i in _grid.get(Vector2i(floori(p.x / CELL), floori(p.z / CELL)), PackedInt32Array()):
+		var b: AABB = _solids[i]
+		if b.end.y <= p.y + STEP or b.position.y >= p.y + 1.8:
+			continue
+		var q := p + out
+		var dx0 := q.x - (b.position.x - r)
+		var dx1 := (b.end.x + r) - q.x
+		var dz0 := q.z - (b.position.z - r)
+		var dz1 := (b.end.z + r) - q.z
+		if dx0 <= 0.0 or dx1 <= 0.0 or dz0 <= 0.0 or dz1 <= 0.0:
+			continue
+		var m := minf(minf(dx0, dx1), minf(dz0, dz1))
+		if m == dx0:
+			out.x -= dx0
+		elif m == dx1:
+			out.x += dx1
+		elif m == dz0:
+			out.z -= dz0
+		else:
+			out.z += dz1
+	return out
+
+
+## Under a roof or an upper floor (town-local `p`): indoors.
+func indoors(p: Vector3) -> bool:
+	for i in _grid.get(Vector2i(floori(p.x / CELL), floori(p.z / CELL)), PackedInt32Array()):
+		var b: AABB = _solids[i]
+		if p.x > b.position.x and p.z > b.position.z and p.x < b.end.x and p.z < b.end.z and b.position.y > p.y + 1.9 and b.position.y < p.y + 6.0:
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## How far to move a ball (town-local `p`, radius `r`) out of the blocks (the ship).
+func push_ball(p: Vector3, r: float) -> Vector3:
+	var out := Vector3.ZERO
+	for i in _grid.get(Vector2i(floori(p.x / CELL), floori(p.z / CELL)), PackedInt32Array()):
+		var b: AABB = _solids[i]
+		var q := p + out
+		var c := q.clamp(b.position, b.end)
+		var d := q - c
+		var dl := d.length()
+		if dl >= r:
+			continue
+		if dl > 0.0001:
+			out += d / dl * (r - dl)
+		else:   # (inside it: out the nearest face)
+			var best := INF
+			var push := Vector3.ZERO
+			for a in 3:
+				for sgn in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+					var depth: float = (b.end[a] - q[a] if sgn > 0.0 else q[a] - b.position[a]) + r
+					if depth < best:
+						best = depth
+						push = Vector3.ZERO
+						push[a] = depth * sgn
+			out += push
+	return out
+
+
+## The camera's line (Cosmos.camera_clear): where it first meets a block, or INF.
+func cam_hit(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, limit: float) -> float:
+	if not built:
+		return INF
+	var lo := to_local(o)
+	var ld := global_basis.inverse() * dir
+	var seen := {}
+	var best := INF
+	var steps := int(limit / (CELL * 0.5)) + 1
+	for k in mini(steps, 40) + 1:
+		var p := lo + ld * minf(k * CELL * 0.5, limit)
+		for i in _grid.get(Vector2i(floori(p.x / CELL), floori(p.z / CELL)), PackedInt32Array()):
+			if seen.has(i):
+				continue
+			seen[i] = true
+			var t := _ray_box(lo, ld, _solids[i], minf(limit, best))
+			if t < best:
+				best = t
+	return best
+
+
+static func _ray_box(o: Vector3, d: Vector3, b: AABB, limit: float) -> float:
+	var t0 := 0.0
+	var t1 := limit
+	for a in 3:
+		if absf(d[a]) < 1e-8:
+			if o[a] < b.position[a] or o[a] > b.end[a]:
+				return INF
+			continue
+		var ta := (b.position[a] - o[a]) / d[a]
+		var tb := (b.end[a] - o[a]) / d[a]
+		if ta > tb:
+			var x := ta
+			ta = tb
+			tb = x
+		t0 = maxf(t0, ta)
+		t1 = minf(t1, tb)
+		if t0 > t1:
+			return INF
+	return t0 if t0 > 0.0 else INF
+
+
+# --- The layout and its mesh (on a worker) --------------------------------------------
+
+## Everything built: {mesh, solids, grid, spots, port}.
+static func _make(kind: String, seed: int, empire: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var b := Builder.new()
+	b.rng.seed = seed
+	b.taper = float((LOOKS.get(empire, LOOKS[""]) as Array)[12])
+	var half := 85.0 if kind == "city" else 45.0
+	if kind == "city":
+		b.palace(Vector3.ZERO)
+		b.houses(half, Rect2(-46, -38, 92, 76))
+		b.shrine(Vector3(-half + 16, 0, half - 16))
+		b.storehouse(Vector3(half - 18, 0, -half + 14))
+	else:
+		b.shrine(Vector3(0, 0, -10))
+		b.houses(half, Rect2(-14, -22, 28, 26))
+		b.storehouse(Vector3(half - 14, 0, half - 12))
+	# The paved square and the landing field beyond the houses.
+	var port := Vector3(half + 38.0, 0, 0)
+	b.box(Vector3(-half, -0.6, -half), Vector3(half, 0.04, half), PALE, false)
+	b.box(port - Vector3(34, 0.6, 34), port + Vector3(34, 0.05, 34), STONE, false)
+	for k in 4:   # (its corner lights: dark posts with red tops)
+		var c := port + Vector3(32.0 * (1 if k % 2 else -1), 0, 32.0 * (1 if k < 2 else -1))
+		b.box(c - Vector3(0.3, 0, 0.3), c + Vector3(0.3, 2.2, 0.3), BLACK, false)
+		b.box(c + Vector3(-0.4, 2.2, -0.4), c + Vector3(0.4, 2.6, 0.4), RED, false)
+	b.spots.append(port + Vector3(-36, 0, 0))
+	return {"mesh": b.mesh(), "solids": b.solids, "grid": b.grid(), "spots": b.spots, "port": port}
+
+
+## The pieces, as they're laid out: vertex arrays and solids.
+class Builder:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	var taper := 1.3
+	var verts := PackedVector3Array()
+	var norms := PackedVector3Array()
+	var cols := PackedColorArray()
+	var idx := PackedInt32Array()
+	var solids: Array = []
+	var spots: Array = []
+	var taken: Array = []        # Rect2s (ground taken)
+
+	func mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
+		var arr := []
+		arr.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = verts
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = norms
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = cols
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = idx
+		var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+		m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, arr)
+		return m
+
+	func grid() -> Dictionary:
+		var g := {}
+		for i in solids.size():
+			var b: AABB = solids[i]
+			for x in range(floori((b.position.x - 1.0) / CELL), floori((b.end.x + 1.0) / CELL) + 1):
+				for z in range(floori((b.position.z - 1.0) / CELL), floori((b.end.z + 1.0) / CELL) + 1):
+					var k := Vector2i(x, z)
+					if not g.has(k):
+						g[k] = PackedInt32Array()
+					var a: PackedInt32Array = g[k]
+					a.append(i)
+					g[k] = a
+		return g
+
+	## A quad a, b, c, d (in order round it) facing `n`.
+	func quad(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, d: Vector3, n: Vector3, col: Color) -> void:
+		var base := verts.size()
+		verts.append_array([a, b, c, d])
+		for k in 4:
+			norms.append(n)
+			cols.append(col)
+		if (b - a).cross(c - a).dot(n) > 0.0:   # (Godot's front faces wind clockwise)
+			idx.append_array([base, base + 2, base + 1, base, base + 3, base + 2])
+		else:
+			idx.append_array([base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3])
+
+	func box(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, slot: int, solid := true) -> void:
+		var mn := a.min(b)   # (its corners in any order)
+		var mx := a.max(b)
+		var col := Color(slot / 255.0, rng.randf(), 0.0)
+		var p := [Vector3(mn.x, mn.y, mn.z), Vector3(mx.x, mn.y, mn.z), Vector3(mx.x, mn.y, mx.z), Vector3(mn.x, mn.y, mx.z),
+			Vector3(mn.x, mx.y, mn.z), Vector3(mx.x, mx.y, mn.z), Vector3(mx.x, mx.y, mx.z), Vector3(mn.x, mx.y, mx.z)]
+		quad(p[4], p[5], p[6], p[7], Vector3.UP, col)
+		if mn.y > -0.5:
+			quad(p[0], p[3], p[2], p[1], Vector3.DOWN, col)
+		quad(p[0], p[1], p[5], p[4], Vector3.FORWARD, col)
+		quad(p[2], p[3], p[7], p[6], Vector3.BACK, col)
+		quad(p[1], p[2], p[6], p[5], Vector3.RIGHT, col)
+		quad(p[3], p[0], p[4], p[7], Vector3.LEFT, col)
+		if solid:
+			solids.append(AABB(mn, mx - mn))
+
+	## An Aegean column on `at`: a dark base, the red shaft (wider at the top
+	## when taper > 1), a cushion capital and its block.
+	func column(at: Vector3, h: float, r := 0.32) -> void:
+		var shaft := h - 0.7
+		box(at + Vector3(-r * 1.4, 0, -r * 1.4), at + Vector3(r * 1.4, 0.18, r * 1.4), BLACK, false)
+		var r0 := r
+		var r1 := r * taper
+		var col := Color(RED / 255.0, rng.randf(), 0.0)
+		var n := 10
+		for i in n:
+			var a0 := TAU * i / n
+			var a1 := TAU * (i + 1) / n
+			var d0 := Vector3(cos(a0), 0, sin(a0))
+			var d1 := Vector3(cos(a1), 0, sin(a1))
+			var y0 := at.y + 0.18
+			var y1 := at.y + 0.18 + shaft
+			quad(at + d0 * r0 + Vector3(0, y0 - at.y, 0), at + d1 * r0 + Vector3(0, y0 - at.y, 0), at + d1 * r1 + Vector3(0, y1 - at.y, 0),
+				at + d0 * r1 + Vector3(0, y1 - at.y, 0), ((d0 + d1) * 0.5).normalized(), col)
+		var cy := at.y + 0.18 + shaft
+		box(at + Vector3(-r1 * 1.25, cy - at.y, -r1 * 1.25), at + Vector3(r1 * 1.25, cy - at.y + 0.3, r1 * 1.25), BLACK, false)
+		box(at + Vector3(-r1 * 1.5, cy - at.y + 0.3, -r1 * 1.5), at + Vector3(r1 * 1.5, h, r1 * 1.5), BLACK, false)
+		solids.append(AABB(at - Vector3(r1, 0, r1), Vector3(r1 * 2.0, h, r1 * 2.0)))
+
+	## Horns of consecration on a roof at `at` (facing along x or z).
+	func horns(at: Vector3, along_x: bool) -> void:
+		var w := Vector3(0.55, 0, 0) if along_x else Vector3(0, 0, 0.55)
+		var t := Vector3(0, 0, 0.18) if along_x else Vector3(0.18, 0, 0)
+		box(at - w * 1.4 - t, at + w * 1.4 + t + Vector3(0, 0.3, 0), HORNS, false)
+		for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var c: Vector3 = at + w * s + Vector3(0, 0.3, 0)
+			box(c - w * 0.35 - t, c + w * 0.35 + t + Vector3(0, 0.75, 0), HORNS, false)
+
+	## A block of `storeys` from y0: walls, its base course, a fresco band and
+	## a cornice each storey, windows on its long sides, horns on its roof.
+	## `door`: the side with a door (0 -x, 1 +x, 2 -z, 3 +z, -1 none).
+	## A building of `storeys` from y0, hollow - walk in: walls WALL_T thick with
+	## a doorway on side `door` (0 -x, 1 +x, 2 -z, 3 +z; -1 none), each upper
+	## floor a slab with a stairwell and stairs up to it from the floor below, a
+	## roof slab, `rooms`: partitions across its length with doorways; outside a
+	## base course, a fresco band and a cornice each storey (rings round the
+	## walls - nothing in the rooms, no two faces in one plane: no flicker),
+	## windows, a parapet, horns now and then; inside its furniture (`kind`).
+	func block(mn: Vector2, mx: Vector2, storeys: int, y0 := 0.0, door := -1, roof_horns := true, rooms := false, kind := "house", door_at := 0.5) -> float:
+		var T := WALL_T
+		var top := y0 + storeys * STOREY
+		ring(mn, mx, y0, y0 + 0.7, 0.12, STONE)
+		var c := (mn + mx) * 0.5
+		for st in storeys:
+			var ya := y0 + st * STOREY
+			var yb := ya + STOREY
+			for side in 4:
+				_wall(mn, mx, side, ya, yb, side == door and st == 0, door_at)
+			ring(mn, mx, yb - 1.25, yb - 0.75, 0.06, FRESCO)
+			ring(mn, mx, yb - 0.38, yb - 0.03, 0.3, TRIM)
+			_windows(mn, mx, ya + 1.6, door if st == 0 else -1)
+			if rooms:
+				_partitions(mn, mx, ya, yb)
+		# The upper floors, a stairwell in the corner, the stairs up to them.
+		var hole := Rect2(mn.x + T, mn.y + T, 1.4, 3.6)
+		for st in range(1, storeys):
+			var ys := y0 + st * STOREY
+			box(Vector3(hole.end.x, ys - 0.3, mn.y + T), Vector3(mx.x - T, ys, mx.y - T), PALE)
+			box(Vector3(mn.x + T, ys - 0.3, hole.end.y), Vector3(hole.end.x, ys, mx.y - T), PALE)
+			stairs(Vector3(hole.position.x + 0.7, ys - STOREY, hole.position.y + 0.1), Vector3(0, 0, 1), 10, 1.3, STOREY / 10.0, 0.34)
+		box(Vector3(mn.x, top - 0.3, mn.y), Vector3(mx.x, top, mx.y), ROOF)
+		ring(mn, mx, top, top + 0.5, 0.3, ROOF)   # (the parapet - low: stepped over)
+		if door >= 0:   # (the doorway's lintel, in wood)
+			var dz := lerpf(mn.y + WALL_T + DOOR_W, mx.y - WALL_T - DOOR_W, door_at)
+			var dx := lerpf(mn.x + DOOR_W, mx.x - DOOR_W, door_at)
+			var p: Vector3 = [Vector3(mn.x, y0, dz), Vector3(mx.x, y0, dz), Vector3(dx, y0, mn.y), Vector3(dx, y0, mx.y)][door]
+			var w := Vector3(0, 0, DOOR_W * 0.5 + 0.25) if door < 2 else Vector3(DOOR_W * 0.5 + 0.25, 0, 0)
+			var o := Vector3(-0.12 if door == 0 else 0.12, 0, 0) if door < 2 else Vector3(0, 0, -0.12 if door == 2 else 0.12)
+			box(p - w + o * 0.5 + Vector3(0, DOOR_H, 0) - o.abs(), p + w + o * 0.5 + Vector3(0, DOOR_H + 0.3, 0) + o.abs(), WOOD, false)
+		_furnish(mn, mx, y0, storeys, kind)
+		if roof_horns and rng.randf() < 0.5:
+			var along := (mx.x - mn.x) > (mx.y - mn.y)
+			if along:
+				horns(Vector3((mn.x + mx.x) * 0.5, top, mn.y + 0.6), true)
+			else:
+				horns(Vector3(mn.x + 0.6, top, (mn.y + mx.y) * 0.5), false)
+		return top
+
+	## One wall of a storey (corners belong to the -z / +z walls), its doorway cut.
+	func _wall(mn: Vector2, mx: Vector2, side: int, ya: float, yb: float, doorway: bool, door_at := 0.5) -> void:
+		var T := WALL_T
+		var a: Vector3
+		var b: Vector3
+		match side:
+			0: a = Vector3(mn.x, ya, mn.y + T); b = Vector3(mn.x + T, yb, mx.y - T)
+			1: a = Vector3(mx.x - T, ya, mn.y + T); b = Vector3(mx.x, yb, mx.y - T)
+			2: a = Vector3(mn.x, ya, mn.y); b = Vector3(mx.x, yb, mn.y + T)
+			_: a = Vector3(mn.x, ya, mx.y - T); b = Vector3(mx.x, yb, mx.y)
+		if not doorway:
+			box(a, b, WALL)
+			return
+		var ax := 2 if side < 2 else 0          # (the axis it runs along)
+		var mid := lerpf(a[ax] + DOOR_W, b[ax] - DOOR_W, door_at)
+		var a1 := b
+		a1[ax] = mid - DOOR_W * 0.5
+		box(a, a1, WALL)
+		var b1 := a
+		b1[ax] = mid + DOOR_W * 0.5
+		box(b1, b, WALL)
+		var la := a
+		la[ax] = mid - DOOR_W * 0.5
+		la.y = ya + DOOR_H
+		var lb := b
+		lb[ax] = mid + DOOR_W * 0.5
+		box(la, lb, WALL)
+
+	## Walls across a long building every ~9 m, each with a doorway in its middle.
+	func _partitions(mn: Vector2, mx: Vector2, ya: float, yb: float) -> void:
+		var T := WALL_T
+		var along_x := (mx.x - mn.x) >= (mx.y - mn.y)
+		var L := (mx.x - mn.x) if along_x else (mx.y - mn.y)
+		var n := int(L / 9.0)
+		for k in range(1, n + 1):
+			var at := (mn.x if along_x else mn.y) + L * k / (n + 1)
+			if along_x:
+				var cz := (mn.y + mx.y) * 0.5
+				box(Vector3(at - T * 0.5, ya, mn.y + T), Vector3(at + T * 0.5, yb - 0.3, cz - DOOR_W * 0.5), WALL)
+				box(Vector3(at - T * 0.5, ya, cz + DOOR_W * 0.5), Vector3(at + T * 0.5, yb - 0.3, mx.y - T), WALL)
+				box(Vector3(at - T * 0.5, ya + DOOR_H, cz - DOOR_W * 0.5), Vector3(at + T * 0.5, yb - 0.3, cz + DOOR_W * 0.5), WALL)
+			else:
+				var cx := (mn.x + mx.x) * 0.5
+				box(Vector3(mn.x + T, ya, at - T * 0.5), Vector3(cx - DOOR_W * 0.5, yb - 0.3, at + T * 0.5), WALL)
+				box(Vector3(cx + DOOR_W * 0.5, ya, at - T * 0.5), Vector3(mx.x - T, yb - 0.3, at + T * 0.5), WALL)
+				box(Vector3(cx - DOOR_W * 0.5, ya + DOOR_H, at - T * 0.5), Vector3(cx + DOOR_W * 0.5, yb - 0.3, at + T * 0.5), WALL)
+
+	## A band round the outside of the walls (out `o`), y0..y1: four boxes, none inside.
+	func ring(mn: Vector2, mx: Vector2, y0: float, y1: float, o: float, slot: int) -> void:
+		box(Vector3(mn.x - o, y0, mn.y - o), Vector3(mx.x + o, y1, mn.y), slot, false)
+		box(Vector3(mn.x - o, y0, mx.y), Vector3(mx.x + o, y1, mx.y + o), slot, false)
+		box(Vector3(mn.x - o, y0, mn.y), Vector3(mn.x, y1, mx.y), slot, false)
+		box(Vector3(mx.x, y0, mn.y), Vector3(mx.x + o, y1, mx.y), slot, false)
+
+	## What's in it: a house's hearth, bench, jars and beds upstairs; a palace
+	## wing's benches and jars - the throne room's throne; a shrine's altar.
+	func _furnish(mn: Vector2, mx: Vector2, y0: float, storeys: int, kind: String) -> void:
+		var T := WALL_T + 0.05
+		var c := (mn + mx) * 0.5
+		match kind:
+			"house":
+				box(Vector3(c.x - 0.6, y0, mx.y - T - 1.0), Vector3(c.x + 0.6, y0 + 0.5, mx.y - T), STONE)          # (the hearth)
+				box(Vector3(c.x - 0.25, y0 + 0.5, mx.y - T - 0.6), Vector3(c.x + 0.25, y0 + 0.55, mx.y - T - 0.4), RED, false)
+				box(Vector3(mx.x - T - 0.5, y0, mn.y + T + 1.0), Vector3(mx.x - T, y0 + 0.45, mx.y - T - 1.5), WOOD)  # (a bench)
+				_jar(Vector3(mx.x - T - 0.6, y0, mx.y - T - 0.6))
+				if storeys > 1:
+					var ys := y0 + STOREY
+					box(Vector3(mx.x - T - 1.0, ys, mx.y - T - 2.2), Vector3(mx.x - T, ys + 0.45, mx.y - T), WOOD)     # (a bed)
+					box(Vector3(mx.x - T - 0.95, ys + 0.45, mx.y - T - 2.15), Vector3(mx.x - T - 0.05, ys + 0.55, mx.y - T - 0.05), PALE, false)
+			"wing":
+				box(Vector3(mn.x + T, y0, mn.y + T + 1.0), Vector3(mn.x + T + 0.5, y0 + 0.45, mx.y - T - 1.0), STONE)
+				for k in 3:
+					_jar(Vector3(mx.x - T - 0.6, y0, mn.y + T + 1.0 + k * 1.3))
+			"throne":
+				# The throne against the back wall, gypsum, benches either side, griffins painted behind it.
+				var b := Vector3(mn.x + T, y0, c.y)
+				box(b + Vector3(0, 0, -0.5), b + Vector3(0.7, 0.5, 0.5), PALE)
+				box(b + Vector3(0, 0.5, -0.5), b + Vector3(0.15, 1.6, 0.5), PALE)
+				for sd in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+					box(b + Vector3(0, 0, 0.9 * sd), b + Vector3(0.5, 0.45, 3.5 * sd), STONE)
+					box(Vector3(mn.x + WALL_T, y0 + 1.0, c.y + 0.7 * sd), Vector3(mn.x + WALL_T + 0.03, y0 + 2.4, c.y + 3.0 * sd), FRESCO, false)
+			"shrine":
+				box(Vector3(c.x - 0.8, y0, c.y - 0.5), Vector3(c.x + 0.8, y0 + 1.0, c.y + 0.5), HORNS)
+				horns(Vector3(c.x, y0 + 1.0, c.y), true)
+
+	func _windows(mn: Vector2, mx: Vector2, y: float, door := -1) -> void:
+		var dside: int = [2, 3, 0, 1][door] if door >= 0 else -1   # (block's door side -> this loop's side)
+		for side in 4:
+			var a: Vector3
+			var e: Vector3
+			match side:
+				0: a = Vector3(mn.x, y, mn.y); e = Vector3(mx.x, y, mn.y)
+				1: a = Vector3(mn.x, y, mx.y); e = Vector3(mx.x, y, mx.y)
+				2: a = Vector3(mn.x, y, mn.y); e = Vector3(mn.x, y, mx.y)
+				_: a = Vector3(mx.x, y, mn.y); e = Vector3(mx.x, y, mx.y)
+			var L := a.distance_to(e)
+			var n := int(L / 3.6)
+			if n < 1:
+				continue
+			var dir := (e - a) / L
+			var out := Vector3(0, 0, -1) if side == 0 else (Vector3(0, 0, 1) if side == 1 else (Vector3(-1, 0, 0) if side == 2 else Vector3(1, 0, 0)))
+			for i in n:
+				if rng.randf() < 0.2 or (side == dside and absf(L * (i + 0.5) / n - L * 0.5) < DOOR_W):
+					continue
+				var c := a + dir * (L * (i + 0.5) / n) + out * 0.05
+				var w := dir * 0.5
+				var t := out * 0.05
+				box(c - w - t, c + w + t + Vector3(0, 1.3, 0), DARK, false)
+
+	## Steps from `at` along `dir` (unit x or z), `n` of them, rising `rise`
+	## each, `w` wide - each a block you walk up onto.
+	func stairs(at: Vector3, dir: Vector3, n: int, w: float, rise := 0.4, run := 0.55) -> void:
+		var side := Vector3(dir.z, 0, dir.x).abs() * w * 0.5
+		for i in n:
+			var p := at + dir * (i * run)
+			var q := p + dir * run
+			var mn := Vector3(minf(p.x, q.x), at.y, minf(p.z, q.z)) - side
+			var mx := Vector3(maxf(p.x, q.x), at.y + (i + 1) * rise, maxf(p.z, q.z)) + side
+			box(mn, mx, STONE)
+
+	## The palace: wings round a court 36 x 24, a colonnade, a gateway, stairs.
+	func palace(c: Vector3) -> void:
+		var cx := 18.0
+		var cz := 12.0
+		taken.append(Rect2(c.x - cx - 18, c.z - cz - 18, (cx + 18) * 2, (cz + 18) * 2))
+		box(Vector3(c.x - cx, -0.3, c.z - cz), Vector3(c.x + cx, 0.08, c.z + cz), PALE, false)   # (the court's gypsum)
+		# West wing: three storeys, stepped; the colonnade before it.
+		# (blocks that would touch stand 0.6 m apart: their cornices meet, never overlap)
+		var west := [[Vector2(-cx - 16, -cz - 14), Vector2(-cx, -4.3), 3, "throne", 0.85], [Vector2(-cx - 16, -3.7), Vector2(-cx, cz + 14), 2, "wing", 0.3]]
+		for wg in west:
+			block(wg[0] + Vector2(c.x, c.z), wg[1] + Vector2(c.x, c.z), wg[2], 0.0, 1, true, true, wg[3], wg[4])
+		for i in 6:
+			column(Vector3(c.x - cx + 2.6, 0.08, c.z - cz + 2.0 + i * 4.0), STOREY)
+		box(Vector3(c.x - cx, STOREY, c.z - cz), Vector3(c.x - cx + 3.6, STOREY + 0.45, c.z + cz), TRIM, false)
+		# East wing: two storeys; north and south wings, a gap for the way in.
+		block(Vector2(c.x + cx, c.z - cz - 14), Vector2(c.x + cx + 14, c.z + cz + 14), 2, 0.0, 0, true, true, "wing")
+		block(Vector2(c.x - cx + 0.6, c.z - cz - 14), Vector2(c.x - 4, c.z - cz), 2, 0.0, 3, true, true, "wing")
+		block(Vector2(c.x + 4, c.z - cz - 14), Vector2(c.x + cx - 0.6, c.z - cz), 2, 0.0, 3, true, true, "wing")
+		var s_top := block(Vector2(c.x - cx + 0.6, c.z + cz), Vector2(c.x - 5, c.z + cz + 14), 1, 0.0, 2, true, false, "wing", 0.2)
+		block(Vector2(c.x + 5, c.z + cz), Vector2(c.x + cx - 0.6, c.z + cz + 14), 1, 0.0, 2, true, false, "wing")
+		# The gateways (north and south): columns and a lintel.
+		for z in [c.z + cz + 7.0, c.z - cz - 7.0]:
+			for x in [c.x - 2.0, c.x + 2.0]:
+				column(Vector3(x, 0, z), STOREY)
+		box(Vector3(c.x - 5, STOREY, c.z + cz), Vector3(c.x + 5, STOREY + 0.6, c.z + cz + 14), TRIM, false)
+		# The grand staircase: from the court up onto the south wing's roof.
+		stairs(Vector3(c.x - 6.5, 0.08, c.z + cz - 5.6), Vector3(0, 0, 1), 10, 3.0, (s_top - 0.08) / 10.0, 0.56)
+		# The altar in the court, with horns.
+		box(Vector3(c.x - 1.2, 0, c.z - 1.2), Vector3(c.x + 1.2, 1.0, c.z + 1.2), HORNS)
+		horns(Vector3(c.x, 1.0, c.z), true)
+		for p in [Vector3(c.x + 8, 0, c.z + 6), Vector3(c.x - 8, 0, c.z - 6), Vector3(c.x + 10, 0, c.z - 8), Vector3(c.x - 10, 0, c.z + 8)]:
+			spots.append(p)
+		spots.append(Vector3(c.x, 0, c.z + cz + 20))
+		spots.append(Vector3(c.x, 0, c.z - cz - 20))
+
+	## Houses on lots along lanes, within `half`, round what's taken.
+	func houses(half: float, keep_out: Rect2) -> void:
+		taken.append(keep_out)
+		var lot := 13.0
+		var x := -half + 4.0
+		while x + lot <= half - 2.0:
+			var z := -half + 4.0
+			while z + lot <= half - 2.0:
+				var r := Rect2(x, z, lot - 3.0, lot - 3.0)
+				var free := true
+				for t: Rect2 in taken:
+					if t.intersects(r.grow(2.0)):
+						free = false
+						break
+				if free and rng.randf() < 0.82:
+					_house(r)
+				elif free:
+					_garden(r)
+				spots.append(Vector3(x - 1.5, 0, z - 1.5))
+				z += lot
+			x += lot
+
+	func _house(r: Rect2) -> void:
+		var w := rng.randf_range(6.0, r.size.x)
+		var d := rng.randf_range(6.0, r.size.y)
+		var mn := r.position + Vector2(rng.randf() * (r.size.x - w), rng.randf() * (r.size.y - d))
+		var mx := mn + Vector2(w, d)
+		var st := 1 if rng.randf() < 0.45 else (2 if rng.randf() < 0.8 else 3)
+		var top := block(mn, mx, st, 0.0, rng.randi() % 4)
+		# A smaller storey on part of it, now and then; or a pergola on the roof.
+		if st < 3 and rng.randf() < 0.35:
+			block(mn + Vector2(0.5, 0.5), mn + Vector2(w * 0.5, d * 0.6), 1, top, -1, false, false, "none")
+		elif rng.randf() < 0.3:
+			for k in 4:
+				var p := Vector3(mx.x - 0.6 - (k % 2) * minf(3.0, w - 1.5), top, mx.y - 0.6 - (k / 2) * minf(3.0, d - 1.5))
+				box(p - Vector3(0.12, 0, 0.12), p + Vector3(0.12, 2.4, 0.12), WOOD, false)
+			box(Vector3(mx.x - 0.8 - minf(3.0, w - 1.5), top + 2.4, mx.y - 0.8 - minf(3.0, d - 1.5)), Vector3(mx.x - 0.4, top + 2.55, mx.y - 0.4), WOOD, false)
+
+	## A garden: storage jars and a low wall.
+	func _garden(r: Rect2) -> void:
+		box(Vector3(r.position.x, 0, r.position.y), Vector3(r.end.x, 0.9, r.position.y + 0.4), STONE)
+		for k in rng.randi_range(2, 5):
+			_jar(Vector3(r.position.x + rng.randf_range(1.0, r.size.x - 1.0), 0, r.position.y + rng.randf_range(1.5, r.size.y - 1.0)))
+
+	func _jar(at: Vector3) -> void:
+		var h := rng.randf_range(1.1, 1.6)
+		box(at + Vector3(-0.35, 0, -0.35), at + Vector3(0.35, h * 0.25, 0.35), JAR)
+		box(at + Vector3(-0.5, h * 0.25, -0.5), at + Vector3(0.5, h * 0.8, 0.5), JAR)
+		box(at + Vector3(-0.3, h * 0.8, -0.3), at + Vector3(0.3, h, 0.3), JAR)
+
+	## A shrine: three rooms, the middle tallest, columns before it, horns.
+	func shrine(c: Vector3) -> void:
+		taken.append(Rect2(c.x - 12, c.z - 8, 24, 18))
+		box(Vector3(c.x - 11, 0, c.z - 6), Vector3(c.x + 11, 0.6, c.z + 8), STONE)
+		block(Vector2(c.x - 9, c.z - 5), Vector2(c.x - 3.6, c.z + 1), 1, 0.6, -1, false, false, "none")
+		var t := block(Vector2(c.x - 3, c.z - 5), Vector2(c.x + 3, c.z + 1), 2, 0.6, 3, false, false, "shrine")
+		block(Vector2(c.x + 3.6, c.z - 5), Vector2(c.x + 9, c.z + 1), 1, 0.6, -1, false, false, "none")
+		horns(Vector3(c.x, t, c.z - 2), true)
+		horns(Vector3(c.x - 6, 0.6 + STOREY, c.z - 2), true)
+		horns(Vector3(c.x + 6, 0.6 + STOREY, c.z - 2), true)
+		for x in [-7.0, -2.0, 2.0, 7.0]:
+			column(Vector3(c.x + x, 0.6, c.z + 4), STOREY)
+		box(Vector3(c.x - 9, 0.6 + STOREY, c.z + 1), Vector3(c.x + 9, 0.6 + STOREY + 0.4, c.z + 5), TRIM, false)
+		stairs(Vector3(c.x - 3, 0, c.z + 9.6), Vector3(0, 0, -1), 2, 6.0, 0.3, 0.8)
+		spots.append(Vector3(c.x, 0, c.z + 12))
+
+	## A storehouse: a long block, a loading porch, jars in rows.
+	func storehouse(c: Vector3) -> void:
+		taken.append(Rect2(c.x - 12, c.z - 9, 24, 20))
+		block(Vector2(c.x - 10, c.z - 7), Vector2(c.x + 10, c.z + 1), 1, 0.0, 3, false, true, "wing")
+		for x in [-8.0, -4.0, 0.0, 4.0, 8.0]:
+			_jar(Vector3(c.x + x, 0, c.z + 4.0))
+			if rng.randf() < 0.6:
+				_jar(Vector3(c.x + x + 1.6, 0, c.z + 6.0))
+		spots.append(Vector3(c.x, 0, c.z + 9))

bubbles.at: static func sites(shape: PlanetShape, rec: Dictionary, empire: String,
bubbles.text: A planet's town sites: a city (with its palace) and a village or two, on dry ground level enough, apart. Ocean and ice worlds only (the inhabited kinds); none on a pirates' world. `day`: towards its star (planets don't turn): the towns on the lit side - the city near the middle of the day, the villages anywhere it's light.
Its buildings wanted (near) or not (far): built on a worker, or let go.
The building shader with an empire's palette (shared by its towns).
Under a roof or an upper floor (town-local `p`): indoors.

files.explanation: The 3D world - models: The characters' models for the 3D game, made cheap to draw: Stage3D's model (art/<id>_3d/<id>.glb - one surface a material: the pirate has 18) merged, once a run, into one physically based surface - each part's albedo in its vertices (COLOR), its metallic, roughness and glow in CUSTOM0 (Stage3D.surface_look), the old ink outline left out - drawn by pbr_vc. Skinning kept (bones, weights, the same skin). A crowd of characters is one draw each instead of a dozen and more. Recolourable: each vertex's slot in CUSTOM0.w (1 armour, 2 accent, 3 glow) - apply(root, id, colours) gives the model a material that sets them (pbr_vc's recolor_* parameters): the towns' people in their empire's colours. CosmosModels.apply(model_root, "pirate") CosmosModels.apply(model_root, "player", [main, accent, glow]) Modular: `hide` leaves out the parts whose material starts with one of its prefixes - the Minoan android carries its rifle, bow or labrys CosmosModels.apply(root, "minoan", [], ["MIN_Bow", "MIN_Axe"])

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,104 @@ 
+class_name CosmosModels
+extends RefCounted
+## The characters' models for the 3D game, made cheap to draw: Stage3D's
+## model (art/<id>_3d/<id>.glb - one surface a material: the pirate has 18)
+## merged, once a run, into one physically based surface - each part's
+## albedo in its vertices (COLOR), its metallic, roughness and glow in CUSTOM0
+## (Stage3D.surface_look), the old ink outline left out - drawn by pbr_vc.
+## Skinning kept (bones, weights, the same skin). A crowd of characters is
+## one draw each instead of a dozen and more.
+## Recolourable: each vertex's slot in CUSTOM0.w (1 armour, 2 accent, 3 glow)
+## - apply(root, id, colours) gives the model a material that sets them
+## (pbr_vc's recolor_* parameters): the towns' people in their empire's colours.
+##   CosmosModels.apply(model_root, "pirate")
+##   CosmosModels.apply(model_root, "player", [main, accent, glow])
+## Modular: `hide` leaves out the parts whose material starts with one of
+## its prefixes - the Minoan android carries its rifle, bow or labrys
+##   CosmosModels.apply(root, "minoan", [], ["MIN_Bow", "MIN_Axe"])
+
+const PBR := preload("res://shaders/pbr_vc.gdshader")
+
+static var _meshes := {}         # id -> ArrayMesh
+static var _mats: Array = []
+static var _tinted := {}         # str(colours) -> ShaderMaterial
+
+
+## Gives the model under `root` (its "Body" mesh) the merged mesh.
+static func apply(root: Node, id: String, recolor: Array = [], hide: Array = []) -> void:
+	var mi: MeshInstance3D = root.find_child("Body", true, false)
+	if mi == null:
+		return
+	var m := merged(id, mi.mesh, hide)
+	mi.mesh = m
+	if _mats.is_empty():
+		var m0 := ShaderMaterial.new()
+		m0.shader = PBR
+		_mats = [m0]
+	var mat: ShaderMaterial = _mats[0]
+	if not recolor.is_empty():
+		var key := str(recolor)
+		if not _tinted.has(key):
+			var mt := ShaderMaterial.new()
+			mt.shader = PBR
+			for k in 3:
+				var c: Color = recolor[k]
+				var l := c.srgb_to_linear()
+				mt.set_shader_parameter(["recolor_main", "recolor_accent", "recolor_glow"][k], Color(l.r, l.g, l.b, c.a))
+			_tinted[key] = mt
+		mat = _tinted[key]
+	for i in m.get_surface_count():
+		mi.set_surface_override_material(i, mat)
+
+
+static func merged(id: String, src: Mesh, hide: Array = []) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var key := id + ("|" + ",".join(hide) if not hide.is_empty() else "")
+	if _meshes.has(key):
+		return _meshes[key]
+	var table: Dictionary = Stage3D.info(id).get("materials", {})
+	var parts: Array = []
+	for i in src.get_surface_count():
+		var nm := src.surface_get_material(i).resource_name if src.surface_get_material(i) else ""
+		var look := Stage3D.surface_look(nm, str(table.get(nm, {}).get("kind", "toon")))
+		if not look["hidden"] and not hide.any(func(h): return nm.begins_with(h)):
+			parts.append([i, look, table.get(nm, {})])
+	var out := ArrayMesh.new()
+	var verts := PackedVector3Array()
+	var norms := PackedVector3Array()
+	var cols := PackedColorArray()
+	var custom := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var bones := PackedInt32Array()
+	var weights := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var idx := PackedInt32Array()
+	for part in parts:
+		var a := src.surface_get_arrays(part[0])
+		var nm: String = src.surface_get_material(part[0]).resource_name if src.surface_get_material(part[0]) else ""
+		var look: Dictionary = part[1]
+		var c: Array = part[2].get("color", [0.8, 0.8, 0.8])
+		var col := Color(c[0], c[1], c[2]).srgb_to_linear()   # (vertex colours are linear)
+		var emit := float(look["emit"]) * float(part[2].get("strength", 1.0))
+		var base := verts.size()
+		var vs: PackedVector3Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+		verts.append_array(vs)
+		norms.append_array(a[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL])
+		bones.append_array(a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES])
+		weights.append_array(a[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS])
+		var slot := 1.0 if nm.begins_with("AUT_Armor") else (2.0 if nm.begins_with("AUT_Red") else (3.0 if nm.begins_with("AUT_Glow") else 0.0))
+		for k in vs.size():
+			cols.append(col)
+			custom.append_array([look["metal"], look["rough"], emit, slot])
+		var ix: PackedInt32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
+		for k in ix:
+			idx.append(k + base)
+	var arr := []
+	arr.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = verts
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = norms
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = cols
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM0] = custom
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES] = bones
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS] = weights
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = idx
+	out.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, arr, [], {}, Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA_FLOAT << Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM0_SHIFT)
+	out.surface_set_name(0, "pbr")
+	_meshes[key] = out
+	return out

files.explanation: The 3D world - models: The 3D game's first-use work done at the title screen (as Warmup does for the 2D game), so the first flight into 3D space has no long frames: the noise texture made (on a worker), the shared unit spheres made, and one of every kind of 3D thing drawn - one a frame - in a small off-screen viewport set up as Cosmos's (the sky, a shadowed sun): the terrain, sea, atmosphere, clouds, gas giant, rings, star, glows, gate, engine, rocks and the plain materials of the hulls - their shaders compiled, their pipelines made (shadow passes too) - and the HUD's text sizes drawn once (the glyphs cached). Once a run; frees itself.

@@ -1,0 +1,244 @@ 
+class_name CosmosWarm
+extends Node
+## The 3D game's first-use work done at the title screen (as Warmup does for
+## the 2D game), so the first flight into 3D space has no long frames: the
+## noise texture made (on a worker), the shared unit spheres made, and one of
+## every kind of 3D thing drawn - one a frame - in a small off-screen
+## viewport set up as Cosmos's (the sky, a shadowed sun): the terrain, sea,
+## atmosphere, clouds, gas giant, rings, star, glows, gate, engine, rocks and
+## the plain materials of the hulls - their shaders compiled, their pipelines
+## made (shadow passes too) - and the HUD's text sizes drawn once (the
+## glyphs cached). Once a run; frees itself.
+
+const PER_FRAME := 1
+static var done := false
+
+var _vp: SubViewport
+var _queue: Array = []          # Callables, each adding one thing
+var _wait := 3                  # frames to draw after the last one
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	if done or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
+		queue_free()
+		return
+	done = true
+	Cosmos.start_noise()
+	for k in [[64, 32], [384, 192], [128, 64]]:
+		CosmosPlanet.unit_sphere(k[0], k[1]).get_rid()   # (made now, not in a build)
+	_vp = SubViewport.new()
+	_vp.size = Vector2i(96, 96)
+	_vp.own_world_3d = true
+	_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
+	add_child(_vp)
+	var cam := Camera3D.new()
+	cam.near = 0.25
+	cam.far = 600000.0
+	_vp.add_child(cam)
+	cam.position = Vector3(0, 0, 6)
+	var light := DirectionalLight3D.new()
+	light.shadow_enabled = true
+	light.directional_shadow_mode = DirectionalLight3D.SHADOW_PARALLEL_2_SPLITS
+	light.rotation = Vector3(-0.8, 0.5, 0)
+	_vp.add_child(light)
+	_queue.append(_sky)
+	for f in [_terrain, _water, _atmosphere, _clouds, _gas, _ring, _star, _glow, _gate, _engine, _rocks, _flora, _creature, _hulls, _walker, _pirate, _citizen, _town, _text]:
+		_queue.append(f)
+
+
+func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
+	if _queue.is_empty():
+		_wait -= 1
+		if _wait <= 0:
+			queue_free()
+		return
+	var noise := Cosmos.noise_ready()
+	if noise == null:
+		return   # (most of them sample it)
+	for i in PER_FRAME:
+		if _queue.is_empty():
+			break
+		(_queue.pop_front() as Callable).call()
+
+
+func _put(mesh: Mesh, mat: Material, at := Vector3.ZERO, shadow := false) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.mesh = mesh
+	mi.material_override = mat
+	mi.position = at
+	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON if shadow else GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	_vp.add_child(mi)
+	return mi
+
+
+func _shader(path: String) -> ShaderMaterial:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = load(path)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", Cosmos.noise_ready())
+	return m
+
+
+func _sky() -> void:
+	var sm := _shader("res://shaders/world/sky.gdshader")
+	var sky := Sky.new()
+	sky.sky_material = sm
+	sky.radiance_size = Sky.RADIANCE_SIZE_64
+	var env := Environment.new()
+	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_SKY
+	env.sky = sky
+	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
+	env.reflected_light_source = Environment.REFLECTION_SOURCE_SKY
+	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_ACES
+	env.glow_enabled = true      # (as Cosmos: the bloom's shaders compiled here)
+	env.adjustment_enabled = true
+	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
+	we.environment = env
+	_vp.add_child(we)
+
+
+func _terrain() -> void:
+	# (a patch's mesh as the planets make them: vertices, normals, UVs, an index)
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	for v in [Vector3(-1, -1, 0), Vector3(1, 1, 0), Vector3(1, -1, 0)]:
+		st.set_normal(Vector3.BACK)
+		st.set_uv(Vector2(1.0, 0.0))
+		st.add_vertex(v)
+	st.index()
+	var mi := _put(st.commit(), _shader("res://shaders/world/terrain.gdshader"), Vector3.ZERO, true)
+	mi.set_instance_shader_parameter("patch_centre", Vector3(0, 0, 1000))
+
+
+func _water() -> void:
+	_put(CosmosPlanet.unit_sphere(64, 32), _shader("res://shaders/world/water.gdshader"), Vector3(-1, 0, 0))
+
+
+func _atmosphere() -> void:
+	_put(CosmosPlanet.unit_sphere(64, 32), _shader("res://shaders/world/atmosphere.gdshader"), Vector3(1, 0, 0))
+
+
+func _clouds() -> void:
+	_put(CosmosPlanet.unit_sphere(128, 64), _shader("res://shaders/world/clouds.gdshader"), Vector3(0, 1, 0))
+
+
+func _gas() -> void:
+	_put(CosmosPlanet.unit_sphere(128, 64), _shader("res://shaders/world/gas_giant.gdshader"), Vector3(0, -1, 0))
+
+
+func _ring() -> void:
+	_put(QuadMesh.new(), _shader("res://shaders/world/ring.gdshader"), Vector3(1, 1, 0))
+
+
+func _star() -> void:
+	_put(CosmosPlanet.unit_sphere(64, 32), _shader("res://shaders/world/star.gdshader"), Vector3(-1, 1, 0))
+
+
+func _glow() -> void:
+	_put(QuadMesh.new(), _shader("res://shaders/world/glow.gdshader"), Vector3(1, -1, 0))
+
+
+func _gate() -> void:
+	_put(QuadMesh.new(), _shader("res://shaders/world/gate.gdshader"), Vector3(-1, -1, 0))
+
+
+func _engine() -> void:
+	var m := _shader("res://shaders/world/engine.gdshader")
+	_put(QuadMesh.new(), m, Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0)).set_instance_shader_parameter("level", 1.0)
+	var m2 := _shader("res://shaders/world/engine.gdshader")
+	m2.set_shader_parameter("glow", false)
+	_put(CylinderMesh.new(), m2, Vector3(-0.5, 0.5, 0)).set_instance_shader_parameter("level", 1.0)
+
+
+func _rocks() -> void:
+	var mm := MultiMesh.new()
+	mm.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+	mm.use_custom_data = true
+	mm.mesh = CosmosRocks._rock_mesh(1)
+	mm.instance_count = 1
+	mm.set_instance_transform(0, Transform3D(Basis.IDENTITY.scaled(Vector3.ONE * 0.3), Vector3(0.5, -0.5, 0)))
+	mm.set_instance_custom_data(0, Color(0.3, 0.6, 0.2, 0.7))
+	var mmi := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+	mmi.multimesh = mm
+	mmi.material_override = _shader("res://shaders/world/rock.gdshader")
+	_vp.add_child(mmi)
+
+
+func _flora() -> void:
+	var mm := MultiMesh.new()
+	mm.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+	var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, CosmosFlora._crystal(rng, Color.CYAN))
+	mm.mesh = m
+	mm.instance_count = 1
+	mm.set_instance_transform(0, Transform3D(Basis.IDENTITY.scaled(Vector3.ONE * 0.4), Vector3(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5)))
+	var mmi := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+	mmi.multimesh = mm
+	var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	mat.shader = load("res://shaders/world/flora.gdshader")
+	mmi.material_override = mat
+	_vp.add_child(mmi)
+
+
+func _hulls() -> void:
+	# The stations' and ships' plain materials: lit, metal, glowing, shadowed.
+	_put(BoxMesh.new(), CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.6, 0.6, 0.65), 0.55, 0.45), Vector3(-0.5, -0.5, 0), true)
+	_put(BoxMesh.new(), CosmosStation._mat(Color(1, 0.8, 0.5), 0.0, 0.5, Color(1, 0.8, 0.5) * 3.0), Vector3(0, 0.5, 0), true)
+	_put(TorusMesh.new(), CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.55), 0.7, 0.4), Vector3(0, -0.5, 0), true)
+
+
+func _walker() -> void:
+	# The automaton on foot (its cel shaders, skinned, in this lighting).
+	if not Stage3D.has_model("player"):
+		return
+	var model: Node3D = Stage3D._scene("player").instantiate()
+	model.scale = Vector3.ONE * 0.5
+	_vp.add_child(model)
+	CosmosModels.apply(model, "player")   # (the merged mesh made now, its shaders compiled)
+
+
+func _creature() -> void:
+	var m := _shader("res://shaders/world/creature.gdshader")
+	_put(CosmosPlanet.unit_sphere(64, 32), m, Vector3(0.3, -0.3, 0.5), true)
+
+
+func _pirate() -> void:
+	if not Stage3D.has_model("pirate"):
+		return
+	var model: Node3D = Stage3D._scene("pirate").instantiate()
+	model.scale = Vector3.ONE * 0.5
+	model.position = Vector3(0.6, -1, 0)
+	_vp.add_child(model)
+	CosmosModels.apply(model, "pirate")   # (the merged mesh made now, its shaders compiled)
+
+
+func _citizen() -> void:
+	# A town's citizen: the automaton recoloured (its own material).
+	if not Stage3D.has_model("player"):
+		return
+	var model: Node3D = Stage3D._scene("player").instantiate()
+	model.position = Vector3(1.0, -1.0, 0)
+	_vp.add_child(model)
+	CosmosModels.apply(model, "player", [Color(0.9, 0.8, 0.6, 0.85), Color(0.6, 0.1, 0.07), Color(1, 0.6, 0.2, 0.8)])
+	# The towns' people: the Minoan android with each weapon, the guard, Kilon Alios.
+	for v in [["minoan", ["MIN_Bow", "MIN_Axe"]], ["minoan", ["MIN_Rifle", "MIN_Axe"]], ["minoan", ["MIN_Rifle", "MIN_Bow"]], ["guard", []], ["kilon", []], ["skeleton", []], ["demon", []]]:
+		if Stage3D.has_model(v[0]):
+			var m2: Node3D = Stage3D._scene(v[0]).instantiate()
+			m2.position = Vector3(-1.0, -1.0, 0)
+			_vp.add_child(m2)
+			CosmosModels.apply(m2, v[0], [], v[1])
+
+
+func _town() -> void:
+	# The towns' buildings (one shader: their palette as parameters).
+	_put(BoxMesh.new(), CosmosTown.material("minoa"), Vector3(-1.5, 0, 0), true)
+
+
+func _text() -> void:
+	var c := Control.new()
+	c.size = Vector2(96, 96)
+	c.draw.connect(func():
+		for fs in CosmosHud.SIZES:
+			c.draw_string_outline(ThemeDB.fallback_font, Vector2(0, 40), "0123456789 abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ .,:;-+()/%", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, 4, Color.BLACK)
+			c.draw_string(ThemeDB.fallback_font, Vector2(0, 40), "0123456789 abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ .,:;-+()/%", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, Color.WHITE))
+	_vp.add_child(c)

files.explanation: The 3D world - models: The 3D stage: where the game's 3D characters are drawn, live, for its 2D world (the first step of the game turning 3D: the automaton on foot is its actual model - art/player_3d/player.glb, exported from Blender by external/blender/automaton/build.py "export" - not pictures of it). One SubViewport (a world of its own, transparent) holds a row of up to SLOTS cells, CELL px each; a character claims a cell (claim) and gets its model there - one skinned mesh, the kit's cel shading remade as shaders (shaders/toon_part, flat_part: the colours from model.json), its ink outline the mesh's inverted hull - seen by one orthographic camera from the game's angle (ELEVATION above the horizon), lit by one light fixed to the camera. A Sprite2D in the 2D world shows the cell (region(): SheetPuppet's model mode), standing on ANCHOR. The stage redraws HZ times a second, when it has characters: each is asked to pose itself (its `pose` callable) just before. Models are loaded and their shaders compiled on the loading screen (warm); freed cells keep their model for the next one.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,312 @@ 
+class_name Stage3D
+extends Node
+## The 3D stage: where the game's 3D characters are drawn, live, for its 2D
+## world (the first step of the game turning 3D: the automaton on foot is its
+## actual model - art/player_3d/player.glb, exported from Blender by
+## external/blender/automaton/build.py "export" - not pictures of it).
+##
+## One SubViewport (a world of its own, transparent) holds a row of up to SLOTS
+## cells, CELL px each; a character claims a cell (claim) and gets its model
+## there - one skinned mesh, the kit's cel shading remade as shaders
+## (shaders/toon_part, flat_part: the colours from model.json), its ink outline
+## the mesh's inverted hull - seen by one orthographic camera from the game's
+## angle (ELEVATION above the horizon), lit by one light fixed to the camera. A
+## Sprite2D in the 2D world shows the cell (region(): SheetPuppet's model mode),
+## standing on ANCHOR. The stage redraws HZ times a second, when it has
+## characters: each is asked to pose itself (its `pose` callable) just before.
+## Models are loaded and their shaders compiled on the loading screen (warm);
+## freed cells keep their model for the next one.
+
+const CELL := Vector2i(512, 640)
+const SLOTS := 4
+const PX_PER_M := 135.0
+const ANCHOR := Vector2(256.0, 480.0)       # where a character stands in its cell (px)
+const ELEVATION := 22.0                     # the camera above the horizon (degrees: the sprites' too)
+const HZ := 60.0
+const TOON := preload("res://shaders/toon_part.gdshader")   # (the old cel look: kept for reference)
+const FLAT := preload("res://shaders/flat_part.gdshader")
+## The game's look since 2026-11-21: photoreal (physically based parts, no ink outline).
+const PBR := preload("res://shaders/pbr_part.gdshader")
+const HIDDEN := preload("res://shaders/hidden_part.gdshader")
+
+static var _it: Stage3D
+static var _scenes := {}                    # id -> PackedScene
+static var _infos := {}                     # id -> model.json
+static var _mats := {}                      # id -> [Material per surface]
+
+var viewport: SubViewport
+var _cam: Camera3D
+var _slots: Array = []                      # per cell: {} (free) or {id, root, model, skeleton, anim, pose}
+var _pool := {}                             # id -> [model instances not in use]
+var _t := 0.0
+
+
+static func model_dir(id: String) -> String:
+	return "res://art/%s_3d/" % id
+
+
+static func has_model(id: String) -> bool:
+	return _infos.has(id) or (FileAccess.file_exists(model_dir(id) + "model.json") and ResourceLoader.exists(model_dir(id) + id + ".glb"))
+
+
+## A model's facts (model.json): fps, clips {n, loop, gun, marks, air (m a frame), points (m)}, materials.
+static func info(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if not _infos.has(id):
+		var parsed = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(model_dir(id) + "model.json"))
+		var d: Dictionary = parsed if parsed is Dictionary else {"clips": {}, "materials": {}}
+		d["fps"] = float(d.get("fps", 30))
+		d["stand_m"] = float(d.get("stand_m", 1.89))
+		_infos[id] = d
+	return _infos[id]
+
+
+## The stage (made the first time, under the root: it outlives the scenes).
+static func stage(tree: SceneTree) -> Stage3D:
+	if _it == null or not is_instance_valid(_it):
+		_it = Stage3D.new()
+		_it.name = "Stage3D"
+		tree.root.add_child.call_deferred(_it)      # (deferred: the root may be busy building a scene)
+	return _it
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	for i in SLOTS:
+		_slots.append({})
+	viewport = SubViewport.new()
+	viewport.size = Vector2i(CELL.x, CELL.y)      # (as wide as the cells in use: _fit)
+	viewport.transparent_bg = true
+	viewport.own_world_3d = true
+	viewport.msaa_3d = Viewport.MSAA_4X
+	viewport.positional_shadow_atlas_size = 0
+	viewport.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
+	viewport.gui_disable_input = true
+	add_child(viewport)
+	var env := Environment.new()
+	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
+	env.background_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
+	env.ambient_light_color = Color(0.55, 0.6, 0.7)    # (a soft sky fill: the photoreal look's shadows aren't black)
+	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.55
+	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC
+	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
+	we.environment = env
+	viewport.add_child(we)
+	var el := deg_to_rad(ELEVATION)
+	_cam = Camera3D.new()
+	_cam.projection = Camera3D.PROJECTION_ORTHOGONAL
+	_cam.size = CELL.y / PX_PER_M
+	_cam.near = 0.5
+	_cam.far = 60.0
+	viewport.add_child(_cam)
+	_fit()
+	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
+	sun.shadow_enabled = false
+	sun.light_energy = 1.6
+	viewport.add_child(sun)
+	# (as the kit's key light: from the upper left, a little toward the camera)
+	sun.look_at_from_position(Vector3(-3.4, 3.2, 2.4), Vector3.ZERO, Vector3.UP)
+
+
+## The picture as wide as the cells in use (1 for the automaton alone: a quarter
+## of the pixels), the camera over the middle of them, looking down at
+## ELEVATION; a cell's ground point (the model's origin) lands on ANCHOR.
+func _fit() -> void:
+	var n := 1
+	for i in SLOTS:
+		if not (_slots[i] as Dictionary).is_empty() if i < _slots.size() else false:
+			n = i + 1
+	if viewport.size.x != CELL.x * n:
+		viewport.size = Vector2i(CELL.x * n, CELL.y)
+	var el := deg_to_rad(ELEVATION)
+	var cell_m := CELL.x / PX_PER_M
+	var up_m := (CELL.y * 0.5 - (CELL.y - ANCHOR.y)) / PX_PER_M      # (the origin below the picture's middle: m on screen)
+	var look := Vector3(cell_m * (n - 1) * 0.5, up_m / cos(el), 0.0)
+	_cam.look_at_from_position(look + Vector3(0.0, sin(el), cos(el)) * 20.0, look, Vector3.UP)
+
+
+## A model's materials: the kit's, remade (shared by every instance).
+static func materials(id: String, mesh: Mesh) -> Array:
+	if not _mats.has(id):
+		var table: Dictionary = info(id).get("materials", {})
+		var out := []
+		for i in mesh.get_surface_count():
+			var src := mesh.surface_get_material(i)
+			var nm := src.resource_name if src else ""
+			var m: Dictionary = table.get(nm, {})
+			var sm := ShaderMaterial.new()
+			var c: Array = m.get("color", [0.8, 0.8, 0.8])
+			var look := surface_look(nm, str(m.get("kind", "toon")))
+			if look["hidden"]:
+				sm.shader = HIDDEN
+			else:
+				sm.shader = PBR
+				sm.set_shader_parameter("albedo", Color(c[0], c[1], c[2]))
+				sm.set_shader_parameter("metallic", look["metal"])
+				sm.set_shader_parameter("roughness", look["rough"])
+				var k := float(m.get("strength", 1.0)) * float(look["emit"])
+				sm.set_shader_parameter("emission", Vector3(_lin(c[0]), _lin(c[1]), _lin(c[2])) * k)
+			out.append(sm)
+		_mats[id] = out
+	return _mats[id]
+
+
+## How a part's surface takes the light, by its material's name (the kit's
+## names: AUT_Armor, PIR_Leather, KIT_Ink...) and kind: {metal, rough, emit, hidden}.
+static func surface_look(nm: String, kind: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var n := nm.to_lower()
+	if kind == "ink" or n.contains("ink"):
+		return {"metal": 0.0, "rough": 1.0, "emit": 0.0, "hidden": true}
+	if kind == "glow" or n.contains("glow") or n.contains("eye"):
+		return {"metal": 0.0, "rough": 0.3, "emit": 3.0, "hidden": false}
+	for k in ["bone", "hide", "wing", "skin", "crest", "cloth"]:
+		if n.contains(k):
+			return {"metal": 0.0, "rough": 0.7, "emit": 0.0, "hidden": false}   # (bone, hide, cloth: matte)
+	for k in ["gold", "bronze", "gun"]:
+		if n.contains(k):
+			return {"metal": 0.9, "rough": 0.28, "emit": 0.0, "hidden": false}
+	if n.contains("armor") or n.contains("armour"):
+		return {"metal": 0.55, "rough": 0.32, "emit": 0.0, "hidden": false}   # (painted metal plates)
+	if n.contains("grey") or n.contains("red"):
+		return {"metal": 0.45, "rough": 0.38, "emit": 0.0, "hidden": false}
+	if n.contains("joint") or n.contains("cable"):
+		return {"metal": 0.2, "rough": 0.6, "emit": 0.0, "hidden": false}     # (rubber, braided cable)
+	if n.contains("leather") or n.contains("coat") or n.contains("hat"):
+		return {"metal": 0.0, "rough": 0.75, "emit": 0.0, "hidden": false}    # (leather, cloth)
+	return {"metal": 0.4, "rough": 0.45, "emit": 0.0, "hidden": false}
+
+
+static func _lin(x: float) -> float:
+	return x / 12.92 if x <= 0.04045 else pow((x + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4)
+
+
+static func _scene(id: String) -> PackedScene:
+	if not _scenes.has(id):
+		_scenes[id] = load(model_dir(id) + id + ".glb")
+	return _scenes[id]
+
+
+## A model made ready: its materials, its animations set for being posed by hand
+## (looping clips a whole cycle long, wrapping round).
+func _make(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var model: Node3D = _scene(id).instantiate()
+	var mesh: MeshInstance3D = model.find_child("Body", true, false)
+	var sk: Skeleton3D = model.find_child("Skeleton3D", true, false)
+	var anim: AnimationPlayer = model.find_child("AnimationPlayer", true, false)
+	var mats := materials(id, mesh.mesh)
+	for i in mats.size():
+		mesh.set_surface_override_material(i, mats[i])
+	mesh.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	mesh.extra_cull_margin = 4.0           # (posed far from its rest box: a leap, a fall)
+	anim.callback_mode_process = AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_MANUAL
+	var d: Dictionary = info(id)
+	var fps: float = d["fps"]
+	for name in d["clips"]:
+		if anim.has_animation(name):
+			var a := anim.get_animation(name)
+			var n := int(d["clips"][name]["n"])
+			if bool(d["clips"][name].get("loop", false)):
+				a.loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR
+				a.length = n / fps
+			else:
+				a.loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_NONE
+				a.length = maxf(a.length, (n - 1) / fps)
+	return {"id": id, "model": model, "skeleton": sk, "anim": anim, "gun": sk.find_bone("gun")}
+
+
+## A cell for a character: {slot, model, skeleton, anim, gun} - {} when the
+## stage is full. `pose` (dt) is called before each redraw.
+func claim(id: String, pose: Callable) -> Dictionary:
+	var slot := -1
+	for i in SLOTS:
+		if (_slots[i] as Dictionary).is_empty():
+			slot = i
+			break
+	if slot < 0:
+		return {}
+	var c: Dictionary
+	var free: Array = _pool.get(id, [])
+	if not free.is_empty():
+		c = free.pop_back()
+	else:
+		c = _make(id)
+	c["slot"] = slot
+	c["pose"] = pose
+	var model: Node3D = c["model"]
+	model.position = Vector3(slot * CELL.x / PX_PER_M, 0.0, 0.0)
+	if model.get_parent() == null:
+		viewport.add_child(model)
+	model.visible = true
+	_slots[slot] = c
+	_fit()
+	_t = 1.0                                # (drawn at once)
+	return c
+
+
+func release(slot: int) -> void:
+	if slot < 0 or slot >= SLOTS or (_slots[slot] as Dictionary).is_empty():
+		return
+	var c: Dictionary = _slots[slot]
+	_slots[slot] = {}
+	c["pose"] = Callable()
+	(c["model"] as Node3D).visible = false
+	if not _pool.has(c["id"]):
+		_pool[c["id"]] = []
+	_pool[c["id"]].append(c)
+	_fit()
+	viewport.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE   # (its picture cleared)
+
+
+func in_use() -> int:
+	return _slots.filter(func(s): return not (s as Dictionary).is_empty()).size()
+
+
+## A cell of the stage's picture.
+func region(slot: int) -> Rect2:
+	return Rect2(slot * CELL.x, 0, CELL.x, CELL.y)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t += delta
+	if _t < 1.0 / HZ:
+		return
+	var dt := minf(_t, 0.1)
+	_t = 0.0
+	var any := false
+	for c in _slots:
+		var pose: Callable = (c as Dictionary).get("pose", Callable())
+		if pose.is_valid():
+			pose.call(dt)
+			any = true
+	if any:
+		viewport.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+
+
+## Every 3D character's model loaded, made and drawn once, unseen - on the
+## loading screen, never in play (awaitable).
+static func warm(tree: SceneTree) -> void:
+	for dir in DirAccess.get_directories_at("res://art"):
+		if not dir.ends_with("_3d"):
+			continue
+		var id := dir.trim_suffix("_3d")
+		if not has_model(id) or _scenes.has(id):
+			continue
+		var path := model_dir(id) + id + ".glb"
+		if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
+			_scenes[id] = load(path)
+		else:
+			ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path)
+			while ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path) == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS:
+				await tree.process_frame
+			_scenes[id] = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(path)
+		info(id)
+		await tree.process_frame
+		var st := stage(tree)
+		while not st.is_inside_tree():
+			await tree.process_frame
+		var c := st.claim(id, func(_dt): pass)       # (made, and its shaders compiled as it's drawn)
+		if c.is_empty():
+			continue
+		for i in 4:
+			st.viewport.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+			await tree.process_frame
+		st.release(int(c["slot"]))

+class_name CosmosCam
+extends Camera3D
+## The third-person camera of the 3D game (Cosmos): behind and above the
+## ship, turning after it a moment late (you see the ship bank and pitch),
+## widening its view with speed. The wheel pulls it in and out; holding the
+## right button looks round the ship with the mouse (let go: it swings back).
+## It never dips under the ground.
+
+const OFFSET := Vector3(0.0, 13.0, 54.0)   # (the ship's ~49 m long)
+const LOOK_AHEAD := 70.0
+
+var target: Node3D
+var zoom := 1.35
+var cosmos: Node
+var _q := Quaternion.IDENTITY
+var _look := Vector2.ZERO       # free look (yaw, pitch)
+var _fov := 70.0
+## On foot (stage 2): the walker it orbits instead of the ship - the mouse
+## turns the view round it (its `heading`) and up and down.
+var walker: Node3D = null
+var foot_zoom := 1.0
+var _pitch := 0.25
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	near = 0.25
+	far = 600000.0
+	fov = 70.0
+	if target:
+		_q = target.global_basis.get_rotation_quaternion()
+
+
+func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if walker:
+		if event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
+			var u: Vector3 = walker.up()
+			walker.heading = walker.heading.rotated(u, -event.relative.x * 0.004).normalized()
+			_pitch = clampf(_pitch + event.relative.y * 0.003, -1.35, 1.25)   # (up to ~77 degrees up: the sky)
+		elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
+			if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
+				foot_zoom = maxf(0.4, foot_zoom / 1.12)
+			elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
+				foot_zoom = minf(5.0, foot_zoom * 1.12)
+		return
+	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
+		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
+			zoom = maxf(0.45, zoom / 1.12)
+		elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
+			zoom = minf(4.0, zoom * 1.12)
+	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT):
+		_look += event.relative * 0.005
+		_look.y = clampf(_look.y, -1.2, 1.2)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	follow(minf(delta, 0.05))
+
+
+func follow(delta: float) -> void:
+	if walker:
+		_follow_walker(delta)
+		return
+	if target == null:
+		return
+	var tq := target.global_basis.get_rotation_quaternion()
+	_q = _q.slerp(tq, 1.0 - exp(-delta * 7.0)).normalized()
+	if not Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT):
+		_look = _look.lerp(Vector2.ZERO, 1.0 - exp(-delta * 3.0))
+	var b := Basis(_q) * Basis(Vector3.UP, -_look.x) * Basis(Vector3.RIGHT, -_look.y)
+	var at := target.global_position
+	var pos := at + b * (OFFSET * zoom)
+	if cosmos:
+		pos = cosmos.keep_above_ground(pos, 2.0)
+		pos = cosmos.camera_clear(at + b * Vector3(0, OFFSET.y * zoom * 0.5, 0), pos, target)
+	global_position = pos
+	var ahead := at + (Basis(_q) * Vector3.FORWARD) * LOOK_AHEAD * (1.0 if _look.length() < 0.05 else 0.0)
+	if ahead.distance_to(pos) > 0.01:
+		look_at(ahead + b * Vector3(0, OFFSET.y * zoom * 0.35, 0), b * Vector3.UP)
+	var spd: float = target.speed() if target.has_method("speed") else 0.0
+	var want := 70.0 + clampf(spd / 400.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 6.0 + clampf(log(maxf(spd, 1.0)) / log(40000.0), 0.0, 1.0) * 10.0
+	_fov = lerpf(_fov, want, 1.0 - exp(-delta * 3.0))
+	fov = _fov
+
+
+## Behind the walker, over its shoulder, along the camera's heading on the ground.
+func _follow_walker(delta: float) -> void:
+	var u: Vector3 = walker.up()
+	var h: Vector3 = walker.heading
+	var right := h.cross(u).normalized()
+	var pivot: Vector3 = walker.global_position + u * 1.55
+	# Where it looks comes from the pitch itself (the sky too, when the ground
+	# holds the camera up behind you); it sits back along that line, over the shoulder.
+	var look := (h * cos(_pitch) - u * sin(_pitch)).normalized()
+	var pos := pivot - look * 4.6 * foot_zoom + right * 0.55 * minf(foot_zoom, 1.5)
+	if cosmos:
+		pos = cosmos.keep_above_ground(pos, 0.6)
+		pos = cosmos.camera_clear(pivot, pos)
+	global_position = pos
+	look_at(pos + look * 10.0 + right * 0.05, u if absf(look.dot(u)) < 0.98 else h)
+	_fov = lerpf(_fov, 68.0, 1.0 - exp(-delta * 3.0))
+	fov = _fov
+	_q = global_basis.get_rotation_quaternion()
+
+
+## Back to the ship: its view from behind, from where the camera is now.
+func to_ship() -> void:
+	walker = null
+	if target:
+		_q = target.global_basis.get_rotation_quaternion()

+	draw_rect(Rect2(x + 40, y + 58, 160 * maxf(ship.throttle, 0.0), 6), ACCENT)
+	if ship.throttle < 0.0:
+		draw_rect(Rect2(x + 40 - 40 * -ship.throttle / 0.25, y + 58, 40 * -ship.throttle / 0.25, 6), WARN)
+	var line := y + 88.0
+	if pl and ship.global_position.distance_to(pl.global_position) < pl.radius * 3.0:
+		var u := (ship.global_position - pl.global_position).normalized()
+		var lat := rad_to_deg(asin(clampf(u.y, -1.0, 1.0)))
+		var lon := rad_to_deg(atan2(u.x, u.z))
+		_text(Vector2(x, line), "%.2f° %s   %.2f° %s" % [absf(lat), "N" if lat >= 0.0 else "S", absf(lon), "E" if lon >= 0.0 else "W"], 17, ACCENT)
+		line += 22.0
+	_text(Vector2(x, line), cosmos.where_text(), 16, DIM)
+	line += 22.0
+	if ship.heat > 0.01:
+		var hcol := Color(1.0, 0.75 - ship.heat * 0.5, 0.2)
+		_text(Vector2(x, line), "HEAT %d%%" % roundi(ship.heat * 100.0), 17, hcol)
+		draw_rect(Rect2(x + 90, line - 10, 110, 8), Color(hcol, 0.2))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(x + 90, line - 10, 110 * ship.heat, 8), hcol)
+		line += 22.0
+	# Guns and ammo.
+	var kinds := {}
+	for gn in ship.guns:
+		kinds[gn["name"]] = int(kinds.get(gn["name"], 0)) + 1
+	var parts := []
+	for n in kinds:
+		parts.append("%s%s" % [n, (" x%d" % kinds[n]) if kinds[n] > 1 else ""])
+	var missiles: int = CosmosGame.data.count("missile") if CosmosGame.data else 0
+	_text(Vector2(gr.position.x - 40, gr.end.y + 52), ", ".join(parts) + ("   Missiles: %d" % missiles if missiles > 0 or ship.guns.any(func(gg): return gg["ammo"] != "") else ""), 16, ACCENT)
+	if tgt:
+		var d: float = cam.global_position.distance_to(tgt.global_position) - cosmos.radius_of(tgt)
+		var eta := " - %s" % _time(d / spd) if spd > 5.0 else ""
+		_text(Vector2(gr.position.x, gr.end.y + 76), "Target: %s  %s%s" % [cosmos.label_of(tgt), _dist(d), eta], 17, WARN if (tgt is CosmosNpcShip and tgt.hostile) or tgt is CosmosMonster else ACCENT)
+		if tgt is CosmosNpcShip or tgt is CosmosMonster:
+			var ts = tgt
+			draw_rect(Rect2(gr.position.x, gr.end.y + 84, 120, 6), Color(0.35, 0.75, 1.0, 0.3))
+			draw_rect(Rect2(gr.position.x, gr.end.y + 84, 120 * ts.shield / maxf(ts.max_shield, 1.0), 6), Color(0.6, 0.9, 1.0))
+			draw_rect(Rect2(gr.position.x + 130, gr.end.y + 84, 120, 6), Color(1.0, 0.65, 0.3, 0.3))
+			draw_rect(Rect2(gr.position.x + 130, gr.end.y + 84, 120 * ts.hull / ts.max_hull, 6), Color(1.0, 0.65, 0.3))
+
+
+## Your pad: its marker (an arrow at the edge when off the screen), and over
+## it the height, the drift off its middle and the speed to set down.
+func _draw_pad(vs: Vector2, c: Vector2) -> void:
+	var st: CosmosStation = cosmos.dock_station
+	var xf := st.pad_transform(cosmos.dock_pad)
+	var p := xf.origin
+	var id := int(cosmos.dock_pad["id"])
+	if cam.is_position_behind(p):
+		_edge_arrow(c, -(cam.unproject_position(p) - c), vs)
+	else:
+		var s := cam.unproject_position(p)
+		if Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, vs).grow(-20).has_point(s):
+			draw_rect(Rect2(s - Vector2(14, 14), Vector2(28, 28)), ACCENT, false, 2.0)
+			draw_line(s + Vector2(-20, 0), s + Vector2(-8, 0), ACCENT, 2.0)
+			draw_line(s + Vector2(8, 0), s + Vector2(20, 0), ACCENT, 2.0)
+			_text(s + Vector2(18, -8), "Pad %d" % id, 17, ACCENT)
+			_text(s + Vector2(18, 12), _dist(cam.global_position.distance_to(p)), 16, ACCENT)
+		else:
+			_edge_arrow(c, s - c, vs)
+	if cosmos.walker:
+		return
+	var l := xf.affine_inverse() * ship.global_position
+	if l.y < 0.0 or l.y > 600.0 or Vector2(l.x, l.z).length() > 600.0:
+		return
+	var v := ship.velocity.length()
+	var lvl := ship.global_basis.y.dot(xf.basis.y) >= 0.85
+	var ok := v <= Cosmos.PAD_SPEED and lvl
+	var lines := ["Pad %d   height %s   off centre %s" % [id, _dist(maxf(l.y - CosmosShip.GEAR, 0.0)), _dist(Vector2(l.x, l.z).length())],
+		"%.0f m/s%s" % [v, "" if ok else ("  - too fast" if lvl else "  - not level")]]
+	for i in lines.size():
+		var w := _font.get_string_size(lines[i], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 20).x
+		_text(Vector2(c.x - w * 0.5, vs.y - 236.0 + i * 26.0), lines[i], 20, ACCENT if ok else WARN)
+
+
+## What you can do here (land, dock, take off...): one line above the toolbar.
+func _draw_prompt(vs: Vector2, c: Vector2) -> void:
+	var hint := ""
+	if ship.state == "docking" or cosmos.is_docking():
+		hint = "Docking..."
+	elif ship.state == "landed" and cosmos.docked:
+		hint = "E: up from the seat    L / Space: undock"
+	elif ship.state == "landed":
+		hint = "E: up from the seat    L / Space: take off"
+	elif not cosmos.dock_pad.is_empty() and not cosmos.docked:
+		hint = "Set down on pad %d    F: cancel" % int(cosmos.dock_pad["id"])
+	elif cosmos.station_near() != null:
+		hint = "F: ask %s for a pad" % cosmos.label_of(cosmos.station_near())
+	elif cosmos.planet_below(ship.global_position, 400.0) != null:
+		var why: String = cosmos.landing_check()
+		hint = "L: land" if why == "" else "Landing: " + why
+	if hint == "":
+		return
+	var hw := _font.get_string_size(hint, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 22).x
+	_text(Vector2(c.x - hw * 0.5, vs.y - 150.0), hint, 22, ACCENT if hint.contains(": ") and not hint.begins_with("Landing") else WARN)
+
+
+## On foot: the planet, the way back to the ship, the controls.
+func _draw_foot(vs: Vector2, c: Vector2) -> void:
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker
+	var y := vs.y - 250.0
+	var x := c.x - 260.0
+	draw_rect(Rect2(x - 16, y - 16, 552, 110), Color(0.02, 0.05, 0.09, 0.62))
+	_text(Vector2(x, y + 14), cosmos.where_text(), 20, ACCENT)
+	var d := w.global_position.distance_to(ship.global_position)
+	var term: Array = cosmos.terminal_here()
+	var inside: bool = ship.interior != null and w.get("deck") == ship.interior
+	if not term.is_empty():
+		_text(Vector2(x, y + 44), "E: %s" % term[0], 20, ACCENT)
+	elif inside and ship.interior.at_seat(ship.interior.to_local(w.global_position)):
+		_text(Vector2(x, y + 44), "E: take the controls", 20, ACCENT)
+	elif inside:
+		_text(Vector2(x, y + 44), "The pilot's seat: forward, in the cockpit" + ("  -  the ramp: aft, in the hold" if ship.interior.ramp_down else ""), 18, DIM)
+	elif cosmos.dungeon and w.get("deck") == cosmos.dungeon:
+		_text(Vector2(x, y + 44), "Your ship: on the surface, up the stairs", 20, DIM)
+	elif d < 60.0:
+		_text(Vector2(x, y + 44), "Board up the ramp, under the ship's tail", 18, ACCENT)
+	else:
+		_text(Vector2(x, y + 44), ("Your ship: away in orbit - %s: call it" % Keybinds.keys_text("ship_call")) if cosmos.ship_away else ("Your ship: %s" % _dist(d)), 20, DIM)
+	# The sights, and what they're on.
+	draw_arc(c, 9.0, 0, TAU, 24, ACCENT, 1.5)
+	draw_line(c + Vector2(-18, 0), c + Vector2(-11, 0), ACCENT, 1.5)
+	draw_line(c + Vector2(11, 0), c + Vector2(18, 0), ACCENT, 1.5)
+	var a: Array = cosmos.aim()
+	if a[0] != null:
+		var t: Node3D = a[0]
+		var name: String = CosmosFauna.label(t.kind) if t is CosmosCreature else str(t.get("label"))
+		var hostile: bool = (t is CosmosNpc) or (t is CosmosCreature and t.kind["temper"] == "predator")
+		_text(c + Vector2(26, -14), name, 18, WARN if hostile else ACCENT)
+		var f := float(t.get("hp")) / maxf(float(t.get("max_hp")), 1.0)
+		draw_rect(Rect2(c + Vector2(26, -6), Vector2(120, 6)), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.15))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(c + Vector2(26, -6), Vector2(120 * f, 6)), WARN if hostile else ACCENT)
+		_text(c + Vector2(26, 18), _dist(float(a[2])), 15, DIM)
+	if hit_flash > 0.0:
+		var k := hit_flash * 0.5
+		for i in 6:
+			var m := 30.0 + i * 22.0
+			draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, vs).grow(-m), Color(1, 0.1, 0.05, k * (1.0 - i / 6.0) * 0.35), false, 22.0)
+	if note != "":
+		var nw := _font.get_string_size(note, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 26).x
+		_text(Vector2(c.x - nw * 0.5, 150), note, 26, WARN)
+
+
+## The Hyperion drive at speed: streaks of light rushing out from the middle.
+func _streaks(c: Vector2, vs: Vector2) -> void:
+	var k := clampf(log(maxf(ship.speed(), 1.0)) / log(CosmosShip.CRUISE_MAX), 0.0, 1.0)
+	var t := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
+	var r := vs.length() * 0.5
+	for i in 90:
+		var a := fmod(i * 2.39996, TAU)
+		var ph := fmod(t * (0.6 + 1.6 * k) + i * 0.137, 1.0)
+		var d := Vector2.from_angle(a)
+		var r0 := r * (0.12 + ph * ph)
+		var len := r * (0.04 + 0.22 * k) * ph
+		draw_line(c + d * r0, c + d * (r0 + len), Color(0.7, 0.9, 1.0, 0.35 * k * ph), 1.5)
+
+
+func _edge_arrow(c: Vector2, dir: Vector2, vs: Vector2) -> void:
+	if dir.length() < 1.0:
+		return
+	var d := dir.normalized()
+	var r := minf(vs.x, vs.y) * 0.42
+	var p := c + d * r
+	var n := Vector2(-d.y, d.x)
+	draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([p + d * 16.0, p - d * 8.0 + n * 10.0, p - d * 8.0 - n * 10.0]), ACCENT)
+
+
+func _text(at: Vector2, s: String, fs: int, col: Color) -> void:
+	draw_string_outline(_font, at, s, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, 4, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.7))
+	draw_string(_font, at, s, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, col)
+
+
+static func _thousands(n: int) -> String:
+	var s := str(absi(n))
+	var out := ""
+	while s.length() > 3:
+		out = "," + s.substr(s.length() - 3) + out
+		s = s.substr(0, s.length() - 3)
+	return ("-" if n < 0 else "") + s + out
+
+
+static func _dist(m: float) -> String:
+	m = maxf(m, 0.0)
+	if m < 1000.0:
+		return "%d m" % roundi(m)
+	if m < 100000.0:
+		return "%.1f km" % (m / 1000.0)
+	return "%d km" % roundi(m / 1000.0)
+
+
+static func _speed(v: float) -> String:
+	if v < 1000.0:
+		return "%d m/s" % roundi(v)
+	return "%.1f km/s" % (v / 1000.0)
+
+
+static func _time(s: float) -> String:
+	if s < 60.0:
+		return "%ds" % roundi(s)
+	if s < 3600.0:
+		return "%dm %02ds" % [int(s / 60.0), int(s) % 60]
+	return "%dh" % int(s / 3600.0)
