bubbles.text: A message: the 2D HUD's (its place, its look) and a line in the event console.

The ship's circular readout, round its gauge (the 2D HUD's, top left): the compass ring (north: the planet's when near one, else the system's), the speed and the drive (Hyperion's state and speed), heat; beside it latitude and longitude over a planet, the guns and their ammo, the target.
What you can do here (land, dock, take off...): one line above the toolbar.
On foot: the planet, the way back to the ship, the controls.

files.explanation: The 3D world - you: your ship, on foot, the camera, the HUD: Your ship in the 3D game (Cosmos): a procedural hull (a lofted fuselage, swept wings, twin engines, a canopy, fins - in your empire's colours) and its flight: the mouse is a virtual stick (its offset from the middle sets the pitch and yaw rates; C or the middle button centres it), A / D roll, W / S the throttle (it stays where you leave it; X stops), Shift boosts; thrusters: Space / Ctrl up and down, Q / E sideways (landing on pads). J engages the Hyperion drive: after a two-second charge it races across the system - to your target (T) if you have one, steering itself there while you leave the stick alone - its top speed a share of the distance left (up to 250 km/s: any planet in well under a minute), so it slows by itself as you arrive and drops you out HYPER_ARRIVE short of it; passing close to anything else slows it too, and it drops out rather than hit it. Flight assist always steers the velocity toward the nose. Bumps: the ground (it skims along it), stations, rocks, the star.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,570 @@ 
+class_name CosmosShip
+extends Node3D
+## Your ship in the 3D game (Cosmos): a procedural hull (a lofted fuselage,
+## swept wings, twin engines, a canopy, fins - in your empire's colours) and
+## its flight: the mouse is a virtual stick (its offset from the middle sets
+## the pitch and yaw rates; C or the middle button centres it), A / D roll,
+## W / S the throttle (it stays where you leave it; X stops), Shift boosts;
+## thrusters: Space / Ctrl up and down, Q / E sideways (landing on pads).
+## J engages the Hyperion drive: after a two-second charge it races across
+## the system - to your target (T) if you have one, steering itself there
+## while you leave the stick alone - its top speed a share of the distance
+## left (up to 250 km/s: any planet in well under a minute), so it slows by
+## itself as you arrive and drops you out HYPER_ARRIVE short of it; passing
+## close to anything else slows it too, and it drops out rather than hit it. Flight assist always steers the velocity toward the nose.
+## Bumps: the ground (it skims along it), stations, rocks, the star.
+
+const MAX_SPEED := 180.0        # m/s, full throttle
+const BOOST := 2.6              # times that with Shift
+const ACCEL := 70.0             # m/s2
+const RATES := Vector3(1.25, 0.8, 2.2)   # pitch, yaw, roll (rad/s at full stick)
+const CRUISE_CHARGE := 2.0      # s (the Hyperion drive spooling up)
+const CRUISE_MIN := 800.0       # m/s
+const CRUISE_MAX := 250000.0    # m/s
+const CRUISE_SHARE := 0.8       # top speed = this x the distance left (to the target, else to the nearest thing) a second
+const CRUISE_DROP := 450.0      # m: drop out this close to something in the way (an exclusion zone)
+const HYPER_ARRIVE := 1600.0    # m: dropped out this far from the target's surface
+const ASSIST := 1.3             # rad/s: turning to the target by itself
+const ALIGN := 0.2              # rad: the drive engages only with the nose this close to the target
+const DEADZONE := 0.06
+const THRUST := 45.0            # m/s: the manoeuvring thrusters' (up / down, sideways)
+const HULL_R := 20.0            # m (bumps)
+const SCALE := 2.6              # the hull's design scaled up: ~49 m long, big enough to walk inside
+
+var velocity := Vector3.ZERO
+var throttle := 0.0             # -0.25 .. 1
+var stick := Vector2.ZERO       # x right, y down (mouse); |stick| <= 1
+var roll := 0.0
+var boosting := false
+var lift := 0.0                 # -1 .. 1: the thrusters, up / down
+var strafe := 0.0               # -1 .. 1: right / left
+var cruise := 0                 # 0 off, 1 charging, 2 engaged
+var cruise_t := 0.0
+var _aim := Vector3.ZERO        # (the way the drive's assist steers: to the target, round what's between)
+var well: Array = [1.0, null]   # (the gravity slowing the Hyperion drive: [factor, body] - the HUD)
+var cosmos: Node                # (Cosmos: clearance, bumps)
+var control := true             # (off: tests drive it, menus open)
+var _ang := Vector3.ZERO
+var _headless := DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless"
+var _glows: Array = []
+var _plumes: Array = []
+## The input for this frame when not read from the devices (tests): {throttle, stick, roll, boost}.
+var drive := {}
+## Combat (stage 4): shields soak hits and come back after a moment; the hull
+## doesn't. The left button fires twin lasers from the wingtips at what the
+## sights are on (leading a targeted ship).
+const MAX_SHIELD := 120.0
+const MAX_HULL := 200.0
+const LASER_EVERY := 0.14
+const LASER_DAMAGE := 14.0
+var max_shield := MAX_SHIELD    # (from your fittings - apply_upgrades)
+var max_hull := MAX_HULL
+var laser_damage := LASER_DAMAGE
+var speed_k := 1.0
+var shield := MAX_SHIELD
+var hull := MAX_HULL
+var trigger := false
+var reach := 18.0
+var _laser := 0.0
+var _side := 1.0
+var _since_hit := 99.0
+## On a planet (stage 2): "fly", "landing" (settling onto its spot), "landed", "takeoff".
+var state := "fly"
+const LAND_TIME := 2.6
+const GEAR := 3.6               # m: the hull's middle over the ground, landed (on its legs)
+var _land_from := Transform3D.IDENTITY
+var _land_to := Transform3D.IDENTITY
+var _land_t := 0.0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	name = "Ship"
+	add_to_group("cam_solid")   # (on foot, the camera stops short of the hull)
+	set_meta("cam_reach", 60.0)
+	_build()
+
+
+func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not control:
+		return
+	if event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED and not Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT):
+		stick += event.relative * Vector2(1.0, 1.0) / 260.0
+		if stick.length() > 1.0:
+			stick = stick.normalized()
+	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE:
+		stick = Vector2.ZERO
+	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and state == "fly":
+		if Keybinds.pressed(event, "hyperion"):
+			toggle_cruise()
+		elif Keybinds.pressed(event, "stop"):
+			throttle = 0.0
+		elif Keybinds.pressed(event, "centre"):
+			stick = Vector2.ZERO
+	elif event is InputEventJoypadButton and event.pressed:
+		match event.button_index:
+			JOY_BUTTON_Y:
+				toggle_cruise()
+			JOY_BUTTON_B:
+				throttle = 0.0
+
+
+## The ship's numbers from your real fittings (the 2D game's): its class
+## (Shipyard), the modules, tech and upgrades (PlayerData.mod) - as the 2D ship
+## (Ship.apply_tech) - scaled to the 3D game's (the starting ship = MAX_HULL,
+## MAX_SHIELD, MAX_SPEED); and its guns: the weapons on its hardpoints, each
+## firing with its own damage, rate and colour (Hardpoints.stats).
+var guns: Array = []            # [{id, kind, name, damage, interval, cool, color, ammo}]
+var gun_on := 0                 # (the toolbar's pick: -1 all)
+const DAMAGE_K := 1.6           # the 2D game's damage -> the 3D game's (its hulls are bigger)
+const KIND_COLOR := {"pulse_cannon": Color(0.45, 0.9, 1.0), "plasma_cannon": Color(0.5, 1.0, 0.45), "missile_launcher": Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.25),
+	"beam_emitter": Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.3), "electro": Color(0.65, 0.55, 1.0), "bouncer": Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.35)}
+
+
+func apply_upgrades() -> void:
+	var data: Node = CosmosGame.data
+	if data == null:
+		return
+	var base := Shipyard.stats("player")
+	var cls := Shipyard.stats(str(data.ship_class))
+	max_hull = MAX_HULL * (float(cls["hull"]) + data.mod("max_hull")) / float(base["hull"])
+	max_shield = MAX_SHIELD * (float(cls["shields"]) + data.mod("max_shields")) * maxf(0.1, 1.0 + data.mod("max_shields_mult")) / float(base["shields"])
+	speed_k = float(cls["speed"]) * (1.0 + data.mod("speed_mult")) / float(base["speed"])
+	shield = minf(shield, max_shield)
+	hull = minf(hull, max_hull)
+	guns.clear()
+	for id in data.weapons:
+		if str(id) == "":
+			continue
+		var w := Hardpoints.stats(str(id))
+		var kind := Hardpoints.kind(str(id))
+		guns.append({"id": id, "kind": kind, "name": Hardpoints.title(str(id)), "damage": float(w["damage"]) * DAMAGE_K * (float(w["interval"]) if w.get("style", "") == "beam" else 1.0),
+			"interval": maxf(float(w.get("interval", 0.3)), 0.08), "cool": 0.0, "color": KIND_COLOR.get(kind, Color(0.45, 0.9, 1.0)),
+			"ammo": "missile" if kind == "missile_launcher" else ""})
+	if guns.is_empty():
+		guns.append({"id": "", "kind": "pulse_cannon", "name": "Pulse lasers", "damage": LASER_DAMAGE, "interval": LASER_EVERY, "cool": 0.0, "color": KIND_COLOR["pulse_cannon"], "ammo": ""})
+	laser_damage = guns[0]["damage"]
+
+
+## Every gun ready (or the toolbar's pick) fires at what the sights are on -
+## missiles take one from the hold each.
+func _fire_guns(delta: float) -> void:
+	var at: Vector3 = cosmos.ship_aim()
+	for i in guns.size():
+		var g: Dictionary = guns[i]
+		g["cool"] = float(g["cool"]) - delta
+		if g["cool"] > 0.0 or (gun_on >= 0 and gun_on < guns.size() and i != gun_on):
+			continue
+		if g["ammo"] != "" and not CosmosGame.data.remove_item(str(g["ammo"]), 1):
+			continue
+		g["cool"] = g["interval"]
+		_side = -_side
+		var muzzle := global_position + global_basis.x * 17.0 * _side - global_basis.z * 8.0
+		var b := CosmosBolt.fire(cosmos, muzzle, at - muzzle, "player", float(g["damage"]), true)
+		b.tint = g["color"]
+
+
+func up() -> Vector3:
+	return global_basis.y
+
+
+func hurt(dmg: float, _from: Variant = null) -> void:
+	if state != "fly":
+		return
+	_since_hit = 0.0
+	var sh := minf(shield, dmg)
+	shield -= sh
+	hull -= dmg - sh
+	if cosmos and cosmos.hud:
+		cosmos.hud.hit_flash = 0.4
+	if cruise != 0:
+		_drop_cruise(MAX_SPEED)   # (hit: knocked out of the Hyperion drive)
+	if hull <= 0.0 and cosmos:
+		cosmos.ship_lost()
+
+
+## The star's heat: shields first, then the hull (no knock out of the drive).
+var heat := 0.0                 # 0 .. 1 (the HUD's)
+
+
+func burn(dmg: float) -> void:
+	if state != "fly" or dmg <= 0.0:
+		return
+	_since_hit = 0.0
+	var sh := minf(shield, dmg)
+	shield -= sh
+	hull -= dmg - sh
+	if hull <= 0.0 and cosmos:
+		cosmos.ship_lost()
+
+
+func toggle_cruise() -> void:
+	if cruise == 0:
+		cruise = 1
+		cruise_t = 0.0
+	else:
+		_drop_cruise(MAX_SPEED)
+
+
+func _drop_cruise(speed: float) -> void:
+	cruise = 0
+	velocity = velocity.normalized() * minf(velocity.length(), speed) if velocity.length() > 0.0 else Vector3.ZERO
+
+
+## Sets down on `spot` (its basis: level with the ground; its origin GEAR over it).
+func land_at(spot: Transform3D) -> void:
+	state = "landing"
+	_land_from = global_transform
+	_land_to = spot
+	_land_t = 0.0
+	velocity = Vector3.ZERO
+	cruise = 0
+	throttle = 0.0
+	stick = Vector2.ZERO
+	_ang = Vector3.ZERO
+
+
+func take_off() -> void:
+	if state == "landed":
+		state = "takeoff"
+		_land_t = 0.0
+		set_legs(false)
+
+
+func _ground_states(delta: float) -> void:
+	match state:
+		"landing":
+			_land_t += delta / LAND_TIME
+			var k := smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, minf(_land_t, 1.0))
+			global_transform = _land_from.interpolate_with(_land_to, k)
+			if _land_t >= 1.0:
+				global_transform = _land_to
+				state = "landed"
+				set_legs(true)
+		"takeoff":
+			_land_t += delta
+			var u := _land_to.basis.y
+			velocity = u * minf(4.0 + _land_t * 14.0, 26.0)
+			global_position += velocity * delta
+			if _land_t >= 1.6:
+				state = "fly"
+				throttle = 0.3
+	_engines(delta)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	delta = minf(delta, 0.05)
+	if state != "fly":
+		_ground_states(delta)
+		return
+	_read_input(delta)
+	_since_hit += delta
+	if _since_hit > 3.0:
+		shield = minf(max_shield, shield + 12.0 * delta)
+	if (trigger or bool(drive.get("fire", false))) and cruise == 0 and cosmos:
+		_fire_guns(delta)
+	var s := stick
+	if s.length() < DEADZONE:
+		s = Vector2.ZERO
+	var want := Vector3(-s.y * RATES.x, -s.x * RATES.y, -roll * RATES.z)
+	if cruise == 2:
+		want *= 0.6
+	_ang = _ang.lerp(want, 1.0 - exp(-delta * 6.0))
+	basis = (basis * Basis.from_euler(_ang * delta)).orthonormalized()
+	var tgt: Node3D = cosmos.target if cosmos and is_instance_valid(cosmos.target) and cosmos.target != self else null
+	if cruise > 0 and tgt and s == Vector2.ZERO and absf(roll) < 0.1:
+		# (the drive's assist: the nose comes round to the target)
+		var to := (tgt.global_position - global_position).normalized()
+		if cosmos:
+			to = cosmos.steer(global_position, to, tgt)
+		_aim = to
+		var f := -basis.z
+		var ang := f.angle_to(to)
+		if ang > 0.0005:
+			basis = (Basis(f.cross(to).normalized(), minf(ang, ASSIST * delta)) * basis).orthonormalized()
+	var fwd := -basis.z
+	var clear: float = (cosmos.clearance(global_position, null, velocity.normalized() if velocity.length() > 1.0 else -basis.z) if cruise > 0 else cosmos.clearance(global_position)) if cosmos else 1e9
+	var target: Vector3
+	var accel := ACCEL
+	if cruise == 1:
+		cruise_t += delta
+		target = fwd * MAX_SPEED * maxf(throttle, 0.5)
+		var aligned := tgt == null or fwd.angle_to(_aim if _aim != Vector3.ZERO else tgt.global_position - global_position) < ALIGN
+		if cruise_t >= CRUISE_CHARGE and aligned:
+			if cosmos and cosmos.clearance(global_position, tgt, fwd) < CRUISE_DROP * 1.2:
+				cruise = 0     # (too close to something ahead to engage)
+				if cosmos:
+					cosmos.hyper_dropped(null)
+			else:
+				cruise = 2
+	if cruise == 2:
+		var cap := clear * CRUISE_SHARE
+		var arrived := false
+		if tgt:
+			var left: float = cosmos.surface_distance(tgt, global_position)
+			var other: float = cosmos.clearance(global_position, tgt, velocity.normalized() if velocity.length() > 1.0 else fwd)
+			cap = minf(left * CRUISE_SHARE, other * 2.0)
+			clear = other
+			arrived = left < HYPER_ARRIVE
+		if cosmos:
+			well = cosmos.gravity(global_position)
+			cap = minf(cap, CRUISE_MAX * float(well[0]))
+		cap = clampf(cap, CRUISE_MIN, CRUISE_MAX)
+		target = fwd * cap
+		accel = maxf(cap * 1.5, 1200.0)
+		if clear < CRUISE_DROP or arrived:
+			_drop_cruise(MAX_SPEED * 1.4)
+			target = fwd * MAX_SPEED * throttle
+			if cosmos:
+				cosmos.hyper_dropped(tgt if arrived else null)
+	elif cruise == 0:
+		var top := MAX_SPEED * speed_k * (BOOST if boosting else 1.0)
+		target = fwd * top * throttle + basis.y * lift * THRUST + basis.x * strafe * THRUST
+		accel = ACCEL * (2.2 if boosting else 1.0)
+	# (Faster than the cap - just out of cruise - bleeds off quickly.)
+	if velocity.length() > target.length() + 50.0:
+		accel = maxf(accel, velocity.length() * 1.5)
+	velocity = velocity.move_toward(target, accel * delta)
+	global_position += velocity * delta
+	if cosmos:
+		cosmos.bump(self)
+	_engines(delta)
+
+
+func _read_input(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not drive.is_empty():
+		throttle = float(drive.get("throttle", throttle))
+		stick = drive.get("stick", stick)
+		roll = float(drive.get("roll", 0.0))
+		boosting = bool(drive.get("boost", false))
+		lift = float(drive.get("lift", 0.0))
+		strafe = float(drive.get("strafe", 0.0))
+		return
+	if not control:
+		roll = 0.0
+		boosting = false
+		lift = 0.0
+		strafe = 0.0
+		return
+	var t := 0.0
+	if Input.is_action_pressed("forward"):
+		t += 1.0
+	if Input.is_action_pressed("back"):
+		t -= 1.0
+	t += Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_RIGHT) - Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_LEFT)
+	throttle = clampf(throttle + t * delta * 0.7, -0.25, 1.0)
+	roll = 0.0
+	if Input.is_action_pressed("left"):
+		roll -= 1.0
+	if Input.is_action_pressed("right"):
+		roll += 1.0
+	roll += Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_X)
+	var joy := Vector2(Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X), Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y))
+	if joy.length() > 0.15:
+		stick = joy.limit_length(1.0)
+	boosting = Input.is_action_pressed("boost")   # (the controls: Keybinds - Settings > Controls)
+	lift = float(Input.is_action_pressed("up")) - float(Input.is_action_pressed("down"))
+	strafe = float(Input.is_action_pressed("use")) - float(Input.is_action_pressed("strafe_left"))
+
+
+func speed() -> float:
+	return velocity.length()
+
+
+## The engines' glow and plumes follow the thrust.
+func _engines(_delta: float) -> void:
+	if _headless:
+		return   # (no picture: and the dummy renderer can't hold instance parameters)
+	var k := clampf(absf(throttle) * (1.6 if boosting else 1.0), 0.05, 1.6)
+	if state == "landed":
+		k = 0.0
+	elif state == "landing" or state == "takeoff":
+		k = 0.7
+	elif cruise == 2:
+		k = 2.2
+	elif cruise == 1:
+		k = 0.6 + cruise_t / CRUISE_CHARGE
+	for g: MeshInstance3D in _glows:
+		g.set_instance_shader_parameter("level", k)
+	for h: Node3D in _plumes:
+		h.scale = Vector3(1.0, 1.0, 0.3 + k * 1.4)
+		(h.get_meta("mesh") as MeshInstance3D).set_instance_shader_parameter("level", k)
+
+
+# --- The hull ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+var _hull: Node3D
+var interior: CosmosShipInterior
+var _legs: Array = []
+
+
+func _build() -> void:
+	_hull = Node3D.new()
+	_hull.name = "Hull"
+	_hull.scale = Vector3.ONE * SCALE
+	add_child(_hull)
+	var accent: Color = Galaxy.empire_color(Galaxy.HOME_EMPIRE)
+	var white := CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.86, 0.87, 0.88), 0.35, 0.4)
+	var dark := CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.18, 0.19, 0.22), 0.6, 0.45)
+	var paint := CosmosStation._mat(accent.darkened(0.2), 0.3, 0.4)
+	var glass := CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.05, 0.12, 0.2), 0.9, 0.08, Color(0.1, 0.4, 0.6) * 0.6)
+	# Fuselage: sections along z (nose at -z), each [z, half width, half height, y].
+	var sections := [[-9.5, 0.05, 0.05, 0.0], [-8.0, 0.7, 0.45, 0.0], [-5.5, 1.35, 0.85, 0.1], [-2.0, 1.8, 1.1, 0.2],
+		[2.0, 2.0, 1.15, 0.2], [5.5, 1.8, 1.0, 0.1], [8.0, 1.4, 0.8, 0.0], [8.6, 1.1, 0.6, 0.0]]
+	_add(_loft(sections, 12, false), white)
+	# (inside the open tail: the hull's inner skin, so it isn't seen through)
+	var skin := CosmosShipInterior._inner(Color(0.3, 0.31, 0.33), 0.7)
+	skin.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_FRONT   # (its inside faces)
+	_add(_loft(sections, 12, false), skin)
+	_add(_loft([[-6.0, 0.9, 0.5, 0.95], [-4.0, 1.0, 0.7, 1.05], [-1.5, 0.85, 0.55, 1.05], [0.5, 0.4, 0.25, 0.95]], 10), glass)
+	# A stripe of the empire's colour along the spine.
+	_add(_loft([[-7.0, 0.25, 0.08, 0.6], [6.0, 0.3, 0.08, 1.2], [8.0, 0.2, 0.06, 0.85]], 6), paint)
+	# Wings: swept, a little dihedral; a stripe on each.
+	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		_add(_wing(s, [Vector3(1.6, 0.0, -1.5), Vector3(1.6, 0.0, 5.5), Vector3(8.8, 0.55, 6.2), Vector3(8.4, 0.55, 3.6)], 0.28), white)
+		_add(_wing(s, [Vector3(6.6, 0.48, 3.2), Vector3(6.6, 0.48, 6.0), Vector3(7.6, 0.55, 6.1), Vector3(7.6, 0.55, 3.4)], 0.32), paint)
+		# Engines under the wing roots.
+		var eng := [[1.5, 0.6, 0.6, 0.0], [3.0, 0.85, 0.85, 0.0], [8.4, 0.95, 0.95, 0.0], [9.4, 0.8, 0.8, 0.0]]
+		var mi := _add(_loft(eng, 12), dark)
+		mi.position = Vector3(2.9 * s, -0.55, 0.0)
+		# Fins.
+		_add(_wing(s, [Vector3(0.9, 0.9, 4.0), Vector3(0.9, 0.9, 8.2), Vector3(2.3, 3.0, 8.6), Vector3(2.0, 3.0, 7.2)], 0.18), paint)
+		# Glow and plume at the nozzle.
+		var g := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		var q := QuadMesh.new()
+		q.size = Vector2(3.2, 3.2)
+		g.mesh = q
+		g.material_override = _engine_mat(true)
+		g.position = Vector3(2.9 * s, -0.55, 9.5)
+		g.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+		_hull.add_child(g)
+		_glows.append(g)
+		var c := CylinderMesh.new()
+		c.top_radius = 0.75
+		c.bottom_radius = 0.05
+		c.height = 8.0
+		c.radial_segments = 12
+		c.rings = 1

+		holder.position = Vector3(2.9 * s, -0.55, 9.4)
+		_hull.add_child(holder)

+		p.position = Vector3(0, 0, 4.0)
+		p.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF

+		_plumes.append(holder)

+	var leg_mat := CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.3, 0.31, 0.34), 0.7, 0.4)
+	for at in [Vector3(0, 0, -11), Vector3(-6.5, 0, 9), Vector3(6.5, 0, 9)]:

+		leg.material_override = leg_mat
+		leg.position = at + Vector3(0, -GEAR + (GEAR - 1.6) * 0.5, 0)
+		add_child(leg)
+		var foot := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		foot.mesh = CosmosStation._box(Vector3(2.2, 0.3, 2.2))
+		foot.material_override = leg_mat
+		foot.position = at + Vector3(0, -GEAR + 0.15, 0)
+		add_child(foot)
+		_legs.append(leg)
+		_legs.append(foot)
+	interior = CosmosShipInterior.new()
+	add_child(interior)
+	interior.build(accent)
+	set_legs(false)
+
+
+## Legs and ramp down (landed) or up (flying).
+func set_legs(down: bool) -> void:
+	for l: Node3D in _legs:
+		l.visible = down
+	if interior:
+		interior.set_ramp(down)
+
+
+func _engine_mat(glow: bool) -> ShaderMaterial:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = preload("res://shaders/world/engine.gdshader")
+	m.set_shader_parameter("glow", glow)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("tint", Color(0.45, 0.75, 1.0))
+	return m
+
+
+func _add(mesh: Mesh, mat: Material) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.mesh = mesh
+	mi.material_override = mat
+	(_hull if _hull else self).add_child(mi)
+	return mi
+
+
+## A closed loft through elliptical sections [z, half width, half height, y].
+static func _loft(sections: Array, seg: int, cap_end := true) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	var rings: Array = []
+	for s in sections:
+		var ring := []
+		for i in seg:
+			var a := TAU * i / seg
+			ring.append(Vector3(cos(a) * s[1], sin(a) * s[2] + s[3], s[0]))
+		rings.append(ring)
+	for r in rings.size() - 1:
+		for i in seg:
+			var j := (i + 1) % seg
+			var a: Vector3 = rings[r][i]
+			var b: Vector3 = rings[r][j]
+			var c: Vector3 = rings[r + 1][j]
+			var d: Vector3 = rings[r + 1][i]
+			for v in [a, c, b, a, d, c]:
+				st.add_vertex(v)
+	# Caps (the tail's left open: a door in it - CosmosShipInterior).
+	for e in ([[0, true], [rings.size() - 1, false]] if cap_end else [[0, true]]):
+		var ring: Array = rings[e[0]]
+		var mid := Vector3.ZERO
+		for v in ring:
+			mid += v
+		mid /= ring.size()
+		for i in seg:
+			var j := (i + 1) % seg
+			if e[1]:
+				for v in [mid, ring[i], ring[j]]:
+					st.add_vertex(v)
+			else:
+				for v in [mid, ring[j], ring[i]]:
+					st.add_vertex(v)
+	st.generate_normals()
+	return st.commit()
+
+
+## A flat wing panel (four points of its top, mirrored by side), `t` thick.
+static func _wing(side: float, pts: Array, t: float) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	var top := []
+	var bot := []
+	for p: Vector3 in pts:
+		top.append(Vector3(p.x * side, p.y + t * 0.5, p.z))
+		bot.append(Vector3(p.x * side, p.y - t * 0.5, p.z))
+	var faces := [[top[0], top[1], top[2]], [top[0], top[2], top[3]], [bot[0], bot[2], bot[1]], [bot[0], bot[3], bot[2]]]
+	for i in 4:
+		var j := (i + 1) % 4
+		faces.append([top[i], bot[i], bot[j]])
+		faces.append([top[i], bot[j], top[j]])
+	var mid := Vector3.ZERO
+	for v in top + bot:
+		mid += v
+	mid /= 8.0
+	for f in faces:
+		# (Godot's front faces wind clockwise: their normal is (p2 - p0) x (p1 - p0).)
+		var n: Vector3 = (f[2] - f[0]).cross(f[1] - f[0])
+		var k := faces.find(f)
+		var out: Vector3 = Vector3.UP if k < 2 else (Vector3.DOWN if k < 4 else (f[0] + f[1] + f[2]) / 3.0 - mid)
+		var order: Array = f if n.dot(out) >= 0.0 else [f[0], f[2], f[1]]
+		for v in order:
+			st.add_vertex(v)
+	st.generate_normals()
+	return st.commit()

+	for i in ROOMS.size():
+		var r: Array = ROOMS[i]
+		var hw: float = r[1]
+		var z0: float = r[2]
+		var z1: float = r[3]
+		var ceil: float = r[4]
+		var h := ceil - FLOOR
+		var mid := (z0 + z1) * 0.5
+		var len := z1 - z0
+		_box(Vector3(hw * 2.0, 0.2, len), Vector3(0, FLOOR - 0.1, mid), "floor")
+		_box(Vector3(hw * 2.0, 0.2, len), Vector3(0, ceil + 0.1, mid), "wall")
+		_box(Vector3(minf(hw, 1.0), 0.06, len * 0.8), Vector3(0, ceil - 0.03, mid), "lamp")
+		for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			_box(Vector3(0.2, h, len), Vector3(side * (hw + 0.1), FLOOR + h * 0.5, mid), "wall")
+			_box(Vector3(0.05, 0.12, len), Vector3(side * hw, FLOOR + 1.0, mid), "trim")
+		# End walls, open where the next room joins (and the tail: its door).
+		for e in [[z0, i - 1], [z1, i + 1]]:
+			var other_hw := 0.0
+			var other_ceil := ceil
+			if e[1] >= 0 and e[1] < ROOMS.size():
+				other_hw = minf(ROOMS[e[1]][1], hw)
+				other_ceil = minf(ROOMS[e[1]][4], ceil)
+			if e[1] >= ROOMS.size():
+				continue   # (the tail: the door)
+			if other_hw <= 0.0:
+				_box(Vector3(hw * 2.0, h, 0.2), Vector3(0, FLOOR + h * 0.5, e[0]), "wall")
+				continue
+			if other_hw < hw:
+				for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+					_box(Vector3(hw - other_hw, h, 0.2), Vector3(side * (hw + other_hw) * 0.5, FLOOR + h * 0.5, e[0]), "wall")
+			if other_ceil < ceil:
+				_box(Vector3(other_hw * 2.0, ceil - other_ceil, 0.2), Vector3(0, (ceil + other_ceil) * 0.5, e[0]), "wall")
+	# The tail's door (slides up into the hull) and its frame.
+	var aft: Array = ROOMS[ROOMS.size() - 1]
+	_door = _box(Vector3(float(aft[1]) * 2.0, float(aft[4]) - FLOOR, 0.15), Vector3(0, (float(aft[4]) + FLOOR) * 0.5, float(aft[3])), "trim")
+	_box(Vector3(float(aft[1]) * 2.0 + 0.4, 0.18, 0.3), Vector3(0, FLOOR - 0.05, float(aft[3])), "dark")
+	# The cockpit: the seat, the console, the canopy's window (glowing).
+	_box(Vector3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), SEAT + Vector3(0, 0.5, 0), "dark")
+	_box(Vector3(1.0, 1.2, 0.2), SEAT + Vector3(0, 1.2, 0.5), "dark")
+	_box(Vector3(3.6, 0.9, 0.8), Vector3(0, FLOOR + 0.45, -14.4), "dark")
+	_box(Vector3(3.2, 0.5, 0.06), Vector3(0, FLOOR + 1.2, -14.6), "screen").rotation.x = -0.4
+	# The terminals: a console, a screen, a label.
+	for t in TERMINALS:
+		var at: Vector3 = t[2] + Vector3(0, FLOOR, 0)
+		var side := signf(at.x)
+		_box(Vector3(0.6, 1.0, 1.4), at + Vector3(side * 0.1, 0.5, 0), "dark")
+		var scr := _box(Vector3(0.06, 0.8, 1.2), at + Vector3(side * -0.15, 1.45, 0), "screen")
+		scr.rotation.z = side * 0.25
+		var l := Label3D.new()
+		l.text = t[0]
+		l.font_size = 48
+		l.pixel_size = 0.006
+		l.position = at + Vector3(side * -0.4, 2.25, 0)
+		l.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
+		l.modulate = accent.lerp(Color.WHITE, 0.6)
+		add_child(l)
+	# The ramp: out of the floor at the tail, on its hinge.
+	_ramp = Node3D.new()
+	_ramp.position = Vector3(0, FLOOR, RAMP[1])
+	add_child(_ramp)
+	_ramp_plank = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	_ramp_plank.mesh = CosmosStation._box(Vector3(RAMP[0] * 2.0, 0.18, RAMP[2]))
+	_ramp_plank.material_override = _mats["trim"]
+	_ramp_plank.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	_ramp.add_child(_ramp_plank)
+	_crates = Node3D.new()
+	add_child(_crates)
+	set_ramp(false)
+
+
+## An inside surface: matte, no metal (it would mirror the sky outside), dull specular.
+static func _inner(c: Color, rough: float, glow := Color.BLACK) -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	m.albedo_color = c
+	m.metallic = 0.0
+	m.metallic_specular = 0.15
+	m.roughness = rough
+	if glow != Color.BLACK:
+		m.emission_enabled = true
+		m.emission = glow
+	return m
+
+
+func _box(size: Vector3, at: Vector3, mat: String) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.mesh = CosmosStation._box(size)
+	mi.material_override = _mats[mat]
+	mi.position = at
+	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF   # (the inside: lit from its ceiling)
+	add_child(mi)
+	return mi
+
+
+## Opens (the door up, then the ramp out) or shuts (the ramp in, then the door) - over a few seconds.
+func set_ramp(down: bool) -> void:
+	want_open = down
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if want_open:
+		if door_t < 1.0:
+			door_t = minf(1.0, door_t + delta / DOOR_TIME)
+		else:
+			ramp_t = minf(1.0, ramp_t + delta / RAMP_TIME)
+	else:
+		if ramp_t > 0.0:
+			ramp_t = maxf(0.0, ramp_t - delta / RAMP_TIME)
+		else:
+			door_t = maxf(0.0, door_t - delta / DOOR_TIME)
+	ramp_down = ramp_t >= 1.0
+	_pose()
+
+
+## The door and ramp where door_t / ramp_t put them.
+func _pose() -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_door) or not is_instance_valid(_ramp) or not is_inside_tree():   # (not while it's being freed)
+		return
+	var aft: Array = ROOMS[ROOMS.size() - 1]
+	var dh := float(aft[4]) - FLOOR
+	_door.position.y = FLOOR + dh * 0.5 + dh * smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, door_t)
+	_door.visible = door_t < 0.99
+	var drop := FLOOR - ramp_end_y
+	var ang := asin(clampf(drop / RAMP[2], -1.0, 1.0))
+	_ramp.rotation.x = ang   # (about x, +ang turns the ramp's +z (out of the tail) down to the ground)
+	var out := smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, ramp_t)
+	_ramp.visible = out > 0.01
+	_ramp_plank.scale = Vector3(1.0, 1.0, maxf(out, 0.01))
+	_ramp_plank.position = Vector3(0, -0.09, RAMP[2] * out * 0.5)
+
+
+## The ramp's foot (its z, ship space) as it lies now.
+func foot_z() -> float:
+	var drop := FLOOR - ramp_end_y
+	return RAMP[1] + sqrt(maxf(RAMP[2] * RAMP[2] - drop * drop, 1.0))
+
+
+## Crates in the hold for what you carry (a crate a few units).
+func stack_cargo(units: int) -> void:
+	for c in _crates.get_children():
+		c.queue_free()
+	var n := mini(units / 4 + (1 if units > 0 else 0), 24)
+	for i in n:
+		var row := i / 6
+		var col := i % 6
+		var side := -1.0 if col < 3 else 1.0
+		var x := side * (2.6 - (col % 3) * 0.0)
+		var z := 7.0 + (col % 3) * 1.3 + row * 0.0
+		var y := FLOOR + 0.45 + row * 0.9
+		var c := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		c.mesh = CosmosStation._box(Vector3(1.0, 0.85, 1.2))
+		c.material_override = _mats["crate"]
+		c.position = Vector3(x, y, z)
+		_crates.add_child(c)
+
+
+# --- The walker's deck --------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _rects() -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	for r in ROOMS:
+		out.append([-float(r[1]), float(r[2]), float(r[1]), float(r[3])])
+	if ramp_down:
+		out.append([-float(RAMP[0]), float(RAMP[1]), float(RAMP[0]), foot_z()])
+	return out
+
+
+## On the ramp (ship space)?
+func on_ramp(l: Vector3) -> bool:
+	return ramp_down and absf(l.x) <= RAMP[0] + 0.01 and l.z > RAMP[1]   # (past its foot: its foot's height - you step off level)
+
+
+## The floor's height at ship-space `l` (the ramp slopes down to the ground).
+func floor_y(l: Vector3) -> float:
+	if on_ramp(l):
+		var k := clampf((l.z - RAMP[1]) / (foot_z() - RAMP[1]), 0.0, 1.0)
+		return lerpf(FLOOR, ramp_end_y, k)
+	return FLOOR
+
+
+func ceiling_y(l: Vector3) -> float:
+	if on_ramp(l):
+		return floor_y(l) + 3.2
+	for r in ROOMS:
+		if l.z >= float(r[2]) - 0.01 and l.z <= float(r[3]) + 0.01 and absf(l.x) <= float(r[1]) + 0.01:
+			return float(r[4])
+	return CEIL
+
+
+## `l` kept within the rooms (and the ramp), `m` in from their walls.
+func confine(l: Vector3, m: float) -> Vector3:
+	var best := l
+	var bd := INF
+	var first := float(ROOMS[0][2])
+	var last := float(ROOMS[ROOMS.size() - 1][3])
+	for r in _rects():
+		# (margins off the side walls and the outer ends - not where rooms join)
+		var x := clampf(l.x, r[0] + m, r[2] - m)
+		# (the tail's end: a wall only while the door's shut - open, the ramp goes on from it)
+		var z := clampf(l.z, r[1] + (m if is_equal_approx(r[1], first) else 0.0), r[3] - (m if is_equal_approx(r[3], last) and not ramp_down else 0.0))
+		var d := Vector2(x - l.x, z - l.z).length()
+		if d < bd:
+			bd = d
+			best = Vector3(x, l.y, z)
+	return best
+
+
+## The terminal within reach of ship-space `l`: [label, Ship Computer tab, position] or [].
+func terminal_near(l: Vector3) -> Array:
+	for t in TERMINALS:
+		if Vector2(l.x - t[2].x, l.z - t[2].z).length() < 1.6:
+			return t
+	return []
+
+
+func at_seat(l: Vector3) -> bool:
+	return Vector2(l.x - SEAT.x, l.z - SEAT.z).length() < 1.8
+
+
+## The end of the lowered ramp (ship space): stepping off it, you're outside.
+func ramp_foot() -> Vector3:
+	return Vector3(0, ramp_end_y, foot_z())

files.explanation: The 3D world - you: your ship, on foot, the camera, the HUD: You on foot in the 3D game (Cosmos, stage 2): the automaton's actual model (art/player_3d - its cel shaders and animations: idle, walk, run, leap) walking a planet's procedural ground. "Down" is the planet's middle: the walker stands along the local up, the ground under it is the planet's height field (PlanetShape - the same one the terrain patches are built from), seas are waded (shallows) or swum (head above water), an ice sheet walked on. W A S D move relative to the camera, Shift runs, Space jumps; it turns to face where it goes. Boulders and the landed ship are solid.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,252 @@ 
+class_name CosmosWalker
+extends Node3D
+## You on foot in the 3D game (Cosmos, stage 2): the automaton's actual model
+## (art/player_3d - its cel shaders and animations: idle, walk, run, leap)
+## walking a planet's procedural ground. "Down" is the planet's middle: the
+## walker stands along the local up, the ground under it is the planet's
+## height field (PlanetShape - the same one the terrain patches are built
+## from), seas are waded (shallows) or swum (head above water), an ice sheet
+## walked on. W A S D move relative to the camera, Shift runs, Space jumps;
+## it turns to face where it goes. Boulders and the landed ship are solid.
+
+const WALK := 3.4               # m/s
+const RUN := 8.0
+const ACCEL := 22.0
+const AIR_ACCEL := 6.0
+const JUMP := 5.6               # m/s up
+const GRAVITY := 11.0
+const TURN := 10.0              # how fast it turns to face its way
+const SWIM_DEPTH := 1.25        # deeper water than this: swimming, head above it
+const BODY_R := 0.45
+const CLIPS := {"idle": "idle", "walk": "walk", "run": "run", "air": "leap", "down": "ko",
+	"gun_idle": "gun_idle", "gun_walk": "gun_walk", "gun_run": "gun_run"}
+const MAX_HP := 100.0
+const REGEN := 6.0              # health a second, 5 s after the last hit
+const FIRE_EVERY := 0.17        # s between bolts, the trigger held
+const BOLT_DAMAGE := 18.0
+
+var planet: CosmosPlanet
+var deck: Node3D = null         # (a hangar's or a ship's inside - CosmosHangar / CosmosShipInterior: its floor instead of a planet's ground)
+var _dl := Vector3.ZERO         # (where on the deck: kept in its own space - a moving ship carries you)
+var cosmos: Node
+var velocity := Vector3.ZERO    # world
+var on_ground := false
+var swimming := false
+var control := true
+var facing := Vector3.FORWARD   # world, along the ground
+var drive := {}                 # (tests: {move: Vector2 (x right, y forward), run, jump})
+var heading := Vector3.FORWARD  # the camera's way along the ground (CosmosCam keeps it)
+var hp := MAX_HP
+var downed := false
+var trigger := false            # (the fire button held: Cosmos sets it)
+var reach := 0.6
+var _cool := 0.0
+var _gun_t := 0.0               # (the rifle up for a while after firing)
+var _since_hit := 99.0
+var _anim: AnimationPlayer
+var _clip := ""
+var _model: Node3D
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	name = "Walker"
+	if Stage3D.has_model("player"):
+		_model = Stage3D._scene("player").instantiate()
+		_model.rotation.y = PI       # (the model faces +z; the walker's forward is -z)
+		add_child(_model)
+		CosmosModels.apply(_model, "player")   # (two draws: its parts merged, colours in the vertices)
+		_anim = _model.find_child("AnimationPlayer", true, false)
+		if _anim:
+			for c in ["idle", "walk", "run", "gun_idle", "gun_walk", "gun_run"]:
+				if _anim.has_animation(c):
+					_anim.get_animation(c).loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR
+	else:
+		var cap := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		var cm := CapsuleMesh.new()
+		cm.radius = 0.4
+		cm.height = 1.9
+		cap.mesh = cm
+		cap.position.y = 0.95
+		add_child(cap)
+	_play("idle")
+
+
+func up() -> Vector3:
+	if deck:
+		return deck.global_basis.y
+	return (global_position - planet.global_position).normalized()
+
+
+## The ground's height (metres above the radius) under `local` - and the
+## level to stand on there (the sea's surface less the swim depth, an ice
+## sheet's top).
+## Onto `d` (a deck) at its point `local`, or off it (null).
+func set_deck(d: Node3D) -> void:
+	deck = d
+	if d:
+		_dl = d.to_local(global_position)
+
+
+func floor_at(local: Vector3) -> float:
+	if deck:
+		return 0.0
+	var h := planet.shape.height(local.normalized())
+	if cosmos:
+		h = maxf(h, cosmos.town_floor(planet, local))   # (a town's steps and roofs)
+	match planet.shape.sea:
+		1:
+			return maxf(h, -SWIM_DEPTH)
+		2:
+			return maxf(h, 0.0)
+		3:
+			return maxf(h, -0.4)
+	return h
+
+
+## A hit (a bite, a bolt).
+func hurt(dmg: float, _from: Variant = null) -> void:
+	if downed:
+		return
+	hp -= dmg
+	_since_hit = 0.0
+	if cosmos and cosmos.hud:
+		cosmos.hud.hit_flash = 0.5
+	if hp <= 0.0:
+		hp = 0.0
+		downed = true
+		_play("down")
+		if cosmos:
+			cosmos.walker_downed()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	delta = minf(delta, 0.05)
+	if planet == null and deck == null:
+		return
+	if downed:
+		return
+	if deck:
+		global_position = deck.to_global(_dl)   # (carried along with the deck)
+	_since_hit += delta
+	if _since_hit > 5.0:
+		hp = minf(MAX_HP, hp + REGEN * delta)
+	_cool -= delta
+	_gun_t -= delta
+	if (trigger or bool(drive.get("fire", false))) and _cool <= 0.0 and cosmos:
+		_cool = FIRE_EVERY
+		_gun_t = 3.0
+		cosmos.walker_fire(self)
+	var u := up()
+	# The way the camera looks, along the ground.
+	heading = (heading - u * heading.dot(u)).normalized()
+	var right := heading.cross(u).normalized()
+	var mv := Vector2.ZERO
+	var running := false
+	var jump := false
+	if not drive.is_empty():
+		mv = drive.get("move", Vector2.ZERO)
+		running = bool(drive.get("run", false))
+		jump = bool(drive.get("jump", false))
+	elif control:
+		mv.x = float(Input.is_action_pressed("right")) - float(Input.is_action_pressed("left"))
+		mv.y = float(Input.is_action_pressed("forward")) - float(Input.is_action_pressed("back"))
+		var joy := Vector2(Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X), -Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y))
+		if joy.length() > 0.2:
+			mv = joy
+		running = Input.is_action_pressed("boost") or Input.is_joy_button_pressed(0, JOY_BUTTON_LEFT_STICK)
+		jump = Input.is_action_pressed("up") or Input.is_joy_button_pressed(0, JOY_BUTTON_A)
+	mv = mv.limit_length(1.0)
+	var top := (RUN if running else WALK) * (0.45 if swimming else 1.0)
+	var want := (heading * mv.y + right * mv.x) * top
+	var vert := velocity.dot(u)
+	var flat := velocity - u * vert
+	flat = flat.move_toward(want, (ACCEL if on_ground or swimming else AIR_ACCEL) * delta)
+	if jump and (on_ground or swimming) and vert <= 0.5:
+		vert = JUMP * (0.6 if swimming else 1.0)
+		on_ground = false
+	vert -= GRAVITY * delta
+	velocity = flat + u * vert
+	global_position += velocity * delta
+	# The ground (or the hangar's deck, within its walls).
+	if deck:
+		var hl := deck.to_local(global_position)
+		var fy: float = deck.floor_y(hl)
+		if hl.y <= fy + 0.02:
+			hl.y = fy
+			if velocity.dot(u) < 0.0:
+				velocity -= u * velocity.dot(u)
+			on_ground = true
+		elif hl.y > fy + 0.3:
+			on_ground = false
+		hl.y = minf(hl.y, float(deck.ceiling_y(hl)) - 1.9)
+		hl = deck.confine(hl, 0.45)
+		global_position = deck.to_global(hl)
+		_dl = hl
+		swimming = false
+	else:
+		var local := global_position - planet.global_position
+		var r := local.length()
+		var stand := planet.radius + floor_at(local)
+		u = local / r
+		swimming = planet.shape.sea == 1 and planet.shape.height(u) < -SWIM_DEPTH * 0.8 and r <= planet.radius + 0.2
+		if r <= stand + 0.02:
+			global_position = planet.global_position + u * stand
+			if velocity.dot(u) < 0.0:
+				velocity -= u * velocity.dot(u)
+			on_ground = true
+		elif r > stand + 0.25:
+			on_ground = false
+	if cosmos:
+		cosmos.walker_bumps(self)
+	# Face the way it goes; stand along the local up.
+	var go := velocity - u * velocity.dot(u)
+	if _gun_t > 0.0:
+		facing = facing.slerp(heading, 1.0 - exp(-delta * 18.0))   # (aiming: facing where the camera looks)
+	elif go.length() > 0.4:
+		facing = facing.slerp(go.normalized(), 1.0 - exp(-delta * TURN)) if facing.dot(go.normalized()) > -0.99 else go.normalized()
+	facing = (facing - u * facing.dot(u)).normalized()
+	if facing.length() < 0.5:
+		facing = heading
+	global_basis = Basis.looking_at(facing, u)
+	# Animation.
+	var speed := go.length()
+	var gun := "gun_" if _gun_t > 0.0 else ""
+	if not on_ground and not swimming:
+		_play("air")
+	elif speed > (WALK + RUN) * 0.5 - 0.5:
+		_play(gun + "run", speed / RUN)
+	elif speed > 0.3:
+		_play(gun + "walk", speed / WALK)
+	else:
+		_play(gun + "idle")
+
+
+func _play(kind: String, rate := 1.0) -> void:
+	if _anim == null:
+		return
+	var clip: String = CLIPS[kind]
+	if not _anim.has_animation(clip):
+		return
+	if clip != _clip:
+		_anim.play(clip, 0.18)
+		_clip = clip
+	_anim.speed_scale = clampf(rate, 0.5, 1.6) if kind.ends_with("walk") or kind.ends_with("run") else 1.0
+
+
+## Back on its feet (beside the ship), whole.
+func revive(at: Vector3) -> void:
+	downed = false
+	hp = MAX_HP
+	velocity = Vector3.ZERO
+	global_position = at
+	_clip = ""
+	_play("idle")
+
+
+## Metres from its feet to the ground below (tests, the HUD).
+func height_above_ground() -> float:
+	if deck:
+		var l := deck.to_local(global_position)
+		return l.y - float(deck.floor_y(l))
+	var local := global_position - planet.global_position
+	return local.length() - planet.radius - floor_at(local)

+## The 3D noise every shader samples (64^3, tiling): made once a run on a
+## worker (at the title screen by CosmosWarm, else here), then kept.
+static var _noise: Texture3D
+static var _noise_task := -1
+static var _noise_imgs: Array = []
+
+
+static func start_noise() -> void:
+	if _noise != null or _noise_task != -1:
+		return
+	_noise_imgs = []
+	var imgs := _noise_imgs
+	_noise_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func():
+		var n := FastNoiseLite.new()
+		n.noise_type = FastNoiseLite.TYPE_SIMPLEX_SMOOTH
+		n.frequency = 4.0 / NOISE_SIZE
+		n.fractal_octaves = 3
+		imgs.append_array(n.get_seamless_image_3d(NOISE_SIZE, NOISE_SIZE, NOISE_SIZE, false, 0.1)), true, "cosmos noise")
+
+
+## The noise if it's made (finishing it off if its task is done), else null.
+static func noise_ready() -> Texture3D:
+	if _noise != null:
+		return _noise
+	if _noise_task == -1 or not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_noise_task):
+		return null
+	WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_noise_task)
+	_noise_task = -1
+	var data: Array[Image] = []
+	for im: Image in _noise_imgs:
+		if im.get_format() != Image.FORMAT_L8:
+			im.convert(Image.FORMAT_L8)
+		data.append(im)
+	_noise_imgs = []
+	var t := ImageTexture3D.new()
+	t.create(Image.FORMAT_L8, NOISE_SIZE, NOISE_SIZE, NOISE_SIZE, false, data)
+	_noise = t
+	return t
+
+
+func _make_noise() -> Texture3D:

+		await get_tree().process_frame

+
+

+	var tint: Color = Galaxy.empire_color(Galaxy.owner_of(system_id))
+	sky_mat.set_shader_parameter("neb_a", tint.darkened(0.3))
+	sky_mat.set_shader_parameter("neb_b", Color.from_hsv(fmod(tint.h + 0.5 + rng.randf() * 0.2, 1.0), 0.6, 0.6))
+	sky_mat.set_shader_parameter("band_axis", Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.4, 0.4), 1.0, rng.randf_range(-0.4, 0.4)))
+	var sky := Sky.new()
+	sky.sky_material = sky_mat
+	sky.radiance_size = Sky.RADIANCE_SIZE_64
+	var env := Environment.new()
+	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_SKY
+	env.sky = sky
+	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
+	env.ambient_light_color = Color(0.11, 0.12, 0.15)
+	env.ambient_light_energy = 1.0

+	# ACES tone mapping, bloom on the bright things (the star, engines, lava,
+	# lights), a touch of contrast.
+	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_ACES
+	env.tonemap_exposure = 1.1
+	env.tonemap_white = 8.0
