bubbles.text: Flies its pad's approach: over it, down onto it, a while there, off it. True when it moved itself (sitting, setting down, lifting off).

files.explanation: The 3D world - space: A planet (or moon) of the 3D game: real ground all the way down. Its surface is a cube's six faces bent onto the sphere, each a quadtree of terrain patches (PATCH x PATCH quads of PlanetShape.height): far away a handful of coarse patches, coming closer they split into finer ones - down to a metre between vertices underfoot - so the planet you see from orbit IS the ground you land on, nothing swapped. Patches are built on worker threads (a few at a time, their meshes made on the main thread within a budget), patches beyond the horizon aren't drawn, and children replace their parent only once all four are built (no holes; skirts hide the seams between levels). Gas giants are a sphere of cloud bands (no ground). Around it: its sea (water, an ice sheet or lava), clouds and an atmosphere shell (scattering worked out per pixel against the depth buffer: the halo from space, the sky and the haze on the ground).

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,685 @@ 
+class_name CosmosPlanet
+extends Node3D
+## A planet (or moon) of the 3D game: real ground all the way down. Its
+## surface is a cube's six faces bent onto the sphere, each a quadtree of
+## terrain patches (PATCH x PATCH quads of PlanetShape.height): far away a
+## handful of coarse patches, coming closer they split into finer ones - down
+## to a metre between vertices underfoot - so the planet you see from orbit
+## IS the ground you land on, nothing swapped. Patches are built on worker
+## threads (a few at a time, their meshes made on the main thread within a
+## budget), patches beyond the horizon aren't drawn, and children replace
+## their parent only once all four are built (no holes; skirts hide the
+## seams between levels). Gas giants are a sphere of cloud bands (no ground).
+## Around it: its sea (water, an ice sheet or lava), clouds and an
+## atmosphere shell (scattering worked out per pixel against the depth
+## buffer: the halo from space, the sky and the haze on the ground).
+
+const PATCH := 24               # quads a patch side
+const SPLIT := 2.2              # split a patch closer than this many of its sizes
+const KEEP := 1.2               # (hysteresis: merge only beyond SPLIT x KEEP)
+const MIN_PATCH_M := 34.0       # the finest patch (m across): ~1.4 m a quad
+const MAX_TASKS := 10           # patches building at once (all planets share this)
+const ROCKS_A_PATCH := 4        # boulders on a finest patch (up to; a few patches a field of them)
+const MESH_BUDGET_US := 1500    # main-thread time a frame turning built patches into meshes (all planets)
+const TERRAIN := preload("res://shaders/world/terrain.gdshader")
+const WATER := preload("res://shaders/world/water.gdshader")
+const ATMO := preload("res://shaders/world/atmosphere.gdshader")
+const CLOUDS := preload("res://shaders/world/clouds.gdshader")
+const GAS := preload("res://shaders/world/gas_giant.gdshader")
+const RING := preload("res://shaders/world/ring.gdshader")
+
+static var tasks := 0           # building now, all planets
+static var deadline_us := 0     # (meshes made until then: Cosmos sets it each frame)
+
+var rec := {}
+var shape: PlanetShape
+var radius := 1000.0
+var max_level := 6
+var sun_dir := Vector3.UP       # (to the star, world - set by Cosmos)
+var material: ShaderMaterial
+var atmo_radius := 0.0
+var _roots: Array = []
+var _busy: Array = []           # patches whose builds are running
+var _sea_mi: MeshInstance3D
+var _sea_low: Mesh
+var _sea_high: Mesh
+var _cam_local := Vector3(1e9, 0, 0)
+var _horizon := PI
+var deepest_hint := 0
+var _cam_dir := Vector3.RIGHT
+var patches_made := 0
+var _rock_mat: ShaderMaterial
+var flora: Array = []           # the species (CosmosFlora.design), built on a worker at setup
+var flora_ready := false
+var _flora_task := -1
+var _flora_meshes: Array = []
+var _flora_mat: ShaderMaterial
+static var _rock_mesh: Mesh
+
+
+static func rock_mesh() -> Mesh:
+	if _rock_mesh == null:
+		_rock_mesh = CosmosRocks._rock_mesh(77)
+	return _rock_mesh
+
+
+class Patch:
+	var face := 0
+	var level := 0
+	var a0 := 0.0
+	var b0 := 0.0
+	var span := 2.0
+	var centre := Vector3.ZERO  # planet-local, on the ground
+	var dir := Vector3.UP
+	var size := 1.0             # metres across
+	var mi: MeshInstance3D
+	var task := -1
+	var arrays: Array = []
+	var kids: Array = []
+	var ready := false
+	var shown := false          # (its mesh drawn now)
+	var sub := false            # (something under it drawn now)
+	var rock_xf: Array = []     # boulders on it (transforms, relative to its centre) - while building
+	var flora_xf := {}          # species index -> its plants' transforms - while building
+	var rock_buf := PackedFloat32Array()   # ...then as MultiMesh buffers
+	var rock_n := 0
+	var flora_buf := {}
+	var rocks: Array = []       # [planet-local position, radius] (collisions)
+
+
+var towns: Array = []           # CosmosTown.sites: where its towns stand
+var sun_hint := Vector3.ZERO    # (towards the star, before it's placed - the towns' day side)
+
+
+func setup(record: Dictionary, noise: Texture3D) -> void:
+	rec = record
+	name = str(rec.get("name", "Planet")).replace(" ", "_")
+	shape = PlanetShape.of(rec)
+	radius = shape.radius
+	max_level = clampi(ceili(log(2.0 * radius / MIN_PATCH_M) / log(2.0)), 3, 12)
+	var L: Dictionary = shape.look
+	var atmo_col: Color = L.get("atmosphere", Color(0.5, 0.7, 1.0))
+	var atmo_k := float(L.get("atmo_strength", 0.5))
+	if shape.kind == "gas":
+		var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+		m.shader = GAS
+		for k in ["gas_a", "gas_b", "gas_c", "gas_d", "band_count", "band_turb", "storm", "storm_pos", "storm_size", "storm_color", "seed"]:
+			if L.has(k):
+				m.set_shader_parameter(k, L[k])
+		m.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", noise)
+		material = m
+		_ball(radius, 128, 64, m, "Body")
+		if float(L.get("rings", 0.0)) > 0.0:
+			_add_rings(L)
+		atmo_radius = radius * 1.04
+		_add_atmosphere(atmo_col, atmo_k * 0.7)
+		return
+	material = ShaderMaterial.new()
+	material.shader = TERRAIN
+	for k in ["land_low", "land_mid", "land_high", "land_peak", "biome", "biome_color", "ice_cover", "ice_color",
+			"lava", "lava_color", "lava_hot", "water_shallow", "water_deep"]:
+		if L.has(k):
+			material.set_shader_parameter(k, L[k])
+	material.set_shader_parameter("amp", shape.amp)
+	material.set_shader_parameter("radius", radius)
+	material.set_shader_parameter("sea", shape.sea)
+	material.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", noise)
+	_rock_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
+	_rock_mat.shader = preload("res://shaders/world/rock.gdshader")
+	_rock_mat.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", noise)
+	var lh: Color = L.get("land_high", Color(0.4, 0.38, 0.35))
+	_rock_mat.set_shader_parameter("tone", lh.lerp(Color(0.42, 0.4, 0.38), 0.4))
+	# The towns (CosmosTown): where they stand, their ground levelled - before any ground is built.
+	towns = CosmosTown.sites(shape, rec, Galaxy.owner_of(str(rec.get("system", Galaxy.current_system))), sun_hint)
+	shape.set_flats(CosmosTown.flats_of(towns, radius))
+	_flora_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
+	_flora_mat.shader = preload("res://shaders/world/flora.gdshader")
+	var fseed := int(rec.get("seed", 1))
+	var ftype := str(rec.get("type", "rocky"))
+	_flora_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): flora = CosmosFlora.design(shape, fseed, ftype), true, "planet flora")
+	for f in 6:
+		var p := Patch.new()
+		p.face = f
+		p.a0 = -1.0
+		p.b0 = -1.0
+		p.span = 2.0
+		_place(p)
+		_roots.append(p)
+		_start(p)
+	if shape.sea > 0:
+		_add_sea(L, noise)
+	if float(L.get("clouds", 0.0)) > 0.05 and atmo_k > 0.3:
+		_add_clouds(L, noise)
+	atmo_radius = radius + maxf(shape.top() * 2.5, radius * 0.06)
+	_add_atmosphere(atmo_col, atmo_k)
+
+
+## Built enough to be seen: every face's first patch is in.
+func settled() -> bool:
+	for p: Patch in _roots:
+		if not p.ready:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+func _place(p: Patch) -> void:
+	var ax := PlanetShape.face_axes(p.face)
+	p.dir = PlanetShape.face_dir(ax[0], ax[1], ax[2], p.a0 + p.span * 0.5, p.b0 + p.span * 0.5)
+	p.centre = p.dir * (radius + shape.surface(p.dir))
+	p.size = radius * p.span * 0.9
+
+
+func _start(p: Patch) -> void:
+	tasks += 1
+	_busy.append(p)
+	p.task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(_build.bind(p, p.face, p.a0, p.b0, p.span, p.centre), true, "planet patch")
+
+
+## (Worker) The patch's vertices (relative to its centre), normals, heights.
+func _build(p: Patch, face: int, a0: float, b0: float, span: float, centre: Vector3) -> void:
+	var ax := PlanetShape.face_axes(face)
+	var n: Vector3 = ax[0]
+	var u: Vector3 = ax[1]
+	var v: Vector3 = ax[2]
+	var G := PATCH + 3          # samples a side: the patch's vertices and a border (normals)
+	var step := span / PATCH
+	var pts := PackedVector3Array()
+	pts.resize(G * G)
+	var hs := PackedFloat32Array()
+	hs.resize(G * G)
+	for j in G:
+		for i in G:
+			var d := PlanetShape.face_dir(n, u, v, a0 + (i - 1) * step, b0 + (j - 1) * step)
+			var h := shape.height(d)
+			hs[j * G + i] = h
+			pts[j * G + i] = d * (radius + h)
+	var V := PATCH + 1
+	var verts := PackedVector3Array()
+	var norms := PackedVector3Array()
+	var uvs := PackedVector2Array()
+	var idx := PackedInt32Array()
+	verts.resize(V * V)
+	norms.resize(V * V)
+	uvs.resize(V * V)
+	for j in V:
+		for i in V:
+			var k := (j + 1) * G + (i + 1)
+			var du := pts[k + 1] - pts[k - 1]
+			var dv := pts[k + G] - pts[k - G]
+			var nr := du.cross(dv).normalized()
+			if nr.dot(pts[k]) < 0.0:
+				nr = -nr
+			verts[j * V + i] = pts[k] - centre
+			norms[j * V + i] = nr
+			uvs[j * V + i] = Vector2(hs[k], 0.0)
+	for j in PATCH:
+		for i in PATCH:
+			var a := j * V + i
+			idx.append_array([a, a + V + 1, a + 1, a, a + V, a + V + 1])
+	# Skirts: the rim's vertices again, dropped toward the centre - hides
+	# the cracks where a finer patch meets a coarser one.
+	var drop := 1.0 - (span * radius * 0.02 + 2.0) / radius
+	var rim := []
+	for i in V:
+		rim.append(i)
+	for j in range(1, V):
+		rim.append(j * V + PATCH)
+	for i in range(PATCH - 1, -1, -1):
+		rim.append(PATCH * V + i)
+	for j in range(PATCH - 1, 0, -1):
+		rim.append(j * V)
+	var base := verts.size()
+	for r in rim:
+		verts.append((verts[r] + centre) * drop - centre)
+		norms.append(norms[r])
+		uvs.append(uvs[r] - Vector2(span * radius * 0.02, 0.0))
+	for q in rim.size():
+		var a: int = rim[q]
+		var b: int = rim[(q + 1) % rim.size()]
+		var sa := base + q
+		var sb := base + (q + 1) % rim.size()
+		idx.append_array([a, sa, b, b, sa, sb, a, b, sa, b, sb, sa])   # (both sides)
+	_scatter(p, n, u, v, a0, b0, span, centre)
+	var arr := []
+	arr.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = verts
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = norms
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] = uvs
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = idx
+	p.arrays = arr
+
+
+## (Worker) What stands on the ground of the finest patches: boulders and
+## the planet's plants (CosmosFlora). Placed a finest cell at a time, each
+## cell from its own seed - so a patch one level coarser (which shows only
+## the big boulders and the trees) has them exactly where its children will:
+## nothing jumps when the ground refines. None in the sea, plants by their
+## species' heights and slopes.
+func _scatter(p: Patch, n: Vector3, u: Vector3, v: Vector3, a0: float, b0: float, span: float, centre: Vector3) -> void:
+	if p.level < max_level - 1:
+		return
+	if p.level == max_level:
+		_scatter_cell(p, n, u, v, a0, b0, span, centre, false)
+	else:
+		var h := span * 0.5
+		for q in 4:
+			_scatter_cell(p, n, u, v, a0 + h * (q % 2), b0 + h * (q / 2), h, centre, true)
+	# (as MultiMesh buffers, made here: the main thread sets each in one call)
+	p.rock_buf = _buffer(p.rock_xf, true)
+	p.rock_n = p.rock_xf.size()
+	p.rock_xf = []
+	for k in p.flora_xf:
+		p.flora_buf[k] = _buffer(p.flora_xf[k], false)
+	p.flora_xf = {}
+
+
+## Transforms as a MultiMesh buffer (TRANSFORM_3D: 12 floats each, row-major;
+## + 4 of custom data, all 0.5 - the rocks' "no tumbling").
+static func _buffer(xs: Array, custom: bool) -> PackedFloat32Array:
+	var w := 16 if custom else 12
+	var b := PackedFloat32Array()
+	b.resize(xs.size() * w)
+	var i := 0
+	for t: Transform3D in xs:
+		var bs := t.basis
+		b[i] = bs.x.x; b[i + 1] = bs.y.x; b[i + 2] = bs.z.x; b[i + 3] = t.origin.x
+		b[i + 4] = bs.x.y; b[i + 5] = bs.y.y; b[i + 6] = bs.z.y; b[i + 7] = t.origin.y
+		b[i + 8] = bs.x.z; b[i + 9] = bs.y.z; b[i + 10] = bs.z.z; b[i + 11] = t.origin.z
+		if custom:
+			b[i + 12] = 0.5; b[i + 13] = 0.5; b[i + 14] = 0.5; b[i + 15] = 0.5
+		i += w
+	return b
+
+
+func _scatter_cell(p: Patch, n: Vector3, u: Vector3, v: Vector3, a0: float, b0: float, span: float, centre: Vector3, coarse: bool) -> void:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = hash([int(shape.look.get("seed", 0.0) * 100.0), p.face, snappedf(a0, 1e-6), snappedf(b0, 1e-6)])
+	var area := pow(span * radius * 0.9 / 22.0, 2.0)   # (densities are per 22 x 22 m)
+	var count := int((rng.randi_range(0, ROCKS_A_PATCH) if rng.randf() < 0.85 else rng.randi_range(8, ROCKS_A_PATCH * 4)) * area)
+	for i in count:
+		var d := PlanetShape.face_dir(n, u, v, a0 + rng.randf() * span, b0 + rng.randf() * span)
+		var size := pow(rng.randf(), 4.0) * 2.4 + 0.15
+		var e := Vector3(rng.randf() * TAU, rng.randf() * TAU, rng.randf() * TAU)
+		var sy := rng.randf_range(0.5, 0.9)
+		var sz := rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.2)
+		if coarse and size < 1.0:
+			continue
+		var h := shape.height(d)
+		if shape.sea > 0 and h < 0.4 or shape.cleared(d):
+			continue
+		var at := d * (radius + h - size * 0.3)
+		p.rock_xf.append(Transform3D(Basis.from_euler(e).scaled(Vector3(size, size * sy, size * sz)), at - centre))
+		p.rocks.append([at, size * 0.8, size * 0.7])
+	if not flora_ready:
+		return
+	var step := 1.2 / radius
+	for k in flora.size():
+		var sp: Dictionary = flora[k]
+		var dens: float = sp["density"]
+		var patchy := rng.randf()
+		var m := int(dens * area * (0.3 + patchy * 1.4) + rng.randf())
+		for i in m:
+			var d := PlanetShape.face_dir(n, u, v, a0 + rng.randf() * span, b0 + rng.randf() * span)
+			var sc: float = rng.randf_range(sp["size"].x, sp["size"].y)
+			var turn := rng.randf() * TAU
+			if coarse and float(sp["solid"]) <= 0.0:
+				continue
+			if shape.cleared(d):
+				continue
+			var h := shape.height(d)
+			var t := d.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(d.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+			var slope := absf(shape.height((d + t * step).normalized()) - h) / 1.2
+			if not CosmosFlora.grows(sp, shape, h, slope):
+				continue
+			var x := t.rotated(d, turn)
+			var b := Basis(x, d, x.cross(d)).scaled(Vector3.ONE * sc)
+			var at := d * (radius + h - 0.08 * sc)
+			p.flora_xf[k] = p.flora_xf.get(k, []) + [Transform3D(b, at - centre)]
+			if float(sp["solid"]) > 0.0:
+				p.rocks.append([at, float(sp["solid"]) * sc, 6.0 * sc])
+
+
+## Called by Cosmos a few times a second: the camera's planet-local position.
+func update_lod(cam_local: Vector3) -> void:
+	if shape.kind == "gas":
+		return
+	_cam_local = cam_local
+	_collect()
+	# (the horizon, once a visit: patches beyond it aren't drawn)
+	var h := cam_local.length()
+	var top := radius + shape.top()
+	h = maxf(h, radius + 1.0)
+	_horizon = acos(clampf(radius / h, -1.0, 1.0)) + acos(clampf(radius / top, -1.0, 1.0))
+	_cam_dir = cam_local.normalized()
+	deepest_hint = 0
+	for p: Patch in _roots:
+		_visit(p)
+		if not p.kids.is_empty():
+			deepest_hint = 2   # (split somewhere: visited until it's merged back)
+	if _sea_mi:
+		var near := cam_local.length() - radius < radius * 0.6
+		var want := _sea_high if near else _sea_low
+		if _sea_mi.mesh != want:
+			_sea_mi.mesh = want
+
+
+## Only turns finished patches into meshes (the frames between LOD visits).
+func collect_only() -> void:
+	if shape.kind != "gas":
+		_collect()
+
+
+func _collect() -> void:
+	if _flora_task != -1 and WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_flora_task):
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_flora_task)
+		_flora_task = -1
+		for sp: Dictionary in flora:
+			var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+			m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, sp["arrays"])
+			_flora_meshes.append(m)
+		flora_ready = true
+	var i := 0
+	while i < _busy.size():
+		var p: Patch = _busy[i]
+		if not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(p.task):
+			i += 1
+			continue
+		if Time.get_ticks_usec() > deadline_us:
+			break
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(p.task)
+		p.task = -1
+		tasks -= 1
+		_busy.remove_at(i)
+		if p.arrays.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+		m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, p.arrays)
+		p.arrays = []
+		var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		mi.mesh = m
+		mi.material_override = material
+		mi.position = p.centre
+		mi.visible = false
+		mi.set_instance_shader_parameter("patch_centre", p.centre)
+		mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON if p.level >= max_level - 1 else GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+		add_child(mi)
+		p.mi = mi
+		p.ready = true
+		patches_made += 1
+		if p.rock_n > 0:
+			var mm := MultiMesh.new()
+			mm.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+			mm.use_custom_data = true
+			mm.mesh = rock_mesh()
+			mm.instance_count = p.rock_n
+			mm.buffer = p.rock_buf
+			var mmi := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+			mmi.multimesh = mm
+			mmi.material_override = _rock_mat
+			mmi.visibility_range_end = 260.0 if p.level < max_level else 140.0   # (the big ones further)
+			mmi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON if p.level < max_level else GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+			mi.add_child(mmi)
+		p.rock_buf = PackedFloat32Array()
+		for k in p.flora_buf:
+			var buf: PackedFloat32Array = p.flora_buf[k]
+			if buf.is_empty():
+				continue
+			var fm := MultiMesh.new()
+			fm.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+			fm.mesh = _flora_meshes[k]
+			fm.instance_count = buf.size() / 12
+			fm.buffer = buf
+			var fmi := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+			fmi.multimesh = fm
+			fmi.material_override = _flora_mat
+			var solid: bool = float(flora[k]["solid"]) > 0.0
+			fmi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON if solid else GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+			# (draw distances: the small plants only near - their patches' draw calls go)
+			fmi.visibility_range_end = {"grass": 42.0, "flower": 38.0, "bush": 80.0, "fungus": 100.0}.get(str(flora[k]["kind"]), 0.0)
+			if solid and p.level == max_level:
+				fmi.visibility_range_end = 0.0
+			mi.add_child(fmi)
+		p.flora_buf = {}
+
+
+func _visit(p: Patch) -> void:
+	var d := _cam_local.distance_to(p.centre)
+	var limit := p.size * SPLIT * (KEEP if not p.kids.is_empty() else 1.0)
+	if p.level < max_level and d < limit:
+		if p.kids.is_empty() and tasks < MAX_TASKS:
+			_split(p)
+		if not p.kids.is_empty() and _kids_ready(p):
+			_show(p, false)
+			p.sub = true
+			for k: Patch in p.kids:
+				_visit(k)
+			return
+	elif not p.kids.is_empty() and not _subtree_busy(p):
+		_drop_kids(p)
+	if p.mi:
+		_show(p, _in_sight(p))
+	if p.sub:
+		p.sub = false
+		for k: Patch in p.kids:
+			_hide(k)
+
+
+func _show(p: Patch, on: bool) -> void:
+	if p.shown != on and p.mi:
+		p.shown = on
+		p.mi.visible = on
+
+
+func _split(p: Patch) -> void:
+	var h := p.span * 0.5
+	for q in 4:
+		var k := Patch.new()
+		k.face = p.face
+		k.level = p.level + 1
+		k.span = h
+		k.a0 = p.a0 + h * (q % 2)
+		k.b0 = p.b0 + h * (q / 2)
+		_place(k)
+		p.kids.append(k)
+		_start(k)
+
+
+func _kids_ready(p: Patch) -> bool:
+	for k: Patch in p.kids:
+		if not k.ready:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+func _subtree_busy(p: Patch) -> bool:
+	for k: Patch in p.kids:
+		if k.task != -1 or _subtree_busy(k):
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+func _drop_kids(p: Patch) -> void:
+	for k: Patch in p.kids:
+		_drop_kids(k)
+		if k.mi:
+			k.mi.queue_free()
+	p.kids.clear()
+
+
+func _hide(p: Patch) -> void:
+	_show(p, false)
+	if p.sub:
+		p.sub = false
+		for k: Patch in p.kids:
+			_hide(k)
+
+
+## Not hidden behind the planet's own horizon (from the camera).
+func _in_sight(p: Patch) -> bool:
+	return acos(clampf(_cam_dir.dot(p.dir), -1.0, 1.0)) < _horizon + p.size / radius * 0.8
+
+
+## Leaf patches on screen (tests, the HUD's debug line).
+func shown_patches() -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	for c in get_children():
+		if c is MeshInstance3D and c.visible and c.material_override == material:
+			n += 1
+	return n
+
+
+## The finest level shown now.
+func deepest() -> int:
+	var best := 0
+	var stack := _roots.duplicate()
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var p: Patch = stack.pop_back()
+		if p.mi and p.mi.visible:
+			best = maxi(best, p.level)
+		stack.append_array(p.kids)
+	return best
+
+
+## Boulders within `reach` of planet-local `local` on the patches drawn now:
+## [planet-local position, radius] each.
+func rocks_near(local: Vector3, reach: float) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	var stack := _roots.duplicate()
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var p: Patch = stack.pop_back()
+		if p.centre.distance_to(local) > p.size + reach:
+			continue
+		if p.kids.is_empty() or not _kids_ready(p):
+			for r in p.rocks:
+				if (r[0] as Vector3).distance_to(local) < reach + r[1]:
+					out.append(r)
+		else:
+			stack.append_array(p.kids)
+	return out
+
+
+## The ground (or sea) under planet-local point `local`: metres above the radius.
+func ground_at(local: Vector3) -> float:
+	return shape.surface(local.normalized())
+
+
+func _add_sea(L: Dictionary, noise: Texture3D) -> void:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = WATER
+	m.set_shader_parameter("kind", shape.sea)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("shallow", L.get("water_shallow", Color(0.15, 0.45, 0.65)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("deep", L.get("water_deep", Color(0.05, 0.1, 0.35)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("ice", L.get("ice_color", Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.0)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("lava", L.get("lava_color", Color(1.0, 0.4, 0.05)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("lava_hot", L.get("lava_hot", Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.4)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", noise)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("radius", radius)
+	_sea_low = unit_sphere(64, 32)
+	_sea_high = unit_sphere(384, 192)
+	_sea_mi = _ball(radius, 64, 32, m, "Sea")
+
+
+func _add_clouds(L: Dictionary, noise: Texture3D) -> void:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = CLOUDS
+	m.render_priority = 1
+	m.set_shader_parameter("cover", float(L.get("clouds", 0.5)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("scale", float(L.get("cloud_scale", 2.2)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("tint", L.get("cloud_color", Color.WHITE))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("seed", float(L.get("seed", 0.0)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", noise)
+	_ball(radius + shape.top() * 1.3 + 40.0, 128, 64, m, "Clouds")
+
+
+func _add_atmosphere(col: Color, k: float) -> void:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = ATMO
+	m.set_shader_parameter("tint", col)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("strength", k)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("r_planet", radius)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("r_atmo", atmo_radius)
+	var mi := _ball(atmo_radius, 64, 32, m, "Atmosphere")
+	mi.extra_cull_margin = atmo_radius   # (never culled while you might be inside it)
+
+
+func _add_rings(L: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var inner := float(L.get("ring_inner", 1.4)) * radius
+	var outer := float(L.get("ring_outer", 2.2)) * radius
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	var n := 160
+	for i in n:
+		var a0 := TAU * i / n
+		var a1 := TAU * (i + 1) / n
+		var p := [Vector3(cos(a0) * inner, 0, sin(a0) * inner), Vector3(cos(a0) * outer, 0, sin(a0) * outer),
+			Vector3(cos(a1) * outer, 0, sin(a1) * outer), Vector3(cos(a1) * inner, 0, sin(a1) * inner)]
+		var uv := [Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(1, 0), Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(0, 1)]
+		for t in [0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]:
+			st.set_uv(uv[t])
+			st.set_normal(Vector3.UP)
+			st.add_vertex(p[t])
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = RING
+	m.set_shader_parameter("ring_a", L.get("ring_a", Color(0.8, 0.7, 0.6)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("ring_b", L.get("ring_b", Color(0.5, 0.45, 0.4)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("density", float(L.get("rings", 1.0)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("seed", float(L.get("seed", 0.0)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("r_planet", radius)
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.name = "Rings"
+	mi.mesh = st.commit()
+	mi.material_override = m
+	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	mi.rotation = Vector3(float(L.get("incline", 0.3)) * 0.6, 0.0, float(L.get("tilt", 0.2)))
+	add_child(mi)
+
+
+## A unit sphere of `radial` x `rings` segments - one of each kind for every
+## planet (seas, clouds, atmospheres, gas giants: scaled to their radius),
+## made once a run (CosmosWarm makes them at the title screen).
+static var _spheres := {}
+
+
+static func unit_sphere(radial: int, rings: int) -> SphereMesh:
+	var k := Vector2i(radial, rings)
+	if not _spheres.has(k):
+		var s := SphereMesh.new()
+		s.radius = 1.0
+		s.height = 2.0
+		s.radial_segments = radial
+		s.rings = rings
+		_spheres[k] = s
+	return _spheres[k]
+
+
+## A sphere instance of radius `r` (a shared unit sphere, scaled).
+func _ball(r: float, radial: int, rings: int, mat: Material, label: String) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.name = label
+	mi.mesh = unit_sphere(radial, rings)
+	mi.scale = Vector3.ONE * r
+	mi.material_override = mat
+	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	add_child(mi)
+	return mi
+
+
+func set_sun(dir: Vector3) -> void:
+	sun_dir = dir
+	for c in get_children():
+		if c is GeometryInstance3D and c.material_override is ShaderMaterial:
+			(c.material_override as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("sun_dir", dir)
+	if material:
+		material.set_shader_parameter("sun_dir", dir)
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	if _flora_task != -1:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_flora_task)
+		_flora_task = -1
+	for p: Patch in _busy:
+		if p.task != -1:
+			WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(p.task)
+			p.task = -1
+			tasks -= 1
+	_busy.clear()

files.explanation: The 3D world - space: An asteroid field in the 3D game (Cosmos): a few hundred rocks in a loose flattened cloud - three lumpy rock meshes (spheres pushed about by noise), drawn as multimeshes (one draw each), tumbling in their shader. `rocks` keeps every rock's place and size (the ship bumps into them).

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,71 @@ 
+class_name CosmosRocks
+extends Node3D
+## An asteroid field in the 3D game (Cosmos): a few hundred rocks in a loose
+## flattened cloud - three lumpy rock meshes (spheres pushed about by noise),
+## drawn as multimeshes (one draw each), tumbling in their shader. `rocks`
+## keeps every rock's place and size (the ship bumps into them).
+
+const COUNT := 320
+const SPREAD := 2600.0
+const SHADER := preload("res://shaders/world/rock.gdshader")
+
+var rocks: Array = []           # [local position, radius]
+
+
+func setup(seed: int, noise: Texture3D) -> void:
+	name = "Asteroids"
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = seed
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = SHADER
+	m.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", noise)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("tone", Color(0.42, 0.38, 0.34).lerp(Color(0.5, 0.42, 0.36), rng.randf()))
+	var kinds := 3
+	var per: Array = []
+	for k in kinds:
+		per.append([])
+	for i in COUNT:
+		var r := pow(rng.randf(), 2.2) * 70.0 + 4.0
+		var p := Vector3(rng.randfn(0.0, 1.0), rng.randfn(0.0, 0.25), rng.randfn(0.0, 1.0)) * SPREAD * 0.5
+		rocks.append([p, r])
+		per[i % kinds].append([p, r, rng.randf(), Vector3(rng.randf(), rng.randf(), rng.randf())])
+	for k in kinds:
+		var mm := MultiMesh.new()
+		mm.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+		mm.use_custom_data = true
+		mm.mesh = _rock_mesh(rng.randi())
+		mm.instance_count = per[k].size()
+		for i in per[k].size():
+			var e: Array = per[k][i]
+			var b := Basis.from_euler(e[3] * TAU).scaled(Vector3.ONE * e[1])
+			mm.set_instance_transform(i, Transform3D(b, e[0]))
+			mm.set_instance_custom_data(i, Color(e[3].x, e[3].y, e[3].z, e[2]))
+		var mmi := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+		mmi.multimesh = mm
+		mmi.material_override = m
+		add_child(mmi)
+
+
+## A lumpy unit rock: a sphere's vertices pushed in and out by noise.
+static func _rock_mesh(seed: int) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var s := SphereMesh.new()
+	s.radius = 1.0
+	s.height = 2.0
+	s.radial_segments = 20
+	s.rings = 10
+	var arr := s.get_mesh_arrays()
+	var n := FastNoiseLite.new()
+	n.seed = seed
+	n.frequency = 0.9
+	n.fractal_octaves = 3
+	var verts: PackedVector3Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	for i in verts.size():
+		var d := verts[i].normalized()
+		verts[i] = d * (1.0 + n.get_noise_3dv(d * 1.3) * 0.45) * Vector3(1.0, 0.75 + 0.2 * (seed % 3) / 2.0, 0.9)
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = verts
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = null
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT] = null
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.create_from_arrays(arr)
+	st.generate_normals()
+	return st.commit()

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,53 @@ 
+class_name CosmosStar
+extends Node3D
+## The system's star in the 3D game (Cosmos): a boiling sphere (its StarGen
+## colours - the 2D game's sun) and a glow around it seen from anywhere in the
+## system.
+
+const SIZE_TO_R := 9.0         # a 2D star's radius (px) -> its radius (m)
+const SHADER := preload("res://shaders/world/star.gdshader")
+const GLOW := preload("res://shaders/world/glow.gdshader")
+
+var radius := 8000.0
+var color := Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.6)
+
+
+func setup(system_id: String, noise: Texture3D) -> void:
+	name = "Star"
+	var t: Dictionary = Galaxy.STARS.get(str(Galaxy.system(system_id).get("star", "yellow")), Galaxy.STARS["yellow"])
+	radius = float(t["radius"]) * SIZE_TO_R
+	color = t["color"]
+	var spec := {}
+	if Galaxy.SYSTEMS.has(system_id):
+		spec = Galaxy.star_spec(system_id)
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = SHADER
+	m.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", noise)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("c_dark", spec.get("c_dark", color.darkened(0.6)))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("c_mid", spec.get("c_mid", color))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("c_hot", spec.get("c_hot", color.lightened(0.6)))
+	var s := SphereMesh.new()
+	s.radius = radius
+	s.height = radius * 2.0
+	s.radial_segments = 96
+	s.rings = 48
+	var body := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	body.name = "Body"
+	body.mesh = s
+	body.material_override = m
+	body.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	add_child(body)
+	for g in [[radius * 5.0, 0.9, 0.2], [radius * 16.0, 0.12, 0.0]]:
+		var gm := ShaderMaterial.new()
+		gm.shader = GLOW
+		gm.set_shader_parameter("tint", spec.get("c_corona", color))
+		gm.set_shader_parameter("intensity", g[1])
+		gm.set_shader_parameter("core", g[2])
+		var q := QuadMesh.new()
+		q.size = Vector2(g[0], g[0])
+		var glow := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		glow.mesh = q
+		glow.material_override = gm
+		glow.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+		glow.extra_cull_margin = g[0]
+		add_child(glow)

files.explanation: The 3D world - space: A space station (the 3D game): big - ~2.5 km across - and assembled from modular pieces by its seed and empire: a core tower of stacked sections, a habitat ring of segments on spokes, docking arms out from the core, each ending in a platform of landing pads (numbered, lit; two big ones for the largest freighters), solar wings, masts, window lights, a beacon - in its empire's colours (hull, paint, glow). Docking is flown by hand: ask for a pad (Cosmos.request_dock), fly to it, set down on it - its lift takes the ship into the hangar. Other ships use the pads too (CosmosNpcShip). Every part is a box or a cylinder: the camera and the ships bump into the parts themselves (Cosmos.solid_push), not a sphere round the station.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,379 @@ 
+class_name CosmosStation
+extends Node3D
+## A space station (the 3D game): big - ~2.5 km across - and assembled from
+## modular pieces by its seed and empire: a core tower of stacked sections,
+## a habitat ring of segments on spokes, docking arms out from the core, each
+## ending in a platform of landing pads (numbered, lit; two big ones for the
+## largest freighters), solar wings, masts, window lights, a beacon - in its
+## empire's colours (hull, paint, glow). Docking is flown by hand: ask for a
+## pad (Cosmos.request_dock), fly to it, set down on it - its lift takes the
+## ship into the hangar. Other ships use the pads too (CosmosNpcShip).
+## Every part is a box or a cylinder: the camera and the ships bump into the
+## parts themselves (Cosmos.solid_push), not a sphere round the station.
+
+const PAD_SMALL := 90.0        # m across: ships up to ~70 m
+const PAD_LARGE := 230.0       # the big freighters
+const STYLE := {               # [hull, dark, paint mix toward the accent]
+	"minoa": [Color(0.86, 0.85, 0.8), Color(0.2, 0.24, 0.26), 0.2], "athens": [Color(0.82, 0.86, 0.92), Color(0.16, 0.2, 0.3), 0.15],
+	"sparta": [Color(0.5, 0.42, 0.38), Color(0.18, 0.1, 0.09), 0.35], "mycenae": [Color(0.72, 0.6, 0.42), Color(0.22, 0.16, 0.1), 0.3],
+	"ionia": [Color(0.8, 0.82, 0.8), Color(0.14, 0.22, 0.2), 0.2], "cyclades": [Color(0.9, 0.9, 0.92), Color(0.18, 0.2, 0.28), 0.15],
+	"pirates": [Color(0.38, 0.34, 0.3), Color(0.12, 0.1, 0.09), 0.5]}
+
+var record := {}
+var reach := 1300.0            # (the HUD, clearances)
+var bay := Vector3.ZERO        # (kept for old callers: the first pad)
+## The pads: [{id, at (local, its top's middle), size, owner (a node or null), label}]
+var pads: Array = []
+var _ring: Node3D
+var _spin := 0.01
+var _mats := {}
+## The parts ships bump into: [in the ring?, centre, bound, inverse transform, half size, cylinder?, basis]
+var _solids: Array = []
+var _bound := 0.0
+
+
+func setup(st: Dictionary) -> void:
+	record = st
+	add_to_group("cam_solid")   # (the camera stops short of its parts)
+	set_meta("cam_reach", 2200.0)
+	name = str(st.get("name", "Station")).replace(" ", "_")
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = hash(str(st.get("id", name)))
+	var emp := str(st.get("empire", ""))
+	var accent: Color = Galaxy.empire_color(emp)
+	var sty: Array = STYLE.get(emp, STYLE["athens"])
+	_mats = {"hull": _mat(sty[0], 0.3, 0.5), "dark": _mat(sty[1], 0.45, 0.55), "paint": _mat((sty[0] as Color).lerp(accent, sty[2] + 0.35), 0.35, 0.45),
+		"glow": _mat(accent, 0.0, 0.5, accent * 2.2), "lights": _mat(Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.62), 0.0, 0.5, Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.55) * 2.2),
+		"pad": _mat(Color(0.2, 0.21, 0.23), 0.4, 0.7), "solar": _mat(Color(0.1, 0.14, 0.3), 0.8, 0.25)}
+	# The core: stacked sections, wider and narrower in turn.
+	var core_r := rng.randf_range(120.0, 170.0)
+	var y := -700.0
+	var k := 0
+	while y < 700.0:
+		var h := rng.randf_range(90.0, 220.0)
+		var r := core_r * (1.0 if k % 2 == 0 else rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.25))
+		_piece(_cyl(r, r, h, 24), "hull" if k % 3 else "paint", Vector3(0, y + h * 0.5, 0))
+		_piece(_cyl(r * 1.04, r * 1.04, 6.0, 24), "lights", Vector3(0, y + h * 0.5, 0))   # (a band of windows)
+		y += h
+		k += 1
+	_piece(_cyl(core_r * 0.3, core_r * 0.6, 140.0, 12), "dark", Vector3(0, y + 70.0, 0))
+	_piece(_cyl(4.0, 4.0, 260.0, 6), "dark", Vector3(0, y + 270.0, 0))
+	_piece(_sphere(12.0), "glow", Vector3(0, y + 405.0, 0)).name = "Beacon"
+	# The habitat ring: segments on spokes, turning slowly.
+	_ring = Node3D.new()
+	_ring.name = "Ring"
+	_ring.position.y = rng.randf_range(150.0, 400.0)
+	add_child(_ring)
+	var ring_r := rng.randf_range(800.0, 1000.0)
+	var segs := 36
+	for i in segs:
+		var a := TAU * i / segs
+		var painted := i % 4 == 0   # (a touch bigger than its plain neighbours: their faces never meet in one plane)
+		var seg := _piece(_box(Vector3(ring_r * TAU / segs * 1.02, 70.6 if painted else 70.0, 90.6 if painted else 90.0)), "paint" if painted else "hull", Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)) * ring_r, _ring)
+		seg.rotation.y = -a + PI * 0.5
+		var win := _piece(_box(Vector3(ring_r * TAU / segs * 0.8, 8.0, 2.0)), "lights", Vector3(cos(a), 0.4, sin(a)) * ring_r + Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)) * 46.0, _ring)
+		win.rotation.y = -a + PI * 0.5
+	for i in 4:
+		var a := TAU * i / 4 + PI * 0.25
+		var sp := _piece(_box(Vector3(ring_r - core_r, 26.0, 30.0)), "dark", Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)) * (ring_r + core_r) * 0.5, _ring)
+		sp.rotation.y = -a
+	reach = ring_r + 120.0
+	# Docking arms: out from the core, each with a platform of pads at its end.
+	var arms := 4
+	var pad_id := 1
+	for i in arms:
+		var a := TAU * i / arms + rng.randf_range(-0.1, 0.1)
+		var dir := Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a))
+		var arm_len := rng.randf_range(420.0, 560.0)
+		var arm_y := rng.randf_range(-450.0, -250.0)
+		var arm := _piece(_box(Vector3(arm_len, 30.0, 40.0)), "dark", dir * (core_r + arm_len * 0.5) + Vector3(0, arm_y, 0))
+		arm.rotation.y = -a
+		var big := i % 2 == 0
+		var pw := PAD_LARGE + 60.0 if big else PAD_SMALL * 3.0 + 80.0
+		var pd := PAD_LARGE + 60.0 if big else PAD_SMALL + 60.0
+		var centre := dir * (core_r + arm_len + pd * 0.5) + Vector3(0, arm_y, 0)
+		var plat := _piece(_box(Vector3(pd, 24.0, pw)), "hull", centre)
+		plat.rotation.y = -a
+		var side := dir.cross(Vector3.UP)
+		var n := 1 if big else 3
+		for j in n:
+			var size := PAD_LARGE if big else PAD_SMALL
+			var off := (j - (n - 1) * 0.5) * (PAD_SMALL + 20.0)
+			var at := centre + side * off + Vector3(0, 12.4, 0)   # (its top a little over the platform's: no flicker between them)
+			_pad(pad_id, at, size, -a)
+			pad_id += 1
+		# Floodlights over the platform (no shadows), the arm's guide lights.
+		var flood := OmniLight3D.new()
+		flood.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.75)
+		flood.light_energy = 3.0
+		flood.omni_range = pw * 1.3
+		flood.omni_attenuation = 0.6
+		flood.shadow_enabled = false
+		flood.position = centre + Vector3(0, 110.0, 0) - dir * pd * 0.3
+		add_child(flood)
+		for q in 6:
+			_piece(_box(Vector3(6, 6, 6)), "glow", dir * (core_r + arm_len * q / 6.0) + Vector3(0, arm_y + 18.0, 0))
+	# Solar wings and masts.
+	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		var wing := _piece(_box(Vector3(30, 30, 700)), "dark", Vector3(0, 560.0, s * (core_r + 350.0)))
+		for q in 3:
+			var p := _piece(_box(Vector3(220, 4, 200)), "solar", wing.position + Vector3(0, 0, s * (-200.0 + q * 210.0)))
+			p.rotation.z = 0.4
+	bay = pads[0]["at"] if not pads.is_empty() else Vector3.ZERO
+	rotation.y = rng.randf() * TAU
+	_collect_solids()
+	_merge()
+
+
+## The parts merged into one mesh per material (and per parent: the ring
+## turns) - a station of ~250 parts drawn in a dozen draw calls. Kept apart:
+## the pads' decks (their lifts move) and each pad's lights (lit for you).
+func _merge() -> void:
+	var groups := {}
+	for parent: Node3D in [self, _ring]:
+		for ch in parent.get_children():
+			var mi := ch as MeshInstance3D
+			if mi == null or mi.has_meta("keep"):
+				continue
+			var key := "%s|%s|%s" % [parent.get_instance_id(), mi.material_override.get_instance_id(), str(mi.get_meta("group", ""))]
+			if not groups.has(key):
+				groups[key] = [parent, mi.material_override, SurfaceTool.new(), mi.get_meta("group", "")]
+				(groups[key][2] as SurfaceTool).begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+			(groups[key][2] as SurfaceTool).append_from(mi.mesh, 0, mi.transform)
+			parent.remove_child(mi)
+			mi.free()
+	for key in groups:
+		var g: Array = groups[key]
+		var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		mi.mesh = (g[2] as SurfaceTool).commit()
+		mi.material_override = g[1]
+		(g[0] as Node3D).add_child(mi)
+		if str(g[3]) != "":
+			for p in pads:
+				if "pad%d" % int(p["id"]) == str(g[3]):
+					p["glows"] = [mi]
+
+
+## The camera's line from `o` along `dir`: where it first meets a part (or INF).
+func cam_hit(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, limit: float) -> float:
+	var lo := to_local(o)
+	var ld := global_basis.inverse() * dir
+	if lo.length() > _bound + limit:
+		return INF
+	var ring_inv := _ring.transform.affine_inverse()
+	var best := INF
+	for s in _solids:
+		var q: Vector3 = ring_inv * lo if s[0] else lo
+		var qd: Vector3 = ring_inv.basis * ld if s[0] else ld
+		var c: Vector3 = s[1]
+		var r: float = s[2]
+		# (a quick sphere test first)
+		var tc := (c - q).dot(qd)
+		if (q + qd * clampf(tc, 0.0, limit)).distance_squared_to(c) > r * r:
+			continue
+		var inv: Transform3D = s[3]
+		var a := inv * q
+		var d: Vector3 = inv.basis * qd
+		var h: Vector3 = s[4]
+		var t0 := 0.0
+		var t1 := minf(limit, best)
+		var hit := true
+		for k in 3:
+			if absf(d[k]) < 1e-8:
+				if absf(a[k]) > h[k]:
+					hit = false
+					break
+				continue
+			var ta := (-h[k] - a[k]) / d[k]
+			var tb := (h[k] - a[k]) / d[k]
+			if ta > tb:
+				var x := ta
+				ta = tb
+				tb = x
+			t0 = maxf(t0, ta)
+			t1 = minf(t1, tb)
+			if t0 > t1:
+				hit = false
+				break
+		if hit and t0 > 0.0:
+			best = t0
+	return best
+
+
+func _collect_solids() -> void:
+	for mi in find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
+		var m := mi as MeshInstance3D
+		if m.material_override == _mats["glow"] or m.material_override == _mats["lights"]:
+			continue
+		var in_ring := m.get_parent() == _ring
+		var half := Vector3.ZERO
+		var cyl := false
+		if m.mesh is BoxMesh:
+			half = (m.mesh as BoxMesh).size * 0.5
+		elif m.mesh is CylinderMesh:
+			var c := m.mesh as CylinderMesh
+			var r := maxf(c.top_radius, c.bottom_radius)
+			half = Vector3(r, c.height * 0.5, r)
+			cyl = true
+		else:
+			continue
+		var xf := m.transform
+		_solids.append([in_ring, xf.origin, half.length(), xf.affine_inverse(), half, cyl, xf.basis])
+		_bound = maxf(_bound, (xf.origin + (_ring.position if in_ring else Vector3.ZERO)).length() + half.length())
+
+
+## How far to move a ball (at `p`, radius `r`, in the world) to get it out of
+## the station's parts: the sum of the pushes (zero when clear).
+func push_out(p: Vector3, r: float) -> Vector3:
+	var lp := to_local(p)
+	if lp.length() > _bound + r:
+		return Vector3.ZERO
+	var rp := _ring.transform.affine_inverse() * lp
+	var total := Vector3.ZERO
+	for s in _solids:
+		var q: Vector3 = rp if s[0] else lp
+		var lim: float = float(s[2]) + r
+		if q.distance_squared_to(s[1]) > lim * lim:
+			continue
+		var l: Vector3 = s[3] * q
+		var h: Vector3 = s[4]
+		var push := Vector3.ZERO
+		if s[5]:
+			var rad := Vector2(l.x, l.z)
+			var rl := rad.length()
+			if absf(l.y) > h.y + r or rl > h.x + r:
+				continue
+			var side := h.x + r - rl
+			var cap := h.y + r - absf(l.y)
+			if side < cap:
+				push = Vector3(rad.x, 0, rad.y) / maxf(rl, 0.001) * side
+			else:
+				push = Vector3(0, signf(l.y) if l.y != 0.0 else 1.0, 0) * cap
+		else:
+			var c := l.clamp(-h, h)
+			var d := l - c
+			var dl := d.length()
+			if dl >= r:
+				continue
+			if dl > 0.0001:
+				push = d / dl * (r - dl)
+			else:
+				var best := INF
+				for a in 3:
+					var depth := h[a] - absf(l[a]) + r
+					if depth < best:
+						best = depth
+						push = Vector3.ZERO
+						push[a] = depth * (signf(l[a]) if l[a] != 0.0 else 1.0)
+		var b: Basis = s[6]
+		if s[0]:
+			b = _ring.basis * b
+		total += global_basis * (b * push)
+	return total
+
+
+## A landing pad: its deck, its edge lights, its number.
+func _pad(id: int, at: Vector3, size: float, yaw: float) -> void:
+	var deck := _piece(_box(Vector3(size, 2.0, size)), "pad", at - Vector3(0, 1.0, 0))
+	deck.name = "Pad%d" % id
+	deck.set_meta("keep", true)
+	deck.rotation.y = yaw
+	var glows: Array = []
+	for e in 4:
+		var a := yaw + e * PI * 0.5
+		var d := Vector3(cos(a), 0, -sin(a))
+		var strip := _piece(_box(Vector3(size * 0.96, 0.6, 2.0)), "glow", at + d.cross(Vector3.UP) * size * 0.48 + Vector3(0, 0.3, 0))
+		strip.rotation.y = a
+		strip.set_meta("group", "pad%d" % id)
+		glows.append(strip)
+	var l := Label3D.new()
+	l.text = str(id)
+	l.font_size = 512
+	l.pixel_size = size / 1400.0
+	l.position = at + Vector3(0, 0.6, 0)
+	l.rotation = Vector3(-PI * 0.5, yaw + PI * 0.5, 0)   # (read coming in from outside)
+	l.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8)
+	add_child(l)
+	pads.append({"id": id, "at": at, "size": size, "owner": null, "glows": glows, "yaw": yaw, "deck": deck, "label": l})
+
+
+## The pad's lift: its deck (and the ship on it) `depth` metres down.
+func lower_pad(p: Dictionary, depth: float) -> void:
+	(p["deck"] as Node3D).position = (p["at"] as Vector3) - Vector3(0, 1.0 + depth, 0)
+	(p["label"] as Node3D).position = (p["at"] as Vector3) + Vector3(0, 0.6 - depth, 0)
+
+
+## A pad free for a ship `length` long (the smallest that takes it), or {}.
+func free_pad(length: float, near := Vector3.ZERO) -> Dictionary:
+	var best := {}
+	for p in pads:
+		if p["owner"] != null and is_instance_valid(p["owner"]):
+			continue
+		if float(p["size"]) < length * 1.15:
+			continue
+		if best.is_empty() or float(p["size"]) < float(best["size"]) or (float(p["size"]) == float(best["size"]) and to_global(p["at"]).distance_to(near) < to_global(best["at"]).distance_to(near)):
+			best = p
+	return best
+
+
+## The pad's top, as a transform in the world (its up: the station's).
+func pad_transform(p: Dictionary) -> Transform3D:
+	var b := global_basis * Basis(Vector3.UP, float(p["yaw"]))
+	return Transform3D(b, to_global(p["at"]))
+
+
+## Lights a pad (assigned to you) or dims it.
+func light_pad(p: Dictionary, on: bool) -> void:
+	for g: MeshInstance3D in p.get("glows", []):
+		if is_instance_valid(g):
+			g.material_override = _mats["lights"] if on else _mats["glow"]
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _ring:
+		_ring.rotate_y(_spin * delta)
+
+
+func _piece(mesh: Mesh, mat: String, at: Vector3, parent: Node3D = null) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.mesh = mesh
+	mi.material_override = _mats[mat]
+	mi.position = at
+	(parent if parent else self).add_child(mi)
+	return mi
+
+
+static func _mat(c: Color, metal: float, rough: float, glow := Color.BLACK) -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	m.albedo_color = c
+	m.metallic = metal
+	m.roughness = rough
+	if glow != Color.BLACK:
+		m.emission_enabled = true
+		m.emission = glow
+	return m
+
+
+static func _box(s: Vector3) -> BoxMesh:
+	var b := BoxMesh.new()
+	b.size = s
+	return b
+
+
+static func _cyl(top: float, bottom: float, h: float, seg: int) -> CylinderMesh:
+	var c := CylinderMesh.new()
+	c.top_radius = top
+	c.bottom_radius = bottom
+	c.height = h
+	c.radial_segments = seg
+	c.rings = 1
+	return c
+
+
+static func _sphere(r: float) -> SphereMesh:
+	var s := SphereMesh.new()
+	s.radius = r
+	s.height = r * 2.0
+	s.radial_segments = 12
+	s.rings = 6
+	return s

bubbles.at: func push_out(p: Vector3, r: float) -> Vector3:

files.explanation: The 3D world - space: A planet's ground in the 3D game (Cosmos): one height field over the whole sphere - `height(dir)` metres above (or below) its radius, the same for the planet seen from orbit and the ground under your feet (CosmosPlanet builds its terrain patches from it, finer as you come closer; the ship's and the walker's collisions read it too). Continents, ridged mountain ranges, craters (moons) and a sea level, by the planet's type and its PlanetGen look (the 2D game's: the same colours, water level, ice, lava, clouds). Thread-safe: the noises are only read (patches are built on workers).

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,182 @@ 
+class_name PlanetShape
+extends RefCounted
+## A planet's ground in the 3D game (Cosmos): one height field over the whole
+## sphere - `height(dir)` metres above (or below) its radius, the same for the
+## planet seen from orbit and the ground under your feet (CosmosPlanet builds
+## its terrain patches from it, finer as you come closer; the ship's and the
+## walker's collisions read it too). Continents, ridged mountain ranges,
+## craters (moons) and a sea level, by the planet's type and its PlanetGen
+## look (the 2D game's: the same colours, water level, ice, lava, clouds).
+## Thread-safe: the noises are only read (patches are built on workers).
+
+const PX_TO_M := 10.0       # the 2D map's units -> metres (orbits, stations)
+const SIZE_TO_R := 4.0      # a 2D planet's size (px across) -> its radius (m)
+
+var radius := 3000.0
+var amp := 80.0             # the relief's scale (m): continents +-amp, ranges up to ~2 amp more
+var sea := 0                # 0 none, 1 water, 2 ice sheet, 3 lava
+var kind := "rocky"         # rocky / gas
+var look := {}              # PlanetGen params (colours etc.)
+var ridges := 0.5
+var craters := 0.0
+var shift := 0.0            # the continents' noise below this is under the sea
+## Level ground for the towns (CosmosTown): set_flats() once, before any
+## ground is built (then only read - by the workers too). Packed: height()
+## runs hundreds of times a frame.
+var flats: Array = []
+var _fdir := PackedVector3Array()   # each town's direction
+var _fin := PackedFloat32Array()    # cos of its level part's angle
+var _fout := PackedFloat32Array()   # cos of where it's blended back
+var _fh := PackedFloat32Array()     # radius + its height
+var _fclear := PackedFloat32Array() # cos of where nothing grows
+
+
+## [unit dir, cos in, cos out, height, cos clear] per town.
+func set_flats(list: Array) -> void:
+	flats = list
+	_fdir.clear()
+	_fin.clear()
+	_fout.clear()
+	_fh.clear()
+	_fclear.clear()
+	for f in list:
+		_fdir.append(f[0])
+		_fin.append(float(f[1]))
+		_fout.append(float(f[2]))
+		_fh.append(radius + float(f[3]))
+		_fclear.append(float(f[4]))
+
+
+var _cont := FastNoiseLite.new()
+var _ridge := FastNoiseLite.new()
+var _mid := FastNoiseLite.new()
+var _fine := FastNoiseLite.new()
+var _crater := FastNoiseLite.new()
+
+
+## The shape of a planet record ({type, template, variant, size, seed}).
+static func of(rec: Dictionary) -> PlanetShape:
+	var s := PlanetShape.new()
+	s.look = PlanetGen.generate(str(rec.get("template", "barren")), int(rec.get("variant", 0)))
+	s.radius = float(rec.get("size", 500.0)) * SIZE_TO_R
+	var type := str(rec.get("type", "moon"))
+	s.kind = "gas" if int(s.look.get("mode", 0)) == 1 or type == "gas_giant" else "rocky"
+	var seed := int(rec.get("seed", 1))
+	var ts := float(s.look.get("terrain_scale", 2.2))
+	s.ridges = float(s.look.get("ridges", 0.5))
+	s.craters = float(s.look.get("craters", 0.0))
+	s.amp = s.radius * (0.022 + 0.012 * s.ridges)
+	var wl := float(s.look.get("water_level", -1.0))
+	match type:
+		"ocean":
+			s.sea = 1
+		"ice":
+			s.sea = 2
+		"volcanic":
+			s.sea = 3
+			wl = 0.42
+		_:
+			s.sea = 1 if wl > 0.0 else 0
+	s.shift = (wl - 0.5) * 0.9 if s.sea > 0 else -0.25
+	for n: FastNoiseLite in [s._cont, s._ridge, s._mid, s._fine, s._crater]:
+		n.seed = seed
+		seed = seed * 7919 + 13
+	s._cont.noise_type = FastNoiseLite.TYPE_SIMPLEX_SMOOTH
+	s._cont.frequency = ts * 0.5
+	s._cont.fractal_type = FastNoiseLite.FRACTAL_FBM
+	s._cont.fractal_octaves = 7
+	s._cont.fractal_gain = 0.45
+	s._cont.domain_warp_enabled = true
+	s._cont.domain_warp_amplitude = 0.08 + 0.18 * float(s.look.get("warp", 0.5))
+	s._cont.domain_warp_frequency = ts * 0.35
+	# (the warp's own octaves: two, doubling - its defaults, five at x6 each,
+	# warp the ground by tens of metres every 17 m: a field of needles)
+	s._cont.domain_warp_fractal_octaves = 2
+	s._cont.domain_warp_fractal_lacunarity = 2.0
+	s._cont.domain_warp_fractal_gain = 0.5
+	s._ridge.noise_type = FastNoiseLite.TYPE_SIMPLEX_SMOOTH
+	s._ridge.frequency = ts * 0.8
+	s._ridge.fractal_type = FastNoiseLite.FRACTAL_RIDGED
+	s._ridge.fractal_octaves = 5
+	s._ridge.fractal_gain = 0.45
+	s._mid.noise_type = FastNoiseLite.TYPE_SIMPLEX_SMOOTH
+	s._mid.frequency = 1.0 / 240.0          # (metres) hills between the big octaves
+	s._mid.fractal_type = FastNoiseLite.FRACTAL_FBM
+	s._mid.fractal_octaves = 3
+	s._fine.noise_type = FastNoiseLite.TYPE_SIMPLEX
+	s._fine.frequency = 1.0 / 18.0          # (metres) the ground underfoot
+	s._fine.fractal_type = FastNoiseLite.FRACTAL_FBM
+	s._fine.fractal_octaves = 2
+	s._crater.noise_type = FastNoiseLite.TYPE_CELLULAR
+	s._crater.cellular_return_type = FastNoiseLite.RETURN_DISTANCE
+	s._crater.cellular_distance_function = FastNoiseLite.DISTANCE_EUCLIDEAN
+	s._crater.cellular_jitter = 0.85
+	s._crater.frequency = float(s.look.get("crater_scale", 2.5)) * 2.2
+	s._crater.fractal_type = FastNoiseLite.FRACTAL_NONE
+	return s
+
+
+## Metres above the radius at unit direction `d` (from the planet's centre).
+func height(d: Vector3) -> float:
+	var h := raw_height(d)
+	for i in _fdir.size():
+		var c := d.dot(_fdir[i])
+		if c > _fout[i]:   # (the town's plane, through its middle, flat - not round)
+			h = lerpf(h, _fh[i] / c - radius, smoothstep(_fout[i], _fin[i], c))
+	return h
+
+
+## True where a town stands (no boulders or plants).
+func cleared(d: Vector3) -> bool:
+	for i in _fdir.size():
+		if d.dot(_fdir[i]) > _fclear[i]:
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## The land as the noises make it (before the towns' levelling).
+func raw_height(d: Vector3) -> float:
+	if kind == "gas":
+		return 0.0
+	var e := _cont.get_noise_3dv(d) - shift
+	var m := _ridge.get_noise_3dv(d) * 0.5 + 0.5
+	var h := e * amp
+	# Mountain ranges on land, rising from the coasts inland.
+	h += ridges * amp * 1.6 * m * m * m * smoothstep(-0.02, 0.3, e)
+	if craters > 0.0:
+		var c := _crater.get_noise_3dv(d) * 0.5 + 0.5      # 0 at a crater's middle
+		var bowl := smoothstep(0.05, 0.45, c) - 1.0
+		var rim := exp(-pow((c - 0.47) * 9.0, 2.0)) * 0.45
+		h += craters * amp * 0.9 * (bowl + rim)
+	var p := d * radius
+	h += _mid.get_noise_3dv(p) * (2.5 + amp * 0.035)
+	h += _fine.get_noise_3dv(p) * 1.4
+	if sea > 0 and h < 0.0:
+		h *= 0.55          # (gentler sea floors)
+	elif sea > 0 and h < amp * 0.05:
+		h *= lerpf(0.4, 1.0, h / (amp * 0.05))   # (beaches: flat near the shore)
+	return h
+
+
+## The ground's height at `d`, or the sea's (0) if that's above it.
+func surface(d: Vector3) -> float:
+	var h := height(d)
+	return maxf(h, 0.0) if sea > 0 else h
+
+
+## The highest the ground gets (m above the radius) - bounds, horizons.
+func top() -> float:
+	return amp * (1.0 + ridges * 1.7) + 12.0
+
+
+## Unit cube face `f`'s axes: normal n, and u, v across it (u x v = n).
+static func face_axes(f: int) -> Array:
+	var n: Vector3 = [Vector3.RIGHT, Vector3.LEFT, Vector3.UP, Vector3.DOWN, Vector3.BACK, Vector3.FORWARD][f]
+	var u := Vector3(n.y, n.z, n.x)
+	return [n, u, n.cross(u)]
+
+
+## The direction of cube face point (a, b) in [-1, 1]^2 (the tangent warp
+## evens the patches' sizes over the face).
+static func face_dir(n: Vector3, u: Vector3, v: Vector3, a: float, b: float) -> Vector3:
+	return (n + u * tan(a * PI * 0.25) + v * tan(b * PI * 0.25)).normalized()

files.explanation: The 3D world - stations: A station's hangar in the 3D game (stage 4) - where your ship sets down when you dock: a great hall (built when you dock, freed when you leave) with a landing pad, the bay's mouth open to space behind a shimmering field, light panels overhead, cargo stacked about, cranes, the crew going about their work (automatons), and terminals along the back wall - the market, outfitting, missions, repairs (Stage 5 opens them). You walk its deck on foot (CosmosWalker's deck mode: floor at y = 0 in its own space, walls at BOUNDS).

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,179 @@ 
+class_name CosmosHangar
+extends Node3D
+## A station's hangar in the 3D game (stage 4) - where your ship sets down
+## when you dock: a great hall (built when you dock, freed when you leave)
+## with a landing pad, the bay's mouth open to space behind a shimmering
+## field, light panels overhead, cargo stacked about, cranes, the crew going
+## about their work (automatons), and terminals along the back wall - the
+## market, outfitting, missions, repairs (Stage 5 opens them). You walk its
+## deck on foot (CosmosWalker's deck mode: floor at y = 0 in its own space,
+## walls at BOUNDS).
+
+const BOUNDS := Vector3(80.0, 34.0, 60.0)    # half sizes (x, height, z): a ~50 m ship on its pad, room round it
+const PAD := Vector3(0, 0, 0)
+## [label, the Station Menu's tab] (StationMenu.TABS: REPAIR, MARKET, OUTFITTING, SHIPYARD, DESIGNER, SELL, REPUTATION, MAIN QUESTS, MISSIONS)
+const TERMINALS := [["Repair", 0], ["Market", 1], ["Outfitting", 2], ["Shipyard", 3], ["Designer", 4], ["Reputation", 6], ["Missions", 8]]
+const CREW := 5
+
+var station: CosmosStation
+var terminals: Array = []       # [label, id, local position]
+var _crew: Array = []           # [node, anim, goal]
+var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+
+
+func setup(st: CosmosStation) -> void:
+	station = st
+	add_to_group("cam_solid")   # (the camera stops short of its parts)
+	set_meta("cam_reach", 90.0)
+	name = "Hangar"
+	_rng.seed = hash(str(st.record.get("id", "")))
+	var accent: Color = Galaxy.empire_color(str(st.record.get("empire", "")))
+	var floor_m := CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.28, 0.29, 0.31), 0.4, 0.6)
+	var wall := CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.5, 0.52, 0.55), 0.5, 0.5)
+	var dark := CosmosStation._mat(Color(0.16, 0.17, 0.19), 0.6, 0.5)
+	var lamp := CosmosStation._mat(Color(1, 0.95, 0.85), 0.0, 0.5, Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.85) * 4.0)
+	var paint := CosmosStation._mat(accent.darkened(0.2), 0.3, 0.5)
+	var glow := CosmosStation._mat(accent, 0.0, 0.5, accent * 3.0)
+	var B := BOUNDS
+	_box(Vector3(B.x * 2, 1, B.z * 2), Vector3(0, -0.5, 0), floor_m)
+	# (the shell casts no shadows: the "sun" in here is the ceiling's lights)
+	for b in [_box(Vector3(B.x * 2, 1, B.z * 2), Vector3(0, B.y + 0.5, 0), dark),
+			_box(Vector3(1, B.y, B.z * 2), Vector3(-B.x - 0.5, B.y * 0.5, 0), wall),
+			_box(Vector3(1, B.y, B.z * 2), Vector3(B.x + 0.5, B.y * 0.5, 0), wall),
+			_box(Vector3(B.x * 2, B.y, 1), Vector3(0, B.y * 0.5, B.z + 0.5), wall)]:
+		b.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	# The bay's mouth (-z): a frame, the field across it.
+	_box(Vector3(B.x * 2, 4, 1.5), Vector3(0, B.y - 2, -B.z), paint).cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	_box(Vector3(3, B.y, 1.5), Vector3(-B.x + 1.5, B.y * 0.5, -B.z), paint)
+	_box(Vector3(3, B.y, 1.5), Vector3(B.x - 1.5, B.y * 0.5, -B.z), paint)
+	var field := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	var q := QuadMesh.new()
+	q.size = Vector2(B.x * 2 - 6, B.y - 4)
+	field.mesh = q
+	var fm := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	fm.shader = preload("res://shaders/world/gate.gdshader")
+	fm.set_shader_parameter("tint", accent.lerp(Color(0.5, 0.8, 1.0), 0.5) * 0.35)
+	fm.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", Cosmos.noise_ready())
+	field.material_override = fm
+	field.position = Vector3(0, (B.y - 4) * 0.5, -B.z)
+	field.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	add_child(field)
+	# The pad: rings of light.
+	_box(Vector3(70, 0.2, 70), PAD + Vector3(0, 0.05, 0), dark)
+	for r in [32.0, 33.0]:
+		var t := TorusMesh.new()
+		t.inner_radius = r - 0.15
+		t.outer_radius = r + 0.15
+		t.rings = 64
+		t.ring_segments = 4
+		var ring := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		ring.mesh = t
+		ring.material_override = glow
+		ring.position = PAD + Vector3(0, 0.2, 0)
+		add_child(ring)
+	# Light panels overhead, stripes on the walls.
+	for i in 4:
+		for j in 3:
+			_box(Vector3(18, 0.3, 4), Vector3(-54 + i * 36, B.y - 0.2, -36 + j * 36), lamp).cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		_box(Vector3(0.3, 0.6, B.z * 1.8), Vector3(side * (B.x - 0.1), 6, 0), glow)
+	# Cargo stacks and a crane.
+	for k in 14:
+		var s := _rng.randf_range(1.6, 3.2)
+		var at := Vector3(_rng.randf_range(-B.x + 4, B.x - 4), 0, _rng.randf_range(-B.z + 8, B.z - 4))
+		if at.distance_to(PAD) < 40.0 or at.z > B.z - 10:
+			continue
+		for h in _rng.randi_range(1, 3):
+			_box(Vector3(s, s, s * 1.4), at + Vector3(0, s * (h + 0.5) - s * 0.5 + s * 0.5 * 0.0, 0), paint if (k + h) % 3 == 0 else dark).rotation.y = _rng.randf() * 0.4
+	_box(Vector3(1.2, B.y - 2, 1.2), Vector3(-B.x + 8, (B.y - 2) * 0.5, B.z - 8), dark)
+	_box(Vector3(24, 1.2, 1.2), Vector3(-B.x + 18, B.y - 3, B.z - 8), dark)
+	# Terminals along the back wall.
+	for i in TERMINALS.size():
+		var x := lerpf(-B.x + 10, B.x - 10, float(i) / (TERMINALS.size() - 1))
+		var at := Vector3(x, 0, B.z - 1.8)
+		_box(Vector3(2.2, 1.2, 0.9), at + Vector3(0, 0.6, 0), dark)
+		var scr := _box(Vector3(2.0, 1.3, 0.12), at + Vector3(0, 1.9, -0.1), glow)
+		scr.rotation.x = -0.25
+		var l := Label3D.new()
+		l.text = TERMINALS[i][0]
+		l.font_size = 72
+		l.pixel_size = 0.01
+		l.position = at + Vector3(0, 3.3, 0)
+		l.modulate = accent.lerp(Color.WHITE, 0.5)
+		l.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
+		add_child(l)
+		terminals.append([TERMINALS[i][0], TERMINALS[i][1], at + Vector3(0, 0, -1.2)])
+	# The crew.
+	if Stage3D.has_model("player"):
+		for i in CREW:
+			var m: Node3D = Stage3D._scene("player").instantiate()
+			CosmosModels.apply(m, "player")
+			var holder := Node3D.new()
+			holder.add_child(m)
+			m.rotation.y = PI
+			add_child(holder)
+			holder.position = Vector3(_rng.randf_range(-B.x + 6, B.x - 6), 0, _rng.randf_range(0, B.z - 6))
+			var anim: AnimationPlayer = m.find_child("AnimationPlayer", true, false)
+			if anim and anim.has_animation("walk"):
+				anim.get_animation("walk").loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR
+				anim.get_animation("idle").loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR
+				anim.play("idle")
+			_crew.append([holder, anim, holder.position, _rng.randf_range(1.0, 4.0)])
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	for c in _crew:
+		var n: Node3D = c[0]
+		var anim: AnimationPlayer = c[1]
+		c[3] -= delta
+		if c[3] <= 0.0:
+			c[3] = _rng.randf_range(3.0, 8.0)
+			c[2] = Vector3(_rng.randf_range(-BOUNDS.x + 6, BOUNDS.x - 6), 0, _rng.randf_range(-BOUNDS.z + 10, BOUNDS.z - 6))
+			if (c[2] as Vector3).distance_to(PAD) < 36.0:
+				c[2] = Vector3(signf((c[2] as Vector3).x + 0.01) * 50.0, 0, (c[2] as Vector3).z)
+		var to: Vector3 = c[2] - n.position
+		to.y = 0.0
+		if to.length() > 0.5:
+			n.position += to.normalized() * minf(1.6 * delta, to.length())
+			n.rotation.y = atan2(-to.x, -to.z)
+			if anim and anim.current_animation != "walk":
+				anim.play("walk", 0.2)
+		elif anim and anim.current_animation != "idle":
+			anim.play("idle", 0.2)
+
+
+func _box(size: Vector3, at: Vector3, mat: Material) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.mesh = CosmosStation._box(size)
+	mi.material_override = mat
+	mi.position = at
+	add_child(mi)
+	return mi
+
+
+## The terminal within reach of hangar-local `p`, or [].
+func terminal_near(p: Vector3) -> Array:
+	for t in terminals:
+		if (t[2] as Vector3).distance_to(Vector3(p.x, 0, p.z)) < 2.6:
+			return t
+	return []
+
+
+# --- The walker's deck (as CosmosShipInterior's) ---------------------------------
+
+func floor_y(_l: Vector3) -> float:
+	return 0.0
+
+
+func ceiling_y(_l: Vector3) -> float:
+	return BOUNDS.y
+
+
+func confine(l: Vector3, m: float) -> Vector3:
+	var c := inside(l, m)
+	return Vector3(c.x, l.y, c.z)
+
+
+## Keeps hangar-local `p` inside the walls (a margin `m` in).
+static func inside(p: Vector3, m: float) -> Vector3:
+	return Vector3(clampf(p.x, -BOUNDS.x + m, BOUNDS.x - m), clampf(p.y, 0.0, BOUNDS.y - m), clampf(p.z, -BOUNDS.z + m, BOUNDS.z - m))

A 3D world shader: A planet's atmosphere (CosmosPlanet): a shell drawn from the inside (its far side), each pixel working out the stretch of air its view ray crosses - from the camera (or where the ray enters the shell) to the ground, the first thing in the depth buffer, or out of the shell - in four samples of a density thinning with height, each lit by the star (orange where the light grazes). The light it scatters is added; the air's thickness dims what's behind (stars hide in a day sky). So: a halo round the planet from space, a sky from the ground, haze over distant hills.

+		c.ship.global_position = lr.global_position + Vector3(900, 120, 300)
+		c.ship.look_at(lr.global_position, Vector3.UP)
+		c.cam._q = c.ship.global_basis.get_rotation_quaternion()
+		c._lairs_tick()
+		var mon = lr.monster
+		for i in 200:
+			await process_frame
+			if mon and mon.built:
+				break
+		mon.global_position = c.ship.global_position - c.ship.global_basis.z * mon.length * 1.6
+		mon.look_at(c.ship.global_position, Vector3.UP)
+		c.target = mon
+		await _snap("space3d_monster", 2.5)
+	# Docked: the hangar.
+	for x in c.npc_ships:
+		if is_instance_valid(x):

+	c.npc_ships.clear()
+	c._pirate_cd = 9999.0
+	c._place_ship()
+	c.dry_run = true
+	# Manual docking: over the pad the station gave you, coming down on the thrusters.
+	c.request_dock()
+	var st: Node3D = c.dock_station
+	var xf: Transform3D = st.pad_transform(c.dock_pad)
+	var out: Vector3 = (xf.origin - st.global_position)
+	out = (out - xf.basis.y * out.dot(xf.basis.y)).normalized()
+	var at: Vector3 = xf.origin + xf.basis.y * 75.0 + out * 170.0
+	c.ship.global_transform = Transform3D(c._level(-out, xf.basis.y), at)
+	c.ship.velocity = Vector3.ZERO

+	c.cam.follow(1.0)
+	await _snap("space3d_pad", 2.0)
+	c.ship.drive = {}

+		await process_frame
+	c.disembark()   # (down the ramp onto the hangar's deck)
+	c.walker.heading = c.hangar.global_basis.z   # (away from the ship: the crew, the terminals)
+	c.cam.foot_zoom = 2.4
+	await _snap("space3d_hangar", 2.5)
+	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE

+	check(c.ship.global_basis.y.dot(local.normalized()) > 0.99, "level with the planet's up")

+	w.drive = {"move": Vector2(0, 1)}

+		last = w.global_position
+	w.drive = {}
+	check(w.deck == null and w.planet == pl, "down the ramp: on the planet's ground")
+	check(jump < 0.5, "walked out, no jump on the way (largest step %.2f m)" % jump)
+	for k in 30:

+	check(w.on_ground and absf(w.height_above_ground()) < 0.1, "standing on the ground (%.2f m)" % w.height_above_ground())
+	var p0 := w.global_position
+	w.drive = {"move": Vector2(0, 1), "run": true}
+	for k in 90:

@@ -1,0 +1,186 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Packs a character's rendered animation frames into the game's atlases.
+
+  python3 tools/puppet_atlas.py <skin> [--id <art id>] [--page 2048]
+
+Reads external/blender/automaton/renders/<skin>/<clip>_<dir>_<frame>.png (all
+from one orthographic camera, transparent; build.py renders them) and its
+meta.json, and writes art/<id>_clips/ (SheetPuppet's clip mode):
+
+  p00.png, p01.png ...   pages of trimmed frames (identical pictures stored once)
+  clips.json             {"fps", "stand_h" (px: the standing figure's height),
+                          "pages", "clips": {name: {"loop", "gun", "marks", "air": [px per frame],
+                          "points": {name: {dir: [x, y]}}, "frames": {dir: [[page, x, y, w, h, ox, oy]...]}}}}
+                         (ox, oy: the trimmed picture's corner from the point the character stands on)
+  <id>_idle_s.png        the standing picture on its own (the health gauge's outline, portraits)
+  web/                   the same at half size (web builds: phones)
+
+The pages' .import files are written here too (VRAM compressed, high quality,
+on desktops; lossless at half size for the web) - Godot keeps what it finds.
+Skins: automaton -> player, pirate -> pirate.
+"""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+
+from PIL import Image
+
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+RENDERS = os.path.join(ROOT, "external", "blender", "automaton", "renders")
+IDS = {"automaton": "player", "pirate": "pirate"}
+DIRS = ["e", "se", "s", "sw", "w", "nw", "n", "ne"]
+PAD = 2
+
+IMPORT = """[remap]
+
+importer="texture"
+type="CompressedTexture2D"
+
+[params]
+
+compress/mode=%d
+compress/high_quality=true
+compress/lossy_quality=0.7
+compress/hdr_compression=1
+compress/normal_map=0
+compress/channel_pack=0
+mipmaps/generate=false
+mipmaps/limit=-1
+roughness/mode=0
+roughness/src_normal=""
+process/fix_alpha_border=true
+process/premult_alpha=false
+process/normal_map_invert_y=false
+process/hdr_as_srgb=false
+process/hdr_clamp_exposure=false
+process/size_limit=0
+detect_3d/compress_to=0
+"""
+
+
+def pack(items, page):
+    """Shelf packing, tallest first: items [(key, w, h)] -> {key: (page, x, y)}, pages."""
+    order = sorted(items, key=lambda it: (-it[2], -it[1]))
+    out = {}
+    pages = 0
+    shelves = []          # [page, y, h, x]
+    for key, w, h in order:
+        w2, h2 = w + PAD, h + PAD
+        put = None
+        for s in shelves:
+            if s[2] >= h2 and s[3] + w2 <= page:
+                put = s
+                break
+        if put is None:
+            p = pages - 1
+            y = 0
+            last = [s for s in shelves if s[0] == p]
+            if last:
+                y = last[-1][1] + last[-1][2]
+            if pages == 0 or y + h2 > page:
+                pages += 1
+                p = pages - 1
+                y = 0
+            put = [p, y, h2, 0]
+            shelves.append(put)
+        out[key] = (put[0], put[3], put[1])
+        put[3] += w2
+    return out, pages
+
+
+def build(skin, art_id, page, scale, out_dir, compress_mode):
+    src = os.path.join(RENDERS, skin)
+    meta = json.load(open(os.path.join(src, "meta.json")))
+    gx, gy = meta["ground"]
+    files = {}
+    for f in os.listdir(src):
+        m = re.match(r"^(.+)_(e|se|s|sw|w|nw|n|ne)_(\d+)\.png$", f)
+        if m:
+            files[(m.group(1), m.group(2), int(m.group(3)))] = os.path.join(src, f)
+    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    for f in os.listdir(out_dir):
+        if re.match(r"^p\d+\.png$", f):
+            os.remove(os.path.join(out_dir, f))
+    uniq = {}        # hash -> (image, w, h)
+    frames = {}      # (clip, dir, i) -> (hash, ox, oy)
+    for key in sorted(files):
+        im = Image.open(files[key]).convert("RGBA")
+        g0x, g0y = gx, gy
+        if scale != 1.0:
+            size = (max(1, round(im.width * scale)), max(1, round(im.height * scale)))
+            im = im.convert("RGBa").resize(size, Image.LANCZOS).convert("RGBA")
+            g0x, g0y = gx * scale, gy * scale
+        bb = im.getchannel("A").point(lambda v: 255 if v > 6 else 0).getbbox()
+        if bb is None:
+            bb = (0, 0, 1, 1)
+        im = im.crop(bb)
+        h = hashlib.md5(im.tobytes() + bytes(str(im.size), "ascii")).hexdigest()
+        if h not in uniq:
+            uniq[h] = im
+        frames[key] = (h, round(bb[0] - g0x, 1), round(bb[1] - g0y, 1))
+    where, pages = pack([(h, im.width, im.height) for h, im in uniq.items()], page)
+    sheets = [Image.new("RGBA", (page, page), (0, 0, 0, 0)) for _ in range(pages)]
+    for h, im in uniq.items():
+        p, x, y = where[h]
+        sheets[p].paste(im, (x, y))
+    for i, s in enumerate(sheets):
+        path = os.path.join(out_dir, "p%02d.png" % i)
+        if i == pages - 1:               # (the last page: only as tall as it's filled)
+            bb = s.getbbox()
+            s = s.crop((0, 0, page, min(page, ((bb[3] + 3) // 4 + 1) * 4))) if bb else s
+        s.save(path)
+        imp = path + ".import"
+        if not os.path.exists(imp) or ("compress/mode=%d" % compress_mode) not in open(imp).read():
+            open(imp, "w").write(IMPORT % compress_mode)
+    clips = {}
+    for name, c in meta["clips"].items():
+        fr = {}
+        for d in DIRS:
+            row = []
+            for i in range(c["frames"]):
+                if (name, d, i) not in frames:
+                    row = None
+                    break
+                h, ox, oy = frames[(name, d, i)]
+                p, x, y = where[h]
+                row.append([p, x, y, uniq[h].width, uniq[h].height, ox, oy])
+            if row is None:
+                fr = None
+                break
+            fr[d] = row
+        if fr is None:
+            print("  (not rendered: %s)" % name)
+            continue
+        pts = {k: {d: [round(v[0] * scale, 1), round(v[1] * scale, 1)] for d, v in per.items()} for k, per in c.get("points", {}).items()}
+        clips[name] = {"loop": c["loop"], "gun": c["gun"], "marks": c["marks"], "air": [round(a * scale, 1) for a in c["air"]],
+                       "points": pts, "frames": fr}
+    stand = "gun_idle" if "gun_idle" in clips else "idle"
+    h0 = frames[(stand, "s", 0)][0]
+    stand_h = uniq[h0].height
+    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "clips.json"), "w") as fh:
+        json.dump({"fps": meta["fps"], "stand_h": stand_h, "pages": pages, "px_per_m": meta["px_per_m"] * scale, "clips": clips},
+                  fh, separators=(",", ":"))
+    portrait = "idle" if "idle" in clips else stand
+    uniq[frames[(portrait, "s", 0)][0]].save(os.path.join(out_dir, "%s_idle_s.png" % art_id))
+    px = sum(im.width * im.height for im in uniq.values())
+    print("%s -> %s: %d frames (%d different), %d page(s) of %d px, %.1f M px, standing %d px" % (
+        skin, os.path.relpath(out_dir, ROOT), len(frames), len(uniq), pages, page, px / 1e6, stand_h))
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("skin")
+    ap.add_argument("--id", default=None)
+    ap.add_argument("--page", type=int, default=2048)
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    art_id = a.id or IDS.get(a.skin, a.skin)
+    out = os.path.join(ROOT, "art", art_id + "_clips")
+    build(a.skin, art_id, a.page, 1.0, out, 2)
+    build(a.skin, art_id, a.page, 0.5, os.path.join(out, "web"), 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
